ra chab / bzhugs/ bzhugasas so

༄༅ / /'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po rlabs chen spyod pa'i sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa las byung bas/ /skyon gyi dri mas dben zhing yon tan dkyil 'khor rab rgyas mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar /gzugs sku nyin byed gzhon nu stong gsum mi mjed zhing 'di'i gdul bya yongs kyi dpal du shar/ /'gro kun rmongs pa'i mun sel phan bde'i pad tshal yongs 'phel zas gtsang sras po gang de rgyal/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po la/ /ma rtogs log rtog dri mas gos pa 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bye dor byas/ /thos bsam sgom gsum rgyal mtshan rtser mchod mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin phabs/ /skye dgu'i dbul phongs sel mdzad sras kyi thu bo mi pham 'jam dbyangs dang / /klu sgrub thogs med la sogs rgya gar mkhas grub 1

thams cad phyag gi yul/ /ngo mtshar gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu de dag kun/ /skye dgu rnams kyi srid zhi'i dbul ba sel slad du/ /dka' ba du mas gangs can ljongs 'dir 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa sku drin dran na cis mi dad/ /nam yang 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams rin chen kun gyi mdzod 'dzin mnyam med jo bo chen po dang / /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa rnam gsum rim par legs byon nas/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa spel nas 'gro la bde skyid byung bas sku drin bsam na su yis 'khor/ /gsung rab nor bu'i sgom gyi kha phyes nas/ /'phangs pa med par gnang ba'i bla ma rnams/ /rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /bsam gyen bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /da ni rang nyid nam 'chi nges pa med/ /bla ma'i drin las rang gis gang thob pa'i/ /ngo mtshar gsung rab rin chen dga' ston 'gyed/ /skal ldan snying gi bu rnams gus pas longs/ /zhes zhing mchog dam pa de dag rnams la bstod tshig me tog gi mchod pas sngun bsus te bar skabs kyi brjod bya'i don ni/ de yang 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren dam pa/ snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo ba'i tshe/ snying 2

stobs btsan pa'i go cha ma smad par gyon pa'i/ mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po zhes rnam 'dren rgyal ba stong gi nang nas kyang pad dkar lta bur shin tu bsngags shing / snyan grags chen po srid pa'i ra ba las brgal te/ nam mkha'i pha mtha' bsnyegs pa gang des/ phyogs bcu'i zhing kun 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor bas/ ngo mtshar gsung rab yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnams sras kyi thu bo byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs/ de'i sras klu sgrub dang thogs med sogs mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam gyis rim bzhin ma rtogs log rtog glo bur gyi dri mas gos pa rnams/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bye dor yang yang byas/thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtser mchod nas/gdul bya'i yid kyi re ba skong bzhin yod dus/ chos rgyal chen po rnams kyi sku ring la/ lo paṇa mkhas grub du mas bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gdan drangs pa'i mthus/ skye dgu yongs la sngar bas bde skyid 'phel zhing rgyas pa byung / de nyid bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog rnams kyis rim bzhin thos bsam bsgom gsum gye rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa'i mthus/ da lta'i bar du ma nyams par gnas pa de nyid rang stobs kyis thob pa ma yin 3

yang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma du ma'i bka' drin la brten nas bdag gis kyang gtsug gi rgyan du thob pa/ da ni rang yang na so ni rgas/ nam 'chi la nges pa mi 'dug snyam nas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la rang gis sngar bla ma rnams kyi drin las thob pa'i gsung rab rin chen mang po'i dga' ston 'gyed pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang dad gtong blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i skal ldan gyi bu chen sde pa blo bzang tshe ring dang / dbang po rnam gnyis kyis rang nyid gangs rir sdod pa'i ring la/ bdag dang mtshams pa mang po la/ 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar/yon bdag gi gtso bo byas/ rjes nas blo bzang tshe ring gis tshe blos btang nas gnas chen der 'ongs/ mkho ba'i yo byad mang po yang phul nas/ bla ma rin po che da ni rgan po 'chi la nye ba bdag kyang / thugs brtse ba chen pos byang chub ma thob kyi bar du tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / dben par lha chos byed lugs kyi gdams pa stsal du gsol zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/ngo mtshar ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog /nyon mongs dug gsum nad sel sman pa mchog /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol ba'i nor bu mchog /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi mchog /4

mi mngon dbyengs na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /bdag gzhan snang ngor tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /bka' drin 'khor med bla ma rin po che'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor lan brgyar gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchod tshogs 'bul zhing sngar byas sdig ltung bshags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rjes yi rangs/ /bdag gzhan 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs bla ma'i sku tshe brtan phyir bsngo/ /de mthus sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas gyur cig /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /tshe gang po 'di dkor nag dug chu 'thungs/ /shi na ngan song ma gtogs 'gro sa med/ /da ni na so rgas nas 'chi la nye/ /'chi ba 'jigs nas chos shig byed snyam 'ongs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod kyis 'bral med rjes su zungs/ /lha chos byed tshul gdams pa stsol bar zhu/ /chos bzhin nus par bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o chos rnam dag cig snying nas byed na/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung / da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ltar/thog mar tshe 'di blos gtong dgos ste/ de yi rgyu mtshan tshe 'di'i 5

bya ba blos ma btang na/ chos rnam dag cig mi 'ong bar ma zad/sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum dus gcig la sleb 'ong ste/ po to ba'i gsung sgros las/ chos ma byung tshad tshe 'di ma spangs pas lan gsungs/ shwa bo ba'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i sgrub bya che tsa na thugs mi bde/ gar rgyug cha med/ de tsa na sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum dus gcig la sleb 'ong / zhes dang / dge bshes ston pas/ a ti sha la tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang rnyed bkur sogs 'dod nas las byas pa rnams la 'bras bu ci mchis zhus pas/'bras bu de kho na nyid mchis gsungs/ phyi ma la ci mchis zhus pas/ dmyal ba mchi/ yi dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs so/ /tshe blos thongs na chos dang srid zhi'i bde skyid snyan gsum thams cad dus gcig la 'ong ste/ po to ba'i gsung sgos las/dbyangs la sogs pa 'jen pa la/ dang po i zer ba de thon par dka'/ 'go de rgyangs 'then thub byung na/ de nas las sla/de bzhin du chos byed pa la/ dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa dka' ba yin/ 'di lan cig thongs na de nas las sla gsungs/sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas kyang / gal te bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa thams cad yo ngas su spong / /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /6

rtog ldan bsam gtan dpal gyis/ tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod sdug bsngal yin/ /rlung la bskyur na gtan skyid 'byung / /zhes dang /sgye mchog pa'i zhal nas/ cis kyang dgos pa med tsa na/ /grags pas sa steng khyab pa lags/ /lus srog chos phyir thongs tsa na/ /snyan pa'i ser bu bskyod pa lags/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang / mdo las/ 'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos yin te/ /'dod pa chung na 'phags pa'i rigs yin no/ /zhes dang / thog ma'i blo sbyong las/ sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /'dod pa spangs pa'i rtsa na gda'/ /gsungs/ des na mnyam med jo bo rje sku 'da' khar/ rnal 'byor pa phyag pa khri mchog gis/ jo bo gshegs pa na/ bdag gis rtse gcig tu bsgoms par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin pas bor la thongs gsungs/ 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na res bshad res bsgoms par zhu zhus pas kyang / de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci bgyed zhus pas/ tshe blos thongs gsungs/ des na tshe blos btang 'di chos kyi 'go yin te/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub par/ /khyod nyid chos par rloms pa kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa/ /rang gi rgyu da la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /gsungs/ 'di chos 7

kyi 'go tsam du ma zad/ thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che bas/thugs dam gyi mthil du bya dgos te/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ngas ni tshe blos gtong ba la/ sgrub pa'i mthil du byas pa yin no skyes bu kun gsungs so/ /des na sngar chos byas sam ma byas da chos yong ngam mi yong / rang gi pha yul dang nye 'brel zas nor sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams blos btang ma btang la brtag pa bya dgos 'di blos thongs 'dug na sngar yang chos byas te/ da yang chos yong 'di blos ma thongs 'dug na sngar yang chos ma byas/ da yang chos mi yong ste/ mar pa lo tsas/ rje mi la 'byon khar/ bu 'jig rten 'di blos ma thongs par 'di yi bya ba dang dam pa'i chos bsres na/ chos shor zin pa de rang yin gsungs skad/ po to ba'i gsung sgos las/ tshe 'di ma nyams pa gcig dang phyi ma'i chos gnyis lhan du mi yong / pags pa gcig la spus brang lag pas theg tshad gcig dang / rlid bu chu thub pa gnyis yong sa med gsungs/ sa skya paṇa chen rin bo che'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar/ /gtan gye phan bde thar pa re ba de/ /rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod gzu lum nyid yin pas/ /tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs/ /zhes dang / chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang / dam pa'i chos dang tshe 8

'di'i mdun ma gnyis/ /ma nyam du 'grub pa su yang yod ma yin/ /sgrub par 'dod pa de dag rang nyid kyis/ /rang nyid bslu ba nyid la the tshom med/ /gsungs/ 'o na tshe blos gtong dgos na/ gang gtong snyam na pha yul dang nye 'brel/ yul mi khyim mtshes zas nor longs spyod lus kyi gces 'dzin thams cad blos gtong dgos/ ji ltar gtong na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ tshe blos gtong ba la gtad pa bzhi/ rdo rje gsum/bud snyegs thob gsum dgos pa yin gsungs/ gtad pa bzhi ni/ blo phug chos la gtad/ chos phug sprang la gtad/ sprang phug shi la gtad/ shi phug grog po stong par gtad/ rdo rje gsum ni/thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la 'jogaye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ bud snyegs thob gsum ni/ mi khyu nas bud/ khye gral snyegs/ lha gral thob gsum mo/ /de bcu la phug nor bcu zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ de rnams yid la bzhag pa tsam gyis nyon mongs kyi rdzong 'gyel/ las ngan gye gru 'jigaganyen po'i thang bde ba la slebs pas/ des na phug nor 'di dag yod na/ tshe 'di'i bde ba dang tshe phyi ma'i bde ba thams cad dka' tshegs med par myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ thub pa'i dbang po drin can bla ma sogs/ /dngos 9

rgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /mnyam med zas gtsang sras po de nyid kyis/ /na rga 'chi ba gzigs pas thugs skyo nas/ /rgyal srid spangs nas ne rañdza na'i 'gram/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad mthar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de bzhin dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /mi rtag 'chi ba bsam pas thugs skyo nas/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben par nyams len mdzad/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rang yang nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /dam chos rnam dag 'ong du mi ster ba'i/ /pha yul zhing khang nye 'brel zas nor sogs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis cis mi gtong / /rje red mda' pas chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed la sogs pa/ rang nyid 'tsho ba'i yo byad ma gtogs pa/ /gser dang dbyeg sogs lhag pa'i yo byad ni/ /rang gi don du til tsam mi 'chang ngo / /rgyal sras rin po ches bdag la nges par 'ong pa 'chi ba yin/ /de tshe nor dang 'khor sogs kyis mi phan/ /de dang bral bas lhag par sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /de ltar bsams nas tshe 'di'i che thabs spangs/ /blo phug chos gtad chos phug sprang la gtad/ /sprang phug shi gtad shi phug brag la gtad/ /thebs med rdo rje sngon du 10

legs par btang / /khrel med rdo rje nges par rjes la 'jog /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs par bya/ /mi yi khyu nas ci bud ci thon bya/ /dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon te/ /khyi gral snyegs nas lha gral thob par bya/ /mdor na mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'ong / /da ni tshe blos gtong ba'i dus la babs/ /bla ma'i thugs rje rang gi dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs par shog /ces tshig ngag gis bton nas don yid la bsam na tshe 'di blo yis myur du thongs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang blo kha chos la phyogs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob bu bsod nams stobs chen/ ngag dbang chos 'grub gnyis kyis/ 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin po che lags/ mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad nas yon tan kun gyi gzhi gyur mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma tshul bzhin bsten pa gal che tshul yang dang yang du gsungs 'dug na yang / bdag cag gnyis blo rmongs pas bsten tshul mi shes par 'dug pas/ bla ma tshul bzhin bsten tshul zhig gsung du gsol zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ ngo mtshar skye mchog rin po che/ /ya mtshan sprul ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nyam thag skyongs pa'i drin can ma/ /'phongs la 11

gang 'dod ster ba'i pha/ /thar pa'i lam ston sa mkhan mchog /legs nyes blang dor ston pa'i mig /ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpon/ /nyon mongs nad sel sman gyi bla/ /kun la phan pa'i nyi ma mchog /dgos 'dod stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /chos kyi sgra 'byin lha yi rnga/ /ci 'dod 'byung ba'i bum pa bzang / /shin tu rnyed dka' u dum war/ /mjal ba don ldan sangs rgyas dngos/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /mtshan snyan tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad nas/ /yon tan gzhir gyur drin can rje/ /tshul bzhin bsten pa gal che zhes/ /yang nas yang du gsungs pa go /go rung bsten tshul mi shes gda'/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi/ /zhal gdams nyung la 'dus pa zhig /stsol zhes thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med myang / /smin zhing grol ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /dag dang ma dag rab 'byams zhing / /gang du bskal brgyar btsal gyur kyang / /khyed las lhag pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /rnyed par dka' ba bdag gis go /da ni 'dis mtshon dge tshogs kyang / /khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /deng nas ba zung ste byang chub 12

bar/ /mgon po khyod dang mi 'bral shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/'o na mdo sde sdong bo bkod pa las/ sems dgus dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyede bkur bar gsungs pa ni/ bsten tshul thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa yin pas/ de la dang po bu mdzangs pa lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na bu mdzangs pa des/ bya ba rang dbang du mi 'jug gi pha'i ngor lta zhing de'i dbang du btang nas ngag bzhin byed pa ltar/ rang dbang dor nas rang nyid bla ma'i dbang du btang nas/ rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye ngor lta zhing / gsung bzhin byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na mi chod pa/ mi shig pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thogs pa med pa/ mi pham pa ste/ khyad chos bdun dang ldan pa'i rdo rje ltar/ bdud dang sdig grogs sogs kyis bla ma dang slob ma gnyis ga'i bar du 'byed pa'i dbyen dang rdzun tshig ji ltar smras kyang nam yang mi phyed par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa sa lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na sa gzhi 'di'i steng du ci bzhag kyang 'khur ba ltar/ bla ma'i bya ba las don gyi khur gang bskur yang skyo ngal med par thams cad 'khur ba'o/ /bzhi pa khor yug ge ri lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na khor yug gi ri bo chen po su gang gis sgul mi nus pa ltar/ bla ma bsten nas chos 13

byed dus/ ltogs skom la sogs mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal ci byung yang / de kun gyes sgul mi nus par byed pa'o/ /lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i bran lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na rgyal po'i bran gyis ngan las ci byed dgos kyang sgrub pa ltar/ bla mas bcol ba'i ngan las thams cad nyams su len pa la yang / yid mi 'khrug par byed pa'o/ /drug pa phyag bdar pa lta bu'i sems ni/dper na phyag dar byed pa'i bran g.yog la che ba'i nga rgyal med pa ltar/ bla ma las nga che snyam pa'i nga rgyal thams cad spangs nas bla ma las rang dma' bar 'dzin pa'o/ /bdun pa thag pa lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na thag pa'i nang du gang bzhag kyang 'dzin pa ltar/ bla ma'i bya ba shin tu bya dka' ba'i khur lci ba rnams kyang spro bzhin 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /brgyad pa khye lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na sgo khye la khyem bdag gis ci ltar smras kyang mi khro ba ltar/ bla mas brnyas smod khyad gsod gshe zhing mtshang 'bru sogs ci ltar gsungs kyang de la nam yang mi khro bar byed pa'o/ /dgu pa gru lta bu'i sems ni/ dper na gru chen bo de chu yi khar phar tshur gang du brgya stong 'gro dgos kyang skyo ba med pa ltar/ bla ma'i bya ba la ji tsam zhugs kyang / 'gro zhing 'ong bas mi skyo bar byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sems dgu'i sgo nas dge ba'i 14

bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur byas na/ ched du gnyer nas ma sgrub kyang yon tan ngam po ngam ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skye zhing /bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i drin can rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun tu mtshan ldan bla ma rje/ /gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /yon tan gzhi gyur drin can bla ma rje/ /tshul bzhin bsten pa bde legs rtsa ba ru/ /shes nas srog gi phyir yang mi spong bar/ /rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas bsten par bya/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i ngor lta dbang du btang / /bka' bzhin byed pa mdzangs pa'i bu ltar bya/ /bdud dang sdig grogs sogs kyis dbyen byas rung / /nam yang mi phyed rdo rje lta bur bya/ /bla ma'i bya ba las don khur bsgur yang / /thams cad 'khur ba sa gzhi lta bur bya/ /bla ma bsten dus sdug bsngal ci byung yang / /sgul mi nus pa ri bo lta bur bya/ /ngan las thams cad nyams su len dgos kyang / /yid mi 'khrug pa rgyal po'i bran ltar bya/ /nga rgyal spangs nas bla ma rnams las rang / /dma' sa 'dzin pa phyag dar lta bur bya/ /bla ma'i sku don bya dka'i khur lci ba/ /spro bzhin 'dzin pa thag pa lta 15

bur bya/ /bla mas brnyas shing gshe la mtshang brus kyang / /de la khro ba med pa khyi ltar bya/ /bla ma'i don du 'gro zhing 'ong ba la/ /nam yang skyo ba med pa gru ltar bya/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gis de ltar nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen de ltar bsten par shog /ces pas tshig ngag tu bton nas don yid la bsam na skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yang tshe 'di'i snang shas dor nas phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i slob bu blo bzang tshul khrims kyis/ kho bo la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sa gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i bstan pa'i sgron me chen po byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu/dal 'byor don che ba rgyu dang dpe dang grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' ba'i tshul rnams nyung la 'dus pa zhig gsung du gsol zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ 'chad pas gdul bya'i rgyud la phan/ /rtsod pas pha rol rgol ba 'joms rtsom pas rgyal bstan nyin mor byed/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med/ /16

snyigs dus mkhas pa yongs kyi mchog /skye dgu'i phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing / /'gro ba yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes/ /'brel tshad don ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /khyed kyis brtse bas bdag la dgongs/ /tshe stod tshe 'di'i dbang du song / /dal 'byor mi lus rin po che/ /don med chud zos byas pa la/ /skyo nas dal 'byor mi lus la/ /chos kyi snying po blangs na snyam/ /ma nor thar pa'i lam ston pa'i/ /rje btsun khyed kyi spyan sngar 'ongs/ /da ni bla ma rin po che/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo ltar/ /dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu/ /tshang pa'i mi lus rin po che/ /thob pa don che rnyed dka' ba/ /bsams nas snying po len dgos tshul/ /shin tu nyung 'dus kha gsal zhig /brtse bas bdag la gsung du gsol/ /rje btsun mnyan pa khyed dang 'grogs/ /dal 'byor mi lus gru bo che/ /brten nas rang sems nyam thag mgron/ /'khor ba'i dug chu rab med la/ /brgal nas skye rga na 'chi sogs/ /sdug bsngal ming tsam ma mchis pa'i/ /gtan bde thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /dka' tshegs med par slebs par shog /ces zer ba'i lan du/ 'o de yin na/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral ba la dal ba brgyad zer/ mi bo/ ma pa brgyad ni/ dmyal ba dang gcigayi dwags dang gnyis/ dud 'gro dang gsum/ lha tshe ring po dang 17

bzhi/ log lta can dang lnga / yul mtha' 'khob kla klo dang drugaglen lkugs sogs dbang po ma tshang ba dang bdun/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang brgyad do/ /de brgyad du skyes na dge ba bya ba'i dal ba med pas na/ mi khom brgyad ces bya'o/ /'o skol rnams de brgyad dang bral nas dge ba'i las bya ba'i dal ba yod pas na/ dal ba brgyad ces bya'o/ /'byor ba bcu ni/ mi lus thob pa dang gcig 'khor rnam bzhi rgyu ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa dang gnyis/ mig rna ba sogs dbang po tshang ba dang gsum/ mtshams med las byas sam byed du ma bcug pas na las mtha' ma log pa dang bzhi/ phan bde 'byung gnas 'dul ba sogs dam pa'i chos la dad pa dang lnga po de rang rgyud kyis bsdus shing chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yin pas rang gi 'byor ba zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas byon pa dang gcigadam pa'i chos bstan pa dang gnyis/ bstan pa gnas pa dang gsum/ bstan pa de'i rjes 'jug mang po yod pa dang bzhi/des kyang gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'i chos ston zhing sbyin bdag rnams kyis zas gos sogs ster ba dang lnga'o/ /de lnga ni gzhan rgyud la yod cing rang gis chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yin pas gzhan 'byor zhes bya'o/ /dal 'byor don che chu 4 ni/18

dper na yid bzhin nor bu las zas gos sogs thun mong gi dgos 'dod 'byung yang mchog gi dngos grub mi 'byung la/dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che la brten nas chos byas na mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thob pas yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pas na/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa don che ba'o/ /da re tsam ma gtogs phyis 'di lta bu'i rten mi khom pa'i gnas rnams su bskal ba brgyad khrir btsal yang rnyed dka' ste/ de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyu yi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/tshul khrims kyis gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/smon lam dri ma med pas 'tshams sbyor dgos pas rnyed dka'/dpe yi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi bu gar rus sbal gyi mgrin pa chud dka' ba ltar mi nyid thob par dka' zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ gzhan yang gyang logs la sran ma gtor na sa la lhung ba rnams mi khom pa'i gnas su skyes pa'i tshod dang / re re tsam chags pa dal 'byor mi lus kyi rten tsam yin pas rnyed dka'/grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam/ yi dwags ni bye ma'i grangs tsam/ dud 'gro ni chang gi sbang ma tsam/ lha dang lha min ni kha ba bu yug tsam/ dal 'byor 19

tshang ba'i mi lus ni sen mo'i steng du blangs pa'i rdul bzhin du shin tu nyung bas rnyed dka'/ de ltar rnyed dka'/ zhing rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa 'di don ldan zhig bya'o snyam du bsam par bya'o/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro tshe ring lha/ /log lta can dang mtha' 'khob kla klo dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang glen lkugs te/ /mi khom brgyad dang bral ba dal ba brgyad/ /mi lus thob dang dge slong pha la sogs/ /'khor yang rnam bzhi rgyu ba'i yul dbus skyes/ /dbang po sgo lnga tshang zhing 'dul ba sogs/ /phan bde 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos la dad/ /mtshams med ma byas byed du ma bcug pas/ /las mtha' ma log pa ste rang 'byor lnga/ /sangs rgyas byon dang de yis dam chos bstan/ /bstan pa gnas dang de yi rjes 'jug mang / /des kyang brtse ba'i chos ston yon bdag gis//mthun rkyen sbyor ba rnams ni gzhan 'byor lnga/ /de 'dra'i dal 'byor mi lus rin chen la/ /brten nas dam pa'i lha chos nyams blangs na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma/ lus thob/ /yid bzhin nor las lhag pas 20

don re che/ /da res ma gtogs phyis nas rnyed par dka'/ /tshul khrims gzhi bzung sbyin sogs grogs byas te/ /smon lam 'tsha mas sbyor byas nas thob dgos pas/ /rgyu yi sgo nas bsam yang rnyed par dka'/ /rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal long pa'i mgrin pa chud dka' ltar/ /mi lus rnyed par dka' zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /dpe yi sgo nas bsam yang rnyed par dka'/ /sems can gzhan gyi grangs la bsam tsa na/ /sa yi rdul bzhin shin tu grangs mang zhing / /mi lus sen mo'i steng gi rdul bzhin nyung / /grangs kyi sgo nas bsam yang rnyed par dka'/ /de ltar rnyed dka' don che'i mi yi lus/ /thob dus chos kyi snying po len pa dgos/ /mdor na dal 'byor don che rnyed par dka'/ /da ni lha chos byed pa'i dus la babs/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /dal 'byor don ldan nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes tshig legs par bton nas don la tshul bzhin bsam na dal 'byor gyi rten la dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len 'dod kyi blo ngam ngam shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras so/ /yang yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la gces spras su mdzad pa'i skal ldan gyi slob bu sbyin 21

pa nor bus/ga kho bo la skal bzang thar par bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs bla na med pa/ byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/'chi ba mi rtag pa/ rtsa ba gsum/ rgyu mtshan dgu/ thag bcad pa gsum gyi sgo nas/ bsam tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /dam pa'i chos kun sgrog pa'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse dpag par dka' ba'i thugs/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran dang gcig /tshe 'di blo yis thongs dang gnyis/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed dang gsum/ /'di gsum mnyam du 'ong gsungs kyang / /bdag ni rtag 'dzin che dang gcig /tshe 'dir shi sbar 'thams dang gnyis/ /'jig rten mi chos byed dang gsum/ /'di gsum mgo mnyam yong zhing gda'/ /rtag par mi gzhan 'chi ba mthong / /rtag tu khyed dang gsung rab nas/ /rtag pa'i chos med mang gsungs kyang / /rtag 'dzin che ba'i bu ngan la/ /mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gzhon nu de/ /mi yi gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /mdzad pa'i mtshungs med legs bshad mchog /skal bzang thar pa bgrod 'dod pa'i/ /'jug ngogs bla na ma mchis pa/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo ltar/ /rtsa ba gsum dang rgyu 22

mtshan dgu/ /thag bcad gsum gyi sgo nas ni/ /mi rtag 'chi ba bsam pa'i tshul/ /shin tu kha gsal nyung 'dus shig /bdag la brtse bas gsung du gsol/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag par mi 'chi snyam pa yi/ /rtag 'dzin gdon dang bral gyur cig /deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /mgon po khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /khyod kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myang / /rnam mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog /ces zer ba'i lan du/ 'o 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom tshul gyi rtsa ba gcig ni/ nges par 'chi ba bsam pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa la gsum ste/ dang po 'chi bdag nges par 'ong la rkyen gyis bzlog tu med par bsam pa ni/ lus ci 'dra zhig gi skye ba blangs kyang / 'chi bdag nges par 'ong la/ de yang rdzas sngags sman dang stobs dang nor sogs rkyen gang gis kyang bzlog du med pas na nges par nga 'chi snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa tshe la snon pa med cing 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod pa bsam pa ni/zas nor sogs zad song na slar snon du yod kyang / mi tshe ni de ltar ma yin par snon pa cung zad med par ma zad/ 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod pas na nges par 'chi snyam du bsam/ gsum pa gson pa'i tshe la yang chos bya ba'i long med par nges par 23

'chi ba bsam pa ni/ de yang yun thung tshe yi phyed gnyid la zad/phyed la chung dus chos mi dran/ rgas nas dran kyang chos mi nus/gzhon dus dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong so nam bun bskyed bza' btung long gtam rnam g.yeng gi dbang du song nas chos bya long med par nges par 'chi snyam du bsam mo/ /thag bcad pa gcig ni 'chi ba'i dgra ni dgag tu med par nges par 'ong na/ tshe 'di'i bslu brid la dga' bas ci zhig bya tshe 'di'i 'khri ba thams cad bcad nas chos zhig ma byas pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam du bsam ste/ chos byed dgos pa la thag bcad cing zhe dam mang du bya ba'o/ /yang rtsa ba gcig ni nam 'chi nges pa med pa bsam pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa la gsum ste/dang po 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pa bsam pa ni/gling gzhan gye tshe la nges pa yod kyang / lho 'dzam bu gling gi tshe la nges pa med pas na nam 'chi nges pa med snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa 'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung ba bsam pa ni/ char rlung gseb kyi mar me ltar/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa sogs tshe la gnod pa'i rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung bas na nam 'chi nges pa med snyam du bsam/ gsum pa lus shin tu nyam chung bas na nam 'chi nges pa 24

med bsam pa ni/ sgyu lus chu yi chu bur dang 'dra bas tha na tsher ma zug pa tsam gyi rkyen la bsnyad btags nas kyang 'jig par 'gyur bas/ rkyen ngan phra mos kyang gzhom sla bas lus shin tu nyam chung bas na nam 'chi nges pa med snyam du bsam mo thag bcad pa gcig ni/ 'chi bdag gis lus srog nam 'joms nges pa mi snang na/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad che bzhag chung bskyur byas nas myur bar myur du chos shig ma byas pas thabs mi 'dug snyam du bsam ste/ da lta nyid nas chos bya bar thag gcod pa'i zhe dam mang du byed pa'o/ /yang rtsa ba gcig ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis mi phan pa bsam pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa la gsum ste/ dang po gnyen gyis mi phan pa bsam pa ni/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ brtse gdungs che ba'i gnyen bshes mang pos mtha' bskor kyang nang nas gcig tsam yang 'khrid sa med snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa nor gyis mi phan pa bsam pa ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i nor gye phung po ji snyed yod kyang rdul phran tsam yang khyer dbang med snyam du bsam/gsum pa lus kyis mi phan pa bsam pa ni/ gces par bskyangs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus kyang mal du bzhag nas 'gro snyam du bsam mo/ /thag bcad pa gcig ni/ 'chi tshe mgon 25

skyabs dpung gnyen chos ma gtogs gzhan gang yang med/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams kyis bdag dor bdag gis 'di rnams dor/ nam 'dor cha mi 'dug do nub yin yang dor nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro nyen yod pas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad cham gyis bzhag nas chos shig ma byas pas thabs mi 'dug snyam du bsam ste/ chos byed pa blo thag gcod cing zhe dam mang du bya ba'o/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon chad ma shi lus pa gcig kyang med/ /de bzhin rang yang mi rtag nges par 'chi/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'chi bdag nges par 'ong / /rkyen gyis bzlog thabs med pas nges par 'chi/ /tshe la gsar du snon pa cung zad med/ /'brid byed bar ma chad pas nges par 'chi/ /gnyid dang bza' btung long gtam sogs kyis g.yengs/ /lha chos byed long med par nges par 'chi/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /nges par lha chos byed la blo thag bcad/ /da lta gzhon nu mang po 'chi ba bzhin/ /rang yang glo bur nam 'chi nges pa med/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'dzam gling tshe tshad la/ /nges pa med pas nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe la nad gdon dgra sogs gnod pa 26

mang / /gson rkyen nyung bas nam 'chi nges pa med/ /sgyu lus nyam chung rkyen ngan phra mos kyang / /'jig par sla bas nam 'chi nges pa med/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /da lta lha chos byed la blo thag bcad/ /'jigs rung 'chi bdag thog tu babs pa'i tshe/ /lha chos ma gtogs gang gis phan pa med/ /de yi rgyu mtshan brtse gdungs che ba'i gnyen/ /gcig kyang 'khrid sa med pas phan pa med/ /'bad pas sgrubs pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i nor/ /rdul tsam 'khyer dbang med pas phan pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang gi sha rus kyang / /mal du bzhag nas 'gro bas phan pa med/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /phan nges lha chos byed la blo thag bcad/ /mdor na mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'ong / /da ni lha chos byed pa'i dus la babs/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gis lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshig legs par bton nas de dag gi don la bsam na tshe 'di'i snang shas chung du song nas/ phyi mar bde thabs lha chos byed 'dod kyi blo ngam ngam shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur ro/ / yang dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la brtson pa'i slob bu mkhas btsun don ldan gyis/ kho bo la chos phung 27

brgyad khri bzhi stong glegs bam gcig gis dzu la brten pa'i byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/ ngan song gi rgyu mi dge bcu ngos bzung nas spong ba dang / mtho ris rnam smin brgyad ldan gyi rten bzang gi rgyu sgrub tshul/ nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos btsun/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems bzang / /mkhas btsun bzang gsum kun 'dzoms pa'i/ /mjal dka'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /mgon khyod zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ /bdag ni las nyon dbang du song / /tshe 'dir chung dus chos ma dran/ /cher song dgon pa'i dkor la rngams/ /dkor gyis tshos pas je blun song / /chos zhog 'jig rten mi chos kyang / /ma shes thabs rdugs sna tshogs byas/ /dge ba dag kyang ma byas par/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags pas/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang mi thos zhes/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas gsungs pa/ /go bas sdig pa 'dor 'dod byung / /lam mchog sgrub la mtshan nyid kun/ /tshang pa'i rten bzang ma thob na/ /lam la sa chod mi 'byung zhes/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yis/ /gsungs pa go nas sgrub 'dod skyes/ /28

da ni legs nyes blang dor kun/ /gsal bar ston pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo ltar/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu/ /mi dge bcu bo rab spangs nas/ /rnam smin brgyad ldan rten bzang rgyu/ /sgrub tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig /brtse ba chen pos gsung du gsol/ /blang dor ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /khyed kyi gsung bzhin mi dge spang / /dge ba sgrub nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces zer ba'i lan du/ 'o na ngan song gi rgyu mi dge bcu ni/ mi rta khye dang ra lug sogs sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa dang gcig gser dngul rgyan gos bza' btung sogs gzhan gyis ma byin pa len pa dang gnyis/ khyem pas rang gi chung ma bzhag nas gzhan gyi bud med la spyod cing / rab byung gis bud med la mi tshangs pa spyod pa dang gsum po 'di la lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum zer/ mthong ba la ma mthong zer ba sogs rdzun smras pa dang gcig gzhan mthun pa 'byed pa'i phra ma smra ba dang gnyis/ gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa'i tshig ngan smras pa dang gsum/ don med long gtam lab lob kyi ngag 'khyal smras pa dang bzhi bo 'di la ngag gi rnam pa bzhi zer/ gzhan gyi nor nga la byung na snyam pa'i brnab sems dang gcig dgra sogs mi 29

mdza' ba la gnod pa skyel snyam pa dang / gzhan gyis gnod pa re de la byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i gnod sems dang gnyis/las rgyu 'bras dang dkon mchog gsum sogs med par 'dzin pa'i log lta dang gsum po 'di la yid kyi rnam pa gsum zer/mi dge bcu bo 'di chen po byas na phyi mar dmyal bar skye/'bring tsam byas na yi dwags/ chung ngu tsam las ma spyad kyang dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo / /des na ngan song gsum gyi rgyu mi dge ba bcu bo 'di ngo shes par byas nas nam yang dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /phyi mar rnam smin brgyad ldan gyi rten bzang thob pa'i rgyu sgrub tshul ni/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la sems can la mi 'tshe zhing mi 'tshe ba'i bsam pa bsten pa dang / tshe thar srog blu gtong ba dang /nad g.yog sman sbyin pa dang gcig kha dog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la/ mar me sogs snang ba dang gos gsar rgyan mdzes sbyin pa dang gnyis/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la/ nga rgyal bcoms nas bla ma la phyag dang gzhan la bran ltar gus par bya ba dang gsum/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la/ nor longs spyod kyi sgo nas dbul bo ngan slong dang mi slong ba thams cad la/ sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong ba dang bzhi/ tshig btsun pa'i 30

rgyu la ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi spangs pa dang lnga/ dbang che bar grags pa'i rgyu la/ phyi mar rang la yon tan sna tshogs sgrub par smon lam 'debs pa dang / dkon mchog mchod pa dang pha ma nyan rang mkhan slob bla ma rnams mchod pa dang drug skye ba pho lus thob pa'i rgyu la/ rang pho lus thob pa la dga' zhing bud med kyi lus thob pa mi dga' zhing / gzhan bud med kyi lus thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi 'dun pa bzlog pa dang / pho yi dbang po mi gcod cing gzhan gyis gcod pa thar bar bya ba dang bdun/ stobs dang ldan pa'i rgyu la/ gzhan gyis ma nus pa rang gis byed cing / bsdoms nas nus pa la grogs byed bza' btung ster bar bya ba dang brgyad do/ /de ltar rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po zhig phyi mar thob na rten de la lam sgrub na sa chod gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yong bas/ de'i rgyu la da lta 'bad par bya'o/ /slar yang smras pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub par byen gyis rlobs/ /log gcod ma byen len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /dzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ /mi dge bcu bo de dag byas gyur na/ /ngan song skye bas dug bzhin spang bar bya ma 31

ring rgyu la tshe thar srog blu gtong / /gzugs byad mdzes phyir mar me bzod pa bsgom/ /rigs mtho'i rgyu la kun la gus par bya/ /dbang phyug che phyir slong la sbyin pa bya/ /tshig btsun rgyu la ngag gi mi dge spang / /dbang cher grags phyir mchod 'bul smon lam 'debs/ /skye ba'i rgyu la pho dbang gcod pa spang / /stobs ldan rgyu la gzhan gyi las grogs bya/ /de ltar byas na rnam smin brgyad ldan gyi/ /rten bzang thob nas lam la sa chod 'byung / /de yi rgyu la da lta 'bad par bya/ /mdor na mi dge bcu bo rab spang nas/ /da ni dge ba sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /sdig sgong dge sgrub nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshig rnams bton nas don yid la bsam na sdig spong dge ba'i las la ngam ngam shugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /yang tshe stod tshe 'dir chags nas 'jig rten mi chos byas kyang / tshe smad la nges 'byung skyes nas dam pa'i lha chos byed pa'i slob bu bsod nams snyan grags kyis/ kho bo la rab 'byams gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig lta bu'i byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/ 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal brgyad dang drug dang / gsum gyi sgo nas bsam tshul bye brag rigs drug gi 32

sdug bsngal drug bsam tshul rnams nyung la 'dus pa zhig gsung du gsol zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ ngan song nas 'ong sems can yang / /so so skye bo'i sa 'di nas/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung bshags/ /mdzad pa yi rang chos 'khor bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dge tshogs mdzad phrin rgyas phyir bsngo/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i skyabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla mas bdag la dgongs/ /sngon chad dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la/ /skyo ba skye ba'i chos gsungs kyang / /ma rig nyon mongs tshan che bas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar bzung / /skyo ba ma skyes zhen chags skyes/ /da ni bla ma rin po che/ /'khor bar nges 'byung drag po skyes/ /thar pa don gnyer skye thabs su/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yis/ /mdzad pa'i rab 'byams gsung rab la lta ba'i mig dang 'dra ba yi/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo yi/ /nang nas gsungs ltar 'khor ba spyi'i/ /sdug bsngal brgyad dang drug dang gsum/ /bye brag rigs drug sdug bsngal drug /bsam tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig /bdag la brtse bas gsung du gsol/ /deng nes 'khor ba skyo shas skyes/ /tshe 'di'i don la mi 'bad 33

par/ /thar pa don gnyer blo skyes nas/ /de don sgrub par byen gyis rlobs/ /thar pa'i go 'phang ma thob par/ /khyed kyis 'bral med brtse bas skyongs/ /mgon khyod thugs rjes 'khor ba las/ /thar nas bde chen mchog thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ skyes pa'i sdug bsngal dang gcig rgas pa'i sdug bsngal dang gnyis/ na ba'i sdug bsngal dang gsum/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang bzhi/ dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal dang lnga/ gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang drug 'dod pa'i dngos po btsal nas mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal dang bdun/ sdug bsngal snga ma'i gzhi rten phyi ma'i sna 'dren zag bcas nyer len phung po lnga'i sdug bsngal dang brgyad do/ /sdug bsngal drug ni/ 'khor ba 'di na dgra gnyen du 'gyur gnyen dgra ru 'gyur bas dgra gnyen la yid brtan med pa'i sdug bsngal dang gcig 'dod yon la ci tsam spyad kyang bzang pos tshim te chog shes dang / ngan pas sun te zhen log ma byung bas ngoms pa med pa'i sdug bsngal dang gnyis/ lus bzang ngan 'bring gsum ci tsam blangs kyang yang nas yang du 'dor dgos pa'i sdug bsngal dang gsum/ slar yang ma'i mngal du yang dang yang du nying mtshams sbyor ba'i 34

sdug bsngal dang bzhi/ rgyal po sprang por 'gyur pa sogs yang nas yang du mtho dman sna tshogs su 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang lnga/ grogs med par rang nyid gcig bur phyi mar 'gro dgos pas grogs la yid brtan med pa'i sdug bsngal dang drug go /yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gsum ni/ zag bcas 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad nam zhig sdug bsngal du gyur pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang gcig rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu na ba/ na ba'i thog tu 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal byung ba bzhin/ sdug bsngal snga ma'i thog tu phyi ma/ phyi ma'i steng du phyi ma bsnan nas lus sems kyis mi bzod pas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang gnyis/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'di dang 'di bya snyam/ grabs shoms byed pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum mo/ /bye brag rigs drug gi sdug bsngal so sor bsam tshul ni/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dang gcig yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dang gnyis/ dud 'gro bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum/ mi'i skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang bzhi/ lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal dang lnga/ lha'i 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang drug go /mdor na las nyon dbang gis 'khor ba'i 35

gnas 'dir mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod dang / bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug pas/ des na 'khor ba 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling dug sbrul gyi tshang dang /'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyang dug dang 'dres pa'i zas/ spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar reg na yang phung pa'i tshul bsams nas/ sgyugs nad can la zas bstan pa ltar/'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyi bde ba la zhen pa gting nas log ste nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar/ da re 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por las nyon gyi rba rlabs chen po drag tu 'khrug cing / sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu srin 'jigs su rung bas gang ba 'di las thar pa'i thabs dam pa'i lha chos kho na la 'bad par bya dgos so/ /smras pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba spyi la skye rga na 'chi dang / /mi sdug dgra 'phrad sdug pa'i gnyen dang bral/ /'dod pa'i dngos po btsal na mi rnyed cing / /nyer len phung po lnga yi sdug bsngal dang / /dgra gnyen ma nges 'dod yon 36

ngoms pa med/ /lus ni blangs nas yang yang 'dor ba dang / /ma yi mngal du yang yang nying mtshams sbyor/ /yang nas yang du mtho dman sna tshogs 'gyur/ /grogs la yid brtan med pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal sdug bsngal dang / /'du byed sdug bsngal la sogs sdug bsngal mang / /bye brag dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal dang / /yi dwags rnams la bkres skom sdug bsngal dang / /dud 'gro rnams la bkol spyod sdug bsngal dang / /mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang / /lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal dang / /lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ /'khor ba me 'obs srin gling dug sbrul tshang / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs dug dang 'dres pa'i zas/ /spu gri rnon po'i kha yi sbrang rtsi dang / /dug sbrul nag po'i mgo yi nor bu ltar/ /reg kyang phung na bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /mdor na 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /da ni phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i dus la bab/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /'khor ba zhen pa ldog par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshig legs par bton nas don yid la bsam na 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la chags zhen chung du song nas/ gtan bde thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs dam pa'i lha chos byed 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa 37

ngam ngam shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang skal ldan gyi slob bu dge 'dun thos bsam dang /bsam 'grub seng ge gnyis kyis/ khong gnyis la tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon dang bsrung tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig gsung du gsol/ zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ sngon dus zas gtsang sras po yi/ /dus kyi khrims ldan dge slong mchog /dge slong mi 'khrugs rnam thar ltar/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos par/ /btsun pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes/ /khyed kyis yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che/ /blangs nas nyams med bsrung dgos zhes/ /yang yang nan gyis gsungs na yang / /de yi bsrung tshul mi shes gda'/ /da ni yongs 'dzin rin po che/ /rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon dang / /bsrung tshul nyung 'dus bstan du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste khas blangs khrims/ /mig bzhin bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /'bral ba med par rjes su zungs/ /tshul khrims bslab pa mi nyams par/ /gong nas gong du 'phel gyur cig /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yang skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams nas/ srid pa 'di me 'bar ba'i nags klung ltar mthong ba'i 38

blos de las thar pa'i thabs dam pa/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rigs gang yang rung ba blangs nas tshul bzhin bsrung na phan yon shin tu che ste/ mya ngan 'das pa las/ tshul khrims ni dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi them skas so/ /shing la sogs pa'i rtsa ba sa yin pa ltar rtsa ba'o/ /tshong dpon tshong pa thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ltar dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba'o/—/brgya byin gyis rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba ltar chos thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan no/ /sdig pa thams cad dang ngan song gi lam gtan gcod pa'o/ /sdig pa'i nad thams cad gso ba'i sman gyi sdong po lta bu'o/ /srid pa'i lam nyam nga ba'i brgyags tshegs so/ /nyon mongs pa'i dgra 'joms pa'i go mtshon no/ /nyon mongs pa'i sbrul gdug pa sel ba'i rig sngags so/ /sdig pa'i chu las sgol ba'i zam pa'o/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /dwangs pa'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me 'phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /bsod nams 'di ni de bas bye brag 'phags/ /zhes dang /39

dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ ji ltar lo tog thams cad sa la ni/ /brten nas skyon med par ni skyes pa ltar/ /de bzhin tshul khrims brten nas chos dkar mchog /snying rje chus brlan pas ni rnam par skye/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba gal che/ de yang mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen por bslab bya rnams nyan nas shes par bya/ ma gus pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen por ston pa dang / des gsungs pa'i bslab pa rnams dang / grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la gus par bya/ bag med pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen por dran shes ngo tsha khrel yod bskyed nas bag dang ldan par bya/nyon mongs pa mang ba ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin pas/ de'i gnyen po rnams bsten la nyon mongs pa gang skyes kyang 'bur 'joms bya/ mdor na nyes pas nam yang ma gos pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la bslab par bya'o/ /smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims mig bzhin bsrung bar byen gyes rlobs/ /tshul khrims 40

mtho ris thar pa'i them skas 'dra/ /tshul khrims yon tan gzhi rten sa gzhi 'dra/ /tshul khrims chos kyi sngon 'gro tshong dpon 'dra/ /tshul khrims dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /sdig dang ngan song lam gcod sgo mo 'dra/ /sdig pa'i nad 'joms sman gyi sdong po 'dra/ /nyam nga srid pa'i lam gyi rgyags phye 'dra/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams 'joms pa'i go mtshon 'dra/ /de phyir tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che/ /rang gi mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung bar bya/ /de yang mi shes ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /de yi gnyen por bslab bya shes par bya/ /ma gus pa yang ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /de yi gnyen por bslab pa gus par bya/ /bag med pa yang ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /de yi gnyen por dran shes bsten par bya/ /nyon mongs mang ba ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /de yi gnyen po bsten la 'bur 'joms bya/ /mdor na nyes pas nam yang ma gos par/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung bar bya/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /tshul khrims bslab pa bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs / /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshul khrims bslab pa 'bral bar ma gyur cig /ces bton nas don legs par 41

bsam na tshul khrims la gces spras 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang slob bu tshe blos btang ri khrod pa blo bzang tshul khrims kyis/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dus rgyun du sems la bcang rgyu'i zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse 'phrin las gcig bsdus bdag /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus char bzhin du/ /'bebs mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /tshogs drug rang grol zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /sdig lhung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /mtshan dpes rgyan spras gzi brjid phung po'i sku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung sgogs pa'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse shes bya kun la thogs med thugs/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bdag bstod do/ /rang don mthar phyin gzhan don bsdu bzhi yi/ /sgo nas 'gro ba'i don la skyo ngal med/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dbul sel yid bzhin nor/ /'gro ba'i re skong khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /khyed min re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /'bral ba 42

med par rjes su bzung du gsol/ /ston pa'i bstan pa rig pas legs par sgrub/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing / /blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa yi/ /bla ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thos pa tsam gyis theg chen rig sad cing / /bsam na byang chub sems dpa'i gral du chud/ /bsgoms pas gegs med bde blag 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /bla mas gnang ba'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi mchog /chos brgyad dkor nag dug chus ma bslad pas/ /dben pa'i gnas su nyams su len par smon/ /smon pa bzhin du 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ /g.yas nas tsan dan sde gus byugs pa dang / /g.yon nas sta res gshag pa gnyis byung yang / /nye ring med par brtse bas skyongs mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'gro ba'i don du mnar med me nang du/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du gnas dgos kyang / /snying rjes mi skyo gzhan don lhur len pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sems can nyam thag mthong na spyan chab 'byen/ /srog 'tshab rang srog gtong yang 'phangs pa med/ /snying rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla 43

ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /nang pa sangs rgyas pa yi khyad chos mchog /legs tshogs yon tan 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /theg chen rtsa ba snying rje rin po che/ /de yi bsgoms tshul bshad kyi gus pas nyon/ /de yang phyi rol pa sogs gzhan la med pas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa yi khyad chos/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yongs kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba/ snying rje chen po 'di yin pas theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ste/ rgyal ba gnyis pas legs bshad zla med sa gsum gyi sgron me byang chub lam rim chen mo las/ ji skad du/ thog mar gal che ba ni/ snying rje chen pos yid bskyod na sems can thams cad 'khor ba las 'don pa'i phyir nges par dam bca' bar 'gyur la/ snying rje med na de ltar byed par mi 'ong bas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer ba ni/ de la rag las pa'i phyir dang / khur de mi 'dzin na theg pa chen por mi chud pa'i phyir/snying rje ni thog mar gal che ba yin no/ /de ltar yang blo gros mi zad pa'i bstan pa las/ btsun pa shā ra twa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po mi zad de/ de 44

ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa shā ra twa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ dper na dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba ni mi'i srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po ni theg pa chen po yang dag par 'grub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /zhes dang / gā ya gro ri las kyang / 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni ci/ gnas ni gang / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni snying rje chen po'o/ /gnas ni sems can no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dam bcas pa de yang / tshogs gnyis rgya chen po la ma bslab na mi 'grub par mthong nas bya dka' ba'i tshogs rgya chen po la 'jug pas na spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rten no/ /bar du gal che ba ni/ de ltar lan cig sems de lta bu skyes nas zhugs kyang sems can grangs mang zhing byed ngan pa dang bslab par bya ba yang shin tu dka' zhing mtha' yas pa dang dus kyang dpag tu med par dgos par mthong ba na zhum nas theg pa dman par ltung ba la/ snying rje chen po lan cig bskyed pa tsam min par je 'phel du goms par byas pas rang gi bde sdug la mi lta zhing gzhan gyi don la mi skyo bas tshogs thams cad bde blag tu 45

rdzogs par byed de/ sgom rim dang po las/ de ltar snying rje chen pos bskyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag nyid la mi lta bar gzhan la shin tu phan pa don du gnyer ba'i phyir tshogs bsog pa shin tu bya dka' zhing yun ring la dub par 'gyur ba la 'jug go /'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa las gsungs pa lta bu ste/ de la snying rje chen po ni sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sdug bsngal gyi skye ba mi len pa ci yang med de/ des bde ba'i skye ba mi 'dor ba ci yang med do zhes so/ /de ltar shin tu bya dka' ba la zhugs na ring por mi thogs par tshogs yongs su rdzogs so/ /gdon mi za bar thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni snying rje kho na yin no/ /zhes so/ /tha mar gal che ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams 'bras bu brnyes ba'i tshe yang theg dman bzhin zhi bar mi gnas par nam mkha' ji srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yang snying rje chen po'i mthu ste/ de med na nyan thos ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ bsgom rim bar pa las/ snying rje chen pos yongs su zin pas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag brnyes kyang sems can gyi khams mthar thug gi bar 46

du bzhugs par mdzad do/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu ni snying rje chen po de nyid yin no/ /zhes so/ /dper na lo tog la thog mar sa bon dang bar du chu dang tha mar smin pa gal che ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi lo tog la yang thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba snying rje yin par dpal ldan zla ba grags pas gsungs te/gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas las smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes so/ /don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ chos yang dag par sdud pa las kyang / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyis na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na 'khor 47

los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che de gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na srog gi dbang po mchis na dbang po gzhan rnams kyang mchis par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du steng rje chen po mchis na byang chub sems dpa'i chos gzhan rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung ba yin/zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub tu mngon par mos pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni/ snying rje chen po yin no zhes dang / phar phyin bsdus pa las/ thub rgyal theg pa snying rje'i bstan pa la/ /gzhan phan ro gcig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /ces dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ mtshan gyi lha mo dpyid ldan nor bzang mas kho mo'i snying rje rgya mtsho tshad med de/ /'di las dus gsum rgyal ba 'jig rten 'byung / /des ni 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar byed/ /ces dang / rgyan las/ dang po rtsa ba tha mar 'bras mchog 48

ldan/ /'di ni snying rje ljon shing chen po yin/ /rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na/ /dka' spyad bzod pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snying rje chen po yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ /sems can rnams la snying rje su mi byed/ /'di ltar 'di dag la ni sdug bsngal yang / /brtses bskyed bde ba gzhal du med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i chos ni gcig ste/ bdag gi bde ba la ma chags pa'i snying rje chen po'o/ /zhes dang / blo sbyong snyan rgyud du lung du drangs pa las/ mchod pa bla na med pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems bskyed pa dang / chos 'dzin pa dang snying rje bsgoms pa'o/ /zhes dang /dge sdig rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ tshe ring ba ni snying rje che ba las 'ongs so/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprid pa sangs pa'i sgra las/ yon gyi mchog ni snying rje ste/ /de bas snying rje ldan par byos/ /zhes dang / dge bshes ston pa'i drung du/ btsun chung zhig mjal du byung ba la/ kham pa lung pa khong ci mdzad kyin gda' gsungs pa la/ kham pa grog kha re bzhugs/ dbu btums te bshums pa 'ba' zhig mdzad cing gda' zhus pas/ston pa dbu zhwa phud/ thugs shar thal mo sbyar nas/ spyan chab mang po byung nas shin tu ngo mtshar che/ chos bya ba khong gis byas 49

pa yin/ 'di'i yon tan mang po bshad rgyu yod de/ da lta bshad na khong mi mnyes par 'dug gsungs par gda'/ des na jo bo bka' brgyud rnams kyang thugs dam gyi gtso bo 'di la mdzad par gda' gsungs/ bka' gdams glegs bam las jo bo sems can nyon mongs pa tshan che bar yod na de dag bsal nas gdams ngag byed na ci 'dra zhig bgyid 'tshal/ 'brom snying rje phan sems gal che/ jo bo chos thams cad rang la/ snying rje phan sems gal che ba ma lags sam/ 'brom de bas kho de skad zer/ de med na gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa shas chen po rnams mi thul/ jo bo 'o na 'jig rten gyi nad yams chen po la sogs pa 'go ba'i nad kyi gseb tu/ phan sems kyis phyin na 'go 'am mi 'go 'brom rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ma zhugs par/phan sems kho nas phyin na de mi 'go bar ma zad/ sngags nag gi phur kha dang mu stegs kyi ngan sngags kyi sna dang / ma mo'i rbad kha dang / dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gseb tu phyin yang / de la gnod pa 'ong mi srid/ jo bo phan sems chen po skye ba la rgyu gang gal che/ 'brom snying rje drag po thun mong mo yin pa de gal che'o gsungs/ yang jo bo de'i lugs kyi tshad med bzhi'i 'go gang nas rtsom/ 'brom sems la bzod klag med pa gcig byung na/50

de la 'dor 'dod kyi sems skye ba gcig 'ong ba yin/ dper na bu me dong du lhung na/ ma la bzod klag med ba'i sems skye ste/bya ba gal che'o thams cad lang nge lang nge la bsgyur nas/ bu gcig bu ci thon gyi sems su rngams nas 'gro/ 'brom gzhan du bu la byams pa chen po yod kyang / bu de tsam du mi nyes na bya ba gzhan gtsor byed do/ /'brom sems can thams cad la bzod klag med pa'i snying rje yod na/ bya ba thams cad dor nas sems can ci 'drongs byed pa gcig 'ong / de la brten nas pha ma yin par ngo shes par go nye ring gcig kyang med/ de dag bden dang skyid na dga' ba'i sems 'ba' zhig sbyong ngo / /de yang sangs rgyas thob na bde skyid thams cad zhor la 'ong bas/sangs rgyas la ci 'khod byed pa'o/ /'brom des na snying rje chen po nas 'go bzung la/ snying rje ba'i sems can rnams su yin ltos/ pha mar shes tsa na/ phan ci thogs kyi byams pa gyes/byams bsngo tsa na thams cad skyid na dga' ba sangs rgyas na dga' ba'i dga' ba bsgoms/ dga' bsngo tsa na thams cad la nye ring dang phyogs ris med pa rang skyid pa la nye ring med pa bzhin/ btang snyoms chen pos khyab par gyis/ thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis sleb par gyis/ 'brom des na 51

phan sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin/ snying rje la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad 'byung gsungs/ snying rje med pa'i skyon ni sa ra has/ /snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /de ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal rnam 'phrul las/ stong pa nyid la so sor rtog cing / sems can yal bar 'dor ba ni bdud kyi las so/ /zhes dang / 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ snying rje med la 'gro don rgyangs khyi za gsungs so/ /'o na snying rje ji ltar bsgom snyam na/ tshe 'di la drin che shos ma yin pas de la thog mar bsgom tshul ni/ blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus las/ ma 'dis bdag la byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bzung ste/'phral yun du phan pa'i phyogs rnams sgrub pa dang / gnod pa dang sdug bsngal las ci nus kyis bskyabs pa dang / bdag la sdug bsngal byung dus ma bzod pa'i sgo gsum gyis rnam 'gyur dang / bdag gi ched du sdig sdug dang du blangs pa rnams bsams nas snying rje drag tu bsgoms/ de'i dus su bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / skyabs 'gro byed cing bsgom na 'chun che zhing skye sla bar 'dug pas de bzhin bya/skyabs 'gro byed pa'i dus su rang btang snyoms su bzhag ma 52

dmigs yul du byas/ de'i sdig sdug rnams bsams te/ skyabs gsol snying gi dkyil rus pa'i gting nas bya/ gzhan la mi gnod na skad gseng mthon po bya/ snying rje skyes na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang zhing sna mi bskyil/ de ltar drag la yun ring bsgoms pas/ snying rje skyes te ma de'i sdig sdug bsal ba dang /bde dge bskyed par 'dod kyang / de'i nus pa bdag la med cing / bla ma dkon mchog la yod pas/ ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer na gzhan la ra mda' sgron pa bzhin du/ bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs drag po bya'o/ /ma'i mtshon te pha la sogs pa gang snying nye ba dang / drin che ba rnams la de lta ra bsgom mo/ /sdug bsngal che ba la bsgom pa ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ste/ 'di rnams ni bdag tshad pas cung zad gdungs pa'ang bsil ba'i thabs byed pa dang / tha na kha tshig gis dogs nas/ tshod ma la phus 'debs pa dang / bdag 'khyags kyis dogs nas/ lus kyi drod kyis bsro ba dang / bdag bkres skom gyes dogs nas/ rang gis spyod mi nus pa'i longs spyod rnams 'phangs pa med par ster ba dang / nu zhos yang yang bskyangs pa dang / bdag la tha na bza' btung gi za tshul tshun chod legs par slob cing /53

bdag na yis dogs shi yis dogs nas dka' ba dpag med spyod pa'i ma yin na/ 'di dag tsha grang bkres skom glen lkugs —sogs kyis gzir ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'drar 'gyur ba snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgoms shing / snying rje ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes nas de dag sdug bsngal bral ba dang / bde ba la 'god pa'i don du sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab/ yang rnam pa gsal ba'i dgra dang nad gdon dang khral bu lon sogs kyis nyam thag pa'i mi sogs sdug bsngal gang che ba la de ltar bsgom mo/ /sdig pa che ba la bsgom pa ni/ kha drag btsan phyug 'dzom zhing / 'khor g.yog mang la sdig pa rlabs can byed pa 'di rnams ngan song bas kyang ches cher snying rje bar 'dug 'di dag la snying rje drag po skye thang ba la mi skye ba de/ rtag par rang la'aring tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thob 'dod kyi blo phugs na yod pa'i rtags su gda' gsungs/ 'di rnams rang gzhan la gang phan byas pas chog pa la/ tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad re'i phyir 'di tsam pas sdig pa byed byed nas/ dngos su rang gzhan gnyis phung byed cing / phugs su rang gi 'dun ma gtan brlag la gtong ba 'di rnams sems so na gnas pas dug 'thung na ci zer/ de'i dper yang mi bzod na 'di lta bu'i las byed pa 54

re snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgom zhing yang sngar ltar bya'o/ /gzhan yang gang sdig pa che ba rnams la'ang de ltar bsgom mo/ /skye dka' ba la bsgom pa ni/ bdag gis phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byed pa lta bu la yang bsgom ste/ 'dis thog ma med pa nas sdug bsngal dpag med myong zhing / da dung yang gnod pa la sogs pa'i las ngan bsags pas sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar 'gyur la/ 'di dag gis kyang bdag gi pha ma yang yang byas shing phan yang yang btags pa'i drin can yin na/ 'di ltar gyur par snying rje snyam du sngar ltar bsgom mo/ /sems can thams cad la bsgom pa ni/ rang gi tshe 'di'i ma lta bu de shes pa gdon gyes brlams pas na spyo bar gyur/ mig kyang long / long khrid kyang med/ sa phyogs kyang mi bde/ de'i dbang gis gom pa re bor ba na brdab cing 'ong / de nas kyang g.yang 'jigs su rung bar lhung bar 'dug na/ de la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye ba yin/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad ma ni yin/nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis btab ste/ thog ma med pa nas smyos pa bzhin du gyur/ gti mug gis shes rab kyi mig kyang long /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis long 'khrid kyang med/ 'khor ba'i gad bub mang po'i lam yang mi bde/ de nas ngan song rnam pa 55

gsum gyi g.yang sa 'og nas 'og tu khrogs kyis ltung ba rnams la dmigs kyin yang snying rje bsgom mo/ /'di skye ba yang sla zhing bsod nams kyang che gsungs/ gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ jo bo snying rje bsgom pa'i thabs gcig zhu 'tshal/ 'brom zhu ba che/ sems can nad drag pos gzir ba'i rtsar rgyug de sems can thams cad la dmigs pas khob la/sems can thams cad kyis 'di lta bu'i lus blangs pas/ lus 'di yod na nad 'di 'byung / mdze thog tu phol/ gnyan thog tu gzer/ gzer thog tu gzer bsnan nas/ sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba 'ba' zhig 'ong ba snying re rje/ a tsa ma 'di gzhan min/ nga yang yang bskyed pa'i pha ma yin snyam du/ rtsa ba'i ma de me dong du lhung ba'i snying rje tsam du mi bzod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dbul ba dang phongs pa dang / bkres skom gos med pa rnams kyi rtsar phyin cing / yang de kho na bzhin du snying rje bsgom mo/ /rang gi spyil bu na gnas pa'i tshe yang dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sems brtse yam yam pa bsgoms/ de yang bzod klag med par bsgoms gsungs/ lam rim myur lam las thog mar bshan pas gsod bzhin pa'i lug lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la dmigs nas 56

bsgoms/ de'i tshul ni mdun du de rnams kyi rnam pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ yan lag rnams ni bcings/ brang gi pags pa ni gshags/ bshan pa'i lag pa khong bar bcug pas srog la babs pa ni mngon sum du shes/ mig bshan pa'i gdong la trig hrig tu blta zhing sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i tshul bsams nas/ des na 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsungs/ de la myong ba thon pa na dge 'dun gyi dkor la bag med du spyod pa dang / tshul 'chal dang chos spong mkhan dang log lta can dang / sems can la 'tshe zhing sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byed pa la rkyen rkyen por byed pa'i 'gro ba rnams la dmigs nas bsgoms gsungs/ de dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ rgyas par 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal brgyad dang drug dang / gsum dang bye brag rigs drug so sor sdug bsngal dang / byang sa las snying rjes dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu gsungs pa la bltas nas blo'i mthu yod pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /gang 57

ltar byas kyang snying rje skye bar mi 'dod na/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid las skyabs sems sngon du song bas rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms pas rang gi mdun du rtsa ba'i ma gsal btab nas/de'i ltor chags pa nas btsas pa dang / mthar nar son pa'i bar bskyangs pa'i drin bsam la/ brtse gdungs drag tu shugs bskyed nas/ ngag tu nga'i ma zhes yang yang brjod la/ba spu g.yo ba dang 'chi ma 'khrugs pa nam byung bar bsgom zhing /de ltar ma byung na lus spus brang sbyar/ gdong smad bzhin bsdus lag pas 'gram skyor/ srin lag khar bcug mya ngan gyi lus gnad dang ldan pas snying rje drag tu bsgoms shing / pha bla ma bdag gi ma drin can 'di thar pa'i lam la dus da lta rang drongs mdzod/ ces ra mda' 'bod pa'i tshul du skad kyi nga ro chen pos gsol ba 'debs shing / bsgom gyi sne zin nas dmigs pa kha bsgyur/ 'gro drug pha ma yongs la spos nas bsgom ste/ lha la 'chi 'pho/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/mi la myong grub skye rga na 'chi/ dud 'gro la gsod 'khol/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dmyal ba'i tsha grang btso bsreg rnams dran par byas la snying rje bskyed cing / yus ngo thon gyi pha ma zhes drag 58

shul du gsol ba phur tshugs su btab rjes/ ma rgan 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal dang len gyis bzod stobs bskyed mthar/ bdag gzhan mnyam nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog gsungs pa ltar yang bsgom par bya'o/ /snying rje chen po ma skyes kyi bar du/ thun gyi ngo bo tsam la bsgoms par ma zad/ thun rjes la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du dran par byas nas rgyun ldan du bsgom na bogs che ste/ bsgom rim bar pa las/ snying rje de ting nge 'dzin la 'dug kyang rung / spyod lam thams cad du yang rung ste/ dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya gsungs/ des na thun 'tshams rnams su snying rje ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel la blta zhing tshigs su bcad pa dbyangs su bton nas bskyang bar bya'o/ /bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'brom rin po ches/ bdag gi pha ma nyon mongs dgra bos khyer/ /dgra bor bcas pa skye rga na 'chi yi/ /chu bo bzhi ru rab tu bying bar gyur/ /thar pa'i gzings bcas bla ma mnyam pa mchog /phan bde'i skya bas kha lo rab bsgyur nas/ /bdag gi pha ma skams la 'don du gsol/ /phal cher mu mtha' med pa'i rgya mtshor shor/ /bla ma klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu can/ /nga yi pha ma bde ba'i skams la drongs/ /mthu 59

dpal rmad mnga' khyed kyis drang du gsol/ /zhes pa dang / sku gsum don thugs las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re rje/ /brtse sems bu gcig shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol bar dam bca' zhing / /ji ltar bya mos sgong gso gab pa ltar/ /rnam mkhyen sa la 'god pa'i byams pa dang / /rgyal po'i gdung brgyud chad khar sras 'khrungs ltar/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho thob pa'i dga' ba dang / /drang srong rgyal pos gtor ma bsngo ba bzhin/ /nye ring dgra gnyen med pa'i btang snyoms dang / /'gro rnams bla med sa la 'god pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis theg chen bla med sgrub par bgyi/ /gnod pa'i lan du phan pa'i gdung shugs bskyed/ /gsungs pa sogs tshigs bcad gang shes brjod cing don yid la bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas snying rje skyes pa'i tshad ni/ bsgom rim dang po las/ gang gi tshe yid du 'ong ba'i bu mi bde ba bzhin du/ sems can la yang sdug bsngal gtan nas byang bar 'dod pa'i rnam pas snying rje rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa bdag nyid kyis mtshungs par 'jug par 'gyur ba de'i tshe de rdzogs pa yin pas snying rje chen po'i ming 'thob ste/ zhes dang / de 60

bzhin du rje rin po ches/ bu chung snying du ches sdug pa sdug bsngal bar gyur pa la mde snying rje ji tsam skyes pa de tsam pa'i blo chod gcig sems can thams cad la snying rje rang gi ngang gis skye ba na/ snying rje chen po'i mtshan nyid tshang bar gsungs so/ /smras pa/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /yal bar mi 'dor brtse bas skyong mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi pha ma yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang gi lus srog gcod pa'i dgra la yang / /pha ma'i 'du shes skyes nas lhag par du/ /brtse ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /bdag gi pha ma sems can bu bzhin skyongs/ /sems can sdug bsngal mthong na bzhugs mi tshugs/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /bdag gi pha ma sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus zhi bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang gi tshe rabs thog ma ma mchis pas/ /tshe sngon pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /drin can pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro kun gyis/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid tsha ba'i dus/ /bsil bar byed pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta tsha dmyal brgyad du skyes/ /tsha ba'i 61

sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid grang ba'i dus/ /drod kyis bskyangs pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta grang dmyal brgyad du skyes/ /grang ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid bkres skom dus/ /bza' btung ster ba'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta yi dwags gnas su skyes/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid blun pa'i dus/ /blang dor ston pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes/ /bkol spyod sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid na ba'i dus/ /nad g.yog byed pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta mi yi gnas su skyes/ /na 'chi'i sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid 'jigs pa'i dus/ /bsu skyel byed pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta lha min gnas su skyes/ /'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /tshe sngon bu ngan rang nyid dbul ba'i dus/ /gang 'dod ster ba'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /la la da lta lha yi gnas su skyes/ /'pho ltung sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /kye hud pha mar ma gyur su yang med/ /'khor ba'i gnas su bde ba gang yang med/ /rang la skyob pa'i nus pa ci yang med/ /kye ma kye hud da ni 62

ji ltar bya/ /bde med sdug bsngal brgya yis gtses pa yi pha ma sems can 'di kun sdug bsngal dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral gyur cig /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag gis pha ma drin can sems can gye/ /sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la 'god par bya/ /de ltar nus par bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ /tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod sdug bsngal dang / /na 'chi 'thab rtsod 'pho ltung sdug bsngal sogs/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal ma lus zhi bar shog /chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyi rgyan gyi mchog /dpag med yon tan 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje rin po che/ /tshe rabs kun du 'bral ba med gyur cig /ces pa'i tshig rnams ngag tu brjod cing snying thag pa nas de dag gi don rnams yid la bsam na/ ring por mi thogs par snying rje chen po rgyud la bde blag tu skyes nas/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur pas na/ bsgoms pa la brtson par mdzod cig /ces smras pa'o/ /yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan gyi slob bu lha rje kun dgas rna g.yu sogs nor sna mang po zhig phul nas/ rab tu 63

gus pas phyag dang bcas kho bo la nges par sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa zhig bstan du gsol/ zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad de dbyangs su phul ba/ zab gsal thugs kyi mthing shog la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi gser yig bris/ /mi brjed gzungs kyi na bzas klubs/ /rje glegs bam lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mkhyen rab kha gnyis shin tu rno/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba rtsad nas gcod/ /rje ral gri lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags rjes yi rang / /zab rgyas chos zhu zhabs brtan 'bul/ /dge tshogs sku tshe brtan phyir bsngo/ /de mthus bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod/ /gdams pa rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /sngon chad tshe 'di'i dbang du song / /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen 'di/ /don med tshe 'di'i las la bskol/ /don chen yal bar shor nas song / /da ni rgan po 'chi la nye/ /mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'ong / /bsam pas skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /da lta bla ma'i zhabs drung snyegs/ /da ni rje btsun rin po che/ /'chi brod gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /bstan bzhin nyams su len nus par/ /bla ma khyed kyis byin gyes 64

rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /gsungs bzhin thos bsam bsgom byas nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du gdams pa 'di nyid bstan te/ 'o nges par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob phyir/ theg pa chen po mdo sngags kyi chos kyi sgor zhugs nas/ chos rnam dag cig byed rgyu yin na/ theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba'i rmang rdo lta bu'i byams snying rje gnyis dang / skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad la bslab na bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs nas/ dka' tshegs med par myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur bas blo gros can rnams kyis 'di la bslab pa gal che/ de la ji ltar slob snyam na/ de yang rang gi tshe sngon ma rnams su drin can gyi pha ma sogs gnyen mdza' bshes su gyur nas phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med las skyabs/ sems can thams cad da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pa'i zag med thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gi bde ba phar zhog bar skabs su zag bcas lha mi'i nang gi tshangs pa brgya byen sogs phun sum tshogs pa tsam zhig gi bde ba yang med pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ drin can pha ma sems can 'di dag kun 65

zag bcas zag med kyi bde bde dag dang / de'i rgyu dge ba kun dang ldan pa zhig byung na ci ma rung ldan par gyur cigaldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snyam du sems can thams cad la byams pa shugs drag la rgyun ring ba bsgoms/ yang skye rga na 'chi yod med 'du 'bral brdeg brdung sogs 'khor ba spyi yi sdug bsngal dang / khyad par du dmyal ba tsha grang yi dwags bkres skom/dud 'gro bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal rnams bsam ste/ sdug bsngal myong ba'i pha ma sems can 'di kun shin tu snying re rje/'di rnams spyir 'khor ba dang / khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung bral bar gyur cig bral ba zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ snyam du snying rje shugs drag po nan tan yang yang bsgom/ de nas bdag gis nam zhig pha ma sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams 'byor ba chen po la 'jog nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus kyis sems can gyi don byed nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du gnas nas sems can la phan 'dogs 66

nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor ba chen pos sems can rnams kyis bsam pa rdzogs par byed nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal nges par 'byin nus snyam pa dang / sems can la mi phan pa'i skye ba dang / don dam pa'i ro la gcig tu spyod pa dang / skye bo thams cad sem par mi byed pa'i tshig dang / gzhan la mi phan pa'i 'tsho ba dang / lus dang shes rab dang / nor dang dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang /gzhan la gnod pa byed pa la dga' bar tshe rabs thams cad du ma gyur cig snyam pa dang / sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin zhing / bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu de dag la smin par gyur cig snyam du bsgom mo/ /skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad po ngo bo rnam rtog yin yang / shin tu ngo mtshar can yin pas/ skyes bu chen po rnams kyis kyang bsgom par gsungs na/ 'o skol rnams kyis bsgom dgos pa lta ci smos/des na rab tu 'bad nas bsgom par bya'o/ /slar yang smras pa/drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kye hud pha mar ma gyur sems can med/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba skad cig med/ /bde med 67

sems can byams pas cis mi skyongs/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /bdag gis nam shaṃg sems can thams cad kyi/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sel nus snyam pa dang / /nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams/ /'byor ba chen po 'jog nus snyam pa dang / /nam zhig sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa'i/ /lus kyis 'gro don byed nus snyam pa dang / /nam zhig dmyal bar gnas nas sems can la/ /phan 'dogs chen po byed nus snyam pa dang / /nam zhig 'byor ba chen pos sems can gyis/ /bsam pa rdzogs par byed nus snyam pa dang / /nam zhig sangs rgyas gyur nas sems can gyi/ /sbug bsngal nges par 'byen nus snyam pa dang / /sems can rnams la mi phan skye ba dang / /don dam ro la gcig tu spyod pa dang / /skye bo thams cad dga' bar mi byed tshig /sems can gzhan la mi phan 'tsho ba dang / /lus dang shes rab nor dang dbang phyug dang / /gzhan la gnod pa byed la sems dga' bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu ma gyur snyam pa dang / /sems can sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu de dag la/ /smin par gyur cig snyam du bsgom par bya/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /gzhan phan bsam pa 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /68

zhes tshig ngag tu brjod cing / don yid la bsam na byams pa dang snying rje gzhan la phan 'dogs 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems rnams rim gyis ngam ngam shugs kyis rgyud la bde blag tu sgyes nas/ theg pa chen po'i gral du chud cing / phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang rang bzhin gyis bsam pa bzang zhing / tshul khrims gtsang ba'i skal ldan gyi slob ma blo bzang don 'grub kyis/ kho bo la skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus pa yongs su skong ba'i gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs tshul dang / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs tshul/ kha gsal zhing nyung la 'dus che ba zhig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ 'gro kun ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes/ /khyed kyis bdag cag rnams kyi phyir/ /bskal pa dpag med sngon rol nas/ /yang yang byang chub thugs mchog bskyed/ /rang nyid gces 'dzin sdug bsngal sgo/ /gzhan rnams gces 'dzin yon tan gzhir/ /gzigs nas rang nyid yal bar dor/ /sems can gzhan la rab tu gces/ /sdug bsngal rang bde 'dod las byung / /bde ba gzhan phan sems 69
