las byung / /de gnyis rnam dbye legs mkhyen nas/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje/ /snying rje chen pos thugs bskyod nas/ /'gro ba'i don la skyo ngal med/ /gnod pa byed pa'i dgra la yang / /rab tu brtse bas phan thogs mdzad/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi mar/ /rang yang bzhes shing gzhan dag la/ /bgo bsha' byed pa khyed min su/ /de phyir bdag las gzhan gces kyi/ /byang chub sems la mnga' brnyes pas/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ /'jam dbyangs mi yi tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yi/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo ltar/ /rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang ni/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bsgom tshul zhal gdams zab mo zhig /brtse bas bdag la bstan du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas/ byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs tshul la/ dang po mar shes pa ni rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mches pa'i tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su/ sems can thams cad rang gi mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ sems can re res kyang ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod ces thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyis 70

gsungs pas na/ gsung de tshad mar bzung nas/ sems can thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa rang gi ma yin snyam du bsam/gnyis pa drin dran pa ni sems can rnams kyis ma byas res kyis/ tshe 'di'i mas rang ji ltar bskyangs pa de ltar phan tshad med pa btags gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pas drin can sha stag yin snyam du bsam/ gsum pa drin gzo ba ni 'jig rten 'di na lan cig zas gos tsam byen pa dang / 'jigs pa las skyobs pa'i dpon zhig la yang slar mi des drin gzo zhig ma byas na kun gyis mi de la khrel med par brtsi na/ tshe 'khor ba thog med nas yang yang phan btags 'jigs pa las skyobs pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad la/ rang gis drin gzo zhig ma byas na de las khrel med cig gzhan na med pas/ sems can thams cad la drin gzo bzang po zhig ci nas kyang bya snyam du bsam/ bzhi pa byams pa ni sems can thams cad kyis 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang / sgrub pa sdug bsngal gye rgyu kho na sgrub pas zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu shor ba'i dbang gis/ da lta'i gnas skabs thar pa'i bde ba phar zhog mngon mtho'i nang gi lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byin/mi'i nang gi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal tsam gyi bde ba yang med/ de 71

phar zhog mi phal cher la/ deng sang gi mi tshangs phyug po gcig gi bde ba yang med/ de phar zhog ngan song gsum gyi sems can la mi thabs rdugs shos tsam zhig bde ba yang med pas na/ ma gyur sems can 'di kun bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung / ldan par gyur cig ldan pa zhig bya'o snyam du dper na mas bu gcig pu zas gos kyis phongs pa la rtag tu byams pa ltar/ sems can thams cad la yid 'ong gi byams pa bsgom mo/ /lnga pa snying rje ni yang sems can la bde ba med par ma zad/ dmyal ba la tsha grang / yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la yod pa 'tsho skyong med pa btsal na mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal dang / dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad cing gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang / thun mong du skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas na/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i ma gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung / bral bar gyur cig bral bar bya'o snyam du dper na mas bu gcig yod pa me nang du lhung ba mthong na mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye ba ltar/sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bsgom/ drug pa lhag 72

bsam ni byams pa dang snying rje drag po'i ngang nas/ bde ba med cing sdug bsngal gyis bar mtshams med par gdungs pas nyam thag ma gyur sems can 'di dag rnams kyis bu bdag la mi re na su la re/ bu bdag gis ma 'di dag la phan mi 'dogs na gzhan su zhig gis phan 'dogs/ da ni ma gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa kun spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las bdag gis bsgral bar bya'o/ /bde ba med pa rnams gnas skabs su lha mi'i bde ba dang / mthar thug gtan bde thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bdag nyid gcig pus 'god par bya'o snyam du lhag bsam rnam dag bsgom/ bdun pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ 'o na rang gis ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal bde ba la 'god pa'i khur khyer yang / da lta'i gnas skabs su rang gis sems can thams cad phar zhog sems can gcig tsam gyi sdug bsngal sna gcig mi sel/ bde ba sna gcig ster mi nus par ma zad/ rang yang las nyon dbang gis gar 'gro'i gtad so ma mchis pas/ de lta bu'i nus pa su la yod snyam na/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la yod/ rang gis de lta bu'i go 73

'phang zhig thob rgyu yin na/ sku'i sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sems can bye ba ther 'bum gyi sdug bsngal dus gcig la bsal/ bde ba la dus gcig la 'god pa'i nus pa yod pas na/ da ni rang gzhan gang gi don du yang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig ma thob pa'i thabs mi 'dug pas/ bdag gis myur bar myur du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob na ci ma rung / thob par gyur cig thob pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du blo sbyongs pa'o/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs tshul ni/ 'o na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas gang la bslab par bya snyam na/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su/ rang yal bar dor gzhan gces par bzung nas/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis blangs/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin pas sngon nas sangs rgyas so/ /'o skol rnams kyis gzhan yal bar dor rang gces par bzung nas rang don ma 'grub par ma zad/ da bar 'khor bar 'khyams nas sdug bsngal myong ba yin pas/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ltar/ rang gis kyang sems can thams 74

cad kyi don du myur du sangs rgya ba'i phyir/ bdag las gzhan gces kyi bsam pas gyong dang pham kha rang gis blangs/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster thub na ci ma rung / thub par gyur cig thub pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du blo sbyongs pa 'di ka lags/de ltar sbyangs na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi a mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /gyur dus tshe 'di'i ma bzhin drin re che/ /drin can rnams la drin gzo cis kyang dgos/ /bde ba med pa rnams la byams par bya/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag yongs la snying rje bsgoms/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal bsal/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ /sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la 'god pa'i slad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rang don dor/ /gzhan don mdzad nas sangs rgyas thob pa ltar/ /da ni bdag kyang rang don yal bar dor/ /'gro ba gzhan gyi don la brtson par bya/ /rgyal bu thams cad sgol du gyur(blo sbyong rma bya dug 75

'joms las/)pa na/ /bu dang bu mo rgyal srid sbyin pa ltar/ /shin tu 'phreng ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod sogs/ /'phangs pa med par yongs su gtang bar bya/ /rgyal bu snying stobs chen por gyur pa na/ /stag mos rang gi sha yis gsos pa ltar/ /shin tu gces pa'i sgyu lus phung po 'di/ /sha za'i tshogs la dga' bas sbyin par bya/ /rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na/ /gnod sbyin rang gi khrag gis gsos pa ltar/ /gcad par dka' ba'i snying khrag dron mo 'di/ /khrag 'thung dag la brtse bas sbyin par bya/ /tshong dpon khye'u chu 'bebs gyur pa na/ /bde gshegs mtshan brjod nya rnams drangs pa ltar/ /chos kyi 'phongs pa'i skye bo thams cad la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa sbyin par bya/ /rgyal bu dge don chen por gyur pa'i tshe/ /ngan ngon log sgrub thugs rjes bzod pa ltar/ /'khor gyi log sgrub gshis ngan 'khrug pa la/ /snying rje chen pos lhag par brtse bar bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' —spre'ur gyur pa na/ /sdig can khron pa'i gnas nas drangs pa ltar/ /ngan pa dag la phan btags mi shes kyang / /bzang lan mi 'dod snying rjes drangs par bya/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob 76

bar/ /byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /ces tshig gi rjes su don 'brang ba byas/ blo yang yang sbyangs na/ skabs shig byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnams ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byongs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang dad brtson snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu sbyin pa sangs rgyas kyis rtsam pa do po gcig dang lha rdzas bcas phul nas gdams pa dgos zhes zhu don phul ba/ mnyam med thub dbang rnam thar ltar/ /dang po byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du bskal mang tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tha ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob/ /da lta bdag sogs gtsug gi rgyan/ /khyed la gus pas zhu don ni/ /chos med dkor zan ser gzugs bdag /dang po ma rig dbang du song / /bar du nyon mongs dug lnga langs/ /tha ma las ngan sna tshogs bsags/ /da lta chos med lus su skyes/ /da ni bla ma rin po che/ /khyed la brten nas lha chos zhig /byed snyam zhabs pad drung du 'ong / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa stsal du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ /khyed kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ /lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces phul ba'i lan du gdams pa 'di nyid 77

bstan te/ 'o sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis/dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mtha' ma myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sems bskyed pa 'di gal che/ de ji ltar bskyed na bla ma'i drung ngam/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi mdun nam/ yang na rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' dang 'od kyi klong na bla ma thub pa'i dbang po sogs tshogs shing rnams khra lam mer bzhugs yod par mos nas/ de la yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal phul/ skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas sems bskyed dngos la ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du phar phyin drug sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rnams la bslab par bya snyam du/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gye bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya/78

de nas/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes spro ba bskyed/ de nas sems bskyed de nyams pa'i rgyu nag po'i chos bzhi spang ba ni/ bla ma mkhan slob sogs la dzun smras nas dbu skor ba dang gcig gzhan dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang gnyis/byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis mi snyan pa smras pa dang gsum/ lhag bsam ma yin par g.yo sgyu byed pa dang bzhi yin/sems bskyed 'phel ba'i rgyu dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab pa ni/ sems can su la yang tha na ku re bzhad gad kyi phyir yang dzun mi smras pa dang gcig g.yo rgyu med par drang por byed pa dang gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang gsum/ rang la ltos pa'i gdul bya rnams nyi tshe ba'i theg pa la mi sbyor bar rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dzin du bcug pa dang bzhi yin/ gzhan yang sems bskyed 'phel ba'i phyir du dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa'i tshogs gnyis bsogs pa la brtson par bya'o//79

smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas dang po thugs bskyed bzhin/ /rang yang smon 'jug sems bskyed byed pa la/ /bla ma rten gyi drung ngam rang ga yang / /mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs shing gsal bar bsgoms/ /yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal skyabs 'gro bya/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /byang sems bslab bya rim bzhin bslab pa ltar/ /bdag kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /byang sems bslab bya rim bzhin bslab par bgyi/ /tshe sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /tshe 'dir dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /de ring ston pa sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis rigs mthun las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs la gnas par bya/ /rdzun gyis bla ma mkhan slob dbu bskor zhing / /dge ba byed la 'gyod sems bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpar khros nas mi snyan spras/ /lhag bsam ma yin g.yo sgyu byed pa ste/ /sems bskyed nyams pa'i nag po'i chos bzhi spang / /ku re phyir 80

yang dzun gyi tshig mi smra/ /g.yo sgyu med par drang po byed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan brjod/ /gdul bya theg chen chos sgor 'jug pa ste/ /sems bskyed 'phel ba'i dkar po'i chos bzhi bslab/ /gzhan yang sems bskyed gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa la yang brtson par bya/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /sems bskyed gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /ces sems bskyed yang yang bya'o/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la brtse gdungs/sems can la snying rje che ba'i skal ldan gyi slob ma blo bzang dge legs kyis/ nyin gcig mkho ba'i yo byad mang po phul nas/rab tu gus pas phyag dang bcas rang gi 'dod pa'i chos kyi zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bdag las gzhan gces byang sems kyis/ /gang yod chags med sbyin par gtong / /mig gi 'bras bzhin tshul khrims bsrung / /srog la babs kyang bzod pa bsgoms/ /dge 81

tshogs 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin ngang la bzhugs/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kun mkhyen/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i gzhan don mdzad/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che'i/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /blo gros ngan pa'i slob bu ngas/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed kyang / /rang gi don du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /rang rgyud smin par byed tshul dang / /gzhan gyi don du bsdu bzhi bslab/ /gzhan rgyud smin par bya ba'i tshul/ /sngon chad yang yang thos na yang / /da dung chen po mi shes gda'/ /theg chen byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /rang don ji ltar bsgrub tshul dang / /gzhan don ji ltar bya dgos tshul/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sogs/ /dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /nyung 'dus gsal bar bstan du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig sgrub pa dang / /khyod kyi gsung bzhin zab rgyas chos/ /sbyad nas myur du 'tshang rgya shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ rang rgyud smin byed phyin drug gi dang po sbyin pa'i nyams len ni/ rnyed bkur dang grags pa sogs la mi blta bar chos kyi phongs pa'i sems can 82

rnams la dam pa'i chos ci nus su ston par byed pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin dang 'byung pos gnod pa'i sems can rnams 'jigs pa de dag las skyobs par byed pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sems can rnams la las dang rnam smin la re ba med par ser sna spang ste/ ji ltar 'os pa'i yo byad gtong bar byed pa zang zing gi sbyin pa ste/ sbyin pa rnam pa gsum gyi nyams len la tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi nyams len ni/ mi dge ba bcu la sogs ji ltar khas blangs pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes spyod rnams spangs nas/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i dge ba rnam par dag pa rang rgyud la ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa rnams gong 'phel byas te/sems can thams cad kyang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i dge ba rnam par dag pa la sbyar nas smin grol gyi lam la 'god par bya'o/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i nyams len ni/ sems can thams cad dgrar langs kyang khro ba'i sems skad cig kyang mi bskyed par gnod lan du phan pa bsgrub ste/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bzod pa'i phar phyin la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang zas nor dang / gnas 83

mal sogs kyis phongs pa dang /na tsha sogs mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal thog tu babs pa'i tshe sdug bsngal 'di ltar myong ba sngar las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ 'di la brten nas las ngan mang po dag 'gro bas mi 'dod rgyu mi 'dug cing / khyad par chos phyir sdug bsngal byung ba la bzod bsran bskyed pa la brten nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la nye bar 'gyur bas/sdug bsngal 'di dag dang du blangs te rang gzhan gyi 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyun bcad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dkar nag gi las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub dang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas rnams la mos pa bskyed na 'bras bu che bas/ de la mos par byas nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir du/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas rnams la tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi nyams len ni/ mtshan dpe la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i chos 84

re re bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bskal pa 'bum phrag re rer mnar med du gnas nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub dgos na'ang /brtson pa mi 'dor zhing spro ba bskyed nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rang rgyud la bsdud par byed pa dang / gzhan yang dge ba'i lam la bkod nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o/ /lnga pa bsam gtan gyi nyams len ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan/phyogs kyi sgo nas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang / de gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i bsam gtan/ byed las kyi sgo nas tshe 'dir lus sems bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i bsam gtan/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan rnam pa thams cad la bslab par bya'o/ /drug pa shes rab kyi nyams len ni/ gnas lugs rig pa don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab/ gnas lnga rig pa kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab/sems can thams cad kyi don bya tshul rtogs pa'i shes rab ste rnam pa thams cad pa la basmab par bya'o/ /gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu bzhi ni/ sems can thams cad sbyin pas 'khor du bsdus te/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas chos ston pas snyan par smras pa dang / chos bstan pa'i don nyams su len du 'jug pas 85

don spyod pa dang / gzhan la bstan pa ltar rang gis kyang nyams su len pas don mthun pa ste/ gzhan don byed pa'i thabs bzang po 'di la brten nas/ sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god par bya'o/ /smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gzhan smin zhing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ /rnyed bkur grags pa sogs la mi blta bar/ /chos kyis phongs pa rnams la chos sbyin dang / /'jigs pas nyen la mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang / /nor gyis dbul la zang zing sbyin par bya/ /nyes spyod thams cad sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos rnams bsdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims rnams la bslab/ /gnod pa byed la khro med bzod pa dang / /chos phyir sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa dang / /chos la nges sems bzod pa rnams la bslab/ /yun ring go cha chen po'i brtson 'grus dang / /dge ba'i chos rnams bsdud pa'i brtson 'grus dang / /sems can don byed brtson 'grus rnams la bslarā/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das bsam gtan dang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel bsam gtan dang / /lus sems bde ba'i bsam gtan 86

rnams la bslab/ /gnas lugs rig pa don dam shes rab dang / /gnas lnga rig pa kun rdzob shes rab dang / /'gro don shes pa'i shes rab rnams la bslab/ /gdul byar mkho ba sbyin nas 'khor du bsdu/ /'dus tshe dam pa'i chos kyis snyan par smras/ /smras pa'i don bzhin de la spyod du 'jug /don der mthun pa'i nyams len rang yang bya/ /gzhan don byed pa'i thabs bzang bsdu bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro kun smin grol lam la 'god par bya/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gis de ltar nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i tshogs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /pha rol phyin drug bsdu bzhir slob gyur cig /ces tshig rjes su don 'brang ba byas/ shar bsgoms byas na nam zhig rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rnams la zhum pa med par slob nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang dad gtong blo gros dang ldan pa'i slob bu mkhas grub kyis dngul dang lug sogs nor rdzas mang po phul nas/ bdag rgan po 'chi la nye ba la/ nges par sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas 87

phul ba/ legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba zla med cing / /legs lam ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /legs gnas sku bzhi dam pa'i zhing khams su/ /legs par 'khrid mdzad bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang bsgrub pa snyom pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sngon chad tshe 'di'i dbang song mtho la lo bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /bdag sogs 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs bla ma'i bzhed don 'grub phyir bsngo/ /de mthus sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas par shog /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /mi rgan bdag la sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi gnad 'dus pa'i/ /tshegs chung don che'i gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /rnam dag bla ma mchog gi thugs rje yis/ /rnam mang tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /rnam dkar thos bsam bsgom pa'i grur zhugs nas/ /rnam grol nor bu'i gling du phyin par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o nges par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir chos rnam par dag pa zhig byed na/bod kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po glang ri thang ba/ rdo rje seṅge sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul du grags 88

pa des/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi don kun 'ub kyis bsdus te mdzad pa'i sngar med kyi gdams pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma 'di bzhin nyams len byed pa gal che/ de yang rang gi tshe sngon drin can gyi pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad phar zhog de'i nang nas tha na ngan slong gcig tsam la/ bsam pa byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ zas gos sogs sbyin pa sna re tsam btang ba'i bsod nams kyis tshe 'dir yang bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom zhing / phyi mar phyug po 'byor ldan gyi bu ru skyes nas gnas skabs su lha mi'i bde ba tshad med pa thob nas bde zhing / mthar thug skyon kun zad yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob la/ yang dgra la sogs gzhan gyi gnod pa byed pa la/ bzod pa lan re tsam bsgom rgyu'i skal pa byung na yang / de'i mthus tshe 'dir yang bsod nams chen po rgyas nas gzhan kun gyis chos pa bzang po ru go nas lha mi yongs kyis ngang gis byams shing phyi ma tshe rabs kun tu gzugs byad mjes shing 'khor gdul bya ma/nga po 'dus nas bkur zhing / mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob nas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /des na sems 89

can re re la yang brten nas rang gi 'phral phug gi 'dod don thams cad 'grub na sems can thams cad kyis smos ci dgos/des na ma gyur sems can rang la 'phral phug gang du phan pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar bltas nas/ gcig kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar rang gi khog pa'i snying dang dpral ba'i mig ltar rtag tu gces par 'dzin pa dang / grong dgon dpen gnas sogs gnas bzang ngan gang du sdod kyang rung / skya ser pho mo la sogs grogs su dang 'grogs kyang rung / rang nyid gzhan kun las dman par blta zhing gzhan kun yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor ltar bltas nas/ mchog dman bar gsum thams cad la snying thag pa nas mchod bstod bkur nas lus ngag yid gsum gye sgo nas gus pa khyad par can bya ba dang / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs spyod lam gang gi dus su yang / rang rgyud la rtogs shing chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa phra rags gang skyes kyang skyes ma thag ma bcoms na/ rang gzhan kun phongs nas ma rungs pa byed pas na/ de ma thag btsan thabs su gdod nas bzlog par byed pa dang / shin tu rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can sdig pa'i las tshan po che dang / sdug bsngal drag pos non 90

pa mthong tshe yal bar mi 'dor bar/ rin chen gter dang 'phrad pa ltar/ rnyed par dka' bar bsams nas gces par 'dzin pa dang / rang la gzhan gyis phrag dog gi dbang gis don med par gshe skur mtshang 'bru brdeg brdung sogs mi rig pa'i nyes skyon chen po byed pa byung na yang dag gtsang tsam yang mi bya bar/ rang la khyod rang gis tshe sngon las ngan bsags pas lan/da ni mi 'os pa zhig byung ba min/ 'ong nges shig thog tu babs pa yin/ da phyin chad sdug bsngal 'di dang 'di 'dra mi 'dod na/de'i rgyu da lta gtan nas ma byed byas na da dung yang 'di bzhin 'byung zhes gyod 'khon dang / rngan chan le lan thams cad rang la bda' zhing / gyong dang pham kha thams cad rang gis len/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad phan bde 'byung gnas ma gyur sems can de dag la 'phangs pa med par ster ba dang / rang gis sngar gyi gnyen nye ba grwa rogs grogs mched grwa bu slob yon bdag pho mo sogs gang la phan btags pa'i yul/ re ba che ba gang la la zhig gis phan pa'i lan du drin gzo med par ma zad/da dung de'i thog tu kha'i zas 'phrog rgyab kyi gos bshus/ lag gi nor khyer ba sogs shin tu mi rigs pa'i gnod pa chen po byas na yang / rang gi sbyin pa dang bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs 91

pa'i rten bka' drin che ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam par blta ba dang / mdor na dngos dang brgyud nas/ phan bde ma lus pa ma gyur sems can kun la 'bul zhing / sems can thams cad kyi gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad gsang ba'i sgo nas dngos dang yid kyis rang la len snyam pa dang / de dag kun yang rnyed ma rnyed bde mi bde snyan mi snyan bstod dang smad pa ste/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa'i dri mas ma sbags shing / chos kun sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur shes pa'i blos/ dngos po gang la'ang chags zhen med par bslab nas/ zhen chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bas/ sngar bcings pa kun las grol bar bya ba de brgyad po 'di khong gi thugs dam gyi gtso bo yin skad/ skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyis de brgyad smon lam gyi yul du byas te tshigs su bcad nas gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/smras pa/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /don mchog bsgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gces par 'dzin par shog /gang du su dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid kun nas dman blta zhing / /gzhan la bsam pa thag pa yis/ /mchog tu gus par 'dzin par shog /spyod lam kun tu rang rgyud la/ /rtog cing nyon mongs skyes ma 92

thag /bdag gzhan ma rungs byed pas na/ /btsan thabs gdod nas bzlog par shog /rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can ni/ /sdig sdug drag pos non mthong tshe/ /rin chen gter dang 'phrad pa ltar/ /rnyed par dka' bas gces 'dzin shog /bdag la gzhan gyes phrag dog gis/ /gshe skur la sogs mi rig pa'i/ /gyong kha rang gis len pa dang / /rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul bar shog /gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i/ /re ba che ba gang zhig gis/ /shin tu mi rig gnod byas na'ang / /bshes gnyen dam par blta bar shog /mdor na dngos dang brgyud pa yis/ /phan bde ma rnams kun la 'bul/ /ma yi gnod dang sdug bsngal kun/ /gsang bas bdag la len par shog /de dag kun kyang chos brgyad kyi/ /rtog pa'i dri mas ma sbags shing / /chos kun sgyu mar shes pa yis/ /zhen med bcings pa las grol shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang gsung byen rlabs can de dag bton nas smon lam tshun chad btab/ 'phral du lag len la ce thebs byas na/ gnas skabs su rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'grub cing mthar thug yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /93

yang bslab gsum rgyan dang ldan zhing byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob bu mtha' yas rgya mtshos/kho bo la gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshogs drug dang / nyes pa lnga spong ba'i gnyen por 'du byed brgyad bsten tshul dang / sems gnas dgu dang stobs drug dang / yid byed bzhi'i sgo nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul rnams go sla la 'khyer bde ba tshig nyung la don 'dus pa zhig gsung du gsol zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ bzhag na ga yo med ri ltar brtan/ /btang na dmigs pa kun la 'jug /shin sbyangs bde bas lus sems khyab/ /dga' bde'i ngang la rtag tu bzhugs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /brtse bas bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /rab tu gus pas phyag dang bcas/ /rje btsun snyan du 'di skad zhu/ /sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byen/ /gsungs ltar zhi gnas ma 'grub pas/ /sems ni g.yeng ba'i dbang du song / /sngon chad dge sbyor mang po zhig /byed khul byas kyang gnad ma song / /da ni rje btsun rin po ches/ /chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pas/ /mdzad pa'i gzhung bzang chu bo kun/ /'du ba'i legs 94

bshad rgya mtsho che/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo ltar/ /zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i rgyu tshogs dang / /nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad/ /sems gnas dgu dang stobs drug dang / /yid byed bzhi yi sgo nas ni/ /zhi gnas sgrub tshul go be+e zhing / /'khyer bde tshig nyung don 'dus shig /brtse ba chen pos gsung bar zhu/ /khyed kyi thugs rje byen rlabs kyis/ /shin sbyangs bde bas rab brgyan pa'i/ /zhi gnas mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig /bdag gi rgyud la skye bar shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yin na zhi gnas rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu tshogs drug ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen med cing / mthun rkyen rnyed sla bas/ mthun pa'i yul du gnas pa dang gcig zas gos bzang po dang mang po la lhag par chags pa med pas/ 'dod pa chung ba dang gnyis/ zas gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes par byed pa dang gsum/ nyo tshong skar rtsis sman sogs bya ba mang po spong ba dang bzhi/ rang gis sngar ji ltar khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba dang lnga/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spong ba dang drug go /ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs nyes pa lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin la sbyor ba'i tshe de la mi spro zhing de'i mi mthun phyogs la dga' ba'i le 95

lo'i nyes pa dang gcig sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs sogs la sems gtad nas ting nge 'dzin la brtson pa'i tshe gdams ngag brjed pa'i nyes pa dang gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin la gzhag pa'i tshe bying rgod gnyid kyi nyes pa dang gsum/ bying rgod byung dus 'du mi byed pa'i nyes pa dang bzhi/ bying rgod chod nas sems dmigs rten la gnas dus 'du byed pa'i nyes pa dang lnga'o/ /de dag gi gnyen po 'du byed brgyad ni/ dang po ting nge 'dzin la sbyor ba'i tshe/ le lo'i gnyen por ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dran pa'i dad pa dang gcig ting nge 'dzin la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin la rtsol ba'i brtson 'grus dang gsum/ rtsol ba'i 'bras bu shin sbyangs kyi bde ba dang bzhi bo bsams nas/ ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las yid spro sing nge bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin la brtson tshe gdams ngag brjed pa'i gnyen por/ dmigs rten mi brjed pa'i dran pa rgyun chags su bsten pa dang lnga/ ting nge 'dzin la gzhag tshe byeng rgod kyi gnyen por byeng rgod 'ong mi 'ong shes pa'i shes bzhin gye byar bsten pa dang drug bying rgod byung dus 'du mi byed pa'i gnyen por/de ma thag bying rgod spong ba'i 'du byed bsten pa dang bdun/bying rgod med par gnas dus 'du byed pa'i gnyen por 'du 96

mi byed par btang snyoms su glod nas 'jog pa dang brgyad do/ /sems gnas thabs dgu'i sgo nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul la dang po 'jog pa ni/ phyi rol la g.yeng ba'i sems bsdus te dmigs rten gyi steng du sems 'jog gnyis pa rgyun du 'jog pa ni/bzhag pa'i dmigs rten de nyid las gzhan du mi yengs par dmigs pa de la rgyun du 'jog gsum pa slan te 'jog pa ni/brjed nges kyi dbang gis phyi rol du g.yeng na de shes par byas nas slar dmigs rten de nyid la slan te 'jog bzhi pa nye bar 'jog pa ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis rgya che bas yang nas yang du nang du bsdus te phra bar byas nye bar 'jog lnga pa dul bar byed pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan bsams nas ting nge 'dzin la dga' bas sems dul bar byed/ drug pa zhi bar byed pa ni/ rnam g.yeng la skyon du bltas nas ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba zhi bar byed/ bdun pa rnam par zhi bar byed pa ni/chags sems dang yid mi bde bying rmugs sogs langs byung ba rnam par zhi bar byed/ brgyad pa rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni/ rab tu 'bad nas bying rgod kyis bar chad pa med pa byas rgyun chags su ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu 'jog par byed/ dgu pa mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ byeng rgod kyi rnam par g.yeng ba thams 97

cad dang bral nas/ 'bad med lhun grub tu ting nge 'dzin la ngam ngam shugs kyis 'jug pa'i tshe rtsol ba'i 'du shes med par btang snyoms su glod nas mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /yang stobs drug gi sgo nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul la/ dang po thos pa'i stobs ni gdams ngag thos pa'i stobs la brten nas sems mnyam par 'jog tshul legs par shes par byas nas 'jog pas na/ thos pa'i stobs zer/ gnyis pa bsam pa'i stobs ni/de ltar mnyam par gzhag pa de yang yang bsam pa'i stobs kyis rgyun cung zad 'thud nas skyongs pas na/ bsam pa'i stobs zer/ gsum pa dran pa'i stobs ni/ de nas dran pa nyams nas yengs na myur du bsdu la/ dmigs pa brjed pa myur du dran pa dang / dran nas dmigs pa las ma yengs pa'i dran pa'i stobs shugs can bskyed pas na dran pa'i stobs zer/bzhi pa shes bzhin gyi stobs ni/ dran pa stobs can 'grub pa dang / dmigs pa las gzhan du mi g.yeng bas bying rgod sogs kyi skyon yod med mthong ba'i sgo nas bya ra byed pa'i shes bzhin stobs can bskyed pas na/ shes bzhin gyi stobs zer/ lnga pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni/ de nas brjed nges phra mos g.yeng na yang / de ma thag rig nas rgyun gcod pa dang / bcad nas mi 98

mthun phyogs kyis bar ma bcad pas rgyun je ring du gtong bas rtsol ba'i stobs bskyed pas na/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs zer/ drug pa yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs ni/ de skyes pa na 'bad nas bsgoms pas nam zhig bsgom la yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs kyis/ 'bad rtsol med par ting nge 'dzin du hril hril 'gro bar 'gyur bas na yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs zer/yang yid byed bzhi'i sgo nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul la/ dang po bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed ni zhi gnas bsgoms pa'i tshe thog mar bying rgod shas che bas/ rab tu 'bad pas bsgrims nas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug dgos pas na/ bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed zer/ gnyis pa chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed ni/de nas bsgoms na bying rgod kyis ting nge 'dzin bar chad cing chad ma thag slar ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pas na/ 'chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed zer/ gsum pa chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed ni/ de nas byeng rgod kyis bar 'chad rgyu med par yun ring ba'i bar du ting nge 'dzin la 'jug thub pas na/'chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed zer/ bzhi pa rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed ni/ de nas bskyangs pa'i bar yang mi 'chad cing rtsol ba yang rgyun par bsten mi dgos par 99

ngam ngam shugs kyis ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pas na rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed zer ro/ /yang dran shes gnyis la brten nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul ni/ dang po dran pa ni/ thub dbang sogs dmigs rten gang yin yang / de nyid yid la thu re dran par bya/ gnyis pa shes bzhin ni byeng rgod gang rung byung nas/ dran pa shugs zhan du song ba 'am/ dran pa nyams ma thagashes bzhin gyis shes par byas nas slar sngar gyi dmigs rten yid la wa ler dran par bya/ 'o na ting nge 'dzin gyi bdud bying rgod gnyis ji 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ bying ba phra mo ni/ sems dwangs cha tsam ma 'gags kyang dmigs rten mi gsal ba de yin/ byeng ba rags pa ni/ sems kyi dwangs cha yang nyams nas mun mun par song ba'o/ /rgod pa phra mo ni/ dmigs rten la g.yo med du mi gnas par cung zad 'phro ba'o/ /rgod pa rags pa ni/zas gos rtse rgod sogs chags yul rnams la 'phro ba'o/ /byeng rgod che dus rig pa bsgrims/ byeng rgod nyung du song dus cung zad glod/ bying rgod phra rags thams cad dang bral nas/dmigs rten la lhan ner gnas dus rtsol ba med par btang snyems su glod nas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhag pas sngar bas brtan zhing shin sbyangs kyi bde ba dang bcas pa'i zhi 100

gnas mtshan nyid pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di la nyes pa lnga bying rgod gnyis la bsdus/ 'du byed brgyad dran shes gnyis la bsdus nas skyongs tshul mdor bsdus yin pas las dang po pa la stabs bde zhing zhi gnas skye sla bar gsungs so/ /de ltar gzhung khungs thub nas zhi gnas sgrub tshul mi 'dra ba gsungs pa'i nang nas/ nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad brten nas zhi gnas sgrub na/ gzhan rnams kyang de'i khongs su don gyis 'dus pas de kho nas kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang 'di dag shes na gcig grogs su gcig 'gro bas/ ting nge 'dzin skyon med sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag la sgrub tshul mi 'dra ba 'di dag med mi rung yin pas/ rin po che'i gter ltar gces spras gyis shigade ltar zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i tshe/ bying rgod dang bral nas ting nge 'dzin ri bo ltar mi g.yo bar brtan po byung na/ zhi gnas rjes mthun pa zer/ lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde bas zin pas ting nge 'dzin brtan po byung tshe/ zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa zer/ de 'dra'i zhi gnas thob nas/ lhag mthong du sbar na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur/ yang zhi gnas de kho nas rgyun bskyangs kyang / mngon shes la sogs zhi gnas kyi yon tan thams cad thob par 'gyur ro//101

smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhi gnas ri ltar brtan par byen gyis rlobs/ /mthun par gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / /'dod chung chog shes bya ba thams cad spangs/ /tshul khrims bsrung zhing 'dod pa'i rnam rtog spangs/ /'di dag zhi gnas 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs yin/ /dang po ting nge 'dzin la sbyor ba'i tshe/ /le lo'i gnyen por ting 'dzin yon tan la/ /dad dang 'dun dang rtsol dang rtsol ba las/ /byung ba'i shin sbyangs bde ba legs bsams nas/ /rang sems ting 'dzin bsgoms la spro bar bya/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin la brtson pa'i tshe/ /gdams ngag brjed pa'i gnyen por dran pa bsten/ /ting nge 'dzin la bzhag tshe bying rgod kyi/ /gnyen por shes bzhin so ba rgyun du bzhag /byeng rgod byung tshe 'du mi byed pa yi/ /gnyen por byeng rgod sel thabs 'du byed bsten/ /bying rgod med par gnas dus 'du byed pa'i/ /gnyen por 'du mi byed par btang snyoms bzhag /dmigs rten thog tu rang sems legs par 'jog /rgyun du 'jog dang yengs na slan te 'jog /nye bar 'jog dang dul bar byed pa dang / /zhi bar byed dang rnam par zhi bar byed/ /rtse gcig byed dang mnyam par 'jog par bya/ /thos pa'i stobs kyis mnyam gzhag legs par 102

bya/ /bsam pa'i stobs kyis de yi rgyun skyongs zhing / /dran pa'i stobs kyis brjed na dran par bya/ /shes bzhin stobs kyis bying rgod shes nas spong / /brtson 'grus stobs kyis yengs med rgyun du skyongs/ /yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs kyis 'bad med du/ /ting nge 'dzin la tril hril 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dang po ting nge 'dzin la bzhag pa'i tshe/ /rab tu bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed dgos/ /byeng rgod dbang song ting 'dzin bar 'chad pa'i/ /dus su 'chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed bsten/ /byung rgod gnyis kyis bar chad mi nus dus/ /'chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed dgos/ /de nas ngam ngam shugs kyis ting 'dzin la/ /rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed 'ong/ /mdor na dmigs rten yid la thu re dran/ /bying rgod 'ong ba shes par byas la spangs/ /sngar gyi dmigs rten wa ler dran par bya/ /bying rgod chod nas lhan ner gnas pa'i tshe/ /rtsol ba glod nas bzhag na brtan par 'gyur/ /de ltar zhi gnas bsgrub nas mi g.yo bar/ /yun ring gnas na zhi gnas rjes mthun zer/ /shin sbyangs bde bas lus sems zin pa'i tshe/ /zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa yin ngo mtshar che/ /de la brten nas lhag mthong bsgoms nus na/ /zab mo stong nyid lta ba mngon du 'gyur/ /zhi gnas kho na 103

bskyangs kyang mngon shes sogs/ zhi gnas yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i thugs rje rang gi dge tshogs mthus/ /zhi gnas rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces smras pa'o/ /yang 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i slob bu bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis kho bo la/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs shing / gsung rab ma lus pa gdams par 'char ba/rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed cing / nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba ste/ che ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub lam rim chen mo'i dgongs pa dang mthun par/ lhag mthong gi rgyu tshogs dang / shing rta rnam bdun gye rigs pas lhag mthong gi lta ba gtan la phab nas mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid dang / rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid gnyis bsgom tshul shin tu kha gsal nyung 'dus shig gsung bar zhu zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ lnga ldan 'og min zhing gi mgon po yi/ /sku ru bzhengs kyang sna tshogs zlos gar gyi/ /byams pas 'gro la dam chos dar bar mdzad/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /deng nas bzung ste dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi/ /sngon chad 104

tshe 'di'i dbang song mthol lo bshags/ /mgon khyod gsung gi mdzad par rjes yi rang / /da res nges don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs yang dag lta ba rtogs phyir bsngo/ /gnas lugs lta ba myur du mngon gyur shog /mdo sngags bstan pa 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /zab rgyas gsung rab gdams par 'char ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /chos spong nyes spyod thams cad rang 'gags su/ /'gro ba'i che ba bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo'i dgongs don ltar/ /lhag mthong rtogs pa'i rgyu tshogs gtso bo dang / /shing rta rnam bdun rigs pas lhag mthong gi /lta ba gtan la phab nas skyongs tshul dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid kyang / /skyongs tshul kha gsal nyung la 'dus pa zhig /brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o lhag mthong gi rgyu tshogs kyi gtso bo ni/ gsung rab kyi gnad phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa bsten nas/ dri ma med pa'i gzhung lugs nyan te thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed pa ni lhag mthong gi rgyu tshogs med mi rung yin par gsungs/ de nas shing rta rnam bdun zhes rig 105

pa rnon po mi 'dra ba bdun gyi sgo nas lhag mthong gi lta ba gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/ dper na ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor shes par 'dod pa'i mi yis thog mar shing gi ral gri la bslab pa ltar/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med rtogs par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog mar shing rta rnam bdun gye rigs pa 'di la sbyangs par bya ste/ de yang srog shing dang 'khor lo dang gzer bu sogs yan lag rnams 'tshogs pa la brten nas shing rta zhes brjod pa 'di/ yan lag de dag dang gcig yin snyam na de ma yin te/ yin na yan lag mang ba bzhin du shing rta yang mang por 'gyur ba dang / yang na shing rta gcig yin pa bzhin yan lag rnams kyang cha med gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skyon dang /'jig rten na yang shing rta dang shing rta'i yan lag ces ming so sor brjod pa yang don med par 'gyur bas na/ gcig ma yin par thag chod pa dang gcig 'o na yan lag rnams dang so so ba yin snyam na/ de yang min te yin na/ dper na rta g.yag ra rnams bsal ba'i shul na lug 'di'o zhes ston rgyu yod pa ltar/yan lag rnams so sor bsal ba'i shul na shing rta 'di'o zhes ston rgyu yod dgos kyang rig pas dpyad na med pas na so sor yang med par thag gcod pa dang gnyis/ 'o na yan lag rnams 106

kyi rten du yod dam snyam na/ de yang med de yod na/ dper na 'khar gzhong dang zho so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa ltar shing rta dang yan lag rnams so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu zhig yod dgos kyang rig pas brtag na med pas/ yan lag rnams kyi rten du yang med par thag gcod pa dang gsum/ 'o na yan lag rnams la brten nas yod dam snyam na/ de yang med de/ yod na khang pa la brten nas mi gnas pa ltar yan lag rnams la brten nas shing rta yod dgos kyang rigs pas bltas na mi mthong bas na/yan lag rnams la brten nas kyang shing rta med par thag gcod pa dang bzhi/ 'o na yan lag de dag la shing rta ldan pa yin nam snyam na/ de yang min te yin na dper na dbul po nor dang ldan na dbul po las so sor logs su nor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa bzhin du/ yan lag rnams las so sor logs su shing rta ngos 'dzin rgyu zhig dgos kyang de yang rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pas/ yan lag la shing rta ldan pa yang ma yin par thag gcod pa dang lnga / 'o na yan lag thams cad 'tshogs pa tsam gyis shing rta yin snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/yin na 'khor lo sogs yan lag rnams so sor bral nas gnas khang sogs na phyogs gcig tu bzhag yod dus kyang yan 107

lag thams cad 'tshogs yod pas/ de yi dus su yang shing rta yod dgos/ de'i dus su shing rta med na/ phyis bsgrigs nas 'tshogs pa tsam gyi dus su yang shing rta glo bur du gnas 'ong /yan lag 'tshogs pa tsam ni shing rta'i gdags gzhi yin gyi shing rta ma yin pas/ yan lag 'tshogs pa tsam shing rta ma yin par thag gcod pa dang drug 'o na yan lag rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbyibs de shing rta yin nam snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/yin na 'jig rten pa'i grags pas kyang gnod de/ shing rta dang shing rta'i dbyebs zhes so sor grags pa 'gogs mi nus shing yan lag 'tshogs pa'i dbyibs shing rta'i gdags gzhi yin gyi shing rta de'i btags chos yin pas de gnyis mi gcig so so yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dbyibs shing rta min mod 'on kyang yin du srid kyang / dbyibs kho yang yan lag las/ zur du ci 'dra 'dug ces rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pas dbyibs kho yang dmigs su med na shing rtar ga la 'gyur/ des na yan lag 'tshogs pa'i dbyibs yang shing rta ma yin par thag gcod pa dang bdun no/ /de ltar shing rta rnam bdun gye rig pas dpyad tshe/ 'jig rten na shing rtar grags pa de yan lag rnams 'tshogs pa'i steng du ming gi phar btags pa tsam zhig ma 108

gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang mi rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /dper na shing gi ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor bskor nas lob tshe dngos su ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor bskor nas pha rol gyi dgra rnams phye mar 'thag nas 'joms pa ltar/ de ltar shing rta la rig pa sbyangs nas lob pa'i tshe/ shing rta rnam bdun gyis rigs pa de nyid kyis dngos su gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med gtan la phab nas/ tshugs thub bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin gye dgra kun stong pa nyid du phye mar 'thag dgos te/ de yang gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/gzugs phung dang tshor phung 'du shes kyi phung po sogs phung po lnga tshogs pa la brten nas nga 'am bdag zer ba 'di/ phung po lnga dang gcig tu grub snyam na/ de ma grub ste grub na/ phung po lnga bzhin du nga yang mang par 'gyur ba dang / yang na nga gcig yin pa bzhin/ phung po lnga yang gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skyon dang /'jig rten na nga dang nga'i phung po zhes so sor brjod pa yang don med par 'gyur bas na/ nga de phung po lnga dang gcig tu ma grub par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga dang tha dad du grub snyam na/ de yang ma grub ste grub na/ dper na rta g.yag ra rnams bsal ba'i shul na lug 'di'o zhes ston rgyu yod pa ltar/ phung po 109

so sor bsal ba'i shul na nga 'di'o zhes ston rgya zhig yod dgos kyang / rigs pas dpyad na med pas rno/ so sor yang ma grub par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga yi rten du yod dam snyam na/ de yang med de yod na/ dper na 'khar gzhong dang de'i nang gi zho gnyis so sor ngos 'dzin yod pa ltar/ nga dang phung po lnga yang so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod dgos kyang / rigs pas brtag na med pas phung po lnga yi rten du yang med par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga la brten nas yod dam snyam na/ de yang med de/ yod na khang pa la brten nas mi gnas pa ltar phung po lnga la brten nas nga bdag yod dgos kyang rig pas bltas na mi mthong bas/ phung po lnga la brten nas kyang nga med par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga la nga ldan nam snyam na/ de yang mi ldan te ldan na/ dper na dbul po nor dang ldan na/ dbul po las logs su nor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa bzhin du/ phung po lnga las logs su nga ngos 'dzin rgyu zhig dgos kyang / de yang rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pas/ phung po lnga la nga ldan pa yang ma yin par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga 'tshogs pa tsam nga yin nam snyam na/ de yang min te yin na/ gzugs phung dum bur gtubs nas dur khrod sogs na phyogs gcig tu bzhag yod dus kyang 110

phung po 'tshogs yod pas/ de'i dus su yang nga yod dgos/ de dus nga sked na da lta phung po lnga 'tshogs pa tsam gyi dus kyang glo bur du nga gnas 'ong / phung po lnga 'tshogs tsam ni gdags gzhi yin gyes nga ma yin pas/ phung po 'tshogs pa tsam yang nga ma yin par thag bcad/ 'o na phung po lnga 'tshogs pa'i dbyebs yin nam snyam na de yang min te/ yin na 'jig rten pa'i grags pas kyang gnod de/ nga dang phung po zhes so sor grags pa 'gogs mi nus shing / phung po lnga 'tshogs pa nga'i gdags gzhi yin gyis/ nga ni de yi btags chos yin pas/ de gnyis mi gcig so sor yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dbyebs nga min mod/'on kyang yin du srid kyang dbyibs kho yang phung po lnga las zur du bkar nas ci 'dra 'dug ces rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pas dbyebs kho yang dmigs su med na nga ru ga la 'gyur/ des na phung po lnga 'tshogs pa'i dbyebs yang nga ma yin par thag bcad/ de ltar shing rta rnam bdun gyi rigs pa la brten nas brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe snga sor dus rtag tu nga zhes mig gis mthong rgyu lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod pa de lta bu phung po lnga'i steng du ming gis phar btags pa tsam zhig ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang ma rnyed par stong cham gyis song 111

ba'i tshe dbu ma'i lta ba dang po rnyed pa yin/ de'i tshe nga rang bzhin gyis ma grub par stong pa nyid du 'dug snyam pas nges shes shugs drag bo 'dren/ de nas chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs tshul ni gzugs can rang lus lta bu la mtshon na/ nga'i lus po zhes zer ba 'di/ rkang pa lag pa mgo bo bcas yan lag lnga dang gcig tu grub bam snyam na zhes sngar bzhin rig pas dpyad nas/ rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa 'dren par bya/yang gzugs med rang sems lta bu la mtshon na/ nga'i sems zhes zer ba 'di snga phyi bar gsum gyi rnam rtog mang po 'di dang gcig tu grub snyam na/ zhes sngar bzhin dpyad la/ rang bzhin med par gtan la dbab/ gzhan yang gzugs can gzugs med mang po la spros nas thub tshod la dpyad nas rang bzhin med pa'i nges pa 'dren/ de nas spros pa cher mi byed par de bzhin du ri rwa ba khang khyim/ rtsi shing nags tshal nyi ma zla ba ri rab sogs snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang rang gi gdags gzhi'i steng du ming gi phar btags pa tsam zhig ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang mi 'dug snyam pas/ stong nyid kyi nges shes shugs drag bo drangs la/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gdod nas nam 112

mkha' ltar stong sang 'ba' zhig tu nges pas nges shes de nyid kyi rgyun skyongs pa ni mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyongs tshul lo/ /yang byeng rgod kyis bar bcad nas mi nges pa'i tshe sngar bzhin dpyad nas/ stong nyid kyi nges shes shugs drag po drangs la/ stong sang nger nges pa'i ngang de nyid la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa dang dpyad pa gnyis ka spel mar bya'o/ /de ltar bying rgod kyi skyon bsal nas/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid kyi rgyun dran shes kyis bskyangs pa'i tshe skabs zhig bying rgod phra rags thams cad dang bral nas/ 'bad rtsol med par mnyam gzhag gi ngang du ngam ngam shugs kyis 'gro ba'i tshe rtsol ba glod nas btang snyoms su bzhag na ci tsam 'dod pa de tsam du gsal 'grib med par mnyam gzhag la gnas pa byung na/lhag mthong rjes mthun pa zer/ de nas bskyangs pas lus sems la sngar med pa'i shin sbyangs kyi dga' bde khyad par can dang bcas pas mnyam gzhag brtan po byung na/ lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa zer/ des tshe phra rags kyi rnam rtog thams cad mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang du rang sar zhi nas/ mnyam gzhag gi ngo bo su gang gis kyang ma sgrib par/ ston dus kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dkyil ltar 113

gsal 'grib med par rjen lhag ger mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba 'byung tshe/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam zer/ de nas yun ring mnyam par gzhag na/ mi rtog pa dang /gsal ba dang / dwangs pa dang / phra ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du skye ste/ mi rtog pa ni mnyam par gzhag pa na/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba yang mi tshor zhing / 'khrul rtog thams cad dang bral nas gnas pa 'ong / gsal ba ni ston dus kyi nyi ma phyed kyi dus kyi nam mkha'i dkyil gsal ba dang khyad par med pa 'ong /dwangs pa ni ting gtsang ma'i nang du chu blugs nas/ nyi ma la bzhag nas bltas pa dang 'dra ba 'ong / phra ba ni mtshan nyid gsum po de'i ngang nas bltas na/ dngos po spu'i rtse mo gshags pa'i cha gcig byung yang mthong ba 'ong / de nas bsgom na mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs lhag mthong gi yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang dag lta ba rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /shing rta yan lag rnams dang gcig min bzhin/ /nga dang phung po gcig tu grub pa med/ /yan lag rnams las logs na shing rta med/ /de bzhin phung po las gzhan nga yang med/ /shing rta yan lag rnams kyi rten du 114

med/ /de bzhin nga yang phung po'i rten du med/ /shing rta yan lag rnams la brten nas med/ /de bzhin nga yang phung por brten nas med/ /yan lag rnams la shing rta mi ldan bzhin/ /phung po lnga la nga yang ldan pa min/ /shing rta yan lag 'tshogs tsam min pa ltar/ /nga ni phung po 'tshogs pa tsam yang min/ /shing rta yan lag 'tshogs pa'i dbyibs min bzhin/ /nga ni phung po 'tshogs pa'i dbyibs yang min/ /dpyad na shing rta rang bzhin med pa ltar/ /nga yang rang bzhin med par shes par bya/ /de bzhin rigs pas dpyad nas gzugs phung sogs/ /chos kyi bdag med gtan la dbab par bya/ /phabs nas chos kun stong pa nyid du 'dug /snyam du stong nyid nges shes shugs drag drangs/ /mdor na 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /gdod nas mkha' ltar stong sang 'ba' zhig tu/ /nges pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa la/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid zer/ /zhi gnas snying stobs can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /shing rta rnam bdun rno ngar rig pa yi/ /ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor yang yang bskor tsa na/ /bdag 'dzin dgra rnams phye mar 'thag par 'gyur/ /de ltar bskyangs tshe byeng rgod skyon dang bral/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid kyi/ /ngang du ngam ngam shugs 115

kyis 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rtsol ba glod nas bzhag tshe sngar bas kyang / /gsal zhing brtan na lhag mthong rjes mthun zer/ /de nas sbyangs tshe lus sems gnyis ka la/ /sngar med shin sbyangs bde ba 'bar ba'i tshe/ /lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa yin ngo mtshar che de tshe rnam rtog stong nyid dbyengs su zhi/ /stong nyid ngo bo lhag ger mthong ba la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel zhes zer/ /de nas bskyangs tshe rtog med lhan ner gnas/ /shin tu gsal zhing dwangs pa'i mnyam gzhag 'byung / /de yi ngang nas bltas na phyi nang gi /dngos po spu rtse tsam zhig tshun chad mthong / /de nas bskyangs na mngon shes dzu 'phrul sogs/ /lhag mthong yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste yang dag lta ba dang / /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral bar ma gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid la sbyongs tshul ni/ dper na shing rta yan lag gi steng du sgro btags pa ma gtogs/ dpyad na don dam par rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa ltar/ nga yang phung po lnga'i steng du ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs dpyad na don dam par 116

rang bzhin med par rtogs/ de bzhin du chos gzhan thams cad kyang rang bzhin med par rtogs pas rtag mthar mi ltung /yang rang bzhin med rung ma dpyad pa'i tshe kun rdzob kyi snang ngor yan lag gi steng du ming gis btags pa tsam zhig yod pa ltar nga yang rang bzhin med rung / ma dpyad pa'i kun rdzob kyi snang ngor phung po lnga'i steng du/ ming gis btags pa tsam zhig yod par shes pa de bzhin du chos gzhan thams cad kyang ming gis btags pa tsam zhig yod par shes pas chad mthar mi ltung / dper na shing rta rang bzhin med rung yan lag 'tshogs tsam gye rten 'brel la brten nas shing rta'i don byed nus pas na shing rta'i ming tsam yod pas kyang yod go chod pa ltar/ nga yang rang bzhin med rung phung po lnga 'tshogs tsam gyi rten 'brel la brten nas nga'i don gang yang byed nus pas na nga'i ming tsam yod pas kyang yod go chod yong / de bzhin du chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa med rung rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam yod pas yod go chod yong / mdor na don dam par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med rung / kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ las 'bras 117

dang bya byed kyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad pa'i tshul la nges pa shugs drag po drangs nas/ tshogs bsogs sgrib sbyong sogs spyod phyogs rnams la yang sgyu ma rmi lam ltar 'jug par bya'o/ /de ltar chos thams cad ngo bo stong bzhin du snang zhing rnam pa snang bzhin du stong pa'i snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid la sbyangs na/ skabs shig yid ngor snang ba thams cad sang seng khral khrol za zi ban bun lang long du song nas reg rgyu med dam snyam pa'i nyams 'byung / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu mar shar nas gang la'ang chags sdang mi 'byung /gzhan chags sdang byed pa mthong na rgod 'chor ba 'byung ngo / /yun ring po sbyangs pas nam zhig chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum du gyur nas pha rol gye yul phyogs mthong ba la sogs pa'i spyan dang / sems can gzhan gyi sems la ci dran shes pa la sogs pa'i mngon shes dang / ri brag la thal byung du bgrod pa la sogs pa'i dzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /shing rta yan lag thams cad 'tshogs tsam gyi/ /steng du ming gis phar btags ma gtogs pa/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam ma mchis 118

kyang / /yan lag cha shas 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel la/ /brten nas shing rta'i don byed nus pas na/ /ming tsam yod pas yod go chod pa ltar/ /nga yang phung po lnga po 'tshogs tsam gyi/ /steng du rtog pas btags pa ma gtogs pa/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam ma mchis kyang / /phung po lnga po 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel la/ /brten nas nga yi don byed nus pas na/ /ming tsam yod pas yod go chod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad don dam du/ /rang rang gdags gzhi'i steng du ming btags pa/ /ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa ma mchis kyang / /kun rdzob rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel la/ /brten nas dkar nag las 'bras bya byed sogs/ /'thad pa'i tshul la nges shes shugs drag drangs/ /gang snang tshugs thub bden par mi 'dzin par/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i gzigs mor lam lam blta/ /sgyu ma bzhin du las 'bras blang dor sogs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rnams la 'jug par bya/ /de ltar rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la yun ring sbyangs gyur na/ /yid ngor snang ba sang seng khral ma khrol/ /shag shig za zi ban bun lang long du/ /song nas reg rgyu med dam snyam pa 'ong / /nam zhig sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin nas/ /yul gzhan mthong zhing pha rol sems rgyud shes/ /ri brag 119

rnams la thal byung bgrod pa sogs/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs rang gzhan dge ba'i mthus/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mtha' ru phyin par shog /ces smras pa'o/ /yang dad gtong blo gros mchog mnga'i slob bu sde pa blo bzang tshe ring dang / skyes bu dam pa gong ma'i yang sprul rtse brgyad bla ma blo bzang chos grags rnam gnyis kyis tshe blos btang nas 'ongs te mkho ba'i yo byad mang po phul nas/ gus pas phyag dang bcas bla ma rin po che/ bdag cag gnyis la 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyun bcad nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i gdams pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul pa/byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i 'od stong 'gyed/ /gdul bya gling bzhi thogs med bgrod/ /rje nyi zla lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sku gsum lhun grub rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i g.yu ral rgyas/ /thub bstan gangs ri'i rgyan du mdzes/ /rje seṅge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas gru bo cher/ /brten nas gdul bya mgron po rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu bo che las sgrol/ /rje 120

mnyan pa lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i sman rkyal thogs/ /'gro kun nyon mongs nad rnams gsos/ /gtan bde lus zungs rgyas par byed/ /rje sman pa lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /kyi hud bdag cag thog med nas/ /ma rig 'tsho med gcong gis zin/ /chags sdang gnyis kyi tsha grang 'thab/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi zug gzer langs/ /bdag bstod gzhan sgod 'khun bu shor/ /dge ba'i zas la zhen pa log /mi dge chang skyur dbang med 'thungs/ /na tsha sngar bas che bar song / /mi na ba yi dgu gcig na/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sman pa med/ /gson pa'i re ba ma mchis dus/ /e ma las dang smon lam bzang rje btsun sman pa'i rgyal po khyed/ /byon nas dam chos sman yang btang / /ma rig gcong nad sangs pa'i mod/ /nyon mongs nad gzhan rim gyis dwangs/ /dge ba'i zas kyi dang kha phye/ /da ni dge sems zo mdog bzang / /'khor ba'i mal nas yar langs nas/ /thar pa'i lam la gom pa re/ /'dor ba'i skal pa da lta byung / /bka' drin che'o sman pa'i rgyal/ /da ni chos kyi sman yon du/ /bsgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /slar yang nyon mongs nad byung yang / /rje btsun sman pa khyed la re/ /da ni bka' gdams gong ma yis/ /sbyar zhing gsol ba'i sman gye 'phro/ /ma 121

rig nyon mongs nad kyi rigs/ /thams cad gcig char rab bcom nas/ /gtan bde lus zungs rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i lam/ /gdams pa kun gyi rab dang phul/ /sman mchog 'chi med bdud rtsi zhig /bdag cag gnyis la stsal du gsol/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ /kye skal ldan gyi bu gnyis ma yengs par nyon la yid la legs par zungs shig 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs mi 'dod bzhin du myong dgos pa 'di gang las byung snyam na/ gtam rgyud gcig bshad/ sngon ston pa shes rab g.yung drung bya ba shin tu sdar bas/nub gcig phyi rol tu song nas chos bshad nas mchod khang nang du 'ong tsa na/ mar me rlung gis bsgul bas/ 'od phyags ma la phog pas sdig pa gcig sgab sgab byung bar gzigs nas/ 'a byas skad ngan bton pas/ phug na yod pa'i sgom chen gcig kyang phyir thon byung nas slob dpon la skad ngan byung bas 'tshe ba zhig byung ba yin snyam nas/ 'as btab pas/ dge bshes yung ba byung nas/ ci nyes byas pas 'di ci yin zer/ yung ba pa dpa' pas drung du phyin nas bltas pas/ phyags mar song bas khong rang tsho phar 'gyel tshul 'gyel nas gad mo shor skad/ de yang ma rig pa las byung ba ltar/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams 122

cad kyi rtsa ba phar ded na ma rig pa yin/ 'o na gang ma rig snyam na/ chos dang gang zag gnyis bdag med stong pa nyid du ma rig pa yin/ 'o na de ji ltar ma rig snyam na/ dper na mi gcig dgung dus mun pa rab rib la phyin na/ mun pa rab rib kyis bsgribs nas/ sa na thag pa khra bo 'khyel nas yod pa gsal bor ma mthong tshe/ steng na sbrul med rung de sbrul du mthong nas/ shin tu 'jigs shing skrag nas snying khar 'tshangs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyang ma rig pa mun pa lta bus bsgribs nas/ lus sems thag khra lta bu'i gnas lugs gsal por ma mthong tshe/ steng na nga med rung de la brten nas nga zhes mig gis mthong rgyu dang lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod yod 'dra ba sbrul gyi snang ba ltar byung nas/bdag gzhan ris su bcad/ rang phyogs la chags gzhan phyogs la sdang bas chags sdang sgyes/ chags sdang gnyis la brten nas nyon mongs pa gzhan thams cad rim gyis rgyas nas/nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba mtho dman du skye ba'i las bzang ngan tha dad pa bsags/ las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba mtho dman du mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor nas sbrul gyi 'jigs skrag ltar sdug bsngal ci yang myong ba yin te/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ gti mug mun pa 'thib po'i 123

rab rib kyis/ /lus sems thag khrar 'khyil ba'i snang tshul la/ /nga'o snyam pas dug sbrul 'jigs rung gi /sdug bsngal gsum gyes dngangs skrag cir yang 'khor/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba phar gtugs na ma rig pa yin gsungs/ 'o na ma rig pa de ji ltar rig par bya snyam na/ dper na thag khra la sbrul du 'khrul nas 'jigs shing skrag pa'i mi de la/rgyus yod kyi grogs gzhan zhig gis sbrul med tshul gyi rgyu mtshan rnams smras na/ de la brten nas rang gis kyang thag nyer btud nas zhib tu bltas pas/ sbrul ma yin par thag pa yin par mthong tshe 'jigs skrag rang zhi la song nas zhe blo bde ba ltar/'o skol rnams kyis bdag med la bdag tu bzung nas sdug bsngal ba la/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyus yod kyi grogs lta bus bdag med tshul lung rigs kyi sgo nas zhib tu gsungs tshe/de la brten nas rang gis kyang shes rab mig lta bus zhib tu brtags shing dpyad pas gang zag dang chos rnams bdag med stong pa nyid du rtogs tshe/ sbrul gyis 'jigs skrag lta bu'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams kyang rang zhi la song nas zhe blo bde ba ltar/ thar pa'i bde ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bdag med 124

kyi lta ba rnam par dag pa la spyod pa rnam par dag pa dgos/dper na bya gshog pa gnyis 'dzom gyis nam mkha' la 'phur nus/ gshog pa ya gcig bzang yang gar yang mi phyin pa ltar/lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len la brten nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob nus/ lta spyod gang rung gcig bzang yang sa lam gar yang phyin mi nus/ 'o na lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len ji ltar bya snyam na/ mdo tril gyis dril ba'i lag len la sngon gyi bka' gdams pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed pa'i rtsa ba bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa 'di yin par mkhyen nas/ gcig dang du bral gyi rigs pas gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med gtan la phab nas/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid dang / rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong pa nyid la bslab pas lta spyod zung 'brel gyi lam rnam par dag pa de la brten nas sangs rgyas pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyis kyang /gang zag gi bdag med la da lta rmi lam tshun chad du/ nga nga zer snying nang du dam sbreng sbreng mig gis mthong rgyu dang lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod yod lta bu 'di/ lus sems gnyis kyi steng du rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin par/ rang ngos nas grub pa'i nga 125

'am bdag zhig yod na/ lus sems gnyis dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub/ gcig tu grub na/ lus la yan lag nying lag dang / sems la snga phyi bar gsum gyi dran bsam gye rnam rtog mang ba bzhin du nga de yang tha dad pa mang por 'gyur la/yang na nga gcig yin pa bzhin du thams cad cha med gcig tu 'gyur/ gcig tu 'dod na nga dang nga'i lus sems zhes ming so sor btags pa yang don med cing lus 'jig pa'i tshe nga yang skye 'jig byed par 'gyur/ lus med par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ nga yang med par 'gyur bar 'dod na/ las byas pa chud za ba sogs nyes pa du ma yod pas/ nga de lus sems gnyis dang gcig tu ma grub par thag bcad/ yang tha dad du grub na lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag sogs cha shas re re nas bsal zhing sems kyi snga phyi bar gsum gyi rnam rtog so sor phyes nas bltas tshe/ nga 'am bdag rang bzhin gyes grub pa rdul tsam yang mi rnyed par stong cham gyis song tshe/ de bzhin du chos kyi bdag med la gzugs can rang lus lta bu la mtshon na/ lus zhes pa yan lag lnga'i steng du rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin par rang ngos nas grub pa'i lus shig yod na/ yan lag rnams dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub/ gcig tu grub na yan lag lnga bzhin 126

du lus kyang lngar 'gyur la/ yang na lus gcig pa bzhin du yan lag rnams kyang cha med gcig tu 'gyur/ gcig tu 'dod na lus dang lus kyi rkang lag mgo zhes ming so sor btags pa yang dgos pa med la/ lus kyi rkang pa 'am lag pa brkyangs tshe/lus kun g.yo dgos mi g.yo na/ so sor grub pa'i rtags yin pas/ lus yan lag rnams dang gcig tu ma grub par thag bcad/ tha dad du grub na yan lag nying lag sogs so sor bsal ba'i shul na/ lus zhes ston rgyu e yod/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas/ lus zhes pa ming tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin gyis grub pa skra'i rtse mo brgyar bsgos pa'i cha tsam yang ma rnyed par stong cham gyis song ba'i tshe yang de bzhin du/ gzugs med rang sems lta bu la mtshon na/ sems zhes bya ba/ rnam par rtog pa 'di rnams kyi steng du phar rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin par rang ngos nas grub pa'i sems shig yod na/ rnam par rtog pa dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub/ gcig tu grub na/ nyin re la yang rnam rtog bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyu ba bzhin du sems yang mang bar 'gyur/ yang sems gcig yin pa bzhin du/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad kyang cha med gcig tu 'gyur/127

gcig tu 'dod na sems dang rnam rtog ces ming so sor btags pa yang don med du 'gyur zhing / da lta'i rnam rtog gi steng du 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i rnam rtog gnyis kyang yod dgos pa sogs nyes pa du ma yod pas/ sems dang rnam rtog kun gcig tu ma grub par thag bcad/ tha dad du grub na snga phyi bar gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag rnams so sor phyes nas bltas tshe/ sems zhes pa ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang ma rnyed par stong sang nger song tshe/ de bzhin du ri rab khang khyim sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos gang la thub tshod la dpyad nas/ gang yang ming brda' tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas ma grub pa stong sang 'ba' zhig tu nges tshe/ de'i ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag yang byeng rgod kyis bar bcad nas mi nges par gyur tshe/ sngar ltar dpyad nas stong sang nger nges tshe de'i ngang la bzhag yang skabs rer byeng rmugs gnyid gsum rnam rtog 'phro rgod gang byung la yang sngar ltar dpyad nas/ rang bzhin gyes ma grub pa ra stong pa nyid du lhang nger nges tshe/ stong sang de nyid kyi ngang du rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni/mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid skyongs tshul lo//128

smras pa/ gdod(rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgur las/)nas dag pa'i sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rjen par ston mdzad drin can bla ma dang / /dbyer med 'jam dpal rdo rje tsong kha pa/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi zhabs la 'dud/ /gnyid kyis myos pa'i shes ngor rmi lam yul/ /sgyu mas bslus pa'i rta dang glang po sogs/ /snang ba tsam las gzhi der don gyi chos/ /gang yang med par blo yis btags pa tsam/ /de bzhin bdag gzhan 'khor ba myang 'das sogs/ /chos kun blo dang ming gis tha snyad kyis/ /btags pa tsam las gdags gzhi rnams kyi steng / /rang gis yod pa rdul tsam ma mchis so/ /de lta na yang ma rig gnyid 'thug gis/ /sbags pa'i so so'i skye bo'i tshogs drug ngor/ /gang snang gzhi der don gyis grub pa zhig /'char tshul rang re'i blo ngan 'di la ltos/ /da ltar 'khrul ba'i blo la snang ba yi/ /nga sogs ngos nas grub pa'i sdod lugs 'di/ /dgag bya phra mo yin pa'i blo yi ngor/ /lhag ma med par khegs pa shin tu gces/ /gal te nga zhes phung po'i steng nyid du/ /ming tsam min par rang nyid yod gyur na/ /gzhan la rag las ltos grub mi rung bas/ /bdag phung shar nub ri bzhin 'brel med 'gyur/ /gzhan yang gcig dang du ma rgyu 'bras sogs/ /rnam par brtag pa'i nges ngor dpyad 129

bya'i chos/ /rdul tsam mi dmigs dmigs gtad zhig pa yis/ /stong sang mkha' ltar shar ba'i shes rab de/ /lta ba dngos yin de dang dus mtshungs su/ /mi brjed dran pas 'tshir bzung shes bzhin gyes/ /rgyang so btsugs nas ting 'dzin brtan po yi/ /bde gsal mi rtog bsgom gyi yang rtser son/ /de ltar rtse gcig 'jog dang yang dang yang / /dpyad pas nges shes shugs drag rdo rje ltar/ /mi shig rtse mo brgya ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /bdag 'dzin ri bo 'joms par gdon mi za/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar mnyam par gzhag nas rjes thob tu langs pa'i tshe/ nga dang lus sems sogs 'di ltar snang ba'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni don dam par ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nam mkha' lta bu yin kyang /kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs pa la brten nas sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ rnam pa dgag med du snang tshul la bsams nas/las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar bden par nges pa la nges shes shugs drag drangs/ gang yang tshugs thub bden grub tu mi 'dzin par sgyu ma rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar/ snang stong du lam lam bsgom zhing / sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs kyi snang ba rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa shes bzhin du nye ring chags 130

sdang med par/ rang gzhan gang gi don du yang sprul bsgyur sna tshogs kyang byed pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / snang grags kyi chos thams cad tshugs thub bden grub dngos po mtshan mar ma grub shes bzhin du/ nye ring chags sdang med par rang gzhan gang gi don du yang / lta bsgom sngags bzla tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs sdig spong dge bsgrub sogs spyod phyogs rnams la brtson par bya ba ni/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i skyongs tshul lo/ /smras pa/ mnyam gzhag(rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgur las/)mkha' ltar dag pa'i rjes thob tu/ /rten 'brel 'tshob/sa pa dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar/ /ma brtag nyams su mtshar ba'i snang ba kun/ /rang bzhin cir yang ma grub bslu brid tsam/ /bde sdug rmi lam yul gyi rol ba dang / /gzugs snang sgyu ma sprul ba'i grong khyer 'dra/ /sgra grags ri phug stong pa'i brag cha dang / /mtshungs mod zhen pas 'jug rnams byis pa bzhin/ /'on kyang skyes bu'i bzhin dang me long gsal/ /'phrad tshe stong pa'i snang brnyan bsnyen med du/ /shar bzhin chos kun snang dang stong pa zung / /gcig tu 'du ba'i rten 'brel bslu med phyir/ /rang rgyud sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams sogs/ /dkar nag phra zhing phra ba'i blang dor la'ang / /zhib mor 'jug pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma 131

yis/ /blo bde gtan gyi mdun ma bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar lta spyod zung 'brel lam/thabs shes zung 'brel gyi nyams len la 'bad na/ ring por mi thogs par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon du byas/ rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /khong gnyis dga' mgu yi rangs nas/ phyag 'tshal te rang rang gi gnas khang du song ngo / /yang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po'i rnam 'phrul/lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i mnga' bdag chen po bon ri'i sprul sku'i dge rgan phun tshogs kyis/ kho bo la gzhung khungs thub cig la brten nas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgrub pa'i tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/ 'gro kun chos kyis dbul ba la/ /zab rgyas legs bshad dgos 'dod stsol/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /rje btsun khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang don bdag 'dzin 'ching ba bcad/ /gzhan don byang chub sems la sbyangs/ /gnyis don snang ba chos la bsgyur/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i gu ru 132

rje/ /bdag ni tshe rabs thog med nas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i khang pa ru/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mal stan bting / /bde sdug btang snyoms gos kyis btums/ /chos brgyad sngas la mgo bo gtad/ /ma rig 'thug pa'i gnyid du log /bag chags ngan pa'i rmi lam rmis/ /gnyid dang rmi lam ngan pa la/ /thog mtha' sangs pa'i dus ma byung / /ngo mtshar rje btsun thugs rje can/ /khyed kyis zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /gsung rab lha yi rnga bo che/ /yang yang drag tu brdung ba'i mod/ /dbang med ma rig gnyid las sad/ /bag chags ngan pa'i rmi lam chad/ /bka' drin che'o bla ma rje/ /da dung ma rig gnyid song na/ /khyed kyis yang yang slong du gsol/ /da ni bla ma thugs rje can/ /bdag la khungs thub gzhung bzang la/ /brten pa'i zhi lhag bsgrub tshul gyi/ /gdams pa nyung la 'dus pa zhig /brtse ba'i sgo nas gnang du gsol/ /zhes legs par bskul ba'i lan du/ /'o de yin na/ rgya nag stong khun gyi rgyal po'i longs spyod dang 'gran pa'i za hor rgyal po chen po'i rgyal rigs su sku 'khrungs nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dang /sde snod gsum rgyud sde bzhi sogs lung gi yon tan dang /bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis sogs kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i rtags su rgya gar gyi slob mas ci mdzad bod nas sa 133

ler gzigs shing zhabs sa la mi reg par gtsug lag khang rnams la phyag bskor mdzad pa sogs mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing rje btsun sgrol ma sogs yi dam gyi lha nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam gyi zhal gzigs shing gsung gis gnang ba thob pas/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa mnyam med jo bo chen po zhes/ snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba de nyid bod yul gangs can ljongs 'dir byon dus/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od sogs kyis bstan pa dag gter mdzad dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ legs bshad mtshungs med byang chub lam gyi sgron ma mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa'i 'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal bar byung / gzhung 'di ni lam rim che chung thams cad kyi ma lta bu yin/ 'di las lhag pa'i gzhung khungs thub cig btsal na mi rnyed pas/ de nyid kyi nang ltar bsam gtan gyi ngo bo zhi gnas la bslab tshul ni 'di lta ste/ bsod nams ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyu ni sangs rgyas thams cad dag /mngon shes bskyed pa nyid du bzhed/ /ji ltar 'dab gshog ma rgyas pa'i/ /134

bya ni mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin mngon shes stobs bral bas/ /sems can don byed nus ma yin/ /mngon shes ldan pa'i nyin mtshan gyi/ /bsod nams dag ni gang yin te/ /mngon shes dag dang bral gyur la/ /skyes pa brgyar yang yod ma yin/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'dod gyur pa/ /des ni 'bad byas mngon shes dag /'grub par 'gyur gyis le los min/ /zhi gnas grub pa ma yin par/ /mngon shes 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /de phyir zhi gnas 'grub pa'i phyir/ /yang nas yang du 'bad par bya/ /zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams pas/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgom byas kyang / /lo ni stong phrag dag gis kyang / /ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir ting 'dzin tshogs le'u las/ /gsungs pa'i yan lag la legs gnas/ /dmigs pa gang rung gcig dag la/ /yid ni dge la bzhag par bya/ /rnal 'byor zhi gnas 'grub 'gyur na/ /mngon shes dag kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dang /rang gzhan gyi don gnyis gang bsgrub kyang / mngon shes yod na sa chod chen po 'byung bas/ mngon shes 'char ba'i gzhi ni zhi gnas yin pas/ de bsgrub pa la 'bad par byas na 'grub kyis 135

le lo byas na 'grub pa min/ zhi gnas ma 'grub bar du mngon shes kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir zhi gnas bsgrub phyir yang nas yang du 'bad dgos/ zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshogs med na yang yun ring 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u las gsungs pa'i spang bar bya ba dang /sngon du 'gro ba dang / ldog par bya ba dang / gdungs pa bcad pa dang / yid 'byung bar bya ba dang / yon tan rjes su dran pa dang / brtson par bya ba dang / zung du 'brel bar bya ba dang /gnas pa thabs kyi yan lag rnams dang / gzhan yang nyan sa nas zhi gnas kyi yan lag tshogs bcu gsum gsungs pa sogs shes nas bsgrub na legs mod/ 'on kyang de dag rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo tshul khrims kyi yan lag dang / 'dod pa chung pa/chog shes pa/ dben par gnas pa bzhi cis kyang dgos par gsungs pas/ rgyu tshogs de dag la legs par gnas nas/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun nam/ yang na tsog bu sogs gang bder gnas nas/ lus drang por bsrangs te shes pa gzhan du ma yengs pa byas/ thub dbang gi sku sogs dmigs pa gang rung gcig gsal btab la/ yid dmigs rten de'i thog tu gzhagabazhag nas dmigs pa de nyid ma brjed par yid la thu re dran 136

par bya/ de'i tshe byeng rgod kyis dran pa nyams pa byung na de ma thag shes par byas nas slar dmigs pa la 'dogs dgos/ de ltar dran shes gnyis kyis bskyangs pas/ nam zhig bying rgod gnyis dang bral nas/ lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde bas brgyan pa'i zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa thob tshe/ mngon shes kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang gzhung bzang po de ltar shes rab kyi ngo bo lhag mthong la bslab tshul ni 'di lta ste/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /skye ba med par rtogs gyur pa'i/ /rang bzhin stong nyid shes pa ni/ /shes rab ces ni yongs su bshad/ /yod pa skye ba rig min te/ /med pa'ang nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /nyes pa gnyis ka thal 'gyur phyir/ /gnyis ka dag kyang 'byung ba min/ /dngos po rang las mi skye zhing / /gzhan dang gnyis ka las kyang min/ /rgyu med las min de yi phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin med/ /yang na chos rnams thams cad dag /gcig dang du ma'i rnam dpyad na/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mi dmigs pas/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid du nges/ /stong nyid bdun cu'i rig pa dang / /dbu ma rtsa ba sogs las kyang / /dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /stong pa nyid du grub bshad pa/ /gang phyir gzhung ni mang gyur pas/ /de phyir 'dir ni ma 137

spros la/ /grub pa'i grub mtha' tsam zhig tu/ /bsgoms pa'i don du rab tu bshad/ /de bas chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag ni mi dmigs pas/ /bdag med pa ni bsgoms pa nyid/ /'di ni shes rab bsgoms pa yin/ /shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kun/ /gang gis rang bzhin ma mthong bzhin/ /shes rab de nyid rigs dpyad pa/ /rnam rtog med par de bsgom bya/ /rnam rtog las byung srid pa 'di/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid de/ /de phyir ma lus rtog spangs pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog yin no/ /de ltar yang ni bcom ldan gyis/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung bar byed/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas pa/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las kyang / dam chos 'di la rgyal ba'i sras/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam gyur na/ /rnam rtog bgrod dka' las 'das te/ /rim gyes mi rtog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lung dang rig pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad skye med pas/ /rang bzhin med par shes byas nas/ /rnam par rtog med bsgom par bya/ /de ltar de nyid bsgom byas na/ /rim gyis drod sogs thob byas nas/ /rab dga' la sogs thob 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yun 138
