mi ring / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar lhag mthong gi rgyu tshogs/ /bla ma mtshan ldan la lhag mthong gi gdams pa yang yang zhus nas nyan pa dang / de don la yang yang bsam pa dang / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med du byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bsags sbyangs la yang yang 'bad par bya/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i sta na la lus drang po ra bya/ de nas phung po khams dang skye mched sogs chos kun skye ba med par rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa la shes rab zer bas de shes par bya tshul ni/ phung po khams dang skye mched sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i snang grags kyi chos thams cad yod pa las skyes snyam na/ dper na myu gu de rgyu dus yod na/grub tshar zin pa skye mi dgos/ skye dgos na skye ba don med dang thug med du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /med pa las skyes snyam na/de yin na nam mkha' la me tog skye dgos kyang mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /yod med gnyis ka las skyes snyam na/ sngar bshad pa'i nyes pa gnyis gar thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yod min med min las skyes snyam na/ nga 'dra sngar yang skyes pa ma mthong la/ phyin chad kyang skye mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dpyad na chos thams cad skye ba med par rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par 'gyur/139

phyi nang gi dngos po 'di dag thams cad rang las rang skyes snyam na/ mi skye ste dper na mi zhig rang las rang skye mi srid pa ltar/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams kyang rang las rang skye mi srid/gal te skyes na bskyed bya skyed byed gnyis gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan las skyes snyam na/ dper na bu chung zhig pha ma'i khu khrag las skyes na/ rgyu khu khrag gi dus na 'bras bu bu chung de dmigs dgos kyang / de'i dus mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te 'brel med gzhan las skye na/ rkang pa las lag pa lag pa las rkang pa/ me las chu chu las me skyes pa sogs/ rgyu mthun mi mthun thams cad las thams cad skyes dgos te/ de mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka las skyes snyam na/ sngar bdag gzhan re re ba la dpyad tshe skye ba med par khegs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu med las skyes snyam na/ de yin na/ 'jig rten pa rnams ston thog 'byung ba'i phyir zhing las la ma 'bad na yang skye dgos te/ mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dpyad tshe phyi nang gi dngos po rnams ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin med par stong pa nyid du shes par 'gyur ro/ /yang chos thams cad gcig tu med de/ cha bcas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tha dad du med de cha rnams so sor bsal ba'i shul na mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 140

stong nyid bdun cu'i rig pa dang / dbu ma rtsa ba sogs gzhung mang po nas dngos po rnams gdod ma nas stong pa nyid du grub par bshad pa la rgya cher blta zhing lta ba'i phu thag chod par bya dgos pa zhal 'phang mdzad nas ma spros/ 'dir lung rigs kyis grub pa'i grub mtha' tsam zhig bdag med pa bsgom pa'i don du rab tu bshad pa yin/ de lta bas na sngar rigs pas dpyad tshe chos kun ngo bo rdul tsam mi dmigs pas na/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyes grub pa rdul tsam mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du 'dug snyam du yang nas yang du dpyad nas bsgom pa de ni/ shes rab stong pa nyid bsgom pa yin no/ /'o na de ltar dpyad nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par nges par byas nas stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i shes rab de nyid la 'dzin pa ji ltar spong snyam na/ shes rab kyis chos rnams kyi rang bzhin btsal nas ma rnyed pa de bzhin du/ shes rab de nyid kyang rigs pas dpyad nas/ rang bzhin med par rtogs pas/ rnam par rtog pa med pa de ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgyur nges pas yul yul can thams cad stong nyid 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa'i ngang du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar mchod par byas/ rtog med du bsgom dgos pa'i tshul mdo rgyud 141

kyi lung gis bsgrubs nas rgyas par gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar lung dang rigs pa mi 'dra ba de dag gi sgo nas/ chos rnams skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin med par nges par byas nas/ de'i ngang du rnam rtog gzhan med par byas nas bsgom dgos pa'i tshul cung zad mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms na rim gyis drod sogs dang / sa dang po rab tu dga' ba sogs sa lam rnams thob nas sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring bar myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang skal bzang gi slob bu blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ kho bo la bla ma rin po che khyed kyi thugs dam gye gtso bo nang sems rgyud gyong po 'di myur du thul ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab pa zhig bstan du gsol zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ pha sangs rgyas kun lhag bka' drin can/ /bu bdag la dar gcig snyan gsan zhu/ /blo rtse gcig gus pas phyag dang bcas/ /pha bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhu/ /bdag tshe stod yad ma yud la song / /tshe'i bar la 'dod yon dkor gyis bslus/ /da tshe lhag ci tsam yod ma shes/ /rang chung ngu ma la skyes nas bzung / /gzhan rgan gzhon mang po shi ba mthong / /da rang yang nam 'chi cha mi 'dug /dus do nub yin yang 'chi nyen gda'/ /142

de bsams nas mgon khyod zhabs drung bsnyegs/ /pha bla mas rjes bzung sprang po ngas/ /chos zab mo stong nyid mtshon rnon gyis/ /dgra bdag 'dzin phung rgan btul na snyam/ /de 'dul ba'i 'dul lugs ji ltar byed/ /sems ngo bo chos skur ma rtogs par/ /blo ma rig 'khrul bas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /nad nyon mongs tshan ches mnar lags pas/ /'di 'joms pa'i chos kyi sman mchog zhu/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mgon khyed kyi thugs dam kun gyi mthil/ /gnad zab mo'i nang nas yang zab cig /thugs brtse bas bdag la stsol bar zhu/ /pha bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa la/ /gegs gol sa med pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can/ /dus ring min skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o byang chub kyi sems la mnga' brnyes pa'i bla ma gser gling pa las jo bo rjes gsan pa'i theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig las/ rmi lam snang ba sems kyi ngo bor bstan/ /sems nyid sgyu ma ji bzhin stong par rtogs/ /sna tshogs sprin bzhin stong pa'i ngang las byung / /chu yi chu bur bzhin du dbye ba med/ /de phyir brjod med spros bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul ni/ dang bo dben pa'i 143

gnas su bde ba'i stan la lus gnad drang por bsrangs te/skyabs sems bla ma'i gsol 'debs sngon du btang / de nas rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su gtan la dbab/ sgyu ma'i dpes sems nyid stong par gtan la dbab/ sprin gyi dpes stong pa las snang ba 'byung bar gtan la dbab/ chu bur gyi dpes snang stong dbyer med du gtan la dbab/ nam mkha'i dpes brjod med spros bral du gtan la dbab/ de ltar gtan la dbab nas dngos gzhi mnyam gzhag spros bral bsgoms/ rjes su bsngo ba sgon lam bya/ thun mtshams su chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar snang stong du shes par bya zhing / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la byams snying rje chen po bsgoms shing bdag las gzhan gces kyi bsam sbyor la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ bde ba'i mal du lus gnad bsrangs/ /skyabs sems gsol 'debs sngon du btang / /rmi lam bzhin du yul snang kun/ /rang gi sems su gtan la dbab/ /sgyu ma bzhin du sems nyid kyang / /stong pa nyid du gtan la dbab/ /mkha' la sprin bzhin stong pa las/ /snang ba 'byung bar gtan la dbab/ /chu bur bzhin du snang stong 144

gnyis/ /dbyer ru med par gtan la dbab/ /nam mkha'i dpe bzhin brjod du med/ /spros dang bral bar gtan la dbab/ /de ltar gtan la phabs pa'i mthar/ /dngos gzhi spros bral ngang la bzhag /rjes su bsngo ba smon lam bya/ /thun mtshams rnams su chos rnams kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'khor 'khyams kyi/ /'gro la byams dang snying rje bsgoms/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis len/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster/ /snyam pa'i bsam pa shugs drag bskyed/ /'phral du rang gis gang nus rnams/ /lag len la yang ci thebs bya/ /de ltar byang chub sems gnyis po/ /zung 'brel nyams su blangs gyur na/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i skal ldan gyi slob bu mtho lding dge slong ngag dbang ye shes dang / bkra shis sgang gi dbu mdzad zur pa blo bzang tshul khrims/ blo bzang dge legs dang blo bzang bstan 'dzin bzhi yis/ snga phyir rim pa byas sku gsung thugs rten gser dngul ja mar gos dar sogs mang bo phul/ nyin gcig khong bzhi po 'ongs nas/ ja dkar dang 'bras kyi 'tsho ba drangs 145

nas/ dge slong ngag dbang ye shes kyis rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas/'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon bka' drin sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la zhu ba/ bdag cag rnams kyis skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams na blo bde ba zhig ma mchis kyang / da res 'khor ba sdug bsngal gye rgya mtsho las sgol ba'i rje btsun ded dpon chen po khyed dang mjal ba tsam gyis blo bde zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsi myong tshe/ rang gis nyams su len nus na yar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dug snyam/ sngar med pa'i dga' bdes lus sems khyab pa byung mod/ 'on kyang sngar khyed kyis skal bzang gi gdul bya'i grwa pa bu slob mang po la zhal gdams dang nyams mgur mang po stsal pa thos/ da ni khyed nyi ma bzhin du phyogs gcig nas mi bzhugs par 'gro ba'i don du phyogs gzhan du phebs 'gro bas na/ yang yang mi mjal bar gda'/ da lan mjal ba'i dus 'dir nged 'dir 'tshogs rdo rje spun bzhi bo la/ thugs brtse bas zhal gdams zab mo zhig stsol dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nyid nas/ /146

bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bsogs/ /chos rnams sems kyis rol pa dang / /sems nyid stong pa nyid du rtogs/ /stong gsal ngang las shes bya'i chos/ /thams cad ma 'dres sa ler mkhyen/ /chos sku'i dbyengs las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar/ /de srid 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /snyan gyi dbang po dar gcig gson/ /bdag cag rdo rje spun bzhi pos/ /sngon chad bsam blo 'di ltar btang / /mi lus ri dwags nyam chung po/ /chung ngu ma la skyes nas bzung / /lo dang zla ba'i rngon pas bdas/ /zhag dang za ma'i sha khyes ded/ /rgas pas dbugs 'tshangs byen pa 'dar/ /na ba'i mda' yis glo brdeg byas/ /'chi ba'i g.yang du lhung la khad/ /de la bsam tshe skrag pa skyes/ /ngan song gsum gyi me 'obs su/ /chud na sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /mtho ris lha mi'i tsher dong du/ /lhung na bde ba'i go skabs med/ /'dod yon dkor nag dug gi chu/ /'thung na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /sngar las lhag pa'i 'jigs skrag skyes/ /da ni ci drag snyam yod dus/ /rje btsun mnyan pa khyed dang mjal/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i gru chen la/ /brten nas 'khor ba'i dug gi chu/ /da res 147

brgal nas pha rol gyi/ /thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' ru/ /'gro ba'i skal pa byung ba la/ /bsam pas sems la dga' ba skyes/ /mgon khyod gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /chos 'dod skom gyi gdungs pa bsal/ /yid kyi re ba rdzogs pa'i mod/ /rab tu dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /da ni bla ma rin po che/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /bdag gzhan deng nas byang chub bar/ /'bral med rjes su bzung du gsol/ /bdag cag rdo rje spun bzhi po/ /thos pas ngan 'gror mi ltung zhing / bsgom pas 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa'i/ /zhal gdams zab mo stsal du gsol/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams spyir zhal gdams zer ba yang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung dam pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas brgyud/ slob ma yang slob rnams la yang nas yang du gdams pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i chos lam rim blo sbyong sogs bdag gis gang thos pa rnams slar rang gi zhal nas khyed rnams la gdams tshar song ba de rnams la nga'i zhal gdams zhes kyang chog pas/ de las lhag pa'i zhal gdams gsar pa zhig da bshad rgyu med pas/ de lugs bzhin nyams su blangs na chog mod/ 'on kyang gal che na 'bum la brgya tshar thon bya ba yin pas/ slar de dag rnams kyi 148

nang nas gal che ba la gsal 'debs zhu bas gsan par 'tshal/ de yang snyigs dus kyi tshe thung nam 'chi la nges pa med/gzhan mang po zhig shes kyang bsgom long med tshul soms la/dus dang rnam pa thams cad du myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba'i chos gcig chog don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal chen po 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ mtha' bral chos sku klong yangs chen po'i ngang du btang bzhag med par glod la gu yangs khyab brdal gyi dran pas ma brjed par skyongs dang / nam zhig ma rig nyon mongs rtog tshogs kyi mun pa rims kyis mtha' nas sangs te/ gnas lugs stong gsal gyi nam mkha' yangs pa langs nas mtha' dbus gsal 'grib med par gyur pa'i tshe/ de'i ngang du snang sems thams cad 'dres nas/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus/ sems nyid nang du ma lus/ snang bas stong pa ma bsgribs/ stong pas snang ba ma bkag snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa chen po'i klong du nam yang mer gyis song nas gnas pa zhig byung na/ nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong rtsad nas sangs/chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi tshig don thams cad sa ler sems la 'char zhing / 'khor 'das yongs la ltad mo blta nus 149

pa'i chos gcig shes kun grol bya ba 'di ka lags/ des na chos de ston pa'i bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kun las bka' drin che bas/ da nyid rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor bltas la/ mos gus gdungs shugs drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba snying nas thob la/ de nas/ bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang / /gsungs pa dang / dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /cir yang sa le'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsungs pa'i don ltar bla ma'i thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bus 'khor 'das yongs la khyab brdal phyogs ris med pa gsal stong spros pa dang bral ba dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par dus rtag tu sa ler gnas pa dang / rang gi sems gnyis nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres pa ltar bsres la/thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin chen po de'i ngang du nyin mtshan khor yug tu zhog la/ yang mi gnas shing skyo ba'i dus su/ bla ma la gsol 'debs gyis la/ thugs yid bsres pa'i ngang la blo lhod kyis glod la rtse gcig tu mnyam par zhog yang byeng rmugs gnyid gsum byung dus su yang skad gseng mthon pos bla ma la gsol 'debs gyis la/ rig pa nam mkha' ltar phyogs bcur thongs la rgya 150

bsgyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su thongs la/ gu yangs khyab brdal gye dran pas rgyangs so tshugs la ma yengs par phyal le kha yan byung rgyal du skyongs zhes tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtog stong ba'i ngang / /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs dgongs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /'khor 'das kun la khyab cing brdal/ /dus gsum bsgrib med sa ler mkhyen/ /rgyal kun thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems nyid dag pa chos dbyings kyi/ /zhing khams mtha' yas mu med na/ /bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal kun dang / /thugs yid 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'o ma'i mtsho/ /bla mas rnam dpyod phyag gis bsrubs/ /man ngag mar gyi nying khu byung / /bdag la stsal pa bka' drin che/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /sems nyid nor bu'i gter mdzod sgo/ /bla ma'i man ngag lde mig gis/ /phyes pas bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /rang sems chos dbyengs zhing khams na/ /'khor 'das ltad mo sna tshogs snang / /sems las ltad mo che ba zhig /'jig rten khams na yod ma myong / /'khor 'das chos kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sems kyi 151

gnas lugs nam mkha' 'dra/ /phyogs ris med pa'i mkha' klong du/ /rtsol sgrub med par lhod kyis zhog /snang ba bzang ngan cir snang yang / /phyi na yod pa ma yin te/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /sems nyid stong pa'i rang gzugs yin/ /chos kun gzhi ma sems nyid kyang / /nang na yod pa ma yin te/ /phyi yi nam mkha' yangs pa bzhin/ /'khor 'das kun la khyab cing brdal/ /chos nyid khyab brdal chen po la/ /'di zhes tshad bzung ma mchis pa'i/ /ngang la mtha' dbus med par glod/ /glod na mkha' ltar 'gyur med gsal/ /nam mkha' 'dom gyis 'jal ba bzhin/ /chos dbyings khyab brdal chen po la/ /phyogs ris go ler ma gcod cig /bcad nas mtho dman gsal 'grib yong / /mdor na gang shar sems kyi rtsal/ /sems nyid stong gsal ngang la zhog /nam yang sdug btsir ma byed par/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bde gyes/ /phyogs ris med par kun la khyab/ /rgya chad med par brdal ba yi/ /gnas lugs khyab brdal stong gsal gye/ /ngang la de ltar mnyam gzhag na/ /glo bur nyon mongs rnam rtog sangs/ /chos kun tshig don sems la 'char/ /'khor 'das ltad mo thams cad mthong / /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /don dam byang chub 152

sems mchog la/ /brten nas chos sku mngon du byas/ /chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs skus 'gro don byed par shog /ces smras tshe/ yang slob bu blo bzang dge legs na re/ don dam byang chub sems kyi zhal gdams zab mo de thos pa tsam gyis kyang rig pa gu yangs sang nger song nas lhag mthong gi nyams 'char ba snyam pa byung bas bka' drin shin tu che/ da dung mnyam gzhag gi rjes su kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rin po che la blo sbyongs tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zer ba'i lan du 'di skad smras so/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med pa'i/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /mtha' bral stong gsal bsgoms rjes su/ /de ltar gnas lugs ma rig pas/ /ma rig dbang gis nyon mongs rgyas/ /nyon mongs dbang gis las ngan bsags/ /las ngan dbang gis lus ngan blangs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med la/ /rgyun tu spyod pa'i sems can kun/ /rang gi pha mar ma gyur med/ /kun kyang drin can sha stag yin/ /drin can rnams la bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /da ni kun gyi sdug bsngal bsal/ /bde la 'a god snyam gtong len bya/ /dbugs de tshur la 'ong ba'i dus/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal las nyon rnams/ /153

'od zer nag po'i rnam pa ru/ /byung nas rang gi snying dbus su/ /thim pas bdag 'dzin rdul du brlag /ma gyur 'gro kun sdug bsngal dang / /las nyon kun dang bral bar mos/ /dbugs de phar la 'gro ba'i dus/ /rang gi bde dge gang yod rnams/ /'od zer dkar po'i rnam par song / /'gro kun lus sems yongs la khyab/ /gnas skabs thams cad bde dang ldan/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob nus pa'i/ /skal ba can du gyur par mos/ /bdag(dbu ma rin chen 'phreng ba las/)la de dag sdig smin zhing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /skyid(paṇa chen shākya shis/)na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal khur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems par shog /ces sogs smon lam gang shes bya/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems 'di la/ /slobs dang sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas/ yang slob bu blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal blangs nas ma sbyangs na chog gam zer ba'i lan du ma sbyangs kyang chog tshul 'di skad ces smras so/ /dper na gser 'gyur rtsi mchog gis/ /lcags rnams gser du bsgyur ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems gnyis rten 'brel gyis/ /sdug bsngal bde bar 'char bar 154

'gyur/ /rma bya'i pho ba'i nus pa yis/ /dug zhu zas su 'gyur ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems gnyis nus pa yis/ /gzhan gnod blangs tshad phan par 'gyur/ /zhing la mi gtsang lud sbyar na/ /lo tog legs po smin pa ltar/ /sdug bsngal blangs nas bzod nus na/ /sangs rgyas pa la shin tu nye/ /me dpung chen po 'bar ba yi/ /steng du rtswa shing bzhag pa ltar/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong mkhan la/ /rkyen ngan na tsha grogs su 'gyur/ /rma bya dug dang 'phrad tsa na/ /zos pa'i steng du za ba bzhin/ /sdug bsngal snga ma mi spong bar/ /steng du sdug bsngal ches cher blangs/ /sdug bsngal bde bar ma shar na/ /sdug bsngal spangs pas ga la langs/ /sdug bsngal bde bar shar tsa na/ /spongs shig zer yang spong don med/ /rmi lam skabs kyi sdug bsngal la/ /blangs dang spong rgyu gnyis med bzhin/ /sdug bsngal ngo bo gdod nas stong / /stong pa nyid la spong len ci/ /sdug bsngal sgong rgyu med bzhin du/ /yod snyam spong ba sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bde sdug ngo bo gdod nas stong / /stong zhing snang ba sgyu ma 'dra/ /sgyu ma'i rta dang glang po sogs/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis byas pa ltar/ /bde sdug bzang ngan snod bcud chos/ /thams cad rang gi sems kyis byas/ /byed mkhan sems nyid gdod nas stong / /stong gsal nam 155

mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /de la don dam byang chub kyi/ /sems zer de yi ngang la zhog /zhog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /de ltar rtogs na sdug bsngal kun/ /blangs nas slar yang spong mi dgos/ /dgos kyang spong rgyu gang nas rnyed/ /don dam byang chub sems klong na/ /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ /chos nyid ngang du dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gyis/ /zhes smras pas/ blo bzang tshul khrims na re/ don dam gnas lugs mngon du gyur nas sdug bsngal bde bar shar ba la nad gdon sogs rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan yin pas spong mi dgos pa khyed kyi gsung de shin tu bden te/ rje mi las/ nad dang gdon dang sdig sgrib rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyan du mdzes/ /zhes dang / rgyan du che ba'i na tsha 'di/ /spo thabs yod de spo don med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags mod/ 'on kyang / yang khong gis/ khyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyang / /bdag gis blangs nas sbyong bar shog /gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gis gnas lugs kyi rang sa ma zin par/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma rmi lam ltar gzhan gye sdug bsngal blangs pa sbyong tshul zhig kyang gsungs na/na ba la sogs pa byung dus su phan che bar gda' zer ba'i lan du/ 'o na sbyangs kyang chog ces sbyong tshul 'di smras so/ /e 156

ma skal ldan snying gi bu/ /'o na na ba sogs kyi dus/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun blangs nas/ /mi bzhag sbyongs na 'di ltar gyis/ /dbugs de phyir la gtong ba'i dus/ /blangs pa'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal kun/ /'od zer nag po'i rnam pa ru/ /phyi ru thon nas bar snang ngam/ /yang na sa rdo gang rung la/ /sib sib thim nas stong par yal/ /nad dang sdig sgrib dag par mos/ /dbugs de nang du len pa'i dus/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kun/ /'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung / /rang gi lus la sib sib thim/ /rang lus dwangs shing gsal bar mos de nas yi dam lha ru bsgoms/ /dbugs de phar la gtong ba'i dus/ /thugs srog sngags las 'od zer dang / /'dod yon lha mo dpag med 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /'dod yon lnga yis mchod par mos/ /dbugs de tshur la len pa'i dus/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams/ /lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi/ /rnam par byung nas rang lus la/ /mtsho la kha ba babs ltar thim/ /'ja' lus 'od skur grol bar mos/ /dbugs de phar la gtong ba'i dus/ /rang las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /phyi rol snod bcud yongs la phog /ma dag nyes skyon thams cad 157

sbyangs/ /phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing / /nang bcud lha dang lha mor gyur/ /dbugs de tshur la len pa'i dus/ /snod bcud bcud dang nus pa rnams/ /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi yi/ /rnam par byung nas rang la thim/ /'chi med rig 'dzin thob par mos/ /gzhan yang gtong len 'di ltar gyis/ /dbugs de nang du len pa'i dus/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /byin rlabs rang la zhugs par mos/ /dbugs de phar la gtong ba'i dus/ /rang gi bde dge phar la song / /'gro kun bde dang ldan par mos/ /sdug bsngal len dang sbyong ba yi/ /nyams len yang yang byas gyur na/ /nam zhig dngos su len nus shing / /blangs pa gzhan la spo bar nus/ /de dus 'gro la mi spo bar/ /sa rdo sogs la spo dgos gsungs/ /rma byas btsan dug zos gyur na/ /sgo mdongs gzhan las mjes pa bzhin/ /de ltar blangs nas sbyangs gyur na/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas/ khong rnams shin tu dga' nas/ da res gzhan gyi sdug bsngal blangs nas sbyongs tshul gsungs pa 'di yang bdag cag rnams la shin tu phan pa zhig byung zer phyag byas te rang gnas su song ngo / /yang dad gus che zhing rig pa rno ba gso ba rig pa la mkhas 158

pa'i slob bu lha rje chos rgyal gyis/ shing jog 'bras sogs kha zas dang lha rdzas dri med bcas/ zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ spyir 'gro ba yongs gyi dge ba'i bshes/ /sgos bdag gi 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bu bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /chos kun gye mdzod 'dzin mgon khyod kyis/ /chos drang don las 'bras rnam gzhag dang / /chos nges don sems kyi ngo sprod sogs/ /chos zab la rgya che mang gsungs kyang / /sems chags sdang mi dge'i dbang du song / /lha bla ma dkon mchog thugs khrel zhing / /mar ngan song lhung yang skrag pa med/ /sprang snying rul bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sngon tshe 'di'i lto gos gnyis kyi phyir/ /dus nyin par lto dang mtshan mo'i gnyid/ /gcog mang po myong te bzod par gda'/ /nga dam pa'i lha chos byed dus 'dir/ /dbyar nyi mar bzhag na zhu la khad/ /dgun lhag pa phog na 'khyag la khad/ /lto thun gcig chag na shi la khad/ /sprang go log po la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dus da dung sems khrid skyong ba'i dus/ /nang sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams stsol/ /sems gyong po thul ba'i dus mi gda'/ /'di myur du thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ de yang bla ma'i man ngag gi gnad zab 159

mo la brten nas/ rang gis lung rigs kyis brtags shing dpyad nas/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'khor 'das yongs la khyab pa phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa/ 'di zhes mtshon du med pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab brdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngo bo rjen cer gyis mthong dgos te/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/rnal 'byor mi la ras pa ngas/ /cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong / /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /gsungs/ de'i ngang la 'jog pa'i tshe na yang/ las dang po bas bsgom 'debs mkhas dgos te/ rje mi las/ bdag gis phyag rgya chen po bsgom tsa na/ /don yin lugs kyi steng du rtsol med bzhag /ces gsungs pa ma gtogs/ rang ka tham thom du bzhag ces ma gsungs pas na/ ci yin 'di yin med pa'i lung ma bstan du bzhag pa tsam ma yin par/ phyag chen gye gzhung 'ga' zhig las/nam mkha' ltar dpangs bstod la bzhag /sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed la bzhag /gsungs pa dang / khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba bzhin du ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la rtsol sgrub med par bzhag nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin du kun gsal mdangs dang ldan par bzha ga gsungs pa ltar/ nam mkha' 160

ltar rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang nas/ khyab brdal klong yangs sems kyi ngo bo yin lugs ji bzhin pa'i ngang la 'jog dgos te/ rje mi las/ nya ma dpal dar 'bum la/khyod nam mkha' 'di la dpe long la/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i bsgom zhig gyes/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzhin/ /yid gzhungs nas sgoms shig pad+ma dkar/ /gsungs/ de ltar mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin chen po'i ngang la gnas pa'i tshe yang / sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid las ma 'das kyang /rnam pa la kha mthon po nas nam mkha' yangs pa la bltas pa ltar gsal sing nge / stong rjen ne/ zang thal ler gnas pa 'byung / de'i tshe yang blo'i zur gyis gsal ba de la ngos bzung gtad so e 'dug bltas na ngos bzung gtad so gang yang mi rnyed smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa 'byung / yang ma dpyad par de ga'i ngang la bzhag na 'di yin med pa'i gsal stong chen po smra rgyu med pa'i nyams su myong rgyu yod yod lta bu de la/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces pa dang / zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos 161

rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi spra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa de ka lags pas/ de nyid la ngos bzung med rung ngos bzung gi mchog gtad so med rung gtad so'i mchog tu bzung nas rtag tu de'i ngang la 'jog pa ni man ngag gi gnad dam pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sems nyid stong gsal rjen pa'i ye shes chen po de nyid ngos ma zin par mi rtog par gnas tshad thams cad bsgom du bzung na/skabs re tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bla ma'i byen rlabs sogs la brten nas/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba byung tshe/yang de ka ngo mi shes par dor nas rang ka blo btang bas btang snyoms tha mal du sdod pa 'am/ ci yin 'di yin med pa'i lung ma bstan du lus na nor ba chen po yin pas/ de ltar gyur na bsgom gang yin byeng ba gang yin gyi dbye ba yang 'byed dka' zhing / de gnyis dbye ba ma byas na lung ma bstan gyi ngang la mi tshe sdug zad la gtong nyen che bas/ des na gnas lugs kyi ngo bo bla mas kyang thabs du ma la brten nas/ mngon sum mdzub tshugs su ngo sprad/ slob mas kyang ngo bo bcar phog tu ngos zin pa de'i ngang du 'jog pa gal che zhes slar yang rang gi nyams la shar ba glu dbyangs su blangs pa/ dbu rdzogs phyag 162

gsum gdams pa rnams ston pa'i/ /drin can bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs shig /zhi gnas ngang nas lung rig gis dpyad tshe/ /chos kun rang bzhin mkha' ltar du rtogs byung / /gang shar rnam rtog ngo bo la bltas pas/ /'dzin med klong du 'bad med du grol song / /blta mkhan rig pa'i rang ngo la bltas pas/ /stong nyid ma gtogs rnyed rgyu zhig ma byung / /blta yul blta mkhan stong nyid du dag nas/ /mthong rgyu med pa'i ltad mo zhig mthong song / /de nyid ngang la glod nas rang bzhag pas/ /gu yangs khyab brdal chen po zhig byung song / /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang du/ /snang sems thams cad dbyer med du 'dres byung / /snang stong sgyu ma'i gzigs mo la ltos dang / /rtag chad g.yang la lhung sa zhig mi gda'/ /zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam chen la zhugs dang / /lam la nor gye dogs pa zhig ma mchis/ /spros bral chos sku'i pho brang du gzims dang / /spros pa mang po byed rgyu zhig mi gda'/ /smra ba ma mang de tsam zhig gyis la/ /smra bsam brjod med ngang la rang zhog thongs/ /chos dbyings khyab brdal ma bang na gnas pa'i/ /rig pa'i khye'us glu chung 'di blangs so/ /zhes phul bas/ ོkho rang gi bsgom la sngar 'phel 'grib mang zhing yin nam min nam snyam pas the tshom yod pa 163

thams cad chod nas/ sngar med pa'i lhag mthong gi nyams khyad par can skyes/ gnas lugs kyi sgro 'dogs chod nas bogs chen po thon pa byung zer ro/ /yang skal ldan gyi slob bu/ rtogs ldan rnal 'byor pa chen po/bon mo phug gi bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel dang / bstan 'dzin ras pa/ bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ bzod pa chos 'phel rnams kyis/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab ni rgya che/ de yi dgongs 'grel ni grangs mang / snyigs dus sems can ni tshe thung / rang nyid nam 'chi la cha mi 'dug pas/ khong rnams la rgan po 'chi kha ma'i chos/ 'bad rtsol chen po byas nas bsgom mi dgos pa/tshegs chung la don che ba ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zab mo kun gyi mchog gyur/ thugs la gab pa mngon du byung ba/ thos pa tsam gyis srid pa hrul bor byed nus pa zhig bstan du gsol/ zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ lung rtogs yon tan dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /gdul bya ku mud tshal rnams skyong / /rje zla ba lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'jig rten mi chos rgya mtsho bsgral/ /dam pa'i lha chos nor bu blangs/ /'gro la legs bshad dgos 'dod stsol/ /rje ded dpon lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /las nyon dgra yi lag tu 164

shor/ /sdug bsngal chad pas mnar ba rnams/ /zhal mthong gsung thos tsam gyis grol/ /rje chos rgyal lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud/ /bdag 'dzin lcags sgog dam pos bcings/ /las dang nyon mongs mtshon gyes bsnun/ /na rga 'byor rgud chad pas bcad/ /lo zla nyin zhag pho nya yis/ /'chi bdag khrims ra ya nga bar/ /sang 'khrid gnang 'khrid lta bu'i dus/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po byon/ /thabs mkhas chos kyi ngo chen zhus/ /'khor ba'i btson ra dam po las/ /cung zad thar pa'i skal pa byung / /bka' drin che'o chos kyi rgyal/ /drin lan bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /da dung 'khor ba'i btson ra ru/ /chud kyang khyed kyis yang yang skyobs/ /da ni bdag cag bu slob kyis/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma mchis te/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya che zhing / /de yi dgongs 'grel grangs yang mang / /snyigs dus sems can tshe thung zhing / /nam 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas/ /myang bas nyon mongs nad 'joms pa'i/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i thig pa zhig /bdag cag dad pa'i gser snod du/ /brtse ba chen pos blug tu gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /'dzad med dngos grub stsol ba'i rtsa gsum lha/ /thogs med 165

'phrin las sgrub pa'i chos skyong kun/ /skye med sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul du/ /rtogs nas skyabs gcig sems nyid rin po che/ /snying nas rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'dod rnams la/ /gdams ngag mchog gcig bshad kyis gus pas nyon/ /de yang / mtha' dbus med pa'i nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong na/ gling bzhi yongs la thogs med bsgod pa'i 'od gsal nyi ma bzhin du/ 'dra 'dra 'dra la 'gran zla med pa'i rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu'i khyu mchog dpal ldan sa ra ha chen po zhes/ snyan grags srid pa'i rwa ba las brgal te nam mkha'i pha mthar 'ur zhing song ba gang de'i zhal gyi bum bzang las thon pa'i do ha rdo rje'i glu las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster byed pas/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ seṅge'i sgra lta bu'i rdo rje glu 'di'i don/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang sbyar nas cung zad bshad na/ dang po gzhi ni/sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa/ snang srid kun la khyab pa phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa/ 'di zhes mtshon du 166

med pa stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab brdal klong yangs chen po spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sems nyid gcig bu 'di ni rang lus snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas sa bon lta bu yin te/ des na chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med khyab brdal klong yangs chen po 'di nyid sngar ma rtogs pa la ma rig pa zhes zer/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis ngar 'dzin gyi blo 'byung / de'i dbang gis bdag gzhan ris su bcad nas chags sdang gnyis 'byung / de la brten nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong rim gyis rgyas nas las bzang ngan tha dad pa bsags/ las kyi dbang gis 'khrul snang bzang ngan sna tshogs byung ba mi bden pa la bden par bzung nas/tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bzung da bar 'khor ba 'dir sgyu ma rmi lam ltar 'khor nas bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba yin pas/'khor bar skye ba'i rtsa ba phar ded na sems kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i ma rig pa 'di yin pa'i tshul rnams legs par shes nas lam bsgoms na/ ma rig pa dag nas sangs rgyas pa'i tshul yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa lam ni/ gang la srid dang mya ngan 'da' 'phro ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po lam 167

ston pa'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten nas/ de'i zhal nas thob pa'i gdams ngag gi gnad la brten nas/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi ma sems kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs pas/ gnas skabs gang la yang ma rig nyon mongs las sgrib sogs glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas/ de'i dbang gis snang zhing srid pa'i 'khor ba'i chos kun 'phro ba yin pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan ma rig par 'khrul ba'i snang ba mi bden pa la bden par bzung nas zhen cing chags na slar sngar bzhin 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pas na/ de lam log pa yin par ngo shes nas de'i dbang du ma song bar bya ba dang / de nas snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig tu lung rigs du ma'i lam nas thag bcad cing /kun gzhi sems kyi gnas lugs la brtags shing dpyad nas/ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab brdal klong yangs nam mkha' ltar rtogs pas/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la nyin mtshan khor yug tu lo zla ba byas bzhag pa'i tshe/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang 'phro yang sngon bsu rjes gcod blang dor sogs blos bya rtsol gang yang mi byed par/168

sngar gye gnas lugs ma bcos gnyug ma khyab brdal blo bral chen po'i rgyun skyong ba la 'bad pas/ rnam rtog phra rags thams cad 'bad rtsol gyis gnyen po spu rtse tsam yang ma bsten bzhin du rang shar rang grol du song nas glo bur las nyon gyi dri ma mtha' dag rang sar dag nas/ rig stong rjen pa blo 'das rgya yan chos sku chen po'i klong du btsan sa zin nas rtogs pa nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur ba med pa'i dus/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phro ba yin tshul khong du chud nas/gnas lugs de nyid kyi rgyun skyongs pa de lam ma nor ba yin pas/ thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung nas nyams su len pa gces so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster byed pas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de ltar lam nyams su blangs pa'i mthus gnas skabs su yang rang gzhan gyi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster zhing khyad par mthar thug rang sems skye med spros bral chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa mngon du byas nas/ de'i ngang la ma g.yos bzhin du/gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'ja' tshon bzhin du ma 'dres par so sor byung nas/ rang gzhan kun gyi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster bas so/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams 169

cad ster bar byed pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dra ba'i don dam byang chub kyi sems rin po che de la/ kun gyes thog mar phyag byar 'os pas na/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dpal ldan sa ra ha chen pos kyang phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mchog gi chos lugs gdams pa kun gye mchog tu gyur pa'i lam chen po 'di la/ snang sems gnyis dang ma bral na thabs shes gnyis dang ma bral ba yin pas thabs shes zhes logs su 'tshol mi dgos pas/ des na snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam chen bo 'di'i khongs su bskyed rdzogs man chad kyi 'bad rtsol la brten pa'i lam 'og ma thams cad kyi thabs shes kyi cha kun yang don gyis 'dir ma 'dus pa med pa'i lam bzang chen po 'di la/ kha cig gis thabs shes phyogs re bar song nas lam la nor 'dug snyam pas the tshom gyis dogs pa skyes pa los bden te/ thabs shes de 'dra dgos na 'dir sems dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad thabs shes zung 'brel du khyer chog pa yod pas/ de 'dra'i dgos med kyi dogs pa skye mi dgos te/ gangs ri'i khrod na seṅge dkar mo srab med du 'phyo 'dra'i 'gran gyi do med tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal mi la bzhad pa rdo 170

rje zhes/ mtshan snyan lha mi yongs kyis nyin rer lan brgyar gleng ba gang de'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ ngas nor gyis dogs nas lam gcig btsal/ /lam ni zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam da nor gyis dogs pa nga la med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag zab mo la brten nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong pa mkha' ltar rtogs shing rnam pa 'gag pa med par rmi lam bzhin snang bar shes/ rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad rang gi sems las byung / sems su snang ba ltar stong bzhin du snang ba'i snang grags kyi chos thams cad kyang / rang gi sems las byung / sems su snang ba'i pha de yang go de lta bu'i chos kun gyi rtsa ba 'am/ gzhi ma 'am/ 'byung gnas chen po sems kyi gnas lugs ni sus kyang ma byas pa rgyu med pa rkyen med par ye gdod ma nas stong zhing nam mkha' ltar phyogs dang ris su ma chad par stong nyid kun la khyab pa 'di zhes mtshon du med pa/ zang thal khyab brdal klong yangs mtha' bral chos dbyings chen por gtan la phabs nas/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar rang sems stong pa nyid chos dbyings mtha' dbus bral ba'i klong du snang grags kyi chos thams cad ma 'gag par shar ba rnams mi dgag de ltar du 171

blos 'dzin pa'i shes pa thams cad dang bral bar sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal sgo lnga ha ra sangs rgya yan mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid chen po'i klong du gnyis su med par zhugs nas rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag dus/ snang sems thams cad mnyam gzhag chen po'i klong du ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ snang ba phyi ru ma chad/ sems nyid nang du ma lus/ mnyam gzhag phyogs gcig tu go ler ma chad/ snang bas gar khyab thams cad la/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid kyis khyab/ stong pa nyid kyis gar khyab la snang bas khyab cing brdal/ snang bzhin du ngo bo stong / stong bzhin du rnam pa ma 'gag par snang / snang stong dbyer med zung 'jug nam mkha' las yangs pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul ma nor ba'i gzhung lam chen mo yin te/rim lnga las/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa gnyis bo spang nas ni/ /gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /ces dang / kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i cha ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i snang stong thabs shes zung 'jug gi lam yangs pa de 172

nyams su blangs na/ dper na nor bu las dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba ltar/ 'bad rtsol med par sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kun 'byung ste/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas/ yod pa dngos por snang ba dang / /med par stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis/ /ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas/ /rang rig gzhan rig yod min te/ /thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong / /sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong / /chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong / /de las snying rje shugs 'byung ste/ /stobs dang mi brjed gzungs la sogs/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin pa/ /nor bu rin chen tshul du 'byung / /de rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs tshad yin/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs lha 'dre'i rna lam du/ /chos zab mo bas kyang bon sgra snyan/ /a snyi ra yi rgyal khams su/ /mkhas pa bas kyang spyon pa brin/ /dur khrod nyul ba'i wa spyang rnams/ /seṅga'i nga ros 'jigs shing skrag /'ga' zhig skal ldan yod srid na/ /'di don thos pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/yang ras chung pa la/ gcig shes kun grol re ba la/ /gsungs pa dang / ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis/ gdams ngag tshig gcig sangs rgyas kyi ngang / /zhes gsungs pa rnams gdams ngag 'di la zer/173

mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi nyams len kun 'ub kyis dri lan 'di la 'du ste/ rje btsun gyis/ snang ba rang gi sems nyid lags/ /sems nyid stong par shes par gyis/ /rtogs pa nyams dang ma bral na/ /tshul khrims mchod sogs dge ba'i chos/ /thams cad ma lus de la tshang / /zhes dang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ man ngag gcig ni bsgom pa yis/ /man ngag thams cad mtshon par bya/ /ji ltar sa gcig thob pa yis sa ni thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin man ngag thams cad kyang / /man ngag gcig gis thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /btags grol gyi rgyud las/ rang rig rnam dag sa gcig la/ /theg pa kun 'dus sa lam rdzogs/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ ngas ni 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /mdo sde sna tshogs gang gsungs pa/ /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste/ /tshig gcig rnam par bsgoms pas ni/ /de dag thams cad bsgom dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / sher phyin las/ chos gcig gi mdo dang rgyas pa shes na/ chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dbu ma pas kyang / gcig gi lta bo gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi lta bo yin/ /gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams 'di la dgongs 174

nas gsungs pa yin pas gung gcig tu 'grigs par 'gyur ro/ /des na chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi 'bab sa gnad 'gags mthar thug kyang / rang sems skye med chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po 'di ga'i thog tu 'bab pa yin te/ rje rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'gags dang nyag ga gzigs tsa na/ /tshig tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs gyur kyang / /skye med thang du kha ba babs/ /zhes dang / mnyam med jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang / /chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'babs/ /gsungs/ des na tshe gcig la sangs rgya bar 'dod pas/ thugs dam gyi mthil 'di la mdzad na legs te/ lho brag mar pas rje btsun la/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /yengs med sems la ltos shig gsung / /de dag la dgongs nas/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ 'brom 'tshang rgya ba la thag nye ba zhig dgos na/gsang sngags zab mo 'di rnams 'doms/ /khyad par do ha sems la tshud/ /'tshang rgya ba la de las thag nye ba med/ ston dus kyi lo tog kham rum med pa dang 'dra/ grub thob chen po rnams kyi nyams len yin/ khyad par du do ha 'di kun byas na/lung stong na phar la rnal 'byor pa bzang po nyams gar rtse zhing /175

ḍa ma ru khrol le 'ong srid/ blo rab la chos rab mchis/khyod kyi cha lugs 'di kun la lhag par 'di mthun gsungs pa'i glu ni/ gson gsang sngags theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /sgos dam chos zab mo do ha de/ /rje sa ra ha yis nga la byin/ /bu thugs kyi dkyil du 'di chongs gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na so nam zin pa'i skye bo nyal nas sdod pa ltar/ chos kun sems su shes/ sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med chos dbyengs spros bral chen por thag chod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/gzhan lha sgom sngags bzla sogs spros bcas kyi bya ba thams cad blos btang ste/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la gnas par bya'o/ /gzhan byed snying 'dod pa dang / gyis zhes bskul ba rnams bar chad yin te/ gsang ba grub las/ phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags sogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems sogs ni/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa ma 'ongs pa'i /slob dpon de ni bdud kyi rigs/ /zhes dang / rje mi las kyang /bu phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i dus/ /lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma brtson zhig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod/ /bu ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /gsungs/ 'di nyid dor nas gzhan dman pa'i dge sbyor sogs la brtson pa ni/ rgyal po khri las babs nas 176

phyag bdar byas pa dang 'dra ste/ dpal sa ra ha'i do ha las/gnas lugs rtogs nas dman pa nyid byed na/ rgyal bo khri las babs nas phyag bdar byed pa bzhin/ zad mi shes pa'i bde ba chen po nyid spangs nas/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i bde la reg pa nyid kyis 'chings gsungs/ dper na lto ba 'brang nas zas gzhan gyi rtsol ba mi byed pa ltar/ 'di ltar sems kyi phu thag chod nas/ slar gzhan rig gnas sogs mi slob par/ 'di kho nas chog shes par byas skyong dgos te/ rjes na rat+nas/ gang du mchog gi go 'phang la/ /yid gcig pa yis bsam byas na/ /de las dngos grub rnyed 'gyur te/ /bya mang rtsom la 'bras bu ci/ /gsungs/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs nas spros pa rnams la ched du 'bad pa de yang /lung gzhan las/ nor bu rnyed nas 'ching bu 'tshol ba dang / /zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan 'tshol ba bzhin/ /gsungs so/ /phyi'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba lta ci smos/ nang mchod sbyin sogs kyang re zhig bzhag nas bsgom dgos te/ bhud+ngha ka ras/ ye shes goms byed rnal 'byor pa yis yid ni 'di ltar rig min nyid/ /slong ba bgyid dang shin tu mang po'i bza' ba dang ni gnyid kyang ste/ /myur ba'i dbang las mang du smras dang sgra sgrogs rlung 177

dang klog pa dang / /mchod dang sbyin sreg sogs kyang de bzhin spang bya 'dir ni ting nge 'dzin la'o/ /gsungs/ bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi lta bu 'di 'dra thob nas/ da dung gzhan du bstan bcos du ma la blta ba de ni/ dper na chu bor nas thang chen du 'khyams nas skom pas gdungs nas 'chi ru bcug pa dang 'dra ste/ dpal sa ra ha'i do ha las/ gang zhig bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu/ /gdungs sems bsil ba ngoms par mi 'thung bar/ /de ni bstan bcos don mang mya ngan gyis/ /thang la skom pas gdungs te 'chi bar zad/ /gsungs/ des na ri dwags nyal sar phur ba btab pa ltar/ mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul gyi ri dwags rnams kyi gdan sa brag skyibs su lus ngag yid gsum g.yo ba med par chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ chu bo'i rgyun ni 'babs pa dang / /mar me rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par gzhag /ces gsungs pas rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur ba dang / phyir bzlog pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo dang / grub chen brgyad lta bu 'tshol ba la yang zhen pa bor nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'ba' 178

zhig la/ sems rtse gcig pa byas bsgoms na/ rnal 'byor pa sngon sbyangs can nam/ yang na brtson 'grus can gyis zla ba drug tshun la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/spyod bsdus las/ zla ba drug gis don 'grub 'gyur/ /gsungs/des na 'bad rtsol gyis bsgom sogs la ltos pa med par/ ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag 'di 'dra yod na/gdams ngag yod pa yin te/ lho brag mar pas/ bsgom de sangs rgyas kun la yod/ /ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin/ /gsungs so/ /'di lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo ni gzhan 'bad rtsol gyis bsgoms na sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'i/ lam 'og ma'i gang zag blo chung ba'i rigs la gsang dgos pa ni gdams ngag la skyon yong nas gsang dgos pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang ma gsang na blo chung de dag gis 'di'i dgongs pa mi lon par log lta skyes nas chos spong gi las bsog nyen yod pas shin tu gsang dgos te/ thal 'gyur gyi rgyud las/ gnas lugs 'dug tshul 'di lta bu/ /bshad na nyan thos rang rgyal kyang / /rab tu skrag ste brgyal bar 'gyur/ /des na mchog tu gsang bar bya/ /zhes dang /rin po che spungs pa'i rgyud las/ tshig 'di dag ni nyan thos dang rang rgyal la sogs pa'i nang du rdul tsam yang brjod par 179

ma byed cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rnams kyis tshig 'di kun thos pas skrag pa dang / dngangs pa dang brgyal bar 'gyur te/gsang sngags la mi mos te yid dbyung nas de'i rnam par smin pas sems can dmyal ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas na/ bstan zhing thos pa lta ci smos te/ rlung phyogs tsam du yang brjod par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na gdams pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di lta bu ni mnyam med jo bo/ blo bzang grags pa yab sras sogs skyes mchog thams cad kyi lkog nor khyad par can yin pas/ dam pa de dag sogs la nang don gyi gdams pa 'di med par rang gzhan kun gyis ma sems shig /smras pa/ sngon byon grub thob pho mo mkha' lding gis/ /snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa'i 'dab gshog rgyangs/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i g.yang sa rab bcad nas/ /kun mkhyen mkha' klong yangs par 'phur shul du/ /kha mig yar blta skal bzang khyung phrug rnams/ /'jig rten chos brgyad sgong shun rdog rdzis thongs/ /dben pa'i brag la mjug sgro legs gtod la/ /zung 'jug 'dab gshog rgyongs la da 'phur cig /ces pa bar skabs su glu ru blangs pa'o/ /yang slob bu bstan 'dzin ras pa na re/ gdams ngag de bdag cag la shin tu phan pa zhig byung /180

de ltar gnas lugs skyong dus/ rnam rtog lam khyer sger du dgos sam mi dgos zhes dris pa'i lan du/ 'o de lta bu'i gnas lugs khyab brdal zang thal klong yangs chen po'i ngang la blo lhod kyis glod nas mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na rba rlabs chu bur byung dus rgya mtsho sngar ltar g.yo ba med par gnas na rba rlabs ji ltar che yang rang tshugs mi thub par gar song med par rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du thim nas gcig kyang mi mthong ba ltar/ rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang mnyam gzhag gi ngang la sngar bzhin g.yo ba med par gnas na rnam rtog ji ltar mang yang gcig gis kyang rang tshugs mi thub par gar song cha med par mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyengs su dag nas gcig kyang mi mthong bar gnas lugs kyi ngang du gnas pa 'byung ste/ rgyud las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ltar/ /sems kyi rba rlabs g.yo ba kun/ /gdod ma gzhi yi rgya mtshor thim/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du byeng rmugs gnyid gsum byung yang gnas lugs kyi ngang la sngar bzhin bzhag pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar byas na rnam rtog lam khyer zhes sger du mi dgos/mnyam gzhag 'di ka rnam rtog gi gnyen po yin te/ rje mi las/sems nyid bsgom du bde lags na/ /rnam rtog sems kyi cho 181

'phrul yin/ /sems nyid rang gi ngang du zhog /ces dang / o rgyan chen pos/ 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang / /sngon bsu rjes gcod blo yis bcos mi bya/ /'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol/ /gsungs/ yang dper na dar seng la kha ba babs pa dang / glang chen la tsher ma zug pa dang / khang stong du khyi rkun zhugs pa rnams la ched gnyer gyis rtsol ba med pa ltar/ nyon mongs rnam rtog gang shar yang shar 'dug snyam pa'i 'dzin pa mi bya/ 'gog dgos snyam pa'i rtsol ba mi bya/ gang ltar shar yang rjes su mi 'brang bar shar ba dang sngar ltar shes pa rang sar glod nas/gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzhag na/ rnam rtog shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam ste/ rig 'dzin shri sirnya'i zhal nas/ ma shar ma shar shar shar shar ma zhen/ /shar grol dus mnyam shar grol dus mnyam mo/ /gsungs/ yang dper na sbrul gyi mdud pa kho rang gis bshig pa ltar/ rnam rtog gang shar yang sems nyid rang gi ngang du bzhag pas/ gzhan gyis 'bad rtsol gnyen po cung zad tsam yang bsten mi dgos par rang sar grol bar 'gyur te/rgyud las/ ji ltar shar ba'i rig pa rnams/ /sbrul mdud bzhin du rang grol lo/ /gsungs/ yang dper na nam mkha' la/ shar 182

lho nub byang nas rlung ci byung yang / 7nam mkha' g.yo ba med par gnas na rlung gis nam mkha' mi bsgrib cing / bya che chung gang 'phur ba'i jes de ma thag med par song nas nam mkha' bar mi chod pa ltar/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas dus/ rnam rtog gang shar yang 'dzin pa med par bzhag na/ rnam rtog gis mnyam bzhag mi bsgrib cing rnam rtog brgya stong shar yang ting nge 'dzin gyi bar mi chod pas/ des na gang shar la 'dzin pa med par lam du 'khyer shes na/ rnam rtog gis phan gnod gang yang mi 'byung / bsgom la 'phel 'grib mi srid pas rtag tu gnas lugs kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa man ngag gi gnad dam pa yin te/ mkha' 'gro'i snying thig las/ yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i mdangs yin zhog /gsungs so/ /mdor na mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid 'di kho na bskyangs na/'di ka nyon mongs rnam rtog byeng rmugs gnyid gsum sogs spang bya mtha' dag gi gnyen po bla na med pa yin no/ /smras pa/ mdo rgyud man ngag go mtshon mang thogs kyang / /nyon mongs dgra mi thul ba'i mi des ci/ /bla ma'i man ngag 183

mtshon rnon gcig gis kyang / /nyon mongs dgra rnams thul ba'i dpa' bo dgos/ /bde chen thang la yengs 'dod slob bu rnams/ /lta ba'i mtshon rnon mdung ring lag tu thogs/ /sems kyi mkhar bo che yi sgo 'gags nas/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams gang byung cham la phob/ /ces par skabs su glu ru blangs pa'o/ /yang slob bu bstan 'dzin 'gyur med na re/ de ltar bsgom na snying rje skye 'am mi skye zhes dris pa'i lan du/ de yang chos kun rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal zang thal khyab brdal chos dbyings chen po'i ngang la nyin mtshan med par bzhag pas/rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i pham sems can yongs la rang bzhin shugs kyis bcos ma ma yin pa'i kun khyab snying rje chen po skye ba chos nyid yin te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ stong nyid dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /dmigs med snying rje'i 'bras bu 'byung / /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/ byang chub sems dpas mnyam gzhag pa'i/ /goms pa'i stobs kyis rdzogs pa na/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa la/ /khyad par du yang snying rje skye/ /zhes dang / pha dam pa rgya gar gyis/ stong nyid rtogs pa dang snying rje skye ba dus mnyam gsungs/rje rdo rje rgyal pos/ byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa'i dus/ /184

rang srog gcod pa'i dgra la yang / /ma yi 'du shes yang yang 'byung / /gsungs/ de lta bu'i stong nyid snying rje can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ 'gro don byas na 'grub ste/ rje mi las/ stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro don 'grub/ /gsungs/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de kun gyis phyag bya ba'i gnas yin te/ klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ de 'dra'i skal bzang bde gshegs rig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bor btud nas phyag byas 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /gsungs/ /smras pa/ gnas lugs stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa yi/ /nyon mongs lho sprin rab rib dag gyur na/ /snying rje'i nyi ma phyogs ris med par 'char/ /'gro kun pad tshal skyong ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /stong nyid snying rje'i gru chen la brten nas/ /'gro kun mgron po 'khor ba'i chu bo las/ /sgrol la skyo ngal med par brtson pa yi/ /sngar med rnal 'byor mnyan pa byung na mtshar/ /185

zhes bar skabs su glu ru blangs pa'o/ /yang slob bu bzod pa chos 'phel na re/ de ltar gnas lugs kyi rgyun bskyangs na skabs shig mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo rnams mthong ngam mi mthong zer ba'i lan du/ de yang 'khor 'das yongs la khyab cing shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i ngos nas/ nam mkha' lta bu rab tu gsal zhing dwangs la bsgrib med sna tshogs 'char ba'i ngos nas/ dri bral shel dkar gyi me long lta bu mtha' dang gting dpag par dka' ba'i ngos nas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po lta bu ngos bzung bza' gtad dang bral ba'i ngos nas bar snang dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu'i don dam spros bral byang chub kyi sems stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal rgya yan khyab brdal klong yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ skabs shig rig pa dwangs snyigs phyes nas mnyam gzhag gsal ba byung ba'i tshe/ rang gi skyes pa'i pha yul sogs sngar 'dris che ba dang / rgya dkar nag sogs sngar cha med pa'i yul dang / yang sngar gyi pha ma sogs 'dris che ba dang / lha 'dre sogs sngar rgyus med pa dang / phyogs bcu'i zhing khams sangs rgyas byang sems sogs rim gyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gsal bar mthong ste/ sngon rje btsun mi las mnyam 186

gzhag gi ngang nas/ ras chung pa rgya gar du byon dus gar phebs gzigs shing / tshur phebs dus bsu ba mdzad pa dang / ras chung pas nyin gcig mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas spyir srid pa'i rtsa rtse kun gzigs shing / sgos rje btsun mi las gnya' nam grogs phug na slob ma rnams la chos 'chad pa sogs ci mdzad gzigs pa byung / de'i tshe rje btsun mi las/ ras chung pas de ltar gzigs pa mkhyen nas/ da ni nga yi bu ras chung pa yang phyag rgya chen po'i gdon gyis smyos tshar 'dug sogs gsungs/yang rje btsun gyis/ ngas mgo bo btums pas rgyangs mig mthong / /'jig rten mig bltas cer re long / /zhes dang / ltad mo sems la blta dus su/ 7 /bsam yas ltad mos ci la phan/ /gsungs/ des na rgyun tu sems la blta dgos/ ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo mthong dgos/ mthong ba la ma zhen dgos/ zhen 'dzin med par bskyang na skabs shig 'khor 'das sems su rdzogs/sems nyid chos skur gtan srid zin nas/ bya ba thams cad tshar ba 'byung ste/ rje mi las/ lha rnams kun gyi dam pa mchog /rang sems chos skur mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nyid mthong na 'khor 'das kyi/ /ltad mo thams cad mthong ba yin/ /bya ba thams cad tshar ba yin/ /gsungs so//187

smras pa/ chos dbyings khyab brdal klong de gu re yangs/ /gu yangs blo bde'i ngang nas glu zhig len/ /'khor 'das yongs la ltad mo blta 'dod na/ /gzhan la ma blta rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems la byung gnas 'gro gsum e 'dug ltos/ /gnas 'gyu rig gsum stong ngam mi stong ltos/ /stong pa nyid la ngos bzung e 'dug ltos/ /ngos bzung med na mtha' dbus e 'dug ltos/ /mtha' dang dbus med sems nyid mkha' las yangs/ /phyi nang zang thal rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /sems nyid khyab brdal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / /nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' dbus med par zhog /nyi zla bzhin du gsal 'grib med par zhog /bar snang ngos ltar ngos bzung med par zhog /bzhag na 'khor 'das chos kun sems la 'char/ /glu 'di thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces slar yang glu ru blangs nas gdams pas khong rnams dga' mgu yi rang ba'i ngang nas phyag du ma byas/ rang rang gi bsam gtan gyi khang par song nas gnas lugs kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar gyur to/ /yang skal ldan gye slob bu blo bzang sbyin pa dang / bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gnyis kyis lha rdzas dri med phul nas/ bdag cag gnyis la 'chi kha 'am bar dor grol zhing phyi mar dag zhing du bgrod pa'i 188

zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bla ma rje/ /rje btsun khyed kyis dang po'i dus/ /dus kun bla ma du ma bsten/ /bsten nas thos bsam sgro 'dogs bcad/ /bar du dka' spyad snying rus byas/ /dben par rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /lam rtags yon tan sna tshogs bcas/ /ring min sku gsum mngon du gyur/ /tha ma da lta bsgrubs 'bras kyis/ /phyogs 'di'i skye dgus thog drangs pa'i/ /skal bzang gdul bya ma lus pa/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam la bkod/ /khyed kyi phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rnam thar bshad na brjod mi langs/ /de phyir khyed kyi zhabs pad la/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang 'dud/ /da ni bla ma rin po che/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /slob bu kun gyi tha shal ba/ /bdag cag rdo rje spun gnyis po/ /blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung / /na so rgas shing 'chi la nye/ /mang po bslab kyang shes pa dka'/ /gal te shes kyang bsgom long med/ /khyod kyis bdag cag bu slob la/ /dbu rdzogs phyag chen gcod yul sogs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa ngo mtshar can/ /thos pa tsam gyis nyams dga' zhing / /zhe blo bde ba mang gsungs kyang / /de yi nang nas 'chi kha ru/ /grol byed 'od gsal lta ba dang / /bar dor grol thabs bskyed rim 189

dang / /dag zhing bgrod pa'i zhing sbyong rnams/ /sngon chad rgyas par mang gsungs kyang / /da dung bdag cag blo dman gnyis/ /phyin chad mi brjed dran pa'i tho/ /ma shes dus su gsal 'debs dang / /'chi khar bsam na blo bde ba'i/ /zhal gdams shin tu gsal ba zhig /rab tu brtse bas gsung du gsol/ /bdag cag rdo rje spun gnyis po/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /khyed las lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan med/ /khyed kyis 'bral med thugs rjes zungs/ /nam zhig 'chi ba byung ba'i dus/ /mgon khyod mdun du mngon sum byon/ /'chi ba chos sku'i gsal 'debs mdzod/ /'chi ba chos skur ma grol na/ /bar do longs skur bsgyur grogs mdzod/ /gal te bar dor ma grol na/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes zer ba'i lan du/ 'o skal ldan bu gnyis rgyas par sngar bshad zin pa de ka lags/ da ni dran tho lta bu 'di la gyis zhes tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ dad pa brtan zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /shes rgyud 'jam zhing ngang ring po/ /slob bu blo bzang sbyin pa dang / /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rnam gnyis la/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /phyi mar phan pa'i zhal gdams ster/ /gser srang stong las 'di nyid lhag /ma yengs rna ba'i 190

dbang po nyon/ /tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /'jig rten phyi mar 'gro grab gyis/ /'chi ba chos skur grol ba'i phyir/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang la zhog /bar do longs skur grol ba'i phyir/ /snang stong lha yi bskyed rim sgoms/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i phyir/ /rigs lnga'i zhing sbyong yang yang gyis/ /de ltar byas na 'chi ba'i tshe/ /gang la bsam yang babs mi brdal/ /mang po thob 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag snying la chongs/ /zhes smras pas/ sbyin pa na re/ de yang mi brjed pa'i dran tho shin tu bka' drin che ba byung yang / nged blo rmongs dran brjed che phyin chad ma shes pa 'dra byung na gsal 'debs su 'gro ba cung 'di las rgyas pa zhig gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du/ yang 'di skad ces smras so/ /chos kun ngo bo gdod nas stong / /stong bzhin snang ba rmi lam 'dra/ /rmi lam sems las byung ba ltar/ /chos kun rang gi sems las byung / /sems kyi gnas lugs gdod ma nas/ /mkha' ltar stong gsal 'dzin pa med/ /mtha' bral chos dbyengs chen po yi/ /klong du lhod kyis glod la zhog /mkha' la sprin phung 'khrig pa'i tshe/ /rlung gis bskyod nas gtor ba ltar/ /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum byung ba'i dus/ /lta stangs rig pa gsal ngar thon/ /mkha' ltar rgya bskyed dpangs bstod 191

la/ /khyab brdal gu yangs yan par zhog /byeng rmug gnyid gsum rang sar dwangs/ /mnyam bzhag bsgrib med mkha' ltar gsal/ /rba rlabs rgya mtshor shar ba bzhin/ /rnam rtog gang shar sems kyi rtsal/ /rgya mtsho gnas na rba rlabs zhi/ /de bzhin sems nyid stong gsal gyi/ /ngang du zhog dang rnam rtog yal/ /gnas lugs ngang du bzhag pa dang / /rnam rtog rang sar grol ba dang / /gnas lugs rang sa zin pa gsum/ /snga phyi med par dus mnyam 'ong / /de ltar tshe 'dir nyams blangs nas/ /mnyam gzhag legs po 'byongs tsa na/ /nam zhig 'chi ba byung ba'i dus/ /'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho na re/ 'o de bka' drin che bar byung / da dung de lta bu'i bskyed rim gyi gsal 'debs shig kyang gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du/ /smras pa/ rang lus snod bcud stong par sbyongs/ /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /me long nang du gzugs shar bzhin/ /'byung bzhi rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang / /de dbus rang nyid yi dam lha'i/ /gsal snang nga rgyal brtan po byas/ /de yi thugs shar sngags 'phreng sgoms/ /de las 'od zer lha mo spros/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /byen rlabs 'od zer rnam par 192

byung / /rang la thim pas sdig sgrib dag /lha dang khyad med nus pa thob/ /'od 'phros snod bcud yongs la phog /ma dag nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ /snod rnams yongs rdzogs gzhal yas khang / /bcud rnams lhar gyur sgra grags sngags/ /dran rtogs thugs su gyur par mos/ /grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /rjes su stong pa nyid du bsdus/ /stong pa'i ngang las lha ru ldang / /bsngo smon bkra shis gang shes bya/ /de ltar tshe 'dir bsgom nus na/ /'chi ba chos skur ma grol rung / /bar do'i skabs kyi yid lus de/ /sbyangs nas lha ru bsgoms tsa na/ /bar do longs skur grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas/ /sbyin pa na re/ nyung ba go bde ba zhig byung / da dung zhing sbyongs byed tshul la yang de 'dra zhig thugs rjes gzigs zhes zer ba'i lan du smras pa/ rang nyid 'od kyi lam la zhugs/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro yis/ /lam sna drangs nas mngon dga' sogs/ /rigs lnga'i zhing du rim gyis song / /sangs rgyas de dag thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa phul bas mnyes/ /phyag g.yas brkyangs nas mgo la bzhag /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung byon nas/ /byang chub lung bstan thob par mos/ /nam zhig rang nyid shi ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams de rnams su/ /'gro dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang / /smon lam 193

dag pas 'tshams sbyor gyis/ /de ltar tshe 'dir sbyangs gyur na/ /bar do longs skur ma grol rung / /skye ba sprul sku dag zhing nas/ /'dzin snyam dag zhing yid la byas/ /song na zhing khams de rnams kyi/ /gang rung zhig la sleb par nges/ /sleb ma thag tu pad+mo las/ /rdzus te skye ba len par nus/ /blangs nas sangs rgyas chos nyan te/ /nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas tshe/ /ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba rnams/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur/ /zhes smras so/ /khong gnyis na re/ yang nged tsho las ngan dkor sgrib che ba'i dbang gis zhing khams de rnams bgrod pa'i skal ba ma byung na ci 'dra zhig bya dgos zer ba'i lan du/ /smras pa/ gal te sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /dag zhing bgrod par ma nus na/ /bar do dus su mngon shes dang / /dzu 'phrul yod pas rgya bod nas/ /rigs mtho chos la dkar ba yi/ /pha ma btsal nas rnyed pa'i tshe/ /pha ma gnyis ka rdo rje 'chang / /yum gyi mngal te gzhal yas khang / /de dbus rnam shes 'jug rten la/ /hūṃ yig phra mo gsal bar sgoms/ /de nas smon lam 'di skad gdab/ /bla ma rnams kyi byen rlabs dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag ni pha ma 'di gnyis la/ /brten nas dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /mi la bzhad pa rdo rje bzhin/ /194

chos byas tshe gcig lus gcig la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byas/ /gzhan don mdzad pa mthar phyin shog /snyam du 'dun pa drag po yis/ /rang sems hūṃ la 'jug par bya/ /de ltar byas na bar srid 'gags/ /ma yi mngal du 'jug par nus/ /zhugs nas mi lus rin chen thob/ /rten der sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas/ khong gnyis kyis da ni bka' drin che zer tshig gi gtang rag phul phyag byas/ dga' zhing spro bzhin du rang gnas khang chung du song ngo /yang 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i slob bu sde ba dbang pos ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod zhig gsungs dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran/ /'gro kun drin can pha mar shes/ /rang gzhan don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob 'dod shugs drag skyes/ /thob phyir mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /zab rgyas chos la thos bsam mdzad/ /de nas tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad/ /ming don mthun pa'i bya btang byas/ /rtse la sprin dkar gzhon nu lding / /rked la na bun dngul mdog 'khril/ /rtsa ba spang ljongs me tog bkra/ /ri dwags ma bus rtse bro brdungs/ /bung bas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /bya bye'u dga' zhing 'phyo la lding / /nyams dga' rig pa 195

dwangs pa yi/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gcig pur drang srong bzhin du gnas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan don gnyis tshe 'dir grub/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod cig /rjes 'jug rnams la gsung du gsol/ /rje btsun khyed bzhin bdag cag kyang / /ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /kun gyis ri khrod dben pa ru/ /chos bzhin byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o spyir 'dus byas 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos thams cad zlos gar dang dri za'i grong khyer ltar/ skad cig kyang mi rtag par rnam par g.yo zhing 'gyur ba'i tshul la yid skyo/khyad par khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin ma gtogs/ bde ba'i go skabs khab rtse gang yang med par shes pas nges 'byung dang skyo shas rnams kun tu brjed pa med par rang shugs kyis shar nas/ ri klung nags 'dab la rgyu ba'i glang chen rgyal po'i skyed tshal du bkug nas/nor bu'i dra bas g.yog kyang dga' bar mi 'gyur ba/ de ltar bcos pa'i khang bzang du gdan mthon por lus dar zab kyi sbubs su bzhag nas zhal ja chang gi ngang la nyin mtshan 'da' bar byas kyang de la nam yang dga' bar mi 'gyur bar/ 'jig 196

rten chos brgyad kyi 'dor len rnams mthong na skyugs nad can la zas bstan pa ltar/ mngon zhen gting nas log nas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi yong bar ji ltar sos ga'i nyi ma phyed kyi dus su skyes bu skom pas gdungs shing 'gro bas chu snying la 'dod nas/ phyogs kun tu chu 'tshol zhing rnyed ma thag ngoms pa med par 'thungs pa ltar/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pas yid gdungs chos dang bla ma snying la 'dod nas/ phyogs gang du 'tshol zhing mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rnyed ma thag bsam pa dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten nas/ zhal nas byung ba'i zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms med du lo zla ba byas 'thungs shing / de nas sdug bsngal du mas gdungs shing nyam thag pha ma sems can thams cad kyi don du thob bya bla med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi blo shugs drag po'i ngang nas/ rgyab ri mtho zhing rtse la sprin dkar rgyun du lding ba/ nyi ma snga mor 'char zhing dgung mo nub pa'i nyi tshe ring ba/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs rab dkar rdo yi 'bab stegs na/ 'bab chu gtsang mas shin tu bsil bsil 'thung 'thung zer ba ltar/snyan pa'i sgra si li li sgogs shing 'bab pa/ lo 'dabs me tog 197

'bras bu yongs su mdzes pa'i ljon shing la/ dri bzhon yor bus btab tshe chos pa thams cad gnas 'dir shog ces lag pas g.yob pa ltar/ yal 'dab rnams rgyang nas phyogs kun bskyod pa/ res 'ga' ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la lus po 'di bzhin sdod dgos zer ba ltar g.yo 'gul med par sdod cing / bya btang ri khrod pa la 'bol stan gyi ched du btings pa ltar sa gzhi thams cad la shing lo gsar rnying du ma brtsegs nas yod pa/ bsam gtan pa spro ba'i mchod sprin gyi ched du me tog sna tshogs pa gsar du kha phye 'dra'i dri bzang 'thul zhing 'dzum dgod byed pa'i rab mdzes me tog du mas khor yug gang ba/ me tog ra ba na sbrang rtsi'i ros myos pa'i bung ba mang pos dga' ba'i 'phur lding g.yo zhing snyan la ring ba'i glu di ri ri len pa/ljon shing gi ra bas bskor ba'i nang na nyi ma'i mdangs kyis gsal bar byas pa'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar snyoms pa la/ g.yu dang bai ḍūr+ya'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i sngo ljang rtswa 'jam po skyes pa'i steng na ri dwags kun bag phebs su rgyu zhing brtse ba/ lngon shing gi ra ba rnams su bya dang bye'u mang po dga' zhing phyogs la lding zhing skad snyan sgrogs pa/ lha yul skyed mos tshal mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i shin tu nyams dga'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas 198

mchog tu gom pa bdun tsam spos kyang bsod nams che ste/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ rab tu byung nas chos spyod ci 'dra bar/ /zas dang skom dang byug pa gos rnams dang / /me tog spos dang 'phreng ba rnams kyis ni/ /khyu mchog rgyal la bsnyen bkur byas mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer byed cing / /'dus byas ngan la yid 'byung sems kyis ni/ /dgon par phyogs de gom pa bdun bor ba/ /'di ni de bas bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / mdo gzhan las/ dgon pa bsams nas gom pa bdun bor na/ /de ni sa bdun bar du 'phags par 'gyur/ /gsungs so/ /des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / gzhon nu'i dus su dam pa'i chos la thos bsam byas nas/ na tshod cung zad yol nas/ spang ri rdo ba dang 'dres pa'i bar bar na/ se ba'i shing sogs kyi tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dang / spen ma la sogs me tog can gyi shing mang po'i dra ba 'dzengs pa'i gseb na rtswa phung sngo seng nge sgyes pa ljon shing gi dra ba'i gseb na bya dang bye'u tshang byas shing / rtsa ba na ri bong sogs ri dwags snyom chung gis mal sa bzung nas bag phebs par gnas pa/ kha lho lta dgun nyi 'od 'khyil zhing dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa/ chu me shing 'dzom zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub sla ba'i 199

dben pa'i dga' tshal gye rang shong gi spyil po nyams dgar drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gcig pur gnas pa'i skal ba zhig byung na shin tu'ang bde ste/ so thar gyi mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / mdo gzhan las/ su dag nags khrod mngon par dga' ba yi/ /dge sbyong de ni shin tu bde ba myong / /gsungs/ tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong so nam rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi che ba'i grong dang dgon chen sogs nas dge ba dpag med bsgrub pa bas/ 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba gangs ri chen po ti se rang byung shel gyi mchod rten lta bu rtse mo la na bun gdugs ltar phub nas kha char me tog rgyun du 'babs pa ri ngos la nus pa can gyi sman dang dri zhim 'byung ba'i spos dang /me tog sna tshogs skye zhing rna ba dang lha bya gong mo sogs bya ri dwags kun 'khor ba/ rtsa ba na dad gus can gyi yon bdag pho mos phyag bskor mchod pa 'bul zhing chos bzhin byed pa la mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i dben gnas khyad par can 'di dang 'di 'dra'i gnas su dge sbyor med par nyal nus na yang don che ste/sbyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ 'du 'dzir dge ba dpag med sgrub pa bas/ /dben par nyal nas sdod pa ches dga' ste/ /200

sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bde ba'i rgya mtsho gnyis/ /'dams kha ma nor dgos so shākya'i sras/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul gyi dge sbyor brgya bas/ /dben pa'i dge sbyor gcig dga'/ /des na ri la song la/ /gang nus dge la 'bod cig /gsungs/de yang tha mal skye bos 'du long med par shin tu dben pa'i bste gnas/ me tog 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i ljon shing dang /'bab chu yod pa rtswa sngon pos khebs pa'i spang gshongs la dri ngad ldang ba'i me tog sna tshogs skyes pa/ khor yug kun na zos na ro mngar ba'i za tshod sogs sngo yi kha zas mod cing / bya ri dwags pho mo zung du 'brel nas bag phebs rgyu zhing skad snyan 'byin pa shin tu nyams dga'/ rig pa dwangs pa'i dam pas byin rlabs dben pa'i ri sul gyi rang shong bsam gtan gyi khang chung gi nang du 'khod nas/ sngon gye sgyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ltar lto gos gtam gsum la gyong bskur nas/ bla mas gnang ba'i zab rgyas gdams pa nyams su len rgyu'i skal ba dang ldan na tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas te/ mdo las/sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /gang du mya ngan 'das gyur pa/ /kun gyis dgon pa rab dben du/ /bla med byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 201

'byams pas/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /grub thob gong ma'i yon tan yang / /dben pa bsten las 'byung bar gsungs/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /gsungs so/ /skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi grong dang ha cang thag mi nye ba'i nags tshal/ ri dwags sna tshogs bag yangs su rgyu ba/ 'bab chu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dus su me tog sna tshogs 'char ba/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs kyis skad snyan par 'byen pa chu bsil zhing dwangs pa'i rdzing bu 'khyel ba/ kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i shing 'bras dus su smin pa/ rtswa ser 'jam mnyen shing ldem por skyes pas khebs shing nyams dga' snang ba spro ba'i dben pa'i gnas shig tu tshe 'di'i spyod yul gang la yang ma chags par rang nyid gcig pur 'khod nas/ nyams len byed rgyu'i skal pa zhig nam 'ong na snyam pa'i yid smon byed pa yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ nags na bya dang ri dwags dang / /shing dag mi snyan brjod mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig bdag gnas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bu mo bdun gyi rtog brjod las/ shing drung ne tso ltar ljang bas/ /dur ba 'jam po'i gos can du/ /mthong chos bde ba'i dga' ston dang / /nam zhig bdag ni nyal bar 'gyur/ /202

zhes dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ yul 'dod yon 'ching bas ma bcing bar/ /gnas nyams su dga' ba'i dben pa'i tshal/ /don bsam sgom rnal 'byor lhur len par/ /mi kho bos snying nas yid smon 'cha'/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ don de phyir pad+mo'i dra ba yis/ /steng mdzes par khebs pa'i yid bzhin mtsho/ /rgyangs mig la babs pa'i ngang ba bzhin/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal snying nas dran/ /zhes dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtshos/ grogs bzang po 'ga' re ri na bzhugs/ /ri shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rang gcig bur drang srong spyod la gnas/ /'di bsam zhing bsam zhing smon pa skyes/ /zhes dang / rje btsun shākya rin chen gyis/nags nang me tog 'khrigs shing lding ba'i khrod/ /shing lo'i gnas mal bsten nas zhe ba'i don/ /rtse gcig sems pa'i dga' bde de lta bu/ /lha yi skyed tshal la yang yod pa min/ /ngal dub yongs spangs skye bos dben pa'i sar/ /rtsod dang 'thab mo rmongs dang chags pa yis/ /gdungs pa bskyed pa'i nor dang ldan min par/ /gcig pur spyod pa nam zhig yongs snyam sems/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la ri bo gnam la snyegs 'dra'i rtse mo dang /203

phrag gong na sprin dkar gzhon nu gdugs dang ba dan ltar mdzes shing sked pa na na bun dngul mdog dar gyi yol ba ltar bres pa/ rtsa ba na lha yul skyed mos tshal ltar spang gshongs ne'u gsing sngo 'jam la yid 'ong mjes pa'i me tog sna tshogs bkra ba/ ri ngos na 'brog pa'i sgo phyugs zas la bkram pa ltar/ sha ba dang rna ba dgo ba sogs spu sdug ri dwags du ma khyu khyu byas rgyu ba/rtswa shing sna tshogs skye ba'i rtswa rtse na khu byug dang 'jol mo sogs bya bye'us skad snyan du ma sgogs bzhin du gnas pa/ sos ka 'dod pas myos pa'i gzhon nu dang na chung mdzes ma nags nang du 'khod nas brtse dga' skyongs shing glu len pa ltar/ sbrang rtsi'i chang gis myos pa'i bung ba'i kha yis me tog la bsnun zhing 'dar ba'i skad kyis zir zir gyi glu len pa/ lha yi bu mos dga' ba'i co 'dri byed pa bzhin/ ri ye ngogs na bsil ba'i chus chal chil gyi sgra sgogs bzhin 'bab pa/ tshad pas gdungs pa'i dus su ri zur du phyin na lha yi bsil yab kyis g.yab pa ltar/ rlung bsil bur ldang ba bsil ba'i bde ba ngang gis ster ba'i phun sum tshogs pas dben pa'i gnas su dam pa'i chos gyes zhes yang yang gsungs te/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ grong dang grong khyer dag la dga' spong la/ /rtag tu dben pa'i nags 204

khrod bsten par gyis/ /bse ru lta bur rtag tu gnyis med byos/ /ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang /jo bo rjes/ sems la gnod pa'i yul dang thag bsring rtag tu dge ba 'phel sar sdod/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du 'du 'dzis gnod pas dben pa'i nags khrod bsten/ /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ sna tshogs 'dam skyes dpag med gcal du bkram/ /rkang drug ldan rnams mang pos sgra dbyangs sgogs/ /snyan pa'i dar dir sgogs par byed pa yi/ /dben gnas dam pa bsten dang rgyal khams pa/ /zhes dang / klong chen rab 'byams kyis/e ma dad ldan thar pa 'dod pa dag /gsang chen bla med don la rab zhugs nas/ /gcig pur dben par sgrub pa snying por mdzod/ /tshe 'dir chos sku'i gtan srid zin pa legs/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib/ /rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye/ /dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang / 'chad kha pa'i zhal nas/ dka' thub kyi ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas pa zhig byung na gzod phas bu gsos bya ba yin gsungs/des na dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la kha mig yar blta 205

byas/ gsung rdo rje'i tshig rnams dang du blangs nas tshe 'di'i 'khri ba thams cad rbad kyis bcad nas/ dam pa gong mas bsngags shing smon pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su hrul po'i gos gyon zhing / ngan ngon gyi zas zos nas rang la sngar bla mas zab rgyas gdams pa gang bstan pa de nyams su len pa la nyin mtshan med par brtson par gyis shig /smras pa/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal legs bsams nas/ /bla ma'i zhabs bsten zab rgyas gdams pa blangs/ /'gro kun don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob 'dod bsam pas kun blangs nas/ /rgyab ri mtho zhing rtse la sprin dkar lding / /sa phyogs gtsang ma'i rdo yi 'bab stegs na/ /'bab chu gtsang mas 'thung 'thung zer ba ltar/ /lhung lhung skad snyan sgrogs bzhin chad med 'bab/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bus yongs mdzes pa'i/ /ljon shing dri bzhon bser bus bskul ba'i mod/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom rnams 'dir shog ces/ /lag pa g.yob ltar yal 'dab phyogs kun bskyod/ /res 'ga' ting 'dzin bsgom dus 'di ltar du/ /sdod dgos zer ltar g.yo ba med par gnas/ /ri khrod pa la 'bol stan bting ba ltar/ /sa gzhi kun la shing lo du ma brtsegs/ /bsam gtan pa la mchod 206

sprin bsgrigs pa ltar/ /dri ldan me tog gsar bas khor yug gang / /sbrang rtsi'i chang gis myos pa'i bung ba yis/ /'phur lding g.yo zhing snyan pa'i dar dir sgrogs/ /sngo ljang rtswa najam skyes pa'i sa gzhi la/ /lus mdzes ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu/ /ljon shing yal gar bya dang byi'u'i tshogs/ /dga' zhing 'phyo la lding zhing skad snyan 'byin/ /lha yul skyed tshal mi yul 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gom bdun spos kyang bsod nams rgya cher thob/ /song nas bsdad na bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /nyams len byas na bla med byang chub brnyes/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi slob bu rnams/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba thams cad rbad kyis chod/ /nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i ri khrod du/ /rgyab tu gzhan la mi mkho'i gos gyon zhing / /kha ru gang byung ngan ngon bza' btung byas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ /nyin mtshan med par rab tu 'bad 'tshal lo/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i skal ldan gye bu chen rtse brgyad bla ma/ bon mo phug gi bla ma sogs/ sa dge rnying 'brug gi chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i tshe blos btang slob ma lnga bcu 207
