lhag tsam la gdams pa/ 'o skal ldan bu kun/ spyir bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis stan pa rin po che 'di las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad/ gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir/ sa dge rnying 'brug 'bri dwags dkar gsum/ zhi byed gcod yul/ jo nang bo dong pa sogs grub pa'i mtha' khyad par can mi 'dra ba mang du byung ba thams cad rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na las chad pa yin pas/ nges don lung rigs la mkhas shing /nyams myong dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas dpyad na thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab ste/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gyi bum bzang las/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ga 'u ma/ /lnga ldan ro snyoms yi ge bzhi/ /zhi byed gcod yul rdzogs chen dang / /dbu ma'i lta khrid la sogs pa/ /so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang / /nges don lung rigs la mkhas shing / /nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ /zhes dang / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ phyag chen rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ /mkhas pas bltas na gcig tu 'dug /blun po chos spong mdzad 'dod rnams/ /so sor phyes la nga yis 208

bsgoms/ /'brug pa kun legs de skad lo/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos rang rang mos pa'i ngo na zab/ /mchog sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ /sa dge ldan gsar rnying kun la yod/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /gsungs/des na khyed rnams kyis gzhan gye chos dang gang zag yongs la nye ring phyogs ris chags sdang gis kun nas bslangs te bzang ngan 'dor len/ brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byen byas chos spong gi las byed mi rung ste/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/rang lugs 'di bden gyis/ chos byed gzhan gyi grub mtha' ni ma rungs pa'o/ /de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu ni gti mug pa'o/ /zhes smod pa ni mdo las gsungs pa'i chos spong gi las/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi bzad pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas srog gi phyir yang de lta bu'i las la 'jug mi nyan gsungs/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis rje bdag nyid chen pos lam gyi rim pa'i che ba bzhi gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs shing / gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char dgos te/ rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad/ 'di 'dra ba ni/ rang cag ri bo dge lugs pa dang / rnying ma pa rgad po rnams dang / sa skya pa sogs 209

mtha' dag dgongs pa mthun pa yin zhes/ thams cad kyi lta ba'i dgongs pa mthun tshul rgyas par gsungs pa'i 'jug tu/rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i man ngag la brten na/ 'di 'dra ba'i bshad pa gu yangs po rgyab chog gsungs so/ /de nas bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' thams cad dgongs pa mthun zhing / kun yang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas/ chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba yongs la dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs pa gnad che ste/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi zhal nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /kun yang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis sdang shugs ma mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ /deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang / /thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /don med kha sdig ma bsog par/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /zhes dang / rgyal dbang rjes/ sems rgyud bsha' ma gcig 'dul na dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs dang / /dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs pas dag pa rab 'byams su 'char ba/ /zhes dang / yang dgon pas/ mdor na mngon shes ma thob bar/ /dam pa su yin mi shes pas/ /su la'ang brnyas pa mi bya zhing / /bzang por blta 210

zhing dag snang sbyangs/ /zhes dang / rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyes/ rang re rnams spyir lus can kun dang / sgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang 'byongs pa zhig gtso bor bya dgos/ zhes dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyis/ spyir lus can kun la bka' drin soms/ /sgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/'phags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar so so'i sgye bo rnams kyi yul las 'das shing / chos dang skyes bu dam pa la brten pa'i sdig pa shin tu mi zad pas/ phyogs 'dzin gyi sdang shugs dor nas dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad du gsol zhes cho sa kyi rgyal mtshan gsol ba 'debs so/ /gsungs/ /smras pa/ ma 'dris mdza' bshes chen po sangs rgyas kyis/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab sems can thams cad la/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa'i/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dpag par dka'/ /kha cig gsung rab dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu/ /'bebs par 'dod kyang gsung rab rgya che'i phyir/ /dgongs pa ma lon 'dor len byed dgos byung / /'dor len shes la mkhas pa su zhig zer/ /gang zag rgyud tshod mtho dman 211

sna tshogs pa'i/ /dbang gis chos lugs mi 'dra sna tshogs yod/ /phan tshul 'gal ba ltar snang thams cad po/ /'dor rgyu yin na mdo sngags gnyis kyis kyang / /nang na 'gal ba ltar snang du ma snang / /de ltar yin na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang / /dgongs 'grel bla ma so so'i man ngag gis/ /nang na 'gal ba ltar snang mang po gda'/ /bod du 'gyur ba'i bka' bstan 'di'i nang na/ /bzang ngan 'dor len mang po zhig yod na/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'gyur tsa na/ /chos spong ci 'dra mdzad dgos thugs bsam thongs/ /kha cig blo gros chung ngus gzhal gzhal nas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab pha mtha' rtogs snyam pa/ /nam mkha' 'dom gyis 'jal nas tshad len zhing / /rdo skas 'dzegs nas nyi ma 'dzin snyam 'dra/ /sman pas sman kun nad pa gcig tsam don/ /ma yin kun gyi don du bsags pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab sems can gcig tsam la/ /gsungs pa ma yin 'gro kun don du gsungs/ /de dag mi gcig rgyud la ma phan yang / /sems can so so'i rgyud la phan che bas/ /mi phan chos shig rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ /de phyir 'dor rgyu'i chos ni gcig kyang med/ /mi gcig blo la 'thad cing rgyud la phan/ /phyogs mthun tsam blangs gzhan ma 'dor rgyus na/ /sangs rgyas 212

bstan pa phal cher bsgrubs pa yin/ /sems can dpag med bde skyid la gnod 'gyur/ /skom pas chu klung rdzogs par ma 'thung yang / /chu 'ga' 'thung bas yid kyang ngoms pa ltar/ /gcig gis chos kun nyams su ma lon yang / /gang mos nyams su blangs pas grol bar 'gyur/ /thams cad nyams su ma blangs mi grol na/ /bod la chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong las/ /cung zad tsam las thams cad ma 'gyur bas/ /da dung bsgyur dgos rgya gar yul du rgyug /sngon byon rgya bod mkhas grub phal mo che /gdams ngag re re tsam gyis rgyud grol ba/ /brgya dgos 'dug na stong yod rnam thar gzigs/ /de rnams grol ba min zhes zer phod dam/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal ba med par rtogs/ /gsung rab gcig kyang ma lus gdams par shar/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag ma rnyed rung / /chos spong nyes spyod g.yang la ma 'chong zhig /e ma chos mthun snying gi slob bu tsho/ /dag snang phyogs med rtse dga' rgod bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud man ngag lam chen la zhugs nas/ /thar ba'i grong khyer nyams dga' da snyogs shig /dam pa'i byin rlabs gnas chen gangs ri nas/ /dam chos byed pa'i tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dam gtsang skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /dam chos de dang de 'dra bstan 213

nas song / /zhes skal ldan slob ma yongs la phan pa'i gdams pa rnams legs par bshad zin to/ /de ltar skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la snga phyi rim pa byas/ gang la gang 'dod kyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyis dga' ston 'gyed pa rnams glegs bam du bkod nas/ kun la lung khrid byas pa'i mjug tu grwa bu slob rnams kyis bka' drin gtang rag tu zang zing nor gyi 'bul ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston byas nas/ bstod tshig snyan pos sngun bsus te mnyam med jo bo chen po'i gsung gi yan lag bdun pa'i smon lam gyis 'tshams sbyor 'di ltar byas so/ /sde snod gsum gye sham bu mdzes/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis mtshan/ /gdul bya lha khang steng na mdzes/ /rje rgyal mtshan lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan phan byang sems rtsal stobs che/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i gom stabs bsgyur/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i khur chen 'khur/ /rje glang chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /tshogs gnyis me shel khams las 'khrungs/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'od stong 'gyed/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sel/ /rje nyi ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /zhu tshig bser bus bskyod nus na/ /rnam dpyod yal 'dab rgyas pa las/ /zhal gdams dri bzang yang yang 'thul/ /rje tsan+dan lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bu 214

slob gser dngul bum bzang du/ /myang grol chos kyi bdud rtsi de/ /ci tsam byo yang 'dzad pa med/ /rje bum bzang lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lung gi chos kyi yal 'dab rgyas/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu smin/ /gdul bya lha bu'i re ba skongs/ /rje dpag bsam lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i g.yu ral rgyas/ /tshad med bzhi yi sder bzhi bgrad/ /rje seṅge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs nas thon/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog sgro rgyas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' la lding / /rje khyung chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /byams dang brtse ba'i sprin phung 'khrigs/ /theg chen chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgogs/ /snyan pa'i char ba phyogs bcur 'bab/ /rje g.yu 'brug lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /khyed kyi mkhyen rab sde mig gis/ /gsung rab rin chen mdzod kyi sgo/ /phyes nas gang 'dod byin pa'i mod/ /rab dga'i sa thob bzhin du spro/ /bka' drin che'o chos kyi rje/ /drin lan bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /da dung byang chub ma thob par/ /'bral med rjes su bzung du gsol/ /tshe(jobo'i gsungs/)rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten/ /phun sum tshogs pa yod gyur nas/ /dkon mchog gsum la sgo gsum gyis/ /phyag dang mchod pas bkur bar shog /215

stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sdig bshags shing / /dge ba kun la yi rang shog /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed pa'i/ /bskul ma drag tu thebs par shog /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed la/ /mi 'da' gsol ba thebs par shog /ji ltar bsngos shing smon pa rnams/ /bsam pa nyid nas 'grub par shog /ces pa dang / gzhan yang phyag dang bcas bsngo ba dang smon lam du mas 'tshams sbyor byas so/ /smras pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel la 'gran pa'i zla bral chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po dang / /ji lta'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pas ji snyed chos kun mkhyen pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / /thos bsam rgya chen mdzad pas gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba'i 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya phrag tsam gyi zhal mthong gsung dbyangs thos pa'i skal ba byung ba bzang / /bla ma rnams kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las thon gdams ngag bdud rtsi rnams/ /dad gus gser gyi snod du blangs nas rnam dpyod ljags kyis ngoms med myang / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud man ngag gter mdzod mang po'i sgo phyes nas/ /gdams ngag rin chen nyer mkho mang po rang rgyud i phrag g.yon par bcug /ngo mtshar zab rgyas 216

gdams pas phyug pa'i mod/ /mi med dben pa'i ri khrod dga' tshal bsnyegs/ /rtse gcig bsgoms pas bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /byang chub sems sogs sngar med nyams rtogs shar/ /tshogs gnyis shing dang pags pa smon lam dag pas 'tshams sbyor las byuje ba'i/ /sgyu lus phyi ldir sems nyid nang stong tshogs drug rang grol rnga bo che/ /bu slob rnams kyis bskul tshig 'jam mnyen dbyug gus dal bus brdungs pa'i mod/ /zab rgyas chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan po 'gag med lhang lhang byung 'di mtshar/ /bdag sems gsal stong kun dga' ra ba na/ /legs bshad zab mo'i glags bam cir yang snang / /nang nas 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i glegs bam 'di/ /skal bzang rnams la ster bas dga' ston mdzod/ /mngon mtho nges legs bde skyed gzhon nu kun/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i zur mig gcig gis kyang / /dbang med 'gugs pa'i gdams ngag lus phra ma/ /'di nyid chos mdzad kun gyis bsten par 'os/ /zab rgyas gdams pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras/ /gdul bya'i rgyud kyi sa gzhi gar btab kyang / /kun mkhyen dpag bsam ljon pa myur 'khrungs nas/ /don gnyis lhun 'grub 'bras bur longs spyod shog /ces 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di nyid 217

kyi tshig don phal che ba/ mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs mi yi gar gyis rnam rol khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i legs bshad zla med/ 'jam dbyangs g.yon gyi pad+ma'i steng gi glegs bam mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i ngo mtshar rmad byung byang chub lam rim chen mo'i nang ltar/ bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis skal ldan gyi bu slob yongs la phan phyir/ yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang / dgra bcom stong dang lnga brgya'i bzhugs gnas/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du sa gnas chen gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se'i shar phyogs dzu 'phrul phug tu sbyar ba'o/ /smras pa/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma'i man ngag gi /snying po 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i glegs bam 'di/ /par du bsgrub mkhan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /gangs can ljongs 'dir nad yams 'khrugs pa sogs/ /bkra mi shis pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /zas nor g.yang 'khyil lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces sgon tshig nyung 'dus 'di yang zhabs dkar pas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐// //218

༄༅ / /bka' gdams sprul ba'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ rab 'byams zhing kun 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'gro kun mngon mtho nges legs go 'phang la /'god mdzad sangs rgyas zhabs rdul spyi bor len/ /mnyam med bu ram shing ba'i lung rtogs kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /'gran gyi do med nyi zla ltar grags pa'i/ /byams mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dzam gling mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub thogs med ces/ /snyan grags srid pa'i ra ba las brgal te/ /nam mkha'i pha mthar son pa gang de mchod/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po kun / /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par bsdus/ /'doms mdzad jo bo chen po'i bka' drin de/ /bsam gyin lag pad chos 'khor ngos su zum/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin chen rnams/ /slar yang lam rim che chung mdzod khang du/ /byur bur spungs mkhas rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i//sku 219

drin bsam gyin bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /ma nor lam rim ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /rang gi ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag /zla med bla ma mchog gi bka' drin rnams/ /bsam gyin rtag tu mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spro/ /deng dus thub bstan nyi ma bod la shar/ /sku gsung thugs rten skar tshogs las kyang bkra/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu ri dang brag pas mang / /de dag kun la'ang yid kyis gus pas 'dud/ /rab 'byams gsung rab dgongs 'grel blta ba'i mig /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me mchog /gang 'dod re skong yid bzhin nor 'dra ba/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam las gzhan na gang / /thos na yid 'phrog bsam na rgyud la phan/ /gcig shes kun grol gnad kyi gdams pa 'di/ /nyams su len pa phar zhog lan gcig tsam/ /thos pa bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras/ /de phyir kun gyis yang yang thos dka' ba'i/ /byang chub lam rim chos kyi rnga bo che/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i dbus su cis mi brdung / /gtam rgyud dbyug gus dal bus brdungs la nyon/ /de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa dang / gsung rab bzhin byas na mngon mtho nges legs 220

kyi bde ba gang 'dod pa rnams lag pas bzos pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar dgongs nas/ gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin jo bo rjes rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya'i don mtha' dag bsdus nas byang chub lam gyi sgron ma mdzad la/ de nyid kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen pos lung rigs kyi lam nas slar gsal bar mdzad pa'i byang chub lam rim chen mo ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /de ji ltar 'chad na/ 'dir lam rim gyi dgongs don rags rim tsam zhig blo dman bdag 'dra'i nyan na tshig don go sla zhing / bsam na rgyud la skye sla ba'i phyir bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po po to ba'i gsung sgos sngar med legs bshad dpe yi lam rim rin chen spungs pa las/ 'o skol gye ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang mgon du gyur pa des/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mtha' mar rdo rje gdan du srod la bdud kyi sde 221

rnams pham par mdzad nas/ dgung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ bka' chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bskor nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad/ de yang 'o skol sems can gyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang bcas par gzigs nas/ de'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' bstsal nas/ rigs can byang chub gsum la bkod/ rigs med lha dang mi la bkod de/ sems can rnams grol zhing thar pa'i lam la bkod pa yin gsungs/ de nas sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'das nas/slob dbon klu sgrub dang thogs med sku mched la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i gang zag kha yar byon/ gzhan yang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang du byon nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin gsungs/ de ltar slob dpon klu sgrub dang thogs med la sogs pa nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad rgyud dang / sgrub rgyud kyi gdams pa bum pa gang byo lta bu jo bo rje lha gcig la mnga' ba lags par gda'/ de yang jo bo rje lha gcig sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/222

yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal gzigs pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gdams ngag thun mong ma yin pa mnga' ba/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi thugs kyis/ gzhan don gtso bor mdzad pa'i yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu des/ 'o skol byang phyogs bod kyi rgyal khams mun pa'i smag rum dang 'dra ba 'dir/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs nas/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i dus su byon/ chos mang po gsungs nas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba 'dra bar mdzad/ bod thams can dkar lam gyis btang ste/'gro ba mang po grol zhing thar pa'i lam la bkod pa lags gsungs/ yang po to ba'i gsung sgros don gyi lam rim be'u bum sngon po las/ spyir jo bo rje lha gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa legs par gtan la phab pa ni byang chub lam gyi sgron ma lags/ de'i don gdams ngag tu gsungs pa dge bshes pa rnams la gsung sgros mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / don la khyad par med pas phan tshun spong len bya mi dgos gsungs/ bka' gdams dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ rong du sngags pa tshan gcig chang phud gtor ba ma phrel ba 223

la/ sngags pa lha mo 'bar bya ba'i chang phud gtor nas/ dkon mchog gsum po bzhes/ chos skyong srung ma bzhes/ dus gsum pha ma bzhes/ 'gro drug sems can bzhes/ da lus rgyu cang gda' 'am zer/ de bzhin du dpal ldan a ti sha'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di la rgyud sde bzhi dang / sde snod gsum gyi don gang yang ma 'dus pa med/ de ltar na jo bo'i man ngag 'di sbyar legs pa lags pas/ 'di la bag re gsol bar zhu/ gsol gyi rting la mi skyugs par zhu/ skyug skyug 'dra na mchil ma dang phus gdab/ rdo brang la brlan/ skra thon pa tshun chad byed par zhu/ de nas da lta kha na mi gsol na yang / phyis gsol ba'i ched du a phrag g.yon kho nar 'jug par zhu/ brul dogs na phugs su yang 'bul bar zhu gsungs/ yang a ti sha'i chos 'di lta bu sngar yang ma byung / da yang yong ste mi yong gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha bo pa'i zhal nas/ skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum la blo sbyong ba 'di sdom pa 'bog bdo ba yang yin/ slob gnyer byed bdo ba yang yin/ 'dir blo 'byongs na nor 'tshol ba'i blo mi skye bas mi thams cad dad yong bas tshogs bsog bdo ba yang yin/ mthun 'jug byed bdo ba yang yin gsungs/ des na chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nying khu/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal 224

med du rtogs pa'i che ba/ gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba'i che ba/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba/ nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i che ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa lta ci smos/ lan gcig thos pa yang skal ba bzang ste/ sngon dge slong u pa ku te bya bas chos 'chad pa'i sgra khyi mo gcig gi rna bas thos pas/ khyi mo sgrib pa bsrabs nas khyi mo de tshe'i dus byas nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skyes/ yang sngon dge slong gcig gi brang khang gi gdung rtsa na bya thi ba gcig nyal zhing yod pas/ dge slong de tho rangs 'phags pa sdud pa zhal 'don mdzad pa'i sgra de yang yang thos pas/ bya thi ba de'i sgrib pa bsrabs nas/ bya de shi ma thag mi lus thob ste/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa zhig byung nas/ rab tu byung bas 'phags pa sdud pa rna bar thos pa tsam gyis slob ma dgos par shes pa zhig byung skad/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis mnyan yod na chos gsungs pa'i rtsa ba na sbal ba gcig yod pa'i rna bar chos kyi sgra thos pa la/ dus gcig gi tshe/ gnag rdzi dga' bo bya ba 'ongs nas khos ma mthong bar sbal ba'i steng du 'khar ba oṃ tshugs byas nas nyan pas/ sbal ba brdzis nas shi ba'i sngar chos thos pa dang /225

de'i tshe chos kyi sgra rna bar lhang lhang yod pa'i 'phro la shi ba'i stabs kyis sbal ba de tshe 'phos ma thag tu sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes/ der skye ba dang gnas gsum la rtog pa 'byung ste/gang nas skyes pa dang / gang du skye ba dang / las gang gis skyes pa gsum la brtags pas/ sngar sbal ba zhig tu skyes pa la/ chos kyi sgra rna bar thos pa tsam gyis lhar skyes par rtogs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' drin rjes su dran te/ lha'i me tog mang po khyer/lha'i bu mang po dang bcas mnyan yod du sangs rgyas mchod du 'ong bas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang / 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad ni bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad ni zhi ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha'i bu des bden par mthong ste/ mnyan yod 'od kyi gang bar byas nas/ slar sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su song ngo / /des na chos la go ba lhang nge ba zhig ma skyes kyang chos kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis kyang / phyi ma la chos kyi bag chags 'jog pas/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod bzang po'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal//de yang slob ma chos kyi snod ldan la 'di lta bu'i chos lan re tsam 'chad pa po yang skal ba ches shin tu bzang ste/ sngon sangs 226

rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob pa lam gyi dus skabs/ thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas chos bstan te gdul bya mang po'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pas mthar sangs rgyas pa yin/de bzhin du bla mas rwakyang gdul bya nyam thag la zas skom sogs sbyin nas tshim par byas/ de nas dam pa'i chos kyi snyan pa smra/ de ltar du spyod du bcug de nas rang yang de dang mthun par byas/ slob ma'i rgyud smin zhing grol bar byas na slob ma la chos bshad pa kho na la brten nas kyang myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur te/ sngon dge slong lha chen po zhes bya bas pha ma bsad/ slob dpon bkrongs nas mkhan slob med pa'i dge slong byas/ chos pa ltar brdzus nas yul gzhan du 'khyams nas/ kho bo dgra bcom pa zhig yin zhes gzhan la chos bstan pas/ slob ma dgra bcom pa mang po byung / phyis kho shi nas dmyal bar skyes pa slob ma dgra bcom pa rnams kyis mthong nas yar bton pa byung / de bzhin du chos ston shes na gzhan dad can la bstan na slob ma bzang po byung tshe bla ma la yang phan pa 'byung / sngon rje btsun mi las/ chu bar du sngar gyi grwa bu slob gzhan skal ldan mjal mi mang po la/ drang don las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag nges don snying po don gyi ngo sprod rnams nyi ma mang po'i bar du gsungs 227

dus/ skal ldan gyi bu slob 'gas nam mkha' lha'i chos nyan gyi gang ba mngon sum du mthong / 'ga' zhig la lha mi'i chos nyan gyis sa dang bar snang kun gang 'dug snyam pa'i nyams dga' yal le ba byung / kun gyi thun mong gi mthong snang du/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang / kha dog sna lnga'i sprin gyi gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas dpag med kyi gang ba dang / me tog kha dog sna lnga'i char 'bab pa dang / yid 'phrog pa'i rol mo'i sgra mang po thos pa dang / sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri zhim po tshor ba byung / yang sngon 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skal bzang gi gdul bya mang po la nyin gcig bka' chos gnang ba'i dus su/ nam mkha' stong pa nas me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur phung pa kun gyis mthong /nam mkha' lha'i chos nyan gyi gang ba'i nang nas lha'i bu gzhon nu mang po byung nas 'brom gyi dbu dang snyan sogs la me tog gi rgyan 'dogs pa jo bo chen pos gzigs pa byung / sngon 'gro mgon g.yu thog pas slob ma la chos 'chad pa'i skabs shig tu/lha mang po chos nyan du byung ba kun gyis ma mthong kyang / a ru ra rlon pa'i char phab pas/ khong gi sku pang du a ru ra rnam rgyal zhig byung / kun gyis ci 'dod len rgyu byung nas ngo mtshar ba 228

byung / sngon rgya gar na dge slong byams snying rje dang ldan pa zhig theg pa chen po'i mdo 'don pa la/ nam mkha'i lha mang bos nyan pa byung / de bzhin du zang zing gi nor 'bul ba la mi lta bar sems bskyed bzang po'i sgo nas 'di lta bu'i chos zab mo bstan na nam mkha'i lha yan chad kyis gsan zhing rtag tu srung skyob byed par 'gyur/ des na bla mas kyang kun slong kun spyod bzang pos chos 'chad cing / mjug tu dpon slob thun mong gis chos la 'chad nyan byas pa'i dge ba rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba byas na/ 'chad nyan byas pa tsam gyis kyang dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par 'gyur ro//da ni nyams su blang bya'i gdams pa dngos ston pa la/ sbyor dngos 'jug gsum thun mtshams gyi rim pa rnams las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi che ba 'byin pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba la 'di ltar bya dgos zhes go ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'gro la chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus sogs la/ sa phyogs dang gnas khang rnams bye dor mdzad pa dang / gcung dga' bo yang rab tu byung nas 229

gtsug lag khang la phyag bdar byed du bcug pas/ tshar mang po'i bar du mdzad pa dang / sngon lam phran bya ba yang rab tu byung nas/ kho'i sgrib pa sbyong phyir/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo ra nas dge slong rnams kyi mchil lham phyir bcug pas/ de'i bar la rdul phyis/ dri ma dag slob tu bcug pas/ dbyar zla gsum la ma lobs pa la/ skabs shig kho'i sgrib pa dag nas tshig don la brtags pas/ rdul zhes pa phyi rol sa rdul ma lags nang gi 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa la zer snyam nas/ de don bsgoms pas dgra bcom par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i che ba 'byin phyir gso sbyong gi dge slong ma rnams la chos 'chad du bcug pas/ lam phran gyis smras pa/ rdul 'di sa rdul ma yin 'dod chags rdul/ /mkhas pa gang gis rdul 'di rnam spangs pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan la bag yod 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi chos bstan nas ma smin pa mang po smin par byas/ smin pa rnams grol bar byas so/ /des na sngon na ga ge sar gling gi rnal 'byor pa mngon shes la thogs pa med pa gcig la jo bo dpon slob bltar byon pas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig gi drung na/ shing ne gro rnya zhig yod pa'i rtsa na/ phyag bdar mdzad kyin 'dug skad/230

dge bshes spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa dang lta ba rtogs pa yin pas ci yang bya mi dgos zer bar yon tan thams cad bsod nams bsags pa las 'byung bar dgongs pas phyag bdar mdzad pa 'di yang gdams ngag yin gsungs skad/ sngon rje btsun mi las kyang / dwags po lha rje 'byon khar zhal gdams gsungs pa las/ gtsang sgra che bar bya/ rnam rtog chung bar bya gsungs/ des na 'o skol las dang po pas dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gsungs ltar/ ri khrod dben pa sogs gang du sdod sa'i gnas khang la thog mar bye dor legs par bya dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab/ sngon gyi jo bo yab sras kyi rjes 'jug bka' gdams dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang gi sku re 'bral spang gi tshul du 'chang nas gang bzhugs sar gong nas bshams te ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i rnam thar ltar/ thub dbang gi sku re rgyun ldan du 'chang zhing / rten des gtso mdzad sku gsung thugs rten gang yod rnams/ gnas khang gtsang ma de'i gong gi mtho ba'i sar legs par bkram par bya/ sngon jo bo gcig gis gzhi'i kun dga' ra bar nya ma yod pa'i sngon du gding ba rtsid skud kyi chum chum btsem pas/ nya ma rnams na re/ a tsa ma skud pa de 231

'dra bas ga na mchi zer ba la/ des nga la bal skud med byas pas/ da bdag gi 'bul lags zer nas/ sang nang bar bal dang skud pa mang bo byung skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rang la ster du re ba'i blos gzhan gyi drung du/ de 'dra'i gtam dang spyod pa byas/ g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas btsal ba'i nor gyes dkon mchog mchod pas mi yong/ gzhan yang srog gcod rku 'phrog sogs kyi sgo nas blangs pa'i log 'tsho sogs kyi ma sbags pa'i ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rnams shin tu gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba byas/ bkod pa mjes par bshams/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtswa tshong gi khye'u bkra shis las/ rtswa bzhes nas rtswa'i rtse mo nang du bstan rtsa ba phyir bstan rtswa rnams ma 'khrugs par btang ste/ steng du bzhugs nas tshes bco lnga'i skya rengs dang po 'char ba'i tshod tsam la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa yin pas/ 'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / ston pa'i rnam thar ltar byas na sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi che ba yod pas/ rang gang du sdod pa'i mal sa'i 'og tu rtswa dur ba ci 'byor dang /de'i khar 'bol gdan sogs stan bshams/ sngon yul bcom brlag zhes bya ba'i spre'u zhig gis/ rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya skyil 232

krung byas bsam gtan la gnas pa mthong nas/ spre'us kyang skyil krung byas nas bsdad/ nam zhig gi tshe rang sangs rgyas de rnams 'bar ba dang gsal ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan nas mya ngan las 'das tshe/ spre'u 'khyams nas/ drang srong lnga brgya ri sul na spyod lam sna tshogs pas 'dug pa'i drung du song nas/ skyil krung byas nas bsdad pas/ mkhan bos 'khor drang srong rnams la/ spre'u rnams ni dran pa dang ldan pa ste/ 'dis drang srong kha cig gis spyod lam de lta bu mthong gis/ khyed cag kyang skyil krung gyis la sdod cig byas pas/ kun gyis skyil krung byas nas bsdad pas/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon du gyur nas/mkhan slob thams cad kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon du bskyed nas/ rang byang chub mngon du byas so/ /sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung byas sku drang por bsrings nas/ srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhagatho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangarngasga rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa yin/ des na chos thams cad rten 'brel la rag las pas/'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyang myur du khong ltar sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du/ bde ba'i stan la rkang pa rdo rje 233

skyil krung ngam phyed skyil/ lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs bsrings pa/ mgrin pa cung zad bkug pa/ mig sna rtser phab pa/mchu so ma reg par bya ba/ lce rtse ya rkan la cung zad sbyar ba ste/lus rnam snang chos bdun gyi gnas par bya/ sngon 'ban gung rgyal gyi yon bdag 'dra yong ba'i ngor mdzes chos su mchod pa bshams nas/ rjes su kun slong la brtags pas yon bdag gi ngor mdzes chos byas pa shes nas mchod pa'i nang du thal ba spar gang gtor nas/ dge slong rang zog ma byed par bzhugs shig gsungs pa de pha dam pas gsan nas/ bod na dkon mchog mchod pa la 'ban gung rgyal gyi thal ba spar gang bo de bzang gsungs skad/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bos sgom pa rin chen bla ma bsgom skad/ bsgom tsa na bsgoms pas dar yug dang ja sig mang po yong bar sems na ci tsam bsgom pa sdig pa yin/bsgom tsa na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar dbyung byang chub mchog gi sa bon 'debs sems na/ sems pa tsam zhig byas pa'i bsod nams nam mkhar mi shong gsungs/ dge bshes ston pas jo bo la/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid rnyed bkur 'dod nas byas pa'i las rnams la 'bras bu ci mchis zhus pas/ 'bras bu de kho na nyid mchi gsungs/ phyi ma la ci mchi zhus pas/ dmyal ba mtsho yi 234

dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs/ des na 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i thog mar kun slong la brtags te kun slong ngan pa de 'dra'i rigs skyes pa dor nas/dge sems khyad par can byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs de bya dgos/ sngon khye'u dri ma med pa'i dpung pa zhes bya bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan la kha zas phul te/ skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs nas/ skyabs 'gro byas pa dang / yang sngon bram ze zhig gi byis pa mang po sngar ma sos shi song ba/ phyis bu gcig btsas pa lam po cher khyer nas/ sangs rgyas byon pa dang dge 'dun byung tshad la byes pa'i ming gis skyabs 'gro byas pas ma shi ba byung / yang bu gcig btsas pa lam phran zhig tu khyer nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas byon pa dang 'phrad tshe sngar ltar skyabs 'gro byas pas ma shi ba byung bas/ gnyis ga'i ming la lam pa dang / lam phran du btags/ gnyis ka rab tu byung nas dgra bcom par gyur/sngon bdag cag gi ston pa rdza mkhan gyi khye'u yangs pa'i 'od zhes bya bar gyur dus/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la dad pa'i sems kyis gdugs gcig rdza bum gcig kar+sha pa ṇi lnga/'jam por gang phul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra 235

dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces sems bskyed pas thub pa chen po de nyid kyis khyod ma 'ongs pa na shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ sngon ston pa de nyid bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul zhes bya bar gyur dus/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po 'khor bcas la bsod snyoms mal cha yo byad dpag tu med pas bsnyen bkur byas nas/ bdag gi 'dis mtshon dge ba'i tshogs kyi snyigs ma'i dus su bcom ldan 'das su gyur te/sems can rnams theg pa gsum gyi byang chub la 'god phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyur cig /ces sems bskyed pas/de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos kyang / khyod ma 'ongs snyigs ma tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar gyur nas chos 'khor bskor zhes lung bstan/ sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i bu mo mya ngan med kyis yab la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras gang yin zhes smra na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnams lags so/ /zhes gtam de brjod pas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i btsun mo nyi shus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems 236

bskyed do/ /de bzhin du lha'i bu lnga brgya tham pas kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / dkon mchog gsum po yid kyi mdun du bzhugs par mos nas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs ngag tu 'don/ don yid la bsam bzhin du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi yang bsgom/ sngon khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga rnya bzang mos khang thog tu spos phul/ chu sgreng / me tog gtor/ rab tu gus pas 'di skad du/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu zab/ /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis/ /mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes bzung zhing / /don mdzad thugs rjes gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sangs rgyas 'khor bcas spyan 'dren byas tshe/ ma ga rnya'i yul dang / sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i mnyan yod gnyis kyi bar la dpag tshad brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa dpag tshad re rer nyin lam 'bring po re yod kyang sangs rgyas 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'phags te/ thog mar sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyis yab kyi ji ltar spangs pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong / nor bu rin po che sna 237

bdun dpung gi tshogs bye ba brgyad 'bum dang bcas pa sprul nas sngon la gshegs pa dang / khyim bdag bya mkhan 'khor bcas kyis mthong nas/ khyed kyi ston pa 'di min nam zer bar/ma ga rnya na re/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po yin te/ yab kyis ji ltar spangs pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad kyis byon pa yin zhes smras so/ /yang 'phags pa kun shes ko'u di n+ya 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang /glog 'byen pa dang / gcig tu gyur yang mang du sprul ba dang /mang du sprul zhing gcig tu bsdus pa dang / snang ba dang mi snang ba la sogs pa'i dzu 'phrul du ma bstan nas byon pa dang / khyed kyi ston pa 'di yin nam zer/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 'bras bu thob snga ba/ kun shes ko'u di n+ya zhes bya ba yin smras pa dang / de nas shā ri'i bu 'brug gi shing rta la zhon nas/ 'bar ba dang gsal ba la sogs pa dzu 'phrul ya ma zung dpag tu med pa bstan nas byon no/ /ston pa 'di su yin zer/'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams kyi nang nas/shes rab che ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa shā ri'i bu yin smras pa dang / yang mo'u 'gal gyi bu seng ge'i shing rta la zhon nas/ 'bar ba la sogs pa dzu 'phrul ya ma zung bstan nas 238

byon no/ /'di ston pa yin nam zer bar/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams kyi nang nas rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu zhes bya ba yin no smras so/ /de nas 'od srung gis gser gyi ri la rin po che'i shing sna tshogs skyes pa'i nang na/ 'bar ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam sna tshogs bstan nas byon pas/ sngar bzhin zer bar/ 'di ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa/ gnas brtan 'od srung chen po yin smras so/ /de nas rim gyis gong bzhin du la la ni 'bar bar byed/ la la ni gsal bar byed/ la la ni glog 'byin par byed/ la la ni gcig tu bsdus shing mang por spel ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa sprul zhing byon pas/ re re nas dris shing rim pa bzhin 'di ltar yin zhes smras so/ /de'i rjes la bcom ldan 'das mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcu/ sku gser gyi mchod sdong 'bar ba ltar mdzad nas byon te/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pas mchod nas/ ma ga rnya bzang mo dang / khyem bdag bya mkhan dang bcas pa la sogs pa srog chags brgya stong du ma la chos bstan pas bden pa mngon sum du mthong nas/ thams cad kyang sangs rgyas la 239

gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bad pa dang / dge 'dun la 'dun par gyur to/ /des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang ma lus sems can ma sogs bton nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren dus de ltar byon par mos dgos/ yang sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon dus lha mang pos nam mkha' nas bdud rtsi'i chus khrus gsol/tshangs pa brgya byen gyis lha'i gos ka shi ga'i na bza' phul ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la khrus gsol zhing sku byi byas/ na bza' phul nas mdun gyi gdan khri phun sum tshogs pa la dgyes bzhin bzhugs par mos la/ ngag tu ji ltar bltams pa dang / de dag sku la mtshungs pa/srab 'jam yang ba ma dang / bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse phyir rnams 'don/ sngon dge slong zhig gis dang ba'i sems kyis mchod rten la phyag byas tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ dge slong dag 'dis sa ji tsam zhig non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong na gser gyi 'khor lo rnams la thug pa'i bar na bye ma ji snyed yod pa de snyed du dge slong 'dis 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi rgyal srid nyis stong 'gyur du longs spyod par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can la lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byen dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' 240

po 'jog po/ mi'i rgyal po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sogs skye dgu kun gyi spyi bos btud nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / na ga ge sar gyi rnal 'byor pa chen pos mnyam med jo bo rje la/ mkhas pa chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag 'tshal ba la/ jo bos kyang don gyi mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes phyag lan gnang ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis mdun gyi tshogs zhing lha tshogs rnams la yan lag bdun pa'i thog mar dngos dang / yid kyi lus grangs med sprul nas phyag 'tshal/ sngon bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la me tog ut+pal lnga gtor nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas shing ta la bdun tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /de'i tshe mar me mdzad kyis bram ze'i khye'u 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog cig nam mkhar gtor na yang / mthar sangs rgyas thob pa snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo nas gsungs/ des na sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mchod yon phul ba dang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen gyis zhabs bsil phul ba dang / srid mo gaṅgā'i lha mos me tog phul ba dang / spos tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis bdug spos phul ba dang /241

rgyal po gser gye lag pas snang gsal phul ba dang / dri za'i rgyal po rab dgas dri chab phul ba dang / khyem bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis zhal zas phul ba dang / mgar ba lha dga' klu dgas sil snyan phul ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du dngos dang yid kyi mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul nas 'bul/ sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgras yab bsad pa sogs sdig pa'i las mang po byas pa la shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'o rang gzhan sems can gyi ma rig pa'i dbang gis sngar sdig pa gang byas tshad thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /zhes phyag 'tshal bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis rang gi sdig pa tsam du ma zad/ sems can gzhan gyi sdig pa byas pa yang mthol bshags byas pa ngo mtshar che gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang tshogs zhing gi spyan sngar rang gzhin gyi sdig pa mthol bshags bya/ sngon mu lto ba gcig gis rgyal po gsal rgyas gyis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bsnyen bkur byas pa la rjes su yi rang phul bas/bsod nams de dang mnyam pa thob pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du skye 'phags rnams kyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bya/ sngon lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byen gnyis kyis sangs 242

rgyas la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs phul nas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas chos 'khor mi bskor bar bzhugs pa rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo dung dkar sogs phul nas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/sngon ded dpon zhig gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku mya ngan las 'da' ba la/ 'jig rten la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bskal bar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ded dpon khyod nga la dad pas bsnyen bkur zhing /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas snying rje can zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ g.yu thog pa rin chen mkha' 'gro ma mang pos mkha' spyod du gdan 'dren pa slob ma zhig gis mthong nas gdan 'dren du ma bcug par bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas lo gcig tsam bzhugs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du dngos su bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams la yang skabs re bsnyen bkur byas/ g.yung drung sna tshogs rdo rje sogs kyi mtshan pa'i gdan khri sogs phul nas skal chen khri phrag mang po'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ yid kyis kyang phyogs 243

bcu'i zhing na mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ sngon rgyal po gsal rgyas kyis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas pa'i dge tshogs dang / de la mu lto bas rjes su yi rang byas pa'i dge ba rnams sangs rgyas kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngos pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du dge ba gang byas rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo ba rnams kyi dmigs pa byas/ ngag tu ji snyed su dag ma 'don/ sngon mnyam med po to pas slob ma rnams la da lta dad pas kun nas blangs te/ maṇ+ḍal zhig phul na/'di nas gser gyis gzhi la thug pa'i bar gyi maṇ+ḍal gye ji tsam non tshod kyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por skye gsungs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos 'ol kha chos lung du rdo gru bzhi rtsa ba brtan pa zhig la maṇ+ḍal mdzad nas/ phyag ngar gyis phyis shing maṇ+ḍal grangs bsogs mdzad pas phyag mdzub kyi rtse rnams ser gar song/phyag ngar la sha ro chags pa byung skad/ des na skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs bla ma chen po rnams la/ rgyal po sogs phyug po stobs can kha cig gis sngon du mjal rten tsam phul/ de nas 244

slar yang 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po phul nas chos 'brel zhu ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du sngar mchod pa tsam du ma zad/ da dung slar yang yid kyis ri ra gling bzhi gling phran/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa phul bar mos nas ngag gis/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi zhes maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma 'don/lag gis maṇ+ḍal steng du tshom bu rnams bkod nas 'bul la/sngon slob dpon la wa pas/ bla ma la gsol ba btab nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge a'i gdams pa bsgoms pas nub gcig la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa byung /de bzhin du sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis bla ma la gsol ba btab nas lam nyams su blangs pas/ sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la skyes nas sangs rgyas pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyang byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di rgyud la bde blag tu skyes nas phyur du sangs rgyas pa'i phyir rtsa ba dang brgyad pa'i bla ma rnams la snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po man chad nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi//lam rim brgyad pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus yongs skong ba'i/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim bdag brgyud la/ /skyes nas byang chub thob par byin 245

gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems can rnams kyi lus sems la zhugs tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyis ltung dri ma'i tshogs ngan pa thams cad mun pa'i gling du nyi ma'i 'od phog pa ltar sbyangs/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan sogs legs tshogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag song snyam pa'i mos pa bya/ de dag rnams mdor bsdu na/ sngon byang chub sems la mnga' brnyes pa'i bla ma gser gling pa dang /jo bo rje yab sras sogs bka' gdams bla ma gong ma'i gdams pa zab mo byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di dang / 'di 'dra ba rgyud la bde blag tu skye sla ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba'i chos drug sngon du btang ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang dam pa gong ma'i phyag len de bzhin du/ gnas khang phyi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang yod bkrams pa/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa g.yo med pa btsal nas bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa/ bde ba'i stan la skyil krung ngam phyed skyil sogs gang bder gnas 246

nas lus drang bor bsrang ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma sogs skyabs yul gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa bzhugs yod snyam du tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/bsag sbyang gi gnad thams cad 'dus pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ maṇ+ḍal phul te phyin ci log gi blo sna 'gag pa dang /phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag skye ba dang / rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad kun nye bar zhi bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rgyud dang 'dres nges bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul ni/sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med pa bsten pa dang / tshong dpon gyi bu gzhon nu nor bzang gis bla ma brgya dang bcu bsten pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dngos grub brgyad thob pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad bsten gzhan yang mang ste/ tha na rdza ma bzo mkhan la'ang gtugs nas rdza bzo tshul yan chad slob par mdzad/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos dngos grub thob pa'i bla ma bcu gnyis gzhan yang mang ste/ tha na sgra dang tshad ma rnams phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa kha cig nas kyang 247

gsan sbyongs mdzad/ khyon jo bo la bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu yod gsungs/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ jo bo chen po dang / rje btsun se btsun pa sogs bla ma lnga tsam bsten/ dge bshes gsang pu bas/ byis pa las kyang legs bshad pa/ /thams cad blang bya kho na yin/ /gsungs nas kun la nyan pa'i bla ma shin tu mang / tha na khams nas byon pa'i lam khar dge bsnyen zhig gis chos 'chad cing 'dug pa la yang nyan pas/'khor rnams kyis de la nyan pa stangs zhan byas pas/ khyed rnams de skad ma zer nga la phan pa gnyis byung gsung skad/ lho brag mar ba rin po ches kyang / paṇa chen nā ro ba mi tri pa/ ku ku ri pa sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas chos gsan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pas bka' drin che shos mar pha dang /rngog ston sogs bla ma bcu tsam bsten par gda'/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje bdag nyid chen pos/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rje red mda' ba/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ de bzhin du sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bla ma bsten pa mang nyung yod pa ma gtogs/ bla ma ma bsten pa gcig med/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rnam grol sgrub pa la chos shes dgos/ shes pa la 248

bla ma bsten nas thos dgos pas/ bla ma mang po bsten ma nus kyang bla ma bzang po re gnyis tsam ma bsten pa'i thabs med pas ci nas kyang bsten dgos te/ po to ba'i gsung sgros las/rnam grol sgrub pa la bla ma las gal che ba med/ tshe 'di'i bya ba bltas nas byas chog pa la yang slob dpon med pas mi yong na/ngan song gsum nas 'ongs ma thag 'gro ma myong ba'i sar 'gro ba la bla ma med pas ga nas 'ong gsungs/ sngon slob dpon bai ro tsa na dang / sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsa sogs skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsa ba rnams kyi lus srog la ma ltos par/ bla ma dang gdams ngag 'tshol ba'i phyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dbus su song nas/ bla ma dang gdams ngag gang bzang zhes gzhan la rtsad bcad nas dris pas/ gzhan gyi kha mthun par 'di bzang zhes zer ba rang gis kyang brtags na bzang gi snyam pa'i bla ma mi la ngom chog cing rang gi yid 'phrog pa mang po bsten nas/ zab rgyas gdams pa rnams thob nas bod thams cad chos kyi dkar lam mer btang ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams da lta rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro mi dgos kyang / dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing la sogs pa'i yul nye ring gang gi bla ma su bzang gang bzang dris nas gzhan kun gyis ding sang 'di bzang zhes kha mthun par 249

smra zhing / rang gi yid 'phrog cing sems kha khengs pa dad pa dbang med du skye ba'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig btsal nas bsten dgos/ 'o na mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla ma de ci 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ sngon mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa gnyis kyi gcig gis chos bshad byas pas zas nor bag ri byung tshe/gcig po na re/ khyod kyis go bcad zer/ yang mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa zhig na re/ chos dag mang rab shes te da dung don gcig ma 'grub zer ba/ don gang yin byas pas khri kha zhig nas bla ma khri pa gcig gi ming ma thogs zer skad/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang shas che bas bla ma mi 'ong /sngon sngags pa zhig gi rdor legs brten nas lo gnyis gsum tsam la 'phrin las myur ba byung / de'i 'phro nas bzung nyin re gnyis kyi gesur mchod chags pa byung na/ na tsha dang god kha gtong la/ yang rems nas gsol mchod byas tshe 'phrin las myur ba zhig byung skad/ de bzhin du bla ma nor rdzas kyi 'dod pa can phyag rten re bltas nas/ dang po'i dus thugs rje che che 'dra ba byas/ lo zla ba kha shas song tshe slob ma'i bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog bag re chung ba dang cung zad 'gyangs pa byung na ko long dam zhing / nor snying sdug re phul na 'dzum yal yal yongs/250

cung zad re la yang dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston zhing / slob mas chos bzhin byed mi byed mi lta bar/ phral gyi zas nor kho na la lta zhing rdor legs ltar 'gyur ldog che ba'i bla ma des mi yong / sngon wa mo zhig zas tshol du phyin pas/ rtsig phag gcig na ram tshos byed pa'i phru ba zhig 'dug pa la ci bro bsnum pas/ kha spu sngo yal gyi song bas/ der lus kun tshos phrur bcug nas sprugs pas shin tu mdzes pa zhig byung bas/ dud 'gro thams cad kyi dpon du bkur nas/ glang po che'i shul steng du bzhag nas bsnyen bkur byed tsam na/ wa rnams la lhag par sdang ba byung bas/ wa rnams kyis gros byas pas/ 'u cag gi dpon po 'di'i mtshul pa mjug ma gang la bltas na 'u cag wa'i rigs dang shin tu 'dra bar 'dug pas/ 'u cag thams cad kyis kho'i sngon du skad 'don byas te/ thams cad kyis wa skad bton pas/ der wa des kyang skad ma bton na spu bye bas wa skad bton pas glang po ches bskyur skad/ de'i tshe nam mkha' nas lha'i tshigs bcad brjod pa/ ma rabs mtho sar phyin pa 'di/ /'gro ba rnams la rtswa bzhin blta/ /de dag myur du phung 'gyur te/ /lpags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /zer skad/ de bzhin du nang na yon tan med par phyi'i spyod tshul bzang 251

bzang 'dra ba/ gos kyi lhab lhub dang / spyod pa'i 'gying bag dang bcas nas mthon po la byams shing / gang dman pa la sdang ba'i wa skyes 'dra ba'i bla ma des mi yong / sngon nags gseb cig tu spre'u mang po yod pa las/ spre'u'i dpon po zhig yod pas mtshan mo nags kyi mtha' mar phyin pas/ khron pa gcig gi nang na zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dkar lhag ge shar 'dug pa mthong nas/ zla ba ma gi yar blang snyam pas kho ma thar te/ zla bo kun bos nas nga'i mjug ma la rtsal stobs che ba gcig 'jus shig zer te/ de ltar rim gyis 'jus/ kun gyi mjug tu 'khos chung gcig gis khron khar 'dzin du bcug nas/ dpon pos sna drangs te khron pa'i gting du zla ba rnyab du phyin pas/ khron kha'i spre'u des ma thub par lag nas shor bas spre'u kun khron par rub kyis song skad/ de dus lha'i tshigs bcad brjod pa/ mi mkhas tshad mar ma gyur pa'i/ /dpon po ngan pa'i ngag nyan na/ /de dag myur du phung 'gyur te/ /chu zla rnyab pa'i spre'u bzhin/ /zhes zer ro/ /dpe de bzhin slob dpon ngan pa chos mi shes kyang chos ltar bcos pa dbang po che'i kha la nyan na/ rang phung bar ma zad bka' ma chog pa'i ring la gzhan slob ma thams cad kyang 'phungs nas/ ngan song du dpon slob kun rub kyi 252

'gro bas/ spre'u'i dpon po 'dra ba'i bla ma des mi yong/ sngon zhang pa tshab khrod pa bya ba chos mkhas la tshul khrims med pa gcig na re/ slob ma kun la nga zer nyon/ nga byed ma byed zer ro/ /de bzhin du kha nas chos bshad shes kyang spyod pa chos bzhin mi byed pa'i bla ma des slob ma'i mgo mi 'grongs/ des na po to ba'i zhal nas/ da lta mi nag pa kun gyi gnyen 'dam pa re la yang rtog dpyod mang du byed te/ bshes gnyen sna re slob pa yang dpon mkhas mi mkhas la rtsis gdab cher byed na/ 'o skol de rnams kyi do min/ so so skye bo'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa ru 'gro ba'i lam mkhan bla ma la re dgos pas/ slob dpon gyi skyon yon legs par brtags la/ lam sna 'grongs nges kyi bla ma re 'tshol dgos/ de yang chos 'brel ma byas pa'i gong la skyon 'dug gam mi 'dug rtog dgos/ chos 'brel byas nas yon tan la brtags dgos gsungs/ 'o na bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de ji 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ rab byung na sngon gyi jo bo 'brom khu rngog sogs bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams ltar/bla ma bslab gsum rtogs pa'i chos kyi rgyud dul ba zhi ba nye bar zhi ba/ sde snod gsum gyi lung gi chos kyi rgyud phyug cing / de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs pa/ gdul bya la smra mkhas pa/ brtse ba 253

dang ldan pa/ chos 'chad pa sogs slob ma skyong ba la skyo ngal med pa zhig dgos/ sngon jo bo bod yul gyi snye thang na bzhugs dus/ thengs gcig ngas bsgom zhig bya dgos par 'dug gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ rgya gar na nga'i slob ma zhig bsgom par 'dod 'dug ste mi yong 'dug gsungs/ slob mas bsgoms ma byung ba la bla mas bsgoms pas phan nam zhus pas/de la mi phan na bla mas ci byed gsungs/ yang thengs gcig rgya gar nas nga'i slob ma gcig gis nga la mchod pa 'bul ba'i dril bu'i sgra thos gsungs/ sngon bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 'brom gyis dus gcig gi tshe na ting nge 'dzin gcig la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rta pa'i nyin lam bcu bdun tshun chad mnga' bar gda' gsungs/ sngon rje mi las mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas ras chung pa rgya gar du phar 'gro tshur 'ong ba rnams gsal ler gzigs nas/ tshur 'ong dus sngon du bsu ba byed du byon/ ras chung pas nyin gcig mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas/ srid pa'i rtsa rtse kun gzigs shing khyad par rje btsun mi las nya nam grog phug na slob ma rnams la chos 'chad pa dang bzhengs bzhud gang byed thams cad gzigs pa byung / de bzhin du bla ma rgyang na gnas kyang slob ma'i skyid sdug ye shes kyi 254

spyan gyis sgrib med gzigs shing / gsol ba 'debs pa lha'i snyan gyis lhang lhang go ba/ sgom ma skyes pa yang byen gyis brlabs nas rgyud la dbang med du skye ru 'jug pa'i bla ma zhig dgos/sngon ras chung pas rgya gar nas mu stegs ngan sngags khyer 'ong ba/ rje btsun gyis rang gzhan phung du dogs nas/ ras chung pa chu len du song shul nas me la bsregs pas/ ras chung sngar mdzad spyod la mi mos pa cung zad skyes yod pa'i khar de ltar mdzad tshe dad pa rtsa ba nas log pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan tshe/ rje btsun gyis lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul/ pha bong 'dam ltar badzis/ zan ltar bcad/ nam mkha' la bya ltar 'phur/ glog ltar 'khyug pa sogs dzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs pa bstan nas/ ras chung pa'i ma dad pa'i snang ba bsgyur ba dang / sngon khams su rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po gcig chang bag re gsol bas/ mkhan bu kun mkhan po'i lad mo byas nas chang 'thung ba la/ khyed chang ma 'thung nga dang mi 'dra gsungs pa la/ ma nyan tshe nyin gcig mkhan bu rnams bos nas/ ja rten du rgya khab snyim pa gang re drangs nas/ nga'i lad mo byed na da 'goms shig gsungs nas zhal du zhu nas krog krog gsol bas/ gzhan mkhan bu rnams kyi 'gams ma thub pa byung nas phyag 'tshal 255

nas gsungs ltar mdzad skad/ de bzhin du slob ma bla ma'i mdzad spyod la mi mos shing / bka' bzhin mi byed pa la/ mi mos pa'i snang ba bsgyur nus dbang med du dad pa skye nus par byed pa'i bla ma nus pa'i yon tan gyi rtags dang ldan pa zhig dgos/sngon po to ba dpon slob thang dkyil zhig na yod dus zhig la 'brog pa phyug po zhig pha shi nas dngul srang mang po'i rin thang can gye g.yu chen po zhig phul ba der zhog cig gsungs nas bsngo ba mdzad/ 'brog pa sa der zhag gi bsdad nas phyi nyin dpon slob phebs shul du bltas tshe sngar gyi g.yu phul ba de ka na bzhag 'dug pa mthong nas kho dad pa sgyes/ bla ma dang 'khor thams cad ngo mtshar che bar 'dug snyam/ der khos kyang g.yu khyer ma 'ong bar sa de khar bzhag skad/ sngon gung thang gnas brtan gser zho bya ba'i drung du/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig byon nas/ de man ngag zhus te sgrub pa'i mod la grub nas/ sa 'og gi gter bag re mthong ba byung / de nas rnal 'byor pa gshegs pa la re phrug gi na bza' gcig phul nas mi gnyis skyel du btang bas/ ya gir sleb tsa na na bza' phul ba de skyel mkhan gnyis la byin nas/ kho'i snying la nga grang ba yin snyam ste/nga la grang ba med gsungs nas gshegs skad/ sngon rje mi la la 256

dwags po lha rjes gser srang mang po dang ja phul ba/ rje btsun gyis gser dang mi rgan lo mi mthun/ ja bskol ba'i thab chas bdag la med sogs mgur gsungs slar gnang nas sgrub rgyags gyis gsungs/ de bzhin du bla ma zang zing nor la mi blta zhing / gang la yang chags zhen spu tsam med pa zhig dgos/ sngon snar thang na skye po grags rin bya ba'i btsun chung shes rab can zhig yod pas/ dgung phyi dro'i kha zas zos pa slob dpon gyi lan gcig mthong bas ci yang mi gsung bar gzim mal du byon nas/ ltung ba phra rma byung ba la yang snying nas spyan chab bsil ba grwa bas mthong nas/ khong gis nga la ltung ba 'di tsam byung ba la thugs kyis mi bzod par spyan chab bsil na/ 'di 'dra ba'i slob dpon gyi thugs dang 'gal ba sus byed snyam nas/ gsung ltar byas pas nyes pa phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i btsun pa'i tshad cig byung / sngon bla ma dharmā rak+ṣi ta bya ba bzhugs pa'i thag nye na mi zhig nad drag pos thebs pa la/ sman pa na re/ nad 'di la mi gson po'i sha rnyed na phan te/ mi rnyed na gzhan thabs med zer/ des phan na ngas sbyin gyes gsungs nas bla mas rang gi brla sha nas sha bcad nas sbyin/ nad pas sha de zas pas phan/khong gi stong nyid kyi rtogs pa mngon du ma gyur pas zug rngu chen 257

po byung yang / nad pa snying rje bas 'gyod pa ma skyes/ nad pa la phan nam dris pas bdag gi nad la phan lags te/ khyed 'o brgyal du bcug zer/ khyod bde na nga shi yang bzod gsungs/bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ chos gsung ba'i rtsa ru mi zhig gis khye la dbyug pa rgyab pas/ bla ma ar gsungs nas 'gyel bas/ gzhan rnams khyi la ci yang ma gnod par 'dug pa la tshul 'chos re che snyam pa byung bar/ bla mas mkhyen nas sku rgyab bstan pas khye la rgyab pa'i thad na sku sha khyu re skrangs 'dug pa mthong nas yid ches nas dad pa byung / de bzhin du slob ma la nyes ltung phra mo re phog pa la yang mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye zhing / slob ma sogs gzhan la phan na sku sha gcod pa la yang phangs pa med pa/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yang dngos su rgyud steng du len nus pa'i bla ma zhig dgos/ sngon te lo pa'i drung du pan chen nā ro pas dka' ba mang po spyad nas ro ltar gyur pa la/ te lo pa'i phyag gi byel ba re mdzad pas bsos pa byung / paṇa chen nā ro pa la ḍo sti pas chang bum pa gang khyer nas phul bas mgo thog tu phyag bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pas/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes nas/sde snod gsum la mkhas pa byung / ḍo bhi pa dang jo bo gnyis kyi bar du zla lam zhig yod kyang / jo bos 258

gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du mi sha lag pa zhig khyer nas byon te/ khong rang gi gsol zhing jo bo la khyod kyis za 'am zer nas srin lag cig bcad nas sbyin pa zos pa rmis pas mnal sad tsa na/ sngar med pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thugs rgyud la rang 'khrungs su byung / ma zhig gis mi tshang zhig gi chos klog bzhin ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas/ sgo ru rnal 'byor pa gcig byung nas bsod snyoms blangs pas rang ga ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la lhan gnas pa byung bas nang na su yod dris pas ma zhig yod zer ba de'i byen rlabs su go nas nang du 'ongs/ phyag 'tshal byin rlabs sogs zhus skad/ de bzhin du bla ma rtogs pa'i bdag rgyud grol zhing / thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin par byed nus pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can zhig dgos/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa zhal gzigs nas chos thob pa dang / rje rin po ches rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nam 'dod dus zhal gzigs pa dang / grub chen las kyi rdo rjes phyag na rdo rje la dngos su nam 'dod dus chos zhus chog pa dang /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa lha mo dbyangs can ma'i phyag tu bsnams nas ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bstan pa byung /de bzhin du bla ma lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing 259

gsung gi snang ba thob pa zhig dgos/ po to ba'i zhal nas/bsgom pa spa bsgoms bya bas gong ma'i ting nge 'dzin bsnyen pa zhig bzhugs pa la/ dus gcig gi tshe khong la 'jug pa'i nyes pa zhig byung snyam nas thugs ma bde ba la/ kha sar pā ṇi'i lugs sku zhig la bskor ba mdzad kyin bzhugs pas lugs skus gsung byon nas/ des khyed la nyes par mi 'gyur gyis gsung skad/ 'o skol thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bgrod pa la lam mkhan gyi bla ma 'khor ba las ring du song ba de lta bu re 'tshol dgos gsungs/ yang khong gis/ ngas da lta ri rtse ya gi na gser gyi khron pa rdol nas yod kyis khyed rang len du song byas kyang / ngas ngag 'khyal du go nas khyed 'gror mi nyan/ nga rang gis rings par phyin na khyed tsho yang gzhug na yar 'gril yong / de bzhin du bla ma rang chos bzhin mi byed par gzhan la chos bshad kyang lag len byed mkhan mi yong / bla ma rang gis chos bzhin byas na/ gzhan yang rjes su slob pa bag re yong / des na bla ma de kho rang yang chos bzhin byed la/ gzhan yang chos bzhin byed du sbyor ba zhig dgos gsungs/ de 'dra'i bla ma zhig dang mjal na slob ma de ji ltar ngan rung rgyud byin gyes rlabs nas btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa 'byung / 'o na snyigs dus 'dir yon 260

tan de 'dra dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed dka' bas ma rnyed na ji ltar bya snyam na/ sngon gyi bka' gdams bla ma zhang btsun yer pa dang / gnyan ston rnam gnyis la smra mkhas sogs gzhan yon tan rgya chen po mi mnga' yang / bslab pa gsum dang byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la mnga' bas/gzhan 'grogs 4 da dang drung du 'khod tshad gye grwa bu slob rnams la phan pa byung / de bzhin du bla ma gzhan yon tan rgya che dpangs mtho ba ma mchis kyang / bslab pa gtsang zhing byang sems che ba bsten rung / gal te de lta bu yang ma rnyed na/ sde snod gsum po sogs rang la mkho ba'i chos la mkhas na khyim pa yin yang bsten chog pa jo bo rjes gsungs so/ /'o na bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa des slob ma ji ltar skyong snyam na/ sngon gyi bka' gdams pa dang bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhabs drung du/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa gtugs tshe thugs spro slob ma de 'byor ba med pa yin na/ lto gos chos gsum gye sgo nas bskyangs te thar pa'i lam la 'god pa ltar/slob ma snod ldan byung na brtse bas rjes su bzung / rang la 'byor ba yod/ slob ma la gtan nas med pa yin na/ phangs pa med par lto gos chos gsum gyi sgo nas skyong ba'i bla ma thugs rje 261

che ba zhig dgos/ sngon po to ba gangs skya mo na bzhugs tsa na/nangs ma gcig mi zhig gis bong thor gcig la lug khal gyi nang du la ma khres se re bcug nas 'gel ba gzigs/ de nas sang nangs par la ma khres se gnyis bcug nas 'gel ba gzigs pas khong gi thugs la bla mas slob ma skyong ba yang 'di 'dra ba gcig dgos snyam pa dgongs/ yang btsun rgyab pa'i btsun pa jo lags zer ba gcig po to ba las kyang snga ba nas dge bshes ston pa'i phyag phyir bzhugs pa de snyung bas/ de'i nad g.yog po to ba dang / phu chung pa dang dge tshul gcig dang gsum gyes byed pa la/ mu ge che bas khong rnams la rgyags tsam med pas gzhan du 'gro ba rings kyang / nad pa ma sos pas da nad pa myur du drag par 'dod/ nad pa yang dang kha phye nas gcig char zas skom 'dod/ zas skom bzang po zo sa na nad pa drag pa'i thabs yin yang / 'dod tshad sbyin na nad log nas/slar yang ring rgyang nge song gi dogs nas/ zas che bar 'dod kyang chung ngu ster/ skom mang du 'dod kyang nyung ngu ster ba la brten nas/ nged kyi dge bshes ston pas rim gyis ston pa yang de lta bu zhig yin par dgongs/ sngon gtsang bu bsgom chung brag gi spe'u ke ru na gcig pur bzhugs dus/ brag la khug rta'i tshang 262

bca' ba la tshegs che bar 'dug dgongs/ 'dag pa khyer nas skyor skyor mdzad pa'i mod la thang la log gin song / bya kho ji ltar byed gzigs nas de ltar rim gyis brtsigs pas tshang de 'grub pa byung bas/ ngas bya'i tshang la brten nas chos go gsungs/ de bzhin du bla mas slob ma la chos ston pa yang / thog mar zab mo stong pa nyid dang / gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis sogs bstan na 'ga' zhig la phan las gnod che ba 'byung bas/ re zhig bzhag nas/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di bzhin lam la rim gyis blo sbyangs na gang gi sa nas chos kyi babs mi brdal ba zhig 'ong / dge bshes gsang phu ba'i zhal nas/ 'gro ni ye 'gro ban gyis mchongs sa med/ nya ni bags kyis za/ ri bor dal gyis 'dzeg don chen rim gyis gnyer bya ba yin gsungs/ de ltar yin pas shes byed kyang / rgyal gyi gangs rgya mor/ dge bshes grags rgyal gyis byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhus nas gsungs pa'i skabs su 'di skad gsungs te/ rba tsa klu rdor bya ba'i gtso bo rgad po gcig rab tu byung nas/ po to ba la chos nyan pa la/ kho shed dge bshes legs/ rim gyis slob pa de gzhon pa longs yod pa rnams kyi chos su 'dug nga rgas pa'i long med rgan po'i chos zhig zhu byas pas/ tshogs su 'di skad 263

gsungs te/ mdo khams smad du mgar ba zhig gis khab mig rgyang ring nge ba byas 'dug par/ khab mig ring byas pas/ de la legs mi legs gang yang mi zer bar/ nga la phas bslab pa yin zer ro/ /de bzhin du nga la yang jo btsun rin chen 'od na re/nga rgas pa'i long med pas rgan po'i chos shig zhu zer/ rgan po'i chos shig khyod la mkho ni yang mkho ste/ nga la 'brom dge bsnyen rgad po zhig gis bslab pa'i chos lam gyi rim pa de rang yin/ rgan pa'i chos shig dang / gzhon pa'i chos gcig gnyis nga la med gsungs/ de bzhin du rgan gzhon dbang po rno rtul gang yin yang lam la ban mchongs mi byed par chos byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di bzhin rim gyis 'khrid na 'phral phugs gang du bkra shis pas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim pa 'di ni kun gye gzhung lam yin pas lam la 'dam kha med par thams cad 'dir 'jug par bya/ sngon shā bo pa'i drung du slob ma gsar ba re byung ba dang / jo bo khyod nga'i drung du sdod pa yin na/ kho bo ni skyon dang mtshang 'bigs pas rgol lo/ /de tsa na khyed rang ko long ma dam zhes gsungs/ khong la brten tshad ma 'tshengs med par gda'/ de bzhin du bla ma de'i snying nas slob ma la brtse yang/ dngos su slob ma dmu rgod la bka' bkyon/ snyom chung 264

rnams gzengs bstod/ 'dod pa dang nyon mongs dbang du 'chor 'chor 'dra ba rnams tshar bcad nas/ phyogs thams cad du lam 'khyogs su mi ster bar yar mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam la 'god dgos/ slob ma'i snang bar gang shar byed du bcug nas mar ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i lam la btang na mi yong bas/ slob ma skyong tshul la mkhas par bya'o/ /'o na slob ma ngan pa snod dang mi ldan pa de ci 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ sngon dge bshes 'brom gyi sku drung du rgyus ston ke ru zhes bya ba btsun pa zhig pa'i dge bsnyen zhig 'ongs nas/ phyag rten du gser zho phyed tsam phul nas/ chos dang rgyags gnyis ka zhu ba yin zer ba la/ dge bshes ston pa zhal nag rog ge bzhugs skad/ de'i tshe dge bshes phu chung pa mdun na yod pas bka' bkyon pa byung /sngon rje mi las thog mar lho brag mar pa mjal dus/ phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs nas bla ma rin po che bdag nyi ma la stod kyi mi sdig po che zhig lags pas/ lus ngag yid gsum yang 'bul/ lto gos chos gsum yang bla ma la zhu/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas shig thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ mar pa'i zhal nas/ sdig po che yin pa'i yus nga la ci 'gro/ nga'i ched du sdig pa bsag tu btang ba ni min/ gang ltar na'ang lus ngag yid 265

gsum 'bul ba de bzang / lto gos chos gsum kun mi yong /zhes phyi rabs gdul bya la go ba skye phyir de skad gsungs/ de bzhin du mjal ma thag nas lto gos chos gsum thams cad dgos zer ba'i ham pa can gyi slob ma des mi yong / sngon skyes bu se ther ba la kham pa tshan zhig gis ja skol dang nged kyi chos nyan cig bya byas pas/ khong gis kham pa greg pa tshan zhig gis skor na dpe med par 'gro ba zer ro/ /sngon kun dga' bo sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas su bskos pa'i tshe/ ston pas mi gsol ba'i na bza' rnying ba dang / gsol ras kyi lhag ma mi gnang ba dang / chos 'dod pa rnams kyi zhu sna byed du ston pa'i spyan sngar dus nam yang 'ong chog pa gsum gnang na zhabs 'bring byed zhes zhus pas gnang / kun dga' bos de ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag la dgongs pa yin/ des na chos la ci yang mi rtsi bar ja sun re re'i mtho dman la thugs la btags ma btags rtsi ba de phugs rul ba'i rtags yin pas de lta bu'i slob mas mi yong /sngon po to ba'i drung du zha'i ngang pa rgya gar bya ba'i btsun pa zhig byung ba la/ dge bshes kyi thugs thag pa nas gdams ngag bstan yang / kho la nang na chos la nyer len med pas thabs ci byas rung rgyud la yon tan gang yang ma skyes pas/ dge bshes kyi 266

zhal nas/ nang gi nyer len med pa la/ /phyi yi rkyen gyis mi phan te/ /zha yi ngang pa rgya gar la/ /rin chen gsal gyi gdams ngag rdugs/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du nang na chos la nyer len med pa la thabs ci byas rung mi phan/ des na chos la 'dod pa med pa'i slob ma des mi yong / sngon gcig gi gtsug tor dkar mo'i sngags kyi phan yon mes mi tshugs chus mi tshugs bya ba la sogs pa rnams mthong bas khos snying po bris te/ ra gcig yod pa'i ske ru btags te byis pa 'tsho ru btang bas/ spyang ki byung nas ra zos/ der byes pas 'u cag gi ra spyang kis khyer byas bas pha na re/ 'o na a na le jug song byas pas/ byes pa na re/ a na le tshun chad can con du zos song zer ro/ /de bzhin du slob ma ngan pas nyon mongs spyang ki dang 'dra ba de mi thub pa'i ring la/slob dpon tshun chad can con du btsongs pa mang bas/ de lta bu'i slob mas mi btub/ sngon bud med gcig la mna' ma gsar ba zhig yod pas/ des mas bu la mi sdod kyis dogs nas/mna' ma'i drung du bu la bstod ra mang bo btang bas/ bag ma na re/ a ne ni bstod ra che te/ bdag ni mi gcig dang me 'jal zer ro/ /de bzhin du mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i slob ma ngan pa yid du mi 'ong ba la/ gzhan 'ga' zhig gis 'di 267

dad gtong shes rab che sogs zer bstod ra gtong yang/ de dang ma mjal ba dga' gsungs/ 'o na slob ma bzang po chos kyi snod dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid ci 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ rab byung na sngon gyi bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams kyi slob rgyud ltar / chags sdang med par blo gzu bor gnas pa/ blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa/ chos la don gnyer che ba/ chos dang chos smra ba 'a/ gus pa/ yid legs par gtad nas nyam pa zhig dgos/ sngon 'phags pa nor bzang gis phyogs bcu thams cad du bla ma brgya rtsa bcu bsten pa'i dus/ khong yangs shing gsal la dri ma med par gyur pa'i bla ma thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi (rnadu shes rnal ma yod pas/ gzhan du 'gro ba'i dus na 'bral ye mi phod par lan brgya stong du mar bskor bar byed cing mig mchi mas gang bas yang dang yang du lta ba sogs byas pa'i rnam thar ltar/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus gdung shugs drag pos lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrug cing / nam yang bla ma dang 'bral blag mi phod pa'i slob ma zhig dgos/ sngon sngags pa dad can zhig la bla ma gzhan zhig gis dad pa 'gyur ram mi 'gyur tshod brtag phyir/ sngags pa khyod kyi bla ma gshegs pa de dmyal bar skyes 'dug gsungs 268

pas/ sngags pa na re/ nga'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas de rang ka dmyal bar skye dogs med/ gal te skyes na dmyal ba'i 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi zhig yod pas skye ba yin las che/ nga yang shi ma thag khong gi 'khor du skyes nas thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed nus par shog smras pas/ bla ma mnyes nas slob ma dad pa can bya ba khyod 'dra la zer/ ngas khyod la ku re byas gsungs skad/ sngon phan yul yangs kyi rgan mo dad pa shin tu che ba dge 'dun kho na la mos pa zhig yod pa la/dus gcig gi tshe dge 'dun rgyal bas mo'i grong du chom bo byas/rgan mo'i sgo bcag pas/ gzhan kun gyes mo la snying tshim/ dge 'dun kho na la dad pa byas pa de byas byas pas/ mo phyir bskor log byas/ ci rung cha rung chos bden zer ro/ /de bzhin du rkyen gang gis gtses rung bla ma la dad pa 'gyur ba med pa de lta bu zhig dgos/ sngon rje btsun mi las mar pa bsten dus sras mkhar dgu thog rtsig dus chos ma gnang ba'i khar/ gan rkyal du nam 'a ngas pa dang kha sbub tu sa rub pa lta bu brdungs pa sogs bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs tshar mang po byas/ yid chad drag po lan brgyad tsam btang yang / log lta skad cig tsam yang ma sgyes pa ltar/ bla mas bka' bkyon brdung btsog brgya stong byas kyang 269

log lta ma skye bar da dung spro bzhin zhabs tog sgrub nus pa'i slob ma zhig dgos/ sngon nā ro pas te lo bsten dus/ g.yang la mchongs pa dang / me'i dkyil du 'dug pa sogs dka' chen bcu gnyis dka' phran bcu gnyis spyod dgos pa byung yang /bka' gcig kyang ma bcag par sgrub pa ltar/ bla mas bka' gang phebs la bzang ngan dang blang dor mi byed pa ji bzhin sgrub pa zhig dgos/ sngon 'phags pa rtag tu ngus byang sems chos 'phags la chos kyi yon dbul snyam/ de'i ched du lus kyi pab/sa pa khrag dang rus pa gzhan la btsongs pa dang / byang sems chos 'phags kyi chos 'chad sar chus chag chag gdab snyam/ chu btsal bas bdud kyis spas nas chu ma rnyed par/ byang sems chos 'phags kyi sku la rdul phog gis dogs nas/ rang gi rtsa chen rnams su khrag bstar nas chag chag btab/ de bzhin du tshong dpon gye bu mo lnga brgyas kyang / lus kyi khrag gis sa la chag chag btab/ de bzhin du bla ma'i phyir longs spyod smos ci dgos/bla ma mnyes na mig dang snying bton nas 'bul dgos kyang spu tsam mi chags par 'bul nus pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i slob ma snod ldan zhig byung na/ bla ma ji ltar ngan rung phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams bla ma ngan pa de'i lus la zhugs nas mchod pa gang 270

phul bzhes/ slob ma'i rgyud byen gyis brlabs nas sangs rgya bar 'gyur/ 'o na slob ma snod ldan de 'dra ba rnyed dka' bas ma rnyed na ji ltar bya snyam na/ sngon dge bshes po to ba'i drung du mi re 'ong tsa na mi gzhi ci 'dra gsungs/ der mi gzhan gyes mi gzhi rang 'bring nge ba zhig gda'/ shes rab ni che ba zhig gda' byas tsa na/ kho bo slob ma'i dmyal bar bsgyur ba'i gnyer ma mchis/ da lta nas khres po khur la rgyug gsungs/ mi gzhi ni grogs su btub pa zhig gda'/ dad pa dang shes rab chung ngu gda' byas tsa na/ dad pa 'dus byas yin pas skyes 'tshal/shes rab chung yang ma shes na ngas lan/ mi byed na khos lan gsungs skad/ des na yon tan gzhan ma tshang na yang / mi gzhi bzang po lha 'dra ba zhig gal che/ gal te de 'dra yang ma byung na chos dang bla ma la dad pa yod na chos bshad pa'i snod du rung zhes dam pa gong ma 'ga' zhig gis gsungs/ 'o na slob ma snod dang ldan pa des bla ma ji ltar bsnyen dgos snyam na bsam pa dad gus kyi sgo nas bsten tshul ni/ sngon rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis snyigs dus gdul bya'i snang ngor nga nyid slob dpon gzugs su 'ong gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom lda na 'das mya ngan las 'da' khar nye gnas kun dga' bos mya 271

ngan mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas kyis zhal nas/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' po/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snyigs dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog dman 'bring gsum bzang ngan sna tshogs kyi tshul bzung nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad gsungs pas/ des na nga'i bla ma 'di bdag cag rnams kyi snang ngor rnam pa mi'i gzugs su shar yang / ngo bo dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du/sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad pa snying thag pa nas bya/ 'o na sangs rgyas ni skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yin pa la bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la la ni thugs gtum/ la la ni phyogs lhung che/ la la ni bslab pa g.yel/ la la ni mkhyen pa chung ba sogs skyon ni mang po snang / sbyin dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan rgya chen po ni mthong rgyu mi snang bas sangs rgyas dngos ma yin no snyam na/ de rang snang ma dag pa yin/ rang snang ma dag na/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi ci mdzad thams cad dge slong legs skar gyis skyon gyi phung por mthong ste yon tan ci yang ma mthong bas/ mi lo bcu gnyis bar du 272

khyod g.yog byas/ /yon tan til 'bru tsam zhig ngas ma mthong /zer ba byung / sngon rje btsun byams pas rgyal ba shākya thub pa dbu'i cod pan du 'bral med mdzad pa 'khor rnams kyis dngos su ma mthong bar byang chub mchod rten zhig tu mthong /slob dpon zla grags kyis spyan ras gzigs dbu thog tu bzhugs su bcug khyer nas phyogs thams cad du phebs te/nga'i spyi bo na 'phags pa bzhugs so/ /phyag mchod gyis byas pas/la las ci yang ma mthong / la las khye ror mthong phal che bas chos mang du bshad pas rlung smyo yin zer/ chang tshong ma zhig gi zhabs tsam mthong bas kyang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par gsungs/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng bar gzigs pa dang / me tri pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha ba ri ba phag gsod pa sogs mi 'tshams par byed par mthong ba dang / nā ro pas te lo pa nya gson bsreg byed pa sogs smyon pas spyod par mthong ba dang /dge tshul tshem bu pas rdo rje phag mo mdze mor mthong ba dang /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas rdo rje phag mo phag dzi mor mthong ba dang / slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen khyem btsun rgad po mgo la chos gos dkris 273

nas rmo rmod cing / rol nang gi sems can mang po chu nang du 'tshod par mthong ba sogs dam pa gong ma rnams la yang mthong snang ma dag pa de 'dra byung na/ las dang nyon mongs pas sgrib pa'i gting du lhung ba bdag la mthong snang log pa de 'dra 'byung ba smos ci dgos snyam du dad pa bya/ yang cha gcig na bla ma rnams kyis bdag cag gdul bya ma dag pa rnams kyi ched du de lta bu sprul yang srid de/ sngon tshong dpon gyi bu gzhon nu nor bzang gis drang srong rgyal ba'i drod kyi gsung ltar/ rgyal po me la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa zhur phyin pas/ rgyal po me khri la bzhugs te/ blon po stong phrag bcu dang / gshed ma'i mi dmyal srung 'dra ba 'jigs 'jigs mang pos nyes can gyi mi mang po'i mig bton rkang lag mgo bo gcod pa sogs khrims gcod par mthong bas/ rgyal po me 'di 'dra la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa zhu rgyu ci yod snyam pas/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis khyod drang srong rgyal ba'i drod kyi gsung mi dran nam smras pas/ nor bzang gis rgyal po me la bskor ba lan gsum byas pas/ rgyal pos nang du khred nas/ nga ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar sgyu ma'i rol ba la mnga' ba brnyes pa ste/ ngas yul mi rnams nyes pa la 'jigs nas mi dge ba las ldog phyir 'di lta bur sprul ba 274

yin gsungs/ sngon li yul gyi dge tshul gnyis kyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs lo bcu gnyis su sgrub kyang zhal ma gzigs pas/'phags pa thugs rje re chung byas pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs nam mkhar byon nas/ nga dang khyed la las 'brel med/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po kha ba can na srong btsan sgam por skye ba bzhes nas yod/ der song gsungs pas/ bod du 'ongs pas stod lung gi mdar rgyal pos chad pas bcad pa'i mgo dang rkang lag dan 'bag gi gur gseb na/ mgo'i ra ba mig gi phung po dang / rkang lag gi 'bal khang mthong nas/ 'jam dpal yang bdud du thal/ sprul ba ci'i sprul ba srog gcod kyi rgyal por 'dug snyam phyir log pa rgyal pos mkhyen nas/ slar bkug nas mjal bas nga bod kyi ār+ya pa lo yin/ yid mi ches na 'di la ltos gsungs/ dbu'i thod shig nas a mi de bstan/ngas gdul bya 'di nams zhi bas mi thul bas/ sprul ba'i mi la sprul ba'i chad pa gcod pa yin/ sems can la gnod pa byed pa min/ da khyed gnyis ci 'dod dris pas/ khong gnyis da dung yid ma ches par dngos grub ma zhus/ sngar gyi yul du sleb pa zhig 'dod zer/ 'o na rgyags phyi'i snod bye ma'i khong la nyol gsungs pas/ de ltar byas nyal bas rang gi li yul gyi brag phug 275

sgo rtsar sleb 'dug bye ma yang gser du gyur/ dge tshul de gnyis dang por log rtog ma skyes na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob rgyu yin pa la/ tshe der dngos grub de las ma thob/ skye ba de'i 'og rol tu dgra bcom pa rgyan med thob par gsungs/sngon yab sras mjal dus su de bzhin gshegs pa bdud dang /spyon pa/ zha bo/ 'dod chags can/ rmongs pa sogs su sprul nas 'gro don mdzad par gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal po sdig can gye rgyal srid 'phrogs te rang gi rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong bar gsungs/des na bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams kyi rang re dug gsum gye gzhan dbang kho nar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams dang rigs mthun pa'i tshul gyi don mdzad pa la ma dag pa'i snang tshul de 'dra ched du gnyer nas bstan pa yang yin snyam la dad pa bya/ yang yon tan yod kyang dgos ched gzhan yod tshe med pa'i tshul ston srid de/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis dus gsum gsal ler mkhyen yang / bdud kyis sgogs rdo 'phen kha bar du ma mkhyen pa'i tshul gnang / 'phangs pas zhabs kyi mthe'u chung bsnad pas tshul bstan/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu dzu 'phrul la thogs pa med rung / mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyi 'dam bu'i tshal ltar 276
