bcom dus rdzu 'phrul mi mnga' ba'i tshul mdzad nas bcom du bcug gzhan gyis khyed kyis de dus rdzu 'phrul mi byed pa byas pas/ las kyi bcoms nas rdzu ba rang yang ma dran na 'phrul ba lta ci smos gsungs/ des na bdag gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams la yang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan khyad par can mnga' na yang / dgos pa gzhan 'dra yod na mi mnga' ba'i tshul mdzad pa yang yin snyam du bsam la dad pa 'gyur med bya/ sngon dge bshes lha bzo la stod lung pas mjal res kyi bka' bkyon byed pa la/ lha bzo'i slob ma nyag mo bas slob dpon 'dis 'o skol dpon slob la sdang ba zhig 'dug byas pas/ khyod kyis bka' bkyon du go 'am/ kho bo la 'di lta bu mdzad res kyi te ru ga'i byin gyes rlabs pa 'dra zhig 'ong gsungs/ de bzhin du bla mas rtas/ tu brnyas shing bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs ci byung yang thugs khros pa yin mi bsam par/rang la rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad 'dra yod pa rnams zhi ba'i phyir bka' bsgo byin rlabs mdzad pa yin/ yang cha gcig na/ sngon rje mi lar mar pas bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs gnang ba thugs kyis dor ba ma yin par thugs la btags pa'i rtags su rjes nas gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag 277

sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba ltar/ de bzhin du nga'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'dis dngos su thugs khro ba ltar mdzad nas bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs sogs gnang ba snying nas thugs la 'dogs pa'i rtags yin shin tu bzang snyam du lhag par dad pa bya/ sngon mar pas mi lar sku rgyab pa rgal mig gsum tsam byung ba'i bar du sras mkhar dgu thog brtsig tu bcug pa/ phar bltas na lho brag mar pa'i sras kyi ched ltar snang yang / don gyi rjes su mi la'i las sgrib sbyong phyir ma gtogs/ mar pa la rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa/de bzhin du bla mas rang la las ka mang po gcig phyir gcig mthud nas bcol rung / bla ma'i ched yin snyam du mi bsam par/rang gi las sgrib sbyong phyir 'di ltar mdzad pa bka' drin re che snyam du lhag par dad bzhin du bsgrub par bya/ sngon lho brag mar pa dpon slob kha shas 'bul bsdud du byon pas/ sbyin bdag 'ga' res na bza' gsar ba phul ba yang sku la ma bzhes par snod du bcug pas/ slob ma zhig gis khong phyag rdzas la ser sna che bar 'dug snyam nas/ na bza' sku la bzhes na legs zhus pas/ ngas btsong nas nor kun gser du sgril nas rgya gar gye bla ma rnams la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te gdams ngag bod la 278

bsgyur snyam/ gyon nas rnying na gzhan gyes mi nyo zhing rin thang chung snyam pas ma gyon gsungs pas/ slob ma des phral du ser sna che ba ltar mdzad kyang / phugs kyis dgongs gzhi ni 'di 'dra 'dug skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad spyod kyi dgongs pa ni lon dka' bar 'dug snyam sngar bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa byung / de bzhin du rang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phyag du nor rdzas la chags zhen dang ser sna che ba 'dra ba mdzad pa la mi dad pa byed rgyu mi 'dug phugs kyis dgongs gzhi ni gang yin mi shes snyam du lhag par dad pa bya/ de ltar bla mas ci mdzad thams cad legs par bltas nas rtag tu sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i 'gyur med kyi dad pa brtan po yod na/ bla ma bzang po smos ci dgos ngan pa tshad med kyi las byed mkhan zhig yin yang slob ma la phan thogs te/ sngon pha ma dang slob dpon dgra bcom pa gsod pa'i dge slong lha chen po zhes bya bas mi'i yul gzhan du song nas/ kho bo dgra bcom pa zhig yin smras dzun gtam chos bshad pas slob ma dgra bcom mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa mang po byung skad/ yang bla ma la 'gyur med kyi dad pa yod na bla mas chos log par bstan yang slob ma dmyal bar skyur mi srid de/ sngon bram ze zhig la slob ma 279

gzugs mdzes sems bzang skad snyan zhig yod par/ bram ze'i chung ma chags nas slob dpon med shul du slob ma'i mgul du khyud nas 'o byas pas slob mas de mi rung zhes chags pa ma spyad pa la mo ngan sems skyes nas gdong rnams la spar shad byas/ slob dpon 'ong tshe khyod kyi grwa pas khyod med shul du nga la chags pa spyod du 'ongs pa ngas spyod du ma bcugs pas gdong yang 'di ltar song byas pas/ bram ze yang ngan sems skyes te/ slob ma la khyod kyis mi stong bsad nas sor mo'i 'phreng ba zhig thogs na sangs rgya zhes bshad pas/ slob dpon gyes gsungs bden par bzung nas mi dgu brgya dang go dgu bsad nas gcig de la gzhan ma rnyed par/ ma'i rtsar 'ongs nas da nga sangs rgyas nas ma la phan pas ma bsad kyang rung snyam/ ma gsod grabs byas pas nam mkhar sangs rgyas byon nas de ni slob dpon gyis log pa'i lam bstan pa yin pas/ de las log la legs pa'i lam la zhugs gsungs pas sangs rgyas gyis gsung ltar byas pas/ sdig pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa byung / yang dad pa yod na bla mas chos ma shes kyang gang gsungs chos su go nas rgyud grol bar 'gyur te/ sngon dge slong ri khrod pa skyabs 'gro tsam las mi shes 280

pa zhig la rgan mo dad can zhig gis chos dgos zhes yang yang nan gyes zhus pas dge slong des chos mi shes pa'i shugs kyis/mi shes pa 'di sdug bsngal zhes smra ba rgan mos chos su go mi shes pa zhes pa ma rig pa red/ sdug bsngal zer ba ma rig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'byung gsungs pa red snyam/ ma rig pa spangs pas dgra bcom zhig byung skad/ yang dad pa yod na gdams pa nor ba nyams su blangs kyang dngos grub thob ste/sngon bla ma gcig la slob ma zhig chos zhu ru phyin pas/ bla ma thugs brel te/ phyag phyir skyog byas nas/ ma ra na dzā byas pas/slob ma'i snying la ma ra na dz+ra sngags yin/ lag pa phyir skyog pa de phyag rgya yin snyam nas/ ma ra na dzā byas lag pa phyir skyog skyog byas nas sgrub pas 'grub nas/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las byed nus pa zhig byung skad/ bla ma dang gdams ngag la yid ches kyi dad pa yod na sngags dang phyag rgya de lta bu'i dngos grub de 'dra thob na/ gdams pa ma nor ba gcig sgrub na dngos grub tshegs med du thob pa sgos ci dgos/ sngon khyem bdag cig la dge slong zhig gis bsod snyoms blangs pas/ khyem bdag des khyed dgra bcom pa yin na drangs/ de min mi 'dren byas pas/ dge slong gis dgra bcom pa min zhes phyir log pas/ khyim bdag gis 281

bsams pa la/ yong 'dod pa chung tshed kyis dgra bcom yin nge sa snyam nas/ tshur byon dgra bcom pa yin rung min rung chos ston drang gis byas nas drangs pas/ dgra bcom pa zhig la drangs pa'i bsod nams thob pa byung / yang sngon rgan mo gcig gis khye'i mche ba la/ dgra bcom pa'i mche ba yin snyam nas mchod pas/ skabs shig mche ba de nas 'od zer 'phro ba 'byung /des na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas/mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs nus na/ bla ma ji ltar ngan rung slob ma'i rgyud la sangs rgyas dang khyad med pa'i byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ sngon dge bshes ya gad pa rwa sgreng na dge bshes kyis spyan sngar yod dus rmi lam la/ dge bshes kyi sku rgyab na dad gus bsgom zhing yod pa la/ zhal phyir bsgyur nas/ khyod nga'i skyon la yon tan du bsgoms dang / yon tan la yon tan du bsgoms dang / des khyod la phan nam mi phan blta gsungs pa rmis pas/ phyis bsam tshe chos de las che ba zhig ma byung gsungs/ des na bla ma'i yon tan la yon tan du blta bar ma zad/ skyon la yon tan du blta ba zhig dgos/ bla mas ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dad pa zhig med na sangs rgyas dngos bsten rung phan las gnod che ste/ sngon dge 282

slong legs pa'i skar ma zhes bya ba/ mdo sde bcu gnyis blo la yod pa/ bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nye gnas lo bcu gnyis byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can 'dul ba'i thabs dang spyod pa ci mdzad thams cad khos g.yo dang sgyu ru mthong bas/ chu bo brgal byed kyi 'gram nas dngos su sa'i mthongs phre nas sems can dmyal bar song skad/ de bzhin du bla ma'i drung du sdod dus/ yon tan la mi blta bar/ bla ma'i skyon rtog shin bsdad na/ 'gro sa dmyal ba las 'os med/ des na dang po chos 'brel ma byas tsa na/ gang zag des skyon yon legs par brtag dgos pa yin/ de nas gang zag de bla mar bsten chos 'brel bzhag nas bzung / bla ma de ci 'dra zhig yin rung mdzad spyod ji ltar snang yang / sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag la/ ci mdzad thams cad yon tan 'ba' zhig tu blta dgos/ des na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad pa 'di shin tu gal che ste/ sngon jo bo la 'brom ston pas/ bod na bsgom sgrub byed pa mang po yod pa la yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa mi bdog zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ theg chen gyi yon tan che skyes chung skyes thams cad bla ma la brten nas skye ba la/ khyod bod bla ma la tha mal ba'i 'du shes 283

las med pa'i yon tan zhig ga nas skye gsungs/ bla mas chos kyi bka' drin dran te gus par bya tshul ni/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su/ rgyal po bye ling gang ling zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ chos tshig bzhi pa zhig thob pa'i phyir/ lus la lcags gzer stong btab pa dang / rgyal bo gan sha ni pa li zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ chos tshig bzhi pa zhig thob pa'i phyir/ lus la mar me stong btsugs pa dang / de bzhin du chos tshig bzhi pa re thos phyir/ me dong du mchongs pa dang / lus kyi pags pa shog bu rus pa smyug gu khrag gis snag tsha byas yi ge bris pa dang / chos kyi phyir rang gi btsun mo yid du 'ong ba dang / sras gces pa yang gnod sbyin gtum po la zar bcug pa dang / dpal ldan a ti shas bla ma gser gling pa la byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag gsan pa'i phyir/ rgya mtsho'i steng la gru gzings bcas nas zla bcu gsum gyi bar du byon nas dka' ba spyad pa dang / sngon gyi lo tsa ba rnams kyis kyang rgya gar gyi yul thang chen po bgrod dka' nyen che la/ gcan gzan dang dug sbrul mang zhing 'jigs pa che ba la lus srog khyad du bsad nas byon pa yin te/nags 'thug po zhig la thon dus med/ /la ring po zhig la bgrod dus med/ /gcan gzan dang chu la thar dus med/ /shing 284

sdong mi ro rengs pa 'dra/ /lam de kun gyi tsha grang bshad tsa na/ /dus da lta dran yang glo snying 'dar/ /zhes gsungs pa de lta bu'i dka' spyad mdzad dgos kyang / da lta rang res de lta bu'i dka' ba spyad mi dgos par/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams ngag rnams sba gsang med par phas bu la slob pa bzhin skyo ngal med par bslab/ sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal yang de las lhag pa zhig ston rgyu ma mchis/ rang la bu sgyes nas nyams su lon na thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa ni the tshom mi 'dug rang gi ngos nas sangs rgyas las bla ma bka' drin che bar gda'/ 'bad pa dang rtsol ba cung zad tsam yang ma dgos par bla mas zab rgyas kyi chos gang 'dod stsol ba'i bka' drin 'di gzhal dgos shig byung na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun rin po ches phyur bur bkang nas lan stong phul rung gzhal bar ga la nus snyam du bla ma'i bka' drin rnams lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma ma byung gi bar du bsam/ dus rtag tu phyag dang zhe sa gus pa khyad par can bya/ sngon 'phags pa rta thul dang / sangs rgyas gnyis stabs gcig tu bzhugs pa la/'phags pa rta thul gyi slob ma bram ze nye rgyal dang / pang nas 285

skyes gnyis khong gi spyan sngar 'ongs te/ sngon la sadas rgyas la phyag bya snyam pas/ sangs rgyas kyis zhal nas/ gang la chos ni thos gyur pa/ /de la dang por phyag bya ste/ /zla ba tshes la bram ze bzhin/ /gsungs nas/ sngon la 'phags pa rta thul la phyag gyis gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / kun gyis thog mar bla ma la rab tu gus pas phyag la sogs pa byed dgos/sngon zhogs kyi mgu mi pha bu gnyis yung bar byung ba na/ gcig gis khyed zhogs kyi mgu dang / yung ba'i bran dang / rma yul gyi gnyos dang gsum mi tshan che ba yin na/ khyed mgu mi da lta ci phod byas byas pas/ dang bo de tshugs lags te/ da lta nya nas gda' zer bas/ bu na re nga ni pha mes gang bas ngan rgyu med zer ro/ /de bzhin du bla ma las rang ngan rgyu med snyam nas nga rgyal gyi khog pa khengs nas bla ma la mi gus pa de la byen rlabs mi 'jug sngon khyung po grags sel slob ma zhang ston thugs rje bya bas bgro gleng btsugs pas bag tsam kho rgyal ba byung nas/ gzhu mkhan phyogs kyi glang po yin/ /mda' mkhan rnyarma gī rti yin/ /'phen mkhan zhang ston thugs rje yin/ /khyung po grags se snoms la gshegs/ /zer ro/ /de bzhin du bla ma la brnyas bcos dang rma 'bebs byed pa de/ bdud kyis khyer ba yin/ bla ma la thal 286

'gyur rgol zhing tshig rma phab na shi 'phos ma thag dmyal bar 'gro yong bas/ des na rtag tu sangs rgyas las kyang lhag par bla ma la gus dgos/ sbyor ba zang zing gi 'bul ba/ lus ngag gis bsnyen bkur/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma bsten tshul ni/ sngon rgyal po khri srong sde btsan rgyal blon rnams kyis rgya gar gye lo paṇa mkhas grub re re tsam gdan 'dren pa la gser gyi pa tra dang / gser phye bre la gzhal nas bsgur/ slob dpon chen po dang mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho sogs la/ chos zhu thengs re re la gser dngul sogs rin po che'i snod du ma bkang nas phul ba dang / sngon lha btsun khu dbon gyes jo bo gdan 'dren pa'i phyir lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ nag tsho lo tsā ba sogs la gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs pa dang / jo bo gdan drangs nas 'bul ba mang po btegs/ 'brom rin po ches/ jo bo la chos zhu thengs gcig la yer pa nas gser zho dgu dgu la srang re byas pa'i srang brgya dang bcu rta bzang po bco brgyad kyi mgo drangs 'bul ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa phul/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ dge bshes ston pa'i bsten tshul gye dbang du byas na/rtag tu ngu dang gnyis sku sha btang ma btang gi khyad las med pa zhig mdzad pa yin gsungs/ lho brag mar pa rgya gar du 'gro 287

thengs gsum mdzad pa re re la'ang / gser dkar yol mang po khyer nas bla ma rnams la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal kho na phul nas chos zhus pas/ khong gis longs spyod ser po gser la byas/ /sogs mgur gsungs par gda'/ sngon gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor gyes/ mar pa la sku gsung thugs rten gser g.yu mdzo rta sogs nor yod dgu chog phul nas/ bla ma rin po che spyir bdag rang gis sgo gsum bla ma la dbang na'ang / da lan ra rgan mo rkang chag gcig min nor yod kun bla ma la phul lags pas/ dbang gdams ngag zab khyad thon pa kun dang / khyad par snyan rgyud shog sgril gyis gdams ngag thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/bla ma mar pa dgyes bzhin de ltar na'ang / ra ma rkang chag de yang phul gsungs pas/ rngog gis ra ma rgyab la khur 'ongs nas phul bas bla ma shin tu dgyes te/ gsang sngags kyi slob ma dam tshig can bya ba khyod 'dra ba la zer ba yin/ nga la ra gcig rang gis dgos rgya chang ste/ chos kyi che ba 'don pa la dgos pa yin ༄ ༄gsungs/ dbang dang gdams ngag khyad par can mang po gnang / skyes rabs las/ nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi'i bar yang ring / /rgya mtsho'i pha rol tshur rol 'gram yang ring / /shar nub gnyis kyi ri bar de bas ring / /phal dang dam pa'i chos 288

kyang de bas ring / /gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni byang sems zla bas bram ze legs bshad kyi skyes khyer 'ong ba zhig la gser srang stong phul nas blangs so/ /de dag rnams bzhin rang la yod na gser dngul g.yu byu ru mdze rta bu chung ma 'khor g.yog sogs gces shing phangs pa'i dngos po gang bzang thams cad bla ma la phangs pa med par phul nas chos zhu dgos/bla ma dgyes na dngos po ngan yang phul chog de ma gtogs harang gi ngos nas bzang po yod bzhin ngan pa 'bul mi rung /sngon rtag tu ngus byang sems chos 'phags kyi phyir lus kyi sha khrag kyang phangs pa med par btang nas lus ngag gis bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang / nā ros te lo mnyes phyir lus kyi steng nas dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad pa dang / rje mi las mar pa'i bka' bzhin sras mkhar dgu thog rang gcig pus brtsigs/ yum bdag med ma'i sku g.yog chu len pa/ yos 'thag pa/ me 'bud pa/ thal ba 'phyags pa/ tha na yos brngo ba dang bzhon ma 'jo ba'i 'phong stegs tshun chad kyi mi dal ba'i bsnyen bkur byas/ yang g.yung ston khro rgyal gyi drung na gnas dus/ grogs po 'ga' yul du log pa tsha lam gcig gi bar bskyal nas tshur log pa'i lam na rta bong gi sbangs/ ba glang gi 289

lci ba/ khye lud rnams 'thu zhing 'ong bas/ 'thu ba gang rnyed pa bla ma'i gsol zhing zhig yod pa de'i khar sa khung brus shing sbas pas/ bla ma gzim khang gi steng na yod pas gzigs te/ grwa pa 'ga' la nga la sngar slob ma ji snyed cig byung ste/ ma ki bas sha tsha ba ma byung da dung mi yong gsungs/ de bzhin du bla ma la sku mnye dril phyi gdan 'bul snyung g.yog bskor ba dang / phyag dang /ldang ba dang / 'dud pa dang / bsu skyel dang / las dang / khur dang / bang chen mngag gzhug sogs bka' gang phebs thugs gang dgyes phan gang thogs pa rnams lus srog la mi blta bar sgrub par bya/ sngon rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pa a na ka ra badz+ra sid+dhi dang / slob ma sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i lo rgyus ltar/ bla ma dgyes shing don du 'gyur na/ bla ma bsad kyang slob ma la nyes par mi 'gyur gyi steng du/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i phan yon 'byung / de lta bu ma yin par bla ma mi dgyes na chos shig yin rung re zhig 'jog dgos/ sngon rje btsun mi las dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi nas brgyad cu gya bzhi'i bar du bla ma'i bka' bzhin mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams su bsgom thag lus dang ma bral ba byas pa mdzad pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag pa khri mchog dgung lo sum cu pa la jo bo 290

rje dang mjal te gdams ngag zhus nas bsgom pa'i tshe/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dus de ring nas ming yang yid la ma byed/ rus kyang yid la ma byed par byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig bsgom gsungs pa/ de khong gi thugs la bzhag nas/rwa sgreng gi shugs gseb na phar ri dwags rnams dang khyad par med par bzhugs nas/ mi su gang dang gdong phrad tsam yang mi mdzad par sku tshe 'da' ru bcug skad/ de bzhin du bla ma'i bkang bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'bul bar bya/ 'o na bla ma bsten dus chos ji ltar zhu snyam na/ sngon gang po gzhis la bsdad nas/ phu bo gsum byes su tshong la song ba dang / mna' ma rnams kyi rgyags dang gos gang pos sbyin pa las/ mna' ma chen mo dus la mkhas pas/ kha sha ras sgo phye tsa na/ bu kun slong du btang bas sbyin nas byung / res phra mos sgo phye ba'i dus slong du btang bas sbyin nas byung / mna' ma gzhan gnyis po dus la mi mkhas pas 'gran nas slong du btang bas/kha sha ras sgo bcad nas/ bu ram gyi sgo phye ba dang phrad bu ram gyi snyim pa bkang nas btang / yang res slong du btang bas/ras sbom pos sgo phye ba dang phrad nas sbom po byen pas/ ma dga' ste 'khang ngo / /de bzhin du bla ma la chos zhu ba yang /291

thugs dam grol ba dang / sku khams dwangs pa/ thugs rnal du phebs pa spro zhing dgyes pa'i dus su gdams ngag legs par zhus na yong / thugs dam la gnod pa dang / sku khams ma bde ba/ thugs brel che ba dang / thugs mi dgyes pa'i dus su mi zhu/de ltar ma byas na chos mi thob pa'i khar bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs kyang yong ste/ sngon ston pa ku shur pa khu tshan gnyis kyis phyi phyag la byon pas/ dge bshes po to ba brag rgyab pa'i chos dbye gsal byed pa'i thugs brel nas 'dug pa la/ gding ba bting nas phyag byas pa la/ nga'i sba mkhar de khyo gshog dang /rkang gnyis mchog gyur 'di brel ma brel 'di la phyag stobs pa gsungs sku rgyab tu ber ka rgyab pa byung / bla ma thugs mi dgyes na nan gyis gdams ngag zhus nas gnang rung mi legs te/ sngon po to ba la gcig gis mi dgyes bzhin du jo bo mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs zhus pas/ cher ma lon par shi bas/ phu chung pa'i zhal nas nga'i de kho na lan snyam gsungs skad/ de bas na chos gyi dpe kun yang ma zhus par thabs kyis thob pa dang / rku ba sogs byas na phan mi thogs/ sngon dge bshes ston pas chos gcig brir bcug par bri mkhan gyis kyang gcig bris yod zhus pas/ 'o na des phan mi thogs gzhan zhig la byen la/ da nga la 292

zhus la gcig bris gsungs skad/ de bas na bla ma ci mnyes byas nas gdams ngag rnams len dgos/ de ltar byas na chos des rang gzhan gnyis gar phan thogs pa yong / 'o na bla ma yun ji tsam bsten snyam na/ sngon pha gcig la bu bzhi yod pa'i chung ba'i ming la gang po zer ba la/ lan gcig pha 'chi ba'i dus na/ bu rnams la shing 'gal ba re re khyer shog la mer thongs shig zer/bu tshos de ltar byas pas me chen po 'bar ba la/ pha na re/ da mi re res shing 'gal ba re re so sor khyer zhig zer/ de ltar byas pas mi de shi bas/ pha na re/ 'o bu tsho shing tsho sogs na me yod la/so sor khyed na mi shi ba bzhin du khyed rang spun tsho mthun na legs la/ so sor song na me shi ba dang 'dra'o zhes kha chems phogayang bu che thag la skog tu/ khyed tsho ye ma 'bral cig brgya la 'bral na yang / khyod dang gang po gnyis ma 'bral cig gang po 'di bsod nams las grub pa zhig 'dug zer nas pha shi bas/spun gzhan dang bral yang / phu bo gang po dang ma bral bas/nyin gcig mi gcig gis shing mi nya'am zer ba gang pos bltas pas/ gseb na tsan dan gor shi ṣa zhig 'dug pa mthong nas shing khur de nyos te btsongs pas tsan dan des yo byad mang po khugs/ de nas phu bo phyi'i rgya mtsho la tsan dan 'don du 293

phyin pas/ tsan dan bsrung ba'i gnod sbyin rnams gyis tshor nas/ gru sbub nas tsan dan 'phrogs par 'dug pa 'phags pa gang pos mkhyen nas dzu 'phrul gyis gru khar phyon nas gnod pa las skyabs pa sogs gang po la brten nas phu bos don kun 'grub pa byung / de bzhin du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang 'grogs rgyu'i skal ba byung na thag nye ring 'tshams par byas/ tshe gang por bsten na chos la bar chad med cing don thams cad 'grub nas 'ong / de lta bu'i skal ba ma byung yang /sngon jo bo chen pos bla ma gser gling pa lo bcu gnyis bsten pa dang / rab tu ma byung ba'i dus kyi bla ma a wa dhu ti ba dgung lo phyed dang brgyad kyi bar du bsten pa dang / 'brom gyes jo bo se btsun/ jo bo rje/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug sogs lo bco brgyad bsten pa dang / mar pas nā ro pa lo bcu lhag bsten pa dang / mi las mar pa lo drug zla mthong brgyad tsam bsten pa sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ gdams ngag rdzogs kyang sems la brtan pa ma thob bar du bla ma lo zla ba byas nas bsten pa ltar mtshan ldan gyi bla ma yun bsrengs nas bsten dgos/ chos thob ma thag nas gang dgar phyin na bdud kyis 'khyer te/ sngon rgyal ba'i btsun pa spun gnyis kyi gcig dad pa 294

dang shes rab che yang / bla ma dang ma 'grogs pas tshong pa gcig las ma byung / mjug tu grir shi gcig dad pa dang shes rab chung yang bla ma dang 'grogs pas bzang po zhig tu byung skad/ ras chung pas rje btsun la kho bo dbus la 'gro ba yin zhes zhu ba nan gyes phul bas/ rje btsun gye zhal nas/ bu ras chung pa nyams dang rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bla ma'i drung nas ma 'phags shig lar rang bu ma'i rtsar bsdad na bskyed che/ sgong nga ma'i drod la btsos na rdol sla/ bsgom chen bla ma'i drung du gol sa med pa yin/ mi nyan par 'gro na song /khyod la dbus kyi khye mo zhig rkang pa la 'ju ba 'dug pas/ de dus bla ma dang nyams len ma brjed gsungs pa'i lung bstan pa ltar/ yar lung lha lcam gyis bslus pa byung / phyis rje btsun gyis thabs kyis bral thabs mdzad/ sngon mi zhig gis zhing rmos nas glang gi skye thag bkrol nas btang bas/ glang rang khyem du ma song bar lam log cig tu phyin pas/ mi yis khrid nas bsad skad/ de bzhin du bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed kyin mi sdod par/ phral rang gang dgar phyin na bdud kyis khyer nas chos ma go mthar mi thon pas chos brgyad sogs rkyen bzang ngan gang gis g.yo mi nus 295

pas sems la brtan pa ma thob bar du bla ma dang 'bral med 'grogs par bya'o/ /'o na bla ma tshul bzhin bsten na phan yon ci 'byung snyam na/ sngon 'phags pa rtag tu ngus sher phyin gyi gdams pa tshol ba'i tshe/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo yid la ma byas/bkres pa dang skom pa yid la ma byas/ tsha ba dang grang ba yid la ma byas/ lus dang srog la ma bltas par btsal bas/ byang sems chos 'phags dang mjal nas sher phyin gye gdams pa thob nas bsgoms pas ring bor mi thogs par lam bzhi rgyud la skyes pa byung / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya dang bcu gnyis bsten nas bka' bzhin du brtson 'grus chen pos nan tan byas pas/ don thams cad 'grub pa byung / nye gnas kun dga' bos sangs rgyas la zhabs tog tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i mthus/ nyin gcig tsam las bsgom ma dgos par dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa byung / dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa phyag pa khri mchog dgung lo sum cu la jo bo chen po dang mjal gdams ngag thob nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ rtsig pa dang ra ba la thogs pa med par gshegs pa byung / yang sngon nā ro pas te lo pa lo bcu gnyis la bsten nas/296

dka' chen bcu gnyis sogs spyad cing / chos zhus pas ye ma gnang yang mos gus ma log par bsnyen bkur byas pas/ nyin gcig gdong la zhabs tho rgyab pas brgyal song bas mthar chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum du gzigs pa byung / de nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de tshe der sangs rgyas kyi sar gshegs/de bzhin du bla ma la mos gus byas/ lus srog la mi blta bar/bsnyen bkur byed nus na bla mas chos thun gcig ma bshad/slob mas nyams len zhag gcig ma byas kyang / bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas slob ma'i rgyud rang shugs kyis grol ba mang /gzhan yang mi las mar pa bsten dus su gsung bzhin dka' spyad drag po mdzad pas/ sngar mthus mi mgo sum cu so lnga dang /ser bas srog chags phra mo bgrang gis mi lang ba bsad pa'i sdig pa dag cing / lo phyed dang brgyad bsgoms pa'i mthar phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas nam mkha' la dngos su 'phur ba byung / sa skya paṇa chen gyis rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig zhus pas/ khyod nga la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi skye khu bo'i 'du shes skye/ dka' thub kyi zhabs tog kyang mi nus gsungs nas ma gnang / phyis khong la 'chi ltas shig byung khams kyang ma bde ba la/ de skabs bla ma'i 297

sku khams kyang ma bde ba zhag 'ga' byung / de dus rang na rung khong gi snyung g.yog zhabs tog 'ba' zhig byas pas sdig pa dag pas bla mas kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang / bla ma 'phags pa 'jam dpal du mngon sum mthong ba byung / 'chi ltas kyang grol/ khams kyang bde ba byung / de nas bla ma'i byen rlabs zhugs te/ dka' tshegs med par phyi ru thos bsam gyi sgo 'dogs chod/ nang du yang dag pa'i rtogs pa skyes/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyis byams pa byung / rgya nag rgyal po sogs dregs pa can thams cad kyis chos zhu ba dang gtsigs che ba byung bas/ gzhan dag gis kyang de ltar byas na tshogs rgya chen bo rdzogs par 'dug gsungs/ sngon jo bo chen pos lan cig byib/ pa chung ngu ltar gzim khang phyi sa chung ngu mang pos gang bar mdzad pa/'brom ston pas ci mi snyam par thams cad phyags nas gtsang sing ba zhig mdzad pas bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad tshun gyi sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rnam pa wal gyes mkhyen pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa rgya chen po brnyes/ 'brom gyis jo bo la da snga'i bya ba rnams chos su song ngam ma song zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis bla ma se btsun gyi g.yog byas pa de tsam lam du ma song / gzhan lam du song gsungs/ dge bshes snyug 298

rum pa'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pas nga la gnod pa mi byed/ 'jig rten pas ni nga la mi tshugs gsungs pa ste/ bla ma la mos gus yod pa'i phan yon yin gsungs/ dge bshes de'i rtsar nad pa zhig byung ba la/ khong rang gi thugs dam bdud rtsi 'khyel ba de dkram nas phyag gsum mdzad pas nad pa de la skad ngan chen po byung bas/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ngas bla ma la gsol ba btab pa yin gsungs/ nad pa de tshigs nas drag pa byung skad/ des na bla ma la snyung g.yog sogs byas pa dang / mos gus tsam byas na yang tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs nas nyams rtogs 'char zhing / bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa 'byung / gzhan yang sngon bya thams cad kyis gyi mi gol gyi bu mo bdos pa la/ gyi mi gol gyi bya rnams la nam 'phangs su mtho ba zhig khyer zhig byas pas/ der pha wang gis bsam pa la/ nam 'phangs rgod mtho snyam/ nub mo bya rgod kyi spu gseb tu yib nas bsdad/ nangs par bya rnams nam 'phangs bcad pas/ bya rgod kho na mtho ste/ der ldog mtshams su pha wang bya rgod kyi spu gseb nas thon te ya tshad 'phur nas/a pa nga mtho byas pas/ gyi mi gol gyi bu mo thob skad/ de pha wang gi nus pa min/ bya rgod kyi nus pa yin/ de bzhin du 'o skol 299

thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa la/ rang la nus pa ci yang med rung / bla ma 'khor ba las 'phags pa zhig bsten zhing / de'i thugs zin par byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs ji tsam rdol ba de'i zhor la mos gus byed pa'i slob ma de yang mi grol mi srid gsungs/ sngon zhang zhung gi mi gcig dang / bod gnyis 'grogs nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la/ zhang zhung gi mi de la rgyags nas gtsang ma'i phye mang po yod/bod de la sran phye bre bzhi las med pa/ bod des 'u rang gnyis kyis phye bsres la za'am byas pas/ zhang zhung na re/ khyed kyi phye nyung ba dang nga'i phye mang bas mi bsre zer ba la/ des nga rang gi phye zad tshod nas mi za byas pas/ 'o na rung zer te bsres nas/kha gting thams cad dkrugs nas zos pas/ zhag 'ga' lon nas da khyod kyi phye kha sang du zad/ da khyed ma za zer ba la/ bod na re/ nga'i phye zad mtshams nas mi za bar chod pa yin te/ nga'i phye da rung ma zad sran ma tshig ge ba 'di thams cad nga'i phye yin zer ro/ /der zad zad bar mnyam por zos skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rang res dge ba logs su byas pa bas bla ma'i dge sbyor dang tshogs gsog mdzad pa'i gseb tu rang gi yo byad phra mo sran phye'i tshul du btab nas btang zhing / bla ma'i 300

las dang bya ba dang / las chen mngag gzhug la sogs pa byas na de bsod nams che ba yin/ bla ma'i tshogs ji tsam rdzogs pa de tsam du rang gis kyang tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur te/ bde ba'i 'bras bu la bla ma dang mnyam du longs spyad chog par gsungs/sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyi lud pa klu'i byang chub kyis blangs nas khar bcug pas/ de nyid dus dang po'i bden pa mthong skad/ de bzhin du rang res kyang bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis mos gus byas shing / bla ma'i mchil snabs la sogs pa tshun chad la gces spras byas na dngos grub tshegs med du thob par 'gyur/ sngon gling ras pas 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i zhal mjal ba'i mod la rtogs pa phyi grol nang grol du song bas/ rje phag mo gru pas chu bo gang gā phan la sa ra ha chen po rtogs pa mtho/ de tshun la khyod rtogs pa mtho ba yin zhes bsngags/ de bzhin du skal ldan las 'phro can mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal ma thag rtogs grol dus gcig tu 'gyur ba yang mang bas/ rang re de lta bu ma byung yang bla ma bsten na yon tan rim gyis skyes nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur nges/ des na phan yon de dang de 'dra rnams la bsams nas bla ma bsten pa la 'bad par bya/ 'o na bla ma ru bsten nas bsten tshul nyes na skyon ci 301

'byung snyam na/ bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa sku la bdo ba phar zhogatha na rten 'brel cung zad re 'chug pa dang / bka' re bcag pa dang mi mos pa byung ba dang / ma gus pa cung zad re shor na yang skyon chen po 'byung ste/ sngon mar pa nā ro'i drung du gzims pas tho rangs paṇa chen nā ro pas yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje dang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor khra lam mer sprul nas/ bu mar ston chos kyi blo gros ma nyal bar yar longs dang / nam mkha' la khyod rang gi yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yang phebs 'dug khyod nga la phyag 'tshal lam yi dam la phyag 'tshal gsungs pas/ mar pas yi dam dgyes rdor rten dang brten par bcas pa la phyag 'tshal bas/ nā ro'i zhal nas/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bskal ba stong gi sangs rgyas kyang / /bla ma dag la bsten sa byung / /yi dam bla ma'i sprul ba yin/ /gsungs shing dkyil 'khor thugs gar bstem/ de'i rten 'brel gnad kyis khyod la mi brgyud ring po mi yong ste/ rten 'brel de yang sems can gye skal ba yin gsungs pa'i lung bstan ltar/ sras dar ma mdo sde gshegs par gyur/ sngon rje btsun mi las zangs shig mar pa la 'bul dus stong par phul 302

pa'i rten 'brel de la brtags nas mar pas khyod kyis nga la zangs stong par phul ba des/ khyod sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe/ 'tsho ba dkren tsam yong ba 'dug ste/ 'on kyang tshe smad dang bu brgyud la longs spyod chen po 'byung ba'i phyir mchod me mar khus bkang nas mchod khang du bzhag pa'i rten 'brel gyis tshe smad dang bu brgyud la longs spyod 'byung gsungs pa ltar/ tshe stod sgrub pa byed dus dka' thub byed dgos byung / des na bla ma bsten pa dang chos zhu ba'i dus sogs la rten 'brel cung zad re 'chugs pa'i skyon de 'dra 'byung na/ chen po 'chug na smos ci dgos/ sngon rje btsun gyis dbus pa ston pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ zhi ba 'od gsum la rmi lam sgugs shig nangs par pha rgan ngas rmi lam brtag gis gsungs/ ston pas sems can mang po'i srog bcad nas 'gams pa rmi lam ngan zhus pas/khyod kyis sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol bar gda' gsungs/ zhi ba 'od kyis shar nas nyi ma zhig shar 'ongs pa snying khar thim pa rmis pa zhus pas/ khyod sems bskyed chung bas 'gro ba la phan cher mi 'byung / khyod rang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gda' gsungs/ ras chung pas lung ba chen po gsum du phyin nas skad chen po bton pa rmis zhus pas/ khyod ro gyong ba'i 303

stabs kyis nga'i bka' lan gsum bcag pas/ lung ba gsum du skye ba brgyud nas/ dge bshes rgyang du grags pa gsum du 'gyur bar gda' gsungs/ sngon slob dpon dza lan rnya ras/nag po spyod pa la/ khyod de wa'i ko ṭir ma 'gro bar/ sa phyogs gzhan zhig na za ma tog cig yod pas kha ma 'byed par khyer shog gsungs par/ bka' bcag nas za ma tog gi kha phye/ de wa'i ko ṭir song bas ci bsams ma 'grub par myur du sku grongs/ des na bla ma'i bka' bcags ci bsam mi 'grub/ tshe la bar chad kyang 'byung / sngon kha che'i dge 'dun bzang po la dbyeg gnyen gyis theg pa chung ngu'i chos rdzogs par gsan nas/phyis gcen slob dpon thogs med kyi rjes su 'brang nas theg chen du gyur pa na/ sngar gyi rang gi slob dpon kha che dge 'dun bzang po'i chos la ma mos par khong gi grub mtha' thams cad sun phyung bas slob dpon thugs ma mnyes phebs pa dbyeg gnyen gyes go nas yul mtha' 'khob bal yul du bros nas 'ongs sku grongs pa'i tshul bstan/ des na bla mas gsungs pa'i chos la mi mos par log lta skyes/ thugs mi mnyes pa byas na tshe 'dir yang tshe'i dus byed par 'gyur/ sngon dge bshes dgon pa ba'i 'khor zhig bsam du ma btub par/ dge bshes kyis 'o 304

na 'di ltar soms dang gsungs nas thabs mang du bslabs par skyed tsam ma byung ba la/ dar cig tshom me bzhugs nas khyod kyis sngar slob dpon du gyur pa la ma gus pa byas pa med dam gsungs/ de lta bu zhig mchis zhus pas da lta yod dam med gsungs/ da lta yod zhus pas/ 'o na de la bsnyen bkur gyis bzod gsol gyis gsungs pas/ de ltar byas nas bsams pas btub pa byung / dge bshes rnal 'byor pa chen po mal gro na bzhugs dus/ jo bo zhig khams ma bde bar ci byas kyang ma phan nas/ dge bshes kyis khyod kyis rmi lam ci 'dra rmis dris pas/ la ma'i me mdag dmar nyil nyil ba kho na rmi zer bas 'o na khyod kyis slob dpon 'dra la ma gus pa byas pa min nam gsungs pas/ gzhan med 'di lta bu zhig la ma gus pa byas te/khong rang yang nyams nas 'di ltar du song zer bas 'o na khyod song la bsnyen bkur dang bzod gsol gyis gsungs pas/de ltar byas pas khams sangs kyis song bar gda'/ des na bla ma bzang ngan gang la yang ma gus pa tsam re byas na yang skyon che ba 'byung bas mi byed pa gal che/ gal te byas song na de ma thag bla ma'i drung du song nas bsnyen bkur byas bshags sdom byed pa gal che/ 'o na bla ma de zhal ma bzhugs na ci bya snyam na/305

brag rgyab kyi bsgom pa rgya smon bya bas/ dge bshes ston pa la sngar bla mar gyur pa la ma gus pa byas shing / de mnyes par ma byas pa la da lta mnyes par bya ba'i yul du ma gyur te/ 'das sam yul thag ring bar phyin nas dad gus byas na/ srog dang tshangs spyod kyi bar chad du gyur na/ de la ci ltar bgyi zhus pas/dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ de'i thabs kyi mchog 'di yin spyir bla ma rnams kyi chos sku la tha dad med pas ngo bo gcig yin par bsams la/ da lta rang gi mngon sum du gyur pa'i bla ma rnams la/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang rim gro sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'bad pa byas la bla ma de ci mnyes byas na/ sngar bla mar gyur pa la ma gus pa'i las kyi sgrib pa de byang ba yin pas/ de ltar mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma de la gus pa'i sgo nas bsnyen zhing mnyes par byas la/ ma 'ongs pa na bla ma dang phrad pa'i smon lam rgyun du gdab gsungs pa ltar bya/ mdor na srid zhi'i bde skyid thams cad chos byas pa las 'byung zhing / chos de ni bla ma las 'byung bas na/ rten 'brel gyi sgo dang po bla ma bsten tshu'/ 'chugs na yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba chad pas/ lus dang srog la babs kyang mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam yang mi byed cing /sngar thugs dang 'gal ba byung ba la bshags sdom mang du bya/ 306

lus longs spyod gang gi sgo nas bla ma mnyes pa la dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ltar rtag tu 'bad par bya'o/ / de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che la dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len dgos tshul ni/mkhas grub rin po che'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor gyi mi rges rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir snying po ci lon zhig byed dgos/ nged rang gi mno bsam dang phyugs kyi mno bsam la khyad par ci 'dug blta dgos pa yin/ phyugs la'ang ma 'khyags pa dang / ma ltogs par bskyangs pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i bsam blo gtong ba yod/ nged rang la'ang de las med na phyugs dang khyad par ma byung ba yin pas snying po len pa gal che gsungs/ 'o na dal 'byor zhes bya ba'i tshig don dang snying po len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/da res 'o skol rnams dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro tshe ring lha dang / yul mtha' 'khob/ dbang po ma tshang ba/ log lta can/sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa'i sa ste mi khom pa'i gnas de brgyad du ma sgyes par/ chos sgrub rgyu yin na khom pa byung nas ga le sos dal du yod pas na dal ba brgyad ces bya la/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rang gis 'byor pa mi lus thob pa/ yul dbus 307

su skyes pa/ dbang po tshang ba/ gnas la dad pa/ las mtha' ma log pa dang / gzhan gyis 'byor pa/ sangs rgyas byon pa/ chos gsungs pa/ bstan pa gnas pa/ de'i rjes 'jug yod pa/gzhan phyir snying brtse ba bcu tshang bas na/ 'byor pa zhes bya la/de lta bu'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che da res thob pa 'di don che ste/ sngon gyi rgyal po spyan med 'byor ldan/ rgyal bu zla 'od sogs ded dpon mkhas pas gru gzings bsdams/ rlung dar 'phyar/ mthun pa'i rlung dang 'grogs te rgya mtsho'i gling du byen nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che blangs te rgyal mtshan gyi rtser bzhag nas dgos 'dod kyi char phab ste rang gzhan gye dbul phongs kun sel bar mdzad pa dang / tshe sngon tshul khrims kyis gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa la dam pa'i chos kyi snying po blangs na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la bde blag tu thob nas rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/des na bde ba can du skyes pa'i byang sems rnams kyang 'di 308

nas shar phyogs logs na mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing khams gan snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i lus rten khyad par can yod pa der skye bar shog cig ces smon lam — 'debs pa yin/ lha dag 'chi ba na yang lha gzhan dag khyod bde 'gror skye bar gyur cig bde 'gro ni mi'i 'gro ba'o zhes lha rnams kyang mi'i rten 'di la smon gnas su byed par gsungs/'brom lo rding gi mi rigs de/ so nam gyi lhu yang gser la byed pas lo ding gi mi gcig pu hreng du 'khyams nas pu hreng pa'i mi gcig glu len pa na re/ lo rding bu ru skyes so cog /gser gyi ri la brko na ang / /zer ba thos pas/ kho'i sems la kho pu hreng pa yang lo rding gi mi la smon gnas 'debs na nga lo rding gi mi rang yin pa la zer nas mar yongs nas gser brkos skad/ de bzhin du dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di thams cad kyi smon gnas shig yin/ lha klu chos la dga' ba kun yang mi lus thob nas chos byed par smon lam 'debs na/ 'o skol da res smon lam gyi thog tu slebs pa'i dus 'dir don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ sgo sna tshogs nas tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong byas nas/ don chen chos kyi snying bo len dgos/ 'brom gyis spyan snga ba la/ dal ba 'byor pa mi lus thob pa dran nam 309

gsungs pa dang / spyan snga ba yang thugs dam la 'jug res kyis/gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa/ /gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na/ /g.yang sar lhung bas gzhan dbang 'jug gyur pa/ /de las phyis nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'jug pa nas gsungs pa de lan re re bton nas thugs dam mdzad pa ltar dal 'byor don che ba don med du btang na mi rung ba'i tshul bsams nas snying po len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /da res chos kyi snying po zhig ma blangs na phyi nas 'di lta bu'i rten shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis dper na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i khams 'di thams cad rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur pa'i kha na gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa zhig yod pa de phyogs kun tu rlung gis ded nas nges med du 'khyer la/ rgya mtsho'i gting na rus sbal long pa lo brgya brgya nas mgo bo mtsho khar thon pa re re tsam byed pa'i mgrin pa gser gyi gnya' shing gi bu gar chud dam mi chud ces 'khor rnams la dris pas/ 'khor rnams na re/rgya mtsho ni kha chung / gser gyi gnya' shing phyogs gcig tu sdod cing bu ga mang / rus sbal la mig yod cing rgya mtsho'i khar yang yang yong na chud srid kyang / de ltar ma yi na par/ rgya mtsho ni kha 310

che/ gnya' shing phyogs kun tu 'phyo zhing / bu ga gcig las med/rus sbal la mig med cing lo brgya'i 'phro la lan re las mtsho khar mi yong bas na/ ye mi chud ces zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad nas dal 'byor thob pa'ang de dang mtshungs so/ /de bas na dal ba 'di don med par ma byed cig phyis mi khom par gyur na/ gsor mi rung bar gyur ta re gsungs/ po to ba mkhar thog na bzhugs tsa na/dgongs chos kyi dus su khri khar byon nas 'di skad gsungs/mkhar thog gi rtswa shing 'di rnams kyi gseb na rtswa nyag ma gcig gi tshad tsam dal 'byor thob pa rnams su 'dug la/ 'gro ba gzhan rnams rtswa gzhan pa'i tshod du 'dug gsungs/ yang po to ba gangs skya mo na bzhugs tsa na/ da lta 'u cag gi mdun 'di nas/ srin 'bu zhig sa gseb nas thon te/ thal mo sbyar nas/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zer ba zhig byung na ngo mtshar che 'am mi che na/ de ngo mtshar che/ de bzhin du 'o skol ngan song gsum du gtan du 'khyams 'khyams pa zhig da res/ dal 'byor thob nas chos sgrub tu yod pa de bas kyang ngo mtshar che gsungs/ sngon byang gi gru gu zhwa bo che bya bas nyag kha zhig nas rkyang 'ong bar zhags pa 'phangs pa stabs kha yags pa zhig 311

'phrod nas/ mi kun gyis 'dzin dka' ba'i rkyang zhig zin te zhon nas glu kho na len pa la/ gzhan gyis khyod 'di ka tsam gyis glu len pa ci yin byas pas/ nga zhwa bo zhig rkyang la zhon nas da rkyang glu mi len nam len zer ro/ /de bzhin du sngon bsags legs byas kyis 'phangs pa'i stabs kha yags pa zhig 'phrod nas da res mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad nas bskal ba brgya khrir btsal yang rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di lta bu thob nas chos mi byed na nam byed dam pa'i lha chos kho nar 'bad dgos/ sngon 'phan yul na phywa mkhar bya ba mkhar rdos can zhig yod pa dgras 'phrogs nas yun ring du kha nyen du song bas/ rgad po gcig dus rtag tu mkhar des gdungs nas yod pa la/ lan cig rgad po'i rna bar phywa mkhar thob zer ba thos pas/ 'gro mi nus bzhin du mdung gcig gi gsum gnyis tsam nas bzung phyed shal byed cing rma'i phywa mkhar thob pa 'di rmi lam min na rung zer ba dang / sngon rje mi lar mar pas yun ring chos ma gnang ba'i khar bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs rang mdzad nas yid chad lan mang du byung / da dung chos gnang ngam snyam 'dod pas gdungs nas yod par nyin gcig mdun du bos te thugs brtse ba'i zhal nas/ da rjes su 312

bzung nas mi rgan nga rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag rnams sbyin te/ sgrub rgyags yang nga rang gis sbyar nas bsgom du 'jug pa yin pas dga' bar gyis shig gsungs byung ba dang /de'i tshe rje btsun gyis nga'i 'di rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin/ rmi lam yin na gnyid ma sad na dga' ste snyam pa'i dga' spro tshad med pa zhig byung gsungs pa ltar/ da res rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor mi lus rin po che 'di thob nas bla ma dam pa la bsten te zab rgya'i gdams pa nyams su blang du yod pa 'di rmi lam yin nam/ mngon sum yin/a re dga' dwangs re spro snyam du dga' spro dang bcas chos la brtson par bya dgos/ sngon mar pa'i drung du rje mi las ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed kyi las sogs pa la rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lus/ rnam smin sha khrag rdos bcas rnam par shes pa'i 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'di/ bsod nams can thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyi dal 'byor lus kyi gru chen/ las ngan sdig pa bsog pa rnams kyi ngan 'gror 'khrid pa'i sna 'dren/yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams/ 'dun ma gtan legs dang /gtan nyes kyi khe nyen shin tu che ba'i dus skyem pa zhig yin par go zhes rtog zhus phul ba dang / sngon gcig la gtsang khyab 313

bslab ste/ dge don legs kyi gzhi/ chos tshul rab kyi dbyings/mchod rten thams cad la/ gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gyis byas pas/ de ma shes par/ yag na yag gi gzhi nyes na nyes kyi gzhi/yag gzhi nyes gzhi la/ gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ zer ro de bzhin du da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di'i thog nas chos byas te yags sam yag na gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob la/ mi dge ba byas te nyes sam nyes na ngan song du lhung nas bskal ba bye bar bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos par 'gyur bas/ 'dun ma gtan legs dang gtan nyes yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'byed pa'i dus yin/ rig pa bsgrims te 'dam kha ma nor ba byas/ gtan du bde zhing yar 'gro ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad dgos/ sngon mu ge chen po zhig byung ba'i dus dbus su mi ltogs bza' tshang zhig gis/nang ma gcig 'u cag ha cang rang sdug ches kyis/ da nang zan gong re gyes shig zer te byas pas/ byes pa gcig gis kho rang gi zan rgyab tu sbas te/ pha'i zan nas zos pas khye gcig gis zan rgyab tu sbas pa de had kyis khyer bas/ byis pa na re/ rgya ma lan cig gis sne zan khye la shor zer dus so/ /de bzhin du dam pa'i chos la phyi bshol byas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba sngon du byas na nam 314

zhig rgya ma lan cig thob pa'i dal 'byor mi lus 'chi bdag gis bcoms te chos med lag stong du phyi mar 'gro dgos/ yang sngon gtsang ba'i ar pa tshan gcig gis dbus su nya'i tshod ma byas pas gcig gi nad la rgyab ste skyug skyug 'dra tshe ske lham sgrog gis bsdams pas/ gnas mo na re/ de tsug byed pa ci yin zer bar/ kho na re/ sgyug tu phangs pa zhig sgyug par gda' zer ro/ /de bzhin du dal 'byor gye rten khyad par can thob pa snying po ma lon par chos med du 'chi ba la 'phangs dgos/ sngon gcig gi sgo rtsa na mi mang rab cig gi gseb na dgra snying na ba gcig yod pa de mthong nas/ kho rang nang na gri brdar gyin mi sod kyis dogs nas pha mes kyis bkug pa la dri bo ngas ni yan par gtong nyen yong zer ro/ /de bzhin du sngon gyi las bzang po'i stobs kyis dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di bkug ste/ rang re dri bo kun gyis chos kyi bed mi chod par don med chud zos su gtong nyen che bas gtong mi rung / mi dang dud 'gro'i khyad par yang chos yod med kyi steng nas 'byed pas/ chos ma byas na rwa mjug ma sogs med rung dud 'gro dang khyad par spu tsam med/ tshe 'di ka tsam shes pas mi dang dud 'gro'i khyad par 'byed dka'/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la mi bas da dung dud 'gro mkhas te/ de la dpa' 315

rtsal gye dbang du song na/ bya khras phug ron sogs bdas pas ma theb tsa na rdo 'am brag la phog pas rdo la sogs pa gas pa yong gin 'dug skad/ bongs de las chung ba med kyang dpa' rtsal chen po de tsam yod pa yin/ bya glag pho yis gla ro nam mkhar khyer ba de ma theg tsa na btang bas/ bya glag mo yis bar snang nas tshir gyis bzung ba'i dus na yar yangs kyis yong / mos btang nas phos bzung tsa na/ mar lteng ba re yong ste/ pho bas mo rtsal che ba yin skad/ des na rig pa dang dpa' rtsal mi bas kyang lhag pa dud 'gro la yod/ dgra thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ brag rgyab na pho rog gi tshang yod pa la/ nyin gcig pha ma med shul du 'ug pa 'ong nas pho rog gi phrug gu khyer te gshog pa'i 'og nas snying brus nas bsad par/ pho rog gnyis kyis 'ug pa ded ded nas shi ma shi med par 'dzings nas bzung ste/ sngar bu bsad sar khyer nas snga ma ltar gsod pa mthong skad/ skyes pa khyo ga ji tsam grung yang dgra la de tsam mi nus/ smig pa la sbrul yongs pa la smig pa gcig gis tshang gi rked par gnam khung bton nas sbrul la gtses pas sbrul gyis smig pa ded pas smig pa tshang du bros te gnam khung na yar thon te/ sbrul tshang sbug tu 'itshangs kyis song ba dang gnam phug nas 316

mar smig pas sbrul gye rked par so btab nas bsad skad/ phyi ba gsod mkhan gcig gis phyi ba ded pas/ tshang du chud pa'i rkang pa nas zin pas/ phyi bas gru mo brgyangs te/ kha mar log nas mi'i lag pa la so btab pas/ gzhan ma na re/ phyi ba ma zin nam byas pas zin zer/ 'o na mar 'then byas pas ngas ma zin khos zin zer ro/ /de na ngan thabs mkhas pa dang snying rus che ba de tsam mi phal ba la med/ rgyal du g.yag yu bo gcig dang rwa can gnyis 'thabs pas rwa can rgyal te/ der yu bo des zhag 'ga' sgyu rtsal sbyangs rmig pa skam nas 'thabs pas gzhug tha ba sgang gi lcags ri'i nang du tshud nas bsad skad/ des na dgra thabs la mkhas pa de 'dra dud 'gro kun la yod/ yang gnyen dang bu skyong ba'i dbang du byas na/ dud 'gro mkhas te/ zla re la'ang pha mnyam bu mnyam byed pa yod/ mis de 'dra mi nus/srid sde gcod pa la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na yang / 'phan yul gyi lcang gseb na/ skya ga'i tshang mang po yod pa la 'ug chung gis 'phrogs pas/ skya ga gza' mi gnyis kyis stod lung tshun chad kyi skya ga g.yab nas 'ug chung yul bton skad/ yang bya yul du glag tshang du sbrul zhugs pa bton pa'i lo rgyus sogs de 'dra mang / des na srid sde gcod pas mkhas pa de 'dra dud 'gro la 317

yang yod pa yin/ nang du bsog 'jog la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ bye ba kun gyis ston da pyid nas dang gro ma la sogs pa bsags pa mi yis rnyed na 'tshengs nus pa yod skad/ sngon glang ri thang ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng na yod pa'i g.yu byi ba gcig gis ma theg pa grogs sbran te/ gcig gis phul gcig gis 'then pa gzigs pas zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad pa byung / mi gcig gis bye tshang du g.yu zhig rnyed de/ sang nangs par blta ru phyin pas/bye ba de rtswa nyag ma gcig gis ske dkris nas lcebs nas shi 'dug skad/ phyi'i bzo mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ kha rag sgom chung bzhugs pa'i brag la khug rta'i tshang byung ba la/ dang po tshang phyed tsam na brag la chu gcig byugs skad/ de nas 'jim pa sla mo byugs nas/ de nas rmang skam tshod na 'jim pa re dang rde'u re spel mar bzhag nas khad kyis bya la gzhug dus gcig la grongs kyis rtsigs skad/ shing gseb kyi bya bye kun tshang 'cha' ba mthong tsam na yang de lta bu'i rigs dang / thabs legs mi kun gyis mi shes/ gzhan yang nam zla dus bzhi'i dus tshod la sogs pa mi bas kyang lhag pa dud 'gro kun la yod pa yin/des na tshe 'di'i don tsam las sgrub mi nus na sgyes bu 'am mi zhes ming don rang ma tshang ba yin/ des na da res mi dang dud 318

'gro khyad par 'byed pa'i dus 'dir/ tshe 'di'i don tsam shes pa dang byed pa la pho khyo ga grung por mi brtsi bar/ rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor mi lus rin po che 'di chos kyi sgo nas don dang bcas pa nom pa dang bcas pa zhig byas te mi zer ba'i ming don gnyis ka tshang ba/ dud 'gro rnams las che khyad thon pa zhig mdzad dgos/ phu chung pa'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob nas dge ba'i las ma byas par shi na/ nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa zhig rnyed nas longs ma sbyad par stor du bcug pa dang 'dra la/ sdig pa byas na nor bu dug dang 'dres pa'i lhad zan rdog po gcig tu btsong ba dang 'dra gsungs/ des na dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di ci nas kyang chud zos su gtong mi rung / dge bshes dol ba'i zhal nas/ ngas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba 'di la 'phrig tshud pas chos yo de nas byung gsungs/ dge bshes spyan snga ba khong mnal ye mi log par thugs dam mdzad pa la/ dge bshes rnal 'byor pas/ bu skabs su khams bag re ma gseng na khams yang log nyen yod gsungs pas/ de dag legs te/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba 'di bsams tsa na/ gnyid log long rang mi gda' gsungs zer/ de la chos rje ba'i gsungs nas/ de shin 319

tu med par gda' de 'dra re med thabs mi 'dug ste/ rang re ni de'i cha tsam yang mi nus par 'dug khong gis mi g.yo ba'i bsnyen pa dung phyur dgu song zer te/ mi tshe la mnal ye ma log pa'i tshod du 'dug gsungs pa de ltar chos kyi snying po len pa gal che/ mdor na dal 'byor gye mi lus rin po che thob pa shin tu don che zhing rnyed dka' ba'i tshul legs par bsams nas rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad na dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ thub dbang thugs kyi shel dkar bum bzang du/ /legs 'khyil zab rgya'i chos kyi bdud rtsi de/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rin chen du ma'i snod/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud bod 'dir 'ong ba mtshar/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi bdud rtsi bzang po nas/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang / /brten nas dal ba'i rten la snying po len/ /dgos tshul chu thig tsam zhig blangs tshar song / /tshe 'di'i bya ba bltas nas byas chog pa/ /slob mkhan dgos na rnam grol sgrub pa la/ /slob mkhan bla ma med par ga na 'ongs/ /de phyir ma nor lam ston bla ma tshol/ /rnyed nas yon tan 'byung gnas drin can rje/ /rang gi srog gi phyir yang mi spong bar/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa la/ /rtag 320

tu ngu dang mi la lta bur mdzod/ /dal 'byor don che yid bzhin nor las lhag /shin tu rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'dra/ /da res chos kyi snying po ma blangs na/ /byol song phyugs kyi bu dang cis mi 'dra/ /yang yang rnyed dka' don che shes gyur nas/ /skyo ngal med par nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /chos kyi snying po len la da brtson zhig /lam kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /dal 'byor rten la snying bo len dgos tshul/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros la bsten te/ /ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis bshad zin nas/ /da ni snying po len tshul gdams pa la thog mar skyes bu chung dang thun mong gi /lam gyi rim pa bsten nas snying po zhig /len tshul gong ma'i gsung bzhin 'di na bshad/ /de yang rang re rnams kyis da res rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di thob zin yang / spyir 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag cing mi brtan snying po med la/ sgos su dal 'byor gyi lus rten bzang po 'di yun ring mi sdod par myur du 'dzig par 'gyur bas/ tshe 'di'i yud tsam gyi bde skyid la chags nas g.yengs te/ chos byed pa'i blo yod kyang phyi bshol byas/ sang bya gnang bya snyam pa'i ngang la bzhag nas 'dir 'chi bdag gis slebs nas chos kyi 321

skal ba 'chad pas/ mi rtag 'chi ba bsams nas tshe 'di'i bde 'byor thams cad glog gi gar dang bar snang gi 'ja' dang gnyid thun gcig gi rmi lam gyi bde ba ltar mi rtag cing snying po med par go nas/ don chung tshe 'di'i bya ba yun ring sdod shoms byed pa'i blo rgya thams cad cham gyis bskur nas da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan spyir 'dus byas 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mi rtag 'jig par 'gyur bas na/ 'jig rten zhes bya la/ de yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag ste/ steng phyogs khams gong ma'i lha tshe ring po rnams kyis/ 'jig rten khams 'di lan grangs mang po 'jig par mthong ba yin pa la/ lha phrug gzhon nu mthong ma myong bas 'jig rten khams 'di 'jig pa mthong bas 'jigs tshe/ lha tshe ring rgan pa rnams na re/ 'jigs mi dgos/ 'og phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams de skabs re rdul 'tshub long nge 'di ltar 'jig pa yin zer skad/ des na ri rab gser ri rol mtsho gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma zla ba lcags ri mu khyud dang bcas pa'i phyi snod 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'dra ba sngar yang chags nas lan grangs du mar zhig la/ da lta yang chags pa 'di rnams ring bo mi lon par nam zhig myur du me chu rlung gsum gyis rim gyes bshig 322

nas thal ba tsam yang mi lus par nam mkha'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba yin pas/ gzhan mi rtag 'jig pa smos ci dgos/ de bzhin du nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog nyi zla'i 'char nub lo dang zla ba/ nyin dang mtshan mo snga dro phyi dro skad cig thang zhig yud tsam sogs gang la bltas kyang sngar gyi sa na mi sdod par mi rtag 'gyur zhing 'gyur zhing 'gro bas dngos po gang yang mi rtag par bsams nas gang la mi chags par dal ba'i rten la chos kyi snying po len dgos/ mtho rgyal po chen po'i gdan sa yang mi rtag ste/ sngon gong ma rgyal po'i gdan sa yang skabs shig rta dzis 'phrogs pa yin skad/ bod kyi rgyal po'i gdan sa yang snga mo gcig gi lag nas gcig gis 'phrogs pa'i gtam mang po gda'/ mtha'i rgyal khag mang po yang deng sang gor ṣa rgyal pos 'phrogs nas gda' ste kho yang ci 'gyur ci shes/ de bzhin du da lta'i rgyal po dang ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i rgyal po yang de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ mtho rgyal po'i rgyal sa la yang yid brtan med par mi rtag 'gyur na/ gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/dma' sprang po'i nyal sa yang mi rtag ste/ dbus kyi 'bras spungs nas lha sar 'ongs pa'i lam gyi yar zur gyi brag khung na mi gcig dus yun ring bsdad pa'i skabs shig sprang du song shul 323

nas sprang po gzhan 'ga' yongs nas bzung kho'i mal shor nas 'gro dgos byung skad/ des na dma' sprang po'i nyal sa yan chad kyang mi rtag par 'gyur/ sgo na rta nor lug gsum 'dzom pa yang mi rtag ste/ sngon bdag gis yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po che mtsho sngon bo'i phyogs su phebs nas sbyin bdag phyug po 'ga' re la nor longs spyod mi rtag cing snying po med tshul chos bya dgos tshul gsungs pas/ sbyin bdag gcig gis khong phebs shul nas/ khong gis nor mi rtag zer te da bar du rtag 'dug da mi rtag rgyu ci yod zer ba byung / lo rjes ma khong gis gsungs bzhin ra ngan gye jag pa byung nas nor rdzas da bar rtag 'dug da mi rtag rgyu ci yod zer mkhan gye rta nor lug gsum gser dadul sogs nor rdzas yod do cog jag pas khyer nas/ kho sprang po byas dge bshes rin po che stong bskor na bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du yong nas phyag 'tshal nas khyed kyis gsungs ltar gyur zhus tshe/ zhal 'dzum bzhin snying rje de yin gsungs gnang sbyin 'dra byas skad/ de bzhin du na tsha dgra 'dre sogs rkyen bag re la brten nas sngar phyug po dbul por gyur pa de 'dra brgya dgos na stong yod/ shes na nor longs spyod gang yang mi rtag par 'gyur bas yid brtan mi 'dug snyam du chos 324

bya dgos/ dpung kha dregs 'dzom yang mi rtag ste nged sang gi nye ba zho 'ong dpyis kyi stobs tshangs sang zer ba skabs shig spun bzhi bu gsum nor longs spyod kun 'dzom nas khas dregs pa byung / kun gyi smon pa'i gnas shig byung yang yud tsam du gda'/phyis spun dang bu phal cher shi nor zad nas kha nyen gnyom chung du gyur gda'/ des na spun dang bu tsha po yang tsha 'dzom yang yung tsam yin pas gang la'ang mi chags par chos bya dgos/nor rdzas cung zad yin yang mi rtag ste/ lha sa'i gling gi sprang mo ma bu gnyis kyi rtsam khug ja skol snod gon pa zhig yod pa yang rkun ma zhig gis mthong nas mtshan mo 'ong nas khyer song bas snga mo sprang mo mig nas mchi ma mang po 'don par gda'/ gnyom chung yang mi rtag ste/ sngon bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla rgan gnyom chung mang po mtshan mo mgo brdung gis bsad nas nor rdzas thams cad khyer skad/ des na de dag rnams kyis mtshon pa'i phyi snod 'dus byas 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mi rtag mi brtan snying po med de/ brtsigs pa 'jig mthon po ltung / bsags pa 'dzad/ 'dus pa 'bral ba'i tshul bsams nas gang la 'ang mi chags par snying po med pa'i 'khor ba'i bya ba kun spangs byas nas/ snying po yod pa dam pa'i lha chos la 325

'bad nas dal 'byor la snying po len par bya'o/ /sgos su nang bcud rang gzhan sems can thams cad mi rtag par 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro dgos te/ gzhon pa glu len pa na re/ 'di na mi dga' rgyal du 'gro/ /rgyal na gser gyi mchod rten yod/ /dga' yang yun gye rten yul min/ /'di na mi dga' yer bar 'gro/ /de na brag lha mgon po yod/ /dga' yang yun gye rten yul min/ /zer ro/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rang re rnams tshe 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba la mi dga' zhing / tshe 'dir gtan du sdod pa la dga' yang / yun ring po'i bsten yul min te/ yud tsam zhig bsdad nas myur du slar 'jig rten phyi mar 'gro ste/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa yang mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir grong khyer rtswa can du zhogs g.yas phab dbu byang du bstan nas mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs tshe/ 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyang de'i phyogs su btud cing gzhol/ sa 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dang bcas sku gshegs pa'i tshe/ skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i dge slong khri 326

brgyad stong kyang mya ngan las 'das so/ /des na mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag par gshegs pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan song na/ chu shing snying po lta bu'i 'o skol rnams kyi sgyu lus 'jig pa smos ci dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dgra bcom dzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu yang mthar grong khyer shing thog can du byon nas sku gshegs dus/ dbang thob pa'i dgra bcom bdun khri bdun stong mya ngan las 'das so/ /shes rab la thogs pa med pa'i 'phags pa shā ri'i bu rgyal bo'i khab ga la ba der byon nas sku gshegs dus/ dgra bcom pa brgyad khri mya ngan 'a/sa 'das so/ /'phags pa ba glang bdag sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas na bzhugs pas sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa gsan nas/ thugs las me byung ste mya ngan las 'das/me'i nang nas tshigs su bcad pa gnyis byung ste/ 'dus byas bsags pa skad cig 'jig 'gyur te/ /srog dang bcas pa'i dpal ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /mkhas rnams rtag tu dge la bag yod cing / /bsod nams las kyi bya ba de brtson bya/ /zhes pa dang / thub pa de la sgo gsum dang bas btud/ /rang gi dgos pa gang yin thams cad byas/ /gus shing rab tu dad pas bla ma de'i/ /phyi bzhin ba glang bdag kyang de ltar song / /zhes bya ba'i 327

sgra byung ngo / /de bzhin du drang srong chen po mngon shes lnga thob cing mkha' la rgyang ring 'gro ba rnams kyis kyang mi 'chi ba'i gnas dang thabs ma rnyed par gshegs/ sngon gyi rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu dang / gangs can ljongs kyi mkhan slob chos gsum rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ mar mi dwags gsum/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ rje rin po che yab sras sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu rnams kyang gshegs/ de bzhin du lha'i nang gi tshangs pa brgya byin/ mi'i nang gi 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' mi skya btsan btsun nyi ma dang zla ba rgyu skar 'dra ba thams cad kyang bsdad dbang med par gshegs song ba de lags/ de bzhin du da lta rang re sa thog na gnas tshad po thams cad 'chi ba las ma 'das/ gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa med de/ sngon sdig rgyal 'phags skyes po dang blon po ma la gnod gnyis kyis grong khyer ser skya'i mi bdun khye bdun stong bsad/ bu mo lnga brgya'i rkang lag bcad nas bsad/ khye'u lnga brgya lcags kyi shal mas mnan nas gsod pa'i 'og nas gnyis bros nas sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'ong ba lhung bzed kyi 'og tu sbas kyang / ring por ma lon par de nyid du shi'o/ /rgya 328

gar na shan pas ma he gsod tsa na/ grog po phug rdugs su ma te rnams bcug mdo mi yis bsrungs nas/ 'chor sa med pa byas gsod skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang 'chi bdag gi bdud kyis 'chor sa med par na rgas grog po phug rdugs su bcug nas gcig kyang ma lus par gsad pa yin tshe/ thar du lus pa sngar yang ma byung da yang bzhag mi yong / po to ba sgo lag dgon pa na chos mya ngan bsal ba gsungs pa'i tshe/ khong gi zhal nas/dper na da lta mi mang po 'di nas mar rgyugs nas 'gro ba la/sngon ma lung phran mda' ri gdong ma ki 'das nas song ba la/phyi ma kun snga ma 'das pa rnams la 'bod cing rgyug 'phro mi gcod pa ltar 'o skol rang yang tshe skad cig ma gnyis par mi sdod par 'chi ba'i phyogs su rgyug cing / zla bo snga ma shi ba la mya ngan byed pa yang de dang 'dra gsungs/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab gsang phu'i dgon na bzhugs pa'i dus mi shi ba gsan tsa na/ kye jo bo kun bya gtong gda'o chos bshad zab mo gda'o gsungs/ dmar khrid zab shos rang de shi ba mthong ba dang thos pa kun yin gsungs/ gsang phu'i nags bsrung bar zhu zhus pas/ bu nang gi bdag 'dzin ma spong bas phyi'i bdag 'dzin gyis ci byed gsungs/ sngon sku drag cig la/ mi ma yin gyi grogs 329

po zhig yod pas/ legs nyes gang yong shes pas khyod kyis mi 'chi ba sngon nas shes sam dris pas de yang shes zer/ de yin na nga 'chi ba'i lo snga ma tsam na brda' zhig gyis smras pas yong zer/ phyis mi ma yin des kho 'chi ba shes nas nyin gcig 'ongs nas/ grogs po ya ki na mi zhig shi 'dug byas pas khos brda' byas pa yin pa ma shes/ yang nyin gcig 'ongs nas grogs po ma ki na yang mi zhig shi 'dug byas par yang snang rtog ma btang/de nas kho bo na nas grogs po da res nga mi 'chi 'am dris pas/da res nges par 'chi zer/ de yin na ngas snga gong nas nga la brda' zhig gyis bshad pa mi byed pa ci yin byas pas/ ngas brda' byas/ ya ki na mi zhig shi thal byas/ ma ki na mi zhig shi thal byas zhes brda' lan gnyis tsam byas te mi go bar gda' dbar gyi grogs po'i thog tu byung ba red zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis gzhan shi ba mthong ba dang thos tsa na/ nga yang 'di bzhin du song / khyod kyang 'di las ma 'das so zhes bya ba'i brda' ston nam/ bya gtong lta bur go bar byas nas dge sbyor la sgrims dgos/ 'chi ba tsam du ma zad/ rgan gzhon la go rim dang nam 'chi nges pa med par 'chi ste/ sngon lho brag mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde zhes bya ba yod na bod gangs can spyi 330

la phan thogs pa'i nyi ma lta bu de yang sku na phra mo'i dus rtas drud de dbu bcag nas gshegs so/ /zho 'ong la kha'i bud med rdo rje skyid bya ba la bu dbang chen zer ba'i gces phrug snying dang 'dra ba gcig yod pas nyin gcig me mda' rgyab pas lcags chag nas dum bu zhig thod dkyil du zug nas glo bur du shi skad/sngon mi gcig gis nas rdza ma gang yod pa sbas nas phyir 'ong tsa na bza' snyam nas sprang du phyin pas sprang lam du kho shi ba byung / mi zhig gis sang 'chi rgyu yin pa ma shes/ gzhan zhig tu 'gro snyam nas lham btsems pa dam can chos rgyal gyis mthong ste/ mi de sang 'chi ba mkhyen nas bzhad gad cig byas skad/yang sbra nag phyogs kyi mi tshang zhig gi g.yog pos dgongs mo bza' btung mang po byas nyal bas snga mo mal na shi yod skad/zho 'ong dpyis kyi bud med cig gis gro phye ba snol ba lag 'og tu mnan nas shi song skad/ yang gling rgya'i bud med cig gis zhing nang gi rtswa rnams bsal ba la khyo gas lto bskol ba khyer nas zhing khar slebs dus mo ma shi ba mthong yang drung du song dus shi 'dug zer/ de bzhin du sngar 'chi bdag bdud pos las kyi 'phro yang mthud du ma bcug par glo bur du bsad nas khrid pa grangs mang / des na rang re rnams kyi yul mi pha spun gnyen nye 331

ring bla ma mched grogs pha ma spun zla bu dang chung ma tsha bo tsha mo sogs glo bur du shi ba sngar mthong thos yod pa rnams yid la bsams nas nga yang nam zhig 'di yi rang bzhin yin pas/chos da lo sang phod gnyis kyi da lo/ zla ba snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring sang nyin gnyis kyi de ring / snga dro phyi dro gnyis kyi snga dro tsam la ma byas na nam 'chi la nges pa mi 'dug da lta nyid du 'chi brod dam pa'i chos kho na la 'bad dgos 'dug snyam du yang yang bsam pa gces/ sngon pho reng pa gcig la bza' rgyu med de sprang du phyin pas nas phad khug gang rnyed de/ de khyem mi gcig yod pa'i gdung ma la btags te/ yang sprang du phyin pas/yang nas phad khug gang rnyed pas kho re ba skyes te/ da ni zas nor btsal ba la tshegs mi 'dug chung ma zhig rang blangs dgos snyam/ der chung ma la bu zhig skyes na/ ming ji skad du 'dogs snyam nas yod tsa na nya'i zla ba lhag ge shar nas byung ba mthong nas/ 'o bu'i ming zla ba grags pa bya bar gdags dgos snyam nas mno bsam/ de tshe kho shin tu nyams dga' ste/ dbyug pa klad la bskor zhing 'phags pas/ sngar gyi gdung ma la btegs pa'i nas kyi phad khug de la dbyug pa phog pas/ nas phad kyi thag pa chad nas kho rang gi mgo thog tu lhung bas ltag 332

pa chag nas shi skad/ der lhas nam mkha' nas tshigs bcad brjod pa ni/ ma 'ongs dngos po bsam mi bya/ /ma 'ongs dngos po bsam bya bas/ /zla ba grags pa'i pha bzhin du/ /phung po dengs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes zer skad/ de bzhin du glo bur da lta yin yang 'chi nyen yod pas ma 'ongs pa'i bsam mno gtong mi rung / 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe tshe 'di'i che thabs lus longs spyod gnyen mdza' bshes sogs gang gis kyang phan pa med par 'chi ste/ sngon 'brom lo ding gi gtso bo klu bstan bya ba 'chi khar kho na re/ spyir 'brom lo rding gi che thabs kyis nga la ci phan/ de'i nang na stod ra ba'i che thabs kyis nga la ci phan zer zhing shi skad/ sngon 'phags pa nyer dga' la gser mang du yod kyang / spyi bor phol mig byung nas sman pas rlung nad red/ mar khu 'thung dang phan smras pas/ de'i nyin 'thung na phan yang / nad la khag bzhag nas nyi ma gnyis la mar khu blangs nas/ de'i phyi nyin mar khu lhung bzed gang 'thung yang nad cher song bas phan ma thogs par ma zad/ mar khu ma zhu bar pho bar gnod nas shi bas/ gser srang sum khri yod pa rnams dge slong rnams 'dus te bgos nas khyer/ des na nor ci tsam yod kyang 'chi khar phan pa med de skyur nas 'chi dgos/333

sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ 'khor g.yog dpag med yod kyang /bus rgyal srid las phyung / g.yog mo gcig bcas rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i skyed tshal du song / la phug zos chu 'thung bas ma zhu ba'i nad kyis thebs te rkang la ga rengs shing 'gyel nas sa rdul gyis kha gang nas tshe'i dus byas/ des na 'khor g.yog ci tsam yod kyang 'chi khar phan pa gcig kyang med grogs med pas gcig pur 'chi dgos/ sngon nged kyi ma'i ming po skyabs go zer ba'i gces phrug gcig yod pa lo nyer gcig steng la glo bur du nad drag pos thebs pas grub pa'i dbang phyug tsho 'du'i mkhan chen gdan drangs/ gzhan ban bon sngags gsum mthu bo che yod tshad bos nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sku rim nyin mtshan med par byas kyang / sku rim byed pa'i sgang la shi ba byung /sngon lho brag mar pa'i sras rtas 'phangs nas dbu dum bu brgyad du chag pa mar pa'i sku pang du bzhag nas dbu ral khra gnyil le ba yum gyis mthong bas thugs dngangs nas dran med du song / dran pa sos nas yum gyes sman yan lag brgyad pa la khyed mkhas na bu 'di la gso thabs 'dug gam zhus pas/ mar pa'i zhal nas/ chu zangs gang gi nang na zhag nya mig tsam zhig yod pa rtsig ngos la gtor tshar 'dug ro mgo med la gso 334

thabs ma mchis/ sems can gye las slebs tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdugs bya ba yin pas bcos thabs med gsungs/ des na tshe tshad la babs tshe thabs gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan par 'chi na 'chi brod chos shig ma byas pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam du chos byed pa la blo thag rbad chod mdzod cig sngon sangs rgyas bsod snyoms la gshegs nas rgan rgon ma bu bzhis 'tsho ba drangs pa la khong gis mi rtag pa'i chos gsungs te/ srid pa thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /mtho ba de yang mthar ltung ngo / /'du ba yod na 'bral ba yod/ /skye ba thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gsung ba ma bu bzhi'i rgyud la skyes nas/ nyin re bzhin tshig bzhi kha ton byed pa/ sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis rgyud la skyes yod med brtag phyi nyin gcig bu nags gseb tu song ba sbas te/ stag cig gis zos song bar sprul ba'i grogs rnams yul du log nas bu stag gis khur byas bas ma bu gsum gyis mya ngan ma bya sa/ sgyu ma mkhan rang song rgad po yod sar phyin nas bu stag gis khur 'dug smras pas/ rgad po na re/ srid pa thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /mtho ba de yang mthar ltung ngo / /'du ba yod na 'bral ba yod/ /skye ba thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de la mya ngan mi byed zer/ /ma yod sar song nas sngar bzhin smras pas/335

ma na re/ dper na ljon shing phung po la/ /bya bye'u mang po'i gnas bcas te/ /srod la 'tshogs shing tho rengs gyes/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /de la mya ngan mi byed zer/ /sring mo yod sar phyin nas sngar bzhin smras pas/ bu mo na re/ dper na sna tshogs 'dus pa'i mgron khang du/ /mgron po mang po 'tshogs shing so sor gyes/ /mjug tu gcig kyang mi sdod 'gro ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /de la bu mo mya ngan mi byed zer/ /ma bu gsum gyi sngar las 'phro yang mi bcag par byed pa mthong / 'o na bu yod pa dga' ba skye 'am snyam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi bu sbas pa btang nas bu 'di na 'dug smras pas/ ma bu gsum gyis bu 'ong ba la cer re ba re ltos te/ dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang med par sngar gyi las 'phro byed pa la sgyu ma mkhan ngo mtshar nas sangs rgyas la zhus pas gling de la mya ngan med kyi gling zhes btags/ sngon bud med gshis bzang mo gcig la/ zhing bzang po zhig yod pa la khyem mtshes kyi bu tshas lam byas pas/ mo'i gnyen kun na re/ zhing la lam byed du ma 'jug byas pas/ mo na re/ da nam 'chi cha mi 'dug cing / gar skye nges pa mi 'dug pas/ gal te khong tsho'i bu tshar skyes nas nga rang yang phyin pas chog par 'dug pas bsrung don med zer 336

ro/ /de bzhin du 'chi ba mi rtag pa gar skye cha med pa bsams nas tshe 'di'i 'dun ma yag nyes bzang ngan gang byung yang dga' sdug chags sdang med par bya dgos/ sngon yer ba'i zhang btsun gyis mi rtag pa 'ba' zhig thugs la dgongs nas bag tsam snyung ba re byung yang snyad 'dogs kyin/ da res rang cha cha gsungs nas ka cha phra mo tshun chad kyi yo byad gang yod thams cad gzhan la bsngos nas/ med mi rung ci rigs la ma shi bar en zhig g.yar po thong / shi na khyed snoms shig gsungs/ spyir bdog po'i dngos po gang yang tshags mi mdzad/ sang gnangs 'chi ba lta bu'i spyod pa rgyun du mdzad par gda'/ brag rgyab kyi gnyan ston shag 'byung bya ba khong yang gcung po gcig shi bas rkyen byas yid 'byung nas tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa mdzad/ mi rtag pa 'ba' zhig thugs la dgongs nas/ skyo sangs mdzad dus kyang / mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ /'chi bas so sor 'bral 'gyur zhing / /mya ngan chen po lngar 'gyur ba/ /de ni 'jig rten 'di na nges/ /zhes sogs kho na gsungs/ nye gnas kyis dbyar shing grabs byed ran zhus pas/ dbyar sdod mi sdod cha med pas shing bu'i grabs kyis ci byed/ sdod na blo tshur ston zhig 'ong gis gsungs nas bzhugs rtsis ye mi mdzad par 337

thugs dam 'ba' zhig mdzad par gda'/ kha rag sgom chung ba/kha rag gi brag khung na bzhugs tsa na/ brag khung gi sgo na sa phung zhig yod pa/ yar 'gro mar 'gro nam byed dus/ na bza' thogs pas/ gcod dgos dgongs pa re byung tsa na/ de ma thag mi rtag pa thur dran te/ 'di bcad nas ci byed 'gro 'ong byed kyin sdod rgyu rang 'ong ba'i nges pa med dgongs gshegs gshegs kyi bar du gcod pa ma byung skad/ 'ban gung rgyal khong gi thugs la mi rtag pa 'khrungs pas/ tshe 'di'i rtog pa phra mo re byung tsa na/ de ring sang gi dbang rang yang byar med pas gtan du sdod chas ma byed tshul khrims rgyal ba gsung / rang la rang sngan bgrang gin thugs dam la shin tu brtson par mdzad par gda'/ de dag rnams bzhin 'o skol rnams kyang rtag tu mi rtag 'chi ba bsam nas tshe 'di'i phyi rtsis kyi 'dun ma gang yang mi byed par 'chi chos kho na la 'bad dgos/ 'o na 'chi ba bsam rung ma bsam rung thog tu 'ong bsam pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ thog tu 'ong ba bden yang ma 'ongs gong du 'chi ba bsam na chos yong ste/ sngon khro phu'i ston pa gzhon tshul na re/gnyan ston ston pa chen po zhig gis 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgoms zer ba cang bden nam/ bden na 'chi ba bsgom mi dgos thog 338

tu yong / zhes 'phya ba la/ rnal 'byor pa chen po'i zhal nas/yong na kho'i de la gcig yong gsungs/ sems mi dga' ba zhig las gzhan ci yong zhus pas/ chos kho na yong gsungs skad/khams lung pa'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa bsgom nas chos byed du re ba yin/ gzhan du na sems mi dga' ba las ci yong mi rtag pa dran na chos min pa dgos pa med par 'ong ste/ rang re gnangs kho na 'chi na chu thams cad mar khur song / ri thams cad gser du song / mi thams cad nged rang gi bu dang bu mor song yang des ci bgyi gsungs/ 'o na chos byas rung ma byas rung thams cad mnyam por 'chi bar 'dug chos byas pa dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ 'chi ba bden yang 'chi lugs dang phyi ma'i bde skyid mi 'dra ste/ chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod 'bring mi 'tsher tha ma mi 'gyod pa yin te/ ma ci ga re ma'i zhal nas/ mi gcig 'chi ba la nga las nyams dga' ba med/ nga'i 'chi ba 'di kun dper na ri chen po'i 'og nas thar ba'i tshod yin gsungs/ de bzhin du nyams dga' yal le/ blo bde 'bol le 'chi ba yin na de 'dra'i chos pas sdug bsngal 'dod kyang mi myong ste/ glang thang pa chen po sku 'da' khar/ nga dmyal bar skye bar 'dod nas smon lam mang po btab ste/ smon lam mi 'grub pa 'dra/ da lta nga 339

la dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las/ tha mal gyi snang ba tsam yang mi 'char bar 'dug gsungs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs/ zhang ston chos bla grongs khar/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad bcas/ /rin chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /zab yangs tshos kyi ngang las ma g.yos par/ /'chi ba 'di ni bsod nams bsags pa yin/ /zhes mgur gsungs kyin gshegs/ zhang btsun yer ba gshegs pa na lha'i rol mo di ri byed pa thams cad kyis tshor ba byung /gnyan snyen shag 'byung sku 'da' khar dga' bzhin spro bzhin gshegs te pur sbyangs dus rus sku ngo mtshar can zhig byon skad/ sngon gling rgya'i dpal ldan zer ba'i sngags rnying ma'i sngags rgan zhig gis nyin gcig a mye da mi sdod zer/ gnad gcod med par lus drang por bsrang ste mnyam par bzhag nas gshegs pas pur sbyongs tshe nam zla dgun yin yang pur khang gi steng gi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon lag pas bzung chog pa lta bu'i gur dang dra ba dra phyed kyi rnam pa mang po shar/ dud pa dkar po mda' bzhin drang po byas nam mkha'i dbyings su zug pa bya rgod mang po 'ongs nas bskor ba byas mthar shar phyogs su bzhud pa der 'tshogs pa'i mchog dman bar ma thams cad 340

kyis mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang dam pa'i chos byas na de 'dra 'byung ngo / /mdor na spyir 'dus byas 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mi rtag mi brtan snying po med cing sgos su 'chi nges nam 'chi cha med 'chi tshe gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan tshul bsam nas don chung tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin rgyang du bskyur nas 'chi brod dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ /'o na shi song rung slar yang mtho ris mi yi nang du skye ba 'di ka yin/ da yang phyi nas 'di bzhin skyes los yong / gal te ma skyes par ngan song gsum du skyes rung 'jigs rgyu rang ci yod sdug bsngal yod rung bzod yong snyam na/ de 'o skol rnams kyis ma bsam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal myong ba lta ci smos sdug bsngal thos sam gzugs brnyan ri mor bris pa mthong na yang snying rlung ldang ba tsam du bzod glag med de/ de yi rgyu mtshan/ shi ba'i 'og tu rtswa phung me la bsregs pa bzhin rigs 'dra rgyun chad nas mi 'gro skye ba zhig len dgos/ de yang rang la dbang med/ las la rag las pas/ las dge ba byas pa rnams sngar 'di bzhin mtho ris lha mi'i gnas su skye ba bden yang / mi dge sdig pa byas pa rnams kyis bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos 341

par dmyal ba mnar med sogs su skye bar 'gyur/ de ru skyes na 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal mtha' yas te/ 'di nas dpag tshad sum khri nyis stong gi 'og na dmyal ba yang sos yod/ de nas dpag tshad bzhi stong bzhi stong gis chod pa'i 'og na/dmyal ba thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen bo/tsha ba rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med rnams yod/ de la tsha dmyal brgyad zer/ de dag gi phyogs bzhi'i thag nye na/ nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba yod/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi byang phyogs na chu bur can/chu bur rdol ba/ so tham/ a chu/ kye hud/ ut+pal/ pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa ste grang dmyal brgyad yod/ tsha grang dmyal ba de rnams kyi nye 'khor na nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba yod/ phal cher mi yi yul na'ang yod gsungs/ dmyal khams bco brgyad kyi nang der skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bsam gyes mi khyab pa yod/de yang dmyal ba yang sos na sems can de dag 'dus nas las dbang gis byung ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis brgyab nas yan lag dang nying lag bcad nas sa la 'gyel tshe nam mkha' nas sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra byung tshe sos nas sngar ltar gsod res byed/ thig nag na dmyal bsrung rnams kyis der skyes pa rnams bzung nas lus la thig nag pa btab ste sog le 342

sta re sogs mtshon gyis 'dra zhing gshag bsdus 'joms na/der skyes pa rnams bsdus nas dmyal bsrung rnams kyis ri gnyis re'i bar du bcar nas sdug bsngal myong / ngu 'bod khang pa me 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs nas ngu 'bod byed/ ngu 'bod chen po na lcags khang nyis rim gyi nang du bcug nas bsregs tshe khang pa nang ma nas rgya la thar rung phyi ma nas mi thar snyam ngu 'bod chen po byed/ tsha ba na lcags zangs tsha ba'i nang du yos brngo ba ltar bsreg lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas 'phongs nas phug ste spyi bor 'byin/ lcags kyi sa gzhir bsgyel nas steng du tho ba tsha zhing 'bar bas brdung / rab tu tsha ba na/lcags zangs nang du khro chu bskol ba'i nang du 'tshod cing lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum me 'bar ba 'phongs su bcug nas spyi bo phrag gong gnyis su 'byin zhing me 'bar nas bsregs par byed/ lcags leb tsha zhing 'bar ba lus la yongs su dkris nas bsreg par byed pa sogs sdug bsngal mang /mnar med na/ phyogs kun nas me 'bar ba'i dkyil du bcug nas lus mar me'i sdong bu ltar bsreg lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i nang du 'khrab du 'jug lcags kyi ri la 'bab 'dzeg byed du 'jug kha nas lce phyung nas brgyangs kha nang du 343

lcags kyi thu lum 'jug zangs zhun khol ma blug nas khog rnams tshig nas ro smad nas 'byung ba sogs sdug bsngal mang /nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba na/ me ma mur gyi 'ob/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri'i lam/ thal tshan gyi chu rlung rab med kyi nang du chud nas sdug bsngal mang / grang dmyal brgyad kyi 'og kha ba'i thang dang 'khyags rom/ steng nas kha ba bu yug rlung gis bskyod nas babs pas/ de ru skyes pa'i sdig can gyi sems can de dag thams cad las dbang gis gos med pa'i gcer bur bsdad pa rnams kyi lus grang nas chu bur byung / de bas grang ba rnams chu bur rdol nas chu ser 'dzag de bas grang ba so tham nas smra mi shes/ de bas grang ba rnams kyi rkan gyi phug nas kye hud zer/ de bas grang ba lus ut+pal ltar kha lnga 'am drug tsam du gas/ de bas grang ba rnams kyi lus kha bcu 'am de las mang bar gas/de bas grang ba rnams kyi lus pad+ma chen po ltar kha brgya 'am de las mang bar gas nas 'chi rgyu med par grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glag med pa myong / nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba na/ phyags ma gtun dang thag pa ka ba lta bu sogs lus kyi bzo dbyebs mi 'dra ba mang po'i gzugs su skyes nas sdug bsngal mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa sna tshogs shig myong bar 'gyur/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi 344
