bu dmyal bar ma len du byon dus/ mi ming la gcan gzan wa zer ba brku 'phrog ri dwags gsod mkhan gyi sdig can zhig bzung nas ske la thag pa btags nas gshin rje pho nya mdog mi sdug pa nyis brgyas dmyal ba'i gnas su 'khrid pa mthong de nas mar byon pas/ gshin rje pho nya mang pos mi dge ba byed mkhan gye sdig can grangs med pa khyu 'ded byas dmyal bar 'gro ba mthong nas/ 'di nas mar la mo'u 'gal ma zer ba zhig e song dris pas/ dmyal bar nyin rer sems can gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs las 'das pa 'gro bar gda'/ mo'u 'gal ma su yin zer ma mthong byas pas/ yang phebs tshe sdong po zhig gi stegs na tshe tshad ma rdzogs par bsdad yod pa 'ga' dang 'phrad nas 'di ru ci la bsdad gsungs tshe tshad ma rdzogs nas sdod dgos byung zer/ de nas gshin rje chos rgyal gyi sgo drung du byon pas gyad stobs po che khris sgo bsrungs 'dug pa de'i nang nas gcig la sgo 'di bsrungs nas lo ji tsam song dris pas/ bskal pa mang po song zer/ bskal pa'i yun ci tsam la zer dris pas/ sgo them gyi rdo dpag tshad mang po yod pa zhig bstan nas/ sdig can rnams brgal nas rdo 'di zad pa'i yun tsam la bskal pa gcig zer ba yin zer/ nang na skad chen po 345

can zhig gis dri ba mdzad pa su red dris pas gshin rje chos rgyal yin zer/ dge sdig shan phye nas sdig can dpag tu med pa gshin rje mang pos brdungs shig choms shig zer dmyal bar mar khyu 'ded byas tshe/ sdig can 'ga' re kha phyir phyogs nas smre sngags du ma 'don pa mthong nas khong gis snying rje nas sbyan chab shor/ de nas dmyal khams bco brgyad du phebs nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal mthong nas yun ring bar du blta mi phod pa byung gsungs/ sngon 'das lo ga gling za chos skyid kyang shi nas bar dor song dus/ thang chen po zhig na chu chen po la zam chen po 'phangs pa'i tshur rol na chos la tshad btsugs nas mna' bskyal ba'i mi zhig gi thog tu chos ri bzhin brtsigs nas mnan pa zhig mthong / zam gyi pha rol gyi bar do'i grong khyer zhig gi nang na sngar shi ba'i rang gi lug rdzi zhig yod pa mthong bas/ kho na re/ da a lce yang 'dir byon nam zer/ de ru yod pa rnams la la skyid pa dang 'ga' zhig sdug pa dang kha cig la skabs re zas gos 'ong ba mthong nas lug dzi 'di ci yin dris pas/ 'di ni bar do'i grong khyer yin tshe tshad ma rdzogs pa rnams 'dir bsdad pa lags/ skyid pa rnams chos byas pa rnams yin/sdug pa rnasam sdig can/ skabs re zas nor 'ong ba yul gyi bu 346

dang bu mo sogs nye 'brel rnams kyis tshe 'das la dmigs nas dge ba byas pa'i 'bras bu yin zer/ de nas gshin rje chos rgyal drung du song nas dge sdig gi shan 'byed pa mang po gzigs/ dmyal khams bco brgyad kyang bstan pa mthong nas re zhig bar du blta ma bzod/ skabs shig blta sa bas tsha grang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa mthong / sngon kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas chos klog tu bcug pas/ nyung shas re klag nas klog tu ma nyan pas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyis dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid nas/ khong gnyis kyi bltas pas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'tshod pa dang gcod pa dang gshag pa dang brdeg pa sogs sdug bsnga la ba mang po mthong / phyogs gcig na lcags zangs chen po gnyis kyi nang na khro chu khol ba mthong nas/ 'dir su 'jug gam dris pas/ 'dir kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas le los dus 'da' ba de gnyis shi na 'dir 'jug go smras pas/ de gnyis shin tu skrag ste bros nas mo'u 'gal gyi rtsar 'ongs nas mthong tshul rnams bsnyad pas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus de gnyis la nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan yang 'byung bas brtson 'grus rtsoms shig gsungs pas/ de gnyis kyis brtson 'grus rtsom zhing zas ma zos pa'i 347

gang du dmyal ba dran na ni zas za bar mi byed la/ zas zos pa'i 'og tu dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dran na skyug par byed do/ /de nas yang lha'i gnas su khrid nas bltas pas lha pho mo mang pos pi wang la sogs pa'i sgra sgrogs shing lha'i skyid dga' longs spyod dpag tu med pa myong ba mthong / phyogs gcig na lha'i bu med pa'i gzhal med khang lha'i bu mo mang pos gang ba mthong nas/ lha'i bu mi 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas brtson 'grus brtsams pas de nyis shi 'phos na 'dir skye'o zhes smras pa dang de gnyis dga' nas mo'u 'gal gyi bu la smras pas/ mo'u 'gal gye bus de gnyis la phan yon 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas brtson 'grus rtsoms shig gsungs pas/ gnyis ka sngar bas brtson 'grus ches cher byung / sngon dge 'dun 'od srung nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar byon tshe dge 'dun pa'i 'du khang gi ka ba la sna bas phyis pa/dge 'dun pa'i phyags ma gtun dang thag pa sogs brkus pa rnams de lta bu'i gzugs su skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba gzigs pa byung / 'o na dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/de'i rgyu spyir srog gcod pa ma byin len mi tshangs spyod dzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste 348

mi dge ba bcu po 'di chen po byas na dmyal bar skye zhing khyad par mtshams med lnga byas pa dang log lta skyes pa dang pham pa bzhi spyad na mnar med du skye/ so thar gyi nyes byas khyad du bsad na yang sos/ sor bshags khyad du bsad na thig nag tu skye/ sde 'khrugs byed pa'i dpon po dmyal bar skyes nas bskal pa dpag tu med par thar pa'i dus mi 'byung de'i kha phyogs zhe phyogs gnyis ka byed pa bskal pa chen po drug cur dmyal bar skye zhes phyogs tsam byed pa yang bskal pa bcu drug tu dmyal bar skye/ sde 'khrug byed pa'i dus su shi tshad po dmyal bar skye zhes 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs/ byang sems kyi rtsa ltung byung ba dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan la dmigs nas khros na khong khro skad cig ma ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal par dmyal par gnas dgos pa spyod 'jug las gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung byung nas sor ma chud kyi bar la skad cig ma ci tsam yod pa'i grangs mnyam pa'i bskal par dmyal pa mnar med du gnas dgos pa rgyud sde kha cig nas gsungs/ bla ma la dmigs nas khong khro skyes na bskal par bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun 'joms shing khong khro skad cig ma ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs mnyam bskal par dmyal bar gnas 349

dgos zhes dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las gsungs/ gzhan yang po to ba'i gsung sgros las/ dam tshig nyams pa dang / dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la sdig pa bsags na rdo rje dmyal bar sgyes te/ mnar med las grong las dgon pa'i tshul du yod/ sdug bsngal mnar med las 'bum 'gyur gyis che gsungs te/ thos pa tsam gyis snying 'gas pa tsam du 'dug gsungs/ yi dwags kyi gnas ni 'dzam bu gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgyas bcad pa na yod/ de las 'phros pa ni mi'i gnas na'ang yod/ yi dwags rnams kyi rgyal po ni gshin rje zhes bya ba yin/ yi dwags kyi gnas der skyes na bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ de yang yi dwags rnams las ngan pa'i dbang gis bkres shing skoms pa dang ldan pas pags pa sha khrag kun bskams nas sdong dum mes tshig pa lta bu gdong mas khebs pa kha skams shing lces bldag pa/ phyi'i sgrib pa can gyis rgyang nas zas skom mthong yang thag nyer song na rnag khrag sogs su 'gyur zhing ma gyur yang mtshon cha thogs pas bsrung nas longs spyod du mi ster/ nang gi sgrib pa can gyis za sa skom rnyed kyang kha kha ba mig tsam las med pas mi shong shong yang mgrin pa rta rnga tsam la mi thar thar yang lto ba ri tsam yod pa mi 350

khengs khengs kyang rkang lag 'jag skya tsam gyis mi theg pas sdug bsngal myong / zas skom gyi sgrib pa can gyis zos 'thung tshad me ru gyur nas 'tshig 'ga' zhig gis mi gtsang ba ljan ljin tsam las gzhan bza' btung bzang po bya mi nus/ kha cig gis rang gi sha bcad nas za ba ma gtogs gzhan gang la yang longs spyod mi nus par gsungs/ sngon bud med cig gis 'khor g.yog rnams la zas skom ma byen/ be'u zhig yod pa'i mgo la dbyug pa zhig rgyab pas mig bcar/ rang gis lkog nas lto yod tshad zos pas shi nas yi dwags mig g.yas zhar ba mgrin pa lba ba chen po yod pa zhig tu skyes nas zas skom gang yang ma rnyed par sdug bsngal myong / sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su bud med gcig gis chu yan chad la ser sna byas pas phyis shi nas yi dwags mo kha nas med dang ma ster sogs smre sngags mi 'dra ba lnga tsam 'don pa zhig tu skyes/ sngon rna ba bye ba ri yi dwags gnas su phyin nas grong khyer zhig na mi nag po dbyug pa thogs pa zhig 'dug pa la chu yod dam dris pas cang mi smra'o/ /der chu zhes pa'i sgra thos tshe yi dwags sdong dum mes tshig pa 'dra ba rus gong gi lus la spu dang skras g.yogs pa lto ba ri tsam kha kha ba mig tsam yod pa brgya stong du ma 'dus so/ /rna ba bye ba ri 351

snying rje can bdag cag la chu blud cig zer ba kho bos chu slong na chu ga la yod smras pas/ yi dwags rnams na re yi dwags kyi yul ngan mu ge'i grong khyer 'di na chu zhig rnyed rgyu ga la yod/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du chu 'thungs pa lta ci smos chu'i ming tsam yang da res ma gtogs ma thos zer/ khyed rnams las ci'i dbang gis 'dir skyes byas pas/ tshe sngon ser sna'i dbang gis longs spyod sbyin pa ma btang bas 'dir skyes zer/ yi dwags kyi gnas su skye ba'i rgyu ni/ spyir mi dge ba bcu 'bring tsam byas na skye zhing khyad par chags pa dang ser sna brnab sems ma byin pa blangs pa rnams yin pas de ru mi skye bar 'dod na de'i rgyu de dag spong dgos/ dud 'gro'i gnas ni phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po yin/de las kha 'thor ba ni lha mi'i gnas kyi ri klung na gnas so/ /de ru skyes na gsod za bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyes mi khyab pa yod/ de yang phyi'i rgya mtsho na dud 'gro che chung mdog dbyibs mi 'dra ba chang gi sbang ma bzhin gnas/ de dag gi phan tshun gcig gis gcig mnan te rkang lag pa brkyang bskum dang dbugs kyi 'byung rngub tsam yang mi nus/ che bas chung ba 'khyur mid byas zos/ chung ba rnams rub nas che ba 'bug zos byas sdug bsngal myong / kha 'thor ba lha mi'i yul na gnas pa'i ri 352

dwags rnams bros kyang mi thar bar rngon pa dang khyis ded nas gsod/ sgo phyugs rnams la mi theg pa'i khal bkal dbyug pas brdungs sha pags kyi ched du gsod pa sogs sdug bsngal mang /sngon khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rjes sha ba la khyi btang bas sha ba 'jigs dngangs skrag nas bros pas spu nyag re'i rtse na rngul nag 'dzag pa rje mi la'i drung du byung / rje mi la ras chung gnyis mar gyes pas tshong pa zhig gi rtsar phyin dus mon pa zhig gis lug nag po zhig la khong lag btang bas lug gis skad ngan pa bton rgyu ma na ra ra bros nas rje btsun yab sras gnyis kyi drung du 'ong ba gzigs nas mi bzod pa'i snying rje dang skyo shas nges 'byung tshad med pa skyes spyan chab mang du shor ba byung / sngon bram ze shed bu ser skyes dge 'dun mang po la chos rtsod bya dus glang bo'i mgo can khyod kyis ci shes zhes re re bzhin de 'dra ba'i ngan smras mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byas pas/ shi nas mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba bco brgyad tsam yod pa'i chu srin nya'i rigs su skyes nas sdug bsngal myang/ sngon dge 'dun pa'i dkor za mkhan zhig rgyal po'i khab kyi mi gtsang ba bshang gci'i khrod kyi srin bu zhig tu skyes nas sdug bsngal myang ngo / /dud 'gro de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu ni spyir mi dge ba bcu chung ngu byas pa rnams skyes 353

shing / khyad par chos spang ba dang chos dang chos smra ba la ma gus pa dang / chos sgor zhugs pa rnams phan tshun gyi skyon brjod byas pa rnams yin/ /de yang 'o skol rnams kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i mthu cung zad cig la bsten nas da res mi lus thob/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung zab rgyas gdams pa bstan rung da dung chos pa'i gzugs bzung nas chos min gyi las byed pa'i bya spyod la bltas na tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du phyin chad myong 'gyur gyi las sdig pa mi dge ba bgrang gis mi langs pa bsags yod pa'i tshod na gda'/de'i steng du da res lus thog 'di la yang zhar dang zhor la mi dge ba'i las bsags pa rgyal po'i dkor mdzod la bltas pa ltar gang gi phyogs nas bltas kyang mang la/ dge ba'i las byas pa ni bsam na dran rgyu rin chen gser las dkon pas shi na 'gro sa ngan song dang / myong rgyu sdug bsngal las 'os med/ sngon mi gcig mchod rten gyi kha na bsdad 'dug pa/ gzhan gcig gis der ma sdod rnga mong du sgye byas pas/ kho na re 'dab ma yug yug byed cing rnga mong du skye rung e ma zin tshar zer/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams mi dge ba'i dbang gis ngan song gsum du sgye 354

rung sngar byas zin tshar yod pas da ni rang la sems shig yod na sdod pa'i tshod min/ da lta ma shi gong 'dir ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyi gtso byas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyabs nas/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba la 'god pa'i skyabs shig 'tshol dgos/ de la bslu med dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu po che rnams kyis kyang mi 'ong/ 'o na dkon mchog gsum la yon tan ci 'dra yod ce na/sangs rgyas ni skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yin pas yon tan 'di med bya ba med/ sku gsung thugs 'phrin las kyi yon tan mtha' yas/ sku'i yon tan mtshan bzang po sum cu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa sku mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing byang chub mchog gi sa bon rgyud la bskrun nus/ gsung gi yon tan gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i gdangs pi wang gling bu las brgya stong 'gyur gyis ches shin tu snyan zhing rigs drug sems can rang rang gi skad du chos ston nus/ thugs kyis mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du sgyu ru ra rlon pa bzhag nas bltas pa ltar sa ler gzigs/ brtse ba'i yon tan ni g.yas nas tsan dan gyi lde gus byug pa dang / g.yon nas sta gris gshag pa 355

gnyis la yang nye ring phyogs ris med par brtse/ 'phrin las kyi yon tan ni gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sems can dpag med smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus/ sngon ston pa shākya thub pa sangs rgyas nas/ sku'i sgo nas 'od zer spro thengs re re la sems can bye ba ther 'bum grangs kyis mi chod pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas/ ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i gnas rnams lan du ma'i bar du stongs par mdzad/sngon lha'i bu zhig shi nas rgyal po'i khab kyi sha za mo phag mgo can gyi mngal du skye ba shes nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ de ru ma skyes par slar sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/ mi rkang pa zha bo gcig rkun po 'gas bsad nas gnod sbyin zhig yod pa mchod snyam pas/ mi rkang pa zha bo de 'jigs nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ sangs rgyas gnod sbyin de 'dra zhig tu sprul nas 'ongs nas mi 'di da res nga la gson por phul dang dgos pa che byas pas/ rkun po rnams kyis de gnod sbyin yin snyam nas phul ba'i tshe thar par gyur/ sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal la bu mo mdog mi sdug pa zhig yod pas sangs rgyas la dad pas skyabs su song bas gzugs byad mdzes par 356

gyur pa sogs gtam rgyud de 'dra mtha' yas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan de dag dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub dpag med tshe gcig dang lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas 'gro don mtha' yas mdzad pa thams cad chos la bsten nas byung ba yin la/ mi la ras pas mthu btang nas mi mgo so lnga ser ba lan mang phab nas/ srog chags bgrang gis mi lang ba bsad kyang phyis chos la bsten nas sdig pa kun dag nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas/ yul re skong zhes bya ba'i ma gsod byi li 'ur pa zhes bya bas kyang rang gi drin can gyi ma bsad kyang /phyis chos bzhin byas pas dag ste grub pa thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba byung / po to ba'i zhal nas/ dge bshes shākya yon tan gyi chos nyams su bzhes pas/ da lta yung ba tsam na khong bde skyid che/ spyan snga bas kyang de bzhin mdzad pas/ da lta klung shod tsam na bde skyid snyan gsum khong la yod/ ngas kyang dang por chos sgor ma zhugs tsam na byang gser khar lan gsum phyin pa la gser zho gcig yod pa thum ma myong ba la/ da lta nyi ma re re la'ang gser srang mang po yong gin 'dug des na 'o skol rnams kyis chos bzhin byas na tshe 'di nyid la yang bde skyid lha 357

dang mnyam pa yong gsungs/ sngon rkun ma gnyis kyis mi tshang gcig gi mdzod phug ste btsal bas/ chang btsags ran pa'i rdza ma gcig dang 'phrad de/ zhabs nas btsags na tshor gyes dogs kha nas bcus nas 'thungs pas bzi ste/ gcig na re/ ngas glu len zer ba la gcig gis 'di ci zer bdag pos tshor na rang cag gnyis ka bsad yong byas pas ma nyan te glu blangs par gda'/ chang kha nas btsags pa 'di 'dra na/ /zhabs nas btsags na ci ltar mchi/ /zer zhing bro rtses pas/ bdag pos tshor ba byung yang ma brdungs par chang mnyam por 'thung skad/de bzhin du 'o skol chos kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams la yang bde skyid khyem pa las lhag na chos bzhin byas na smos ci dgos/ des na tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum yang chos la bsten nas 'byung bas/ chos kyi yon tan ni mtha' yas/ chos de 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi yon tan yang mtha' yas te/ sngon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis sems can dpag tu med pa dag pa'i zhing du drangs nas/ da ni 'khor ba dong nas sprugs yod dgongs nas ri bo ta la'i rtser phyin nas gzigs pas/ sems can de tsam zhig bsgral rung 'khor ba ma stongs par gzigs pas/ slar 358

yang thugs bskyed dang go cha cher bskyed nas da dung 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can 'dren pa yin par gsungs/sngon shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis dmyal bar rgyu zhing song nas mnar med du slebs tshe/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu nam mkha' la 'phur nas char shing rta'i srog shing tsam gyi rgyun phab pas/ chu des dmyal ba'i me kun bsad/ shā ri'i bu ting nge 'dzin mos pa can zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs nas mnar med gnas kun bsil bar byas sdug bsngal rgyun bcad/ yang mo'u 'gal gyi ma dmyal bar skyes pa len du phyon dus phebs zhor la rdzu 'phrul gyes btags pa'i gnas rnams kyi tsha grang gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag bsal nas bde bar byas pa dmyal ba'i zangs chen po dpag tshad mang po tsam zhig gi nang du 'chod pa zangs dang bcas rdzu 'phrul gyis btegs nas/ bar do'i skabs shig tu 'khyer 'ongs nas ma bton te/ zangs bzhag yod pa nyag phrug 'das log dmyal bar song dus mthong nas 'di ci yin zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la dris pas 'di ni sngon mo'u 'gal gyes ma 'chod pa'i zangs bu'i dzu 'phrul gyis dmyal ba nas btegs 'ongs pa 'dir bzhag pa de yin gsungs/ sngon dbang phyug brgyad thob pa'i rgyal po 'jigs thul gyis 'bangs 359

mi rgan mo zhig gi bu glo bur shi bas phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis gshin rje'i yul du dmag drangs nas 'khor rnams kyis gshin rje chos rgyal gyi 'khor rnams dang 'thab/ 'jigs thul gyis lha tshangs pas gnang ba'i bde chen zho 'thung gi rus pa las grub pa'i mdung rgyab na mi phog mi srid/ phog na mi sgol mi sred/ bsgral na mi 'dren mi srid pa zhig yod pa thogs nas gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dzing grabs byas pas/ srid pa gsum po yom yom 'gul ba byung / de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byen gyis lha'i spyan gyes gzigs nas skad cig de nyid la rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ bar nas gzu byas rgyal po 'jigs thul la lha'i bu zhig sprad/ rgyal po 'jigs thul gyis gshin rje chos rgyal la rgol ba byas pa bzod gsol byas slar mi yul du log nas byung / yang sngon gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba'i mas thag 'thag gin yod pa steng nas sa la 'bab dbang yang ma byung bar glo bur du shi ba mthong nas/ kho'i bsam pa la nged ma bu gnyis kha brda' zhig byas 'chi rgyu ma byung rung / thag gi steng nas kyang mar 'bab dbang ma byung ba 'di gshin rje dbang che rung dpe mi srid pa zhig red snyam/ ma'i ro'i rtsa nas bskyed rim la bsdad de/ gshin rje'i yul la gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon 360

bdun cu rtsa lnga snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ gshin rje ya man+da ga'i dmag rnams btang nas gshin rje pho nya dang 'thab pa'i bar der ma khang ba nag po zhig gi nang du bcug yod pa bros te mi yul du log nas slar ro'i nang du zhugs nas sngar ltar sos pa byung / yang sngon 'phags pa gang po zhes bya ba'i phu bo phyi'i rgya mtsho la tsan dan 'don du phyin pas/ tsan dan bsrung ba'i gnod sbyin rnams kyis tshor nas rlung drag po btang nas gru kha sbub par brtsams pa na/ phu bos 'phags pa gang po la skyabs 'gro byas pas 'phags pa gang pos mkhyen nas dzu 'phrul gyis gru khar byon nas skyabs/ sngon nyag phrug 'das log byang chub sems dpas dmyal bar phyin dus/ grub thob thang stong rgyal pos mda' gzhu zhig thogs te sems can mang po 'dren pa mthong / de bzhin du rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos dmyal ba'i sems can dpag tu med pa bde chen thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa mthong / rje mi las kyang slob ma bon po zhig yod pa shi nas las dbang gis lci ba zhig gi 'og tu srin 'bu phra la ring ba zhig tu skyes yod pa gzigs nas lci ba'i rtsar phebs/ mi kun gyis mthong sar rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du drangs/ de 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud shin tu mang / des na dge 'dun gyi yon tan bsam 361

gyis mi khyab/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran par byas/ spyir 'khor ba khyad par ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum la snying thag pas skyabs su 'gro ba gal che/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas bzung mchod bstod bkur nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong dgos te/ sngon jo bo bod na bzhugs dus rgya gar gyi mi byung ba kun la da lta pha gi na gtam ngo mtshar can ci 'dra 'dug dris pas/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen gcig mu stegs pas bzung nas/ da khyod rang gi lta ba thongs la nga'i lta ba la zhugs/ khyod rang gi lha thongs la nga'i lha la 'jus/ de ltar mi byed na khyod gsod zer ba la/ dge bsnyen na re/ tshig tsam du gtong snying nas gtong mi phod byas pas bsad lags zer ba/jo bo'i zhal nas/ dge bsnyen des bya ba byas pa yin gsungs/mi'i rgyal po nang ba sangs rgyas pa zhig gar log tu phyi rol mu stegs pas btson du bzung nas gsod pas bsdigs te khyod lha dang lta ba gtong na mi gsod zer/ mi gtong byas pas mi gsod par ma zad khyod rang gi rgyal sar slar bzhag thong zer/mi gtong byas pas/ da dung de'i steng du khyod rang gi rgyal srid tsam zhig sbyin gyis thongs zer bas kyang / ma btang bas bsad 362

skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis kyang lus srog longs spyod gang gi phyir yang lha dkon mchog gsum mi spang ba de lta bu re byed dgos gsungs/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ sngon rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i tshong ba mang po chu srin chen po zhig gi kha nang du 'chor du nye ba na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas chu srin gyi kha nas thar/ chu srin des kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra de thos pas sgrib pa dag ste tshe'i dus byas nas rgyal po'i khab tu khyem bdag gi bur skyes/sngon khyung gnyis kyis ri rab kyi bang rim gyi sbrul gnyis la gtses pas sbrul gnyis kyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas gnod pa ma nus pas khyed gnyis kyi ci byas dris pas skyabs 'gro byas smras pas khyung gnyis dang sbrul bzhis skyabs 'gro byas pas rgyal chen bzhi ru gyur / sngon ri khrod pa skyabs 'gro byed pa zhig la rgan mo dad can zhig gis chos shig zhus nas yon du snam bu zhig 'bul pa rkun bo zhig gis go nas/mtshan mo ri khrod pa'i sgor 'ong pa nang nas ri khrod pas skyabs 'gro byas pa'i mthus nang du 'jug ma nus/ phyi nas bsdigs te khyod kyi snam bu de sgor mi ster na nga nang du 'ongs nas/ gsod snying la dmar 'don byas bsad nas khyer 'gro byas 'jigs 363

bslang bas/ nang nas ri khrod pa yang 'jigs pa ltar mdzad nang du ma 'ong dang ster zhes thag pa zhig khyer te/ sgo khung nas lag pa tshur thongs dang ster byas pas btang tshe lag mgo nas thag pas bzung ste tshur 'then nas/ ka ba la btags te dbyug pa zhig khyer te sgo phye nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes gcig brgyab/ de bzhin du chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes gsum rgyab nas/ sgo rgyab thag pa dkrol nas btang bas/ rkun ma shi na tu na nas cher 'gro ma nus par tshur 'ongs/zam zhig yod pa'i 'og nas bsam blo btang ste/ dkon mchog gsum las med pa bzang / de bas mang zhig yod na de ring 'chi tshad pa 'byung bar gda'/ dkon mchog gsum po bka' drin che snyam skyabs 'gro byas pa'i nub der lha 'dre mang po zam steng der 'gro ma nus par zam gyi sne der 'tshogs yod pa 'dre mthong mkhan zhig gis mthong nas 'dir 'tshogs nas bsdad pa ci yin dris pas/ zam 'og 'di na mi gcig gis skyabs 'gro byas pas 'gro ma phod pa yin zhes smras skad/ de la sogs skyabs su song bas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyabs nas/ mtho ris thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob tshul gyi gtam rgyud mtha' yas kyang sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa 364

rnams kyis mdor bsdu na nang ba sangs rgyas par tshud pa dang /sdom pa thams cad kyi brten du 'gyur ba dang / mi dang mi ma yin gyes gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang / sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib srab cing 'dzad pa dang / tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa dang / shi na ngan song du mi ltung ba dang / lam khyad par 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba dang / myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gsungs so/ /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi 'tshal zhing /sangs rgyas kyi rten tsha tsha yan chad spyi bor blangs nas gus par bya/ chos la skyabs su song bas/ sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed cing chos kyi yi ge 'bru gcig kyang 'o brgyal sar mi 'jog dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas grogs mu stegs pa dang mi 'grogs shing / dge 'dun gye rtags spu tsam 'dzin pa la'ang gus par bya'o/ /de ltar slu med dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og nas bsdad de/ skyabs su 'gro bzhin du ngan song gsum gyi rgyu mi dge ba spangs mtho ris kyi rgyu dge ba sgrub dgos/ de la sdig pa byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sngon rgyal po chos 'phags kyis mi zhig la khrems bcad nas gsod du bcug pas/ chu srin zhig tu skyes 365

nas lus la srin 'bu mang po gnas nas zos pa'i sdug bsngal byung / lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyis skye ba sngon rol zhig tu khyi gcig la rdo rgyab nas bsad pa phyis skye ba mang po khyi phag sogs lus ngan pa du ma blangs/ slob dpon bai ro tsa na tshe sngon ma zhig tu shig mang bo bsad pas sku tshe der tsha rong rgyal pos shig dong du —bskyur nas sdug bsngal myang / sngon kha che'i dge slong ra ba ti bya ba tshe sngon rkun mo zhig tu gyur dus be'u zhig brkus pas bdag pos ded nas nags gseb na rang sangs rgyas shig mnyam par bzhag 'dug pa'i mdun du skyur nas bros pas/ des rang sangs rgyas khrid nas zhag drug dong du bcug pa'i rnam smin gyis sku tshe der nags gseb cig na snam bu tshos bsgyur dus khyem bdag cig gi be'u stor ba btsal du yongs pas tshos phru kha phye nas bltas tshe snam bu be'u'i sha ru gyur pa mthong nas rgyal pos btson du zla ba drug bzung nas btang / dge slong ma ud pa las tshe sngon mar byes pa zhig gi mgo la khab brdab nas bsad pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su dgra bcom mar gyur yang rnam smin gyis ma btang bar lcags kyi mdung zhig gis spyi bo nas rkang mthil du phyung nas grongs/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa zhig nga rgyal gyes 366

khengs nas gzhan dag la gnag dzi yin byas pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar gnag dzi byed par gyur/ dge slong spong ba la brtson pa zhig klog pa'i sar phyin pas/ kho'i spong ba byar ma btubs pas tshig pa zos te/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dge slong 'di dag ni mtshan thog sbal ba bzhin skad 'byen to smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar sbal bar skyes/ yang sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi dus/ rgyal po me tog bral gyis gtsug lag khang zhig dge 'dun la phul ba/ phyis bu rab tu byung nas phrag dog gis gzhan sdod du ma bcug pas/ bskal pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu dmyal ba sogs ngan song du skyes pa'i mthar klu pad+ma'i gdong zhes bya bar gyur te lus la gang reg mer 'bar te sdug bsngal myang / sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi dus/ chos smra ba 'khor mang po can zhig gis rnyed bkur thams cad 'khor slob ma rnams la ma byen par rang gcig pus longs spyad cing dge slong gzhan rnams la mi snyan pa smras pas ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myang / phyis shākya'i rgyal po 'jig rten du byon dus klu long pa zhig tu gyur te chu tshan nang du 'tshod cing 'khor slob ma rnams kyang sbal ba dang srin bur gyur nas lus zos nas sdug bsngal myang / sngon dzun pham rab 'jigs gnyis la gser bum pa gang 367

yod pa dzun pham gyis shing phye ru gyur 'dug ces rdzun zhig smras pas skye ba lnga brgyar shing phye'i nang gi srin 'bur skyes/ de'i lan du rab 'jigs kyis rdzun pham gyi bu gnyis spre'ur bsgyur nas/bu spre'ur gyur 'dug ces dzun smras pas spre'u'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs/ drang srong bden tshig 'grub pa zhig gis kyang rdzun gcig smras pas lus kyi 'od nyams pa byung / dge slong ma zhig gis grogs mo rnams la khye mo tsho smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar khyi mor skyes/ rgyal po zhig la rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod gnas mang po yod pa'i nang nas sku gzugs sgur bo zhig yod pa ma tshang ba la/ rgyal po'i bu mos rang sangs rgyas de'i sku gzugs kyi lad mo byas te 'di lta bu de ma tshang 'dug byas pas/ skye ba mang por sgur bor skyes/ sngon jo bos mi tri pis nang gi rdzas cung zad bsten pa dge 'dun pa'i khrims la gnod dogs nas gnas dbyung byas pas/ mtshan mo mnal lam du me tro pi byang sems yin pa la gnas dbyung byas pas ri rab la lan gsum bskor thub pa'i sbrul du skye zer ba rmis/ de la ci phan dris pas/ nyin re la sa cha bdun re btab na phan/ khyad par bod du phyin na phan zer ba rmis pa sogs kyis rkyen byas bod du phebs pa byung /sngon bram ze zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srung gis chos ston pa 368

mthong nas/ dge sbyong 'di ni seṅge bzhin 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba med par chos ston la/ nyan thos 'di dag ni ri dwags phra mo bzhin chos nyan no zhes smras pas/ tshe rabs lnga brgyar seṅge ru gyur/ sngon rna ba bye ba ris rgya mtshor rin chen len du 'gro tshe/mas bu dang gson por kho mo dang nam 'phrad snyam nas ngus pas/ 'dis 'gro khar bkra mi shis pa smra'o snyam khros nas/ ma la khyod ngan song la ci'i phyir mi gzigs/ zhes tshig rtsub po smras pas/ phyi'i rgya mtshor zhugs nas rin po che blangs nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du yongs nas tshong pa kun gyis stor te 'khyams nas ngan song gi gnas mang po mthong ba byung / sngon rdzogs byed kyis chos log bstan pas shi nas dmyal bar lus chen por gyur pa'i lce la lcags kyi thong gshol lnga brgya btsugs nas zhing rmos pa'i sdug bsngal myang bar gyur/ yang sngon bram ze rtsa nag skya zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis/ rgyal po zla ba sbas pa'i bla mchod byas pas/ rgyal po de la dgra byung tshad thams cad la khos drag po mngon spyod byas nas bsad pas/ skye ba phyi mar dmyal bar skyes nas/ lo grangs dpag tu med par sdug bsngal myangs par gyur/ yang paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa la rtsa ltung byung bas/ de'i gab pa 369

'tshol ba'i phyir chos log brtsams pas/ tshe der mgul 'gags nad kyis thebs/ jo bo kha sar pa ṇir gsol ba btab pas/ jo bos khyod kyis chos log brtsams pas nad mi sos par ma zad/ phyi mar ngan song du 'gro zhes gsungs skad/ sngon mi gcig gis dge 'dun la bud med yin zhes ngan smras byas pa'i tshe der pho mtshan gnas 'gyur nas mo mtshan du song shi nas skye ba brgyar bud med kyi lus blangs nas sdug bsngal mang po myang / sngon bram ze zhig gi chung ma la bu zhig btsas pa cher song nas slong mo byas pas la phug spar ba gang rnyed pa ma la bcol nas slar slong du song ba'i bar la mas rang sangs rgyas shig bsod snyoms la byon par phul bas/ kho phyir 'ongs nas la phug byas pas/ ma na re rang sangs rgyas shig la phul song byas pas/ kho khros nas de zos pa de rkang lag rengs shing sbos nas shi bar ma gyur ram zhes tshig ngan smras pas/ lo brgya stong mang po dmyal bar skyes/ phyis rgyal po gsal rgyal du gyur dus kyang la phug zos chu 'thungs pas ma zhu ba'i nad kyis thebs nas rkang lag rengs shing sbos nas shi ba byung / dge ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sku tshe sngon ma zhig tu dbul bor gyur pa'i tshe/ rang sangs rgyas shig la zan dron lan tshwa med pa 370

zhig dad pas phul bas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gye bdag por lan drug dang mnyan yod kyi rgyal po lan drug byas pa'i mthar rgyal po gsal rgyal du gyur/ sngon byes pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la sa spar ba gang phul bas/ 'dzam gling phyed la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya bar gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas gser thub la dbul po zhig gis gzhan 'bul rgyu med pas rtswa btus nas btsong ba'i rin gser gyi dong tse gnyis phul bas/ skye ba thams cad du lag mthil gnyis nas gser gyi dong tse zad pa med pa byung / sngon ded dpon thams cad skyob dang legs grub ces bya ba re re la tshong pa'i 'khor bzhi khri bzhi khri yod pas/ded dpon legs grub kyis 'khor ba snying po med par mthong nas/ 'khor tshong pa rnams skyur nas/ drang srong rnams kyi drung du rab tu byung nas brtson 'grus brtsams pas rang sangs rgyas mngon du byas/ phyis ded dpon thams cad skyob 'khor bcas 'ongs nas tshong pa rnams spangs nas ci'i phyir rab tu byung smras pas/ legs grub kyis cho 'phrul bstan pas kun dad par gyur nas thams cad kyis zang zing gi nor phul bas/ — phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su lha brgyad khrer gyur/ sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pas mthong lam skyes/ sngon rgyal po kṛ khrus sangs rgyas 371

'od srung mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa phul/rin chen sna bzhi'i mchod rten khor yug tu dpag tshad gciga'aphang du dpag tshad phyed pa zhig brtsigs so/ /de la rgyal po kṛ kṛ'i bu 'bring bas gdugs 'bring zhig btegs pa'i bsod nams kyis/ stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid nyis stong lnga brgya byas pa'i mthar sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i gcung dga' bor gyur/ sngon ri brag cig na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang ba zhig gnas te/ de la skyed tshal zhig yod pa la rang sangs rgyas shig byon pa la dad pas bsod snyoms sbyar bas nam zhig mya ngan las 'das pa'i rus pa rnams khyim bdag des bum par bcug ste mchod rten byas gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan btsugs nas gur kum byugs/ dri'i lag ris sum cu byas pas/ gcung dga' bar gyur dus/ mtshan bzang sum cus brgyan pa byung / sngon rgyal po gnyen ldan gyi nu bo/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs 'khor bcas kyis zhabs phyi byas te khrus khang du gshegs nas sangs rgyas la khrus byas pas/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi sku gser gyi mdog lta bu de mthong nas/ dge ba 'di yi mthus bdag kyang ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas 'di'i sku mdog bzhin lus gser gyi mdog lta bur gyur cig byas pas 372

phyis gcung dga' bor gyur dus sku lus gser gyi kha dog lta bu byung / sngon sangs rgyas bsod nams skyabs 'jig rten du byon dus bud med rnya ka zhes bya ba dbul phongs can khyo shug gnyis yod pa la/ gos ras yug gcig las med kyang / bud med rnya ga'i lus las phud nas/ dge slong zhig brgyud nas sangs rgyas bsod nams skyabs la phul ba'i bsod nams kyis tshe der yang snga dro phul ba'i phyi dro bsod nams skyes te yul de'i rgyal po dang btsun mo ngo mtshar nas lus la gyon pa'i gos rgyan rnams phud de/ bza' mi gnyis la bskyal lo/ /de'i tshe bsam pa rnam par dag pas ras sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyi dbang gis/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du gang du skyes kyang ras gos dang bcas te ma'i mngal nas skyes te brel phongs med cing yid bzhin 'byor/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su yang ma'i mngal nas gos dkar po dkris nas byung / rab tu byung nas ring po ma lon par dgra bcom ma dge slong dkar mo zhes bya bar gyur/sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyis rang sangs rgyas shig la chos ston drangs pa'i tshe de nyid rang la zhing la gser gyi snye ma 'khrungs pa byung / sngon 'phreng ldan mas sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms lhung bzed gang phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag 373

bran mo dang dbul mor mi 'gyur bar shog ces smon lam btab pas/ tshe de nyid la ring bor ma lon par rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis blangs nas btsun mor gyur/ sngon ded dpon zhig gis khyim bdag khyo shug gnyis la rin po che'i rna cha rna ba las bkrol nas/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la zhig gso byed du bcug nas grub tshe mchod bkur rgya chen po byas te/ dge ba 'dis bdag phyug po'i rigs su skyes/ chos 'di lta bu thob/ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su khyim bdag stobs sde zhes bya ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor la 'gran pa zhig gi rigs su skyes/ ma'i mngal nas btsas dus rin po che bye ba ri ba'i rna cha rna ba la btags shing rgyu skar gro bzhin la btsas pas/ gro zhun skyes rna ba bye ba ri zhes ming btags so/ /rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas kyi sku tshe de'i sngon rol zhig tu lo bdun gyi bar sems can thams cad la byams pa bsgoms pas/ bskal pa bdun du 'jig rten 'dir ma 'ong ste/ 'jig rten 'jig pa'i tshe 'od gsal du skyes/bltas pa'i tshe tshangs chen du skyes/ de nas stong phrag drug cu rtsa drug gi bar du brgya byen du skyes/ de nas brgya phrag grangs med 374

pa'i bar du 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du gyur/ sngon btsun mo dpal gyi blo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran te mchod rten la phyag byas mar me phul bas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su dpag tshad khor yug 'od kyis 'gengs pa'i lta na sdug pa'i lha mo zhig tu skyes par gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus klu phrug cig nam mkha' lding gis khur nas ri rab kyi bang rim du drangs pa dang / dge slong bsam gtan pa ma thong nas sems dad par gyur te/ dge slong 'di dag ni sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa 'di dag las grol ba yin no snyam du sems shing tshe'i dus byas pas bram ze zhig gi bur skyes te rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur/ yang mi gcig gis lam 'phrang zhig na 'gro mi la gnod pa'i rdo zhig yod pa phud nas/'phangs pas shi nas gshin rjes yar btang ste yig drug bton pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhig tu skyes skad/ sngon phag cig gis lus la 'dam gyis gos pa/ mchod rten zhig la drud pas gas kha bsrubs par sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/ sngon sangs rgyas la rtswa tshong bkra shis ldan gyis rtswa'i gdan phul bas/ de ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang byed ces bya bar 'gyur bar lung bstan/ yang sangs rgyas la tshong dpon 375

nag gon dang bzang po gnyis kyis zho sbrang rtsi dang bcas pa phul bas ma 'ongs pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa sbrang rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya bar 'gyur bar lung bstan/ sngon 'phags pa 'od srung la mdze mo zhig gis slong mo byas nas 'bras chan lhung bzed gang phul ba'i mthus tshe 'phos nas dga' ldan lha'i gnas su skyes/ dge sdig gnyis ka byas na 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis ka 'byung tshul ni/ sngon bshan pa zhig gis nyin par srog bcad/mtshan mo 'phags pa ka t+ya nas gsungs ltar srog gcod spangs pas/ phyis mtshan mo gzhal med khang du lha mo bzhi dang lhan cig brtse zhing / nyin mo gzhal med khang dang bu mo bzhi mi snang bar khye sre bo bzhi byung ste kha bub du bsnyal te rgyab kyi sha pags kham tshad kham tshad bcad cing nyi ma nub kyi bar du zos/ nyi ma nub nas yang sngar gyi lha mo bzhi dang lhan cig tu brtse ba byung / sngon bram ze byi bo byed pa gcig gis nyin par 'phags pa ka t+ya nas gsungs ltar bye bo ma byas/ mtshan mo byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/phyis ngan song du skyes tshe/ nyin par gzhal med khang du lha mo zhig dang lhan cig brtse ba byung / mtshan mo gzhal med khang dang bud med mi snang bar/ srin gyi bud med chen po zhig byung ste lus la 'khrid nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du zos/ nyi ma shar ba 376

dang yang sngar bzhin gyur/ sngon ri dwags gsod mkhan zhig gis nyin par ri dwags bsad/ mtshan mo phyag mchod sogs byas pas/ phyis dmyal bar skyes tshe nyin par bya dang gcan gzan ma rungs pas lus zos/ mtshan mo lon pa dang lha mo mang pos mchod cing dga' mgur spyod pa byung / nam langs pa dang sngar ltar gyur/ sngon rgan mo sdig can ma zhig gis smyung gnas lan gsum bsrung bas nyin gcig ltogs nas zas zos/ nyin gcig skoms nas chang 'thung / nyin gcig legs par bsrungs pas/ shi nas legs par bsrung ba'i mthus sdig sgrib dag nas rgyal po zhig gi sras su gyur/ zas zos pas mdog mi sdug pa dang / chang 'thung bas spyon pa bzhin shes pa mtho dman che ba zhig tu gyur/ sngon bram ze gcig gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa blangs nas legs par bsrungs na lhar skye rgyu yin pa la dgung phyi dro'i kha zas zos pas klur skyes/ 'on kyang klur skyes rung bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa'i mthus zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ rgyal po mdzes ldan gyis mchod rten chen po zhig byed du bcug par gla mi zhig gis 'di lta bu'i mchod rten chen po byed du gzhug par brtsams pa 377

nam tsam zin par 'gyur ma shes so/ /zhes lan gnyis su 'phyas pa la phyis legs par zin pa na 'gyod nas gla rngan gyis gser gye dril bu byed du bcug nas mchod rten la btags so/ /phyis snyan pa bzang ldan zhes bya bar gyur dus sngon lan gnyis 'phyas pas mdog ngan zhing lus chung bar gyur/ dril bu btegs pas skad shin tu snyan par gyur/ sngon mdza' bo'i bu mos tshong byas nyin gcig gar+sha pa ṇi bzhi/ nyin gcig brgyad/nyin gcig bcu drug nyin gcig sum cu rtsa gnyis rnyed pa drin can gyi ma la byen nas/ rgya mtshor tshong du 'gro dus mas 'gror ma bcug par sgo bcad nas nyal bas mgo rkang pas 'phul nas song ba'i gru zhig nas gru tshal zhig la 'jus nas skam la thon pas/ sngon ma la gar+sha pa ṇi byin pa'i bsod nams kyis/dga' ba zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du phyin pas bud med gzugs mdzes blta na sdug pa bzhi byung nas bde bar byon nam 'dir byon zhes bza' btung gos 'bru rin po che mang pos bkur snyi byas lo mang por dga' mgur spyad do/ /de nas lho phyogs ra ro ba zhes bya'i grong khyer gyi sgor phyin pas lha'i bu mo sngar gyi de bas kyang mtshar ba brgyad byung nas sngar bas kyang bsnyen bkur byas lo mang por dga' mgu spyad do/ /de nas dga' ba can 378

zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du phyin pas/ lha mo de bas kyang mtshar ba bcu drug gis bsnyen bkur sngar bas lhag par byas lo mang por dga' mgur spyad do/ /de nas yang tshangs pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba'i grong khyer gyi sgor phyin pas/ nang nas lha mo sngar gyi de bas kyang gzugs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba sum cu rtsa gnyis byung nas/ sngar bas bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byas lo mang por dga' mgur spyad do/ /de nas lcags kyi grong khyer zhig mthong nas der zhugs pas/ sngon ma'i mgo rkang pas 'phul ba'i rnam smin gyes/ zhugs ma thag sgo bcad/ sgo rim pa gsum phye nas song ba'i rim bzhin bcad nang du song ba dang skyes bu zhig gi mgo na lcags kyi 'khor lo me 'bar ba 'khor nas rnag khrag byung ba zas su za bar byed pa zhig mthong nas 'jigs shing skrag nas khyod ci'i phyir 'di ltar gyur dris pas/ ma la gnod pa byas pas 'di ltar gyur zer/ de yin na ngas kyang ma la gnod byas pas nga'i mgo la'ang 'ong snyam ma thag skyes bu de'i mgo thog gi 'khor lo de mdza' bo'i bu mo'i mgor byung nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod rlag med pa pyong / de'i tshe gzhan la snying rje skyes nas 'di 'dra'i las byas pa rnams ngas bzod par bya/gzhan gyes las 'di 'dra byas tshad 'dir ma 'ong cig ces 379

smras ma thag 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phags/ tshe'i dus byas nas dga' ldan lha'i gnas su skyes so/ /las bzang ngan gang byas rang rang gi rjes su 'brangs nas bde sdug myong tshul ni/ sngon mo'u 'gal bza' tsho gsum gyis/ phas chos dge ba byas pas lha tshangs pa'i gnas su skyes nas bde skyid tshad med pa myang / mas sdig pa mi dge ba byas pas/ dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal bzod rlag med pa myang / bu sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung /chos la brtson 'grus byas pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog tu gyur/ sngon bram ze mo zhig gis 'phags pa ka t+ya ya na la bsod snyoms drangs pas/ khyim bdag dang bu mna' ma bran mo bzhi ma dga' bar khyem bdag gis/ de'i kha ru phub ma mi za'am byas/ de bzhin du gzhan ma gsum gyis/lcags kyi thu lum/ rang lda rnag khrag mi za 'am zhes tshig ngan smras pas/ phyis bsod snyoms ster mkhan bram ze mo gzhal med khang du ro brgya'i zas za ba zhig tu gyur nas bde zhing / gzhan tshig ngan smra mkhan bzhi po yi dwags bzhir gyur/ kha ru zas gang bzhag phub ma/ thu lum/ rang sha rnag khrag tu gyur nas sdug bsngal myong ba byung / dkar nag gi las chung yang 'phel che tshul 380

ni/ sngon dge tshul kyun tas dge slong dbyangs mi snyan pa zhig la/khyod kyi dbyangs ni khye zug pa dang 'dra'o zhes smras pas skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du khyer skyes pa dang / dge slong lus rtsal che ba zhig la khyod ni spre'u dang 'dra'o zhes smras pas/ spre'u'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa dang / sngon ming sring gnyis kyi sring mo'i khyem phyags dor ba rang sangs rgyas shig gis mgor phog pa ming po la smras pas/ ming po de dga' nas 'dzum pas/ phyis ming po de 'phags pa ka t+ya ya na zhes bya bar gyur dus/ sngon las kyi dbang gis nyes pa med rung phra ma zhig la brten nas rgyal po gtsug phud can gyi sgye bo'i tshogs la steng du sa gtor du bcug pas/ 'phags pa sa'i 'og tu nub nas sdod dgos byung / sngon sran ma 'tshong mkhan zhig gis sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la dwangs pa'i sems kyis sran ma gtor bas bzhi lhung bzed du song / gcig dbu la chags pas/ phyis gling bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi phyed dbang ba'i rgyal po spyi bo skyes zhes bya bar gyur/sngon bram ze zhig gis mchod rten zhig gi glang po'i gzugs kyi ri mo nyams pa la slar zhig gso byas pas/ tshe rabs mang por glang po che zhig dang 'bral med byung / sangs rgyas kyi dus su yang khye'u ba glang skyong zhes bya ba skyes pa dang dus mnyam glang 381

chen zhig kyang skyes pa 'bral med byung / sngon byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed ces bya ba la/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo dpal yon ma shin tu chags pas/ 'dod chags kyis gdungs nas shi bas/sum cu rtsa gsum gye lha'i bur skyes/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa'i tshul ni/ sngon dge bshes chen po glang ri thang pas sems can gyi don du dmyal bar skye ba'i thugs smon btab kyang dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs dmyal bar skye ba'i rtags gcig kyang ma byung / sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su dgra bcom pa sgur chung gis thabs ci byas kyang lto ma rnyed par mu ge myong bas mthar thal skyo 'thung nas grongs pa byung / sngon grub chen me bong rdo rjes sgrub pa mdzad dus/ 'tsho ba ma 'byor bar tsam la sgrub nas zhal bstan yang dngos grub ma gnang / nam mkha' la 'phur nas dzu 'phrul bstan yang yul mi ma dad/ sngon las med pas thabs ci mdzad rung mthun rkyen ma 'byor bar/'phur nas kong po ru phebs pas/ de na sngon rdzi bo zhig tu gyur dus grog tshang zhig la zan phye gtor bas sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yod pa'i skye po pho mo kun dad nas 'tsho pa byung skad/ yang sngon yi dwags mo phrug gu lnga brgya yod pa zhig gi khyo ka yi dwags des lto mi lo lnga brgya'i bar du btsal yang dge slong zhig gis lud pa 382

'phangs pa zhig las gzhan gang yang ma rnyed/ ngan slong zhig gis ston mo gsum nyin gcig la yod pa kun za snyam rgyugs pas/ ston mo gsum po ma non par shor nas skal pa chad ba byung skad/ des na sngon gyi las kyi 'bras bu zhig med na/ brgya bsams kyang gcig ma 'grub pa'i gtam rgyud de 'dra mang /las byas pa chud mi za ba'i tshul ni/ sngon bdud lhas sbyin 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas gsod snyam/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'dzegs nas sgogs 'phangs pa/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes bar snang nas phye mar brlab/ pas/ phyed bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas su lhung gnod sbyin ku be+e ras bzung bas legs par ma zin par de nyid du bsad/ rdo yi dum bu zhig yar bas sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la phog nas rma byung ngo / /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis/ gang du gnas kyang las kyis mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang na med rgya mtsho'i gting na med/ /ri bo rnams kyi gseb tu zhugs na'ang min/ /gsungs/ yang sngon sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du seng ldeng gi tshal ba zhig slebs byung ba zhabs la 'jugs pa mkhyen nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i mthongs rgya mtsho'i gting / ri rab kyi rtser phyin yang sleb byung ba'i tshe zhal nas/ gang du gnas kyang 383

zhes pa'i tshig bzhi de gsungs nas steng du zhabs bzhag pa'i steng du rdol nas byung / de las ci mdzad nas zug zhus pas/sngon gnas shig na ded dpon gnyis yod pa rgya mtshor grur zhugs nas song / tshur 'ong dus ded dpon gcig gis rin po che lci bas gru rgya mtshor nub song / ded dpon de gzhan ded dpon des gru nang du bzhag nas 'ongs pas kho phrag dog bsam ngan skyes/ lkog tu gru phug nas tshong pa kun rgya mtshor bskyur bar brtsams pa de ma byed ces bshad kyang ma nyan tshe kho rang gi mdung 'phrogs nas kho'i snying khar bsnun nas bsad pas/ lo brgya stong bye ba mang bor dmyal bar skyes/ las de'i lhag mas da lta yang nga'i zhabs la seng sdeng gi tshal ba zug pa yin gsungs/ yang sngon rgyal po 'phags skyes bo dang blon po ma la gnod gnyis kyis/ nyes pa med bzhin du shākya lnga brgya bsad pa'i tshe/ ston pa'i dbu yang bsnyung tshabs chen pos thebs par gyur/ de'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ sngon nya pa lnga brgyas nya chen po gnyis kyi steng nas sha gson po bcad pa'i tshe nya gnyis kyis 'o dod bos pa nya pa'i khye'u zhig gis go nas dga' bar gyur to/ /de'i dus kyi nya gnyis ni da lta rgyal blon gnyis su gyur/ nya pa lnga brgya shākya lnga brgya/ de'i dus kyi khye'u de nga yin pas/ da lta 384

nga'i dbu bsnyung bar gyur gsungs/ yang sngon yul sgra mthar rgyal po bram ze mes sbyin gyis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gzhan gyis 'tsho ba sbyar mi chog pa'i khrims bcas pas gzhan khrims la 'jigs nas 'tsho ba ma sbyar/ de'i dus byang phyogs nas tshong pa zhig 'ong bas rta chas su nas rul yod pa phul ba blangs nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gsol/ shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis/ ri bo rtse gsum khar phyin pas brgya byin gyis lha'i bdud rtsi btabs so/ /de'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs 'khor bcas kyis bsod snyoms byas pa'i tshod ma dang 'bras chan gyis lhung bzed bkang ba/ bram ze slob dpon zhig gis mthong bas phrag dog skyes nas/dge sbyong mgo reg 'di tsho'i tshod ma 'bras chan ro sna tshogs za bar mi 'os/ nas rul za bar 'os pa yin zhes smras pas bram ze khye'u rnams kyis kyang slob dpon gyis de ltar lags so zhes brjod/ bram ze gzhan gnyis na re/ de skad ma smra lha'i bdud rtsi gsol bar 'os lags smras so/ /de'i dus kyi bram ze slob dbon phrag dog mkhan de nga yin khye'u rnams ni dge slong lnga brgya gnyis kyis ma tshang ba 'di/ bram ze gzhan gnyis ni shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis yin gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi 385

slob ma dgra bcom pa rdzu 'phrul thob pa kun gyis mchog gyur/mo'u 'gal gyi bu la rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med rung las dbang gis/ mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyis bzung nas rkang lag rnams 'dam bu'i tshal ltar bcom mo/ /shā ri'i bus de dus rdzu 'phrul ma bstan nam byas pas/ las kyis non nas rdzu ba'ang ma dran na 'phrul ba lta ci smos gsungs nas sku grongs/ de'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyi bu pha ma la khros nas 'di gnyis rkang lag 'dam bu bzhin bcom na 'gal ba med ces tshig ngan smras pas/ tshe rabs lnga brgya ru rkang lag bcoms nas shi da lta dgra bcom par gyur yang las de'i lhag mas de ltar gyur gsungs/ yang sngon khyem pa kun dad par byed pa'i dge slong 'char ka mngon shes rdzu 'phrul che rung / sngon las kyi dbang gis nyes pa med bzhin du gtum mo'i mna' ma rkun po'i dmag dpon dang g.yo can lnga brgyas bzung nas mgo bcad phung po phyags dar khrod du sbas so/ /de'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ sngon rgyal po tshangs byin gyis mdun na 'don gyis/rnga phran pho mo gnyis kyis chags pa'i dbang gis rgyab rgal byed pa mthong nas tshig pa zos nas gsod grab byas tshe khye'u lnga brgyas 'di gnyis lags so zhes lag pa brkyang nas bstan pas/386

rnga phran gnyis kyis smon lam log pa btab nas shi'o/ /de'i dus kyi mdun na 'don da lta dge slong 'char ka 'di yin/ rnga phran pho mo gnyis gtum mo'i mna' ma dang rkun po'i dmag dpon/ khye'u rnams g.yo can lnga brgya ru gyur/ las de'i dbang gis grongs pa yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yid ches dgos tshul ni/ sngon khyem bdag cig gi bud med kyis/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la chos ston drangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyis khyim bdag ma ma 'ongs pa na/ rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan pas/ bud med kyis khyim bdag la bshad pas/ khyem bdag gi bsam pa la zan rdog gcig tsam drangs pa la de tsam gsungs pa mi bden snyam nas sangs rgyas la/ nga'i bud med la lung bstan pa de bden nam zhus pas/ de bden gsungs/ de cis shes zer ba la/ khyod kyis 'jig rten na rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byin pa mthong ngam gsungs pas/ de mthong shing n+ya gro rnya 'di nyid yin no zer/ 'o na de'i rgyu la 'bras bu de tsam 'byung bar mi rigs sam gsungs pas/ de ngas mngon sum yin no zer/ de yin na snga ma de yang nga'i ye shes chen po'i mngon sum yin no gsungs/ sngon drang srong snang ba zhes bya bas shing n+ya gro rnya bya ba gcig la yal 387

ga dang 'dab mang du yod pa/ lo bcu gnyis su bgrangs pas shes pa kho khengs nas yod pa dang / bram ze sngo sangs bya ba zhig der 'ong ba la/ kho na re/ shing 'di la yal ga dang lo 'dab du yod zer ba la/ bram ze des rtog dpyod rang med par 'di tsam yod do byas pas/ drang srong de dad nas/ ngas de tsam du bgrangs pa khyod kyis skad cig la shes pa/ khyed ni thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /khyod sangs rgyas pa'i dus na nga yang 'khor du gyur cig zer ro/ /de dus kyi bram ze de ni da lta nga'o/ /drang srong ni shā ri'i bu 'di nyid do gsungs/ sngon slob pa lam gye dus na'ang de 'dra na sangs rgyas pa'i tshe dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pa smos ci dgos/ sangs rgyas kyis tsher ma rno ba dang / sran ma zlum pa/pha wang long bu gru bzhir 'ong ba/ rma bya'i mdongs bkra ba sogs chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma lus pa thugs su chud pas gang yang ma 'dres par sa ler dus gcig tu mkhyen pas/ dzun gsungs don med pas gsung rnams tshad mar 'dzin dgos/ 'o na sdig pa byed pa 'ga' zhig la tshe 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba ci yin snyam na/ sngon yul sgra sgrogs kyi sdig can rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis 'phags pa ka ta ya na la thal ba gtor bas dang po yul du rin po che sogs kyi char babs 388

kyang / rjes su sa'i char babs nas 'og tu shor/ yul khams thams cad dus gcig la brlag pa byung / de bzhin du sdig can kha cig la da lta bde skyid bag re byung ba de skye ba snga ma dge ba bag tsam byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ de myur du zad nas shi ma thag dmyal bar 'gro ba'i snga ltas yin pas de 'dra la smon rgyu spu tsam med gsungs/ 'o na dge ba byas pa kha cig la sdug bsngal 'byung ba ci yin snyam na/ sngon ras chung pa la sa bdag gi nad byung ba'i rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul mar song / rgya gar du phyin pas bla ma wa la tsan+t+ra dang mjal/ phyag rdor khyung sogs kyi gdams pa zhus pas snyung gzhi las grol/ sems can gzhan gyi mdze nad rgyun bcad/ grub pa thob nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ dge slong ma dpal mo yang sa bdag gi nad byung nas thugs rje chen po bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs snyung gzhi las grol grub pa thob nas dbu bcad nas 'khar bsil la btags nas gar mdzad pa sogs rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas dag zhing du gshegs/ jo bo 'da' khar 'brom gyis nga yang dga' ldan du skye ba zhig zhus pas/ phyis snyung gzhi sa bdag gi nad byung nas gshegs rkyen byas na/ dga' ldan du skye gsungs pa phyis de ltar gyur tshe/ 'brom gyis nga'i bsam don 'grub 389

gsungs spro bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas dga' ldan du gshegs/ des na dge ba byed pa la na tsha sogs mi 'dod pa byung ba/ las sgrib kun dag nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'am/yang na phyi ma dag zhing du skye ba'i snga ltas yin pas/ mi 'dod par byar mi rigs/ 'o na mi dge ba gang yin snyam na/ che long rags rim tsam bsdu na lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang ma byin pa len pa mi tshangs pa spyod pa/ ngag gi sgo nas dzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste/ mi dge ba bcu bo 'di ka yin pas spang dgos/ de la srog gcod pa ni/ che ba mi dang rta g.yag nas chung ba sa'i srin 'bu lus kyi shig yan chad gsod pa spang / ma byen len ni/ che ba rta mdzo gser dngul nas chung ba khab skud pa yan chad gzhan gyis ma byin pa mi len/ mi tshangs spyod ni/ khyem pa rnams kyis rang gi chung ma ma gtogs gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i chung ma la mi spyod/ rang gi chung ma la yang bsnyen gnas sgyung gnas bsrung dus/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung bla ma pha ma'i nye 'khor sogs nas spyod pa spang / rdzun ni lha mthong 'dre mthong sogs pha rol bslu ba'i rdzun chen po dang / tha na ku re bzhad gad kyi phyir yang rdzun mi smra/ phra ma ni gtam dngos 390

sam yang na rdzun dang g.yo sgyu gang rung gis mthun pa rnams mi mthun par byed pa spang / tshig rtsub ni/ sod chod rgyob gtubs sogs mi snyan pa'i tshig dang / spre'u dam nyams sdom shor bdud mo sogs pha rol ba'i sems la gnod pa'i tshig rtsub ngan pa thams cad mi smra bar spang / ngag 'khyal ni/ don med pa'i gtam/ 'thab rtsod jag rkun smad 'tshong ma smre sngags kyi lad mo rtsed rgod 'dod chags log 'tsho'i gtam sogs smyon pa bzhin mtho bshad dma' bshad ci zer 'di zer med pa thams cad spang / brnab sems ni/ pha rol gyi mi nor zas gsum sogs longs spyod 'di dang 'di lta bu nga la yod na ci ma rung snyam pa thams cad spang / gnod sems ni/ rang dang mi mthun pa'i pha rol gzhan la gnod cig skyel snyam pa dang gzhan gyis gnod pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa spang / log lta ni bla ma dang grogs la skyon gyi phung por blta ba/ dkon mchog gsum dang las rgyu 'bras med par blta ba/ phan btags par gnod dang /gnod bskyal ba la phan du blta ba/ khyad par du tsa ri'i phyogs kyi mtha' 'khob kla klo na pha ma sogs shi na dge rtsa la srog chags mang po ci sod byas/ sems can brgya'am stong re tsam gsod rgyu byung na/ pha ma'i drin gzo dge ba legs po byung zer 391

ba yin skad/ gangs ri'i phyogs kyi mtha' mi mon pa rnams kyis kyang pha ma sogs shi na g.yag khra bo gcig cis kyang btsal nas gsod la/ gal te ma rnyed na gzhan bya pho yan chad kyi sems can zhig gsod dgos skad/ mtsho pad+ma'i phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig shi ba'i ro dang lhan du de'i btsun mo bcu gsum de dag rnams kyi g.yog dang bcas mi mgo sum cu so gsum sdebs gcig la me chen po'i nang du gson bsregs byas skad/ gzhan yang bal bo mon sogs na de ltar khyo ga'i ro dang lhan du bud med gson bsreg byed pa dus da lta yang mang po yod skad/ de ci yin dris na tshe phyi mar gnyis ka lhan du skyes nas skyid po yong zer skad/yang kong po'i phyogs shig na'ang dug btang nas gzhan bsad na phyug po yong ba yin zer nas dug btang nas mi mang po gsod pa yin skad/ de lta bu'i gnod 'tshe chos su blta ba'i lta ba log pa phyi rol pa sogs kyi rjes su 'jug mi rung / log lta 'di mi dge ba thams cad kyi nang nas thu ba yin pas de lta bu'i bsam sbyor ngan pa dug bzhin du spang mdor na mi dge bcu bo 'di rang gis mi byed pa tsam du ma zad/ gzhan la byed du 'jug pa/ gzhan gyis byas pa la rjes su yi rang tsam yang mi byed par spang bar bya'o/ /sngon khyem bdag tshul khrims tshong 392

dpon gyis rdzun mi zer bas thams cad kyi dpang po byed pa la/lan cig g.yo can 'ga' gros byed pa la gcig na re/ nged tsho lo gcig 'tsho ba'i thabs yod de/ khyim bdag sdums byed kyi 'byor ba 'di tsho nged kyi yin no byas la/ khyim bdag tshul khrims la thams cad yid ches pas kho dben par 'khrid la bsdigs la khas len byed du gzhug byas pas/ de thabs yin no zer nas/tshul khrims kyis tshong dpon bzung nas dben par khrid de/mtshon thogs nas khyod 'chi'am gson byas pas/ khyed ci ltar byed pa'o zer/ khyed rang la rag las pas nged tsho'i dpang po byas na mi gsod byas pas/ bden pas byed dgos sam rdzun pas byed dgos zer/ rdzun pas byed dgos byas pas/ tshong dpon gyi bsam pa la tshe 'di'i srog gi phyir rdzun byas na skye ba gtan du sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur bas de bas shi ba rang sla snyam/ khyed rang sod cig dzun mi smra byas pas g.yo can rnams kyis btang ngo / /de bzhin du srog la babs kyang dzun sogs mi dge ba bcu mi byed pa gal che/ 'o na dge ba ci ltar sgrub dgos snyam na/ mi dge ba bcu bo spang ba de dge ba bcu yang yin/ de ltar spong ba la 'bad na mtho ris kyi rten gtsang ma zhig thob par gsungs/ 'on kyang sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis/ phyi 393

mar lam sgrub pa la sa chod che ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa/ kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa/ tshig btsun pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ skye ba nyid yin pa/ stobs dang ldan pa ste/ rnam smin brgyad ldan gyi lus rten khyad par can thob pa'i rgyu dge ba mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyang tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba dkon pas ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba gzhan brgyud nas sangs rgya dgos/ de la tshe ring po byung na/ dge ba mang bo yun ring bsog nus pas/ de'i rgyu la da lta sems can gzhan la mi 'tshe zhing mi 'tshe ba'i bsam pa rgyun du bsten pa dang / gzhan yang srog blu tshe thar btang ba nad pa'i nad g.yog sman sbyin pa/srog chags bong bu sogs la dbyug pa sogs kyis 'tshe ba ma byas/ gzhan gyis byed pa la yang thabs du ma'i sgo nas byed du ma bcug na/ tshe ring ba dang nad med par 'gyur/ kha dog mdzes na mthong ba tsam gyis gdul bya 'du zhing tshig la nyan pas/ de'i rgyu la mar me sogs snang ba dang / gos rgyan gsar ba sbyin pa/ gzhan yang khro ba med par bzod pa bsgoms na/gzugs byad mdzes par 'gyur/ kun gyes bkur ba'i rigs mthon por skyes na/ gang bsgo ba las gzhan mi 'da' bar sgrub 394

pas/ de'i rgyu nga rgyal bcoms nas bla ma mkhan po sogs la phyag sogs bya zhing / gzhan kun la yang bran ltar gus par byas na mthon po'i rigs su skyes/ gnyen 'khor longs spyod sogs 'dzoms nas dbang phyug che ba byung na/ sbyin pas sems can rnams bsdus te smin par byed nus pas/ de'i rgyur zas gos sogs kyis slong ba la phan 'dogs pa dang / ma slangs kyang phan 'dogs gang nus bya/ dge 'dun pa sogs chos byed pa la mkho ba'i yo byad med pa la yo byad sbyin pas dbang phyug che bar 'gyur/ tshig btsun po byung na/ gdul byas tshig rnams tshad mar bzung nas sgrub pas/ de'i rgyur ngag gis nyes pa/ dzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal rnams spangs pas tshig btsun par 'gyur/dbang che bar grags pa byung na phan btags pa'i byas pa drin gzo 'ong zhing myur du bgo ba nyan pas/ de'i rgyur phyi mar rang la yon tan sna tshogs 'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs shing /dkon mchog bla ma mkhan slob pha ma la mchod pa byas pas/dbang che bar grags par 'gyur/ skye ba pho lus thob na chos byed pa la gegs nyung bas chos gang byed kyang rang dbang thob pas/de'i rgyur pho lus thob pa la dga' zhing 'dun pa bya/ bud med kyi lus la mi dga' zhing nyes dmigs su blta/ pho yi dbang po 395

gcod pa thar bar byas pas skye ba pho lus thob par 'gyur/stobs dang ldan na rang gzhan gyis don gang yang spro bzhin sgrub nus pas/ de'i rgyur gzhan gyis gtan nas ma nus pa rnams rang gis byed cing / bsdoms nas nus pa rnams la'ang grogs byed cing bza' btung byen pas stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ de ltar rnam smin gyis yon tan brgyad dang ldan pas dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can gyi rgyu la tshe 'dir 'bad na/phyi mar de lta bu'i rten gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa thob nas/ rten de la gang zag dbang po rab kyis gsang sngags kyi lam zab mo sogs la brtson na tshe der sangs rgya la/ gal te de lta bu ma byung yang ma 'ongs pa na lha bas lhag pa'i lus thob nas/ rten de'am ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po sha stag brgyud nas myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na sems can gzhan la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod pa'i las thams cad la mi dge ba zer bas dug bzhin du spong dgos/ sems can gzhan la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa thams cad la dge ba zer bas sgrub 'tshal/ dus rgyun du nyes spyod kyis ma gos pa la 'bad cing / gal te bag med pa dang / nyon mongs pa stobs che zhing gnyen bo stobs chung ba'i dbang gis 'phral du nyes pa 396

byas pa dang / tshe stod dang tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su ma shes pa'i dbang gis sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bsags pa rnams kyang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags dgos te/ sngon dge slong zhig grong du bsod snyoms la phyin pas pham pa byung nas/ 'chab sems ni ye med par/ nga ni nyams pa'o zhes sgrogs shing mnyan yod kyi them pa la 'gyel nas 'dug pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ dge slong ma 'jigs shig nga la stobs bzhi zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs yod do zhes stobs bzhi gsungs pa yin pas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byas na/ pham pa bzhi dang mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa yang dag par 'gyur te/ sngon mi gdung ba sor mo'i 'phreng ba can zhes bya bas/ mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa/ phyis rnam par sun 'byin pa kun tu spyod pa'i stobs nyams su blangs pas/ sdig pa thams cad byang nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rnam par sun 'byin pa kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la dug khong du shor ba lta bu'i mnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas yul khyad par can phal mo che'i spyan sngar mthol bshags byas na dag par 'gyur/ sngon khye'u bde byed ces bya 397

bas rang gi drin can gyi ma bsad pas phyis gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs nyams su blangs pas shi nas lhar skyes te 'phags pa rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs stong nyid bsgom pa dang / mdo sde kha ton byed pa dang / gsang sngags kyi bsgom bzlas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mchod 'bul sku gzugs bzhengs pa/ sa tsā gdab pa chos klog pa 'bri ba sogs dge ba'i las la 'bad na sdig pa dag par 'gyur/sngon gcung dga' bo zhes bya ba bud med la chags pas/ phyis nyes pa de las slar ldog pa'i stobs nyams su blangs pas nyes pa kun dag nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs phyin chad sdig pa mi dge ba'i las srog la babs kyang mi byed do snyam pas sdom sems yang yang byas na sdig pa dag par 'gyur/ sngon rgyal bu mthong ldan zhes bya bas rang gi drin can gye pha bsad pas/ phyis rten gyi stobs nyams su blangs pa'i sdig pa dag nas byang chub sems dpar gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / rten gyi stobs dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa sogs byas na sdig pa dag par 398

'gyur/ de ltar byas na stobs bzhi bo de dag re res kyang sdig pa de tsam dag na/ bzhi ka nyams su blangs na sdig pa 'dag pa smos ci dgos snyam du/ dus rgyun du stobs bzhi'i sdig bshags byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /'o na sngon rgyal po dpa' bas byen gyis/ me tog zla mdzes bkrongs pa la 'gyod de mchod rten byas mchod pa shin tu rgya che ba byas shing / nyin re la dus gsum du sdig pa bshags pa/ lo stong phrag bye ba go lngar byas te/ tshul khrims yang dag par bsrung yang / shi 'phos nas mnar med du skyes pa dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig re gnyis su mig bcar ba sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas par myang bar gsungs pas/sdig pa bshags kyang e 'dag mi shes snyam na/ de yang sdig bshags byas pa don med du gyur pa ma yin te/ ma bshags na de bas kyang che ba dang rgyun ring ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa la/ bshags pas sdug bsngal chung ngu dang yun thung du btang ba yin/ 'on kyang sngon tsa ri rong bskor byed dus mi 'ga' zhig gi rkang pa lam 'phrang gi rdo yis bsnad pa la sman bcos byas slar sos kyang sngon du 'gro ba rnams kyang kun gyi rjes su lus nas gnas 'khor ba la rgyang ring nge song ba ltar sdig pa bshags pa byas pas 'dag kyang myur du sangs rgya ba la rgyang ring nge 'gyur/399

des na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis sngon nas sdig pas ma gos pa byed pa mchog yin/ gal te brgya la gos pa byung na de ma thag stobs bzhi'i bshags pa yid che ba re byas na 'phral du sdig pa dag par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyis 'gro kun gnas skabs su/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang thob thabs gang gsungs pa/ /skyes bu chung dang thun mong lam rim du/ /bsdus nas dam pa'i gsungs bzhin bshad tshar song / /ngan song gsum dang ngan 'arge'i rigs su skyes/ /sdug bsngal myong na 'dod mkhan su yang med/ /sdug bsngal mi 'dod bde ba 'byung 'dod na/ / de rgyu mi dge spong la dge ba sgrub/ /lam bzang sgrub la mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten/ /thob na lam la sa chod chen po 'byung / /de phyir phyi ma rnam smin brgyad ldan gye/ /rten bzang thob pa'i rgyu la da 'bod cig /de tsam zhig las sgrub par mi nus pa'i/ /khyem pa dman pa bran g.yog la sogs pas/ /de ltar sgrub la phyi mar mi yi lus/ /rnyed nas rten der sangs rgyas thob par smon/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i phun tshogs thob pa'i thabs/ /gang shes rang gzhan yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /rags rim tsam zhig gsal bar bshad zin nas/ /da ni 'khor ba'i chu 400

bo rab med la/ /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i gru btang nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' ru/ /legs par bgrod tshul gang shes 'di ru bshad/ /de yang sngon byes pa zhig skas la 'dzegs nas ma la nga e mtho zhes dris pas/ ma na re/ mtho mtho ste da dung 'gro nus na yar mthor thong smras pa bzhin du/ rnyed dka' 'jig sla ngan song sdug bsngal bsams nas de las skyob pa'i skyabs 'gro las 'bras dkar nag gi blang dor byas nas/ phyi mar mtho ris su skye ba zhig byas na/ ngan song gsum la bltas na mtho mtho ste/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam yang mi thos pas gtan bde thar pa'i go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul la bsam na/ mtho rgyu rang med pas/ da dung de'i steng du lam la slob nus na bslabs nas/ thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa zhig bya dgos te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi mar mi lus tsam zhig thob kyang / sngar gyi dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na/ slar yang ngan song gsum du skye zhing / sdug bsngal myong bzhin du 'phral la sdig pa bsags nas/ bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos shing / mtho ris kyi rten bzang po thob kyang mi rtag cing / ngan song gsum gyi sbug bsngal tsam zhig med pa ma gtogs/ gzhan 401

skye rga na 'chi 'du 'bral brdeg brdung / bkres skom grang dro ngal dub sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ rab tu byung lam bslab pa gsum la bslabs nas/ gtan bde thar pa'i go 'phang thob par bya tshul ni/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi gcung dga' bo rab tu byung yang bzang mo la da dung ha cang chags pa mkhyen nas/ ri bo spos ngad ldan du khrid nas spre'u mo zhar ma zhig bstan te/ bzang mo dang 'di gnyis gang gzugs bzang gsungs pas/ dga' bo na re/ spre'u mo 'di bzang mo'i brgya'i char yang mi mchi zer/ de nas sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas su khrid nas lha mo rnams la ltos gsungs pas/ der bltas pas phyogs gcig na lha'i bu mo mang po sdod pa mthong nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ gcung dga' bos ston pa'i spyan sngar tshangs spyod bsrung nas shi na 'dir 'ong bas de'i phyir 'dir sdod zer bas/ dga' nas ston pa'i mdun du 'ong bas/ lha mo de dag dang bzang mo gnyis kyi gzugs gang bzang gsungs pas/bzang mo lha mo de dag gi brgya'i char yang mi mchi zer tshangs spyod bsrung na phan yon 'di dang gzhan yang yod srungs shig gsungs pas/ bzang mo la ma chags par lha mo de dag 'a chags 402

nas lha gnas su skye bar 'dod nas tshangs spyod bsrung ngo / /de nas nyin gcig sangs rgyas kyis gcung dga' bo dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid nas bltar bcug pas/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo rab med dang / sog les gshags pa dang / sta res gcod pa la sogs pa mthong / phyogs shig na zangs shig gi nang du khro chu bskol nas nang du sems can su yang mi 'jug pa zhig kyang mthong nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ gcung dga' bos lha'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i phyir tshangs spyod bsrung ba shi na lha ru skye/ de nas tshe 'phos pa dang 'dir 'ong bas de nang du 'jug pa'i phyir bzhag go zer ba/ de thos nas 'jigs nas 'ong ba ston pa'i zhal nas lha'i 'jig rten la smon nas tshangs spyod bsrung na nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas/ khyod kyis myang 'das thob pa la dga' bar gyes lha'i 'jig rten la dga' bar ma byed cig gsungs pas/ gcung dga' bo 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log nas myang 'das thob pa'i phyir tshangs spyod bsrung / chos la brtson 'grus brtsams pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis mtho ris lha mi'i gnas gang du skyes kyang dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na slar ngan song gi gnas su lhung nas sdug bsngal myong 403

dgos par bsams nas mtho ris kyi bde ba la yang mi chags par/ gtan bde thar pa'i bde ba thob pa zhig bya dgos/ sngon mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis yab kyi rgyal srid bzung yod dus/ dus lan cig gi tshe sras gzhon nu shing rta la chibs te/ grong khyer gyi shar sgor phyin pa na/ mi rgas shing 'khogs pa/ lus sgur bor gyur pa/ mgo spra thog bzhin dkar ba/ kha sna zhom pa/ so bud pa/ 'a khar ba la brten pa/ yan lag thams cad 'dar ba zhig gzigs pas/ shing rta'i kha lo bsgyur ba la 'di ci yin dris pas/ 'dun pas smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di rgas pas zil gyis non/ /dbang po rgud cing sdug bsngal lus stobs nyams/ /gnyen bshes tshogs kyi spangs shing mgon med gyur/ /rang don mi nus gzhan gyis bor ba gzigs/ /zhes zer ro/ /de nas sras gzhon nus 'di ni 'di gcig pu'i rigs lags sam/ gzhan gye rigs la'ang 'ong dris pas/ 'dun pa na re/ lha gcig 'di yi rigs chos ma lags yul 'khor chos ma lags/ /skye bo kun kyang dar la babs pa rgas pas 'joms/ /khyod kyi yab dang yum dang gnyen grogs kyang / /rgas pas thar pa'i thabs ni gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes smras tshe/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ bdag cag byis pa'i skye bo mi mkhas pa/ /blo ngan gzhon 404

pa'i rgyags pas rgas ma mthong / /da ni slar 'gro shing rta myur du bsgyur/ /gang yang rgas la gnas na rtse dgas ci zhig bya/ /gsungs nas shing rta nang du bsgyur te grong khyer du zhugs so/ /yang dus gcig gi tshe sngar ltar lho sgor phyin pas/ mi sngo zhing rid pa/ rmu dzings can sman pa dang kha zas kyi bor ba rang gi mi gtsang bas lus la gos shing / mgon med skyabs med cig gzigs pas/ kha lo bsgyur ba la dris pas/ 'dun pa na re/ lha gcig mi 'di nad kyis btab pa ste/ /nad kyis nyen zhing myur du 'gums la thug /zug rngus gzir zhing lus stobs rnam par nyams/ /mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen med pa lags/ /zhes smras pas/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ 'di ni 'di gcig pu'i rigs lags sam/ gzhan gyi rigs la'ang 'ong dris pas/'dun pas tshigs bcad snga ma bzhin smras tshe/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ nad med pa ni rmi lam rtse zhing dga' dang mtshungs/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa 'di ltar shin tu mi bzod pa/ /skyes bu mkhas pas gnas 'di mthong na ji lta bur/ /rtse la dga' zhing sdug pa'i 'du shes ci phyir skye/ /gsungs nas shing rta slar bsgyur te grong khyer du zhugs so/ /yang dus gcig gi tshe grong khyer gyi nub sgor phyin pas/ mi gcig shi nas ro khyogs la bteg te/ nye 405

du'i tshogs rnams ngu zhing brang brdung smre sngags 'don zhing 'o dod 'bod pa zhig gzigs pas/ kha lo bsgyur ba la dris pas/'dun pa na re/ lha gcig mi 'di shi bar gyur pa ste/ /pha ma ma mchis bu rnams kun dang bral/ /longs spyod khyem dang mdza' bshes tshogs rnams bzhag /'jig rten pha rol song ste slan chad 'di mi mthong / /zhes zer ro/ /'di ni 'di gcig pu'i rigs sam/ gzhan la'ang 'ong smras pas/ 'dun pas tshigs bcad snga ma ltar smras tshe/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ rgas pas gnod par 'gyur na gzhon pas ci zhig bya/ /sna tshogs nad kyi gnod gyur nad med ci zhig bya/ /ring du mi gnas 'chi gyur gson pas ci zhig rung / /'dun pa slar log 'di nas thar par bya bar bsam/ /gsungs nas shing rta slar bsgyur te grong khyer du zhugs so/ /yang dus gcig gi tshe grong khyer byang sgo ru phyin pas/ dge slong zhi ba dul ba chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs pa zhig gzigs pas/ 'di ci yin dris pas/ 'dun pa na re/ lha gcig 'di ming dge slong zhes ni bgyi ba lags/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs shing shin tu dul bar spyod/ /bdag nyid zhi ba 'tshol zhing rab tu byung bar gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang bral ba'i bsod snyoms spyod cing rgyu/ /zhes smras tshe sras 406

gzhon nus smras pa/ 'di ni dge bar rab smra nga yang 'dod pa ste/ /rab tu byung ba mkhas pa rnams kyis rtag tu bsngags/ /de ni bdag la phan zhing sems can gzhan la'ang phan/ /'tsho ba bde zhing rga dang na dang 'chi las grol/ /gsungs nas shing rta slar bsgyur te grong khyer du zhugs so/ /de ltar rgas pa'i sdug bsngal dang na ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs pas rkyen byas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la thugs skyo/ dge slong zhi ba dul ba de gzigs pas dge slong de lta bu zhig byed pa la thugs spro/ yab kyi drung du byon nas rab tu byung bar gnang bar zhu zhus pas ma gnang gzhan ci 'dod sbyin gyis sras rang gi gang 'dod smros shig byas pas/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ rga dang na dang 'chi 'gyur ba/ /gal te 'di gsum yod min na/ /bdag kyang shin tu yid 'ong ba'i/ /yul rnams la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pas/ de lta bu sbyin mi nus so byas pas/ sras gzhon nus smras pa/ rgas pa mthong ba na ba'i sdug bsngal te/ /sems dang bral ba'i 'chi ba mthong tsa na/ /'jig rten spyod pa bdag gis nus re gan/ /de bas bdag ni mngon par 'byung bar bgyi/ /gsungs nas pho brang du bzhud pa dang / yab rgyal pos rgyal srid spang gis dogs nas/ sgo ba 407

bzhi'i dpung gi tshogs kyis bskor/ btsun mo rnams kyi dbus su bzhag nas/ nyin mtshan med par bsrungs so/ /der mtshan gcig kun gnyid kyis non par byas/ nam phyed tsam na pho brang gi sgo phye 'dun pa la rta mchog sngags ldan la sga chas sprod du bcug gos ka shi ka dbu la thogs/ rta mchog steng du byon nas bros te/ yab zas gtsang btsun mo sa 'tsho ma grags 'dzin ma/ri dwags skyes gsum bud med kyi 'khor drug khri dang bcas pa/rgyal phran blon gyi tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod zad mi shes pa thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas/ rang byung gi mchod rten rnam dag drung du byon rta mchog phyir btang dbu skra bregs te/ bar snang la gtor ba lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i rten du blangs so/ /de nas gos ka shi ka brgya byin la sbyin nas brgya byin gyis gos ngur smrig gi na bza' phul ba sku la gsol/ chu bo ne+e rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' ba lo drug spyad pa sogs ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar ltar 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / mi'i skye ba'i sdug bsngal/ rgas pa'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug bsngal/'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/lha'i 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs/ mtho ris su skyes na'ang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das tshul bsams 408

nas/ gang la yang mi chags par 'khor ba 'di las thar pa zhig bya dgos/ sngon byis pa zhig ltogs nas ma la rtsam pa 'dod zer ba la/ ma yis rtsam pa med/ nyung ma bsregs pa zhig 'dod dam/ma bsregs pa zhig 'dod dam/ chol pa zhig 'dod dam byas pas/ byes pa na re/ de tsho kun nyung ma yin/ nga rtsam pa 'dod zer ro/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis lha ru skyes na skyid snyam ste/ lha la yang sred pa 'phel ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pas myos pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod pas/ 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams kyi lha rigs gang du skyes kyang de tsho kun sdug bsngal yin/ des mi phan thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa zhig byed dgos/ sngon dbus phyogs kyi zhang mu ne dpal bya ba la/ bu spun brgyud yod de/ de thams cad la'ang bu mang po yod pas/ mu ne dpal kho la mi kun smon ne par yod tsa na/ khong sdug 'khun shor ba gzhan gyis khyod las skyid pa med pa la/ ci la 'khun dris pas/ kho na re/ mi du skyid du tshor tsam na mi rung / nga skyid pa zhig byung bas da mi rung gis dogs zer skad/ des na skyid pa de yang sdug bsngal du song na sdug pa kun la smos ci dgos/ des na lha dang mi'i gnas na bde ba med na ngan song gsum smos ci dgos/ des na 409

khams gsum 'khor ba 'di nas mthar phyin/ mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs med/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'di thams cad kyang sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig yin/ sdug bsngal la bde bar 'dzin mi rung / sdug bsngal sdug bsngal du ngo shes dgos/ phye ma leb kyis mar me lha khang du mthong nas der dga' dga' 'dra bar snyegs pas me lces tshig nas mar khur lhung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la bde bar mthong zhing chags pas 'khor ba'i nang du lhung nas sdug bsngal myang / glang po che reg bya la dga' bas kho'i lus la dal bus 'phrug tshe dga' nas tsog ge sdod pa la spyi bor lcags kyu btab nas gang 'dod du khrid/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyang reg bya la dga' dga' na sdug bsngal gyi lcags kyus 'dzin/ bung ba mi gtsang dri la dga' ste 'khor nas mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab du lhung zhing bya byis kyis 'khyer/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang 'dod pa'i dri ma la 'khor 'khor nas nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying zhing las ngan bdud kyis 'khyer/ lho'i ri dwags gsod pa kun gyis nags gseb tu yib nas/ gling bu sogs sgra snyan brdungs pas/ ri dwags sgra la dga' bas de 410

phyogs su nyan du 'ong tshe phag nas mda' rgyab nas gsod/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang tshe 'di'i snyan grags kyi rjes su 'brangs na chags sdang gi rngon pas gsod par 'gyur/ sngon mi tshang zhig gi sgor bu mo gzugs mjes pa zhig 'ong ba khyod kyi ming la ci zer yon tan ci yod dris pas/ ming la bkra shis lha mo zer/yon tan ni 'dod dgu byen nas gar bsdad sar bkra shis par byed zer ba nang du bzhag tshe/ phyi dro bud med mdog mi sdug pa zhig byung ba/ ming la ci zer yon tan ci yod dris pas/ming la byur sna nag mo zer/ yon tan ci yang med gar bsdad sar mi 'dod sna dgu po btang nas bkra mi shis pa byed zer/de yin na 'dir ma sdod nga'i nang na bkra shis lha mo yod pa la gnod/ da lta rang song smras pas/ mo na re/ he he bkra shis lha mo dang nged gnyis spun yin/ de sdod dgos na nga yang sdod dgos/nga 'gro na de yang 'gro dgos zer ba/ nang du 'ong nas bkra shis lha mo la dris pas de bden zer/ de yin na gnyis ka mi dgos song zhes btang bas mi tshang de la skyid po byung / yang mi tshang zhig gi sgor phyin pas sngar ltar dris pas gnyis ka bzhag pas/ snga dro bkra shis lha mos mi nor zas gsum 'dzom po byas nas bkra shis pa byas na/ phyi dro byur sna nag mos na tsha shi chad 411

god kha sogs mi 'dod pa btang nas mi tshang de la bde ba'i go skabs ma byung skad/ de bzhin du bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom pa zhig la sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum yang rgyun mi 'chad pas/'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'di blos ma btang phyin chad 'di la bsten nas mi 'dod pa thams cad 'byung / sngon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas byon pa'i lam zhig na gser zhig yod pa gzigs nas 'di na dug drag po zhig 'dug gsungs bskor nas byon pa mi zhig gis go nas bltas pas/ gser yin tshe blangs nas 'ong/ rgyal pos ma tshor ba byas skog nas longs spyad pas/ phyis rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tshor nas bzung ste btson rar bcugade'i tshe khos dug drag po dug drag po zhes smras pas/ de ci yin dris pas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gsungs tshul bshad pas rgyal pos khyod sangs rgyas la dad pa yod dam byas pas/yod byas pas ma bsad par btang/ des na 'dod yon longs spyod 'di dug dang 'dra bas reg tshad phung bar 'gyur/ sngon rong gi chu'i tshur khar sre mong zhig gis gong mo'i ske la 'chang bas/ der gong mo 'phur nas chu yi pha khar song bas/ sre mong na re/ gong mo 'bri skam 'dra ba sod lags te/ /pha yul mes btsan cig dang gtan bral byas/ /zer ro/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams 412
