kyang sred pa'i dbang gis 'dod yon la myong ste/ mtho ris thar pa gtan bral byas/ sngon ded dpon chen po siṅga las tshong pa mang po khrid nas/ rgya mtshor nor bu rin po che 'don du phyin dus mi 'dod pa'i rlung gis bskyod nas srin mo'i gling du bskyal bas der tshong pa rnams kyis bud med gzugs mdzes pa lha mo 'dra ba mang po yod pa mthong nas srin mo yin par ma shes bud med rang yin snyam nas/ bza' mir byas nas yod dus bud med rnams na re/ khyed rnams lho'i lam du ma 'gro zhig zer/ siṅga las de na ci yod dam snyam gzhan dag gnyid log pa dang song bas de na lcags mkhar sgo med cig 'dug de'i rtsa na shing sdong ring po zhig 'dug pa 'jogs nas bltas pas/ nang na 'dzam bu gling gi tshong pa mang pos bu dang bu mo a pha a ma zer smre sngags 'don gyen 'dug pa khyed rnams su yin byas pas/ 'dzam gling gi tshong pa yin te mi 'dod pa'i rlung gis srin mo'i gling 'dir bskyal srin mo dang bza' mi byas nas skyid rab yod tsa na/ tshong pa phyi ma khyed rnams byung ba dang 'dir bcug ste/ da re re nas bsad cing za'o zer/ 'o na mi 'bros sam byas pas 'bros thabs med zer/ 'o na nged rnams la 'bros thabs yod dam dris pas/ thabs gcig yod de/ zla ba 413

'di'i bco lnga'i nyin rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can bya ba gcig ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu'i ljang ba zos te gser gyi bye ma la 'gre ldog lan gsum byas nas mgo 'phang bstod de/'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro 'dod pa su yod zer nas lan gsum sgra 'byen du 'ong / de la nged 'gro zhes drung du song nas 'jus na thar ro zer/ der ded dpon siṅga las gnas dben pa zhig tu tshong pa rnams bsags nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams brjod pa dang / tshong pa rnams re re zhing yid phyung nas thams cad sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dang / zla ba de'i bco lnga la rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can sngar zer ba bzhin 'ong ba dang / nged 'gro byas drung du phyin pa dang / rta de na re/ shes ldan dag bud med de rnams gzugs bzang zhing mjes pa dag byas nas bu bu mo rnams khrid de/ gdungs pa'i skad sna tshogs kyis 'bod du 'ong bas/ de rnams la phyi mig ma bltas na nga'i spu nyag ma re re la zin pas chog bltas na nga'i ze ba la zhon yang lhung 'gro gsungs/ tshong pa rnams kyis ji skad gsungs pa de ltar byas nas rta de nam mkha' la 'phur nas song ba'i tshe/ srin mo rnams kyis bu bu mo rnams khrid rgya mtsho'i 'gram du 'ong mi sdug pa'i rgyal mtshan bya ba g.yab 'o dod bos nas khrel med rnams nged 414

rnams dang bu bu mo 'di tsho skyur nas 'gro phod dam gal te 'gro yang phyi mig tsam yang mi lta'am byas 'dod pa'i smre sngags du ma bton pas de thos tshe 'ga' zhig gis sngar gyi bslab bya byas pa brjed nas chags pa'i dbang gis phyi mig bltas pas mang po sa la mar lhung ba srin mo rnams kyis gson snying dmar 'don byas sha zos khrag gi thig pa rnams kyang bldags so/ /phyi mig bltas pa rnams lho 'dzam bu gling gi rang rang gi gnas su thar pa byung / de bzhin du 'khor ba 'di srin mo'i gling dang 'dra/chung ma dang bu bu mo rnams srin mo ma bu dang 'dra/ de la zhen cing chags pa rnams phyi mig bltas pa dang 'dra/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal rnams myong ba mi ltung ba rnams srin mo rnams kyis bsad nas sha zos khrag bldags pa dang 'dra/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ded dpon siṅga la dang 'dra/ bslab pa gsum rta sprin gyi shugs can dang 'dra/ ma chags ma zhen pa phyi mig ma bltas pa dang 'dra/ bde chen thar pa'i go 'phang ni lho 'dzam bu gling du phyin pa dang 'dra ste/ des na da res 'khor ba 'di na bde ba'i go skabs med tshul bsams nas/ gang la'ang ma chags par lam bslab pa gsum la bsten nas bde chen thar pa'i go 'phang 415

snyeg dgos/ sngon dge slong zhig lhung bzed bzang po zhig yod pa la chags nas 'chi khar rim gro ba la khyer shog byas pas des ma byen pa dang / ngan sems skyes lhung bzed la chags nas shi bas lhung bzed nang du sbrul zhig tu skyes dur khrod nas ro bsregs dus sangs rgyas kyis lhung bzed nas sbrul bton pas nags shig tu song khros pa'i kha nas me 'bar nags tshig pas sbrul yang tshig nas shi bas skad cig ma la dmyal bar skyes nas lus mer bsregs/ dus gcig la me gsum 'bar bar gyur/de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag sred pa thams cad la skrag par gyis shig sred pas yo byad kyi phyir ngan sems skyes pas/ nags 'thug por khros pa'i me dang / sems can dmyal ba'i me dang / dur khrod du me phal bas bsregs pa thams cad la yid dbyung bar bya'o/ /de bas dge slong gi yo byad la lhag par chags pa bskyed par mi bya ste/ gang skyes pa de yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /ma spangs na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro gsungs/ yang sngon dge slong zhig la g.yu legs po zhig yod pa shi nas sngar rgyus yod pa'i dge slong rnams kyis btsal bas ma rnyed pas dge slong gcig na re/ kho bo ma shi gong du yang g.yu de la chags zhen che bas 'di'i mgo yang chu skor phyogs su bstan 416

'dug pas chu rtsa de ru tshol dang sbas 'dra yod dam zer/ btsal bas sbal ba zhig gis rkang lag 'og tu mnan 'dug pa mthong bas kun gyis len par brtsams pas ma lon sbal ba gan rkyal du bsgyel nas steng du chu tshan blugs pas tsha nas g.yu btang skad/ sngon 'bras spung gi grwa pa zhig la dngul mang po yod pa la 'chi khar chags nas gzhan la ster ma phod par khang pa'i rtsig gseb tu sbas nas shi bas sdom zhig tu skyes nas dngul gyi steng du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pas dngul sil sil byed pa'i sgra shag rogs gnyis kyis tshor nas btsal bas rnyed de dngul sdom dang bcas ra stod rin po che'i sku mdun du khyer skad/ yang sngon dge slong zhig chos gos shig yod par chags nas sbrul zhig tu skyes nas chos gos gseb tu 'khyil nas bsdad byung / yang sngon bud med gzugs byad mjes pa zhig 'chi khar rang gi gzugs la chags nas sbrul zhig tu skyes ro de'i kha nas zhugs sna nas thon pa sogs byas pa byung / des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang 'khor ba'i phun tshogs rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ru ma shes par bde bar bzung nas zhen cing chags na slar khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong bas/gang la yang ma chags pa byed dgos/ sngon dge slong 'char ka 417

gtum mo'i mna' ma'i khyem du song mi tshangs spyod kyi nyes dmigs gsungs pas/ mna' ma'i bsam pa la 'dis ngas rkun ma'i dmag dpon dang lhan du mi tshangs spyad pa shes 'dug ma bsad na gzhan la bshad na mi rung snyam/ nyes pa med bzhin du dge slong 'char ka rkun ma'i dmag dpon la gsod du bcug nas phung po phyag dar khrod du sbas so/ /de'i chad pa la rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ bud med de rte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang lag la btegs nas gsod du bcug dmag dpon de rgya skyegs kyi khang par bcug nas me la bsregs/ de yi grogs g.yo can lnga brgya yod pa bzung nas rkang lag bcad do/ /sngon drang srong bzod pa smra ba'i drung du rgyal po 'thab mo skyes kyi btsun mo 'ong ba la chos bshad pa yin yang / rgyal po ngan sems skyes drang srong gi rkang lag thams cad bcad/ sngon drang srong zhig gis rgyal po zhig gi bla mchod byas/ btsun mo bzhi yod pa skabs skabs sku mdun du 'ong chos zhus pa yin yang / gzhan gyis phra ma bcug pas/ rgyal po khros nas drang srong chen po de me la bsregs pas/ btsun mo bzhis kyang bla mchod mes tshig tshe sems kyis ma bzod par me nang du mchongs nas tshig sngon dge slong dpal byen gyis/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo'i khyem du bsod 418

snyoms su yang yang phyin nas bu mo la chos bshad pas/ skabs shig 'dod chags skyes nas bu mo dang lhan du bsdad/ bu mo'i khyo ga'i rgyu tshong dpon gzhan gyes bu zhig yod pa yang dug btang nas bsad de phung tshab chen po byung / sngon slob dpon rin po che yang lha lcam la bsten nas rgyal pos gson bsregs byas/ lha lcam man+tar ba btson dong du bsgyur nas sdug bsngal ba byung /sngon a rig gi dge glong zhig mi tshang zhig gi a mchod byas bsdad pa'i skabs shig khyim bdag gi bud med dang lhan du bsdad/ ngan sems skyes nas khyo ga lung stong zhig tu khrid nas mgo la sta res brgyab pas ma phog par shor song bas kho yang gzhan gyis gsod snyam yul bton nas bros skad/ sngon re skong phyogs kyi mi gzhon gnyis kyis bu mo zhig brtsad nas gri ring po thogs nas gtsab res byas gnyis ga'i lus kun tshal ba mang por btang yan lag phal cher yang chad nas sa la lhung gnyis ka mthar 'gyel nas shi yod skad/ gzhan yang de bzhin du bud med la bsten nas rang gzhan gnyis ka phung la btang bas gtam rgyud de 'dra grangs mang / sngon slob dpon pe ro tsa na la/btsun mo dmar rgyan mas 'jus tshe/ ngas phyi sgo bcad nas 'ong zhes pas btang tshe/ sgor thon nas bros te/ bud med zer ba 419

btsan dug ha la 'dra/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi ba yin/ /sogs mgur gsungs pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyang bud med la 'bros dgos/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras par 'dod chags yod med kyi nyams sad phyir bu mo 'ga' byung nas/ 'o byas rdo rje mnyes tshe slar rdo rje gsang ba'i sbubs su nub song zhes bla ma zhang gis mdzad pa'i rje btsun gyi rnam thar nas gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chags sems kyis bud med bsten na tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka phung tshul gyi nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ lha'i bu mo mthong yang 'dod pa mi skye ba zhig bya dgos/ sngon sog phyogs kyi a ka me rin bya ba rta nor lug gsum 'dzoms pa jag pas thos nas/ nyin gcig jag pa mang por byung rta ded pas bu gnyis ra mdar phyin pas phar la yang jag pa mang por mdung brgyab tshur la bu gcig bsad gcig rmas nas sa la 'gyel ba yul tu khyer nas shi gu rta kun nyin gcig la med par song tshe pha sogs gnyen nye ba kun mya ngan gyi 'chi tshad pa byung / yang rab chad rgan rgon gnyis la yang rta pho mo sum cu tsam dang lug bzhi brgya tsam yod pa jag pas thos nas 'ong rta ded tshe rgad po ra mdar rgyug pa'i rgyab nas rdo chen po brgyab pas sa la kha sbub tu 'gyel/ rgan 420

mos mya ngan gyi skad chen po bton pa gzhan gyis tshor bar dogs nas kha nang du lci ba brdzangs nas 'chi tshad pa byas rta kun ded/ phyis slar 'ongs nas lug kyang khyer te/ rgan rgon gnyis ka mya ngan gyis yid gdungs bzhin shi yang zhabs drung phyogs kyi ma gcig la bu bu mo bzhi yod pa tshad pa'i nad kyis sdeb gcig la shi bas/ ma yang mya ngan gyis gzir nas sdod ma zug par chu la mchongs skad/ dbus phyogs kyi pha gcig la bu snying dang 'dra ba zhig yod pa la glo bur du nad cig byung / 'chi bar thag chod tshe pha yis ma bzod par/ dug 'thungs nas bu yi sngon du shi rgan rgon bza' mi gnyis la bu gcig yod pa shi bas/ mya ngan gyis ma'i mig long / pha'i sha zhu pags pa skams nas shi skad/ yang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa rgan phyug po mang po yod pa'i nang nas grwa pa zhig ngan sems skyes/ mtshan mo mi skya'i chas sprad nas song / grwa rgan bdun brgyad tsam zhig rma med pa byas bsad nas nor rnams khyer/ yul re skong gi zho 'ong dang gleng rgya zer ba'i sde chen po gnyis kyis lam zhig brtsad nas 'khrugs te mi mgo nyi shu rtsa bdun bsad/ yang grwa pa zhig dang mi skya gnyis kyis ras kha gang brtsad nas/ grwa pa la mi skyas gri btang nas rgyu ma lugs nas shi ba byung / yang sngon mu ge chen 421

po zhig byung dus mi gcig gis lus kyi gon pa'i nang du g.yag gi sna la rgyag rgyu'i shing gi sna gcu bcug yod pa/ gzhan zhig gis kha zas shig yin snyam nas bsad skad/ yang 'bras spung gi smad sog grwa pa phyug bo zhig lha sar phyin nas yar rtsam pa thum chung zhig rgyab tu khyer 'ong ba gzhan grwa pa zhig gis mthong nas dngul yin snyam nas mgo la rdos brgyab nas bsad/ yang mi ngan zhib/ gis mi gcig bsad nas mi 'di'i lag na dngul kha gang las gzhan gang yang mi 'dug kyang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi khral ma theg par gsod dgos byung nas bsad pa yin zhes yi ge bris nas ro la sbyar yod skad/ yang yul zho 'ong gi ma gcig la bu kha ngan zhig yod pas nyin re bzhin mi tshang 'di brlag rgyu yin 'phung rgyu yin zer kha ngan pa mang po lab pa ma dang mna' ma gnyis 'jigs nas/ 'di ma bsad na nged tsho'i nor thams cad brlag nas 'phung bar 'dug snyam gros byas mtshan gcig gsod mkhan mi gzhan zhig khrid 'ong nas/ bu gnyid du song ba'i tshe/ ma dang chung mas dkar me btegs nas bstan te mgo la sta re rnon po brgyab nas bsad/ ro sbas pa sha nye rnams kyis mthong nas gnyis ga'i rkang lag bcad nas ngan gsod byed snyam pa/ gzhan gyis ngo chen byas gnyis ka yul 422

bton pas lo gcig gnyis song nas sdug bsngal myang tshe 'gyod pa drag po skyes skad/ des na nor gyi phyir mas rang gi bu yang gsod na gzhan smos ci dgos/ da lta bde ba ltar snang ba 'di dag bde ba ma yin sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin te/ dper na grang ba'i tshe nyi ma la bsdad na bde ba ltar snang ste/ de bde ba ma yin grang ba'i sdug bsngal 'gags nas tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'go tshugs pa yin te skabs der ma tshor ba yin/ yun ring na tsha ba'i sdug bsngal tshor nas 'ong / tsha ba'i dus su bsil sar song nas bsdad tshe bde ba ltar snang ba yang / bde ba dngos ma yin/ skabs der tsha ba'i sdug bsngal 'gags grang ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'go tshugs pas bar der bde ba'i mang btags pa yin/ don gyi bde ba ma yin te/ de yin na bsdad kyin bde ba cher 'gro dgos pa la yun ring bsdad na grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa yong / zas zos tshe bde ba ltar snang yang bde ba ma yin rgyags pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'go tshugs pa yin/ de bzhin du rgyags pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i tshe bde ba ltar snang yang bde ba ma yin ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'go tshugs pa yin/ lus 'di yang gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs/ nad med bde ba ltar snang yang bde ba dngos ma yin lus 'di sdug 423

bsngal thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ma yin/ 'di la bsten nas skye rga na 'chi tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub sogs tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal bskyed par byed/ lus 'di'i lto gos phyir mi dge ba'i las byas nas phyi mar ngan song gsum gye sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rang gi steng du mi 'dod bzhin du 'dren par byed de/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos dkor zas bsdus nas gnyen grogs bskyang na bsdu mkhan rnga mong du skyes za mkhan rnams rnga phrug dang dkor bdag rnams rnga mong bdag por gyur nas bkol spyod kyi lan chags 'ded du 'ong / gzhan yang de 'dra'i lan chags nyi khri 'ded du 'ong gsungs/ sngon dge slong dkor za mkhan zhig shi nas lus rnag chu 'dra ba zhig tu skyes nas/srin 'bu mchu rnon gyis zos sdug bsngal ma bzod par nam mkhar 'phags na/ lus nas me 'bar nas sdug bsngal myangs/yang dge slong li ta zhes bya ba dge 'dun pa'i dkor za mkhan zhig shi nas shing sdong lta bu'i lus su skyes nas srin 'bu mang po 'dus nas lus la zos/ yang bla ma dkor bsdu mkhan zhig sdom zhig tu skyes gzhan dkor gyi bu lon can rnams srin 'bu mang por skyes nas lus la zos/ yang sngon dge bsnyen ma gcig gis dge slong gcig la 'bul rgyu'i zas bran mo la bsgur/ dge slong 424

la ma phul bar lam nas mos zos pas shi nas rang sha rang gis za ba zhig tu skyes pa de bzhin du zas nor la ser sna byas pas yi dwags su skyes pa dang / zas nor phyir srog gcod sogs mi dge ba byas pas dmyal bar skyes pa bgrang gis mi lang / des na 'phags pa rnams kyi srid pa'i rtse mo man chad me 'bar ba lta bur sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'ba' zhig tu gzigs pa yin skad/ sngon glang ri thang pas nyin gcig byis pa zhig gis sa khung nang zhig tu yos rdog cig shor song bas phyir du khung nang du kha bltas nas ngus ngus nas snabs lugs pa khung bur song mgo btegs pas snabs la yos 'byar nas 'ong ba byis pa kho dga' ba mthong nas gcig bzhad/ nyin zhig mi gcig la gcig gis yos byin pa sred pa'i dbang gis bar na ka ba yod pa ma mthong bar lag pa gnyis ka bzed nas blangs pas ka ba la lag pa gnyis thogs nas 'khyer ma shes par yug gcig lus pa mthong nas gcig bzhad/ yang khong gi maṇ+ḍal steng na g.yu gcig yod pa bye ba gcig gis 'khyer bar brtsam pas ma theg tshe gzhan grogs byi ba bzhi khrid yong/ kho gan rkyal du bsdad pa'i steng du g.yu bzhag nas gzhan rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas btegs te 'khyer ba mthong nas gcig bzhad/ de gsum ma 425

gtogs gzhan bzhad ma myong bas slob ma gcig gis gzhan gyis khyed la glang ri thang pa ngo nag zer bar gda' zhus tshe/khong gi zhal nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam na gdong dkar po zhig ga nas 'ong zhes gsungs skad/ sngon lho brag mar pas rje btsun mi la yul du 'byon khar/ bu tshe 'di dang dam pa'i chos gnyis bsres na chos shor zin pa de rang yin/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgya rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad kyang brjod kyi mi langs pas/ /ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gsan/ /zhes gsungs pa yin skad/ des na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bshad na brjod kyi mi langs pas/ mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug des na 'khor ba 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gyi tshang / 'khor ba'i phun tshogs rnams dug dang 'dres pa'i zas/ spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar reg pa tsam gyis kyang phung bar 'gyur ba la dgongs nas rjes 426

'jug rnams la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gser dngul la sogs pa'i nor gyi gsog 'jog byed pa phar zhog tha na rin po che la lag pas reg kyang mi rung ba'i dge slong gi bcas pa mdzad pa yin/ / des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de dag gi tshul rnams zhib tu bsam ste 'khor ba'i phun tshogs lus longs spyod gang mthong tshe/ skyug nad can la zas bstan pa ltar mngon zhen gting nas ldog pa zhig bya dgos/ sngon yul ko sa la'i khyim bdag dan bye li zhes bya ba/ rin chen sna lnga'i khang bzang / 'dod 'byung nor bu 'od 'bar/ lha'i bu mo las gzugs mdzes skad snyan sems bzang ba'i chung ma/ gzhan yang lha mi'i dpal 'byor 'di med ces bya ba med pa'i khyem bdag phyug po des kyang 'khor ba'i phun tshogs mi rtag mi brtan snying po med cing sdug bsngal gyi rgyur rtogs nas thams cad bzhag nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'ongs nas rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur/ bo/ nga gis de 'dra yang blos thongs na 'o skol rnams mi nor zas gsum cung rer chags nas rab tu mi 'byung ba de/ khyi keng rus la chags pa dang phag mi gtsang ba la chags pa dang 'dra bas/ des na nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar gang 427

la yang mi chags par khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dgos/ rab tu byung na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las shugs kyis thar nas bde ba gang yang thob ste/ sngon yul ka ling ga'i rgyal po lag rna can khang bzang gi thog na 'dug pa'i tshe/ bya zhig gis sha'i dum bu zhig khyer nas 'phur ba na bya gzhan mang pos gtses so/ /bya des sha bor tshe gzhan zhig gis blangs pas sha bor ba de bzhag nas sha gang gis blangs pa de kun nas bskor te phan tshun du 'phrog pa mthong nas 'di bzhin du bdag kyang rgyal srid la bsten nas nyi 'og gi rgyal po dang 'thab pa dang rtsod par gdon mi za bas da ni rgyal srid kyi bde bas chog go snyam nas smras pa/ bya yis sha yi dum bu khyer ba na/ /bya gzhan kun nas bskor zhing 'brangs pa mthong / /de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan rig byas te/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyod par gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal srid spangs nas nges par rab tu byung ste rang rgyal gyi byang chub mngon du byas so/ /yang sngon yul mi thi li'i rgyal po gdong ma legs zhes bya ba khang bzang thog na 'dug pa'i tshe/ glang gnyis 'dod pa'i rgyus phan tshun bsnad cing rmas pa mthong nas 'di bzhin du bdag kyang 'dod pa'i rgyus nyi 'og gi rgyal po dang lhan cig 'thab pa dang rtsod par 428

'gyur ba gdon mi za bas da ni rgyal srid kyi bde bas chog go snyam nas smras pa/ 'dod pa'i gzhi dang rgyu yi nog g.yo zhing / /bsnad dang gcig shos smras par gyur mthong ba/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan rig byas te/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyod par gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal sred spangs nas nges par rab tu byung nas rang rgyal gye byang chub mngon du byas so/ /yang sngon yul wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po tshangs byen btsun mo dang lhan cig skyed mos tshal du song bas/ a mra'i shing gi me tog shin tu mdzes pa la btsun mo rnams chags nas yal ga rnams bcag pas mi mdzes par gyur pa mthong nas 'di bzhin du bdag gi rgyal srid phun sum tshogs pa la rgyal po gzhan chags nas bcoms te mi mdzes par 'gyur bas da ni rgyal srid kyis chog go snyams nas smras pa/ a mra'i shing rtse'i me tog legs rgyas pa/ /yid 'ong gzugs ldan chags pas mthong ba na/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan rig byas te/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyod par gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung ste rang byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du byas so/ /yang sngon yul brang gi sa nyal gyi rgyal po gcer thul khang bzang thog na 'dug pa'i tshe/ btsun mo zhig gser gyi gdu bus brgyan nas tshon rtsi 429

'thag pa na sgra byung bas 'di bzhin du bdag kyang rgya pa srid la bsten nas tshig ngan sna tshogs 'byung bas da ni rgyal srid kyis chog go snyams nas smras pa/ gser mgar gyes ni legs par brdung ba yi/ /gser gyi 'od gsal lag pa'i 'khrig ma gnyis/ /brdung ba thos pa de ltar bdag dang ni/ /gzhan dag lhan cig gleng gzhi 'di yi rgyus/ /tshig ngan sna tshogs 'thon zhing sems 'khru ga pa/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan rig byas te/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyod par gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung ste rang byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du byas so/ /sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu byung ba'i phan yon ni/ ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs mtho/ rgya mtsho bas kyang gting zab/ nam mkha' bas kyang rgya che zhes bsngags brjod rgya cher gsungs pa/ khyem bdag dpal skyes kyis thos pas yid 'phrogs nas lo brgyar lon rung rab tu byung / brtson 'grus brtsams pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas/ gzhan yang sngon sangs rgyas kyis shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu rab tu byung ba la mngon par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ yon tan bcu yongs su 'dzin to/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa la chags par mi 430

'gyur ba dang / dgon pa'i gnas la dga' ba dang / rnyed pa dang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul thob pa dang / chung ma dang bu'i chags sred dang bral ba dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnam par spangs pa dang / bde 'gror 'gro bas chos la bsten pa dang /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba las yongs su mi nyams pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang / de la lha rnams rab tu dga' ba dang / de la mi ma yin rnam sa kyis bsrung bar 'gyur ba ste/ rab tu byung ba la mngon par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ yon tan bcu bo de dag yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na/ byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad sgol bar 'dod pa dang / rgyun du rab tu byung bar 'dod pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba la shin tu dga' bar bya'o gsungs so/ /rab tu byung nas mkhan slob spyan sngar rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims bsrung na phan yon de bas kyang che ste/ sngon grong dpon zhig gis srog gcod kyi sdom pa nyin gcig tsam bsrung bas mthar sangs rgyas phan bzhed ces bya bar sangs rgyas/ sngon shan pa me ri tses rgyal po'i bu mo chung mar mi le na pa dang / seṅge'i phrug gu tsan dan me la bsreg nas mi za ba 431

dang / bya rgod kyi tshang du rta khrid nas mi 'gro ba gsum po sangs rgyas kyi mdun du khas blangs nas phyis de ltar bsrung bas tshe der seṅge'i 'jigs pa dang bral zhing / rgyal pos kyang nor mang po gnang nas longs spyod chen po byung / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la bram ze zhig gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa bsrung bas mi'i rgyal por skyes/ rgyal po des kyang chos bzhin tshul khrims bsrung bas lhar skyes/ lha de yang sangs rgyas drung du 'ongs nas chos nyan pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob/ des na tshul khrims sna re sna 'ga' tsam bsrung na yang phan yon de 'dra na dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa blangs nas bsrung na phan yon de bas che ba smos ci dgos/ yang sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ mi lnga brgya tsam rab tu byung tshangs par spyad pas mthar kun shi nas gcig lus pas smras pa/ bdag gis tshangs par spyad pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'ongs shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /rab tu byung dgra bcom thob snam sbyar 'dzin pa kun gyi mchog tu lung ston par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgra bcom pa kun shes ko'u di na ya zhes bya bar gyur nas snam sbyar 'dzin pa kun gyi mchog tu lung bstan/ 'bor 432

los bsgyur rgyal zhig yin na/ shing skam po bden pa'i byen rlabs byas na me tog gcig thon/ tshul khrims dag pas dge slong gi shing skam po la byin rlabs mdzad na me tog bcu thon pa la/ slob dpon zla grags tshul khrims dag pa'i dge slong yin pas/ khong gis shing skam po la bden pa'i byin rlabs mdzad pas/me tog dgu las ma byung / 'o na gcig po de cis lan snyam pa la/ khong gis bstan bcos brtsams pas shin tu legs pa zhig byung ste/ dgyes nas phyag na sde mig kyog po zhig yod pa de dran bsam zin pa la klad la bskor ba zhig dran te/ phyir bcos mdzad de bden pa'i byin rlabs byas me tog bcu thon skad/des na tshul khrims dag pa'i smon lam yang ci btab tshad 'grub bo/ /ma bsrung na nyes dmigs kyang che ste/ sngon dge slong zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bcas pa khyad du bsad nas shing zhig gi yal ga bcad pas phyis klu mgor sdong bo chen po skyes pa zhig tu skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myangs/ yang dge slong mang pos bslab pa'i yan lag mang po nyams pas ngang pa dang nyar skyes/ po to ba'i gsung sgos las/ mi skyas lo brgya'i bar du nyin re ma chad pa'i mi dge ba bcu ka byas pa bas/ sdom pa med pas dad zas kham gcig zos pa de sdig che gsungs/433

sngon gcig gis bon byas pa'i phugs su khyi shor te/ gsas zan khyis khyer bas/ bdag po rnam rtog zos nas/ sku gshen gsas zan khyis khyer ba'i mthar cir 'gyur byas lan 'ga' dris pas bon po khong 'khrugs te gsas zan khyis khyer bas tha ma khye lud du 'gro zer ro/ /de bzhin du rang res kyang tshul khrims ma bsrung na tha ma ngan song du 'gro/ des na tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon ma bsrung ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsam nas tshul bzhin bsrung dgos te/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ rab tu byung phan chad bdud mo mtshar mo brgyas bslu mi nus la/ bdud nag bo brgyas chos la 'bral mi nus pa de 'dra zhig 'tshal/gsungs/ tshul khrims kyi mgo thon pa la grogs bzang po bsten dgos/ grogs ngan bsten na spyod ngan 'gos nas sdom pa'i mgo thon mi yong/ sngon 'phan yu la gyi btsun pa chang 'thung ba gcig dang mi 'thung ba'i spun gnyis yod pa la chang 'thung ba de rwa sgreng du song nas/ phyis yul du log tsa na chang mi 'thung ba zhig byung / chang mi 'thung ba de lha sar song bas/ phyis 'thung ba zhig byung skad/ de bzhin du rang re la chos bya bsam dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pa bag re tsam yod kyang / grogs ngan dang 'grogs tsa na kho'i shan zhugs nas gzhug kho dang khyad med du 434

'gro/ grogs bzang po dang 'grogs tsa na rang la khyer 'khos med kyang grogs bzang po de'i 'khyer du mi ste ra bsrung sdom yang khong gi khyed chos la 'gro ba yin/ sngone rgya gar gyi thag pa gcig shing gcod du phyin pas shing gzhon pa legs pa gcod ma phod par nags mthar phyin pas nags kyi lha mos khyo da dngos grub ci 'dod ster zer ba/ groges shig yod par dris pas/ kho na re/ sngon nas rkang lag gis thag ba tags pas mang bo zin na/ rgyab na yang rkang lag yod na thag mang po zin nas rnyed pa yo nga ba sa/ rgyab tu rkang lag bzhi 'dod zhus byas pa/ de ltar zhus pas de ma thag rgyab tu rkang log byung / grogs dang sdeb nas grong khyer du thag 'thag rgyu yod dam zer du phyin pas/grong pa rnams kyis ltas ngan zer rdo 'phangs nas ded skad/de'i tshe nam mkha'i lhas/ rang yang mkhas par ma gyur la / /grogs kyang blo dang mi ldan pas/ /de dag myur du brlag 'gyur te/ /nags kyi thag pa ji bzhin no/ /zer skad/ de bzhin du rang nyid la 'khos med kyi steng du grogs ngan gyi kha la nyan na tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka brlag yong / khyad par bud med dang nye mi rung / sngon dge slong zhig bud med kyi rtsar nyal bas skabs shig 'dod chags skyes mi tshangs pa spyad nas sdom pa shor skad/ sngon 435

dge bshes po to ba chen pos bsod snyoms mdzad pa'i dus na yang / dge bshes phu chung ba dang gnyis grong gseb tu byon pas/btsun ma gcig na re de ring khyed gnyis kyi chos ston bdag gis bgyi zer nas song ba dang / po to ba'i zhal nas/ ban de mo yi bsnyen bkur dang / /khyi lud sogs kyi sbrang bu 'dra/ /phan pa bas kyang gnod pa che/ /rang cag 'deng 'deng gsungs skad/ /des na 'o skol mo byes dang thag nye zhing 'brel che na tshe 'dir grags pa ngan pa dang thag nye phyi mar ngan song dang thag nye bas 'di la bag zon cher byed dgos/ sngon bud med gcig gis dge slong zhig la srog gcod kyis/ yang na mi tshangs pa spyod/yang na chang 'thung byas pas/ dge slong gis de rnams gang yang mi rung byas pas mo na re de yin rung nang nas gcig ma byas pa'i thabs med zer/ dge slong gis bsam par thabs med na chang 'thung na skyon chung snyam/ 'thung bas ra ro ba'i tshe mi tshangs pa spyad de nas srog gcod kyang byas nas sdom pa rtsa ba nas shor skad/ des na chang ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas rtswa kha'i zil ba tsam yang 'thung mi rung / sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun shes/ rta thul/ rlangs pa/ ming chen/ bzang po ste/'khor lnga sde bzang po dang lha brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs 'khor 436

rgya mtsho'i tshogs la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin tshul gyis/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos dang /sdug bsngal mtha' dag nyon mongs kyis bskyed tshul kun 'byung bden pa'i chos dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu nyon mongs mtha' dag bkag nas/'gog pa mngon du bya tshul 'gog bden gyi chos dang / nyon mongs pa 'gog pa'i lam tshul khrims bsam gtan shes rab kyi bslab pa ste lam bslab pa gsum la rim gyis slob tshul lam gyi bden pa'i chos te/ bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ lnga sdes dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob/lha brgyad khri bzhi stong gis dus gcig tu bden pa gzigs/ de nas bcom ldan 'das wa ra ṇa si'i 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram du gshegs pa dang / khyim bdag gtso bo'i bu grags pa la bden bzhi'i chos bstan pas rgyan gyis brgyan bzhin du dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob ste slad kyis bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas gang po dang / dri med dang / lag bzang dang / ming chen rnams tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs/ bden bzhi'i chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pas 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa bcu sangs rgyas dang bcu gcig byung / de nas wa ra ṇa si'i grong mi'i gtso bo'i bu thu bo lnga bcu tham pa rab tu byung bsnyen 437

par rdzogs bden bzhi'i chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob 'jig rten na dgra bcom drug cu rtsa gcig byung / de nas ras bal can gyi nags tshang tshing du gshegs nas/ bzang sde tshogs drug cu bden pa la bkod/ de nas grong khyer bde dngos su gshegs nas grong mi'i bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma gnyis bden pa la bkod/ de nas grong khyer lding rgyas su gshegs nas ne+e rañdza na'i 'gram gyi bsti gnas su 'od srung ral ba can 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rab tu byung / bsnyen par rdzogs/ de ltar ral ba can stong rab tu byung /de kun la cho 'phrul gsum gyi gdams pa mdzad/ de nas dge slong gi 'khor stong dang bcas ma ga rnyar byon/ rgyal po gzugs can snying bo bram ze dang khyem bdag brgya phrag du ma'i tshogs dang bcas lha mi ḍanabum phrag dpag tu med pa la chos bstan pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing bden pa mthong / de nas rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs dus/ shā ri'i bu mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rab tu byung ba bsnyen par rdzogs chos bstan pas dgra bcom par gyur/ de nas 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang / 'od srung chen po/ rab 'byor nye bar 'khor sogs rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs bden bzhi'i chos bstan 438

pas/ de dag rnams kyis lam bslab pa gsum la bslabs nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas pa'i rnam par thar pa ltar/ khyem nas khyim med par rab tu byung sdom pa blangs nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu nyon mongs pa 'gog pa'i lam tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la bslabs nas nyon mongs pa sun dbyung / bsam gtan gyi bslab pa la bslabs nas nyon mongs pa'i mgo mnan/ shes rab kyi bslab pa la bslabs nas nyon mongs rtsad nas bton te skye rga na 'chi sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam yang mi thos pa'i dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ / mdor na sngon gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams kyis/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las las byung bar go las rnams nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis bsags par go nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin pas ma rig pa yin par go ma rig pa de sel ba la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob dgos par go shes rab de bsam gtan gyi bslab pa la bsten nas 'byung bar go bsam gtan tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la bsten nas 'byung bar go tshul khrims bsrung ba la thog mar rab tu byung nas tshul khrims kyi sdom pa len dgos 439

par go nas/ thog mar khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa blangs nas tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin bsrung / dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan ri bo bzhin bsgom/bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab nam mkha' ltar bskyed pas ring por mi thogs par dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa yin pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du go nas rab tu byung sdom pa blangs nas tshul khrims bsrung / bsam gtan bsgom shes rab bskyed de lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la 'bad na tshe 'dir yang bde la phyi mar yang skyid la bstan 'gro yongs la yang phan par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ mnyam med zas gtsang sras po de nyid kyis/ /thar pa'i go 'phang thob thabs gang gsungs pa/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong lam rim du/ /bsdus nas gong ma'i gsung bzhin bshad tshar song / /da lta 'chi yang phyi mar dal 'byor rten/ /thob pa'i gdengs can skye bo pho mos kyang / /da dung nus na lam la slob dgos pas//de tsam zhig gis chog shes bya mi rigs/ /phyi mar mi lus rin chen thob na yang / /sngar gyi dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na/ /slar yang ngan song gsum gyi gnas su skyes/ /sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'phral la sdig bsags nas/ /bskal pa 440

bye bar bde 'gro'i sgra mi thos/ /mtho ris rten bzang thob kyang mi rtag 'gyur/ /ngan song sdug bsngal tsam zhig med mod kyang / /skye rga na 'chi la sogs sdug bsngal mang //de phyir mtho ris bde ba tsam zhig gis/ /mi tshegs 'khor ba'i chu bo rab med la/ /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i gru thong la//thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' da snyogs shig /rje btsun bla ma mnyan pa bzang po yi/ /drin la bsten nas 'khor ba'i chu bo brgal//thar pa'i grong khyer snyegs tshul shes pa'i mdo/ /go sla'i ngag gis legs par bshad zin nas/ /da ni rang gzhan thams cad 'tshengs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi gru gzings legs bsdams nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dar chen 'phyar/ /kun ma.o nor bu len tshul 'di ru bshad/ /de yang sngon byis pa chung ngu zhig sa stegs la 'dzegs nas/srun che ba zhig yod pa la bongs ge snyam nas/ ma la da nga a jo dang e mnyam gi byas pas/ ma na re mtho mtho ste/ da dung mi mnyam gi mthor thong smras skad/de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas rab tu byung lam bslab pa gsum la bsten nas rang gcig pu 'khor ba las thar pa tsam zhig byas na/ gzhan 'khor ba'i sems can la bltas na 441

mtho mtho ste/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul la bsam na/ de tsam mtho rgyu rang med pas da dung de'i steng du lam la slob nus na bslabs te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang mnyam pa zhig bya dgos/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams rang gi tshe sngon pha ma sogs gnyen nye bar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ pha ma sems can 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyes gzir nas nyam thag pa rnams yal bar dor nas/ rang nyid gcig pu ci thar byas na/ de bas bu ngan khrel med cig gzhan na med/ rang gis kyang thar pa tsam thob kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ma thob pas/ gzhan don phar zhog rang don yang nyi tshe tsam las ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang gzhan gang gi don du yang 'gro kun drin can gyi pha mar bsam nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas/ lam phar phyin drug la bslab ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du bya tshul ni/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la/ khong gi sku tshe de'i yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul mas sku tshe sngon mar yang ma byas pa bgrang gis mi langs/ de bzhin du sems can gzhan gyis kyang ma ma byas pa gcig med/ sems 442

can re res kyang ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod/ ma byas res kyi tshe 'di'i mas bskyangs pa bzhin du gnod pa tshad med las skyabs/phan tshad med btags zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi ma byas pa tsam du ma zad/ pha dang phu nu sring mo mkhan slob bu tsha sogs gnyen du ma gyur pa yang gcig med gsungs/ sngon khye'u pad+mas gdul bya mang po 'dus tshe/ der 'tshogs pa'i las can gyi sems can rnams kyi gtso byas nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi sems can thams cad la 'di dag ni bdag gi pha'o ma'o/ /bdag gi bu'o de bzhin du gzhan yang bdag gi bu mo'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes rab tu bsgoms te lan gcig ma yin lan gnyis ma yin nyin mtshan dus drug tu lan stong phrag du mar ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar byas so gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang spyir sems can thams cad gnyen nye ba dang khyad par ma yin tshul dang drin che tshul rnams lan cig ma yin par yang dang yang du bsam nas kha tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas drin gzo zhig bya dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus/ lhas sbyin ngan sems skyes nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i drung du song nas khyod kyis yab rgyal po bkrongs la rgyal sred bzung /443

ngas bcom ldan 'das bkrongs la 'khor rnam bzhi'i dpon bya byas pas/ ma skyes dgras yab kyi drin brjed nas/ 'dod pa'i dbang gis pha bkrongs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis pha ma sems can gyi drin rnams brjed/ nyon mongs pa dang 'dod pa'i dbang gis pha ma sems can la gnod byas drin lan log par gzhal mi rung / 'o na drin gzo ji ltar bya dgos snyam na/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas drin gzo bya dgos/de la byams pa bsgoms pa ni/ sngon po to ba rwa sgreng na bzhugs tsa na/ rgan mo zhig na re/ jo bo byams pa bsgom pa ji lta bu zhig la zer ba lags zer ba la po to bas de khyod rang gis bu tho le grags snying du sdug cing gces par 'dzin pa ltar/ sems can thams cad la de bzhin byed pa yin gsungs/ de bzhin du ma gyur sems can thams cad snying du sdug cing gces par 'dzin pa bu gcig pu'i ma lta bu byams dgos/ sngon ma bu gnyis chu chen po zhig gis khyer ba la/ mas bu mo 'di pha khar bde sar zhig phyin na ci ma rung snyam/ bu mos a ma drin can ma 'di chu yis ma khyer bar pha khar zhig phyin na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'phro la shi bas ma bu gnyis ka lha gnas su skyes pa byung /de bzhin du ma gyur sems can bde bas 'phongs tshul bsam nas/ sems 444

can bde ba med pa 'di tsho bde ba zhig dang ldan na ci ma rung ldan par gyur cig ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam du bsam dgos/ sngon a mdo phyogs kyi sde gnyis 'khrugs nas/ ma bu gnyis ri khar phyin pa gzhan pa'i sde yi dmag sleb tshe mas bu mo 'og tu sbas steng du bkab nas bsdad pas ma bsad par bu mo thar ba byung skad/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad la phan ci tho gas kyi sgo nas byams dgos/ sngon dbul po gcig gi bu gser khar phyin pas/ gser gyi sbram bu ra'i mchin pa tsam zhig rnyed pa pha yis thos pas rang gis rnyed pa dang khyad med kyi dga' ba byung skad/ de bzhin du sems can bde ba dang ldan pa mthong na yang /dga' ba khyad par can bskyed dgos/ sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis/ gnod sbyin lngas sha khrag bslangs pa/gzhan la gnod pa ma byas par sha khrag mi rnyed pas da 'di rnams la bdag gi sha khrag sbyin snyam rang gi yan lag rnams la mtshon brgyab nas khrag gtar te gnod sbyin rnams sha khrag gis tshims par byas te/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod do/ /de bzhin du ma gyur sems can la 'phral du sha khrag gter mi nus na yang nam zhig gtong ba'i yid smon byas/ gzhan la phan ci thogs kyi sgo nas phan btags te byams dgos/ rang gi brtse ba'i mas 445

mtshon nas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyi ma drin can rnams kyis bde ba dam pa zhig thob na ci ma rung snyam du bsam zhing / de'i phyir bdag gis lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba btang nas ma gyur 'gro ba kun la phan gdags snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes na byams pa tshad med bya ba yin gsungs/ sngon btsun pa byang ba shes rab 'bar bya ba na re/ kha ngoms lto 'grangs zla bos blo ma dkrogs tsam na/ nga rang gi pha ma la byams sems phrag phrig re skye zhing gda' zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang kha ngoms lto 'grangs/ zla bos ma dkrogs tsam na/ rang rang gi pha ma'am g.yog po snying du sdug pa la byams sems phrag phrig re skye ba tsam gyis byang chub sems dpar mi 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad la byams pa phyogs ris med pa zhig skyes dgos/ 'on kyang dang po nas phyogs ris med pa'i byams pa chen po zhig skyes dka' bas/dang po rtsa ba'i ma nas bzung blo rim gyis sbyangs pas gzhug byams pa chen po skyes pa la tshegs med pas rim gyis sbyangs dgos/ sngon gnod sbyin lngas wa ra ṇa si'i mi la gnod nas mi mang po shi tshe/rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis khyed rnams kyis sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems kyis shig gsungs pas/ kun gyis byams 446

pa bsgoms pas/ gnod sbyin lnga grong khyer du 'jug ma nus klags ma rnyed/ de nas dzi bo rtsi shing 'thu ba rnams mthong nas/khyed rnams bdag la mi 'jigs sam dris pas/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyi dgongs pa sems pas na mi 'jigs smras/dgongs pa ci 'dra zhig sems dris pas/ sems can la byams pa'o smras pas gnod sbyin rnams kyi rgyu 'dis bdag cag gis klags ma rnyed do snyam du sems so/ /sngon sangs rgyas kyis kyang bdud sdig can bye ba dung phyur mang po byams pa'i stobs kyis pham par mdzad pas/ byams pa bsgom nus na bsrung ba'i mchog tu yang 'gyur ro/ /sngon gnas brtan rgyal shes bya ba na re/ nged spun kha zad zad la 'thab nas/ de nas kho'i phrug gu kun nga'i pang du blangs nas 'o byas brang la gcer byas pas/der kho'i zhe sdang zhi song zer ro/ /de bzhin du ma gyur sems can thams cad la byams pa phyogs ris med pa zhig bsgom nas byung na zhe sdang mi skye zhing gal te skyes byung na yang byams pa bsgoms pas zhi yong/ des na zhe sdang gi gnyen po byams pa las bzang ba zhig med/ gzhan yang byams pa bsgom na lha mi dga' zhing bsrung ba dang dug mtshon gyis mi gnod do/ /yid bde ba dang bde ba mang 'bad rtsol med par don kun 'grub/447

gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang tshe 'phos tshe tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas pas byams pa bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /snying rje bsgom pa ni/sngon kham pa 'jam dpal bya ba'i rkang pa na ba zhig la/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ da lta khyod kyi ma rgan yul sna gdong na khyi tshan zhig gis rmug shin 'dug grogs kyang su yang mi 'dug byas na/ rkang pa na ba rang yang mi dran par sdug rgan ma de de na ci byed na zer nas 'theng khyer ling nge cha nges/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad la ma'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa re skyes na sems can gye sdug bsngal mthong tsam na snying rje shas mi bzod pa zhig 'ong ste gsungs/ sngon a mdo phyogs kyi byams pa 'bum gling bya ba na/ri rtse zhig na mchod khang zhig yod pas bud med cig gis bu chung zhig khur nas mjal du phyin pas bu rgyab nas shor te brag rtsa na chu chen po zhig 'gro ba de'i nang du lhung bas ma yis snying rje nas shas ma bzod par chu nang du lcebs skad/ yang hor gye ming sring gnyis kyi ming bo chu la brgal ba chus khyer bas sring mos ma bzod par chu la mchongs skad/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad 'khor ba spyi dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyis sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i tshul la bsams nas 'di dag 448

rnams sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung / bral bar gyur cig bral ba zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i snying rje shas mi bzod pa tsam du bsgom dgos/ de ltar bsgom pas sems can thams cad la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes na snying rje tshad med bya ba yin/ de yang sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mthong ba dang thos pa dang bsam pa tsam gyis rang gi sha gcod pa tsam du snying rje mi bzod pa skyes na snying rje chen po bya ba yin gsungs/ sngon sngags pa gcig la ra gcig yod pas de bsad nas tshogs rkyen bya snyam/ ra 'og tu bcug nas gsus pa'i spu bton pas/ ra yis phe sgra btab pas khyem mtshes kyis thos te khang thog nas bltas pas kho kha skyengs nas/ de tsam zhig ma byas na 'dis rtswa yang zar mi 'dod kyis zer nas btang skad/ de bzhin du bsam sbyor gnyis gas sems can la gnod pa skyel zhing / kha skad la phan 'dogs pa skad dang snying rje ba skad zer ba 'di 'dra la snying rje mi zer snying rje zhes pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyes dgos/ sngon slob dpon padhi ta zer ba dang nye gnas gzhon rgyal zer ba gnyis spun yin pas nye gnas kyis padhi ta zer ba'i 'khos med po rang gi lto gos tsam yang mi 'byongs pa 'di snying rje zhes spros pa dang / sngon rje 449

btsun mi las dka' ba spyod dus sring mos mthong nas snying rje ba dang lam khar nyal bsdad dus na chung bu mo 'ga'i gcig gis snying rje shor ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi bsgom par chos phyir dka' spyad byed pa la snying rje bsgom pa snying rje go log yin pas de 'dra byas na mi yong ri dwags khri gnyan sa le bya ba de dud 'gro yin yang snying rje dang ldan pas khyi ra bas ded pa'i tshe mi dang khyes gtugs kyang /lam na yod pa'i sems can phra mo rnams rmig pa'i 'og tu 'gro bar dogs nas sna yis 'bud cing 'gro ba yin skad/ de bzhin du rgyud la snying rje zhig skyes na sems can gzhan la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i bsam sbyor rang shugs kyis 'gags nas phan pa'i blo ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes yong / sngon sangs rgyas kyis slob pa lam gye dus stag mo ma bu bkres pas nyen pa la snying rje drag po skyes nas lus sbyin par 'phangs pa med par btang ba ltar snying rje chen po skyes na sems can la lus srog gtong yang 'phangs pa med na gzhan gyi dngos po gtong thub pa smos ci dgos/ slob dpon chen po ka ma la shi la'i zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu ni snying rje chen po de nyid yin gsungs/ don gyi dbang 'di 450

gzigs nas sangs rgyas kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rtogs par bgyis na sangs rgyas kyi chos de'i lag pa'i mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste snying rje chen po'o gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yon tan gyi gzhi ma chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'de yin pas 'di rgyud la skye ba'i phyir rab tu 'bad par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems ni de ltar sems can la byams snying rje khyad par can skyes nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal bde la 'god 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa yod kyang da lta rang gis sems can thams cad kyi don phar zhog sems can gcig gi don yang mi nus/ de bas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang tshangs pa brgya byen lta bu'i go 'phang thob kyang mi nus/ de bas dgra bcom pa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob kyang mi nus/ de bas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang thob kyang sems can nyung shas shig gi don las mi nus/ gang gis nus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na sems can gyi don byed nus/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan ci tsam yod snyam na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'di 'dra zhig go zhes brjod kyis 451

mi langs te/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang gis/bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' rtogs par 'dod nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang de bzhin du steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gye khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na/ 'jig rten khams pad+mo can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i dpal gyi snying po'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i sa rnams su rim gyis phyin te bltas kyang / dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong bar phyir log gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gis ci tsam la khyab yod blta dgongs nas/ nub phyogs bde ba can dang / de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na/ 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas su byon te nyan pas kyang gsung chung du ma song/ da dung yang lhang lhang thos pas gsung gi mtha' ma mngon par phyir log gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bu 'phags pa dgra bcom pa dzu 'phrul dang ldan pa yin yang / rang gi ma gang du 452

skyes pa ma mkhyen pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dmyal bar skye ba mkhyen/ dgra bcom pa gzham/ sus kyang khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod pa ma mkhyen par rab tu ma byung ba bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal skyes kyi skye ba bdun gyi gong rol du khyir skyes pa phag gis bdas nas mchod rten zhig la bskor ba byas pas dge ba'i sa bon yod par mkhyen nas rab tu byung ba sogs 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum gyi chos thams cad sa ler mkhyen/ sngon sangs rgyas la bdud lhas sbyin legs dkar mu stegs ston pa sogs kyi gnod pa'i las ci bgyis kyang sdang sems ma byung /lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byen 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sogs kyis phan ci bgyis kyang chags sems ma byung / de bzhin du sangs rgyas la gcig gis g.yas nas tsan dan gyi lde gus byug cing gcig gis g.yon nas sta res gshags pa byung yang gnyis ka nye ring phyogs ris med par brtse gdungs rgyun mi chad du 'byung /sngon mi sdig can zhig gis bya ngang ser gyi tshang sgo rdos bkag nas ngang pa gcig gi mgo phyi rol du bor tsam byas te bzhag pas/ rjes sor ngang pa khyo shug gcig po des kyang mo yal bar 'dor ma phod par snying rje nas/ de'i nang du mgo rgyus nas gnyis char lhan cig tu 453

shi yod skad/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis sems can thams cad gcig kyang skad cig tsam yang yal bar 'dor mi phod par phan na dpral ba'i mig bton khog pa'i snying phyung nas kyang ster nus shing / sems can re re'i phyir yang dmyal ba'i me nang du bskal pa mang po gnas nus pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/sngon ston pa shākya thub pa sangs rgyas nas sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sems can bye ba ther 'bum grangs kyis mi chod pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod nas/ ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i gnas rnams lan grangs du mar stong par mdzad/ de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje rgyun bsrings nas sems can dpag med thar pa'i lam la bkod nas gnas skabs su sprul ba'i zhing khams stong gsum gyi sems can 'khor ba dong sprugs yang yang byung zhing / da yang bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rdzogs nas sangs rgyas mos pa'i bstan pa la yang stong gsum gyi sems can 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te sangs rgya bar gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ des na sngon sangs rgyas sangs ma rgyas pa'i dus skabs su sems can gyi sdug bsngal 454

bsal bde la 'god pa la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul gyis yid 'phrog nas dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal bde la 'god pa la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul rnams bsams nas sems can thams cad kyi don du skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de lta bu zhig gi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur bar myur du thob par bya'o/ /thob nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral 'a/ bla na med pa'i bde ba la 'god par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed dgos/ de ltar sems can gye don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo dper na bkres pa zas dang skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu zhig skyes na/ byang sems skyes pa yin gsungs/sngon rwa sgreng du zhing mon khye 'khrug bya ba na re/ jo bo sems bskyed bya ba de ji lta bu zhig la zer ba lags zer ba la/ po to bas/ de sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa zhig la zer ba yin te byas pas/ kho na re/ a tsa ma de la snying khams che ba zhig dgos par snang zer te/ de khos go ba yin/ de 455

bzhin du 'o skol gyes kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ sems can gye don byed pa la snying khams bskyed dgos/bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad pha ma ru dgongs byams snying rje shugs drag pos thugs bskyod nas rang don yal bar dor gzhan don gtso bor mdzad pas sangs rgyas/ 'o skol rnams kyis sems can thams cad pha mar ma shes chags sdang drag pos yid bskyod nas rang gces par bzung gzhan yal bar dor bas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzhin sems can thams cad pha ma ru bsams nas byams snying rje shugs drag po yang yang bskyed nas rang yal bar dor gzhan pha ma sems can rnams gces par bzung ste/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa'i bas/ma sbyor la 'bad par bya/ chos thams cad kyi gnad 'gag der 'dus te/ glang ri thang ba'i zhal nas ngas ji tsam gyi chos zab mo zhig zhal phye ste bltas kyang skyon thams cad rang gi yin yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin par 'dug de'i gnad kyis khe dang rgyal /ba gzhan la byin/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med 456

gsungs/ de ltar sbyangs tshe sngar yin na rang gces par 'dzin pa la da ni gzhan gces par 'dzin pa byung / sngar gzhan yal bar 'dor ba la da ni rang yal bar 'dor ba'i bsam sbyor ngang ngam shugs kyis byung na bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa yin/ 'byongs kyang da dung gong 'phel du bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems yod na dmyal bar lhung yang myur du thar te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das mdza' bo'i bu mor gyur tshe ma'i mgo la 'goms pa'i rnam smin gyi dmyal bar lhung nas mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo me 'bar bar byung nas 'khor bas na tsha drag po skyes pa'i tshe sems can gzhan la snying rje skyes nas bdag ltar pha ma la gnod pa'i las byas pa'i sems can rnams kyi las ngan pa'i 'bras bu rnams bdag la smin te de rnams 'dir mi 'ong bar gyur cig ces pas 'khor lo nam mkha' la yar 'phags/ tshe'i dus byas nas lhar skyes/ yang bdag cag gi ston pa 'di sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad a wang zhes bya bar gyur dus/ grogs gzhan gyis ma 'drongs par sdug bsngal myang bar mi bzod pa'i snying rje skyes nas/ 'di rnams bde bar thongs dang 'di rnams kyi tshab du nga gcig pus 'dren smras pas/457

dmyal dpon de khros nas sems can rang gi las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa khyod kyis ci byar yod zer nas mgo la lcags kyi tho ba me 'bar ba zhig gis bsnun pas tshe'i dus byas nas lhar skyes/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'di yod na tshe 'dir yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas 'byung ste/ sngon bya sa ko khar ko ba gcig gi nang du btsun pa drug bang chen pa gcig bcas zhugs nas ko gru brgyab nas dkyil du song tshe ko ba chu la byeng tshe ko mkhan gyis cung lci song 'dug rkyal shes pa yod na gcig thon byas pas rkyal shes pa med tshe nang nas bang chen pa na re/thams cad 'chi ba las nga gcig pu shi na rung zer/ rkyal mi shes rung chu nang du mchongs pas de ma thag gru kha der 'ja' tshon zhig 'then me tog gi char babs pa byung kho yang chu nang nas ma shi bar pha khar thon skad/ sngon bla ma rnyarma rak+ṣi tas gzhan nad pa zhig gi sman la mi gson po'i sha med na 'chi ba la khong snying rje drag po skyes nas brla steng nas sha bcad nas byin pas mtshan mo mi dkar po zhig gis phyag gis byel ba zhig mdzad pa'i sos pa zhig rmis pas/ gnyid sad tshe de bzhin du gyur gsungs/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng ba zhig la snying rje skyes/ 'bu rnams la yang snying rje 458

skyes nas 'bu rnams bsal nas sa la 'phen ma phod par khong gi brla nas sha bcad de steng du len par brtsams pas byams pas zhal gzigs nas sngar bzhin sos pa byung / rgyal po dri med kun ldan gyis rang gi spyan sbyin par btang yang phyis bden tshig brjod pas sngar ltar byung / des na snying thag pa nas bdag gzhan brje ba byung na tshe 'dir yang sdug po mi 'byung bas snying thag pa nas byams snying rje bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rgyun ring la shugs drag par bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs nas sems bskyed cho ga la bsten nas 'dzin tshul ni/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags sbyin gyes 'dzam gling gi rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i tog la/ gtsug lag khang bye ba tsam zhig phul nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin/ yang bde gshegs 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas 'od la/rtswa yi sgron ma zhig phul nas sems bskyed/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'phreng ldan gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgyid ldan bzhud la phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ de bzhin du skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gis 459

sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba che chung gang rung la bsten nas bde gshegs gzhan gyi drung nas dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gal che/ de yang theg pa chen po'i byang chub kyi sems tshogs bsags pa las skye bas sngon jo bo dbus su byon tsam na/ sems bskyed zhus pas/ jo bos sems bskyed na mchod pa shoms gsungs/ der mi kun gyi kun dga' ra bar phyag dar byas te khyams stod du sngags pa grong chog byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal lta bu zhig bshams/ de'i steng du mar me gcig spos gcig lha bshos gcig bzhag nas/ jo bo gdan drangs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas mchod pa ngan/ sems bskyed mi skye gsungs nas phyir logs nas gshegs/ de nas yang snying khams bskyed nas mar me lnga drug tsam/ spos gnyis gsum tsam/ lha bshos drug bdun tsam byas te jo bo spyan drangs pas ma mnyes te mchod pa ngan/ sems bskyed mi skye gsungs nas phyir log nas gshegs/de nas mi kun gyis nus pa yod tshad kyis dkon la mchog mchod pa bshams te/ khyams stod thams cad bkang nas spyan drangs pas/ de rten du rung tsam yin gyes gsungs nas/ sems bskyed mdzad gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang sems bskyed 460

byed dus nus pa yod tshad kyis/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ dbul po la sbyin gtong 'byung po yi dwags la gtor ma bsngo ba la sogs tshogs rgya chen po bsags dgos/ sems bskyed byed pa'i dus na longs spyod gtong ba'i tshad ni/ rang la longs spyod ci yod cha gsum du btang bas cha gcig dkon mchog mchod pa/ gcig bla ma/gcig rang gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen du 'jog gsungs/ sngon da ke bshes khu chen po dbu rur byon pa'i tshe/ thams cad kyis sems bskyed zhus pa na/ lag pa g.yas na dar sna khrag tsam re thogs/lag pa g.yon na lha bshos mdzub mo tsam re thogs nas byung skad/ de la dge bshes ma mnyes te/ sems bskyed 'di min kun gyis sla sla bo gcig tu mthong nas 'dug gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis sems bskyed byed dus de lta bu'i sla chos su ma song ba byas ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgya chen po bshams bla ma la phyag rten phun sum tshogs pa phul nas sems bskyed zhu dbos/ gal te ma 'byor na sngon grags pa tha ka pas/ras kyi kha tshar gcig phul bas sems bskyed zhus pa bzhin du ci 'byor ba'i longs spyod kyis mchod nas kyang sems bskyed zhus na rung sems bskyed pa'i don du bla ma la phyag 'tshal yan 461

lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs tshul ni slob mas slob dpon gyi rjes bzlos byas te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro bya tshul ni/ yang slob dpon gyi rjes su bzlos te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan 462

gsum bya/ de nas sems bskyed dngos la dang po smon pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni/ yang slob mas slob dpon gye rjes su 'di skad du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po la bsten nas 'gro kun don du smon pa byang chub kyi thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sgye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang /dbul po la sbyin pa btang ba dang gzhan yang dge ba bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba la bsten nas ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la phan pa'i slad du thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur bar myur du thob par bya'o/ /thob nas zhi bar cung zad tsam yang mi gnas par ngan song gsum gyi 463

sems can rnams lha mi'i go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /lha mi'i 'gro ba kun thar pa'i go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /rim gyis sems can thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar smon pa'i gnas rnams de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /zhes lan gsum bya/ smon sems 'di ni khyim pa pho mo sogs su la'ang byas chog gsungs/de nas 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon gyi rjes su bzlos te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis 'gro kun don du 'jug pa byang chub kyi thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangab4 rgyas 464

kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ mi dge ba phra zhing phra ba yan chad srog la babs kyang spong bar bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i las phra zhing phra ba yan chad khyad du mi gsod par dang du blangs nas sgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can sdug bsngal can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ bde ba med pa rnams bde ba la bkod nas sems can gyi don yang ci nus su sgrub par bgyi'o/ /de'i mthu la bsten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i tshe na yang zhi bar skad cig yud tsam yang mi gnas par tshe 'di'i pha mas thog drangs pa'i ma gyur nam mkha'e mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi gcig kyang 'khor ba na mi gnas pa de srid du sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub par bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid gcig pus sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mdzad pa dang 'phrin las thams cad mthar phyin par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya/ 'jug sems 'di bslab bya slob nus pa ma gtogs nus mi nus thams cad la bya mi rung bar gsungs/ de nas de ltar du 'grub pa yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su 465

rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbye ngas rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar smon pa'i gnas rnams thams cad de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'o sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/bar du bskal pa mang po'i bar du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa yin pa la/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang da res sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras dang 'gro ba lha mir bcas pa'i phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa yin/ da nas byang chub ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du lha mi'i nang nas phun sum tshogs pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob nas bde zhing sgyid pa'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la 'god pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa yin pas/ kun gyes yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed pa ltar dga' spro tshad med pa'i ngang nas phyin chad sdig spong dge sgrub sems 466

can gyi don byed pa la brtson par mdzod cig ces spro ba bskyed do/ /yang sngon rje btsun 'jam dpal rgyal po nam mkha' zhes bya bar gyur pa na/ sangs rgyas 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar smon sems 'jug sdom stabs gcig tu mnos pa bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang stabs bde ba'i phyir smon 'jug dus gcig tu len 'dod na spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i gsung gi rjes bzlos byas te/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan slad du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu bzang / /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da 'gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /snyogs par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes spro ba bskyed par bya/ de ltar bla ma'i drung nas lan cig blangs nas/ phyis sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung ngam/yang na mdun du tshogs zhing dmigs nas nyin re bzhin blangs 467

chog par gsungs/ de nas slob mas bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing bsngo ba smon lam yang bya'o/ /de ltar sems bskyed nas bslab bya la slob dgos pas/ smon pa byang chub sems kyi bslab bya ni/ sngon tshong dpon gye bu nor bzang / dang po 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sems bskyed zhus nas/ de'i bslab bya la slob pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsten pa'i tha ma la/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram bza' shing gi ra ba khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis brgyan pa'i snying bo na/ mgon po byams pa bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin nas/ der rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob ste/byams pas nor bzang la byang chub sems kyi phan yon gsungs pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /dkar po'i chos thams cad 'phel ba'i zhing sa lta bu'o/ /'jig rten thams tsad bsten pa'i sa lta bu'o/ /dbul ba thams cad yang dag par gcod pa'i rnam thos sras kyi bu lta bu'o/ /re ba thams cad skong ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu'o/ /don thams cad 'grub pa'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'o/ /zhes dpe nyis brgya dang sum cu'i sgo nas rgya cher gsungs/ sngon byang chub sems la mnga' brnyes pa'i bu mo 468

mya ngan med kyis sangs rgyas kyi 'khor nyan thos mchog brgyad zil gyis mnan pa ltar/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur bas na sems bskyed ma thag nas rigs kyi sgo nas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon nus/ sngon jo bo chen po byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba klu zhig gis shes nas shing thog ro mngar ba mang po phul ba ltar/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i gang zag de lha dang klu dang mi la sogs skye dgu kun gyi phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing du 'gyur/ sngon mnyam med jo bo chen pos rdo rje gdan la phyi bskor mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo bo'i sngon la bud med rgan gzhon gnyis kyis bskor ba byed pas/ bud med gzhon pas rgan pa la/myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas gang la bslab par bya zhes dris pa la/ rgan pa na re/ rigs kyi bu myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyongs shig zer skad/bud sked de gnyis sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa yin par gsungs/ yang rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad pa'i tshe byang chub chen pos gsung byon nas/ rigs kyi bu myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems sbyongs 469

shig gsungs skad/ des na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i phyir yang dang yang du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong zhing sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i sgo nas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sems bskyed par bya'o/ /sngon bla rgan zhig la shag rogs grwa pa zhig yod par phan ci thogs byas pas nyin gcig bla rgan med shul nas nang du 'dzul nas rkus byas pas bla rgan zhe sdang langs nas da nas phan yang mi 'dogs gnod kyang mi skyel zer skad/ de bzhin du sems can gzhan 'ga' zhig gis phan lan du gnod skyel ba sogs bya spyod ngan pa ci byung yang rang gi ngos nas 'di la dus nam yang phan 'dogs par mi bya'o snyam du blos spong mi rung / sngon zho 'ong dpyis su bu nor bu zer ba zhig yod pa la phas khyod kyis gzhan gyi chung ma rkus nas ma 'gro dang / khyod la thug pas pha bzang gi bu mo zhig len zhes smras kyang ma nyan par gzhan gyi chung ma khrid nas bros pas nor thams cad brlag song bas pha khros te da ni phan 'dogs ri shi zer zhe mna' bskyal phyis mig gis mthong sar yang bu 'ong du ma bcug skad/ de bzhin du sems can gzhan gyis rang gis bshad pa nang ltar mi byed par/ rang gzhan gnyis ka phungs pa byung yang / phyin chad 'di 470

la phan mi 'dogs par ma zad lan cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya'o snyam du yal bar 'dor mi rung / sngon mi glen pa zhig gis nyin gcig zas mang po za rgyu byung nas shin tu 'grangs pa'i tshe/ gzhan yang 'di ltar 'grangs yod snyam nas/ de ring nged tsho thams cad ci zhig 'grangs 'dug ang zhes smras skad/de bzhin du rang re rnams kyis kyang rang bde zhing skyid pa'i tshe/rang bzhin du gzhan yang bde zhing skyid snyam/ gzhan bde ba med par sdug bsngal ba rnams kyi skyid sdug mi shes pa de 'dra bya mi rung / sngon lho khams nags dang nye ba'i zhing zhig la/ spre'u zar 'ong ba la/ bdag pos sa la dong brus te nang du yib nas spre'u ma smad rnams ded pas/ spre'us bu gces pa byas nas pang du khur/ bu mo mi gces pa byas nas rgyab tu khur te bros pas/der nyen tsam na bu skyur nas shing la 'dzegs pas/ bu mos ske la 'khril ba shing khar thon/ bu shul du lus skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sems can gye don bya ba'i blo re yod kyang sems can gyi bya spyod ngan pa'i stabs kyi rang thog tu rkyen ngan yong du nye tsa na/ sems can gzhan yal bar dor mi rung / sngon 'phan yul gyi mi gcig yul gnyal du skyur phyin pas/ btsun pa gcig gis sgo bar du btsir/ phyis 'phan yul du mi mang sar 471

btsun pa de yod tsa na/ mi des sngar sgo bar du btsir ba zhe la bzhag nas/ 'o cag ngo shes pa yod byas pas/ btsun pa na re/med zer bas/ khyed kyis sngar nga sgo bar du btsir bas ngo shes zhes mi mang sar tshig gi rma phab nas ngo tsha ru bcug skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sems can gzhan gyis sngar gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas/ phyis gnod lan 'jal thub pa byung na gnod che thub chung thub bskyel snyam pa'i bsam sbyor spang dgos/ sngon dge bshes gnyis 'gran zlar yod pa la/gcig la bud med yod zer ba dge bshes gcig des thos pas/ nye gnas la ja zhim po zhig skol zhig gtam snyan thos zer ja bskol nas drangs te/ gtam snyan ci gsan zhus pas/rang re'i 'gran zla de la bud med byung ngo zer/ de kun spangs grags rgyal gyis gsan pas/ zhal nag ting song nas de gnyis sdig pa gang che 'am gsung zer skad/ de bzhin du rang re rnams kyis kyang dgra sogs la mi 'dod pa byung ba thos na dga' ba skyes na byang chub sems dpar mi rung bas spang dgos/ sngon mi thams cad dbyar blta la phyin pas/ chu kha na mdze po rkang chag bu smad nyal nyol mang po dang bcas pa gcig gis mi su byung ba la/ nged chu la sgol dang zer ba la/ gcig byung gnyis byung gis 472

bor/ gzhug ma rnams kyi bsam pa la/ khong snga ma kun gyes ma bsgral bar bor/ ngas sgol bar mi 'ong snyam gyin bor/ la la dag khyed nyal nyol mang nas bsgral gyis mi langs 'dug ngas grogs po tsho 'chor zer gyen bor ba ltar/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang 'a khor ba'i sems can rnams sngar sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas kyang bsgral bar ma nus pa ste/ ngas kyang bsgral mi nus snyam pa dang / sems can mang che bas bsgral gyes mi langs snyam pa dang sems can bya spyod ngan pas bsgral du mi btub par 'dug snyam nas/ sems can yal bar 'dor nyen che bas/ de dus sems can de ltar du 'dug pas bsgral dgos pa yin/ de min na bsgral ci dgos snyam du blos mi spong bar sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sems bskyed nas/ —bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi mthar ma gtogs sangs rgyas ma thub na bdag lta bus sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ga la thob snyam nas sems bskyed dor na mi rung bas de'i dus sangs rgyas kyis brtson pas sgrub na srin 'bu yan chad kyis sangs rgyas thob par zhal gyis bzhes shing / khyad par gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo lta bu nyams su blangs nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs 473

rgyas yang gsungs pas/ ngas sangs rgyas ga la mi thob snyam du sems bskyed yang dang yang du bya'o/ /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba'i slad du sgo sna tshogs nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa la yang 'bad par bya'o/ /yang skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed nyams pa'i nag po'i chos bzhi'i rdzun ni/ sngon bram ze zhig gis gzhan zhig nas ra zhig khrid 'ong ba rkun ma mi lngas mthong nas/ nged rnams lam gyi mtshams mtshams nas bsdad la/ khyed kyis khye 'di 'khrid nas ci bya/ zhes dzun smros dang khos btang nas yong zhes gros byas/ de ltar smras pas bram ze'i bsam pa la mi lngas 'di zer lugs kyis ltas ngan pa zhig yin las che nang du khred na bkra mi shis pa yong snyam btang song ba rkun ma rnams kyis thob skad/ sngon rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i nye gnas kyi mig la dud pa phog nas mig chu byung ba la bla mas ci byung dris pas/ kho na re khyod kyis 'khor ba snying po med tshul sogs chos gsungs pa rnams la bsam blo btang bas mchi ma shor zhes ku re zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis bden snyam nas 'o de legs gsungs/ kho bos ku re byas dud pa gnod zhus pas/'o ku re'i phyir yang rdzun smras nas bla ma'i dbu bskor mi rung gsungs/ de bzhin du sems bskyed pa'i bla ma dang mkhan slob 474

sogs la rdzun smras nas dbu bskor mi rung / gzhan dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa ni/ sngon khams kyi rgad po gcig gis 'chi khar bla ma zhig gdan drangs nas/ bla mas khyod la dge ba ci yod dris pas/ kho bo la dge ba gzhan med badz+ra gu ru dung phyur zhig song zhus pas/ bla ma de o rgyan la dad pa med pa zhig yin pas/ a ho rgad po snying rje khyod dad sa de 'jugs song 'dug chos log de bton tshad dmyal bar 'gro smras pas/ kho bo 'gyod drags nas mtshan ngu zhing bsdad pas gnyid du song tshe o rgyan dngos su byon nas rgad bo 'gyod mi dgos sang nyi dros zangs mdog dpal ri nas dar yug cig brkyang gis de la 'jus shog gsungs pas dga' drags nas glu len pa byung /sang nyi dros khang steng du 'ja' tshon zhig zug byung ba dang dus mnyam du rgad po'i dbugs song skad/ yang sngon jo bo la g.yor po 'ching ru'i bu mo zhig gis mgo rgyan thams cad phul nas yul du song bas pha ma nye 'brel rnams kyis mang po lab nas 'gyod pa bskyed pas/ mo sdug drags nas ma bzod par chu la lcebs nas shi bas lha gnas su sgyes pa byung / de bzhin du hagazhan gyis dge ba byed pa la rjes su yi rang mi byed rung thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'gyod pa bskyed mi rung / bya nga chub sems 475

dpa' la mi snyan pa smra ba ni/ sngon ston pa dar lo dang lo ston gnyis kyis rje btsun mi la la phrag dog gi dbang gis rtsod pa btsugs lhag par dar los bskur zhus drag po byas pas shi nas gdon chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu skyes/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung la rdza mkhan dga' skyong bsnyen bkur byed du 'gro ba la/ bram ze'i khye'u bla mas dga' skyong sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen bkur byed pa zhog cig dge sbyong mgo reg la byang chub ga la yod/ byang chub ni mchog tu dka' ba yin no zhes smras pas/ phyis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas su gyur dus de'i rnam smin gyis lo drug dka' ba spyod dgos pa de byung / de bzhin du gzhan dge 'dun pa sogs gzhan la tshig ngan smras na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang na yod cha med/ 'o skol kha la bzod glags med pas gzhan la tshig ngan thal ba byung na nyes skyon chen po 'byung bas tshig ngan smra mi rung / lhag bsam ma yin par g.yo sgyu byed pa ni/ sngon dbus su sngags pa mar nag 'tshong mkhan gcig gis/ srang dbyebs 'dra ba che chung gnyis byas nas/ dang po srang chung shos phu dung nang du sbas/ tshong byed khar gzhan gyi bre srang bsdur bas/ srang jo bo che bar byung bas/kho na re sems can nyon mongs pa snying re rje/ bre srang gang 476

dga' ba la gyis zer te/ de nas nyo ba bag tsam yengs pa na/phu dung nang gi srang chung ba dang brjes nas tshong byas skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang bzang phyi la bstan nas ngan khog tu sbas nas gzhan mgo bskor zhing / bre log srang log la sogs thabs sna dgus rang ci rgyal byed pa 'dis byang chub sems dpa' mi yong bas spang dgos/ yang 'phan yul rgyal na/nang ba ye shes 'byung gnas bya ba zhig yul gzhan du phrin la gtong ba la/ thag ring sar btang na 'gror mi nyan gyis dogs nas/ thag nye bar btang zer/ de gzhan gyis khas blangs pa dang / da de nas pha tshad der yang khyod song dang zer nas gtong / yang thag nye bar btang na 'gror mi nyan gyis dogs nas/ thag ring sar btang zer/ der gzhan gyis mi 'gro byas pa dang / 'o na de bas thag nye ba che ge mor khyod song dang zer nas gtong ba'i g.yo can zhig yod skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis kyang rang 'dod zhe la bzhag nas gzhan la zol khram byed pa 'dis byang chub sems dpa' mi yong bas spang dgos/mdor na sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems nyams pa'i rgyu nag po'i chos bzhi spangs/ mi nyams pa'i rgyu dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten pa lta ra/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang 477

sems bskyed nyams pa'i rgyu/ bla ma mkhan slob sogs la dzun smras nas dbu bskor ba dang / gzhan dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis mi snyan pa smra ba dang / lhag bsam ma yin par g.yo sgyu byed pa ste nag po'i chos bzhi po de spang zhing / byang chub kyi sems mi nyams pa'i rgyu sems can la ku re bzhad gad kyi phyir yang dzun mi smra ba dang / g.yo sgyu med par drang por byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / rang la ltos pa'i gdul bya nyan rang sogs theg dman la mi 'god par theg chen 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab par bya'o/ /nag po'i chos bzhi byas pa dang / gzhan gyi gnod pa zhe la bzhag nas sems can 'di'i don nam yang gtan nas mi bya snyam pa dang / ngas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob mi nus snyam pa dang / thob kyang sems can mang bas 'dren mi nus snyam pa sogs byang chub kyi sems shor ba byung na/ de ma thag bshags pa byed cing slar byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bya'o/ /'jug pa byang chub sems kyi bslab bya ni lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug yin/ de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi lam la dka' 478

ba spyod pa'i tshe/ thugs dgongs byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig gis/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du gtong ba dang / yongs su gtong ba dang / gtong ba chen po la sogs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te sems can gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa yin/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis kyang byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgo nas zang zing mi 'jigs chos kyi sbyin pa rnams la bslab na ring por mi thogs par thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dus/ dge slong chos smra ba nges pa zhes bya ba la yul de'i rgyan po rgyal ba po zhes bya bas/ gdugs dang mchil lham bla gos mgron bu lnga phul nas smon lam btab/ des kyang yon bsngo ba byas nas yul du 'ong bas chu'i khron pa'i nang nas gser dngul brdol nas chu zom chen po zhig gis lnga tsam len rgyu byung /de nas mchod sbyin rgya chen po byas pas/ yul de'i rgyal por gyur/ de nas de bas kyang mchod sbyin byas pas shi nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang 'phrul dga' dga' ldan 'thab bral/sum cu rtsa gsum rnams kyi rgyal po bye ba phrag du mar byas te 479

mthar mi'i rgyal po bsod nams zhes bya bar btsas pa'i tshe/lha'i rin po che'i char pus mo nub pa tsam phab cing / dbang che bar grags pa bsam pa tsam gyes dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bab par gyur/ mthar rgyal ba shākya thub par gyur to/ /sngon tshe dang ldan pa ka ta ya na'i bu chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa la bram ze'i bu mo skra can gyis ma la skra btsong du bcug gar+ṣa ṇi lnga brgya khugs pa'i rin gyis 'tsho ba sbyar nas drangs pas/phyis ring por ma lon par bu mo de rgyal po gtum po rab snang gi btsun mor blangs/ ming btsun mo zhi ba zhes bya bar grags/dpal 'byor chen po dang ldan par gyur/ ma de la rgyal pos gsang ba'i rgyan lnga/ phyi rol gyi rgyan brgyad dang grong khyer mchog lnga byin nas bde zhing skyid par gyur/ jo bo rjes skye ba bdun du mi lus gtsang ma thob nas chos spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur/ khyad par sku tshe der mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis brgyan pa'i dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes shing / bdag gzhan thams cad kyi don ma lus pa grub pa de sngon bsod nams rgya chen po bar ma chad du bsags pa'i 'bras bu las byung ba yin/ sngon po to bas/ khong gi slob ma zhang se chung bya ba zhig la bsod snyoms 480
