byas pas nas cung zad yod pa gra pa bgres po 'ga' la tshogs bsags su btang nas/ 'di ltar byas pa bsod nams che/ ngas rwa sgreng na yod dus rgyags nas phran bu yod pa bsod snyoms pa tshan gcig la btang bas/ de nas mar la 'tsho ba lhun grub tu byung khyod la yang de bzhin yong gsungs/ rgya gar du slob dpon dzha pa ri bya ba padhi ta chen po zhig yo byad chung bas/ gzhan gyes 'bul mkhan ma byung ba la nub cig rmi lam du thugs rje chen pos khyod kyi srog rten gyi rgyags cung zad de yang sbyin par thongs gsungs pa ltar lhag ma med par btang bas/ de ma thag slob ma gcig gis 'bras khal bzhi bcu phul skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams la dngos po chen po gtong rgyu ma mchis kyang chung ngu btang yang bsod nams rgya chen po thob yong / sngon rdzi bo zhig gis 'dzar ba'i skyar chu lhag ma cung zad yod pa grog tshang zhig la btab pas/ yul gru chen po zhig gi rgyal por skyes/ sngon mi gcig gis zan snum can zhig me la sros nas zos pas snum me nang du thigs pa bcom ldan me lha mchod smras pas/ me lhas dngos grub byin te longs spyod dpag tu med pa byung / rgan mo zhig gis 'phags pa ka ta ya na la chu phor ba gang drangs pas sum cu rtsa gsum gye gnas su skyes/ bram ze'i bu mo gcig gis 481

dge slong zhig la skyu ru ra zhig phul bas/ stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dang 'gran pa'i longs spyod can du skyes/ bud med cig gis sprang po zhig la/ lto zhig sbyin pas rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i khang pa zhig tu ro brgya ldan pa'i zas za ba zhig tu skyes/dbul po 'ga' zhig gis gzhan gyis dge 'dun par mang ja bskol ba'i nang du 'o ma mar gyi thigs pa re zhal 'debs byas pas/ 'o ma dang mar khu'i rgya mtsho la longs spyod rgyu byung / bud med cig gis khye 'khyams shig la lto khru ma zhig blud pas/ shi nas gshin rje glang mgo can gyis dmyal bar khrid nas 'gro ba la/ mi lus khyi'i mgo bo can zhig byung glang mgo can dang 'dzing res byas pa'i bar der bud med de lam dkar po zhig la gyen du bros pas thar te mtho ris su song skad/ sngon bri sha'i rgyal po la phyi rol pa'i slob dpon 'tshe ba chos su smras pa zhig gis tshe 'di la mi bsad na 'bangs su 'ong / phyugs bsad na nor du 'ong byas lta ba log par bkod pas/ bar skabs der rgyal po des mchod sbyin mang po byas pas/ yongs nga'i lta ba 'di nor las che tshe 'dir mi bsad na mi sha len du 'ong / phyugs bsad na nor sha len du 'ong ba 'di dang dpe sbyar na phyi ma la'ang 'ong nges snyam/ lta ba ngan pa de las rang log byung / sngon slob 482

dpon shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa sngar lta ba sems tsam 'dzin pa la/ bsod nams mang po bsags pas/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma la bltas pa tsam gyis sems tsam lta ba 'gyur nas dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs pa byung / yang phyi rol pa zhig gis tshogs bsags pa'i mthus slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dbu ma'i bstan bcos bltas pa tsam gyis phyi rol pa'i lta ba las 'gyur nas dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs nas bstan bcos kyang mdzad skad/ sngon legs 'ong sangs rgyas kyis rab tu byung kho'i sgrib pa sbyong phyir/ dbyar zla gsum dge 'dun la me tog 'bul du bcug pas/ sgrib pa dag nas lan zhig dge 'dun gyi phyag na me tog sngo sang nge 'dug pa la bsten nas/ sngon zad par sngon po'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bag chags sad nas/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin skyes nas dgra bcom par gyur/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul na sngon gsang sngags la bsten nas dngos grub thob pa mang po byung ba la/ da lta mchog gi dngos grub phar zhog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yang med pa de tshogs bsags pa'i zhing dge 'dun bzhi sde re yang ma bzhugs pas lan skad/sngon spyan snga ba'i drung du/ dge bshes dol pa phyin nas kho bos mtshams bcad snying po bgrangs par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na yul du 483

log la dge slong bzhi sde zhig la bsnyen bkur gyis la/ de nas snying po bgrongs shig gsungs/ de chos mgo mthar thon pa la gal che bar dgongs pa yin gsungs/ phu chung ba'i zhal nas khyad par sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams 'di la 'bad pa drag po bya dgos te/ dge bshes ston pa la 'phral la gsol rgyu'i thud tshal re byung yang ma sbags pa byas dge slong bzhi sde re la 'dren pa yin gsungs/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa 'di ka shi ga'i rgyal por gyur dus phug ron gyi phyir rang gi sha khra la sbyin pa btang / rgyal po zla 'od kyis dbu bcad nas sbyin par btang / rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis rang gi khrag sbyin pa btang / khye'u sems dpa' chen pos stag mo la lus sbyin par btang / rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyes zas zing la sogs bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad sbyin par btang / rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis nor bu sras sras mo rang gi sbyan yang sbyin par btang /rgyal po nor bzang gis lo bcu gnyis su gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rang gi nus tshad kyis gzhan la phan gang thogs byed pa la 'bad dgos/sngon khyim bdag ser sna can zhig gis lag pa g.yas g.yon spos kyin gcig la gcig ster ba'i tshul yang yang byas pas 484

goms nas gzhug tu sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong nus pa zhig byung skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang khab skud pa la sogs phra mo nas ster ba la bslab pas/ goms na gzhug tu dngos po chen po la yang mi chags par gtong nus pa 'ong / sngon jo bo lha sar byon dus nas kyi 'bul ba mang po byung bas/ lha khang gi rgya mthongs na spungs nas yod pa la/ dge bshes ston pa blo ma bde nas nangs par snga bar jo bo la nas tsho ci mdzad zhu ru phyin tsa na/ nas rdog gcig kyang mi 'dug pa mthong nas/ nas tsho gar btang lags byas pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bo sbyin pa gtong ba la mkhas pa lags gsungs gzhan 'dir btang ma gsungs/de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang tshe 'di'i snyan grags dang kha lan sogs la re ba med par/ byams snying rje byang chub sems dang / sgyu ma rmi lam ltar 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i lta bas rtsis zin par byas te phyogs med kyi sbyin pa gtong ba la bslab par bya'o/ /sngon rgya gar na dge slong dgon pa ba zhig bzhugs pa'i drung du/ rgyal po dang yul mi la sogs pa byung ba'i dus na/khong la bza' btung sbyin rgyu med pas/ blo tshod dang sbyar ba'i chos re 'chad pa yin skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol chos pa rnams kyis kyang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas blangs 485

nas/ dad pa can la blo kha dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa yang gtong bar bya/ sngon gyi chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dman pa nyam thag pa'i mgon dang skyabs byas pas/ dman pa rnams kyi zhal mthong ba tsam gyis sems la dga' ba bskyed pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rang gi nus pa dang bstun nas rgyal po yin na ri rgya dang klung rgya bsdams pa dang dud 'gro sogs tshe thar srog blu byed pa/ 'jigs pas nyen pa 'jigs las sgrol ba/ khra dang spyang ki sogs kyis 'tshe bar byed pa de las skyob pa nad kyis nyen pa la nad g.yog sman dang bkres skom grang ba'i mchi la nye ba zas skom gos sogs byen nas srog skyob pa tha na srin 'bu nyi ma mes 'tshig pa bsil sar bzhag chu nang lhung ba skam la 'don pa sogs mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa la yang brtson par bya'o/ /sngon rab 'jigs kyis gser bum pa gang rnyed nas 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin las che 'di'i steng nas dkon mchog mchod snyam pa lan cig skyes pas/ phyis bskal pa mang po zhig gi bar du gser la sogs pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung / sngon dbul po zhig gis gzhan ci yang ma rnyed par rde'u chung ngu spar gang rin po che sna tshogs par mos nas dge 'dun pa'i tshogs 486

gral du gtor bas/ phyis mir skyes skyes ma thag tu rin po che sna bdun gyi char babs nas khyim gang ba byung / sngon sprang po zhig gis lam na dge 'dun pa mang po 'gro ba mthong nas rab tu dad pa'i shugs kyis 'di rnams la lha'i bdud rtsi sogs kyi mchod rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa snga dro sems la shar bas/ phyi dro bsod nams skyes te tshong dpon zhig gis tshab byed rgyu byung nas sngar gyi rang gis bsam pa ltar dge 'dun sde mchod rgyu'i skal pa byung / des na sbyin pa gtong rgyu med rung gtong sems spel ba 'di sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i thabs tshegs chung la don che ba yin pas rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams dang gzhan yang 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyi dngos po dpag tu med pa sprul nas/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa ru phul/ mar 'gro ba rigs drug ma gyur sems can thams cad la sbyin pa ru btang / de dag la chos bstan nas sems can thams cad zang zing gi sbyin pas rgyud tshims/ chos kyi sbyin pas rgyud grol song snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ gzhan yang dben pa gnas nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas gtor ma brgya rtsa gsur bsngos gcod dmigs sogs kyang 'phral du lag len la ci thebs bya zhing / sgo 487

sna tshogs nas gtong sems la goms par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na tshegs chung ngu'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs nas ring por mi thogs par bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang mchog la reg pas/ blo gros can rnams kyis 'di la dus rtag tu nan tan du 'bad par gyis shig /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du lha'i bu gnyis byung nas bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa nod de/ chos tshig bzhi pa re thos pas/ de nyid nas grol ba byung /des na bsnyen gnas nyin re tsam bsrung na phan yon de 'dra na/dge bsnyen nas dge slong yan gyi sdom pa thob nas ma nyams par bsrung na myur du thar pa thob pa smos ci dgos/ sngon bram ze zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi sbyan sngar yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong blangs nas/ phyi dro bram ze gzhan gyes khyem du song bas zas zo zhig mi za na khyem du ma 'dug byas pas zas zos pas gso sbyong ral/ ma ral na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su sgyes rgyu yin pa la/ dus min kha zas zos pas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha gnas su skyes/ des na sdom pa nyams na yang phan yon de 'dra na/ legs par bsrung na phan yon che ba smos ci dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rnams la/ bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed 488

kyi grangs las 'das par zas skom gdugs dang mar me 'phreng bas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la rim 'gro byas pa bas bstan pa 'jig la nye ba'i snyigs dus 'dir nyin mtshan gcig tsam la sdom pa sna gcig bsrung ba de bsod nams de bas khyad par du 'phags gsungs/ des na tshul khrims bsrung ba sbyin pa phal gyis do zla min bsod nams dpag med thob par 'gyur/gzhan yang tshul khrims can gyi dad zas gshin zas ri tsam zos kyang 'ju ba dang / smon lam ci btab 'grub lha mi kun gyis bkur/ shi na mtho ris dang thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas/ des na sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob ma dge slong mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya bas tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung nas nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom pa rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar bsrung dgos/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis tshul khrims bsrung bzhin du phar phyin drug sogs dge ba'i chos rnams rang rgyud la bsdud cing / gzhan gyi don yang skyo ngal med par rgya chen po mdzad pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyis kyang tshul khrims bsrung bzhin dge la gzhol ci nus kyis sems can gzhan gyi 489

don la 'bad dgos/ sngon keg ston bya ba'i dge slong zhig gis mdze mo zhig khur nas chu la bsgral na sa/ reg pa de bzod par gsol zer skad/ byang chub sems dpa' bya ba de lta bu zhig dgos pa yin/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sems can gyi don chen po 'grub par 'dug na rang gi bcas pa phra mo re la gnod par 'dug kyang byams snying rje gzhan phan gyi bsam pas sems can gyi don gtso bor byed dgos/ sngon mi 'ga' zhig mes tshig ste so gtsigs nas nang du 'ong ba byis pas mthong nas a pha rgod kyin 'ong byas pas/ pha na re/ nga rgod pa min mes tshig pa yin zer skad/ de bzhin du kha cig gis chos bshad sogs byed pa gzhan don ltar snang yin de la bsten nas rang don rnyed pa sgrub pa yang mang / des na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed pa dang / khram pa chos ltar bcos nas rang don sgrub pa gnyis 'dra min nor sa yod pas gzhan don byed pa la rang 'dod kyi bsam pa med pa zhig dgos/ sngon mi zhig la ba rog mo zhig yod pa la bltas nas ba rog mo 'di'i ngo 'dzum la/ be'u shi ro zhig las 'os med zer/ de bzhin du 'o cag chos pa phal cher gyi bya spyod la bltas na 'bras bu ngan song gsum las 'os med/ sngon jo bo gcig gis lam 490

khar phying zhwa gcig gi nang du nye'u bton pas/ der zhwa zhig pas zhwa lag tu thogs nas/ lham bol nang du gshegs su gsol zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o cag ban btsun 'ga' re'i bya spyod ngan pa 'dis sdom pa rtsa ba nas zhig ste gzhug grwa sa dor te mar grong khyem du gshegs dgos 'byung nyen yod/ sngon mi zhig gis mi gnyis la sha lhu gcig drangs gcig gis kham re bcad kyin zos nas gtub bam bgo bya ba lan 'ga' byas pas/ gcig na re gtub rung bgos rung brlag zin tshar zer/ de bzhin du kha cig gis sdom pa bzang po gcig shor gnyis shor nas/ gzhug brlag 'gro ba yang mang de ltar byas na mi yong / sngon btsun pa gcig spun zla'i khyim du yang yang phyin pas/ mi che ba kun gyis skog tu nyi ma cag la ci byed na byas shub pa byas pa byes pas go nas/ nyin gcig 'ong tshe/ byis pa na re a khu nged khyim du nyi ma cag la 'ong nas ci byed zer skad/ des na che ngag chung bya ba yin pas/ rang re yang ster gi snyam nas sbyin bdag mi tshang re re la yang yang blangs nas sun du bcug na mi yong / spre'us bya glag nam mkha' nas 'ongs tsa na/ dbyug pa thogs nas ag ag zer zhing kha stag bzlo la/ der bya glag yas mar zhung gis byung tsa na/ dbyug pa skyur nas shing phung gi gseb tu mgo 491

btsugs nas bsdad de/ der kho gang 'dod khyer/ de bzhin du kha cig gis rkyen ngan ma byung gong du kha bo che/ rkyen ngan bas/ tsam re byung yang mi thub par kho'i dbang du song nas rang gis sdom pa gtong ba de 'dras mi yong / sngon rgan mo cig gi zhing bzang po zhig gnas brtan zhig gis 'phrogs so/ /nyin gcig gnas brtan de la lag bde bas tshab 'dren pa'i bar na yog pa gcig yod pa ma bsal bar du gnas brtan gyis tshab mi len par mthong nas/ rgan mo na re nga'i zhing thog der yog pa cig skyur ma shes pa zer skad/ de bzhin du da lta dge slong kha cig gis rtsa ba'i sdom pa sogs 'chor bar mi 'dzem bcas pa phra mo re la ku co ding ding byed pa la tshul khrims can mi zer/ go log de 'dras mi yong / sngon po to ba'i slob ma kong po 'dul ba 'dzin pa bya ba bzang po zhig yod pas/ khos rang gi yul du mkhar lan rgya chen po byas te/ 'dul ba'i lung nas bshad pa'i khang pa mig brgya pa byas pas/ de dge bshes kyi gsan pas thugs ma mnyes te/ /gong 'dul gyis kyang chung ma blangs par 'dug gsungs pa thos te drung du 'ong ba/ po to ba'i zhal nas/khyod kyi mkhar lan rgya chen po byas pa de ma legs/ de la bsten te sde 'khrugs dang rtsod pa sogs 'byung nyen yod de byung na 492

chung ma blangs pa las kyang thu ba yin gsungs skad/ des na 'o skol chos pa rnams kyis rang yul mi yul gang du sdod rtsis kyis mkhar lan rgya bo che dang sog rum byas nas sdig rkyen du 'gyur pas/ snying thag pa nas rang gzhan gyi don byed na gzhi med gnas med phyogs med byas bdag tu 'dzin pa gcig kyang med pa zhig bya dgos/ sngon bud med cig gi khyo ga mi zhig gis bsad pas stong bsnyeg tu gzhan 'gro ba la/ mo na re/ rta g.yag byung yang khyer ma 'ong / nga'i sgo la mi shong gi ra lug bya mo 'dra ba byung na khyer shog dang dga' zer skad/ de bzhin du rang re chos pa kha cig gis blo la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mi shong /tshe 'di'i 'jig rten chos brgyad byung na dga' ste/ de 'dra'i chos pa tshul khrims rnam dag 'ong mi srid/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis tshe 'di'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang shas kun dor te/ston pa thugs rje can gyis bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' zhing gal te nyes ltung phra mos gos srid na yang de ma thag bshags sdom dang phyir bcos bya'o/ /sngon mi gcig gis klu mang po mtsho khar sbrul du rdzus nas 'ong yod pa klu bdud cig gi gsod pa las thar bar byas pas/ sbrul zhig gis dngos grub ster ba'i brda' byas nas song bas kho nang du log nas da nga la 493

dngos grub ci 'dra zhig ster ram snyam ham pa tsha po byas/ phyi nyin mtsho khar song bas kho 'dod pas bsgribs nas klus dngos grub khyer 'ongs kyang ma mthong / de nas yun ring song nas da dngos grub mi ster rgyu red snyam phyir log nas lam zhig nas ngal gsos pas gnyid du song / sad tshe klus mdun na dngos grub khyer ba mthong nas da bar mi ster ba ci yin byas pas khyod 'dod pas bsgribs nas re zhig ngas kyang ma mthong skabs cig mthong yang khyod kyis mi mthong bar gda'/ da khyod kyi 'dod pa zad pas mthong zer skad/ des na dge slong ham pa tsha ba rnams la bsnyen bkur mi 'byung bas/ 'dod chung chog shes 'di gal che/ rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtshos slob ma rnams la go ba skye phyir/ sems 'dod chung chog shes mdzod khang sgor/ /khong bya btang phyug po thams cad gnas/ /gsungs/ 'dod pa thams cad spangs nas snying nas chos bzhin byas na/ 'dod pa chung ba'i chos pa de la 'dod pa chung bas mis mchod pa smos ci dgos lhas kyang mchod pa yin te/ lha rje bsam gtan bya ba la/thang lhas zla ba gcig gi bshos drangs/ yang 'phags pa byang chub dpon g.yog thang lhas spyan drangs zla ba gcig gi bar du g.yag rgod kyi zho dar mang po'i bsnyen bkur mdzad/ phebs 494

khar dngul sga gcig phul ba da dung dge 'dun rgyal po'i dkor mdzod na yod skad/ rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ lha'i bu mo bdun gyis 'bras dkar mo'i 'tsho ba drangs/ tshe ring mched lngas 'dod yon gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa drangs/ sku la dga' bzhi'i bde chen sbar ba'i grogs kyang mdzad/ de dag rnams la dgongs nas jo bo rjes lha btsun byang chub 'od la gdams pa/ snying nas chos bzhin byas na lto rgyab gnyis ka zhor la 'byung tshul 'dug grogs dag 'dod pa rnams la tshwa chu 'thung bzhin ngoms pa med pas chog shes mdzod gsungs/des na 'dod chung chog shes byed pa gal che/ sngon pha rgad po gcig la bu gnyis yod pa nor dang gdams ngag ster bas khyed gnyis gang 'dod dris pas/ chung shos kyis gdams ngag 'dod zer bas/ che ba na re gdams ngag khyod 'khyer na/ nga nor tshags byed pa las 'os med zer nor rnams tshags byas/de nas pha 'chi khar/ bu chung bas gdams ngag ga re byas pas/sdug gis thug na rgan pa la gros dris bya ba las gzhan ma byung nas/ der nor med nas yul gzhan du phyin tsa na rgyal po shi ba'i btsun mos rgyal srid bzung nas 'dug pa/ rgad po zhig la 'di ci 'dra yin dris pas/ des thams cad bslu ba yin pas 495

gan du 'gro na 'di ltar gyis byas bslab bya bslabs pa ltar byas pas/ bud med des 'di blo dang ldan pa zhig 'dug snyam mgu nas khyim thabs byas te pha'i yo byad pas rgyal po'i rgyal srid thob pa byung / yang sngon rgyal po gcig gi mig na nas sman pas bud med rang gi khyem thabs ma yin pa skyes pa gzhan gyes ma spyad pa'i nu zho dgos zer bas/ rgyal pos de lta bu yod pa la bya dga' ster byas pas bud med gcig na re/ khyo ga la de lta bu nga yin gyis la bya dga' long zer bas khos grogs po gcig la dris pas/ grogs po na re de mi bden ma bden na rgyal po'i chad pa yong bas/ de las bzlog la dris la ci zer ltos byas pas/ khyo gas khyod kyi des mi 'ong bar 'dug skyes pa brgyas sbyad pa zhig dgos zer byas pas/ mo na re/ de nga la yod zer nas bgrangs pas/ dgu bcu go dgu byung skad/ de yang grogs bo blo ldan de la dris pas rgyal po'i chad pa ma byung ba yin/ bud med kyi kha la nyan na gnyis ka phung bar 'gyur/ des na grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa bzang po bsten na tshul khrems sogs chos mgo mthar thon pas grogs bzang po bsten nas chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byed kyang blo dris nas byas na bab mi brdal ba 'ong / sngon zhang zhung gi btsun rgan zhig rwa sgreng du 'ong na ca/ /496

'di na phyag bya dgos pa su yod zer ba/ 'di dang 'di yod byas de rnams la phyag byas tshar nas da su yod dam byas gcig gis da dung sngags pa dge bsnyen zhig dang khyi rgan 'gengs can zhig yod byas khyi la yang phyag byed du bcug skad/ yang sngon rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis blon po sdig can gyi ngag la nyan nas sdig pa tshan po che mang po bsags pa'i tshe de'i steng du sa'i char babs nas ba sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgras lhas sbyin gyi ngag la nyan nas rang gi yab rgyal po bkrongs/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba can gyis slob dpon ngan pa'i ngag la nyan nas mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa sogs grogs ngan la bsten nas rang gzhan gnyis phung byas pa'i gtam rgyud de 'dra ba mtha' yas/ khyad par bud med dang nye na tshul khrims kyi mgo thon pa shin tu dka' zhing gal te thon na yang / de dang nye na grags pa ngan pa byung bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren yong / bo to ba'i gsung sgros las/ bud med kyi 'khor dang lha khang gi phug ron 'dra ste chos 'khor bshig pa yin bud med kyi bsnyen bkur dang / gal snyi'i tho phyi'i sha rid 'dra ste/ sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum 'byung ba yin gsungs/ da lta rnal 'byor pa kun gyis dang po dga' ye re tshod lta tsam la bud med re blangs phan tshun 497

gcig gis gcig dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro ru re tsa na gzhug gcig gi byur gcig la bkal nas/ bu nyog gi gal du 'dzin te der tha ma gos bum pa tshun chad btsongs nas za dgos gsungs/ des na grogs ngan dang bud med la sogs pa blos yal bar 'dor ba ma yin kyang dngos su de dag dang lus ngag gi 'brel thag gcod dgos/ de ltar ma byas na chos rnam dag mi 'ong ba tsam du ma zad nyes skyon mang po 'phel yong bas blo gros can rnams kyis gzab 'tshal/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po tshangs byen gyi bu ka shi mdzes dgas rgyal srid kyi nyes dmigs mthong nas/ rab tu byung bas mtshan drang srong bzod par btags/ khong skyed mos tshal gyi zhi ba'i phyogs shig na bzhugs dus/ rgyal po 'thab mo skyes sos ga'i tshe skyed tshal du btsun mo dang lhan du 'ong / skyed tshal gyi bde ba myang bas gtubs nas gnyid du log btsun mo rnams shing 'bras tshol du phyin pas/drang srong dang mjal bas drang srong gis chos bshad do/ /rgyal po langs nas bltas pas btsun mo rnams ma mthong bas ral gri langs nas btsal bas drang srong gi drung du 'khod pa mthong nas/ zhe sdang skyes te khyod su yin dris pas/ nga drang srong bzod 498

pa smra ba bya ba yig smras pa'i tshe/ rgyal pos bzod mi bzod tshad blta zer/ ral gris drang srong gi lag pa gnyis bcad nas/ da su yin dris pas/ nga bzod pa smra ba'o gsungs/ de nas rkang pa bcad cing / yan lag nying lag rnams bcad nas/ da su yin dris pas/ smras pa/ gal te bdag gi lus la ni/ /til 'bru tsam du gtubs pa yis/ /lus ni phye ma brgyar gtubs nas/ /sa la gtor yang bzod mi spong / /zhes sogs smras nas smon lam btab pa/ rgyal po 'dis bdag la yang nas yang du dris nas/yan lag dang nying lag bcad pa bzhin du/ bdag gis bzod pa bsgom pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas/ bdag sangs rgyas pa na/ de la yang yang dris nas shes rab kyi ral gris thog mar de'i nyon mongs gcod par gyur cig gsungs/ slar yang rgyal pos bzod dam gsol bas smras pa/ lus la mtshon gyis 'debs na'ang / /bdag ni sems can kun la byams/ /gal te khyod yid mi ches na/ /bdag gi khrag 'dzag pa la ltos/ /zhes khrag 'o ma'i thigs par 'dzag pa'i cho 'phrul bstan yang da dung yid ma ches par/ bzod dam smras pas/ de nas drang srong gis yan lag dang nying lag bcad pa rnams gnas ji lta ba bzhin bzhag nas/ rgyal po khyed kyis bdag gi lus/ /gtubs kyang 499

shen tu phra ba yi/ /zhe sdang 'di ltar yod min na/ /bdag lus ji ltar sngon bzhin shog /ces smras pas lus sngar ltar gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po ya mtshan skyes nas smras pa/ e ma'o chos la legs gnas pas/ /e ma brtul zhugs 'di 'grub ste/ /lus la gtub par byed na 'ang / /khyod la mi dga' ci yang med/ /ces rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis drang srong gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas song ngo / /de'i dus kyi drang srong bzod pa smra ba de phyis ston pa sangs rgyas su gyur/ rgyal po 'thab mo skyes sangs rgyas kyi dus 'khor lnga sde'i nang gi ko'u di n+ya zhes bya bar gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyis bden bzhi'i chos gsungs pa'i tshe mtshams mtshams su khyod kyis shes sam zhes yang yang dris pas/ ko'u di rgyas kyang kun 'tshal zhes gsol bas/ dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ des na bzod pa bsgom na gnas skabs su dge slong bzod pa smra ba lta bu'i mthon po gzugs mdzes pa'i lus len zhing / mthar thugs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra la ngan 'brel bzhag kyang phan yon de 'dra byung na bzang 'brel bzhag na smos ci dgos/ bzod pa bsgoms na smon lam yang ci btab 'grub pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang bzod pa bsgoms shing gzhan bzod pa can la 'brel ba bzhag /smon 500

lam btab na phan yon de 'dra 'byung / sngon byung chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba'i tshe/ bkres skom tsha grang yid la ma byas/ nyin mtshan med par lus srog la ma bltas par btsal bas/ mod la rnyed nas don thams cad 'grub/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis kyang tshe 'di'i bde sdug phra mo la ma bltas par chos phyir dka' ba sbyad nas sgrub nus na/ myur du 'dod pa'i don 'grub nas yong / sngon rgyal po byi ling gar ling sogs kyis chos tshig bzhi pa re'i ched du'ang lus la lcags gzer stong btab pa dang / mar me stong btsugs pa dang / pags pas shog bu rus pas snyug gu khrag gis snag tsha byas chos bris pa sogs dka' ba dang du blangs shing de dag la bzod par mdzad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mod la thob pa yin/ sngon gshen ston g.yung drung rgya mtsho bya bas mi gzhan gcig gis gcig la/ gshe ba dang rgol ba'i lan byed pa kun la ye khyed gser mdog can mi 'dod pa lags sam gsung skad/ des na sangs rgyas kyi sku gser btso ma lta bu de yang gtso bo bzod pa bsgom pa'i 'bras bu las byung ba yin pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang bzod pa bsgom pa'i phan yon de tsho bsams nas bzod pa bsgom dgos/ sngon jo bo rje la rgya gar 501

gyi a tsa ra gshis ngan pa jo bo la rtag tu khro ba gcig yod pa rgyun du jo bo'i drung na 'dug pa la gshis ngan 'di ma bsten mdzod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di ngas bzod pa bsgom pa'i rten lags gsungs skad/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis ched du gnyer nas bzod pa bsgom pa'i rten re 'jog dka' yang /gzhan khong khro slong mkhan su byung yang / bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bltas nas bzod pa ci nus su bsgoms dgos/ sngon tha kha pa tshan gcig gis dge slong dgon pa zhig la/ lus 'dam bu bcom pa ltar byas pas mgo'i klad pa yang brtol bas/ dge slong de la zla bo gcig yod pa des/ rgyal po la bshad pas/ rgyal pos 'di dag thams cad brlag par byed kyi byas pas/ tha kha pa rnams bred nas dge slong gi rkang pa la phyag byas bzod par gsol bas/klad pa tsa re bzod de zer skad/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin bzod pa bsgom dgos/ sngon bla ma zhang gis/sngar gyi dgra rnams kyi yul du phyin nas sgo yon blangs pas/ khong tsho yang khong khro zhi nas shin tu dad de khong 'di bzhin mdzad phyin chad 'o skol gyis kyang zhabs tog bya dgos zer/ sngon khyem bdag phyug po gcig gis bu ma sos pa la thengs gcig bu 502

gcig skyes pa la mo rtsis byas pas dge bshes bzang po zhig gi bu yin byas na sos par 'dug zer bas/ khos chung ma'i bu de khyer 'ong nas dge bshes glang thang ba'i drung du bzhag ste/ khyed rang gi bu de na yod do byas nas 'bros thabs su byas song bas/khong gis ci yang mi gsung bar bud med gzhan zhig la bcol nas gsos pas thams cad the tshom du gyur/ lo 'ga' song tsa na pha ma gnyis 'ong nas/ bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba chen po byas nas bu blangs skad/ des na 'o skol rnams la yang nyes pa med rung gzhan gyis dngos su grags pa ngan pa dang bkur ba btab kyang bzod pa bsgoms nas mi khro ba de lta bu re byed dgos/ sngon rwa sgreng du dge slong bzang po gcig ja brdung ba'i rtsa ru phyin pas/ sder ma bor ba'i khag ngan byung bas/ mkhan po la bdag la nyes pa med de gang drag zhus pas/ khas long la mang ja bskol dang da gzod gtsang sar yang thon par 'dug gis gsungs pas/ khong gis kyang de ltar byas pas de'i nub mo sdig pa mang po dag pa'i rtags byung / phyis gzhan nas sder ma rtsad chod de khong gtsang sar yang thon pas mkhan po la mos su song / de ltar byas pa la dga' ba skyes skad/ des na rang la nyes pa med bzhin du khag ngan 'dra byung yang mi khro bar sngon gyi 503

las su bsams nas rang gi nyes par khas blangs nas bzod sran bskyed na sdig sgrib kyang mang po 'dag pas/ de ltar bya dgos/ glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas nga'i blo 'byongs ma 'byongs/khams su ston pa sher 'bum can du phyin na shes/ khong snying dang 'dra ba'i mched grogs yin pas/ nga byung ba la rab tu dga' nas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa yod du re ba la/ de ltar mi byed par ma zad slar brdung rdeg byas/ ci yod 'phrogs kyang nga la khong khro mi skye zhing / sngar gyi brtse ba de mi 'gyur na 'byongs pa yin gsungs/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sngar phan btags nas re ba chen po byas yod pa 'ga' shaṃg gis tshur drin gzo mi byed pa'i khar brdung rdeg 'phrog bcom mi 'dod pa ci byas rung zhe sdang mi skye ba tsam du ma zad/ sngar gyi brtse sems kyang mi 'gyur ba de 'dra byung na bzod pa bsgom pas blo 'byongs pa yin pas de 'dra zhig bya dgos/ sngon rgyas ston gyis byis pa'i dus su gzhan gyi rta dkrogs pas 'drogs nas brag la mchongs nas shi ba/ pha mas brdungs pas ma'i ngar gdong la rdo brgyab/ der khyim du 'ong du ma bcug pas/ khos sgo nas kha ma bzod par 'o na khyed rang gi yon bdag rdo rje dbang phyug gis 'bri rkus nas gsod pa zer nas 'o dod bos pas/504

gzhan gyis go nas rta skyin 'bri skyin gnyis ka ster dgos byung /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang kha 'di la bzod glag med pas/ gzhan sdom med/ mi bsad pa/ rkun ma byas pa dbang po skyon can sogs kyi skyon rnams khrom sogs su bsgrags na tshe 'dir yang rang gzhan gnyis gar chag sgo 'ong zhing / mi de la dug blud mtshon brgyab nas ma bsad rung / kho bsad pa bas kyang sdig pa che bar gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su/ dge slong rgan pa gcig gzhon pa la khros te tshig ngan smras nas shi bas/ sbrul gdug pa can zhig tu skyes/ sngon dgra bcom pa zhig dang dge tshul gnyis klu yul du song bas klus dgra bcom pa la lha'i bdud rtsi drangs/ dge tshul gyis mi 'ju snyam zas rang ka gzhan byen pas kho khong khro skyes/ bdag gis tshangs par spyad pa'i dge bas klu 'di rnams brlag pa'i klu zhig tu skye bar shog byas pas lus ma bor bzhin du yan lag bzhi nas chu 'dzags nas klu zhig tu gyur nas klu gzhan klad pa'i nad kyis btab par gyur/ sngon dge slong ko ka lika shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis la khros nas mi tshangs spyod kyi bsgur pa btab pas kha nas khrag skyugs nas shi bas/dmyal bar skyes nas lce thog tu lcags kyi thong bshol lnga brgya btsugs nas rmos/ sngon bram ze'i 505

khye'u ne tso sangs rgyas kyi gsung zhig byon pa blo la ma babs par khros nas 'ong ba sangs rgyas kyis rgyang nas gzigs te 'khor rnams la/ khye'u ne tso da lta tshe dus byas na ni lus dang bral nas shi ma khad du mda' 'phangs pa bzhin sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di nga la rab tu khros pa'i phyir ro gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la dge slong khab len dang / span can zhes bya ba gnyis kyis kha na ma tho ba skra'i rtse mo tsam gyes ma gos pa byas tshul khrims bsrung yang / 'chi khar dgra bcom pa zhig la zhe sdang skyes pas dmyal ba mnar med du song / des na zhe sdang skyes na tshul khrims bsrung yang mi phan dge rtsa thams cad bcoms nas ngan song du ltung / sngon dbus kyi lha btsun po rnyi ra dzas jo bo la khong khros sdig pa bsags pas/ tshe 'di nyid la rnam smin gyi sngon bsus slebs nas mje byung / des na yul khyad par can la zhe sdang skyes na tshe 'dir yang nad ngan pa 'byung / des na bzod pa zhig med na khong khro lta bu'i sdig pa med/ dmyal bar skyur ba la khong khro skad cig ma cig skyes pas chog de la dgongs nas slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa 'dra ba'i dka' thub med/ de phyir bzod la nan tan 506

du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis goms par bya/ /gsungs/ des na zhes sdang skyes pa'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas kyang bzod pa sgom pa la nan tan bya dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chu bo nai rañdza na'i 'gram du byon te/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs nas bsam gtan mkha' khyab la mnyam par bzhag ste/ lus sems tshar bcad cing gzir ro/ /de'i tshe kha dang sna dang rna ba'i rlung nang du 'gags pas/ mgo bo thod pa la mdung rtul bos btab pa bzhin du gyur to/ /zas ni rgya shug gi 'bru gu tsam dang / 'bras kyi 'bru gu tsam dang /til gyi 'bru gu tsam dang / chu'i thigs pa tsam dang / zas mi za bar gnas pas sku shin tu rid cing nyams chung bar gyur to/ /de ltar lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar ring por ma lon par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos 'khor bskor ba yin la/ yang sngon grub chen te lo'i drung du paṇa chen na ro pas chos phyir dka' chen bcu gnyis dka' phran bcu gnyis yang phran bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyad/ de bzhin du rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu phal cher gyis de bzhin chos phyir dka' ba spyad pas mthar grub pa thob pa sha stag byung / sngon slob dpon bai ro tsa na/ lho brag mar pa sogs lo tsa rnams kyis kyang rgya gar du 507

chos phyir byon nas dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad nas dam pa'i chos kyis bod khams dkar por btang / sngon dbus phyogs kyi bza' mi gnyis kyis lo gcig tsam la tsha ba 'thung nas zas cher ma zos pa byas khyim gyi so nam la rem pas de nas bzung nor gyi gzhi chags phyis phyug por gyur nas g.yu gcig bu la yang dkar chen 'od 'phro bya ba sogs bstar brgyus pa mdung gang tsam yod skad/ des na tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum sgrub pa la yang thog mar dka' ba spyod dgos na/ tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la thog mar dka' ba zhig ma spyad pas ga la 'ong / spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis rang la gros gtam gyi tshul du smras pa/skyid 'dod thog mar sdug khur dgos/ /ngu re bro ba ma byas par/ /rgod re bro ba'i zas mi myong / /gsungs pa dang / pha dam pas ding ri ba rnams la/ snying rus med pa'i mi la sangs rgyas dkon/ /dka' ba dang du longs shig ding ri ba/ /gsungs/des na dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig byed na skyid bo thams cad bzhag nas/ bsam bzhin du sdug bsngal dang du blangs nas bzod sran bskyed dgos/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras pas brag dkar rta so na chos phyir dka' ba spyod dus/ dka' thub kyis 508

gdungs pas lus rid mig gting du lhung ba/ rus ba thams cad sgang du thon pa mdog sngo la sha rid pa/ sha rus bral du cha ba'i lpags pa la spu sngo zing nge ba skyes pa/ skra yegs la 'jigs pa yan lag rnams 'chag la khad pa de sring mos mthong nas thog mar 'dre yin nam snyam 'jigs pa byung / de nas ming po yin par shes te nang du 'ong 'jus nas a jo a jo zer ba'i ngang nas yug gcig dran med du 'gro ba byung / de dus khong gis zhal nas kyang nga'i lus la bltas na keng rus 'dra/ /sdang dgras mthong yang mchi ma 'chor/ /sems la bltas na sangs rgyas dngos/ /rgyal pas gzigs kyang spro ba skye/ /gsungs/ des na chos kyi phyir de bzhin du dka' sbyad dang du len dgos te/khong gis slob ma yon bdag rnams la/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa la/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod/ de la 'jug cing bskul ba la/ /bka' drin dpag tu med pa yod/ /sogs gsungs/ sngon grub thob thar pa'i rgyal mtshan gyes kyang / dben par dka' thub yun ring spyad pas nyin gcig bser ma'i rnam pas thugs dran med du 'gyel khar ja dang rtsam pa legs po zhig za 'thung byed rgyu byung na skyon mi 'ong snyam pa'i ngang la thugs dran med du 'gyel nas yun ring song / de nas slar dran 509

pa rnyed tshe bltas pas sngar gyi 'dod pa nang ltar thab la ja legs po zhig bskol/ rtsam pa zhig kyang bzhag pa mthong bas/da nga shi ba yin 'di bar do'i snang ba yin/ 'di 'dra sus 'jog don med nga 'khrul ba yin snyam/ mnyam gzhag la bzhag nas yang bltas tshe yod pa mthong nas/ da bar do'i 'khrul snang yin nam mngon sum gang yin rung lan zhig blta snyam bzhengs nas bltas tshe mngon sum yin tshe gsol/ de ni yul de'i mi ma yin dkar phyogs pa zhig gis shes nas bskyal ba yin skad/ de nas bzung snying nas chos bzhin byas na lha 'dre mi gsum gang gis kyang 'o rgyal du mi 'jig gi snyam pa skyes skad/ rje rgod tshang pas kyang chos kyi phyir 'chi tshad pa bco brgyad tsam myang gzhan dka' ba chung chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyad/ rmog cog pas kyang lo bcu gnyis su zas la dka' thub mdzad/ spyan snga bas kyang tshe stod sdug khur la mi tshe bskyal/ sham thabs la klan rgyu ma 'byor bar kom po klan pas spyan snga ko sham can du grags/ de bzhin du rje rang rig ras pas tsa ri sogs su dka' thub mdzad dus lan gsum tsam shi nas slar sos dbugs chad la khad pa dang 'gyel rab mang po zhig byung snang / 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du chos phyir ci nus kyis bzod sran bskyed 510

par bya'o/ / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du rtswa yi gdan la zhabs skyil krung byas nas/ deng 'dir bdag gi lus 'di bskams kyang rung / /pags pa rus pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob bar/ /stan 'di las ni bskyod par mi bya'o/ /zhes dam bcas nas thugs g.yo ba med par ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas byang chub mngon du byas so/ /rje mi las dang po sgrub pa mdzad dus 'bol stan bshams nas da res nyams rtogs khyad par can zhig ma skyes bar du tshe 'di'i don du lus kyi mgul ba skyod tsam yang mi byed par sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i dam bca' drag po mdzad nas bsgoms pas myur du grub pa thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas kyis dge slong nad pa zhig gi gos mi gtsang bas sbags pa 'khru bar brtsams pas/ kun dga' bos bdag gis 'khru zhes blangs nas bkrus sangs rgyas kyis chu blug ste gtsang bar byas/lhung bzed zhal zas lhag ma gnang bas nad sos pas/ dge slong des kyang bdag gi rim 'gro bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad 511

na/ bdag le lor gnas pa ni legs pa ma yin no snyam nas/brtson 'grus brtsams pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob/sngon khyem bdag dpal skyes zhes bya ba lo brgya lon pa zhig yod pa/ bu dang chung ma sogs khyim mi thams cad skyo zhing sdang bas/rab tu byung ba'i yon tan thos nas rab tu byung bas gzhan rab tu byung ba'i dge slong gzhon nu dag gis 'tshe ba byas pa la skyo nas dben par brtson 'grus chen pos chos yid la byas pas nyon mongs pa'i zag pa thams cad zad de/ dgra bcom par gyur nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phags te 'od ma'i tshal du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song bas dge slong gzhon nu kun gyi bla mar gyur/ sngon kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis kyis brtson 'grus chen pos chos la nan tan byas pas dgra bcom go 'phang mngon du byas nas dzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs pa dge slong rgan pa rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/bdag cag le lo byas pa'i lhung bzed du zas zos so lhung zhing mgo dkar por gyur kyang sems rtse gcig pa yang ma thob na/'di gnyis po lo bdun la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon du byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtson 'grus kyis byang chub thob par gsungs 512

pa ni legs par gsungs pa'o zhes smras so/ /sngon kun dga' bos sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas lo nyi shu tsam byas/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas yul rgyu zhing 'bri dzi'i lngongs su byon pas/'bri rdzi spong byed kyi bu rab tu byung ste chos bstan pas/ des kyang brtson 'grus kyis chos nyams su blangs pas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob nas des mkhan po la smras pa/ mkhan po khyod kyang bag med ma mdzad par/ /shing drung 'thib pa bsten na mya ngan 'da'/ /thugs la bzhag ste bsam gtan mdzod cig dang / /ring por mi thogs zhi ba'i gnas thob 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / kun dga' bos kyang brtson 'grus bskyed de/ mnyam par bzhag pas mtshan mo gung gi thun la dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob nas 'phur nas rgyal po'i khab tu byon te/ mdo sde mtha' dag gi bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis ri bo bya rkang du rje btsun byams pa lo 'ga' bsgrubs pas ma 'grub pa yun bsrings nas lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs pas 'grub ste zhal gzigs dga' ldan du khrid nas chos bstan slar mi yul du byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rgyas par mdzad/ sngon khye'u sbyin pa chen po klu yul du byon nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu blangs nas 513

dgos 'dod kyi char ba phab/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kun bsal nas dge ba bcu'i chos la bkod pa ltar/ 'o skol yang sems can gyi don du go cha che ba/ snying stobs dang ldan pa de lta bu zhig dgos/ sngon ma gcig zha ma'i g.yog mos skye bo kun rta rgyug byed pa la bltas pas rta thog nas langs nas rgyug pa mthong ya mtshan snyam nas/ dgong mo ma gcig la de ring ltad mo gda'/ langs nas rta rgyug pa la chags shing gda' byas pas/ngas de 'dra min pa stan thog tu chags gsungs/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ ltogs 'khyags 'dzom bo'i spyil bo ru/ /sdug khur tshugs pa'i snying rus can/ /stan la chags pa'i skya rtsal can/ /gsungs/ sngon rje btsun mi las/ yun ring bsgoms pas 'phong yang chen pa'i dra bar song ba de/ dwags po lha rje la bstan nas/ man ngag la bsgom pa las zab pa med/ ngas kyang 'phong 'di bzhin song song gi bar du bsgoms pas yon tan rgyud la skyes pa yin/ khyod kyang snying rus bskyed la bsgoms shig gsungs/ lha rje de nyid kyi thugs la 'jags pa byung gsungs/des na yun thung thung gis 'khrul ba mi chod pas snying rus dang sdug sran bskyed yun bsrangs nas bsgom dgos/ sngon mi shig khyi shig gnyis kyis mi'i spyi bor su mgyogs byas te sngon la 514

slebs pa des za byas te mi shig gis mi slebs snyam rgyab nas ngal ma gsos par ga le byas song / khyi shig gis nga mgyogs snyam mdun nas ngal gso kyin bsdad pas/ sngon la mi shig gis spyi bor slebs nas zos skad/ de bzhin du chos nyams su len pa la yang / dbyar dgun ston dbyed med par dge sbyor nur re rgyun ma chad par byas na mod la don 'grub nas 'ong / dge sbyor 'phel sgang la 'phro bcad kyin gang dgar 'khyams shing bsdad pas mi 'ong / des na rang re lto rgyab la gyong bskur nas dug pa chom ber re 'go nas lto ngan ngon gang byung tsam re la bsten nas sems la brtan pa ma thob bar du sgrub pa byed 'phro mi gcod par rgyun chad med par 'bad dgos/ byang ba la dgra jag byung tshe sos glod nas bza' rgyu za/ brgyags phye thag rta brtod cing sngon la grabs su 'dzud/ de nas dang po rta ga le 'gro de nas je mgyogs la dgra mig gis mthong nas phar breng gis brgyugs/ 'khrugs nas nor 'phrogs nas 'ong la/ nor ma phral gyi bar du phyir mi ldog pa yin skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol chos nyams su len pas/ dang po thos bsam la gzhi blangs la/dka' thub mi drag pa byas la/ de nas rang blo mal du chud pa dang dka' thub je drag la btang la chos kyi 'dod pa ma grub 515

bar du blo phyir mi ldog par sgrub pa la nan tan byed pa zhig dgos/ de ltar byas na yun ring mi thogs par dngos grub thob nas 'ong / sngon khyi rkun gcig gis 'khur ba zhig thob pas chu 'gram du phyin te mig phar cer tshur cer yod tsa na kho rang gi gzugs brnyan chu nang du shar ba ye re mthong bas/ kho'i snying la khye gzhan zhig gis 'khur ba thogs 'dug snyam 'phrog par 'dod nas chu nang du nyab pas/ kho'i 'khur ba chu nang du shor song / de bzhin kha cig gis sngar gyi bla ma'i man ngag bsgom 'phro bcad kyin de bas gdams ngag zab mo zhig gzhan na yod snyam 'tshol du song nas sngar gyi yon tan bag tsam skye ba de yang stor gtong ba mang de 'dra byas na mi yong / rang gi bla mas gnang ba'i gdams ngag kho na la gcig dril bya dgos/ rje mi las kyang gdams ngag zab pa min snying rus zab pa yin pas snying rus gal che/ sngon mi rkang pa na ba gcig na re/ nga bsam yas su blta ru 'gro zer bas gcig gis khyod rkang pa na bas cang to le byas pas/ kho na re nga rkang pa chad kyang rgya 'gres byas nas kyang 'gro zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang shi ma shi med par chos phyogs la 'bad snyam pas blo de lta bu re bskyed nas chos la brtson dgos/ sngon mi so can so med gnyis la gzhan 516

gcig gis sha lhu gcig spyi la drangs pas/ gcig gis khyod la so med pas cang phed de byas pas/ gcig na re so med rung snyil gyis 'brad zer/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad blos mi chun rung ci nus kyis chos la brtson zhing chos nam yang blos mi gtong ba zhig dgos/ lho bal nas rgya gar phan chad kyi mi de 'o cag pas snying rus che bas/ khong la 'dod pa'i don zas nor lta bu gcig yod pas/ de ma grub bar du sar te btsugs nas cog ge sdod de/ gzhug shi nus pa yin skad/de bzhin du 'o skol yang lto rgyab la gyong bskur nas dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par dam pa'i chos nyams su len nus pa zhig dgos/ sngon bu mo gcig bag mar btang ba zhag 'ga' lon pa dang ma can du yong nas/ a ma nga ni da lta nas skyo na zer/ de bzhin du 'o cag kyang chos sgor zhugs ma thag nas chos kyis bsun nas byas na ma byas na snyam/ mno bsam gang min tshad gtong ba des mi 'ong skyo ngal dang bsun pa med par chos byed pa la brtson dgos/ sngon bsam yas su rgyal ba byang chub kyis rma rin chen mchog la bgro gleng byas pas pham pas/ rgya gar du chos nyan du 'gro zer/ rdo'i mchod rten na yar bang rgyug pa ltar/ 'o cag kyang brtson 'grus tsab tsub dang / mig ri zang 517

zing byas cung zad re bsdoms nas/ de nas bor 'jog pa'i brtson 'grus de 'dras mi 'ong / sngon so mo grub ba'i yul du dag pa byung bas/ thams cad 'ur rgyug pas gcig gi mgo sgo yi ya them la brgyab nas chag gcig gis mda' gzhu blangs nas rgyug pas sgo la thogs nas gzhu chag gzhan yang gzhu btab tu brdung nas chag pa gcig gnyis tsam byung / de nas pha tshad du phyin pas gnod ma 'khrol bar yul du log byung skad/ de bzhin du gnad du mi 'gro ba'i brtson 'grus tab tab po de le lo'i rgyu yin de 'dras mi yong / sngon 'ban bsgom po to ba'i spyan sngar phyin pas/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'ban bsgom khyod kyang bong bu mgo lcags brims pa gcig 'dug go gsungs/ de ji ltar lags byas pas/ rna ba bye ba ras bong bu la mgo lcag brims pas/ mgo 'khor nas nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas su song ngo / /de bzhin du khyod kyang dge sbyor rang dga' rab btub tsa na tsab tsub byed de chos kyi pam stong du ma gzhug cig bong bu'i mgor o long ma brgyab par ga le thongs shig lam log par 'ong ngo gsungs pas/ yid la tig gis song nas nangs par snga mor dge bshes kyi drung du byung nas/ dge bshes mdang gi bong chos ang de zer nas/ dge bshes phyag 'khar dengs dengs 518

gda' skad/ de bas na thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la brtson 'grus dar re drag po byas pas mi 'ong / khong glod zhe chen po mnan nas byed dgos/ de yang gcig la byas pas mi 'ong /dge ba la sgo kun nas 'jug par bya/ de ltar byas pas gcig gi bar chad gcig gis sel/ gcig grogs su gcig song nas dge sbyor la bogs thon po yong / mdor na le lo stoms las kun spangs la brtson 'grus yu na ring la shugs che ba bar ma chad du byas na/ lung rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing gang brtsams las kyi mtha' rnams yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon rgya gar du dge slong gcig gis mchod khang gcig na thang sku mang po bkram 'dug pa la phyag g.yas nas bzung rim gyis bltas pas/ de na gshin rje gshed kyi thang sgu gcig 'dug pa mthong bas/ de nyid la skye ba snga ma'i yi dam gye lha yin par dran nas/ de ka la nags gseb du phyin nas sgrub pa'i dngos grub mod la thob skad/ yang de na dge tshul gcig gis mkhan slob la zhus pa'i po ti gcig rgyun du klog gin yod pa la/ dus gcig gi tshe nags gseb nas rnal 'byor pa gcig byon nas/ khyod kyi skye ba snga ma'i 519

las 'phro dang bsgom 'phro de ma yin/ 'di yin no zhes rna bar shub pa gcig byas pas/ dge tshul des sngar gyi skye ba dran nas/po to'i sku chings kyang ma bsdams par 'jig rten gyi rdog pa thams cad rgyun bcad nas/ nags su phyin nas bsgoms pas thar pa tshegs med du thob skad/ yang sngon rgyal blon mang po zhig 'dun ma byed cing yod tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa gcig byon nas/rgyal po la khyod kyi skye ba sngon ma'i las 'phro ni 'di yin zhes las 'phro'i chos de mtshan rna bar shib pa gcig byas pas/ rgyal po de nyid kyis skye ba dran nas de ka ltar nags gseb tu bsgom du gshegs pas dngos grub tshegs med du thob skad/ des na skye ba dran pa la sogs pa'i mngon shes 'char ba'i rgyu ni zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin yin/ mnyam med dwags po lha rjes dang po bsam gtan la bzhugs pa'i dus ting nge 'dzin gyi zas kyis 'tsho nas zhag lnga drug tsam re 'tsho ba ma gsol yang bkres pa mi mnga' zhing sku lus bde ba'i nyams dang ldan chags sdang rags pa nub/ sku lus kyi srin 'bu thams cad zad/ mnal lam du mdo sde gser 'od nas bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i snga ltas rnams ji lta ba bzhin du byung / rje mi la'i drung du mjal dus mi la'i zhal nas/ dbu rur sdod dus bka' gdams nyan/ /gnas 520

pa bzang po'i ting 'dzin mnga'/ /la sogs thugs dgyes pa'i mgur gsungs/ rje btsun gyis phyugs rdzi lo bcu drug lon pa zhig la khyod rang gi mdun gyi rna rtse'i thad tsam du ston pa sangs rgyas sku 'di lta bu zhig sgoms shig gsungs/ zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa zhig phog nas btang ngo / /nang du ma log par zhag bdun so nga bas mi mang pos btsal tshe rdza khung zhig nas lus drang pod bsrangs nas mig hu re 'dug ci byed pa yin dris pas nga bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgom pa yin zer/ zhag bdun song log mi yong ba ci yin byas pas kho na re/ nga yud tsam min pa ma bsdad rdzun yin nyi ma la blta zer bltas pas/ bsgom la 'jog dus las snga ba 'di ci yin nam zer/ de nas bzung zhag lnga drug stor nas yang yang 'tshol dgos byung ba skyo nas pha mas rje btsun mi la'i drung du bskyal bas dbang gdams pa gnang nas bsgoms pas thugs kyi sras ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs zhes bya bar grags so/ /a mdo phyogs kyi byang pa bsgom chen bya ba dbus phyogs su byon dbang lung khrid gsum thob nas phyir byon ri khrod du ting nge 'dzin gcig gi ngang la sku g.yo ba med par zla re zla phyed re bzhugs pa phyis gzhan yon bdag dad can sogs kyis yun ring mi bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/521

zhag bdun lnga gsum re tsam las mi bzhugs skad/ des na ting nge 'dzin bsgom na tshe 'dir yang mthong chos myong 'gyur du'ang lus sems la bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de la bsten nas stong nyid bskyed rdzogs sogs lam gzhan bsgom na sa chod chen po byung myur du sangs rgya ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod/ sngon yul rgya gar gyi rgyal po mnga' 'og na rgyal phran khri phrag cig yod pa la/ sras khye'u gaṅga ma zhes bya ba zhig yod pa rgyal srid kyi nyes dmigs la 'jigs nas bros te nags khrod cig tu song ba gzhan rgyal bu kun tu dge zhes bya ba zhig 'bod du song nas tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ khyim bzang dpal dang 'dra ba bor nas ni/ /nags khrod shin tu dben pa'i gnas bsten pa/ /bdud kyis bslus sam yang na spyos par nges/ /shin tu 'khrul bas bdag la tshur gson dang / /rgyal po'i srid bzung chos kyang khyem nas spyod/ /byas pas/ khye'u gaṅga mas smas pas/ khyod kyis gsungs pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /byams nas gsungs pa yin mod kyang / /bdag gi don dang shin tu 'gal/ /nags khrod dben pa'i gnas mthong na/ /'khor mang rgyal po'i pho brang dag /grog tshang hrul po dag dang mtshungs/ /byas pas/ yang rgyal bus smras pa/ rgyal srid 'dzin par mi byed kyang / /khyim du sdod la chos 522

gyis shig /byas pas/ khye'us smras pa/ khyem gyi so nam bya ba la/ /snga ma byas pas nyon mongs nas/ /phyi ma byed pa'i sha thang chad/ /khyim ni sbrul gye tshang dang 'dra/ /byas pas/ rgyal bus smras pa/'khor 'dab bsten la bde bar mnos/ /nor rdzas bzung la sbyin pa thongs/ /byas pas/ /khye'us smras pa/ gser gyi ri la g.yu yi khron rdol yang / /nor gyi 'os su rang sems chog shes bzang / /dpal gyi ri la srid kyi chu 'grub yang / /sems kyi bsten sa bla ma dkon mchog bzang / /byas pas/ yang smras pa/'khor ba mi rtag sgyu ma'i chos 'di la/ /blun po chags shing mkhas pas smod pa'i gnas/ /des na bdag kyang dben pa bsten pa lags/ /rgyal bu nyid kyang dben pa bsten na legs/ /zhes smras pas rgyal bu kun tu dges kyang rgyal srid blos btang nas gnyis ka nags khrod der bzhugs nas byang chub bsgrubs so/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang 'dod yon 'du 'dzi'i nyes dmigs dang dben pa'i yon tan bsams nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i thog mar 'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams spangs nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas bsten dgos/ sngon dge slong ma sbom dga' mo zhes bya ba'i dgra bcom gcig na re/ nga bsgom bsgoms nas gzhan ci yang byed du ma khoms gsungs/523

'phags mas ci bsgom lags byas pas/ ngas 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / dgra bo'i rnam par rtog pa dang / gnod sems kyi rnam par rto ga pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / nye du'i rnam par rtog pa dang / mi 'chi ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / khyad du gsod pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang /khyem gyi rnam par rtog pa rnams bsgoms bsgoms nas gzhan byed pa ma khoms gsungs nas gzhan la brda' mdzad pa yin skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyang rnam par rtog pa de dag gi dbang du song na zhi gnas kyi bsgom sogs chos sgrub pa la mi khoms pas/ bsam gtan bsgom pa'i thog mar rnam rtog thams cad spang dgos/ de nas gnas dben par bsam gtan nam ting nge 'dzin nam zhi gnas de ji ltar bsgom snyam na/ po to ba'i gsung sgos las/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ lus sems cham la phab la/ phyi bltas kyi dmigs pa sku 'am bum pa la sogs pa la dmigs pa gtad/ nang bltas kyi dmigs pa lha bsgom pa 'am/ rtsa rlung keng rus la sogs pa la sems gtad cing / byeng rgod du ma song bar dmigs pa de nyid la ma yengs par byas nas bsgom pas/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med 524

pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams rim gyis skye zhing nyams su pyong la/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam stegs dang / bste gnas tsam yin/ de la bsten nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas lhag mthong mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye gsung ba ltar phyi bltas nang bltas kyi dmigs bsten gang rung zhig la bsten nas zhi gnas sgrub kyang legs mod/ 'on kyang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/'khor rnams la dge slong dag dgon pa dang shing drung dang /sa phug la sogs pa na 'jigs shing spu zing nge byed na'ang nga rjes su dran par gyis shig dang / 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas rjes su dran na 'jigs pa kun las grol zhing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas yid la dran pa tsam gyes bskal pa grangs med pa'i sdig pa 'dag cing / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa dang / zhi gnas kyi lam rgyud la bde blag tu skye zhing / gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi snod rung du 'gyur ba dang 'chi khar dran pa mi nyams shing sangs rgyas kyi snang ba mi 'bral/ tshe 'phos nas kyang sangs rgyas kyis lam sna drangs te 'og min dga' ldan bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas 525

kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa bgrod cing / skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du ston pa thugs rje can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas ma nor ba'i lam bstan te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas/ des na 'dir zhi gnas dmigs rten gyi gtso bo thub dbang gi sku gzugs la byas te zhi gnas sgrub par bya'o/ /sngon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ lho brag mar pa'i drung du gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan bla ma'i bka' bzhin lho brag stag gnya'i brag la bsgoms pa'i dus mchod kong mar khus bkang ba mar me sbar nas spyi bor bzhag ste/ mar me ma rdzogs bar du lus mi 'gul bar nyin mtshan thog thag 'da' bar byas te zla ba bcu gcig stan gyi drod ma yal bar bsgoms nas/mar pa'i sku mdun du byon te rtog 'bul byas pa la/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe rnam rtog rgyun chad nas sems rtog med du lhan song ste/ lo dang zla ba zhag la sogs pa ci tsam song yang rang gis mi shes par gzhan gyis tshod 'dzin dgos par byung na zhi gnas skyes pa yin snyam lags zhus pas thugs dgyes pa byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang mtshan bcas sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / mtshan 526

med rang gi sems la dmigs nas zhi gnas lo zla ba byas sgrub ste nam mnyam par bzhag kyang rnam rtog rgyun chad nas rtog med du lhan gyes song g.yo 'khrug med par ri bo bzhin brtan la/ btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa kun la 'jug cing lus sems las su mi rung ba'i gnas ngan len gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag dag nas lus yang zhing bde la sems gsal zhing dga' ba'i nyams sogs lus sems las su rung bas shin sbyangs kyi bde ba rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la nam 'dod 'dod du gnas pa byung na zhi gnas skyes pa yin/ skyes 'dug snyam nas mi 'jog par da dung bsgom na spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan ci rigs dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la 'byung bas de lta bu'i rtags khyad par can ma byung gi bar du 'bad par bya'o/ /sngon jo bo khu 'od seng rgyal bya bas dge bshes ston pa la rtog pa phul ba/dngos grub dngos grub skad pa de nyon mongs pa mtha' dag je chung je chung la song ba zhig lags snyam zhus pas/ dge bshes thugs mnyes te/ jo bo khu 'od seng rgyal gyi de yin gsungs skad/des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / ting nge 'dzin bskyangs pas nang gi nyon mongs pa thams cad je chung je chung la song phyi 527

rol gyi dngos po thams cad la chags zhen je chung je chung la song na de ka la dngos grub kyang zer bas/ de 'dra gcig 'ong dgos/ sngon byang pa mo gcig gis/ sngar zhing 'debs ma myong bas phyis bod du zhing chung zhig la sa bon btab pas/ ston ka ston thog gnyis 'gyur gyis byung tshe/ mo rang gis sngar bas nas mang po byung snyam dga' ba byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis sngar ting nge 'dzin bsgom ma myong bas bsgom pa'i tshe/ lus la bde ba sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sogs skyes nas sngar bas bzang gi ang snyam pas dga' ba zhig 'ong dgos/ byung yang nga rgyal dang rlom sems med par byas te/ da dung yang 'bad de bsgom par bya/ sngon dbus kyi sna dmar dgon pa na/ bsgom chen bzang du re ba kha cig yod pa la/ chang ngar bsgom pa bya ba na re/ 'u cag sa tshod gang tsam yin zer ba la/ sgom ser bya ba na re/ 'u cag la sa thob pa'i rtags gang yang med zer/ dge bshes mtha' bzhi'i slob ma na re/ 'u cag sa tshod 'jig rten pa yin zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin sogs bsgom blo byas kyang sa lam gyis drod rtags gang yang med cing / sa tshod 'jig rten pa las ma 'phags par/ khyad med pa byung na gnad du ma song ba yin pas/528

bsgoms pas rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags sgo gsum la 'char ba zhig bya dgos/ sngon rwa sgreng na khams pa'i sgom pa ye shes bya ba sems gnas pa bzang po yod pas/ dge bshes spyan snga pa dang gnyis la/ 'bar ba rnam gnyis zer nas/ kun gyis yid smon byed pa de/ phyis khams su song nas nyon mongs pa cher 'bar nas gzhan la mthu byed pa zhig byung / yang sngon stod lung pa'i sgom tshan pa zhig la dgong mo chu zangs bum gang spyi bor bzhag nas bsgom pas nangs par tshun chad de mi g.yo bar gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin brtan po yod kyang / des kyang mtshams khong nas 'dun ma ngan pa byas/ phyis sde 'khrug byed pa'i dpon po zhig byung / sngon lhag spyod kyis ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas brtan pa thob kyang / phyis nyon mongs pa cher 'bar mi dge ba'i las tshan po che mang po bsags nas dmyal bar skye ba byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin sogs bsgom gang byas kyang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por ma song bar grogs su song na mi 'ong bas/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba zhig bya dgos/ sngon phyug po'i byes pas mar zan za ba/ mi ltogs kyi bu tshas mthong ste a ma la nga yang mar zan 'dod byas pas/ ma na re/ 'u bu la mar med pas mar zan sbyin rgyu ga na yod/ khong 529

phyug po la 'gran pas ci la phan byas pas/ byes pas ci yang mi zer skad/ de bzhin du rang re yang dmigs pa sna gcig la zhag gcig stan thog tu bsdad nas bsgom ma myong zhing rgyud la yon tan gang yang med par gzhan thos bsam bsgom gsum dka' thub mang po byas pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun gyi bde skyid snyan gsum lta bu 'dod kyang ga nas 'ong / tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum 'dod kyang sngon la tshe 'di la ma bltas par sdug khur byas dben par bsam gtan skyong nus na tshe 'di'i bde skyid mi 'dod kyang shugs kyi 'ong / sngon mi gcig gis yur ba gcig na nya chen po gcig shi la khad 'dug pa blangs nas/ rdzing bu nye 'us gang ba gcig gi nang du bzhag pas/ nya des nye'u chung ba kun rub kyis zos pas slar sdig par song / yang gcig gis chu bo chen po gcig la zam pa gnyis gsum btsugs pas/ gru pa mang po ltogs rir shi skad/ des na gzhan phan gyi bsam pas sems can gyi don byas rung nor nyen che bas rang rgyud la mngon shes ma shar bar du/ chos ltar bcos pa'i tsab tsub thams cad re zhig bar du bzhag nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te dben par bsam gtan skyong ba la 'bad dgos/ sngon dge bshes ston pa bzhugs pa'i 530

dus/ rwa sgreng gi gling gseb der/ 'chal ba dang dam nyams la sogs pa mi gtong / nga'i bsgom chen sgrub pa rnal mar byed pa la nyams grib 'ong gsungs nas bsrung skad/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin sogs bsgom byed dus su spyir grib la 'dzems na bzang khyad par dbo/ra grib 'di la 'dzem dgos/ dkor grib 'di gzhan las 'jigs te spyan snga bas/dkor gyis tshos pas 'phral du je blun song / bong bu mngon sum 'ong ngo shākya'i sras/ /gsungs pa dang / rje mi las slob ma la/dkor gnyan po srog gi spu gri de/ /mang drags na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /gsungs/ des na dkor grib sogs grib thams cad kyis ma gos par nyams rtogs gcig skye bar 'dod na dben pa bsten dgos te/ 'chad kha ba'i zhal nas/ dka' thub kyi ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas nus pa zhig byung na da gzod phas bu gsos pa bya ba yin sungs/ des na chos spyi dang khyad par zhi gnas bsgom par 'dod pas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang ste/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gcig bur drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas pa zhig byung na ring por mi thogs par ting nge 'dzin mchog thob par sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis yang yang gsungs pas 531

na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshe thung nam 'chi cha med 'dod yon dug chu'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams te dben pa'i gnas su ting nge 'dzin la sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myong ba la nyin mtshan med par brtson par rigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sngon sangs rgyas sna tshogs me tog ces bya ba 'khor nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang bcas pa la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mu khyud kyis lo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du gnas khang yo byad na bza' zhal zas sogs kyis bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas pas/ nyin gcig gi tshe rgyal po'i bu stong gi nang nas/ khye'u chos dang chos bzang gnyis kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa la/ rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin gyis yun ring po ji srid du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di lta bu bskyed pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan mchis sam zhus pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sna tshogs kyi zhal nas/ rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin 'dis bsod nams kyi sbyin pa gtong ba gang yin pa de bas ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig dgon pa'am dben pa zhig na gnas shing se gol gtogs pa tsam zhig chos thams cad ma skyes pa'o/ /532

zhes bzod pa thob pa gang yin pa de bsod nams kyi phung po ches che bar rig par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin 'dis sbyin pa lta zhog stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can re res kyang rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin 'dis sbyin pa ji snyed pa de snyed cig sbyin par gyur pa de bas/byang chub sems dpa' dben par gnas pa lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas tshul bzhin rab tu brtson pa zhig gis/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / 'ong ba med pa dang 'gro ba med pa zhes bya bar se gol gtogs pa tsam zhig tu bzod cing gnas par gyur na snga ma de bas brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /de nas khye'u gnyis ngo mtshar nas rab tu byung / de'i rjes la rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis kyang de thos nas rab tu byung / des na dben par gnas nas zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la yud tsam re mnyam par bzhag na phan yon de lta bu yod na yun ring bsgoms na smos ci dgos/yang sngon dge slong dpal sbyin gyis tshong dpon gyi bu mo la 'dod pa spyad/ de'i khyo ga byed rgyu'i tshong dpon gzhan gyi bu zhig yod pa la'ang dug btang nas gsod du bcug phyis shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod nas/ bdag 'di las thar bar nus pa su la 533

yod dam snyam nas gtsug lag khang kun gyi sgor phyin nas sa la 'gyel te/ kye hud kye hud bdag ni dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro zhes smre sngags bton pas/ de'i tshe gang zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung du/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgol dang mjal te/ dge slong dag khyod ci'i phyir sa la 'gyel nas sdug bsngal bar gyur/ des smras pa/ bdag gis 'jigs su rung ba'i las 'khrig pa spyad mi yang bsad pas bdag nges par dmyal bar skyes par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgrol gyi zhal nas/ dge slong ma 'jigs dang ngas khyod kyi 'jigs pa med par bya gsungs/ nags 'thug po zhig tu khrid de byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs sgol nam mkha'i mthongs su yar 'phags nas/ chos rnams gsob ste stong zhing snying bo med/ /smig rgyu 'dra bzhin sprin dang mtshungs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dngos po med/ /chos rnams 'di dag rgyu dang rkyen las grub/ /rgyu dang rkyen rnams ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /rtsa ba mi dmigs gdod nas rab tu zhi/ /thog mtha' dbus med dben zhing snying po med/ /chos 'di thams cad gdod nas zhi ba ste/ /thams cad ma skyes rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /zhi zhing mi gnas mya ngan 'das par mthong / /de ltar shes pas chos rnams rnam 534

par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa de thos pa dang lha'i bu nyi khri nyis stong gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob/ dge slong dpal sbyin yang sdig pa dang sdug bsngal 'jigs skrag kun las rnam par grol te mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ 'jam dpal chos 'di dag ni sgrib pa med par ci tsam du 'dod pa la longs spyod la/ srog gis bar chad byas bzhin mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa la ltos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des khams gsum po de dag thams cad yang dag pa ma yin par shes shing / sems can mig yor dang 'dra bar shes pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal sgyu ma lta bu'i sems la gnas pa la ni/ chos gang yang sgrib pa med do/ /'jam dpal byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ni/ rang gi rtog pas sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ltung bar 'gyur te/ med pa'i chos rnams la log par bltas pas sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'o gsungs/ sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgras/ pha gzugs can snying po bsad/ ston pa la glang chen rbad/ dge 'dun pho mo'i 'tsho ba bcad/ dgra bcom ma ser skya ba la zang mo chung ma dbang med du bkur ba sogs/sdig pa'i las tshan po che byas pa la phyis shin tu gnong zhing 535

'gyod de 'chi tshad pa byung / 'jam dpal gyi drung du 'ong nas/sdig pa dang 'gyod pa sel par zhu zhus pas/ 'jam dpal gyes rgyal po la sdig pa dang 'gyod pa'i ngo bo ji ltar 'dug ltos shig sogs don dam pa la sbyar ba'i chos mang du gsungs so/ /rgyal pos kyang 'jam dpal gyi gsung bzhin sdig pa dang 'gyod pa'i ngo bo la/ shes rab kyi mig gis brtags shing dpyad nas bltas/de bzhin du chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la bltas pas/ gang yang ma mthong bas/ bdag tu 'du shes pas rnam par rtog pa kun dang bral nas stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ngang du lhan gyis song ba'i dus/ 'jam dpal 'khor bcas kyang ma mthong / ting nge 'dzin de las langs pas sngar ltar mthong ba byung / de nas rgyal po sdig pa dang 'gyod pa dang the tshom kun dang bral bar gyur/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed kyis/tshong dpon gyi bu mo dpal yon shin tu gzugs mdzes pa mthong nas/'dod chags kyi sems byung ba dang / skad cig ma de la chags pa'i chos de gang yin snyam du dran pa skyes/ 'di snyam du mig la chags sam zhen ma yin te/ g.yo ba med pa byed pa med pa sems med pa/ 'dus byas sha'i ril bu yin/ mig de rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir chags pa'i tshor ba med do/ /'o na rna 536

ba dang / sna dang lce dang mdog dang sha pags dang / rkang mthil yan chad klad rgya man chad kyi/ lus phyi nang rnams la so sor brtags pas/ de rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir/ chags pa'i chos gang yang ma dmigs so/ /de mi dmigs par mthong ba'i 'dod chags kyi sems de bsal te/ bu mo de'i lus kyi rkang pa nas spyi bo'i bar brtags pa de bzhin du/ gzhan snang grags kyi chos thams cad la brtags pas/ chos thams cad skye ba med par rtogs so/ /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa dang / steng gi bar snang la shing ta la gang tsam du 'phags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ga la ba der song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed bar snang la ngang ba'i rgyal po bzhin du 'ong ba gzigs so/ /de tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' po la bstan te/ kun dga' po byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed 'di ni 'dod chags kyi sems las chos thams cad yongs su rtogs so/ /bdud kyi sde btul lo/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro zhes gsungs so/ /des na zab mo stong pa nyid kyis mtshams med lnga'i las dang / rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom pa nyams pa yang dag par 'gyur/ 'dod chags kyi skyon gyis kyang mi gos/ sngon rnal 'byor pa gcig brag phug 'dre can zhig tu 537

nyal bas/ de na yod pa'i 'dre mo de byung nas mo rang gis gnod ma tshugs pas/ phyir log nas 'dre zla po mang po khrid nas byung ste sngon du rdo char zhig byas nas nang du byung ba dang / rnal 'byor pa stong pa nyid bsgom pas/ 'dre gzhan dag na re mi 'dug pa zer bas/ bdag mo de na re/ da ci 'di ka na yod pa yin zer nas smin phrag tu mdzub mo btsugs pa dang / 'dre mo zhar ma gcig na re/ legs par rtogs shig res yod res med pa 'di 'dra ba zhig gis rdo rje brgyab nas nga'i mig ya gcig kyang bcar ba yin zer nas thams cad gyes so/ /des na stong pa nyid bsgoms na snang srid lha 'dre'i gnod pas mi tshugs/sngon 'jam dpal gyis/ stong pa nyid las brtsams te sems nang na yang med/ phyi rol na yang med/ bar na yang med pas/de la ci yang grol rgyu yang med/ thob pa yang med/ mngon par rtogs pa yang med do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de thos pa tsam gyis dge slong mang po rnam par grol/ dge slong kha cig ma dad nas/ci yang grol rgyu med na 'o skol chos byas pa don mi 'dug pas 'deng zer nas song / rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ dge slong zhig sprul nas btang bas/ de rnams dang 'phrad pas/ khyed rnams gar 'gro spras pas/ khong rnams na 538

re/ 'jam dpal gyis chos bstan nas grol rgyu yang med/ thob rgyu yang med zer ba la ma dad nas 'gro zer/ sprul pa'i dge slong gi zhal nas/ 'o na khyed rnams kyis rtogs rgyu dang grol rgyu de/ gru bzhi 'am/ zlum po 'am/ nar mo la sogs dbyibs/dkar po la sogs kha dog phyi nang la sogs pa ji ltar 'dug ltos shig dang gsungs pas/ khong rnams kyis shes rab kyis brtags shing dpyad nas bltas pas btags don btsal nas ci yang ma rnyed pas/ sprul pa'i dge slong na re/ de la dgongs nas 'jam dpal gyis grol rgyu yang med/ thob rgyu yang med/mngon par rtogs rgyu yang med gsungs pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong de dag rnams kyang sems rnam par grol bar gyur te/ slar log nas 'jam dpal la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/ yang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis yab rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang 'dus byas pa g.yo ba snying po med pa/ chos thams cad bdag med par bstan pas/ yab rgyal po zas gtsang ma la sogs pa'i shākya bdun khris mi skyes pa'i chos la bzod pa thob/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis 'khor rnams la/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'o zhes gsungs pa 539

dang / shā ri'i bus shes rab phar phyin la ji ltar bslab zhus pas/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyis chos thams cad bsal bzhag med par rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing stong pa nyid du bstan pa sogs/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus 'khor dpag tu med pa grol/ sngon rtag tu ngu la nam mkha' nas de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i zhal bstan nas rigs kyi bu khyod 'di nas shar phyogs su dpag tshad lnga brgyar rim gyis song dang / de na grong khyer spos ldan zhes bya ba yod/ de na 'phags pa chos 'phags zhes bya ba yod/de khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin zer ba thos nas/ de ltar phyin pas/ 'phags pa chos 'phags dang mjal bas/ sngar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams gang nas byon gang du bzhud dris pas/ chos 'phags kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams 'gro 'ong med tshul nas brtsams pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos gsungs pas/ rtag tu ngu'i je tshom thams cad chod de mthong lam rgyud la skyes/ des na zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos thos pa tsam gyis grol ba mang na/ thos don bsgoms na grol ba smos ci dgos/ de 'dra'i phan yon rnams shes nas zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la brtson dgos/540

sngon sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis bal zhig khur nas 'ong ba rta la zhon pa'i mi zhig dang 'phrad pas lhan du song / skabs shig gnyis ga'i ngal gso bas/ sgyu ma mkhan na re/ lag na rdza ma kha dog pa zhig yod pa bstan nas kho bos bal khur rta la zhon nas re zhig rdza ma 'di'i nang du song na khyod bltad mo mi blta'am byas pas/der blta byas pas/ sgyu ma mkhan gyes bal khur rta zhon nas lcag gis brab ste rdza khog nang du zhugs song ba bltas tshe nang na glu len gyin 'gro ba mthong / ngo mtshar nas yun ring bltas nas skabs shig mi mthong bar gyur tshe yar mgo btegs nas bltas pas kho rta zhon nas lung pa'i phu'i nyag kha na phar song skad/yang sngon rgad po phyug po ser sna can chos mi dran par bu lon gtong mkhan zhig la sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis chos dran phyir/ rgad po bu lon bsdud pa mthong nas/ de 'dra ba zhig byas khyim du song bas bu mo rnams kyis pha yin snyam yod tshe pha ngo ma de 'ongs nas sgo phye byas pas/ bu bu mo kun gyis nged kyi pha 'ong tshar/ phar song byas pas ma song gang yin ngo ma shes par yul mi kun bsdus nas mi nor zas gsum bgrang du bcug pas khyad ma byung / mi rabs rtsis pas pha ngo mas mi rab gsum las ma shes pas/ pha ltar badzus pa'i sgyu ma mkhan gyis mi rabs 541

bdun bgrangs byung bas yul mi khyim mtshes thams cad kyis kyang sgyu ma mkhan pha yin par thag bcad/ pha ngo ma yul bton pas 'khyams nas yun ring song sdug bsngal myang bas/ sngar yod dus chos shig ma byas pa 'gyod nas chos dran yod tshe sgyu ma mkhan gyis phyir bos nas/ chos thams cad mi rtag snying po med pa 'di dang 'dra/ da khyod chos kyis zhes sngar bzhin sdod du bcug pas kho blo chos la 'gyur nas chos byas skad/ yang sngon sgyu ma mkhan zla bzang bya ba'igrogs po dpal bya bas rta zhig 'dod yod pa shes nas nyin gcig sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i mi rta gnyis sprul nas/ dpal gyi sgor song ste rta mi nyo'am byas pas nyo zer/ gom 'gros ltos byas pas kho rta'i gong la zhon pa dang /dbang med du khur nas yul mtha' med du song nas skabs shig sgyur nas rta bros song bas/ bltas tshe khang chung zhig na rgan mo bu mo gsum can zhig mthong nas da yul du mi sleb snyam/ bu mo zhig gi mag pa byas bsdad pas lo mang po song / bu bu mo gsum tsam byung / chu 'gram zhig tu pha bu rtsed mo rtse zhing bsdad pas bu yis chu zla mthong nas len du phyin pas chus khyer/ de kho rang len du phyin pa'i rjes su bu gcig byung ba de yang chus khyer/gnyis ka ma zin par chus khyer/ de'i bar la bu mo 'gram na 542

yod pa stag gis khur/ tshur 'gram la thon 'gyel nas bsdad tsa na chung ma sleb pa de yang dngangs nas chu la lcebs/ ma bu thams cad shi ba mthong nas mya ngan chen po byas/ skra 'bal tsa na mgo dkar por song ba mthong snying rlung langs/ bros nas 'ongs pas sngar gyi yul der slebs pa'i snang ba byung/ de tshe sgyu ma mkhan gyes bslus pa yin par shes/ de bzhin du chos thams cad shes nas gnas lugs don la goms pas phyis jo bo chen po'i dus su dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bar gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su gnas brtan kha sgyu mkhan zer ba zhig gis kha nas chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yin zer/ ‘pag len la nor rdzas mang po bsags pa sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis mthong nas/nyin gcig sgyu ma'i mi rta gnyis sprul/ mi de rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras rta de la zhon nas sgor song bas/ rta dang rgyan mi nyo'am byas pas/ nyo zer khang pa ma gtogs nor kun byen pa/sgyu ma mkhan gyis yul du nor kun blangs/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas spyan drangs zhag bdun gyi bar du 'tsho ba drangs/ nor kun zad tshe sgyu ma zhig pas/ rta 'jag mar gyur/ rgyan rnams sol bar gyur tshe/ gnas brtan kha sgyu mkhan sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgor phyin nas/ khyod kyis nga bslus 'dug nga'i nor rnams phyir byen 543

byas pas/ khyod kyis kyang nga bslus 'dug nga'i rgyan rta rnams phyir byin byas pas/ khyod kyi rta rgyan 'jag ma sol bar gyur 'dug longs byas pas/ 'o na khyod kyi zas nor kyang mi gtsang bar gyur 'dug longs byas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar song gnyis ka khyad yod dam med zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam dang 'dra/ khyad med tshul gsungs/gnas brtan kha sgyu mkhan gyis kha zhe med par chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa byung / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad tshugs thub bden grub du mi 'dzin par rang bzhin med pa snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ sngon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pas rmi lam du gangs kyi ri bo chen po la phyogs bzhir ka ba bzhi btsugs pa sogs rmis pa dang / dwags po lha rjes me tog gi dkyil du sku skyil krung bcas te bzhugs pa'i mdun du chu mig brdol ba rgyab tu 'od 'khyil ba sogs rmis pa dang / ras chung pas/ ras pa gyon bong bu la kha phyir phyogs nas zhon pa dang / khye la khal bkal nas 'o dod 'bod cing phyin pa sogs rmis pa dang / sngon mi gcig gis mgul du thag pa btags nas mi mang pos btson khang du 'khrid pa zhig rmis nas grogs la nga'i rmi lam ngan/ nga da lo 544

'chi nges zer ba grogs na re/ da nang mgul na thag pa 'dug gam byas pas/ da nang ci yod rmi lam lags med byas pas de yin na rmi lam la bden pa med pas 'chi ba'i nges pa med pas grogs po rnam rtog ma che zer skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad dngos po dang mtshan mar mi bzung bar snang stong rmi lam lta bur shes par bya/ be'u bum sngon po las/ rgyal po zhig la blon po byed ngan pa gcig yod pa la/ lan cig rgyal po dang gnyis mkhar gcig gi kha na bsdad yod pa la/sgyu ma mkhan po gcig gis lung pa chus gang bar sprul nas/mkhar gyi bar la chu lhung lhung byung ba dang / mnyan pa gcig grur zhugs nas skya ba 'debs shing mkhar gyi rtsar 'ongs pa dang / mnyan pa na re/ sngon la blon po zhugs shig zer nas blon po zhugs pa dang sgyu ma zhig nas/ g.yang du lhung nas bslus pa lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags thebs pa la de dag bsnyon med du yod kyang / sngags ma jebs pa la gang yang med pa ltar/ ma rig pa'i 'khrul pa dang ma bral ba'i ring la rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'khor ba dang / gru 'grul lta bu'i rten gye gang zag gru lta bu'i lam bslab pa gsum/ mnyan pa lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / pha rol gyi ngogs lta bu'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad cag ge 545

yod pa yin la/ ma 'khrul ba la de rnams gang yang grub pa med pa yin gsungs/ rin chen spungs pa las/ sngon rgya gar du rgan mo gcig gis bu byes su song ba'i shul du/ mig la rab rib kyi nad byung ste/ mna' mas zas ci byin pa la skra shad btab par mthong nas/ der bu log tsa na/ rgan mo na re/ khyod med shul du khyod kyi chung mas/ nga la 'bras chan la skra shad btab pas ngan zer ba la/ der bu chung ma la khros pas/ chung ma na re/ ngas skra shad ma btab rgan mo rang mig 'khrul ba yin khyed rang gis byen dang zer te/ bus 'bras chan byen pas/ ma na re 'di la yang 'dug zer bas/ der mig skyon yin par shes nas/ 'o na 'bras chan 'di thu bar sbos shig byas nas/ sman pa bos te mig bcos pas sos te/ da thu ba'i 'bras chan der ltos dang byas pas/ der skra shad nyag ma gcig kyang med pas/ khong nad kyang bcos ma dgos par sos skad/ dpe de bzhin du da lta 'o skol la bdag gzhan snod bcud du snang ba 'di rnams thams cad kyang / rang sems 'khrul nas med pa la yod par snang ba yin/de la bla ma'i gdams ngag gis blo bcos pas nam zhig 'khrul ba sangs tsa na/ snang ba 'di yang mi snang bar 'gro gsungs/sngon lha'i bu pad+ma rnam par rol bas 'jam dpal la smras pa/546

'jam dpal phyi rol gyi yul 'di dag byed pa pos byas pa'am ji ltar blta bar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu phyi rol gyi yul 'di rnams ni byed pa pos byas pa ma yin te/ sems rtog pas bag chags brtas pa'i dbang gis snang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ bag chags ji ltar brtas kyang ri bo dang / rgya mtsho dang nyi zla sogs sra zhing 'thas pa 'di ltar du ga la rung /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ rnam par rtog pa brtas pa'i dbang gis de ltar snang du rung ste/ grong khyer wa ra ṇa sir/ bram ze mo gcig gis rang gis rang gi lus stag tu bsgoms pas/ grong khyer gyi mi thams cad kyis stag dngos su mthong nas mi thams cad bros te/ grong khyer stong ba byung ngo / /dge slong gcig gis rang lus mi gtsang bar bsgom pas/ thams cad rul bar mthong ba byung ngo / /de rnams yun thung ngus kyang de ltar snang na thog ma med pa'i dus nas bag chags brtas pas ci ste mi snang gsungs/ yang sngon dge slong gcig gis rang lus keng rus dngos su mthong / rnal 'byor pa zhig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgoms pas brag khung gi yang thems la ma he rwa 'thogs pa byung / mu stegs nag po thub rgyal gyis nam mkha' brag tu bsgoms pas thams cad brag tu dmar chem gyis song / 'gro sa 547

bkag pa byung / sngon mi gcig gis zhing dkyil na pha bong chen po zhig yod pa 'don 'phro la khyim du zas zar phyin pa'i bar la/byis pa zhig yod pas nya bzung nas pha bong gi 'og tu bcug pas/ slar song klog pas nya thon tshe rnam rtog skyes nas log byung bas/ byis pas ci nyes byas pas/ mi bshad par nang du song nas rim 'gro byed kyin 'dug pa/ byes pas nged kyis kyal ka byas pa yin byas pas/ de rang yang 'dre yin zer nas rtog pa ma zhi bar shi ba byung / yang sngon sgom chen gcig la g.yog zhig yod pas bag phye la 'bag cig byas/ de la tshon rtsi byugs nas mgo la gyon nas/ bsgom chen pas mthong ba'i sa zhig tu kha gdang nge bsdad pas/ de khong gis mthong nas bar chad yin snyam nas stong pa nyid bsgoms nas bltas tsa na da dung 'dug pa mthong nas sgom chen rtogs pa skyes te/ dgongs mo snga ma de 'dra mi 'ong ba la de ring nyams tshad cig byung zer ci byung byas pas ma smras tshe/ ngas ku re byas pa yin byas pas de ka rang 'dres byed du bcug pa yin zer nas/ rtog pa ma sol bar sgom chen pa grongs song / sngon lam 'bras ba'i sgom chen pa gcig la rtsa rlung gi byed pas/ skom pa'i nyams shig byung ste chu 'thung 'dod nas chu ra chu mig gtsang po rnams la chu 'thung du phyin 548
