pas/ chu mi 'dug the tshom skyes nas chos gos pha gi'i brag bar zhig tu bzhag nas phyir log nas nyal bsdad/ gnyid sad pa dang skom nyams kyang yal 'dug chu ra sogs na'ang chu 'dug chos gos kyang gtsang po'i pha gi na 'dug pas len pa la ko ba gtong dgos byung zer/ des na sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa med bzhin du snang ba'i snang srid kyi chos thams cad sems kyis byas na sems la snang ba yin pas chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su shes par bya'o/ /sngon jo bo rjes rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na jo mo zhal 'gyur ta re'i lha khang na tshur 'byon tsa na/ bud med rgan gzhon gnyis nam mkhar bsdad nas/ gzhon pas rgan pa la chos thams cad gang du 'dus dris pas/ rgan pa na re/ rang gi sems su 'dus zer/sems kyi mtshan nyid ci lta bu yin zer bas/ sems kyi mtshan nyid nam mkha' lta bu yin gsungs pas/ jo bos de'i dus su sems tsam dang dbu ma'i lta ba thugs su chud skad/ de skad gsungs pa de jo bos 'khor rnams la/ khyed kyis mthong ngam thos sam gsungs pas/ ma thos ma mthong zer jo bo'i zhal nas/jo mos g.yog la gsungs pa'i tshul du byas nas nga la gdams ngag gsungs pa yin gsungs skad/ sngon jo bo yab sras gnyis 549

yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na bzhugs dus/ dge bshes 'brom gyis jo bo rje la/ da ni gcig pur nyams len pas/ /snying po bsdus pa gnad kyi mchog /dben par gnas pa'i chos gcig zhu/ /'brom gcig pur 'dug na sems la dpyod/ /rje bla ma'i thabs kyis bkrol na gsal/ /'brom sems med yul rnams su yis 'dzin/ /rje 'dzin pa po med 'dzin mi 'gyur/'brom sems med gang la su yis smra/ /rje smra ba po med chags sdang ci/ /'brom yul dang yul can de 'drar zad/ /rje sems kyi gzhi rtsa gang zhig lags/ /'brom kho bos don 'di rnyed ma gyur/ /rje rnyed par mi 'gyur ji ltar lags//'brom skye gnas 'jig pa mi gda' na/ /rje sna tshogs rig pa ji ltar lags/ /'brom 'di ni snang med snang ba yin/ /rje snang na de nyid ma lags sam/ /'brom snang ba bya ba ci la zer/ /rje sna tshogs yul du dmigs pa lags/ /'brom yul nyid dmigs sam sems nyid dmigs/ /rje sems kyi yul rnams dmigs pa yin/ /'brom sems de dpyod pa'i dus la babs/ /rje sems 'di dpyod lugs dus la babs/ /'brom khyod kyi rig pa snga ma ston/ /rje 'das pas 'di ru bstan ma mchis/ /'brom 'o na ma 'ongs rig pa ston/ /rje ma 'ongs 'di ru 'byung srid dam/ /'brom 'o na da lta'i sems 'di 550

ston/ /rje 'dzug gu gtang sa mi dga' ba/ /'brom de 'dra 'ong ba ci zhig yin/ /rje de bas khyed la 'dri ba yin/ /'brom sangs rgyas kun kyang 'di la brdugs/ /rje kun la mkhas pa ma yin nam/ /'brom mkhas pa log shes ga la yin/ /rje 'o na sems rang med dam ang / /'brom yod yod 'dra mo shes kyin gda'/ /rje yang yang btsal zhing ma rnyed na/ /'brom rang lugs yang yang mthong ba yin/ /rje ma rnyed pa la bzhag lags sam/ /'brom lhod de glod na dam pa yin/ /rje gnad don 'di yi rgyud pa gang / /'brom rgyal dang sgrol ma nga nyid yin/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems de ci lta bu zhig 'dug yang yang legs par brtags shing dpyad nas btsal bas ma rnyed pa'i tshe sems de rang bzhin gyis grub pa med par stong pa nyid yin par shes par bya/ yang jo bo yab sras gnyis yer ba na bzhugs dus 'brom gyis/ 'o na 'ching ba'i rtsa ba gang lags/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ bdag tu 'dzin pa gang lags zhus pas/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad bdag gcig bu la dgos pa/ nyes pa thams cad gzhan kho nas lan par byed pa zhig yin gsungs/'o na de 'dra'i bdag 'dzin zhig 'di yin gsungs pa gcig 551

gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag 'dzin sgo btags la 'di yin bstan rgyu ga na rnyed gsungs/ yang bdag 'dzin 'di gnas pa gang na gnas zhus pas/ cha med kho bos mthong ma myong / gnas bya med pa'i gnas byed mi shes/ ngo bo med pa'i dbyebs kha dog mi shes/ gsungs/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/'o na 'di 'dra'i nyams thag pa zhig mi 'ong 'a/ thang a zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ smig rgyu'i chu dang zla gnyis dang / rmi lam gyi rta glang la sogs pa'ang mi mthong la thang a gsungs/ jo bo de 'khrul snang lags mod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bo yang de bzhed/ bdag 'dzin kho yong nas chags sdang byed pa ma yin/ gzhung stong gi phyir du lung stong gi khye zug bdag 'dzin med pa la rang rgyud chen po 'khrul/ jo bo dpe de 'dra na bdag 'dzin ye med med 'dra zhus pas/ 'dra bya ba ci la zer dngos yin mod gsungs/ 'o na chags sdang gi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin de rang sems yin nam ang zhus pas/ sems de'i kha dog gang du gda'/ de kho bos mthong ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na dbyibs ci 'dra zhig gda' gsungs/ jo bo kho bos mthong ma myo nga zhus pas 'o na dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ma grub/ mig gis mthong ma myong tsa na gzugs su med pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ yang 552

'brom gyis zhus pa/ nged bdag 'dzin can rnams ji ltar spang zhus pas/ 'brom nyin gcig la rnam rtog ci tsam zhig rgyu/ jo bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rgyu'o/ /'brom chos kyi dbyings ji tsam skye/ jo bo rtog pas zil gyis mnan nas skye ba mi gda'o/ /'brom de la bla ma a wa dhu ti pa'i bzhed pa de dgos pa yin gsungs/jo bo bla ma'i gdams ngag de bstan 'tshal/ 'brom rnam rtog byung tshad chos dbyings su bsgyur/ jo bo sdong dum thams cad gser du song na 'dod pa can la mkho ste/ ji ltar bsgyur du btub bam/ 'brom man ngag la bsten nas gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bya bas/ lcags gser du 'gro ba yod/ gnad shes dgos pa yin/ jo bo gnad bstan 'tshal/ 'brom dgra 'joms pa la dgra ngos zin 'tshal/ jo bo dgra gang lags/ 'brom rnam par rtog pa yin/ jo bo de ji ltar 'joms/ 'brom kho 'bur re byung tsa na 'joms 'tshal/ jo bo 'joms lugs ji ltar bgyid/ 'brom gzhi gang na 'dug dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa la dpyad snga ma phyi ma la sogs pa la dpyad/ 'gro sa dang 'byung sa 'tshol/ de'i dus su kho mi rnyed/ jo bo de ci lags/ 'brom kho yod ma myong bas ma rnyed pa yin/ jo bo ma rnyed na ji ltar bgyi/ 'brom rnam rtog chos dbyings su bsgyur bya ba yin btsal nas ma rnyed na 553

chos dbyings yin pa'i rtags yin/ de la glod la zhog jo bo yang byung na/ 'brom yang 'bur 'joms gyis gsungs/ 'brom sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i rnam rtog brgya byung na/ 'tshol thengs brgya byas pas mi rnyed pa brgya tham pa 'ong / ma rnyed pa'i don rnyed pa de chos dbyings yin/ de la bla ma a wa dhu ti pa'i zhal nas/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyengs yin/ /byung na dga' ste bskul 'debs bzang / /ci phan rnyed par ma gyur pas/ /gnas lugs yo langs tsam du zad/ /ces gsungs na/ 'brom dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa khong la yod/ 'brom kho bos kyang nyi ma nyin gcig la yang bdag 'dzin la mi dgos dgu dgos rnam par rtog pa brgya/ 'phros ma thag tu gnyen pos btsal ba yi/ /mi rnyed chos dbyings kho na yin par gda'/ /gal te yod na rnam rtog mang lugs la/ /gal te gcig tsam ma rnyed khrims yod dam/ /gsungs/ yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ blo thams cad 'das pas cha dngos med/ ma 'ongs pa'i cha yang dngos med/ da lta yang dngos med/ dngos med rang stong / rang stong dbu ma/ de ltar gnas pa de la shes rab zer gsungs/ sngon khams pa gcig rwa sgreng du 'ong nas/ gral byed khar kho na re/ nga stong nyid bsgom pa yin pas gral 'gor 'gro zer skad/ des na 554

gang zag gi bdag ril por bzhag nas phyi'i sa rdo ri sogs pa stong stong por byas tsam gyis mi phan te/ 'brom rin po che'i zhal nas/ la kha'i pha bong stong mi stong 'dra ste rang gi sems stong dgos pa yin gsungs/ yang khong gi zhal nas/ thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ sems nyid stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ stong pa ye stong spros bral gyi rang bzhin du shes pa ni ye shes yin gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang yod yod lta bu'i snang ba 'char ba'i bdag 'dzin rnam rtog sogs la yang brtags shing dpyad nas ma rnyed pa'i tshe bdag 'dzin rnam rtog sogs kyang ming gis phar btags pa tsam zhig ma gtogs pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pas stong pa nyid du shes par bya/ po to ba'i gsung sgros dpe chos las/ 'o skol khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung bas/de'i gnyen por bdag med kyi don rtogs dgos pas/ da nga la gang zag gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can de la dngos po ji lta bu gcig 'dug btsal te dang po lus 'di la gzugs drug lhu bco brgyad/ mgo bo ya thod ma thod gnyis te nyi shur phye/ de las kyang cha shas dum bur phye ste/ bshig pas bdag 555

gi dngos po ci yang mi rnyed de der gcig bur 'dzin pa'i blo ldog ste de gas chog gsungs/ chos kyi bdag shes bya gzugs can gzugs med gnyis su 'dus pas/ dang po shes bya gzugs can dngos po thams cad rdul phra rab kyi phyogs cha phye bas/ gzhug dngos po ci yang mi rnyed shes bya gzugs med kyi dngos po rang gi sems su 'dus pas/ sems dus gsum du phye bas dngos po ci yang mi rnyed de/ sems 'das pa ni 'das zin/ma 'ongs pa ni da dung ma skyes/ da lta'i sems phyogs na mi gda'/ yul na mi gnas/ kha dog dbyibs su ma grub pas/ shes bya la 'jug pa med der shes pa dang / shes bya gnyis rang bzhin med par nam mkha' ltar song ba de la shes rab stong pa nyid zer ba yin/ de la bden dzun yod med rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' dang bral bas dbu ma zhes zer ba yin gsungs/nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil de ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba ltar phung bo khams dang skye mched dang / bzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab cing gzhug pas/ dngos po ci yang ma rnyed tshe shes bya shes byed gnyis ka rang bzhin med par nam mkha'i dkyil ltar song ba de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste goms 556

par bya'o/ /gsungs/ yang po to ba'i gsungs sgos be'u bum sngon po las/ so sor rtog pa'i dpyad pas ma rnyed pas ngang de la nam mkha' bzhin du snang stong dbyer med du cham gyis bag re btang ste bsgom par bya'o/ /de la cung zhig goms pa dang /res so sor rtog pa'i dngos po rnams la dpyod/ res dpyad pas ma rnyed pa'i ngang la mi rtog par 'jog gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang brtags shing dpyad nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam mi rnyed par nam mkha'i dkyil ltar stong seng 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa'i ngang de la mnyam par bzhag par bya ste/ snang ba mtha' yas ngur sprig gar gyes rnam rol paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis rang gi thugs sras dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la gdams pa'i phyag chen las/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas shes pa phra mo zhig gis dpyad pas nged rang la ji ltar snang ba'i mnyam par 'jog mkhan gyi skyes bu'am/bdag gam/ gang zag gam/ nga rdul tsam med par stong cham gyis 'gro la/ de lta bu'i stong seng de'i don spyi blo la gsal bar byas nas/ gzhan ma spros pa gang yang yid la mi byed pa rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag med dgag stong seng de'i 'dzin stangs cung zad zhan du song na/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas sngar 557

ltar dpyad la rtse gcig tu bsgom pa ni mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul lo/ /gsungs/phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba byams pa rin chen gyis bskul ngor gdams pa'i 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ dper na nam mkha' zhes pa bar snang gi skya sang sang ba'i steng du dgag bya thog reg dang bral ba tsam la bzhag pa ltar/ dgag bya bden grub bkag tsam gyis stong seng med dgag la chos gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul rnal ma yin la/ so sor dpyad pa la bsten pa'i rang stobs kyis zhi gnas drangs te yid la byed pa med pa'am mi rtog pa yang 'di nyid la ngos 'dzin no gsungs/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis/ bka' gdams lta ba'i ngos 'dzin bdag lta dang / /'dzin stangs 'gal phyir zhen pa'i blo zhes zer/ /mi bsam mi mno yid la mi byed pa/ /lta ba'i ngos gzhir mar me mdzad dpal gsung / /zhes dge lugs par zur za mdzad pa la/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa/ rje rin po ches bka' gdams lta ba'i skyong tshul stong pa nyid 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas nas skyong dgos par gsungs pa dang / jo 558

bo'i dbu ma'i man ngag tu/ bying ba dang rgod pa la sogs pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba thams cad bsal te/ bar skabs der shes pa cir yang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin/ dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad bsal te/ ji srid du mtshan ma'am rnam par rtog pa'i dgra'am chom rkun ma langs kyi bar du de lta bu la shes pa gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ jo bo'i gsung de'i don ni/ gcig tu bral la sogs pa'i gtan tshig rnams kyis chos rnams btags don btsal nas ci yang ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ btags don ci yang ma rnyed pa'i stong seng de nyid ma gtogs dgag bya bkag shul du sgrub pa'i chos gang yang yid la mi byed pa'i don yin gyi/ stong seng de nyid kyang ma mthong zhing yid la mi byed pa ma yin te/ dper na thog bcas kyi reg bya bkag tsam gyis stong seng mthong ba'i tshe/ thog bcas cung zad tsam yang ma mthong zhing stong seng de nyid mthong ba la nam mkha' mthong ba'i tha snyad btags pa'i phyir te/ sdud pa las/gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing / /'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa mi mthong zhing / /gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa/ /'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /nam mkha' mthong 559

zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mthong ste de 'di brtags par bgyi/ /mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin/ /de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /gsungs pa yang stong nyid mthong ba la byed pas/ /stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/bden grub rnam par bcad tsam gyis med dgag stong seng de nyid mthong ba dang / de yid la byed pa zhes pa'i tha snyad bya'i/yul ci yang mi mthong zhing ci yang yid la mi byed pa zhes tha snyad sbyar bar mi bya'o gsungs/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos bla ma bkra shis bde legs la gdams pa'i mgur las/ gal te nga zhes phung po'i steng nyid du/ /ming tsam min par rang nyid yod gyur na/ /gzhan la rag las ltos grub mi rung bas/ /bdag phung shar nub ri bzhin 'brel med 'gyur/ /gzhan yang gcig dang du ma rgyu 'bras sogs/ /rnam par brtags pas nges don dpyad bya'i chos/ /rdul tsam mi dmigs dmigs gtad zhig pa yi/ /stong seng mkha' ltar shar ba'i shes rab de/ /lta ba dngos yin de dang dus mtshungs su/ /mi brjed dran pas cir bzung shes bzhin gyis/ /rgyangs so btsugs nas ting 'dzin brtan po yi/ /bde gsal mi rtog bsgoms kyi yang rtser son/ /de ltar rtse gcig 560

'jog dang yang nas yang / /dpyad pas nges shes shugs drag rdo rje ltar/ /mi bshigs rtse mo brgya ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /bdag 'dzin ri bo 'joms par gdon mi za/ /gsungs/ des na chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med do snyam pas dam bcas pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog ci yin 'di yin med pa'i lung ma bstan tsam du bsdad pas kyang mi yong so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis legs par dpyad nas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin sogs rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang mi rnyed par stong pa nyid du cham gyis song ba'i tshe/ stong seng de nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya/ yang byeng rgod kyis bar chod nas mi nges par gyur na sngar ltar dpyad nas stong seng 'ba' zhig tu nges tshe nges shes de nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa ni mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul yin/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pas rjes thob tu ji ltar blta bar bya snyam na/ po to ba'i gsung sgros las/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i skye ba dang bud med/ rta dang glang bo la sogs pa sprul ba'i tshe/ sgyu ma mkhan por snang ba yod kyang zhen pa med de/ byed mkhan kho rang yin pa ltar/ dpe de bzhin du 'o skol gyis mnyam bzhag la chos thams cad stong pa bdag med 561

pa nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes thob la/ rang sems 'khrul ba'i rnam rtog gis byas pas ji ltar snang bas chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu la zhen 'dzin med pa'i sgyu ma mkhan lta bu'i shes pas dpyad par bya ste/ srid gsum skra shad 'dzings pa 'dra/ /smig rgyu chu ltar nor ba ste/ /rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu ru/ /bsgoms na rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs kyi gzugs snang ba rnams la rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med par ye nas stong yang rdzas sngags bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la bsten nas/ sgyu ma'i snang ba bzang ngan sna tshogs su snang nas/'gro 'ong skye 'chi sogs mngon sum du snang ba ltar/ chos thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med/ ye nas stong yang las bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas/'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rnam pa ma 'gags/ bzang ngan ma 'dres/ bde sdug ma 'chol bar so sor snang nas nyams su myong ba'i tshul la bsams nas/ las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bden pa la nges shes drangs nas/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i snang ba rang bzhin gyes ma grub par shes bzhin du rang gzhan gang gi don du yang / rta glang sogs sgyu ma'i snang ba sna tshogs sprul ba 562

ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad tshugs thub bden grub dngos po tshad mar ma grub par shes bzhin gnyis sha'i don du tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs sogs spyod phyogs rnams la yang brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar mnyam bzhag tu shes rab stong pa nyid kyi don la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog cing /rjes thob tu thabs kyi cha rnams la 'bad na ring po mi thogs par bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ las nyon dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon du byas/ rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur zhes rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyis zhal mthun par gsungs so/ /des na thabs shes zung 'brel gyi nyams len la brtson par mdzod cig /da ni thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don bya tshul ni/ sngon dus yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus/ thog mar gar bzhugs sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing lta bur sprul/ zas gos sogs ci 'dod kyi char phab nas gang mkho ba sbyin te/ gdul bya bkres skom grang bas gdungs pa rnams kyang lus sems tshims par byas/ de nas 563

rnar snyan yid la 'bab pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas yid spro bar byas/ de nas gdul bya gang la gang 'tsham kyi chos spyod du bcug de nas nyid kyis kyang mthun pa'i chos la rtag tu gnas par mdzad de thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de bzhin du sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis kyang / thog mar gdul bya la mkho ba yang sbyin/ de nas chos kyi don snyan par smras/ de nas gdul bya la de ltar du spyod du bcugarang yang de dang mthun par mdzad de bsdu bzhi la bsten nas 'gro don mdzad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang dmu rgod gdul dka'i snyigs dus 'gro ba nyam thag rnams kyi don gang nus re bya dus/ thog mar zang zing gi mkho ba sbyin nas 'khor du bsdu/ de nas khams 'dri ba sogs 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i gtam smras/ de nas sdig pa spangs shing dge ba sna re tsam sgrub pa'i phan yon sogs kyi snyan pa smras nas yid spro bar byas/sdig pa sna re spong ba dang dge ba sna re tsam sgrub pa yan chad kyi don la spyod du 'jug rang gis kyang don de dang mthun pa'i nyams len ma byas na pha rol gdul bya des kyang dge ba la mi spyod pas rang gis kyang pha rol gyi gdul bya de las lhag gam/564

ma mtha' de dang mnyam pa'i dge ba la spyod/ mdor na mkho ba sbyin pa/ snyan par smras pa/ don spyod du 'jug pa/ don de dang mthun par bya ba ste/ thabs mkhas bsdu ba bzhi yi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po ches dus rtag tu nor rdzas bdag tu mi 'dzin par gzhan gang mkho la phangs pa med par sbyin/gnod skyel ba la yang phan btags/ mi snyan brjod pa la'ang gtam snyan smras/ skyon mthong yāng yon tan du bsgyur nas brjod/ khrims 'chal dam nyams la yang mi snyan pa mi smra/ bon sngags sogs chos lugs grub mtha' mi gcig pa la yang kha mi gtong bar ma zad de dag gi chos dang gang zag la yang bsngags pa brjod/ rtag tu dman sa gzung gzhan thams cad spyi bor bkur/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas gang 'tshams kyi chos gsungs pas mthar bon po sngags pa rgya mi la sogs pa'i gdul bya dpag med 'dus/ bla ma ni bla ma a rig dge bshes bla ma red ces rgya za lar yan chad kyi snyan pa dang grags pa phyogs bcur bsgrags/ mthong thos dran reg gi sems can rnams dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing byang chub mchog gi sa bon rgyud la bskrun par mdzad/ 'brel tshad thams cad 565

smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par gyur na yang da dung a mdo phyogs kyi skya ser pho mo phal cher gyis dam pa de nyid kyi gang gsungs rdo rje'i tshig rnams nyin re bzhin gleng zhing rnam dkar dge ba sgrub pa mang po gda'/ yang bdag gi bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po zhes bya ba de nyid kyis kyang gzhan gdul bya su byung yang rjes su 'dzin zhing zas gos sogs gang mkho ba sbyin dpe cha yang gang mkho ba la blta ru bcug bris nas gnang / chos kyang 'di mi mkhyen dang 'di'i dbang lung khrid gsum med ces bya ba med pas gdul bya gang 'dod kyi dam pa'i chos nyin mtshan bar ma chad du gsungs na'ang thugs skyo ngal sun pa med/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pas khong gis rjes su bzung ba zhig la legs po ma byung ba gcig kyang med/ thams cad mkhas btsun bzang gsum grub pa thob pa sha stag byung / des na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa de dag la kha mig yar blta byas gzhan gyi don la yang ci nus su bslabs na/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la yang dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung zhing / rang don yang shugs kyis 'grub par 'gyur bas blo gros dang ldan 566

pa rnams kyis 'phral du lag len la ci thebs mdzod cig /smras pa/ mnyam med bu ram shing ba'i zhal snga nas/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob thabs gang gsungs pa/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam gyis rim pa ru/ /bsdus nas bka' gdams gsung bzhin bshad tshar song / /'khor ba me 'obs srin gling dug sbrul tshang / /btson ra ltar mthong thar pa don gnyer blo/ /shugs drag gis bskyed 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /spong phyir bslab gsum rnam dag nyams blangs nas/ /rang nyid thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i gdengs/ /yod pa'i skal bzang skye bo pho mos kyang / /da dung nus na lam la slob dgos pas/ /de tsam zhig gis chog shes bya mi rigs/ /gtan bde thar pa'i grong khyer bsgrod 'dod kyang / /shes rab mig med dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /long khrid med cing chos kyi 'khar pa bral/ /skye rga na 'chi'i lam gyi bzhi mdor nyal/ /las ngan sas brlan nyon mongs char gyis sbangs/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi tsha grang bkres skom gyis/ /shin tu nyam thag gnas su gyur pa yi/ /ma rig dmus long 'gro drug pha ma la phyi mig tsam yang mi blta yal bar dor/ /rang nyid bslab gsum them skas la bsten nas/ /thar pa'i khang bzang nang du zhugs song na/ /de bas bu ngan khrel med gzhan na gang / /thar pa thob 567

kyang thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang ma thob gzhan don phar la zhog /rang don nyi tshe tsam las mi 'byung bas/ /de phyir thar pa tsam gyis chog shes byas/ /ma sdod dge ba'i bshes gnyen ded dpon bsten/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi gru gzings sdoms/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis dar chen rab 'phyar nas/ /kun mkhyen nor bu len du da chas shig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ded dpon bka' drin la/ /bsten nas srid zhi'i dbul 'phong kun sel ba'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i nor bu len pa'i tshul/ /go sla'i ngag gis legs par bshad zin nas/ /da ni yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yi/ /gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /mjug dang thun mtshams ji ltar bya tshul bshad/ /de yang mjug tu ji ltar bya tshul ni/ sngon gyi bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zab mos rgyud sbyangs nas mjug tu/ de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang nyin re bzhin 'di lta bu'i lam yorngas rdzogs sam/ yang na bshes gnyen bsten tshul lta bu re re tsam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas mjug 568

tu/ de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams bzang spyod dang smon lam bdun cu ba la sogs kyi sgo nas bsngo smon rnam dag gis mdzams sbyor byed pa gal che ste/ sngon lung pa zhig gis phu na spre'u zhig la spre'u'i 'khor stong gis bskor ba mkhas shing gsal ba zhig yod pa/ dus nam zhig rgyal po'i dpung gi tshogs dang bcas/ spre'u'i mtha' nas bskor te gsod la nye ba'i tshe/ spre'u kun bros pas/ chu chen po zhig yod pa la ma thar tshe/ spre'u'i dpon po de chur zhugs te sba la 'jus nas/ gzhan rnams la nga'i rgyab la mchongs la chu'i pha rol tu song byas pas/ kun gyis de ltar byas pas sor mo rnams kyis rgyab bsnad pas pags pa ral/ sha khrag rus pa bsnad kyang brtson pa ma btang bar spre'u kun bsgral/ spre'u'i phrug gu gcig rgyab na 'dug pa yang chu'i pha khar bton/ 'chi dus ri dwags 'di rnams skyabs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ bdag sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar shog ces smon lam btab bo/ /de'i dus kyi spre'u'i dpon po de phyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur/ spre'u rnams 'khor rnams su gyur/ sprel phrug de kun tu rgyu rab bzang zhes bya bar gyur to/ /yang sngon mu lto ba'i dpon zhig gis 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas shig la dad nas gus pas snum 569

'khur zhig phul lo/ /des blangs nas steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ 'bar ba dang gsal ba dang char 'bab pa dang glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa mthong nas rab tu dad nas/ de'i rkang pa la gtugs nas/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag mi'i rgyal por gyur te/ 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa la bsnyen bkur zhing mnyes par byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ mu lto ba gzhan phyi bzhin 'brang ba rnams kyis khyod rgyal por gyur pa na/ bdag cag kyang khyed kyi 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur cig /ces smon lam btab pas/phyis mu lto ba'i dpon po de shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan du gyur/mu lto ba gzhan rnams kyang shākya lnga brgya ru gyur nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur rgya cher byas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs nas bden pa mthong / yang sngon bram ze'i bu mo zhib ma mo zhes bya bas ming po rang sangs rgyas shig yod pa la ras yug chen po gcig bskon te/ khab dang gri dang rkud pa yang phul lo/ /des blangs te ras yug chen po 'dra bar brtsams pa dang / gri des rno bar chod pa dang / zhib ma mos bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis shes rab rno bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ de bzhin du khab kyis zab mor phigs pa 570

la/ shes rab zab mor gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ rkud pas thal byung du 'grub pa dang / bdag nges par 'byed pa'i shes rab can du gyur cig ces sgon lam btab pa'i mthus/phyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon dus shes rab can kun gyi mchog gyur 'phags pa shā ri'i bur gyur/ sngon rang sangs rgyas 'od zer can zhes bya bas zhal zas gsol tshe gzhon nu 'od zer ldan gyis gdu bu phud nas lhung bzed kyi gzhir bzhag pas lhung bzed mi g.yo bar 'dug pa mthong nas/ 'dis ni lhung bzed mi g.yo ba bzhin du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gi rgyud la chos ci yod pa mi g.yo bar gnas par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas kun dga' bor gyur nas sangs rgyas kyis chos gang gsungs pa rnams mi brjed par gyur/ sngon dbul mo gnyen dga' mos mar bslang nas gyo ral zhig gi nang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mar me chung ngu zhig phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ 'jig rten du ston pa shākya thub pa ji lta ba de bzhin du bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog cig ces smon lam btab pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la/ bu mo 'di ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 571

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa byung / sngon bud med rnya gas sangs rgyas bsod nams skyabs kyi drung nas chos thob nas rnam par grol ba'i smon lam btab pas/ phyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon dus bu mo dkar mo zhes bya bar gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung nas ring por ma lon bar dgra bcom ma dge slong ma dkar mo zhes bya bar gyur/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen bkur dpag med byas nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngor bcug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nam mkhas bsnyen bkur dpag med mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gang du bsngo the tshom du gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa des sprul ba zhig btang ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngor bcug pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur/ sngon yul dbus kyi rgyal po gos sbyin gyis/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ dge ba'i rtsa 572

ba 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob par bsngos nas dung phul bas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung du 'gyur bar lung bstan pa dang / de la 'gran sems kyi mtha'i rgyal po nor ldan gyis sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams par 'gyur bar lung bstan pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bzung ba ji bzhin du bdag kyang smon lam 'debs kyi 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams grub par gyur/ dge slong brtul zhugs mchog tu gyur pa zhig gis yul ta ra'i rgyal por skye bar smon lam btab pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sdom brtson de ni blo chung ngo zhes gsungs/ yul ma ga rnya'i ser bsrung sngags pa gcig gis/ bum pa bzang po lta bu'i dge 'dun la gdugs tshod drangs nas klu'i rgyal po rab bzang gi 'khor du klu gdug pa can du skye ba'i smon lam btab pas klu'i rgyal po sog ma med du gyur/ bram ze'i khye'u kun snyoms kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po byas te glang po cher skye bar smon lam btab pas 573

glang po che sa srungs kyi bur gyur/ bram ze sbyin pa la dga' ba zhig gis mchod rten zhig la ri mo sna tshogs bris nas/ 'dod khams na gzugs che ba zhig tu skye bar gyur cig byas pas/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer 'od can zhes pa la dbang byed pa la lus phyi'i rgya mtsho nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i gnas su slebs pa zhig tu skyes/ sngon drang srong zhig la nyes pa med bzhin du rgyal po zhig gis khrims bcad nas bsad pa'i smon lam log pa btab pas khyab 'jug tu gyur/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs tshar nas kun gyes smon lam 'debs pa'i nang du sa skyel ba'i glang zhig yod pa ma bzhag pas glang khros nas smon lam log pa btab pas rgyal po glang dar du gyur/ des na dge ba gang byas kyi mjug dang rang dgar yang bsngo ba smon lam dman pa dang log pa 'debs mi rung / dge ba gang byas kyi mjug du spyir bsngo smon rgya gang che dang khyad par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i bsngo smon byed pa gal che/ gzhan yang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa'i grong khyer na bzhugs dus yul mi rnams kyi chos ston 'dren pa'i grabs byas tshe/ khong rnams kyi pha mes yi dwags su skyes yod pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'ongs nas de ring gi chos ston gyi dge ba rnams/ 574

bdag cag gi don du bsngo bar zhu zhus pas/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas kyis yi dwags rnams mngon sum du 'ong du bcug pas/ yi dwags keng rus dang sdong dum mes tshig pa 'dra ba mang po byung tshe yon bdag rnams bred de thams cad bros pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ 'jigs mi dgos khyed cag gi pha mes rnams kyis ser sna'i las ngan bsags pas yi dwags su skyes yod pa rnams yin/ de ring gi dge rtsa rnams 'di dag gi ched du bsngo gsungs pas/ yon bdag rnams kyis de lags zhus pas/sangs rgyas kyi sbyin pa 'di yi bsod nams ni/ /yi dwags rnams kyi phyi bzhin song / /yi dwags sdug bsngal gang yin las/ /de dag myur du thar gyur cig /ces gsung pas yi dwags rnams de nyid du tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/sngon rna ba bye ba ri dmyal ba'i gnas rnams su phyin dus/ grong khyen rdo can gyi bshan pa dang smad 'tshong ma sogs dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba rnams kyis yul gyi bu dang bu mo sogs gnyen nye ba rnams la/ nged tshos bsags pa'i zas nor gye steng nas/ 'phags pa ka t+ya na la bsod snyoms phul la/ nged rnams so so'i ming nas zungs la bsngo ba gyis shig dang / des bdag cag rnams kyi las ngan pa zad nas thar par 'gyur ro/ /575

zhes 'phrin bskur ba de dag la bshad pas de ltar 'phags pa ka t+ya na la bsod snyems phul/ 'phags pas kyang bsngo ba mdzad pas de dag rnams dmyal ba nas thar par gyur/ sngon nyag phrug 'das log byang chub sems dpa' dmyal bar phyin dus/dmyal ba'i sgo mang po phye ba'i nang nas skye bo pho mo mang po byung nas lho 'dzam gling du khyed 'gro na/ nged rnams kyi yul 'di skad bya ba na bu bu mo sogs gnyen nye ba 'di skad bya ba yod pas de dag rnams la nged rnams dmyal bar skyes 'dug pas/ nged rnams la dmigs nas dge ba mdzod la bsngo ba re gyis dang / phan thogs chen po 'dug ces 'phrin bskur mkhan mang po byung / sngon gling bza' chos skyid bar dor song dus bar do'i grong chen po zhig na mi la la 'phral du zas skom med kyang glo bur du zas gos mang po byung ba la 'di gang nas byung zhes sngar rang gi lug gi rdzi bo shi song ba de na 'dug pa la dris pas/ de bu bu mo sogs gnyen nye ba rnams kyis de dag la dmigs nas dge rtsa btang bsngo ba byas pa'i 'bras bu yin zer/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras pas rtsam pa bre do 'bras bre gang sha gzugs gcig mar zhogs gcig rnams khyer nas la phyi gangs la bsgom du phyin pas/ de'i mtshan mo nas bzung kha ba nyin mtshan bco 576

brgyad babs pas zla ba drug tu mi'i rgyu 'grul chad pas/ slob 'bangs rnams kyis sku grongs par thag bcad/ thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs kyi tshogs bsags mchod 'bul byas pas de dus rje btsun gyi nyams la bu slob mang pos mtha' bskor bza' btung mang po drangs pa'i snang ba shar bas/ zhag mang po zas za snying mi 'dod pa byung / phyis bu slob rnams mjal dus de'i tshe khyed rnams kyis ci byas gsungs pas/ dus tshod brtsis pas mchod 'bul byas pa'i dus dang gnyis ka mthun par byung tshe/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyis dge rtsa bgyis pa bar dor phan par 'dug ste/ de bas kyang da lta bar do gcod pa stobs che gsungs/ sngon ri dwags gsod mkhan zhig 'gyel nas rbab du shor 'gro mi nus pa'i rdza khrod cig tu lhung bas/ der 'brug gcig nyal yod pa'i kha na lbu ba mang po thon pa zos nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ nye 'brel rnams kyis shi bar thag bcad nas/ de la dmigs nas dge rtsa rgya chen po btang bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor legs po byas pas dus skabs rnams su mi de'i sna sgor gsur dri mang po tshor bas/ ltogs skom gyi snang ba ye med par gyur/ phyis 'brug nam mkhar 'gro dus mjug ma la 'jus nas ri khar thon yul du log byung skad/ des 577

na 'o skol rnams kyis kyang pha ma mched grogs sogs tshe las 'das pa rnams la dmigs nas kyang dge rtsa btang / bsngo smon byas na phan yon chen po 'byung / dmyal bar skyes pa rnams kyang las ngan sgrib pa dag nas mtho ris su skye/ mtho ris su skyes pa rnams kyang dag pa'i zhing du skye/ — dag zhing du skyes pa rnams sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ mi shi ba de'i ming ma stor gyi bar du dge ba byas shing bsngos na phan gsungs skad/des na 'o skol rnams kyis pha ma nye 'brel pha mes yang mes sogs drin can gyi mi shi ba rnams kyi don du lan gcig tsam ma yin par ming ma stor gyi bar du yang dang yang du de dag gi don du dmigs nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs la bsngo 'brel/ ma ṇi pa sogs la bsod snyoms phul nas bsngo ba byed du bcug na shin tu legs/ yang rgya gar na mu stegs pa kun/ mchod sbyin dang tshogs gsog byed tsa na/ ra dang ma te stong phrag re tsam bsad nas mchod sbyin byas/ des thar pa thob pa la re ba yod skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang tshe 'das pa la dmigs nas dge rtsa gtong dus sogs la ra lug g.yag gsum sogs sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa sogs mi dge ba byas na/ mu stegs pa dngos yin pas de ltar byas 578

bsngo smon byas rung tshe 'das la phan pa las gnod che/ tshe 'das mtho ris su skye ba rnams kyang ngan song du lhung nas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur/ des na de 'dra byed mi rung / dngos po sdig dang ma 'dres pas tshogs bsags nas bsngo ba bya dgos/ mdor na rang gzhan gang gi don du yang / zhing dag pa bla ma dang dge 'dun nyam thag dbul 'phong sogs la/ dngos po dag pa sdig dang ma 'dres pas mchod sbyin byas/ bsngo ba dag pa rang gzhan gnas skabs su bde zhing / mthar thugs sangs rgya ba'i phyir bsngo smon byas na/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can la phan thogs par 'gyur ro/ /thun mtshams rnams su ji ltar bya tshul ni/ sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i thun mtshams rnams su dpe blta ba tshogs bsog sgrib sbyangs mdzad tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang byang chub lam rim 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i thun mtshams rnams su skyes bu gsum gyi lam de dag gi thad mkho ba'i ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams dang khyad par lam rim gzhan rnams la blta zhing / lam rgyud la 579

skye ba'i mthun rkyen du tshogs sgo du ma nas bsags pa dang /sgrib pa sbyong ba sgo du ma nas bya zhing / thams cad kyi gzhi mkhas blangs pa'i bsrung sdom mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba dang /gzhan yang zhi lhag gi lam bde blag tu skye ba'i rgyur dbang po'i sgo bsdam pa dang / shes bzhin du spyod pa dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa dang / mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson zhing / nyal ba'i tshe ji ltar bya ba ste/ tshogs bzhi la yang bslab par bya'o/ /de yang dbang po'i sgo sdom tshul ni/ yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong ba la bsten nas chags sdang skye bas/ yul bzang ngan gang dbang po rnams rgya yan du mi btang bar dbang po'i sgo bsdams nas/dge ba 'am/ yang na rang ka lung ma bstan du bzhag dgos te/po to ba'i gsung sgros las/ 'o skol mig gi yul du gzugs sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa la chags sdang skye ba la long pa'i 'du shes bskyed dgos/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa dang mi snyan pa la chags sdang skye ba la 'on pa'i 'du shes bskyed dgos/ gzhan rgol ba la lan 'don pa'i bsam pa skye na lkugs pa'i 'du shes bskyed dgos/ nyal ba'i tshe na ri dwags ltar thum phras kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos/ khyim pas 'dod pa la chags pa skyes na/btson ra lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed dgos/ zas nor la 'dun pa 580

skyes na dgra'am gshed ma lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed dgos /gsungs/ shes bzhin du spyod tshul ni/ mig gis blta ba dang /yan lag brkyang bskums/ chos gos lhung bzed kyi las/ zas za ba dang / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs bya ba gang byed rnams bag med pas ma yin par rtag tu dran shes bsten nas chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin spyod pa dgos/ dran shes ma bsten na nyes ltung 'byung ste/ sngon ral bskor mkhan gcig dang mda' tshan po gcig dang gnyis mtsho la gru btang nas 'thab pa la/nyin gcig mda' mkhan de ngo gnag ge byas nas chung ma can du 'ong nas/ mos ci nyes dris pas/ nged gnyis gyon po yin pa la/ nga'i mda' zad la khad/ mda' zad ma thag khos nga gsod byas pas/ chung ma na re/ nga la thabs yod kyi sang nga yang khrid cig zer te/ mos bca' ba dar byas nas gru nang du zhugs te/khong gnyis 'thab ba rdo tsa na/ o gru nang nas mgo rnyeng byas pas/ ral bskor mkhan mo la mig yengs nas mda' phog nas shi bas ral bskor mkhan na re/ bdag ni dgra yis ma bsad de/ /dran dang shes bzhin nyams pas bsad/ /de phyir blo dang ldan pa'i mis/ /dran dang shes bzhin rtag tu bsrung / /zer nas shi'o/ /de bzhin du 'o skol yang dran shes ma bsten par dbang 581

po'i yul la yengs na nyes lhung gi mda' 'phog gsungs/ po to ba'i gsung sgos las/ sgo gsum zhi ba dul ba bag dang ldan par byas nas mig gnya' shing gang tsam du blta dgos pa yin te/ nyi ma dgongs kha'i glang dor ba'am/ smyon pa shor ba bzhin du mig phyogs bzhir bltas/ ldog sna la rde'u spring spring byas pas chos dang ci la mthun gsungs/ sngon bram ze mo zhig gi bu chung bsnyal yod par sbrul zhig yongs pa/ ne'u le zhig yod pas bu chung la gnod kyis dogs nas sbrul bsad nas kha khrag byas bu chung gi sngas na yod pa mas mthong nas sngon du bu la ma bltas par ne'u les bu chung zas so snyam brgyab pas ne'u le bsad nas nyes ltung gis phog nas phugs ngan song du skye bas/ des na gang byed kyang dran shes kyis zin par byed dgos/ zas kyi tshod rig pa ni/zas ha cang nyung dang mang ba ma yin/ mi 'ju ba dang mi 'phrod pa ma yin/ log pa'i 'tsho ba ma yin par/ chos mthun gyi 'tsho ba 'grangs ltogs ran par bya dgos te/ po to ba'i gsung sgros las/ mi gcong can rgad po des/ kha zas gar thod thod mi za bar zas kyi tshod rig par byed de/ kha na zhim par snang yang gnod pa'i zas mi za/ 'phrad du yog par snang yang zhu mi zhu ba'i tshod bzung nas ran par za ba yin/ de bzhin du 'o skol 582

yang zas kyi tshod rig par byed dgos gsungs/ sngon dbus kyi mal gro'i bud med gcig gis/ bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i nyin mo bro skyor dang dus gnon la zas sna mang po g.yos nas zos pas/ bu na re/ a ma dang bsnyen gnas 'di bya bya nas/ do nub pho ba gnad nas 'gro na zer ro/ /de bzhin du 'o skol gyes kyang dad pa can gyi rdzas dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la bag tsha ba med par byung tshad blangs kyin cha le cho ler longs spyod pa 'di bya bya nas/ phyi mar ngan song du 'gro nyen yod pas gzab 'tshal/sngon rgyal po'i chad pas gsod pa'i bram ze bza' tsho gsum nags gseb na phar 'gro ba'i zhag bdun gyi rgyags las med pa la/ lam du zhag bcu gnyis 'gor bas shin tu nyon mongs pa la/ der bus pha ma gnyis la drin lan bsab pa'i ched du lcebs te sha pha mar zar bcug pas/ pha mas der yang dbang med nas sha zos te/ sha de yang zhim pas chags zhen med par zos pas 'gro sar gtol ba yin skad/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang bza' btung la chags zhen dang ro myang ba yid la mi byed par lus 'di gso la gzhan don du byang chub sgrub snyam pas zas gang la longs spyod dgos/ mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa ni/nyin par mtha' dag dang mtshan mo yang nam gyi cha stod smad la 583

mi nyal bar chos kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe ji ltar bya ba ni glo g.yas pa phab te rkang pa g.yon pa g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag nas seṅge ltar nyal la/ sang nyin yang snga bar langs nas dge chos la brtson par bya snyam du dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas gnyid log par bya'o/ /smras pa/ gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdu bsdu ba/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yi/ /gdams pa bzang po nyams su blangs pa'i mjug /thun mtshams ji ltar bya tshul bshad tshar song / /e ma rgya bod mkhas grub ma lus pa'i/ /thugs kyi nying khu skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /nyams su blang byar yod pa'i skal bzang rnams/ /don chung tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyang bsrings te/ /rnam g.yeng med pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas/ /spang gshongs nags tshal me tog bkra ba'i ljongs/ /khor yug ri dwags bag phebs rgyu ba'i sa/ /nyams dga' snang ba spro ba'i spyil bo ru/ /lus la phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'ching zhing / /gang byung ngan ngon zas kyi 'tsho ba la/ /bsten nas tshul bzhin nyams su len nus na/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar 'gyur/ /de ltar phar phyin theg pa'i lam bzang la/ /bslab na nam zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas nyam thag sems can yang / /sangs rgyas sa 584

la 'dren par gdon mi za/ /'on kyang rang gi ngos nas nyam thag gi /sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med kyi/ /me nang bskal pa rgya mtshor sdod dgos kyang / /snying rjes mi skyo brtson 'grus go yod kyang / /ma gyur sems can thams cad bzod med kyi/ /sdug bsngal drag pos yun ring mnar tshul dang / /sangs rgyas thob nas 'gro kun sdug bsngal las/ /sgol ba'i nus pa yod pa'i tshul bsam tshe/ /gzhan gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas go 'phang de/ /de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring yang / /thob na snyam pa'i shugs drag snying rje yis/ /bskyod pas byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can rnams/ /tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /rgyu yi phar phyin theg pa'i lam bzang la 'bras bu sngags lam bsnon pa 'debs nus na/ /dal 'byor don ldan 'gyur tshul zur tsam bshad/ /de yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa de dag la bslabs na/ ma 'ongs pa'i skyes pa bzang po brgyud nas bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi mthar nam zhig sems can thams cad la phan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ci 'dra ba zhig 'ong mod/ 'on kyang de tsam gyis chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ de yi rgyu mtshan rang gi ngos 585

nas sems can re re'i phyir yang dmyal ba'i me nang du bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas nas sangs rgyas sgrub dgos kyang mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha yod kyang / pha ma sems can gzhan bzod klag med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i tshul la bsam na/sems can gzhan gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring tsam la thob thabs shig mchis na byed dgos te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i sems can bye ba ther 'bum sdug bsngal las sgol ba'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa'i snying rje drag pos kun nas bslangs te myur bar myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas sems can thams cad la phan btags snyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can gsang sngags nyams su len nges pa rnams kyis da dung de tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin par rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa la 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi bsnon pa btab nas nyams su blangs na rnal 'byor pa brtson 'grus can skal ba rab rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya/ 'bring 'chi kha/ tha ma yang 586

bar do/ yang tha yang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba gsum mam/ bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad la/ 'tshang rgya ba gsang sngags kyi rgyud mang po nas gsungs la/ dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis mdo sngags kyi lam gnyis zung 'brel du nyams su blangs pa la bsten nas mchog thun dngos grub thob tshul gyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mtha' yas te/ sngon mgon po klu sgrub kyis zung 'jug gi sku brnyes nas dgung lo drug brgya bzhugs/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dgung lo dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bzhugs/ slob dpon pad+ma dang paṇa chen bi ma mitra rnam gnyis 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ pha dam pa rgya gar dgung lo lnga brgya dang bcu bdun tsam bzhugs/ gshegs rgyu yin pa'i snga lo'i nyin gcig lo rjes ma'i da tsam ding ri la rgya gar gyi a tsa ra rgan po zhig gi ro zhig yong gsungs/ lo rjes ma'i de dus tsam la sku bsnyung tshul bstan pas bu slob rnams kyis bsnyung gzhi ci 'dra dris pas/sems na bar 'dug gsungs/ sems ci ltar bsnyung dris pas/snang sems gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas na tshul zhig 'dug ste smra mi shes par 'dug gsungs/ bcos thabs dris pas lus na ba yin na thabs yod de/ sems na ba bcos thabs med gsungs/ zhal chems gsungs nas mthar ngo mtshar ba'i 587

ltas dang bcas te gshegs/ rwa los 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim bsgoms nas rwa shad byas/ yang lha sham po'i brag bsnyil/sa steng sems dpa' bcu gsum bgrongs kyang skyon gyis ma gos/byang chub 'od dang rwa lo gnyis kyis nus mthu 'gran pas/byang chub 'od kyis phur ba dbal na me 'bar ba mi tshad cig btang ba/ rwa los bsrung 'khor dgu bsgom pa brtol nas byung /phyis rwa los de ci'i khyad yin dris pas byang chub 'od na re/nged gnyis bskyed rim la khyad mi 'dug ste rdzogs rim gye lta ba'i dgongs pa mtho dman gyi khyad yin gsungs skad/ grub chen lwa ba pas rdzogs rim lo bcu gnyis bsgom pa'i mthar tsa ri nas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ rje mi las lo phyed dang brgyad bsgoms pas nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas ston nus pa sogs dzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa byung / gshegs khar bu slob rnams la nga yun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ khyed rnams nga la nyan nas nga bzhin byed na/ nga phyir 'brong zhig nga phyir 'brong zhig gsungs/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang la bzhug nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa'i shing yos lo'i dgun zla tha chung tshes bcu bzhi nyi shar la ltas cho 'phrul dpag med bcas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su 588

gshegs/ ma gcig lab sgon dgung lo drug cu la slar tshems skyes gzhon sha chags/ phags sgra dang bcas ri brag la thogs med du bsgrod cing / sras thod smyon lha 'dres g.yang la skyur ba dbu tshal pa mang por chag pa phyag gis byil ba mdzad pase sngar ltar sos/ mngon shes la thogs pa med dgung lo dgu bcu go lnga lon pa'i mthar gshegs khar/ bu slob rnams la tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par 'dod pas gcod chos 'di la nyams len mdzod gsungs/ sbyan nam mkha' la cher gzigs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /dam chos zab mo gcod chos 'di/ /gdams ngag gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /byin rlabs lus sems 'bral ba 'di/ /'pho ba gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /nga rang rgan mo lab sgron 'di/ /bud med gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs nas/ mthar 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gsum gyi gdugs shar dros la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te nub phyogs u rgyan du gshegs/ sngon jo bo chen pos rgya mtsho chen por gru btang nas bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du phebs pa'i tshe dbang phyug chen pos rlung dmar g.yos/ / gru bshig par brtsam tshe gshin rje gshed kyi bskyed rim gyi sgo nas 589

btul dus der yod pa kun gyis lha dngos su mthong / sku gshegs dus 'brom gyis gsol ba btab dus slar yang byon nas zhal bstan cing slar yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag med bcas dga' ldan du gshegs/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bsgrubs nas/ 'jam dbyangs la mi la mi bzhin dam pa'i chos kyi dka' gnad rnams kyi dri ba mdzad chog cing / sku gshegs dus rdzogs rim gye 'od gsal la bzhugs dus sku gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can blta bas chog mi shes pa gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro ba zhig tu gyur nas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas dga' ldan du gshegs/ spyan snga bas lan zhig ser ba zhig byung ba pra phab nas brtags pas/ sbrul chen po mjug ma phyi'i rgya mtshor lus pa/ mgo po ri rab kyi kha na slebs pa gcig gi kha nas gtong 'dug pa la/ hū phaṭa byas pas rgya mtsho'i nang du dmar nyog gis song nas 〈 rnal 'byor shes rab rdo rje la/ klu srin mo zhig bar chad la byung bas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa byas pas bros nas song bas phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas phyi mig cig bltas nas yang phyi'i rgya mtsho rang yang brgal nas bros/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rta mgrin gyi rta skad bton pas 'dre klad 590

pa na nas bros/ lha rje bsam gtan bya bas thugs rje chen po'i bzlas pa tshad du bskyal bas rta mgrin gyis dbang lan gsum bskur ba'i snang ba byung / pha ri'i nags la me shor ba la rgyang nas sngags btab pas bsad/ nyin gcig thog zhig babs byung ba mdzub mo la dkris nas pha rol gye brag la brgyab/gshegs dus nam mkha' la bzang spyod 'don gyin gshegs skad/ lho brag mar pa dang sras dar ma mdo sde gnyis kyis 'pho ba grong 'jug mdzad/ gshegs khar mar pas yum bdag med ma thugs gar bstem/ bu kun 'pho ba spar na 'di ltar gyis gsungs/ 'pho ba spar chog mdzad pas spyi gtsug gi thod pa'i dum bu zhig yar ba'i nang nas/ 'od bya mo'i sgong nga tsam zhig nam mkha' la song nas gshegs/ sras dar ma mdo sde gshegs khar phug ron la grong 'jug ra/dzad/ 'phur nas rgya gar du song dur khrod du ro gsar ba bskyal ba la grong 'jug mdzad nas/gsang sngags te phu'i sdong po zhes bya bar gyur/ ras chung ba/ras chung ma/ g.yu thog gsar rnying rnams kyis lus ma spangs par sku lus de nyid kyi steng nas mkha' spyod du mi kun gyi mthong sar gshegs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyi khye dang rta sogs bsad nas slar gsos/ nyi zer la 'khor gsum bkal ba sogs grub 591

rtags du ma bstan/ gshegs khar brla g.yas pa'i steng du 'ja' zug nas gshegs/ phyis bltas tshe brla de na thugs rje chen po'i rus sku ngo mtshar can zhig bzhugs skad/ sngon jo bo'i bla ma gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa khong sdong po zhig gi rtsa na bzhugs skabs mi gcig byung nas shing sdong bcad pas/ ma gcod/ yang yang byas pas ma nyan tshe yar bzhengs nas zhabs sa la brdabs nas khyod kyis nga su yin shes sam byas pas grong nas mi lnga byung nas mi de la gri re brgyab nas bsad pas/ slar bzod gsol byas pas/ nga'i zhabs khrus la rma nang du blug gsungs pa ltar byas pas mi de slar sos pa byung / yang nyin gcig yul de'i rgyal po'i steng du dmag chen po zhig chu bo gaṅga brgal nas slebs byung ba dmag bzlog mdzad par zhu zhus pas/gtor ma zhig btang ba bye'u chung chung zhig byung nas zos pas/bya chen po zhig tu gyur pa nam mkhar 'phur bas gshog sgro'i rlabs kyis rlung nag 'tshub ma chen po byung bas dmag thams cad gaṅga'i pha rol tu bskyal bas/ dmag de rnams la yang nyes skyon med pa byung / gshegs khar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan nas gshegs/ grub thob thang stong rgyal pos dgung lo brgya dang brgyad bzhugs pa'i mthar 592

nam mkha' la yar gyen du 'phags/ nas gshegs/ sngon byang bdag rig 'dzin chen pos mi gcig shi nas zhag mang po song ba zhig kyang slar gsos sha ma za dang lo gsum sdod gsungs pas khos lo gcig song nas sha zhig zos pas shi ba byung / khong gis ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan nas gshegs/ rje btsun seṅge dbang phyug 'o yug phyi gong gi thad ga'i nam mkha' nas 'od dang sgra dang bcas te gshegs/ grub chen te lo pas bu kun bskyed rim rdzogs rim du bsdu na 'di ltar gyis gsungs/ nam mkha' la 'phags nas zhal nas a zhes brjod pas lus 'od du zhu nas je chung je chung du gyur nas nam mkha' la yal ba dang / a yi sgra de yang chung ngu chung ngu gyur nas yal song / grub chen me long rdo rjes bu slob rnams la zhal chems kyi mgur gsungs mthar hika brjod pas spyi bo mas 'od phub tsam zhig nam mkha' la song / de cher song sbra tsam/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur 'od dang sgra dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag med bcas gshegs/ sngon po to ba gzhon dus/ shar ba shāka dbang zer ba'i sngags rnying ma mkhan gcig shi ba'i pur sbyangs pa la 'ja' 'od la sogs byung ba yab la dris pas/ bsgom chen zhig 593

grongs pa yin zer bas/ bsgom chen de 'dra ba zhig ngas kyang byed dgos dgongs pa byung / sngon a mdo phyogs kyi sngags pa gcig shi bas pur sbyangs pa'i rus pa rnams ma nyams par dkar krong nge gdes pa la lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan du ma'i rang byon/ sha khrag zhu ba thams cad kha dog sna lnga'i 'phel gdung du song nas sran ma bzhin spar ba byas blangs chog pa zhig byung skad/ yang bdag gi drin can bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sku pur bzhu ba'i nyin gyi tho rangs gdung khang steng du shar phyogs nas 'ja' tshon chen po zhig zug pa der yod pa'i 'tshogs pa kun gyis mthong zhing me rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par 'bar ba dang / kha dog sna lnga'i 'phel gdung sran ma tsam mang po byung / gzhan yang grub chen brgyad cu rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs/ rgya bod du grub thob pho mo nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam zhig byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rnams bshad na mtha' yas/ de dag rnams la dgongs nas bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams gyi zhal nas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis/slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas/ lam bskyed rdzogs kyi thabs zab mo rnams thun bzhi la sogs pas nyams su blangs na/ sangs rgyas zan dron mo lag 594

pas bzo byed pa'i tshod yin par 'dug gsungs/ des na rab tu spro ba'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la bsten nas gsang sngags nye lam gyi sgor zhugs nas zab mo'i gdams pa rnams nyams su blangs te dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par mdzod cig /smras pa/ zla med ston pa sangs rgyas ri dbang de/ /thugs sras ri bo bye ba'i dbus na mdzes/ /ngo mtshar mi pham 'jam dbyangs gser gyi ri/ /yon tan rin thang che zhes kun gyis gleng / /dri med thub bstan lha yi lam yangs por/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar tshogs kyis rab brgyan yang / /zab rgyas legs bshad 'od snang rab spro ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med nyi zla yin par khums/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur btsugs/ /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde yis sa steng kun/ /'gengs mdzad jo bo blo bzang yab sras kyi/ /sku drin gzhal dgos byung na su yis 'khor/ /byang chub lam rim ston pa'i bla ma rje/ /rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /khyod spangs sangs rgyas byon yang phyag mi 'tshal/ /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /brgyud pa khungs btsun thub dbang zhal snga nas/ /legs 'ongs zab rgyas chos tshul mtha' yas kyang / /kun 595

gyi gnad don byang chub lam rim gyi/ /glegs bam chung chung zhig la 'dus pa mtshar/ /thos na go sla bsam na rgyud la phan/ /bsgoms na mchog dman bar gsum thams cad grol/ /de phyir 'di nyid bka' gdams gong ma yi/ /sprul ba'i glegs bam zhig dang cis mi 'dra/ /bdag sems gsal stong kun dga' ra ba na/ /legs ba༅/da zab mo'i glegs bam cir yang snang / /nang nas bka' gdams sprul ba'i glegs bam 'di/ /skal bzang rnams la ster ba'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs don rtogs pa dka'/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i 'gal 'khrul byung srid na/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /'di yis bstan 'gror phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /gling bzhi gling phran pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /dbus kyi ri dbang ze'u 'bru nam gnas par/ /legs bshad 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan par shog /bdag gzhan deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ dal 'byor rten thob mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa la/ /'phags pa rtag tu ngu dang 'gran par shog /ngoms pa med par rgya chen thos pa btsal/ /gsung rab gdams par shar nas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgo nas 596

spel ba la/ /kun mkhyen tsong kha pa dang mtshungs par shog /tshe 'di'i lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /dben pa snying rus bskyed nas rtse gcig tu/ /bsgoms nas tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa la/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa lta bur shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob nas/ /zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor nas 'gro ba kun/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam la 'god pa la/ /'dren mchog shakya'i dbang por mnyam par shog /ces bka' gdams sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lugs gnyis kun mkhyen smra ba'i dbang phyug sde ba dbang po dang blo bzang tshe ring / mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i blo bzang dge legs dang / bstan 'dzin rab rgyas/ bslab gsum rgyan gyes mdzes pa'i sbyin pa nor bu dang / blo bzang tshul khrims/'phags pa'i nor gyes phyug pa'i blo bzang sbyin pa dang / bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i ngag dbang seng ge dang / mtha' yas rgya mtsho/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i 'jigs med rgyal mtshan dang / bsod nams snyan grags/kun spangs rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig bstan 'dzin ras pa dang /kun bzang gzhan phan/ tshe 'di'i snang shas dor nas dben par sgrub la gzhol ba'i bstan 'dzin dbang phyug dang / skal 597

bzang shes rab sogs dad can gyi slob ma mang pos sems la phan pa'i gdams pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgos gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas rang bzhin gyi rgyud la phan du re ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ bya btang ri khrod pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang / dgra bcom mang po'i bzhugs gnas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams/ 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba/ gnas chen gangs dkar te se'i ngo mtshar rdzu 'phral phug gi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o ༄smras pa/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po'i don/ /kun 'dus bka' gdams sprul ba'i glegs bam mchog /stod smad yongs la rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel nas par du bsgrubs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal bstan nor bu yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan/ /'gro la bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad yams mu ge dang / /'thab rtsod 'khrug pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /khyad par par 'di'i don 598
du 'bad pa yi/ /par dpon slob ma sbyin bdag thams cad kyi/ /gnas skabs tshe dang bsod nams chos 'phel zhing / /mthar thag sangs rgyas go 'phang myar thob shog /sarba mang li// //༄ ༄ ga599

༄༅ / /snying rje sprul ba'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣa ya/ g.yas nas tsan dan lde gus byugs pa dang / /g.yon nas sta gris gshags pa gnyis la yang / /nye ring chags sdang med par brtse bas skyong / /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i don du mnar med du/ /bskal chen khri phrag mang por gnas dgos kyang / /snying rjes mi skyo gzhan don lhur len pa'i/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems 'byongs nas/ /nyam thag 'gro don mdzad la skyo ngal med/ /gnod pa'i dgra yang bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /nang ba sangs rgyas pa yi khyad chos mchog /legs tshogs yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje rin po che/ /bdag gzhan rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dam chos bsgrubs las 'byung ste de yi ni/ /rtsa ba snying rje dag la rag las pas/ /600

thog mar snying rje kho na bstod par bgyi/ /snying rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /cod pan thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro la sogs pas/ /gnod pa bya ba'i 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'khor lo yod pa la/ /'khor dang dpungs rnams shugs kyis 'du ba ltar/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje yod pa la/ /chos gzhan kun yang shugs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa sangs/ /de yi drod kyis 'gro la phan pa ltar/ /snying rje rgyud la shar na nyon mongs sangs/ /de yi chos kyis 'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par/ /'dod pas chos kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du/ /snying rje bsgom pa shin tu gal che zhes/ /gsungs rnams sgogs la rang nyid spro bar gyur/ /de'i phyir snying rje dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /lung 'dren mang po byas nas 'chad pa la/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad mar 'dzin pa yi/ /dad ldan snying rje 'dod rnams dga' bas nyon/ /de yang myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas dam pa'i chos byed dgos/ chos kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gang du yang snying rje 'di gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ji skad du/slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ gang phyir 601

brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun sum tshogs 'di yi/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod 'gyur ba/ /de'i phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ thog mar gal che ba ni/ snying rje chen pos yid bskyod nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba las 'don pa'i phyir nges par dam bca' bar 'gyur la/ snying rje med na de ltar byed par mi 'ong bas/ 'gro ba ma lus sgol ba'i khur 'khyer ba ni/ de la rag las pa'i phyir dang / khur de mi 'dzin na theg pa chen por mi chud pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ bar du gal che ba ni/de ltar lan cig sems de lta bur skyes nas zhugs kyang /sems can grangs mang zhing bya byed ngan pa dang / bslab par bya ba yang shin tu bya dka' zhing mtha' yas pa dang / dus kyang dpag tu med par dgos par mthong ba na zhum nas theg pa dman par ltung ba la/ snying rje chen po lan cig bskyed pa tsam ma yin par je 'phel du goms par byas pas rang gi bde sdug la mi blta zhing / gzhan gyi don la mi skyo bas tshogs thams cad bde blag tu rdzogs par byed gsungs/ tha mar gal che ba ni/sangs rgyas rnams 'bras bu brnyes pa'i tshe yang / theg dman 602

bzhin zhi bar mi gnas par/ nam mkha' ji srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yang snying rje chen po'i mthu ste/ de med na nyan thos ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro gsungs/ 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam thar las/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i cod pan thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ ngan song ngan 'gro la sogs gnod pa bya ba'i 'jigs pa med do gsungs/ chos yang dag par bsdud pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu sgrub pa la gnas pa ji ltar rigs par bya/ smras pa/ gang sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rje chen po mi 'dor ba'o/ /zhes pa dang / snying rje chen po ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/zhes pa dang / yang sems can gyi zhing ni byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing las sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'thob par 'gyur bas de la log par sgrub par mi rigs so/ /zhes pa dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ snying rje byams pa'i sprul ba 'di 'dra ba/ /sems can sgrol slad phan pa'i sems ldan pas/ /rnam dag yid can 'di ni ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i 'gro ba lha dang mir bcas dkon/ /zhes pa dang / yang blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ glo gros rgya mtsho gsum 603

po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bla na med pa'o/ /gang zhe na/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang /gang chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang / gang sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / yang de nyid las/ blo gros rgya mtsho byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po bsdud par 'gyur ba'i chos ni gcig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems mi brjed cing bag yod pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos gcig ste 'di ltar bdag gi bde ba la mi chags pa'i snying rje chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mtshan brjod las/ snying rje che dang shes rab dang / /thabs kyi 'gro don byed pa'i mchog /dga' mgu rangs pa'i bsam pa can/ /zhes dang / he badz+ra las/ stong pa snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes de la bya/ /zhes dang / bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ gnyis med sems kyi sdong bo dam pa ni/ /khams gsum ma lus kun tu khyab par song / /snying rje'i me tog gzhan phan 'bras bus 'dzin/ /ming ni mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gā ya go ri'i mdo las/ snying rje dang thabs dang byang chub sems la goms par byas pas/ tshe 'di nyid la gdon mi za bar khyad par du 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdo las/ bzang 604

skyong / byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin te/ gang zhe na/ bdag la mi chags pa dang /gzhan la bde ba stobs pa dang / snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / chos yongs su 'tshol ba'i mi ngoms pa ste bzhi po dag go /zhes gsungs/ mdo sdud pa las/ gang la phan dang snying brtser bcas pas spyad spyad pa/ /rigs sngags 'di la bslab nas mkhas pa byang chub reg /'dus byas bde dang 'dus ma byas bde gang yin pa/ /bde ba de kun 'di las 'byung bar rigs par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/snying rje mdun du bzhag nas su/ /dge ba spel la nan tan bya/ /gsungs/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ theg pa chen po lta bas ma phye snying rjes phye gsungs/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems su de brjod bya/ /zhes dang /brtag gnyis las/ gang shes rab dang snying rje che ba ni theg pa chen po yin la/ gang chung ba rnams ni theg pa chung ngu'o/ /zhes dang / yum las/ byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po dang dga' ba chen po dang btang snyoms chen po'i chos ston zhes dang / byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpas ni dbul por 'gyur du dogs pa'i 'jigs pas sbyin pa sbyin par yang mi 605

byed de/ snying rje'i bsam pa 'ba' zhig gis byed do/ /ces dang /gzhan yang yid la mi byed par sems can rnams la snying brtse bar bsgom par byed do/ /de bsgoms pa'i rgyus sems can rnams la snying rje ba'i bsam pa 'thob par 'gyur te/ des na sems can gyi don du ngan song rnams la khyem du gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas par byed gsungs/ grub thob bir+yā pa'i zhal nas/ thogs med brtse bas bskyangs pa yi/ /drin can rnams la snying rje bsams/ /gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang / /smyon pa lta bur rang dbang med/ /mi dge'i las kyis mnar med 'gyur/ /de ltar dran pas srid gsum la/ /snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ des na snying rje theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin te/ 'di med na pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bskyed rdzogs sogs mdo sngags kyi lam la ci tsam 'bad kyang theg pa chen por mi tshud/ theg pa dman par ltung bar 'gyur bas/ thabs du ma'i sgo nas snying rje bsgoms pa la nyin mtshan med par 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang slob dpon dpa' bo'i zhal nas/ yon tan ma lus byang chub sems la brten/ /byang chub mchog sems snying rje'i rgyu las 'byung / /zhes dang / de yis mdzad pa'i phar phyin bsdus pa 606

las/ /ye shes snang ba mkha' ltar yangs pa la/ /snying rje ldan pa gcig bu pha rol brgal/ /sems can ma lus kun la khyab pa yi/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten kun tu 'byung / /zhes dang / rje mi las/ stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro don 'grub/ /'gro don —'grub na nga dang mjal gsungs/ lung gzhan las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' mnyam bzhag pas/ /goms pa'i stobs kyis rdzogs pa na/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa la/ /khyad par du yang snying rje skye/ /zhes dang / dbang mdor bstan las/ stong nyid dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /dmigs med snying rje'i 'bras bu 'byung / /zhes dang / sems can mgu bar bya ba'i bstod pa las/ nga la gus pa sems can don te gus pa gzhan dag min/ /gang gis snying rje ma btang nga la gus pa ste/ /snying rjes btang na gnas par gyur pa ltung ba gang yin pa/ /de ni snying rjes blangs par nus kyis gzhan gyis min/ /gang gis snying rje sems can rjes su zhugs gyur pa/ /des ni nga yang mnyes byas des ni bstan pa'i khur yang bzung / /tshul khrims thos pa snying rje dag dang blo dang gsal ba dag /gang la yod pa des ni rtag tu bde bar gshegs pa mchod/ /gsungs/ don gyi lam 607

rim be'u bum sngon po las/ theg pa che la snying rje gal che/ de yang sbrul khar tshud pa lta bu med na byang chub sems dpa'i ming mi 'ong / zhes pa ste dug sbrul gyi steng du bya rnams kyis 'phur dus/ kho'i kha rlangs kyis phog na bya de 'bros snyam yang 'bros sa med/ sbrul de la yang da bya gtong snyam yang / bya nam mkha' la lding ba de/ kho'i steng du sdigs kyis lhung yong / de bzhin du snying rje chen po yod na sems can byed ngan pa dang / byas pa mi gzo ba dang / grangs mang ba dang / stong pa nyid yin pa sogs ci yod kyang / snying rje des zin nas slar ma btang gi bar du 'dzin pa dam du 'cha'/ rkyen gyis bsgyur mi thub pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ de 'dra'i snying rje chen po zhig med na byang chub sems dpa'i ming rang yang mi 'ong gsungs/ dpe yi lam rim rin chen srungs pa las/ khams pa 'jam dpal bya ba'i rkang pa na ba gcig la/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ da khyod kyi ma rgan yul sna gdong na/ khyi tshan zhig gis rmug gin 'dug grogs kyang su yang mi 'dug byas na/ rkang pa na ba rang yang mi dran par/ sdug rgan ma des de na ci byed na zer nas 'thengs khyer ling nge cha nges gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol la sems can thams cad la ma'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa re skyes na/ sems 608

can gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsam na snying rje shas mi bzod pa zhig 'ong ste gsungs/ de ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes na/smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems rang dbang med par skye/ de skyes tsam na stong pa snying rje gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems skye ba la tshegs med de/ mdo las/ gang la mgo mchis pa la 'tsho ba mchis so/ /gang la snying rje mchis pa la byang chub kyi sems mchis so/ /gang la byang chub kyi sems mchis pa la sangs rgyas mchis so/ /gsungs/ skyes rabs las/ skye bo snying rje med pas na/ /nang mi la yang phyi mi bzhin/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams/ /mi rigs spyod pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de bas chos la dad pa yis/ /snying rje btang bar mi bya ste/ /char 'bab lo tog 'phel ba bzhin/ /de las yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ /de la snying rje'i bsam pas kyang las dge ba tshe 'di la pyong bar 'gyur te/ 'di ltar 'di na kha cig sems can pha rol rnams dang / gang zag pha rol rnams la snying rje'i bsam pa dang / phan pa'i bsam pa shas cher mngon par 'du byed pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / nyi khri snang ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ni/ /srid pa dga' bar 609

byed pa ste/ /blo yis der ni gnas pa yang / /brkam pa rjes su sems ma yin/ /zhes dang / ye shes dam pas zhus par/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje de lta bu dang ldan pa ni/ nyes pa'i chos dang yang ldan par mi 'gyur la/ nyes pa thams cad spongs par byed do/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gang gi sems kyang pyong min pa'i/ /snying rje yis ni rnam brgyan pa/ /de yi grogs por 'jig rten 'dir/ /'gyur ro snyan pa kun tu khyab/ /gang zhig snying rjes rnam brgyan dang / /mi yi 'jig rten na de lha/ /snying rje yi ni gang dbul ba/ /de ni shin tu dbul bar 'dod/ /snying rje thub pas bsngags pa yin/ /snying rje dri med snying po yin/ /snying rjes skyon rnams 'joms pa'o/ /snying rje zad pa med pa'i gter/ /yon tan rgyan rnams kyi yang mchog /snying rje'i bzhon ma gang la yod/ /de ni mchog gi 'o ma ldan/ /theg chen rkyal ba la zhon pa'i/ /brtse ba'i snying rje lag gnas nas/ /skyon gsum rlabs ni shugs po che/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol byed/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas kyang /snying rje snying ni 'jag gyur pa/ /ye shes thar pa de yin gyi/ /chos gzhan mang pos ci zhig bya/ /mi 'tshe chos kyi mchog yin par/ /grub pa'i mtha' ni kun las 'dod/ /ces gsungs/ glang ri 610

thang pas na bza' zhig phul te/ spyan snga ba la gdams ngag zhus pas/ byams pa snying je ston pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gsungs nas/ byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa 'di man ngag yin snyam pa yin gsungs/ byed na re res kyang chog gam snyam pa lta bu lags so gsungs/ dge bshes phu chung ba dang khams pa lung ba de kun/chos gsungs res kyis/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang ldan/byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan/ smon lam gyis kha lo bsgyur/ man ngag 'di kho na yin snyam pa yin jo bo ba bya ba zhig kho na gsungs/ dge bshes shwa bo pas/ byams snying rje gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs pas/ glang thang pas phyag 'tshal nas/ bdag dus da nas bzung ste byams snying rje bsgom par zhu zhus pas/ shwa bo pas dbu zhwa phud nas/ phyag spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/ shin tu cha yang bzang lags zhes lan gsum gsungs/ rgya gar mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i man ngag lam rim las/ sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /snying rje'i thag pa ma chad par/ /nyon mongs lam las sgol byed cing / /byams pa dag gis mnyes par gyis/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i btson ra las/ /snying rje'i zhags pa cher brkyangs nas/ /nyon mongs 'dam nas 'dren par byed/ /snying rje chen 611

por skyo mi byed/ /ces dang / snying rje chen po goms byas na/ /rnal 'byor don chen rtogs pa yis/ /dus mtha' med par de ltar sgoms/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /spyod yul sangs rgyas nyid dang gcig /rgyu spyod bsod nams tshogs chen ldan/ /gsungs/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ gzhan phan zhan med kyi snying rje 'di/ /thabs kyi mchog tu btsir gyis bzung / /zhes dang / snying rje med pa'i chos pa de/ /'bad rtsol byas kyang nyan thos lam/ /zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ sems can la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje yod na/ bya ba thams cad dor nas sems can ci 'drongs byed pa zhig 'ong / de la brten nas pha ma yin ngo shes par go nye ring gcig kyang med/ de dag bde na skyid na dga' ba'i sems 'ba' zhig sbyong ngo / /de yang sangs rgyas thob na bde skyid thams cad zhor la 'ong bas/ sangs rgyas la ci 'khod byed pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'brom des na phan sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin/ snying rje la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad 'byung gsungs/ sngon 'phags skyes bo'i bus rang gi nye du rnams yab kyis bsad pa thos nas/ snying rje skyes pa'i dbang gis/ 'di nas rtsed mo byed pa'i sil snyan sgra ma yal bzhin du yab kyis bgrongs ma thag sum cu rtsa gsum du lha'i bu 612

mo rnams kyis rol mo byed pa'i nang du skyes pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas so/ /skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos/ nga yi bu slob gang yin pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i brgyud pa bzung / /rje gong ma 'di las byung ba yin gsungs/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ dpal nā ro pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ sngon du phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa'i don rtogs par byas te/ de rgyud la legs par brtan pa'i ngang nas/ sems can thams cad la nye ring med pa'i snying rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i don du yon tan dpag tu med pa'i rtsal sbyongs gsungs/ rje rgod tshang ba'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba zhig pas/ bdag gzhan brje nus pa'i snying rje skyes pa/ nga snying rje'i ngos gdams pa yin gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa la rnal 'byor pa chen pos/ kho bo la rlung mnyam 'jug la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di dang 'di yod byas pas/ khyod la rna rtsar rnga bo che brdungs kyang mi shigs pa'i sgom yod kyang /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems med na nyin mtshan du bshags pa bya dgos pa'i sar skye ba yin no gsungs/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni stong pa nyid kyi ngang tshul can te 'khor ba la mi gnas so/ /byang chub 613

sems dpa' ni snying rje'i ngang tshul can te mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas/ zhes dang / rab tu zhi ba cho 'phrul gyi mdo las kyang / sems can thams cad la byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems yid la byed pas gnas pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi rgyan no/ /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/ smon pa dang ni 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin zab dang rgya che dang / /mi ldog 'bras bu thob pas na/ /theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags/ /de yi sngon du 'gro ba ni/ /brtan pa rnams kyi snying po'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas kyang / snying rje brtan pas byang chub kyi sems brtan par 'gyur te/ skye ba dang gnas pa dang mthar thug gi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ sems can la snying rje che ba ni rnyed par dka' gsungs so/ /nam mkha' klong yangs las/rtogs pa'i rten 'brel sems la 'char ba dang / /byams dang snying rje phyogs ris med pa dang / /chos rnams kun la dag snang skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs pa yin/ /gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge la yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces snying rje yod na theg 614

pa chen po'i rigs su gsungs/ yang mdo sde rgyan las/ snying rjes zin pa'i brtse ldan rnams/ /zhi la'ang yid ni mi gnas na/ /'jig rten bde dang rang srog la/ /chags par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos/ nyon mongs zad na chos la bya rgyu med/ /snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yang dang yang du soms/ /chos la phyi bshol ma mdzad rje 'bangs rnams/ /gsungs/ dbu ma rgyan las/ yang dag bshes 'tshol sngon btang ste/ /don dam rnam par nges gyur nas/ /lta ngan 'thib gnas 'jig rten la/ /snying rje kun tu bskyed nas su/ /'gro don byed pa dpa' gyur pa/ /byang chub blo rgyas mkhas pa ni/ /blo dang snying rjes brgyan pa yi/ /thub pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag spyod/ /zhes dang / pha dam pas/ stong nyid rtogs pas sdig pa byas pas sto'am mi sto zhus pas/ stong pa nyid rtogs pas sdig pa bya don med/ stong nyid rtogs pa dang snying rje skye ba dus mnyam gsungs/ gzhan yang snying rje dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang phan yon mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas yang dang yang du gsungs te/ gtsug na rin po che'i mdo las/ de byams pa'i go cha bgos shing / snying rje chen po'i gnas la gnas nas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong 615

pa nyid mngon par bsgrubs pa la bsam gtan du byed do gsungs/ phal bo che las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ sems can gyi khams la dmigs nas lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rtsom pa thams cad ni 'khor ba na rgyu ba rnams yang dag par 'dren pa'i phyir tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag gam/'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtsug lag gi sbyor bas yang dag par brtson zhing / dge ba la bskul ba ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'o/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'o/ /thar pa'i lam po che'i srol btod pa'o/ /skyes bu dam pa'o/ /rin po che'i tog go /gsungs/ khri brgyad stong pa las/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa tshad ma nges pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa bsgom par bya'o zhes dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /de'i phyir thog mar snying rje bsngags par bgyi/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ gdod nas skye med don de ni/ /blo yis gting nas rtogs gyur na/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du byings pa la/ /616

snying rje ngang gis skye bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ slob dpon dpa' po'i zhal nas/ na ba'i bu la khyad par du/ ma ni gdung ba skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /dam pa min la khyad par brtse/ /zhes dang / slob dpon bha bh+ya'i zhal nas/ sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal can dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /snying rje rus pa'i gting nas ni/ /skye zhing de la phan par byed/ /ces dang / do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang / /'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gang dag gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes dang /snying po mchog las/ snying rje chen pos ni sems las su rung ba dang / 'tshe ba med pa dang / dga' bas brgyan pa'i mchog thob par byed do zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ snying rjes 'dod chags gnas su dag /kun rtog ye shes chos kyi sku/ /zhes dang /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ snying rjes 'dod chags med cing chos kyi sku/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /ces dang / gtsang spyon he ru gas/ bdag pas gzhan gces snying rje med na/ /stong nyid go ba ji ltar bzang yang / /617

chad lta'i grub mtha' logs na med do/ /rang sems snying rje'i chu rgyun med na/ /jo bzang bzang brdzus rang gzhan bslu'o/ /gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgom pa'i rim pa mdo kun las btus pa las/ sems can rnams la snying rje che ba/rnyed par dka' ba cis mngon zhe na mdo sde mang po las thos pa'i phyir te/ zla ba'i snying po'i le'u las 'byung ba/ grogs po dag sems can rnams la snying rje ba dang / snying brtse ba ni rnyed par dka' ste/ dgra dpa' bo lag na rdo rje thogs shing drag tu 'debs pa'i nang nas sgol ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo las 'byung ba/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu mngon par mos pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /dper na ma'i srog gi sngon du 'gro ba ni dbugs 'byin pa dang rngubs pa'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po yang dag par bsgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rin po che thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ni 'khor lo rin po che'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po yang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro'o zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las bdag gi 'khrul pa la so 618
