sor rtog cing / gzhan gyis 'khrul pa la snying rje ba'o zhes kyang gsungs so/ /khyem bdag dpas byen gyis zhus pa las kyang /khyim bdag rnams 'di la byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de lus dang srog la ma chags par bya'o/ /nor dang 'bru dang / khyim dang / chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo dang / zas dang / skom dang / gos dang /bzhon pa dang / mal cha dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / yo byad thams cad la ma chags par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyim bdag rnams sems can dag ni phal cher lus dang srog la sogs pa la chags te/ sdig pa'i las byas pas ngan 'gro rnams su skye la/ sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed nas/ lus dang srog la ma chags par bde 'gror skye ste/ des sems can thams cad yid la byas la/sbyin pa la sogs pa dge ba'i chos thams cad la ba rtson par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni snying rje'i bdag nyid can yin te/ ji lta zhe na/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las 'byung ba/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i bdag nyid can 619

rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sems can sdug bsngal ba dang / skyabs med pa dang / mgon med pa dang / rten med pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dag mthong na/ byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ chos nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ dka' ba spyod pa brgya dag kyang byed do/ /de dag chos nyid thob nas sems can rnams la phan par byed do/ /'di lta ste/ sems can ser sna can rnams sbyin pa la gzhol bar byed/ tshul khrims 'chal ba rnams tshul khrims la/ gnod sems can rnams bzod pa la/ le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la/ sems 'khrugs pa rnams bsam gtan la/ sems can shes rab 'chal ba rnams mthong na shes rab la gzhol bar byed kyang / sems can gyi sdug bsngal me bzad pa/ rtsub pa tsha ba dag gis nyen zhing byang chub la phyir ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'i bdag nyid can yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos zhus pa las kyang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni srid pa'i 'khor lo chen po/ chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo la yongs su zhen pas sbags pa rang dbang med pa bdag la mi 'bongs pa 620

dag ste/ rang dbang yod pa'i bdag la 'bongs par bya ba dang /gar dga' bar 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du/ sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni phan tshun du mi 'phrod pa khro ba dang / zhe sdang dang / gnod sems mang ba dag ste/ khro ba dang / zhe sdang dang / gnod sems spangs par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang /kye ma sems can 'di dag ni sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba sdig pa'i las byed pa dag ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dang /sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spangs par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni brkam pa/ chags pa zil gyis mi gnon pa chog mi shes shing / 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi gnas pa dang bral ba dag ste/chags pa spangs pa dang / 'phags pa'i shes rab bskyed pa'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma 621

sems can 'di dag ni las kyi rnam par smin pa la mi lta zhing rtag pa dang chad pa la gnas pa dag ste/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo dang / las dang bya ba la gzud pa'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni ma rig pa dang / gti mug gis ldongs pa dang /bdag dang sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag la mngon par zhen pa dag ste/ 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi mig rnam par dag par bya ba dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad spangs par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni 'khor ba la mngon par dga' ba/ phung po lnga'i gshed mas yongs su zin pa dag ste/ khams gsum thams cad las dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pas bcings pa g.yo ba dang / rlom sems la gnas pa dag ste/bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pa thams cad las rnam par 622

dgrol ba dang / g.yo ba dang / rlom sems spangs pa'i phyir de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du/ sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sgo bcad cing ngan 'gro'i sgo phye ba dag ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo dbye ba dang / ngan 'gro'i sgo bcad par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po sgye'o zhes gsungs/ slob dpon kā ma la shī las mdzad pa'i sgom rim dang po las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myur du thob par 'dod pas mdor na snying rje dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / sgrub pa dang / gnas pa 'di gsum la 'bad par bya'o/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa'i rgyu'i rtsa ba ni snying rje chen po kho na yin pa shes par byas la de nyid la thog ma kho nar bsgom mo/ /de skad du 'phags pa chos yang dag par sdud pa las gsungs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyis 623

na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen pos ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyis na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyis na srog gi dbang po mchis na dbang po gzhan rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du snying rje chen po mchis na byang chub sems dpa'i chos gzhan rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ngo / /'phags pa blo gros mi zad pa bstan pa las kyang gsungs te/btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po ni mi zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/dper na dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba ni mi'i srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 624

snying rje chen po ni theg pa chen po yang dag par 'grub pa'i phyir sngon du 'gro ba yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par bshad do/ /'phags pa ga yā gau ri'i mdo las kyang gsungs te/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni ci/gnas ni gang / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni snying rje chen po'o/ /gnas ni sems can no zhes de la sogs pa rgya cher 'byung ngo / /de ltar snying rje chen pos bskyod pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag nyid la mi lta bar gzhan la shin tu phan par don du gnyer ba'i phyir bsags pa shin tu bya dka' zhing yun ring la dub par 'gyur ba la 'jug go /'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa las gsungs pa lta bu ste/ de la snying rje chen po ni gang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sdug bsngal skye ba mi len pa ci yang med do/ /des bde ba'i skye ba mi 'dor ba ci yang med do zhe'o/ /de ltar shin tu bya dka' ba la zhugs nas ring por mi thogs par tshogs yongs su rdzogs te gdon mi za bar thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni snying rje chen po kho na'o/ /snying rje chen pos yongs su zin pas na sangs rgyas bcom 625

ldan 'das kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi go 'phang brnyes nas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don mdzad cing bzhugs so/ /mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa lta bu yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rje chen po'i rgyus mya ngan las 'das par mi gnas so/ /de yang sdug bsngal ba'i sems can la dmigs shing yid la bya ba mang du byas pas sgye bar 'gyur te/ sems can 'jig rten gsum na spyod pa thams cad sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum gyes ji ltar mthun pa bzhin du sdug bsngal lo zhes de ltar sems can thams cad la bsgom mo/ /de la sems can dmyal ba de dag ni rgyun mi 'chad cing yun ring la tsha ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi chu bor bying ngo zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin du yi dwags rnams kyang phal cher shin tu mi bzad pa'i bkres pa dang / skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyi mes bskams pa'i lus shin tu sdug bsngal mang po myong ste/ lo brgyar yang la la mchil ma'i thal ba dang / mi gtsang ba yang bzar mi rnyed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang gcig la gcig za ba dang / khro ba dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / gsod pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal mang po myang ba kho nar snang ste/ 'di ltar kha 626

cig sna 'bugs pa dang / brdegs pa dang / bcings pa dang /gdags pa la sogs pa bdag la dbang med par kun gyis bda' ba yin te/ mi 'dod bzhin du khal chen po lci ba bskur bas ngal lo/ /de bzhin du dgon pa na 'khod pa yang nyes pa med par kha cig phyed du tshol zhing gsod de/ rtag tu 'jigs pas yid 'khrugs te phan tshun 'khod cing 'bros pa yang grangs med pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myang ba kho nar snang ngo / /de bzhin du mi la yang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa yod pa kho na ste/ 'di na rkun po la sogs pas gang dag yan lag gtubs pa dang / gsal shing la bskyon pa dang /dpyangs te btags pa la sogs pas nyon mongs pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kho na yin no/ /gang dag dbul zhing phongs pa de dag ni yi dwags dang 'dra bar bkres shing skom pas sdug bsngal lo/ /bran la sogs pa gang dag gzhan gyi lus la dbang byas pa dang / gang dag mthus mnan te gnod par byed pa de dag ni dud 'gro dang 'dra bar brdegs pa dang /gdags pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal lo/ /de bzhin du btsal bar bya ba dang / gcig la gcig gnod par byed pa la sogs pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang / mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa la 627

sogs pa de dag la sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ /gang dag kha cig phyug cing skyid pa dang 'dra bar snang ba de dag kyang 'byor ba'i mtha' ni rgud pa ste/ lta ba ngan pa sna tshogs gzing gzing bar nub cing / sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa bsags pas gad kha na 'dug pa dang 'dra bar sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa yang yang dag par sdug bsngal ba kho na yin no/ /lha la yang gang dag 'dod pa'i khams na spyod pa de dag ni 'dod pa'i mes yid rab tu 'bar zhing sems 'khrugs pa dang 'dra bar gsha' mar mi 'dug la/ skad cig kyang sems mnyam par 'jog par mi 'gyur te/ rab tu zhi ba bde ba'i nor gyis dbul ba de dag la bde ba ci zhig yod/ rtag tu 'chi 'phob dang ltung ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'i mya ngan gyis non pa dag ste de dag ji ltar bde/ gang dag gzugs dang gzugs med pa na spyod pa de dag kyang skad cig sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba las 'das mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag 'dod pa na spyod pa'i bag la nyal ba rnams shin tu ma spangs pas yang sems can dmyal ba la sogs par ltung ba yod par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yod pa nyid do/ /lha dang mi 'di dag thams cad ni las dang nyon 628

mongs pa la sogs pa'i rgyus gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pas na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba nyid do/ /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi me lce'i phreng ba'i sa yin par bltas la/ ji ltar bdag nyid kyi sdug bsngal mi sdug pa ltar gzhan dag gi yang de dang 'dra bar sems shing / sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba kho na bsgom par bya ste/ thog ma kho nar mdza' bshes kyi phyogs la gong du smos pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar blta zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sems mnyam pas bye brag med par lta ste/ thog ma med pa can gyi 'khor ba lan brgyar yang bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa'i sems can gang yang med do snyam du sems pas phal ba la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe mdza' bshes kyi phyogs dang 'dra bar phal ba rnams la yang snying rje mtshungs par 'jug pa de'i tshe dgra'i phyogs la yang de bzhin du sems mnyam pa nyid la sogs pa yid la byed pas bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe mdza' bshes kyi phyogs dang 'dra bar dgra la yang mnyam par 'jug pa de'i tshe rim gyis phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad la yang bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe yid du 'ong ba'i bu mi bde ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la yang sdug bsngal gtan nas 629

dbyung bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa'i snying rje rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa bdag nyid kyis mtshungs par gyur pa de'i tshe de rdzogs pa yin pas snying rje chen po'i ming thob ste/ 'phags pa blo gros mi bzad pas bstan pa'i mdo las bsngags pa bzhin no/ /'di ltar snying rje bsgom pa'i go rim 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chos mngon pa'i mdo la sogs pa las bka' stsal to/ /de ltar snying rje go mas pa'i stobs kyis sems can ma lus pa drangs par dam bcas na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa'i rang bzhin gyis byang chub kyi sems sgrims mi dgos pa kho nar skye ste/ 'phags pa chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ sems can mgon med pa/ skyabs med pa/ gling med pa dag mthong nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan gyi yang dag par 'dzin du bcug pa las kyang byang chub sems dpa' la byang chub kyi sems bskyed mod kyi/ 'on kyang snying rje chen pos non te/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa khyad che bar bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin las bka' stsal to/ /byang chub kyi sems de sgrub pa dang 630

mi ldan yang 'khor ba'i nang na 'bras bu che bar bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las bka' stsal te/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na rdo rje rin po che chag kyang gser gyi rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi 'dor zhing dbul ba thams cad kyang bzlog go /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che sgrub pa dang mi ldan pa yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor zhing 'khor ba'i dbul ba yang bzlog par byed do zhes 'byung ngo gsungs/ sgom rim par ba las kyang /'di la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid shin tu myur du thob par 'dod pa de rtogs pa dang ldan pas de thob par byed pa'i rgyu rnams dang rkyen rnams la mngon par brtson par bya'o/ /'di ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di ni rgyu med pa las 'byung bar mi rung ste/ thams cad kyang dus tham/sa cad du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ltos pa med par 'byung na ni gang du yang thogs par mi rung ste/gang gis na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta 631

bas na la lar brgya lam nas 'ga' zhig 'byung du zad pas dngos po thams cad ni rgyu la ltos pa kho na yin no/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang la lar brgya lam nas 'ga' zhig 'gyur te/ dus thams cad du yang ma yin/ gnas thams cad du ma yin/ thams cad kyang ma yin pas de'i phyir de ni rgyu dang rkyen la ltos par nges so/ /rgyu dang rkyen de dag gi nang nas kyang ma nor cing ma tshang ba med pa rnams bsten par bya'o/ /rgyu nor ba la nan tan byas na yun shin tu ring po zhig gis kyang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'thob pa med do/ /dper na ra las 'o ma bzho ba bzhin no/ /rgyu mtha' dag ma spyad pa las kyang 'bras bu 'byung ba med de/ sa bon la sogs pa gang yang rung ba zhig med na myu gu la sogs pa 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na 'bras bu de 'dod pas rgyu dang rkyen ma nor ba dang mtha' dag la bsten par bya'o/ /'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgyu dang rkyen de dag gang zhe na/ smras pa/ bdag lta bu'i dmus long dang 'dra bas de dag bstan par mi nus mod kyi/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mngon par rtogs pas sangs rgyas nas gdul bya rnams la ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag nyid kyis bshad do/ /bcom 632

ldan 'das kyis der bka' stsal ba/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung ba yin/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu las byung ba yin/ thabs kyis mthar phyin pa yin no zhes 'byung ngo / /de lta bas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'dod pas snying rje dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / thabs dang gsum po 'di dag la bslab par bya'o/ /snying rjes bskyed na byang chub sems pa rnams sems can thams cad mngon par 'don pa'i phyir nges par dam 'cha' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdag la lta ba bsal nas shin tu bya dka' zhing rgyun mi 'chad la yun ring por bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la gus par 'jug go /de zhugs nas nges par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par sgrub po/ /tshogs rnams yongs su rdzogs na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lag tu thob pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rtsa ba ni snying rje kho na yin pas de ni thog ma kho nar goms par bya'o/ /chos yang dag par sdud pa las kyang bka' stsal te/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos gcig rab tu 633

bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste snying rje chen po'o zhes 'byung ngo / /snying rje chen pos yongs su zin pas na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag brnyes kyang sems can gyi khams mthar thug pa'i bar du bzhugs par mdzad do/ /nyan thos bzhin du mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer shin tu zhi bar yang 'jug par mi mdzad de/ sems can la gzigs nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer ni zhi ba de lcags kyi khang pa 'bar ba bzhin du thag ring du spo bas/ bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu ni snying rje chen po 'di nyid yin no/ /de la snying rje bsgom pa'i rim pa de dang po 'jug pa nas brtsams te brjod par bya'o/ /thog mar re zhig btang snyoms bsgoms pas sems can thams cad la rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba bsal te snyems pa'i sems nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba ni 'dod sdug bsngal ba ni mi 'dod la/ thog ma med pa can gyi 'khor ba na sems can gang lan brgyar bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa de gang yang med do snyam du yongs su bsam zhing / 'di 634

la bye brag ci zhig yod na la la ni rjes su chags/ la la ni khong khro bar gyur pas de lta bas na bdag gis sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa nyid du bya'o snyam du de ltar yid la bya zhing bar ma'i phyogs nas brtsams te/ mdza' bshes dang dgra la yang sems snyoms pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa nyid du bsgrubs nas byams pa bsgom mo/ /byams pa'i chus sems kyi rgyud brlan te gser yod pa'i sa gzhi bzhin du byas la snying rje'i sa bon btab na bde blag tu shin tu yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sems kyi rgyud byams pas bsgos nas snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /snying rje de ni sems can sdug bsngal ba thams cad sdug bsngal de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa yin no/ /khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad ni sdug bsngal nyid rnam pa gsum gyes ci rigs par shin tu sdug bsngal ba dag yin pas de'i phyir sems can thams cad la dpe bsgom par bya ste/ 'di ltar re zhig sems can dmyal ba ba'i sems can gang dag yin pa de dag ni rgyun mi 'chad cing / yun ring la tsha ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi chu bor byings pa kho na yin no zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin du yi dwags 635

rnams kyang phal cher shin tu mi bzad pa'i bkres pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis sems bskams pa'i lus shin tu sdug bsngal mang po myang ngo zhes bka' stsal to/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang gcig la gcig za ba dang / 7khro ba dang / gsod pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa mang po myong ba kho nar snang ngo / /mi rnams kyang 'dod pa yongs su 'tshol bas phongs nas gcig la gcig 'khu ba dang / gnod pa byed pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa dang /dbul phongs las gyur pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa nyams su myong bar snang ngo / /gang dag 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas kun nas dkris pa sna tshogs kyis sems dkris pa dag dang / gang dag lta ba ngan pa rnam pa sna tshogs gzing gzing bar 'gyur ba de thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pas gad kha na 'dug pa bzhin du shin tu sdug bsngal kho na yin no/ /lha rnams kyang thams cad 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid kyi sdug bsngal ba dag ste/ 'dod pa la spyod pa'i lha gang dag yin pa de dag ni rtag tu 'chi 'pho ba dang ltung ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'i mya ngan gyis sems la gnod na ji ltar bde/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid las dang nyon mongs 636

pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rgyu'i gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid dang /skad cig re re la 'jug pa'i ngang tshul can gyi mtshan nyid de/'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa yin no/ /de bas na 'gro ba mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal gyi me lce 'bar ba'i nang du zhugs pa yin par bltas la/ ji ltar bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ltar gzhan thams cad kyang de dang 'dra'o snyam du bsam zhing / kye ma kye hud bdag la sdug pa'i sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal na sdug bsngal de las ji ltar thar par bya zhes bdag nyid sdug bsngal ba bzhin du byed cing de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa'i snying rje des ting nge 'dzin la 'dug kyang rung / spyod lam thams cad du yang rung ste/ dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya ste/ thog ma kho nar mdza' bshes kyi phyogs rnams la ji skad smos pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong bar mthong bas bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sems can mnyam pa nyid kyis bye brag med par mthong nas sems can thams cad ni bdag gi gnyen du gyur pa kho na'o snyam du bsam zhing bar ma'i phyogs rnams la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe de la mdza' bshes kyi phyogs bzhin du snying rje de mnyam par zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad 637

la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bu chung ngu snying du sdug pa sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i ma bzhin du bdag nyid kyis shin tu sdug bsngal ba 'don par 'dod pa'i rnam pa rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i snying rje de sems can thams cad la mnyam par zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ snying rje chen po'i ming yang 'thob po/ /byams pa bsgom pa ni mdza' bshes kyi phyorges la thog mar byas nas bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa ste/ rim gyis tha mal ba dang dgra la yang bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar de'i snying rje goms par byas nas/ rim gyis sems can mtha' dag mngon par 'don par 'dod pa rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba nyid du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'o skol rnams sngon gyi sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa'i mi brgyud yin pas kun gyi rgyud na snying rje rta rnga tsam re mchis mod/'on kyang ma brag srin mo yin pa'i stabs kyis sha khrag la 'dod sred che bas snying rje zil gyis mnan nas/ chen po zhig rgyud la skye dka' rung chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ snying rje chen po zhig rgyud la e skyes kyi phyir du tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs bzhin du 'bad na/ nam zhig snying rje chen po bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro/ /638

smras pa/ 'gro ba yongs la bu gcig ltar brtse ba'i sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snying rje chen po'i nor bu rin po che/ /thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med do zhes/ /'phags pa byams pa'i rnam thar mdo las gsungs/ /snying rje che ba'ang rnyed par dka' ba ste/ /sdang dgra dpa' bo'i lag gi rdo rje yis/ /'debs pa'i nang nas sgol ba bzhin no zhes/ /bla ma'i snying po'i le'u dag las gsungs/ /phan dang snying brtser bcas pas rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod par bslab na mkhas pa'i byang chub reg /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dag pa kun/ /'byung zhes mdo sde sdud pa dag las gsungs/ byams dang snying rje kun mkhyen nyid kyi sems/ /yid la byed pas gnas pa 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi rgyan no zhes/ /rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul mdo las gsungs/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de/ /snying rje rtsa ba byang chub sems mchog gi /rgyu las byung ba thabs kyis mthar phyin zhes/ /rnam par snang mdzad mngon byang rgyud las gsungs/ /snying rje'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /spyod yul ston pa sangs 639

rgyas nyid dang gcig /rgyu spyod bsod nams tshogs chen ldan no zhes/ /rgya gar mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang bas gsungs/ /snying rje brtan pas byang chub sems brtan te/ /skye dang gnas pa mthar thug rgyu yin phyir/ /sems can rnams la snying rje che ba ni/ /rnyed par dka' zhes rin chen 'byung gnas gsungs/ /theg pa che chung gnyis kyi khyad par yang / /lta ba'i sgo nas phye ba ma yin par/ /snying rje'i sgo nas phye ba yin no zhes/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo'i zhal nas gsungs/ /stong nyid zab mo rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje chen po skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro don 'grub bo zhes/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas mi la ras pas gsungs/ /snying rje chen po med na dam chos gyi/ /rtsa ba rul zhes o rgyan pad+mas gsungs/ /snying rje med pa'i chos pas 'bad byas kyang / /nyan thos lam zhes dwags po lha rjes gsungs/ /snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /lam mchog mi rnyed sā ra ha bas gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs dang snying rje skye ba gnyis/ /dus mnyam yin zhes dam pa rgya gar gsungs/ /de bzhin rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyi/ /snying rje yod pa'i phan yon med pa'i skyon/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang gsungs pa la/ /ltos dang yid ches nges shes rnyed par 'gyur/ /ces pa'ang 640

bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni byams snying rje lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas/ smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang la slob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis pha ma sems can gyi sha khrag za mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad par bya ste/ de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung dri ma med pa sa'i dngos gzhir drangs pa las/ sngon yun ring po 'das pa nas gang du khyed ma skyes pa dang / ma song ba/ ma shi ba'i sa phyogs de ni ngas ma mthong ngo / /yun ring po 'das pa nas sems can gang khyed kyi pha'am/ma'am/ phu nu'am/ sring mo'am/ slob dpon nam/ mkhan po'am/bla ma'am/ bla ma'i gnas su ma gyur pa de ni ngas mthong bar dka'o gsungs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i pam rim bde lam las sems can 'di'i lus ma blangs bya ba gcig kyang med blangs pa grangs kyis mi chod/ sems can 'di'i bdag gi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod gsungs/ slob springs las/ gang gi ltor ma nyal ba'i sems can de med na 641

gsungs/ bye brag tu mi'i rten la ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod de/ bde lam las/ sems can re res kyang mi'i rten la bdag gi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/byas pa grangs kyis mi chod cing / da dung yang byed par 'gyur zhes dang / slob springs las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ /ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis langs mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ ma nam byas res kyis tshe 'di'i mas bskyangs pa bzhin phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs te/ bde lam las/ dang po mngal du brtse bas bskyangs/btsas pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag sor mo bcu'i rtse la g.yengs/ sha'i drod la sbyar/ brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/dga' ba'i mig gis bltas/ snabs khas phyis/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ ma rang srog la babs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba las/ bdag cung zad na ba la sdug bsngal che bar byas/ sdig sdug gtam ngan rang srog la'ang ma bltas par sha thang thang du sgrub pa'i zas nor thams cad bdag la brtse bas phog ma rang gi 'khyer 'khos dang bstun pa'i phan pa dang bde ba tshad med pa bsgrubs/ gnod pa dang sdug bsngal tshad med pa las bskyabs pas drin shin tu che gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs 642

kyis/ ma byas pa'i nu zho rgya mtshor bskyil na/ khams gsum snod du ga la shongs gsungs/ lung gzhan las kyang / sems can gcig gis ma byas pa'i/ /nu zho 'thungs pa gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ de ltar thog ma med pa nas dridza gyis bskyangs pa'i ma gyur sems can rnams nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis yid dkrugs nas shes pa la rang dbang ma thob par smyos/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la blta ba'i mig dang bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi long 'khrid ni med/ skad cig re res nyes spyod kyis dbyen spyos pas ni brdeg 'cha'/ spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan 'gro 'jigs su rung ba'i g.yangs kha 'grims pa rnams ma rabs khrel med cig yin na ma gtogs/ yal bar 'dor mi rung ste/ slob springs las/ gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzag 'thung ba/ /ngal ba mang bsten byams pa la bsten de dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rabs shig na'ang spangs par su zhig spro/ /gsungs/ phyag na pad dkar 'dzin dngos rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/ tshe 'dir mngal du bzung ba'i ma rgan la/ /drin du brtsi na skye ba grangs med cig /phan pa kho nas bskyangs pa'i sems can rnams/ /blo yis 'dor 643

bar nus sam snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ yal bar mi 'dor ba tsam du ma zad/ pha ma sems can nyam thag la snying rje bskyed na pha ma sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod dang / bde la 'god 'dod kyi blo ngang ngam shugs kyis skye/ de skyes na sdug bsngal sel zhing bde la 'god thabs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thams cad la ngang ngam shugs kyis 'jug la/ snying rje ma bskyed na sems can rnams yal bar 'dor ba'i blo ngang ngam shugs kyis skye/ de skyes na sdug bsngal sel zhing bde la 'god pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ngang ngam shugs kyis rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas/des na sems can la phan 'dogs mi 'dogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin mi 'dzin thams cad snying rje yod med la rag las pas/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams kyis chos gzhan mang po la bslab pa re zhig bzhag nas/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba snying rje 'di gcig bur bslab na chos gzhan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ tshe sngon drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha ma sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i tshul la dmigs nas/ gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung dus rtag tu snying rje la 'di ltar slob dgos te/ bshan pas gsod pa'i ra 644

lug dang / rngon pa dang khye yis 'ded pa'i ri dwags/ khra yis 'dzin pa'i bya bye'u/ rkang pas gcur ba'i 'bu ro smad sa la 'byar nas ro stod 'gul ba/ nad thar med kyis bzung nas phar ma shi tshur mi gson pa/ lto gos kyis phongs nas 'chi la nye ba/ khye la rdo dbyug pas brgyab nas skad ngan ring po ba sogs/sdug bsngal mi bzod pa thog tu babs pa'i sems can mthong ngam thos dus dang / rang ka de 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can rnams yid ngor gsal btab nas/ rang gi skye ba sngon mar pha mar gyur pa'i sems can 'di rnams kyis da lta sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong ba snying re rje/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral ba zhig bya'o snyam du bsgom dgos te/ paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde lam las/ thog mar bshan pas gsod bzhin pa'i lug lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la bsgoms/ de'i tshul ni/ mdun du de'i rnam pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ yan lag rnams ni bcings/ brang gi pags pa ni gshags/ bshan pa'i lag pa khong bar bcug pas/ srog la 645

babs pa ni mngon sum du shes/ mig bshan pa'i gdong la rig rig tu blta zhing / sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i tshul bsams nas/ des na 'di nyid sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar bya'o/ /zhes snying rje bsgom tshul gsal bar gsungs pa ltar bsgom mo/ /de la myong ba thon pa na dge 'dun gyi dkor la bag med du spyod pa dang / tshul 'chal dang / chos spong mkhan dang / log lta can dang / sems can la 'tshe zhing sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byed pa skyen skyen por byed pa'i 'gro ba rnams la dmigs nas bsgom dgos par gsungs so/ /yang skabs re rang gi kha bsum la sha yi ched du 'di ltar byas nas gsod pa 'jig rten khams na mang po yod pas/ de rnams skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin snying re rje snyam du yang yang bsam par bya'o/ /gal te snying rje mi skye na nad pa 'tshab can dang / rngon pas ri dwags gsod pa/ bshan pas lug gsod pa'i rtsar song nas/ nga'i pha ma sems can 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsgom na snying rje skye zhes jo bo yab sras kyis gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de ltar snying rje chen po bsgom bzhin du dper na bu 646

sdug shi ba'i dus kyi ma bzhin du sems can nyam thag rnams blos nam yang mi brjed par zhe phugs su bzhag nas/ rang nyid skyid 'dod dang bde 'dod kyi blo dor nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs snying la bcings nas de bzhin smon lam yang 'debs dgos te/ kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ de bas bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dag /skad cig nyid la bral bar shog cig ces/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bsam par bya/ /zhes dang /yum bar ba las/ sems can sdug bsngal ba dag mthong ba na/'di snyam du sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal dang bral bar shog cig ces sems pa yin te gsungs/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyad par snying rje byams pa'i gtso bo ni lus bskyed pa'i ma yin la/ de'i drin ni 'khor ba'i tshad med mu med pas/'di la byams snying rje tshad med pa bho/ zhes dang / yang / thar med las kyi 'khor ba'i dong ring du/ las kyis mnar ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi tshe 'di'i pha mas gtso byas pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i ma sems can thams cad snying re rje/ 'di thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung bral 647

bar gyur cig bral ba zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam du bsam dgos te/ sku gsum don thig las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re rje/ /brtse sems bu gcig shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar dam bca' zhing / /ji ltar bya ma'i sgong sro bkab pa ltar/ /rnam mkhyen sa la 'god pa'i byams pa dang / /rgyal po'i gdung brgyud chad khar sras 'khrungs ltar/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho thob pa'i dga' ba dang / /drang srong rgyal po'i gtor ma bsngo ba bzhin/ /nye ring dgra gnyen med pa'i btang snyoms dang / /'gro rnams bla med sa la 'god bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis theg chen bla med bsgrub par bgyi/ /gnod pa'i lan du phan pa'i gdung shugs bskyed/ /ces dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ /bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhungs/ /sdug nyam thag ngang tshul mi bsam na/ /bu'i don snying gting nas rul bas na/ /rang skyid 'dod blo sna lings kyis bor/ /gzhan phan bde'i thabs dgu snying la bcangs gsungs/ /de ltar sems la bzhag nas drin gzo la/ thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don la brtson dgos te/ bde lam las/648

sems can thams cad sbyin pas 'khor du bsdus te/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gye sgo nas chos ston pa'i snyan par smra ba dang /chos bstan pa'i don nyams su len du 'jug pa'i spyod pa dang /gzhan la bstan pa ltar rang gis kyang nyams su len pa'i don mthun pa ste/ gzhan don byed pa'i thabs bzang po 'di rnams la brten nas sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i phyir du kun gyis 'bad dgos/ khyad par sha 'di'i phyir rgya bod hor gsum sogs 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na lo re zla re nyin re bzhin du ra lug g.yag gsum bya dang ri dwags sogs sems can grangs med pa gsod tshul bsams nas/ dngos sam brgyud nas sems can gzhan gyi tshe srog la gnod pa'i las sdig zas pha ma'i sha za ba spangs dgos/ gal te ma spangs na nyes pa che ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ khe yi phyir du sems can gsod/ /sha yi phyir ni nor sbyin byed/ /de dag gnyis ka sdig las can/ /ngu 'bod la sogs rnams su 'tshod/ /gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pas sha za na/ /'jig rten gnyis ni gzhig pa'i phyir/ /shākya'i bstan la brtul zhugs blangs/ /shin tu mi zad 649

dmyal bar yang / /sdig pa'i las can de dag 'dong / /ma rungs 'o dod 'bod sogs su/ /sha za de dag btso bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yang / sems can gcig la gcig za ba/ /sha zan dag gi rigs su skye/ /dri mi zhim zhing smad pa dang / /spyon pa rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ /gdol ba sme sha can rigs dang / /btso blag mkhan du yang skye'o/ /phra min rigs kyi skye gnas dang / /sha za'i rigs su skye bar bstan/ /mi yi tha ma de dag ni/ /srin dang bye la'i mngal du skye/ /zhes dang / yang / de ltar sha dang chang la sogs/ /bar chad byed par 'gyur ba'o/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus su ni/ /sha zan gti mug smra ba dag /sha ni sdig med rung ba zhes/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni bshad ces zer/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo sde rnams su rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dul bar yang sha la gnang ba'i skabs med par rigs dgos te/sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis 'dul bar ma gnang bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo rtsar gnang ngo zhe na/ 'di gzhi yod smra'i yin la/ sde ba gzhan bzhir yang blta dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes kun mkhyen dol bo ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs so/ /gsang sngags nas kyang sha za ba ma gnang ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma las/ sha la sogs pa zos pas gdon mi za bar sa yi 'og 650

tu gang gi lus ni ches che ba/ srog chags yi dwags sogs su nges par skye bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa dang /dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du yang / za ba po dang gsod pa po/ /gnyis po dag kyang gsod pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sha lnga la sogs pa ci ltar zhe na/ de la 'dir rang bzhin gyis shi ba ste/ sha'i ched du ma bsad pa'i sha lnga la bdud rtsi'i ril bu bsgrubs nas/ rgya shug gi tshi gu tsam rnal 'byor pas dam tshig gi don du bza' bar bya ste/ lus kyi stobs 'phel ba dang / rigs kyi nga rgyal bcag pa dang / sems can de dag drangs par byed pa'i don to/ /'dir rnal 'byor pas sha zos pa'i sems can de dag drangs nus pa ma gtogs pas sha za bar bya ba min te/ kye rdo rjer/ sha ni mkhas pas bza' bya ba/ /sems can de de'i dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags nas sha za bar gsungs pa de sgra ji bzhin pa min te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel bar ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa za bar byed do/ /zhes rnam rtog za bar gsungs so/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ zhe sdang bsam pa med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi sha rnams ma 'phrog cing / /thub pas rang gi sha rnams byen/ /skye ba 'dir ni khyod 651

sangs rgyas/ zhes dang / yang / rdzas kyis nyos pa nya yi sha /zos pas blus pa yin nam ci/ /glang po'i rtsal dang sprin chen dang / /myang 'das dang ni sor phreng can/ /lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo nyid las/ /thub pas sha ni ma gnang ngo / /rdzas thob don du srog gcod dang / /bza' ba'i don du rin 'jal ba/ /gnyis po dag kyang gsod pa ste/ /ngu 'bod la sogs rnams su 'tshod/ /rdzas kyi don du sems can gsod/ /rdzas ster med na sus kyang min/ /bya dang byed bo yang dag 'brel/ /rtag tu srog chags gsod pa po/ /gang tshe rdzas kyis nya nyos pas/ /khyem gnas rnams la sdig med na/ /de bzhin sku gzugs la sogs pa/ /byas pa'ang ji ltar bsod nams 'gyu ra/ /mchod rten brtsigs mkhan gyis byas dang / /nya ni nya pas bsad pa ste/ /mchod rten phyag byed byed po min/ /nya zos gsod pa po la min/ /gang tshe nya de zos pa yis /sdig pa za ba por med na/ /de tshe mchod rten mchod pa yi/ /bsod nams mchod byed po la med/ /gsod pa po dang za ba po/ /gnyis po dag kyang so so ste/ /gsod pa po ni nor la sred/ /za ba po ni zas kyi don/ /gsod po nor la sred pa dag /bskal ba 'bum du 'tshod pa'o/ /za bo sha la sred pa dag /bskal ba bye bar 'tshod pa'o/ /nyan thos kyis ni ched dag tu/ /nya pas nya ni 652

bsad pa dang / /bram ze yi ni ched dag tu/ /chang mas chang ni byas pa dang / /kha na ma tho med gzhan min/ /sha za ba yi mi gang zhig /dang po yi dwags 'gro ba ste/ /phyi nas ngu 'bod 'gro ba'o/ /sha za ba la snying rje dang / /chang 'thung ba la dga' ba dang / /pha rol bud med 'dzin gsungs pa/ /smad pa las byed btang snyoms med/ /ces pa 'di sngags su yang gtogs so/ /rje mi las/sha khrag zas su za byed cing / /srog gcod las su song ba rnams/ /tsha dmyal brgyad du bsreg par byed/ /ces dang / sa skya padhi tas/ theg pa che las sha rnams bkag /zos na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /zhes dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/dran pa nyams pa'i chang dang gcig /snying rje nyams pa'i sha dang gnyis/ /grags pa nyams pa'i bud med gsum/ /'di gsum sgom chen gyi khong skran lags/ /nges 'byung gi me btsa' myur du thob/ /chos smyon pa'i tshul du nyams su longs/ /gsungs/ mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rnam bshad las/ sha'i ro la chags pa'i dbang gis sha za bar rung bar 'dul ba las gnang ngo zhes kho bo cag ni rnam pa thams cad du mi smra la/ de 'dra bar skyon med par gnyid kyi rmi lam du yang mi smra'o gsungs/ des na theg pa chen bo'i byang chub mchog tu sems 653

bskyed pa gang dag sha zos na rang gi snying rje chen po nyams 'gro zhing blo'i shugs chung du 'gro ba myong bas grub pa dang / rang don du ro la sred pa drag po skye bar mthong nas/ dgag bya de dag 'gog pa'i slad du rnam gsum dag ma dag dang / bsad pa dang rang shi ba'i sha thams cad mi za ba yin na ni mchog tu ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos gsungs snang / rgyas par spro na rmad byung sprul pa'i glegs bam du blta bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdu na sha zos pa'i rnam smin gyis tshe phyi mar dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum mam gang rung du skye/ tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal yun ring myong / brgya la mtho ris su skyes kyang / tshe thung nad mang gdol ba gzhung lugs la mi brten pa/ rigs ngan rme sha can gyi rigs dang / btso blag mkhan sogs su skyes nas sdug bsngal du ma myong bar gsungs/ gzhan yang sha 'di'i phyir tshe 'dir yang mi nor zas gsum zad nas sprang por gyur pa dang / thos bsam sgom gsum shor nas grong khyim 'grims pa mang / sha 'chos thig le rgyas nas mtshan nyid pa'i dge bshes phal cher gyis btsun chung sogs la brten nas dge 'dun gyi lhag ma bcu gsum gyi dang po 'phog gi bcug nas tshul khrims nyams/ phyag rdzogs pa 654

'ga' zhig gis btsun ma sogs la brten nas bsgom bsgrub shor ba mang / 'ga' zhig gis sha 'chos tsho gsog nas lus las su mi rung drang por bzhag kyang 'khyogs por 'gro/ yar langs nas sdod mi tshugs mal nas phag bzhin nyal sdod dgos/ rgyun tu khur po lce mo zhig khur yod pa ltar/ 'gro 'dug bskul bskyod mi nus dbugs 'tshengs 'chi la khad byed pa mang / sha 'di zos na byings rmugs gnyid gsum 'phel/ rig pa mi gsal/ nyin par gnyid na tshad pa sogs nad drag po steng du 'byung / ha cang zos chen dros 'khyag byas sha dug gi song / sman 'thung rim gro byas rung mi drag sgo yi rgyu zad/ khyim gyi zas zad/ lus kyi stobs zad/ zad thog zad bzhag byas shi song ba mang / sha khrag la longs spyod pa'i sa phyogs su dkar phyogs kyi lha mi 'khor nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba 'du/ mi rnams la nad dang phyugs rnams la god kha 'byung / sha khrag gar yod sar tshad pa rgyu gzer dmar bshal sogs nad rims mang po 'ongs mi phyugs khyi gsum dus min du 'chi/ char chu mi 'bab sad ser than pa sogs yul phyogs la bkra mi shis pa mang po 'byung / sha 'di pha ma sems can gyi sha khrag yin pas/ mang po zos na sdig sgrib kyis chos pa rnams kyis thos bsam sgom gsum ci tsam 655

ོbyas kyang nyams rtogs khyad par can mi skye sngar skyes pa yang 'grib par 'gyur/ sha 'dis chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa kun slongs/ srog gcod ma byen len sogs mi dge ba byed du 'jug /sha 'di la brten nas spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos/ sha 'di la dga' ba'i mi la tshe 'di phyi gang du bde skyid snyan gsum mi 'byung / sdig sdug gtam ngan dus rgyun du 'byung / sha 'dis bstan pa'i mig rkyen la yang gnod de/ spyir gzhis ka rtse dang rgyal rtse rtsis thang la sogs pa'i phyogs gzhan dang khyad par lha sa'i gling gi bshan pa rnams kyis ra yi khang pa phug nyin re bzhin ra lug g.yag gsum brgya stong bsad/ jo bo chen po'i bskor lam na sha khrag nang khrol rnams thang ma bzhin du brdal/spyan gzigs ltar bshams nas/ jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras ser 'bras dge gsum na byang chub sems dpa' 'dra yod na 'di e gzigs/ gzigs na snying rje chen po re e skye gi zer ba ltar nyi ma gnam la du shar po bshams nas btsongs pa 'di/ jo shāka rnams gnyis rgyal ba rin po che ser 'bras sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba bshan pa 'dra gi 'dren gyin yod na ci shes/ 'on kyang 'dren 656

gyin yod pa'i dbang du btang yang 'dren tshul btsog pa zhig red/ sngon a mdo'i phyogs kyi mi gcig lha sar song sha khrom mthong nas phyis yul du slebs dus/ yul mi 'ga' res khyod las can po dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mjal du song ba skal ba bzang ltad mo ci mthong smras pa'i lan du/ dag pa'i zhing na yang ma dag pa mang po 'dug ltad mo bzang ngan sna tshogs mthong zhes smras pa ltar/ thag ring mdo smad sogs kyi mi rnams kyis dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing zhes tshad mar bzung nas song dus de 'dra mthong tshe/ ra lug 'di rnams bsad tshad dbus gtsang gi bla ma rnams tshos 'dren gi yod ni yin na bzang gi/de min na 'di ngan gi chos yul zhig dang mi rig gi zer ba thos rgyu mang po snang / 'ga' zhig gis/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos rgyal ba rin po che'i bzhugs gnas pho brang po ta la'i thag nye lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi jo bo'i bskor lam na yang 'di 'dra yod ces dper 'then tshad kyis bzhag nas sdig pa'i las byed pa yang 'dug pas/ 'di 'dra'i bstan pa'i mig rkyen btsog pa zhig gzhan gang na yang mi snang / nyin re bzhin du lha sa'i gling bar na ra lug mang po gsod pa dang / jo bo'i sku rgyab na sha brgya stong mang 657

po bshams nas btsongs pa 'di 'dra/ mi la yab sras sogs sngon byon skyes chen dam pa chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzigs rgyu yin na spyan chab bsil te/ sngon gnya' nang tshong 'dus su dmar khyer ba'i tshong ba mang du byung tshe/ rje btsun dpon slob gnyis bsod snyoms la byon pas sha'i rtsig pa brtsigs/ mgo'i phung po spungs/ pags pa gcal du bkrams khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil te sems can gsod rgyu mang po srang la brgyus pa'i dbus na/ mon pa rgan po ldag pa zha ba zhig gis kyang / lug nag po chen po zhig la khong lag btang pas/ rma bzos tsam la rgyu ma nar ra ra lug shor te/ 'jigs pa'i skad chen po 'don zhing / 'dar khril le ba'i ngang nas rje btsun yab sras la skyabs 'tshol du byung nas lug tshe'i dus byed pa'i bar la/ rje btsun gyis spyan chab bsil zhing lug la 'pho ba mdzad nas rnam shes byang chub lam la bkod de/ snying rje chen po mi bzod pa'i ngang nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la phar ltos dang / /a tsa ma sdig can snying re rje/ /las re rmongs mi lus kyi lod pa la/ /zhe re 'phangs sems can gye gsod lugs la/ /gyong re che mgo bo'i bskor lugs la/ /tsug re drag pha ma'i 'chi lugs la/ /ji ltar 658

byed sdig sha'i brtsigs lugs la/ /ci re byed khrag gi mang lugs la/ /ji tsam ltogs sha yi za lugs la/ /gang nas bsam snang ba'i 'khrul lugs la/ /sdig re che snying rje med lugs la/ /ji tsam bsgribs rmongs pa'i gti mug la/ /ci re byed sdig pa'i so nams la/ /su yis spyod 'dod pa'i gdungs lugs la/ /gang gis byas yul lugs kyi ngan pa la/ /tsug re byed skyo ba'i skye lugs la/ /ci rang byed sdig can gyi brel lugs la/ /phyi ma skad cig mi dran pa'i/ /mi 'di 'dra mthong na nga re 'jigs/ /sdig spyod rnams dran bzhin snang ba 'khrul/ /ras chung pa lha chos shig e dran ang / /dran na skyo shas snying rlung ldangs/ /bsgom na ri khrod gnas su gshegs/ /bsam na bla ma'i bka' drin soms/ /'bros na sdig spyod rtsa nas bros/ /gtong na 'jig rten gyi bya ba thongs/ /'dzin na sgrub pa'i dam bca' zungs/ /shes na mi tshe chos la skyol/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa la yang skyo shas dang nges 'byung drag po gting nas skyes te spyan chab mang po bsil zhing / bla ma lags da bdag kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin chos brgyad sdig zas kyi 'tsho ba spangs nas bsgom pa lags gsungs nas/ dpon slob gnyis byon pas kun dad nas/ sha chang sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad mang po phul rung sdig zas 'jig 659

rten chos brgyad du 'dug gsung / ma bzhes par la phyi bdud 'dul phug tu byon nas sgrub pa mdzad snang / deng sang byang chub sems dpa' yin zer mkhan tsho yang lha sa'i jo bor bskor ba byed du song na sha khrom yod sar slebs tshe/ 'di rnams snying re rje zhes mig nas mchi ma zhig 'ong nas thur gi phyi dgos pa gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi snang / sha ka tshon po red zer/ kha nang du 'gram chu 'khyel nas mar mid pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lto rgyal snying rje med pa'i rang mtshang ston pa mang po snang / deng sang mdo dbus gtsang gsum sogs na dgon pa lha yul 'dra ba mang po tshugs snang yang / de'i thag nye na srog gcod kyi las la rngams pa'i grong sde ngan pa dmyal khams 'dra ba re tshugs 4yod pa 'di gnyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab la bltas na me chu bzhin gtan nas ma 'phrod par 'dug 'di gnyis ka btsugs phyin chad bstan pa la phyogs gcig nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas phan zhig btags/ phyogs gcig nas sdig pa'i sa bon btab nas gnod cig bskyal bar gda'/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rje la rag las pas/ sdig can bshan pas pha ma sems can gyi srog gcod pa 'di la snying rje zhig mi skye phan zhig mi 'dogs na/ bstan pa yod pa dgos pa ci yang ma byung 660

ba yin pas/ phyogs de na bstan pa yod par ma sems/ sha re nyo dgos dus bzang gi snyam bshan pa rnams dgon pa'i thag nye nas bsam bzhin du sdod du bcug /bshan pas khong rnams kyis sha nyo snyam dge 'dun pa la dmigs nas bsad/ dge 'dun pas bshan pas ra lug tshon po rkyang ba bsad nas sha tshil brtsigs yod snyam nas song ste nyes nas 'ong ba 'di la/chos pa yin zer mkhan 'ga' res rnam gsum dag pa'i sha yin tsho zer dga' dga' spro spro byas nyo ba 'di ngas bltas na dag ma dag mi shes te/ nges nges po gsum tshang ba khrig khrig red/ blo gros can gyis thugs bsam re thongs/ deng sang bla ma dge bshes su yin yang sdig par skrag pa ltar mdzad pa mang yang / gzhan gyis bsad pa'i sha nyos nas/ zos pa 'di la nyes dmigs che snyam nas skrag pa nyung bar gda'/ bla ma res dgon re btab nas bstan pa btsugs tsho zer te/ phyogs der srog gcod sogs mi dge ba'i las sngar bas che ba tshugs byung na ni/sdig rgyun zhig tshugs song ba yin bstan pa tshugs yod par ma sems/ srog gcod kyi las 'di la ma 'dzem na nang pa'i chos kyang log par spyad pa yin pas/ phyi rol pa la chos log ces smod rgyu spu tsam mi 'dug ming ma gtogs don gyis gcig par 661

gda'/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras ser 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud gtams yod zer ba rnams dang / bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi chos rgyal chen po snga phyi rim par byon pa thams cad kyis jag rkus byed sa med chang sogs bsten mi rung zhes bka' phebs zhes yang yang thos kyang / bshan pa rnams kyis tshe gang po ra lug g.yag gsum gyi steng na/ gshin rje'i grong khyer sa 'og na yod pa yar sa steng du bud bzhag pa bzhin nyin re bzhin sems can brgya phrag mang po'i sha brtsigs khrag bskyil ba 'di gcod dgos/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis kyang pha ma'i srog la 'tshe ba med pa'i slad du/ sha ma za zhes chos gsungs khrims bzhag zer ba zhig da snga go rgyu chen po zhig rang mi gda'/ sdig rgyun 'di gcod thub pa zhig byung na/ tshe 'dir yang bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams dgyes shing 'khor nas bsrung skyob byed cing / rgyal khams thams cad du char chu dus su babs lo phyugs legs pa dang / ser 'bras dge gsum lha ldan sogs kyi skya ser pho mo rnams kyi nad rims zhi nas tshe ring nad med sku rim dang bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ grwa pa sha'i phyir du yal nas thos 662

bsam mi 'ong bar pha yul du log 'gro ba rnams kyang ldog mi dgos par 'gyur bas phan thogs che/ dbus gtsang du mjal ba'i mgron po rnams kyis kyang rgyu nom sha khud du mi yal bar chos phyogs su 'gro/ phyogs phyogs kyi ra lug g.yag gsum mang po'i srog kyang shugs kyis thar bas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe ring bas tshe bsgrubs zhabs brtan gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ sha khrag jo bo'i sku rgyab nas ma btsongs na bskor lam gtsang sing nge ba bstan pa'i mig rgyan du yang mdzes/ sdig sgrib kyis jo bo'i byin rlabs nyams pa yang mi nyams par che ru 'gro/ sha zos pa'i nyes pa sogs med par sems can mang po'i tshe thar pa'i dge ba'i mthus phyi mar yang lha mi'i go 'phang thob nas bde/ mdor na tshe 'di phyi gang du bde ba 'byung ba tshad ldan gyi rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel la bltas na gsal ba kun gyi thugs na mnga' ba de red gsal btabs pa ma gtogs zhu ci dgos/gzhan yang nged rnams kyis so thar byang sems sngags sdom rnams khas blangs lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs lam 'bras zhi byed gcod yul sogs mdo sngags chos kyi nying khu rnams nyams su len mkhan rnams kyis gral yin phyin dngos sam brgyud nas 663

sems can la gnod par 'gyur ba'i las thams cad spangs nas phan gang thogs byed dgos/ khyad par theg chen byong chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas bzung sems can thams cad pha ma ru bsams nas nyam thag kun la snying rje bskyed dgos/ drin gzo la phan 'dogs byed dgos pa de bden par khas len na/da lta ston pa'i rjes 'jug tu khas len pa'i 'o skol rnams kyis pha ma sems can nyam thag ra lug g.yag gsum sogs la drin gzo ru phan zhig mi 'dogs rung / srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag dmar bo zos nas pham glan pa 'di shin tu mi rigs te/deng sang 'jig rten pa smos ci dgos/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis phal che ba'i longs spyod kyi gzhi ma sha 'di kho na la byas tshe/za ba po mang bzhin pha ma ra lug gi srog la 'tshe ba mang bo 'di byung ba yin pas/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag dmar po la lo ngas spyod pa 'di ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi spyod yul zhig gtan nas ma yin/ snying rje med pa'i bdud dang srin po gshin rje rnams kyi spyod pa ma nor ba dngos lag len la btab pa yin pas/ bstan 'gro la gces spras mdzad 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dra yod na/ snyigs dus btsun pa rnams kyi spyod khyer ngan pa 'di la thugs rje re 664

gzigs dgos te/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ sems can sha khrag rus gsum spungs dkyil du/ /gri 'phyar mchil mid ches cher rings shing rngams/ /dpung tshogs dgra bgegs 'dul la chas 'dra ba'i/ /dge 'dun gzugs brnyan rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa de thugs shin tu mad de/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di ltar soms dang ha go yong / pha ma ra lug 'bri g.yag la sogs sems can las ngan pa mang po yul thag ring po nas ded 'ong dus ltogs skom ngal bas sdug bsngal myang / bshan pa'i sgo drung du slebs nas/ sdig can bshan pa mig dmar gyi lag tu sprade nas mgo bcad de gsod pa'am/ yang na kha bsum/ yang na rtsib logs nas snying la gri phra mo'am 'bug rnon po rgyag yang na brang gshags nas khog tu lag pa btang te srog rtsa dmar po bcad nas gsod pa'i dus skabs rnams su/ ra lug gang yin yang dngangs shing skrag nas 'then bskor byas/ skad 'don sug bzhi 'dar/ bshan pa'i gdong la mig hrig trig blta/ lug 'ga' re mig mthar chu 'khyil mchi ma khril ler gtong / snying rje rgyu de na yod mod/ de mthong zhing thos na bla ma dge 'dun pa zhig mi dgos/ rgan rgon gzhon nu snying rje can gyi mig nas mchi 665

ma 'chor/ de tsho bsam na sha zos pa pha ma gnyis kyi sha zos pa las thu/ srog dbugs gcod dus bzod glags med pa'i na tsha sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myang / ja theb re la 'chi rgyu med/ lus po shig shig yom yom 'gul/ 'o skol rnams kyi mgo gcod pa dang / kha sna bsum pa'am/ yang na khog tu lag pa btang nas srog rtsa'i 'then pa phar zhog rang gi sha sen mo gnyis kyi bar du 'tshir dang / de tsam gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod na/ pha ma ra lug rnams kyis de bas brgya stong 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal myang nas shi ba yin pas/ de ltar rang lus dpe blangs bsam mno zhib tu btang na byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying rlung ldangs na/ 'o skol rnams la snying med na ma gtogs yod na snying rje zhig skye dgos te/ dper na tshe 'di'i rang gi ma rgan gzhan gyis bsad nas sha btsos drangs na ma de la snying rje skye'am mi skye/ dpe de bzhin du ra lug g.yag gsum gang yin yang rang gi tshe sngon ma'i ma drin can yin pas/ gzhan gyes bsad nas byen yang snying rje zhig ci'i mi skye/ gal te snying rje mi skye rung / 'dod sred cig skyes nas za mkhan rnams las kyi srin bo bas snying rje chung zhing / khra dang spyang ki bas sha dad che ba yin te/ sngon rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa bsgrubs nas bstan pa 666

phyi dar gyi dus/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis bod kyi chos log par spyod tshad la bka' shog brdzangs pa las/ las kyi srin po bas ni snying rje chung / /khra dang spyang ki bas ni sha dad che/ /sogs gsungs nas/ sde snod gsum gyi chos la skur btab nas/ /mnar med dmyal bar skye ba snying re rje/ /gsungs pa thugs bden te/ sha yi phyir pha ma sems can mang po'i srog la nyin re bzhin 'tshe ba mthong thos bzhin du bla ma dge bshes rnams kyi rgyud la yang snying rje zhig mi skye/ sems can 'di kun snying rje sha 'di sdig pa'i rtsa ba rang red/ sha za mi rung bar 'dug ces chos shig kyang mi gsung bar ci bder longs spyod na snying rje med pa'i srin po las ngan te/ lho nub srin po'i yul na yang srin po rgan pa rnams kyi kha skad la/ srin po gdong dmar bod kyi yul na sha khrag zos 'thung ba tsam du ma zad/ rus pa yang brdungs nas khu ba 'thung ba red de zhed gi zhes gleng skad/ des na srin po las nged tsho snying rje chung / snying rje med pa'i srin po zhig gzhan na yod ma sems/ khra dang sbyang ki sogs kyis nyi ma re gnyis re la sha med par 'dug dus mang / sha yis 'grangs tshe ltogs rags bar du sha'i phyir du mi 'bad par sa zhig la babs nas lhod de sdod/ nged tsho'i bla ma dpon po la sogs pa'i 667

mi phal che ba nyin gcig la sha med par sdod mi tshugs/ shas rgyags rung da dung phyin chad za dgos snyam sha mang po nyo/ sha rin gyi nor rdzas mang po gsog 'jog byed pas/ khra dang spyang ki rnams las nged tsho sha dad che nges/ des na sde snod gsum na ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod pa'i bya spyod ngan pa 'dra gtan nas byed mi rung zhes gsungs tshad la/ kha gseng nas min zhes ma smras pa tsam ma gtogs don gyis skur ba btab par 'gyur bas/mnar med dmyal bar skye nges/ ci la mi skye/ de ru skye ba'i rgyu bsgrub pa'i 'o skol snyigs dus kyi chos pa'i gzugs brnyan phal che ba rnams/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od sogs sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje'i yul las gzhan 'os ci yod legs par soms dang ha go yong / 'o na sangs rgyas kyis rjes 'jug rnams la rnam gsum dag pa'i sha gnang ngo zer na/gnang ba byin pa la yang rnam pa mang bas/ thams cad po ra chu la brgal ba bzhin byed ga la rung / yul phyogs de na sha ma gtogs 'tsho ba'i zas gzhan med/ yul dus kyi dbang gis srog 'tsho ba'i phyir bsten dgos pa byung na/ dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bya ba yin pas/ rnam gsum dag pa'i sha cung zad 668

tsam re bsten chog /dge slong rgan pa rlung gis 'chi la nye ba'i nad rtsi la zas gzhan gyis phan pa ma byung bar shas phan na rnam gsum dag pa'i sha bsten chog ces gsungs pa yin gyi/ gzhan zas dkar gsum mngar gsum rtsam bgro zhib 'bras sogs ci 'dod za rgyu yod/ dgos pa gzhan med bzhin du bsten rung chog ces pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ de yin na sangs rgyas kyi phyin chad nga'i nyan thos rnams sha bzar mi rung ngo zhes bcas pa mdzad pa dang / sha chang gnyis rang gis longs spyod pa lta ci smos/ gzhan la byin pa yang dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye tshul sogs sha zos pa'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa thams cad rdzun yin zhes smra dgos/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyis rnam gsum dag pa'i sha bshan pa'i lag nas blangs gsungs pa yang rnam pa mang / de yul dus dang bstun dgos te/sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus dang / deng sang gi dus kyi dge 'dun pa dang bshan pa rnams kyis bsam sbyor gcig dogs mod/sangs rgyas kyi dus lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dar bas/ dge 'dun pa rnams byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis gzhan dbang du song nas sha mi za nor rdzas gsog 'jog gtan nas mi bya/ phyogs gcig tu 'tshogs nas dus rgyun mi sdod/ bod 669

bzhin dgon pa mang po yang med/ de'i dus kyi bshan pa rnams kyis kyang rang gi kha dang nye 'brel sogs kyi ched ma gtogs gzhan dge 'dun pas longs spyod snyam de la dmigs nas ra lug gcig tsam yang gsod pa'i bsam sbyor med/ de'i dus dge 'dun pa rgan pa rlung shas che ba 'chi la nye ba'i rlung nad la phan phyir bshan pa'i lag nas sha cung zad re blangs nas zos kyang rnam gsum dag pa yin pa de bden yang / deng sang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar dar 'dra yang / lung gi bstan pa tsam min rtogs pa'i bstan pa nyams pa'i dus ngan 'dir/dge 'dun pa phal che ba dug gsum dug lnga'i gzhan dbang du song / sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag 'di longs spyod gyi gzhi mar bsten/ gsog 'jog khyim pa las che ba byas dgon chen yang mang po tshugs byung tshe/ bshan pa rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun pa rnams kyis sha za ba dang rin chen po byen nas nyo ba shes/ dge 'dun pa spyi la dmigs nas pha ma ra lug mang po bsad/ dge 'dun pa rnams la sha dgos sha'i phyir du pha ma'i srog gcod dgos/ srog gcod pa la bshan pa 'jog dgos byung nas/bshan pa yod tshad bsam bzhin du dgon pa'i thag nyer bzhagabashan pas dge 'dun pa spyi la dmigs nas pha ma ra lug 670

g.yag gsum gsod pa mthong thos dogs gsum yod bzhin du/rnam gsum dag pa yin zhes smras na/ de dge 'dun pa yongs la brdzun gyi pham pa yang 'byung nyen che la/ dge 'dun yongs kyi kha nas ma bshad pa ma gtogs don gyis bshan pa rnams la gsod pa khyed tshos sod dang nyo ba nged tshos nyo zhes bshad pa dang khyad par med/ kha nas phar lug 'di sod dang / bshan pas tshur la dge 'dun pa rnams la dmigs nas lug 'di tsam zhig bsad ces ma bshad pa tsam gyis rnam gsum dag par mi 'gyur/ des na deng sang dgon pa'i thag nye'i bshan pas bsad pa'i sha 'di rnam gsum mi dag par ma zad/ phyogs der 'tshogs pa'i dge 'dun sha bzhes tshad spyi la dmigs nas bsad pa'i bsngos sha yin pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgon mtha' na gnas pa'i bshan pas bsad pa'i sha 'di log 'tsho ru bsams nas 'jom pa gal che/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung de 'dra'i rigs yul dus dang bstun shes dgos/ deng sang bla ma rnams la yang sbyin bdag gis khyed kyi 'tsho ba la lug cig bsad nas sha 'dren rgyu yin zhes zhus na/ ngo tsha nas 'dzem pa 'dra yin na ma gtogs/ sbyin bdag gis bla ma la dmigs nas lug bsad de drangs na/ lug de'i gang yin yang bla mas 671

mthong thos dogs gsum yod kyang / rang gis zos pas mi chog gzhan la yang zo zo zer grwa pa rnams grogs su sbran nas za ba mang / bsngos sha zer ba de bla ma yin yang khyed la lug bsad nas 'dren rgyu yin zhes zhu dgos pa min/ bla ma la dmigs nas bsad pa de bla ma kho rang gis mthong thos dogs gsum byung ba des chog yong / gal te rnam gsum dag rung so thar byang sems sngags sdom blangs nas/ lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs lam 'bras kyi nang ltar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ nyan thos kyi cha lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis sems can ra lug rnams pha ma ru bsams nas/de'i srog la gnod kyis dogs nas mi za ba dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rje la rag las pas/ bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan pa'i phyir yang sha gtan nas mi za ba zhig gal che ste/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ bsam mno btang na pha ma'i sha'am bu'i sha sus za nus/ nyan thos rnams kha sha za bar 'dod pa dang / rang la nyes par 'gyur ba'i dmigs sha ma byung na/ des chog par brtsis nas/ nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha/ /za bar rung gis mi za na/ /lhas sbyin gyi ni brtul zhugs 'gyur/ /gsungs pa la 'khris nas sha bzhes kyin 'dug ste/ 'di la mtshungs pa zhig 672

zhu na/ stu shar po gsum 'khor ba zhig la byas e chog mi chog na tshong 'dus gsum du ma brin pa'i sha yang zos mi chog don la mi bsam par tshig la 'khris pa 'dis phugs skyon gcig ni rang la 'ong gsungs/ 'o na lha sa gzhis ka rtse sogs kyi bshan pa 'di rnams kyis nang nas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul bas yar 'dren pa yang yod srid/ sngon yang yod pa'i rgyu mtshan lo rgyus 'dug pas/ lha sa'i bshan pa 'di rnams kyi lag nas nyos na nyes pa med zer na/ sngon de 'dra re re tsam byung 'dug deng sang yang los yod snyam pa de dag snang sbyangs pa yin na legs te/ kha sha za 'dod pa'i g.yo sgyu min na rung ste/ lha sa'i bshan pa thams cad kyis 'dren gyin yod snyam nas sha za ga la rung / bshan pa stong gi nang na yang 'dren mkhan gcig kyang e yod ci shes/ su la mngon shes ni med/ bshan pa rnams kyis rnam shes dag zhing du drangs rtags khyad par can bstan/ bla ma dam pa'i mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas des 'dren par thag chod ces lung bstan thob pa'i bshan pa yod na legs te/ de 'dra dkon/ gal te de 'dra yod kyang sngon sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis pha ma sems can shi ba'i rnam shes dag zhing du drangs zer ba rna thos yod pas de lugs mdzad na legs kyi/673

srog bcad nas rnam shes dag zhing du 'dren pa 'di 'phral du pha ma sems can sdug la/ phugs su rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rnam thar dang yang mi mthun pa'i 'dren tshul btsog pa zhig red/des na sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis kyang bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren 'di re zhig 'jog rog gyis/ 'o na sha ni snying rje can gyis za/ /chang ni dam tshig can gyis 'thung / /gsungs pa'ang 'dug pas/ snying rje can gyis sha zos na skyon med zer na/de yin na sangs rgyas dang 'khor nyan thos/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ jo bo rje yab sras sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis sha chang ma bzhes par 'dug pas/ de rnams la snying rje dang dam tshig med pa yin nam/ yang na de dag rnams las khyod la snying rje chen po yod ces khas len dgos par 'gyur/ des na snying rje can gyis pha ma sems can gyi sha khrag dmar po za don med/ sha za ba la snying rje med de/ zhi byed kyi rgyud las/ sha za ba la snying rje med/ /gsungs/ 'o na sha ni snying rje can gyis za gsungs pa la dgongs gzhi ci yod zer na/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can gyis bstan 'gro la dgos pa chen po yod tshe/ rma la phan phyir khyi tshil glan pa ltar sred pa med rung / gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa'i dbang gis snying rje bzhin za ba la dgongs nas de 674

skad gsungs pa yin la/ rang dgar snying rje can gyis pha ma'i sha za ba phar zhog lag tu yang len par mi 'gyur/ deng sang dgos pa gang yang med par sha za ba rnams ni rang gi nang na snying rje med pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/mdo tril gyis dril ba'i snying po la/ deng sang sde dgon phal che ba'i longs spyod kun gyi gzhi ma ru sha za ba 'dis pha ma ra lug 'bri g.yag bya phag la sogs pa'i srog la 'tshe ba byung nas/sems can gyi bde skyid 'phrog rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig par 'dug /dge 'dun pa rnams kyis sha mi za ba zhig byung na nyes byas kyi sgo mang po zhig rang bzhin gyis khegs nas/ bstan pa yang yun ring du gnas shing sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar 'gyur nges/ des na rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la sogs pa'i gsar rnying gi grub mtha' phal mo ches rang rang gi bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad 'dod pa'i phyi rabs kyi bla ma chos rgyal rnams kyis/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus rgya gar du khrims ji ltar bcas pa dang / bod du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan gyis chos khrims ji ltar bsdams pa de ltar/ dge 'dun yongs kyis kyang skom du dkar dang ja gsol zhing / zas 675

su 'bru dang bur sbrang mar thud sogs sdig med kyi zas ma gtogs sdig zas sha sogs za mi rung ba'i chos gsungs khrims kyang 'jog dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ sha ni gcan gzan rnams kyi zas/ /bzar mi rung bar thub chen gsungs/ /zos na nyes pa gang yin dang / /ma zos pa yi yon tan dag /sha za de la gang yod pa/ /blo gros chen bos shes par gyis/ /'khrul ba dang ni gnyen byas dang / /khu chu khrag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung bo rnams ni dngangs gyur pas/ /rnal 'byor can gyis sha mi bza'/ /zhes dang / rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ rab byung mkhan pos sdom phog khrims bcas bzhin/ /sde snod gsum nas ji ltar bshad bzhin gyis/ /dge 'dun skom du dkar dang ja gsol cig /zas su 'bru dang bur sbrang mar thud gsol/ /gos su thang sham dur smrig chas mdzod cig /gnas su gtsug lag khang sde'i nang du bzhugs/ /chang nag sha dang lhad zas ma bsten cig /gsungs so/ /des na deng sang bod du chos dar yun ring zhing dar ches drags pas/ thams cad chos bred du song nas dgon sde dang gtsug lag khang gi thag nyer mthong thos dogs gsum/ phung ba'i sdig pa'i grogs po bshan pa lag dmar bzhag nas pha mar lug brgya stong mang po bsad/ sha yi 676

rtsig pa brtsigs/ khrag gi chu rgyun btsugs nas bstan pa la rma phab/ sems can la sdug gtong ba 'di la bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dang / rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis thugs rje re gzigs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal ba yab sras rgyal tshab dam pa dga' ldan gser khri sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa da ltar bzhugs pa dang / slad nas 'byon pa rnams kyis 'di la thugs mnyam re zhog ces thugs rgyud 'gro ba'i don du bskul/ skya ser pho mo blo ldan snying rje can rnams kyis pha ma sems can gsod pa'i bshan pa dang sha khrag dmar po'i zas ngan pa 'di la ltag pa re ston zhes snying thag pa nas smras pa yin pas sems la zhog khyad par khyed bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bsad tshad gso nus shing / zos tshad 'dren gyin yod pa rnams kyis kyang deng sang snyigs dus 'dir yar 'dren pa'i nus pa ma mchis pa'i bla ma sku skyes/ dge bshes sngags 'chang sogs snying khams can mang po'i seng ge'i mchongs sar wa ldang ba ltar byas/ rang gzhan gnyis phung byed par 'dug pas/ de rnams la phan phyir yar 'dren mi nus pa ltar mdzod la sha ma za dang 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin che bar 677

'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ snying rje nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying rjes phongs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la snying rje chen po'i dngos grub stsol/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yis/ /byams dang snying rje lhag bsam dag pa'i sgos/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rnams la bslab par bya/ /rang gi tshe rabs thog ma ma mchis pas/ /tshe sngon pha mar ma gyur sems can med/ /dngos sam brgyud nas pha ma sems can gyi/ /srog la gnod pa'i sha khrag za mi rung / /sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag zos tshad kun/ /phyi mar dmyal ba 'o dod 'bod sogs su/ /btsos nas sdug bsngal chen po myong dgos zhes/ /lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo las rgyas par gsungs/ /sha khrag rus gsum btsos nas zos gyur na/ /phyi mar dmyal ba khro chu khol mar skye/ /sha khrag khams gsum phung bar byed pa'i zas/ /yin zhes thugs rje chen po'i rgyud las gsungs/ /sha khrag zos pa'i lus la dri za 'dus/ /bcud 'phrog phyi mar srin po sha za mo/ /lang ga'i yul du de dag 'khor ro zhes/ /rnying rgyud kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /sha 678

zos tshe thung phal cher dmyal bar 'gro/ /lan du'ang srog gcod rang sha gzhan gyis za/ /rgyu song 'bras bu de dang mtshungs so zhes/ /rgyal bu dad pa brtan po'i zhal nas gsungs/ /de'i phyir sha yi nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /ra lug la sogs sems can gang gi sha /yin yang nam yang za bar mi rung zhes/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal nas yang yang gsungs/ /sha la sred pa'i dbang gis sha za bar/ /rung bar 'dul ba las ni gnang ngo zhes/ /kho bo cag ni rnam pa thams cad du/ /mi smra de 'dra ba la skyon med par/ /gnyid kyi rmi lam du yang mi smra'o/ /sems bskyed pa yis gang dag sha zos na/ /rang gi snying rje chen po nyams 'gro zhing / /ro la sred pa drag po skyer mthong nas/ /dgag bya de dag nges par 'gog slad du/ /rnam gsum dag dang ma dag sha thams cad/ /mi za ba ni mchog tu ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /sems can sha khrag rus gsum spungs dkyil du/ /gri 'phyar dgra bgegs 'dul la chas 'dra ba'i/ /dge 'dun gzugs brnyan rnams la thugs rje yi/ /gzigs zhes lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /lhag par byang chub sems dpa' sha yi ror/ /sred pa che na ma gyur sems can la/ /snying rje skyes pa'ang nyams par 'gyur ro zhes/ /679

rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ /de phyir 'jig rten khams na nyin re bzhin/ /sha yi phyir du sems can grangs med re/ /gsod pa rnams la snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /sems can gzhan srog skyob la 'bad par bya/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gzhan yang gal chen 'bum la brgya tshar 'don pa'i dpe ltar/ da dung yang nan tan byas bshad par bya ste/ ston pa /thugs rje can gyi gsung rab kyi ma mo so sor thar pa'i mdo las/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge pa phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//gsungs/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal zhi zhing bde ba thams cad bstan pa las 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur ste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /gsungs/ bstan pa de 'dzin mkhan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen snod/ /'bar ba'i snod ni dka' thub can/ /ngur sprig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras/ /dge slong rnams ni yin phyir ro/ /gsungs/ des na sdig spongs dge ba sgrub pa sangs 680

rgyas kyi bstan pa yin/ de 'dzin mkhan rnams dge 'dun yin na/ pha ma sems can gyi srog bcad pa'i sha khrag 'di dge 'dun pa zhig gis za ba phar zhog skye bo phal ba zhig gis kyang za ga la phod/ sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag 'di deng sang sa dge rnying 'brug sogs kyi dge 'dun yongs kyi longs spyod kyi gzhi mar bsten pa 'di rjes 'jug rnams kyi spyod yul zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ 'o skol rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pas sems can thams cad kyi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med la/ tshe rabs sngon ma'i ma dang tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis kyis bskyangs pa la khyad par med/ khyad par tshe sngon ma'i ma rnams kyis tshe 'di'i ma'i drin gyis bskyangs pa las lhag gis nged rnams kyi don du lus srog kyang 'phangs pa med par btang ba'i dus kyang mang zhes thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pas de su zhig gis mi bden zer/ de bden par rtsi na/ pha ma sems can drin can de rnams kyi drin lan du da lta phan zhig mi 'dogs rung / srog bcad nas sha zos khrag 'thung bar mi rigs kyang / sha zos pa tsam du ma zad rus pa mur sha yi bzang ngan gleng ba 'di snying rje med pa'i srin po'i spyod pa ma nor ba dngos yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ pha ma ra lug rnams 681

sdig can bshan pas gsod tshe dngangs shing skrag 'then skor mang po byas skad ngan 'don/ mig mthar chu 'khyil sug bzhi 'dar/ bshan pa'i gdong la mig hrig hrig blta/ mig nas mchi ma khri ler gtong / snying rje rgyu de dus yod mod/ bshan pa lag dmar gyi dme lag gi gon pa'i kha gyen du brdzes/ gri rnon pos mgo bo rbad kyis bcad tshe/ bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myang / ja thebs re la yan lag lus po shig shig yom yom 'gul/ de sogs sdug bsngal myong ba bsam na byang chub sems dpa' snying rlung ldang na/ 'o skol rnams kyi snying 'di rul ba zhig yin nam/ yang na chung nas med dam/ yang na lcags shig yin na ma gtogs/ snying rje zhig mi skye ba'i gnas yod dam/ sngon bshan pa zhig gis lug mang po bsad nas sgo la bshang gci 'dor du song ba'i shul na lug gcig yod pa des rang gi srog gcod par shes nas/ bshan pa'i gri bzhag yod pa sa la dong brus nas sbas steng du sa bkab nas nyal bsdad pa'i lo rgyus sogs soms dang / de rnams e bden mi bden blta bar 'dod na/ lha sa'i bshan pas lug gsod pa'i khang ba'i sgo'am steng nas sdod la lug brgya stong mang po nyin re bzhin gsod pa la ltos dang ha go yong / pha ma ra lug g.yag gsum gyi sdug 682

bsngal bzod dam mi bzod kyi tshad blta na/ rang gi kha sna bsum pa'am/ yang na rang gi sha pags pa sen mo gnyis kyi bar du 'tshir dang / lug gi kha bsum pa dang / mgo bo bcad pa dang /khog tu lag pa btang nas srog rtsa bcad pa'i na tsha sdug bsngal de bas brgya stong 'gyur gyi che bas/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal steng du byung na bzod mi bzod kyi ha go yong / de ltar rang lus la dpe blangs bsam mno zhib tu gtong shes na/ skya ser pho mo su zhig yin rung / sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag mthong na snying rje zhig mi skye rung / 'dod sred skyes nas za ba'i mi su zhig yod/ dper na tshe 'di'i drin can gyi pha ma gnyis sam/ yang na bu bsad nas sha rang la byin na/ sred pa skyes nas za'am mi za/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ pha byas pa'i rus pa'i phung po dang / ma byas pa'i nu zho rgya mtshor bskyil na khams gsum snod du ga la shongs/des na bsam mno btang na pha ma'i sha'am bu'i sha sus za nus gsungs/ mnyam med po to bas/ ma mgron du bos pa'i mdun du bu'i sha btsos nas drangs na dga' bar 'gyur ram/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas mchod pa la srog bcad pa'i mchod pa de dang mtshungs gsungs/ de rnams la bsam blo gtong mkhan ni med/ rang gis lag bzhag pa dang / khas gsod ces bshad 683

pa'i sha 'dra yin na ma gtogs/ gzhan gyis bsad pa'i sha gang zos kyang nyes pa med dam snyam za ba 'di sangs rgyas byang sems rnams yi mug skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ mon pa'i kha gtam la/ bod mig ma zhim pa yin/kha ma zhim pa min zer ba bzhin/ dngos su bsad na khyed de 'dra mdzad mkhan mi yong zer/ lkog tu bsad nas sha tshil byen byung na/ yon bdag gis gzab thugs rjes bzung / rjes su yi rang zer ba 'di yi mug gsungs/ des na sa dge rnying gsum/'bri dwags gar gsum sogs rgya bod hor sog tu dar ba'i grub mtha' gar yod phal cher gyi gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa'i thag nye na/ sdig can bshan pa lag dmar gyis sha'i rtsig pa brtsigs/ mgo'i phung po spungs/ khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil/ pags pa dang nang khrol gcal du bkram/ rwa dang rus pa'i khang pa phug /pha ma sems can drin can ra lug g.yag gsum gyi srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag dron mo mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis nyos/ btsun chung shed can gyis 'khur/ yul du song nas dpung tshogs dgra bo 'dul la chas pa bzhin sems can sha rus mang po mdun du spungs pa'i dkyil du/ mig rig rig blta zhing gri 'phyar nas steng du rub/ gri yis gtsab rngams nas zos/684

rjes med thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du gtong ba 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad/ dge 'dun gyi sde brdzad/ sems can gye bde skyid 'phrog par thag chod pas/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyis 'di thabs mkhas thugs rje du ma'i sgo nas med pa zhig ma bzos na/ phyi rol bas kyang de'i lhag byed rab yang med la/ byed tshul yang med par gda'/ chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sha chang rgya mtshor bskyil ba 'di sngar mu stegs pa la yod zer/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin na ci srid gsungs/ da 'di ltar byas phyin chad rgya gar du dar ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gshegs pa'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub thob brgyad cu sogs byon dus rnams su re zhig gnas kyang / de nas rim gyis bstan pa'i rang skyes btegs nas 'og min du phebs song / deng sang yod pa phyi rol dmar mchod byed pa'i lugs dang 'dres pa'i bstan pa yin/ bstan pa rnam dag po med zer dgos/ de bzhin du bod du dar ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang sngon mkhan slob chos gsum gshegs pa'i rjes su jo bo rje dang rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras kyi bar du sdig pa'i dri mas ma gos par re zhig bzang po byas gnas kyang / de 685

nas rjes 'jug phal cher bshan pa dang thag nye byas bsdad pa dang bstan pa yang skyo nas/ jo bo rje yab sras kyi dus skabs dran nas yar dga' ldan du theg song / da lta yod pa 'di kun bshan pa mig dmar gyi sha khrag dang 'dres pa'i bstan pa bslad can yin/ da bslad med dka' zer dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sdig spongs dge sgrub yin pa de bden na/ kun gyis sha mang po nyos nas zos tshe sha khe bar 'dug snyam nas srog gcod la brtson pa'i bshan pa mang po byung / de rnams kyis nyin re bzhin pha ma ra lug brgya stong mang po'i srog la 'tshe ba'i sdig pa tshabs can bsags nas bstan pa sdig pas bslad pa yin la/ chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad dang khyad par dge 'dun pa rnams kyis sha ma zos na srog la 'tshe mkhan yang mi 'byung / dper na rgya gar bas ja ma 'thung tshe yul der ja btsongs mi 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /srog la 'tshe mkhan med tshe sems can mang po tshe thar du 'gro ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas/ de bas dge ba phun sum tshogs pa zhig med kyang de mi sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /sha'i phyir du sdig pa byed bzhin du dgon sa dkar khra shig ge kun bstan pa'i gzhi ma dang / zhwa dmar ser rnams bstan 'dzin yin snyam nas de skad smra na 686
