yang / zhe 'dod dang lag len gnyis rgyab 'gal yin pas/chos pa'i ming tsam zhig ma gtogs don gyis khyem pa dang khyad med de/ rje mi las/ grong ltag gi dgon chung khra bo de/ /ming dgon par btags kyang grong pa yin/ /bka' gdams kyi btsun chung srang rdo mgo /ming btsun par btags kyang lus bsgyur yin/ /gsungs so/ /de ltar byed na rtags tsam 'dzin gye bstan pa zer ba zhig phyi nas 'ong zhes zer ba rnams da slebs yod do zhes kun la bsgrags par rigs so/ /'o na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin zhing / sems can la bde skyid spel bar 'dod na ci lta bu zhig mdzad dgos/ zhes bla ma sgyes bu dam pa rnams kyis phran bdag lta bu la thugs rab tu brtse ba'i sgo nas gsungs 'byon na/ 'di ltar mdzad dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyis/ blo gros chen po/ngas sha'i zas ni su la'ang ma gnang / mi gnang gnang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab tu byung ba rnams la sha'i zas ni mi rung bar ngas bshad do/ /yang 'khrul dang ni gnyen bshes dang / /khu chu khrag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung bo rnams kyang dngangs gyur na/ /rnal 'byor can gyis sha mi za/ /gsungs/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ de bzhin ma sha'i sran chan dag /dngos grub 'dod pas rnam par spangs/ /gsungs/ mnyam med sgam po ba'i zhal 687

nas/ sdig zas khra bo'i sha dang gcig /myos byed ser mo'i chang dang gnyis/ /bslu khrid na chung gzhon dang gsum/ /chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs/ /snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs/skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen dang / rgyal tshab/ bka' blon/ser 'bras sogs kyi bla ma dge bskos las sna thams cad gros byas pa'am/ yang na rang rang gis sgo go phyogs na bstan dgra sdig can bshan pa gang 'dug mi bzhag par tshar bcad/ gal te sdod na zas gzhan ma gtogs srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag dge 'dun pa yongs la btsongs sa med pa'i khrims zhogaser 'bras dge gsum sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun pa chos gos dmar ser sor bzhi 'dzin pa yan chad kyis zas dkar gsum sogs sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i za ma ma gtogs/ pha ma sems can gyi srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag za ba phar zhog lag tu yang blangs mi chog pa'i khrims sdoms/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag grong sde'i skye pho mo mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyis kyang rang bzhin gyi shi ba nad kyis shi ba/g.yang la lhungs pa/ 'gags nas shi ba/ gcan gzan sogs 688

kyis bsad pa'i sems can gyi sha ma gtogs/ pha ma'i srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha za mi rung zhes nyes dmigs che tshul gyis las 'bras bden pa'i chos gsungs la/ rab byung na sdig zas srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag 'di'i ming ma gtogs shul yang mi shes pa zhig bzos zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ khyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba ris med bstan 'gro'i don byed pa la bsam bzhin sku'i skye ba bzhes pa yin zer ba rnams kyang khang bzang nyams dga' ba re'i nang du 'dzul nas skyid rgyab nas bzhugs ma 'dug par/ phyi rol tu byon la sems can gyi skyid sdug legs nyes la gzigs dang / 'gro don ji ltar mdzad dgos kyi ha go yong/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis rgyal srid bzung yod dus pho brang gi phyi sgo la byon nas skye rga na 'chi bzhi gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis rgyal srid spangs/ mchod rten rnam dag drung nas dbu skra bsil/ chu bo dre rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' ba spyad sangs rgyas nas kyang khang bzang gcig bzos/ nang du 'dzul nas ma bsdad par phyogs kun tu byon nas 'gro don mdzad tshul/ chos 'khor bskor tshul gye rnam thar gsung rnams thugs la bzhag nas de bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ khyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 689

dpa'i sprul ba skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dang po thugs bskyed dus/ sems can sdug bsngal can mthong ngam thos sam/ sus gsol ba btab kyang btang snyoms su skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par 'gro ba'i don byed ces thugs bskyed yang yang mdzad smon lam yang btab pa yin tshul dgongs nas/ da thugs bskyed dam bca' ma 'dor bar 'gro ba 'di dag gi don ci nas kyang mdzod/ gal te ma mdzad par btang snyoms yal bar dor na/ sngon thugs rje'i gter chen 'phags mchog phyag na pad dkar bsnams pas kyang / thugs bskyed dam bca' dor bas dbu ji ltar song phyi nas sngar gyi de bas thugs bskyed mdzad nas/ 'gro don la brtson dgos pa byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams thugs la mnga' ba gsal btab pa yin pas thugs kyis dgongs 'tshal/ 'o na ha ha khyod ban rgan zhig gi khas bkod pa btang tshe yong bar 'dug ste/ de sangs rgyas stong gis bsgrubs kyang phyag len la thebs pa mi 'dug sha 'di sdig zas kyi mi tshad dug zas red/ zos tshad sang gnang nas sbos nas 'chi bar gda' zhes bshad kyang chod dka' bar gda'/ sngon bskal pa 'di chags pa nas bzung dar bar 'dug da lta gsar du byung ba zhig min/ khyod min rung sha kun gyes spangs na 690

'dod de/ sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang ma chod par lus song / sdig can bla mas mi 'khyob/ nyes can dpon pos mi 'khyob/ bu rul pha mas mi 'khyob/ sems can gcig gi las sleb tshe/ sangs rgyas stong gi mthu rdugs bya ba yin pas/ las kyi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang bzlog tu med na nged tsho 'dra bas bya thabs med/ sems can rang rang gi las bzang ngan gang la spyod du chug khyod shes chung 'dod thag ma nye/ snying rje skye sla na khong khro rgyun mi 'chad/ kha rog bsdad pa gdams ngag zab pas khyod kyis spyon pa bzhin dgos mi dgos mang po ma lab par kha rog bsdod cig ces bka' bkyon lta bu'i gsung 'byon na/ de ban rgan nga 'dra'i blun pos ci zer gi blta snyam tshod brtags phyir du ku re gsungs pa yin las che/ de la ngas kyang lan 'bul bas dgongs 'tshal/ nga shes chung 'dod thag nye ba'i ban rgan snyoms chung zhig gi kha gdangs pa tsam zhig kyang / khyed deng sang gi sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba dngos yin zer ba'i sgyes bu dam pa stong phrag gcig gis bsgrubs kyang phyag len la mi thebs na/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi sprul sku yin zer ba'ang bden nam/ bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gye dus kyi mi 691

rnams tshe dpal stobs 'byor lha dang mnyam skad/ bar du bod du yang brag srin mo dang / 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyis mi rgyud spel dus/ shing thog gro nas 'bras sogs la longs spyad pa ma gtogs/ sha khrag zos zer ba mi 'dug pas/ bskal pa chags nas bzung dar yod zer ba yang cung mi bden par gda'/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus nas bzung jo bo yab sras kyi bar gye sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyes chod pa'i lo rgyus dang gtam rgyud mang po 'dug zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs la longs spyad gsungs pa ma gtogs / dmar gsum skyur gsum zhes ma gsungs 'dug pas/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa'i dus su yang ma chod gsungs pa yang sgo skur du 'gyur bas mi rung snyam/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'am bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis chos bstan nas/ mtshams med lnga sogs kyi las ngan tshan po che byas pas sdig can yang 'khor ba ngan song gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs nas bde chen gyi zhing du drangs pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pas/ dgongs gzhi can 'dra ma gtogs sdig can bla mas mi 'khyob gsungs pa yang mi bden snyam/ snying rje skye sla na khong khro'i rgyun mi 'chad na/ sangs rgyas byang sems 692

rnams las snying rje skye sla ba zhig gzhan na med pas de rnams la yang khong khro'i rgyun mi 'chad du khas len dgos pa sogs mi 'grigs pa du ma 'byung / kha rog bsdad tshad gdams ngag zab na/ chos gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / da lta thos bsam byed pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis bgro gleng byas pa las/ dud 'gro rnams kha rog par bsdad 'dug pas/ de gdams ngag zab par 'gyur/ smyos tshad thams cad kyi kha la yid brtan sked na/ rje mi las/ nga pha smyo bu smyo brgyud pa smyo gsungs pas/ de rnams kyi gsung la yang yid brtan mi rung bar 'gyur/ da ngas bsams na dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar dang gsungs ltar chos kyis smyo dgos/ smyos nas bshad dgos pas/nga kha rog par 'dug ci la dgos da dung lab rgyu yin/ pha ma sems can gyi sdug la bsams na sdod mi thub par gda'/ 'o na khyod kyis ci bshad na'ang shod zer na/ 'o lags so de yin na da lta bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma bzhin du shar/bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang pos gangs can ljongs 'di dogs por bgyi ba'i dus skabs bzang po 'dir kun gyis sdig pa gcig mi chod na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub bstan 'dzin rnams zhing brjes nas chod yong ngam/ sngon rkang pa ya gcig zha 693

yod pa'i mi zhig rkyang zhig la zhon nas glu kho na len pa la/gzhan gyis khyod 'di tsam gyi glu mang po ci la blangs dris pas/kho bo rkyang la zhon nas glu mi len na nam len zhes smras pa ltar/da lta bstan dang bstan 'dzin yod dus 'dir sdig pa mi gcod la nam tshod gcod/ dper na dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs 'dzom dus dgra 'dul dgos pa ltar/ da re bod la bstan pa dar bstan 'dzin skyes bu mang po dpung ldang gshibs nas bzhugs dus 'dir/ srin po gdong dmar bod yul gye bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren/ pha ma'i srog gi gshed ma/ bshan pa pho mo dang sha khrag dmar gyi longs spyod 'di gtan nas med pa zhig bzo dgos/ kun gyis brtson par byas na 'di'i mi tshad tsho yang chod yong ste/ 'dod yon lnga'i nang gi che shos bud med bsten pa'i bde ba 'di yin zhes rgyud sogs nas gsungs pa sems can thams cad kyis chod dka' yang / dge 'dun pa yongs kyis rbad kyis bcad tshe/ da lta chags bral gyi dge 'dun ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i sde pas sa steng khebs pa tsam byung ba mngon sum tshad ma 'di la gzigs/ 'di lta bu'i spongs dka' ba yang chod na/ de la bltas na sha spongs sla ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ma zos kyang / sha bas lhag gi ro mngar zhing bcud che ba'i kha 694

zas mang po la longs spyod rgyu yod pa'i phyir ro/ da lta phran ngas kyang / las 'bras bden pa'i chos bshad pa'i yul chung mang pos srog mi gcod pa'i khas len dang / btsun pa mang pos sha mi za ba'i dam bca' byed pa mang po byung na/ khyed go sa mtho zhing / thabs la mkhas pa thugs rje che ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen/ rgyal tshab dam pa dga' ldan gser khri/ rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin ser 'bras kyi bla ma sogs skyes chen dam pa bzhugs tshad thams cad kyis sha yi 'tsho ba spangs nas/ gzhan skya ser pho mo drag zhan thams cad la spyir las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos dang sha yi nyes dmigs za mi rung ba'i bcas pa mdzad tshul/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos na yod tshad thams cad bsgrags nas dge 'dun rnams kyis sha'i rigs spong dgos/khyed khyem pa pho mo ya rabs rnams kyis kyang sgong thub na rab/de min rung rang bzhin gyis shi ba'i sha 'dra ma gtogs/ gzhan gye srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha kham gang zos rung tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis bsad pa'i sha zos pa dang khyad med pas mi rung dug ltar spong dgos zhes yang yang nan cher gsungs/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i yul phyogs thams cad kyi bla ma sgyes bu dam pa mchog dman bar ba thams cad kyis sha 695

spangs na/ sangs rgyas bden pa'i gsung dri ma med pa la mi nyan pa su yod/ sdig can gyi bshan pa yin yang snang ba 'gyur nas spong na gzhan smos ci dgos/ des na bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba rnams kyi blo thabs du ma'i sgo nas/ sdig zas pha ma'i sha za ba gcod pa la brtson par rigs so/ /'o na dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso yin pas sha 'di rbad kyis bcad btang na/ rlung shas che ba'i rgan rgon bla rgan dang / gsang sngags tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / bla ma skyes bu dam pa'i 'tsho ba sogs sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dus gsum mkhyen pa rnams kyis/ sha'i rigs spangs nas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs zas sna gzhan bsten na/ sha la nyes pa mtha' yas pas phyi rabs ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis sha za mi rung / dug ltar spong dgos zhes lan cig ma yin par yang yang gsungs pa rnams/ ma 'ongs pa na rjes 'jug bla rgan rlung gis 'chi ba ma mkhyen/ mkhyen rung 'tsho ba'i zas bcad nas 'chi ru bcug pa yin zhes zhu dgos pas de mi 'grig rlung nad can gyi kha nang du sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag gi thal ba zhig rgyag dgos don med/ rlung nad la phan pa/'i zas brgya dgos na stong yod pa sman rgyud sogs nas bshad/ tha na sgog skya yan chad 696

kyis chog par gsungs/ de tsho'i gcig bsten pas mi 'ong na gnyis bsten na mi chog gam/ thabs med gyi srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag cig dgos zer ba 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma' zhing / pha ma sems can ra lug sogs snyoms chung ba'i tshod kyi gtam zhig yin pas snying rje med dam/rlung nad can gyes zho thud mar sogs longs spyod dang rlung gis mi 'chi ba'i kheg ngas 'khur/ grong pa phal cher gyis sha za 'dod kyang sha dkon nas ma zos par lo mang po song ba yod de/rlung nad yul grong de la che rab kyi gtam mi snang / srin po gdong dmar bod yul 'di ma gtogs/ gling gzhan dang 'gro ba gzhan mang pos sha mi za/ de rnams la sha zo zhes ston rgyu yin na/ skyugs nad can la zas bstan pa ltar 'gyur skad/ sems can de dag kyang rlung nad kyis shi ba'i skad cha mi 'dug rang ka skyes mtha' 'chi ba 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ bya thabs ci yod/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sha mi dgos/ bza' btung thams cad ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes yin pa la rnam pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru sprul nas phul na des chog gal te dmigs pa'i rten du rdzas tsam re dgos na yang / mi rnyed snyam nas sems kyi dpa' zhum ci ma dgos/ sems can gyi srog ma 697

bcad na sems can mang du 'gro/ sems can mang ba tsam du 'chi ba mang / shi ba mang ba tsam du ro mang / ro de rnams sha khrag yin pas des tshogs rdzas ci la mi 'ong / gsang sngags kyi rgyud las kyang / tshogs 'khor la sha dgos gsungs kyang / srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha dgos shi ba'i shas mi yong zhes ma gsungs so/ /bla ma skyes bu dam pa yin na 'tsho ba sha mi dgos/dgos na skyes bu dam pa e yin mi shes/ deng sang gi skyes bu dam pa rnams sngon gye rgyan drug mchog gnyis jo bo rje yab sras sogs kyi yan zhig min nam snyam/ de'ang tsam yin phyin zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kyis yong / gal te dus kyi dbang gis sgyes bu dam pa tshos kyang zhal sha la dgyes nas/dkas mi yong bar thabs med kyi pha ma'i sha bzhes dgos gsungs na/ bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la mi gnod pa'i phyir gsang nas tshol dang / ra lug tshon po glo bur du shi ba'i sha rnyed pas sbas pa'i tshul gyis de lugs gnang 'tshal/ 'o na sha zos pa'i nyes pa chung ngu de tsam zhig la chos gzhan mi dgos/ tha na gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan re brjod pas kyang byang zhing dag par 'gyur bas/ ltung bshags mi shes pa su med/ bla ma skyes bu dam pa mi dgos dge 'dun pa lhan pa 698

ser po gyon tshad kyis sha zos kyang skyon gyis mi gos zer na/ sha 'di'i phyir pha ma ra lug brgya stong mang po'i srog gcad pa 'di nyes pa chung na/ khyed tshos nyes pa chen po de gang la zer/ sdig zas pha ma'i sha zos pa'i nyes pa 'di las chen po zhig gang na yang med/ za ba mang tshe bshan pas pha ma'i srog gcod tshul la ltos/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa phal cher gyis/ sangs rgyas kyis/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing gsungs pa sogs shes bzhin khyad du bsad nas/ phyis tshe gang por sgrib sbyong byas kyang sha'i nyes pa sogs nyes pa chen po gzhan phar zhog ngag 'khyal gcig tsam smras pa'i nyes pa yang 'dag dka' ste/ sngon dge slong zhig gis dgra bcom pa skad ngan pa zhig la khye zugs pa 'dra'o smras pas/phyis bshags pa byas dmyal bar ma song yang / khye'i sgye ba lnga brgya len dgos pa byung ba sogs kyi gtan tshigs lo rgyus rnams la soms dang / gal te byang nas rang la skyon gyes mi gos rung / rang la brten nas pha ma sems can la gnod pa chen po 'byung na snying rje nas de dag la phan phyir sgongs ci la mi dgos/ sngon gye skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis chos byas na sha'i nyes pa dag nas rang la skyon gyis mi gos rung / pha ma sems can drin can la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod 'tshe 'byung ba 699

mkhyen nas de la mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen bo skyes te/ pha ma sems can la phan pa'i ched du sha spangs pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rje la rag las pas/ bstan pa 'dzin na 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i snying rje chen po rtag tu bskyed nas/ sdug bsngal nyes brgya'i rgya mtshor g.yengs pa'i pha ma sems can yongs la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyis gang bstan pa rnams bya dgos mod/ tshe sngon drin gyis yang yang bskyangs pa'i pha ma sems can rnams da lta sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la drin gzor phan mi 'dogs rung gnod 'tshe byas nas gang yong / de bas khrel med na rag byed tshul zhig e yod soms dang / rang la skyon gyis mi gos rung / pha ma sems can la gnod na sha tsam du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad gtong dgos na yang gtong ba nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin pas go bar gyis/ 'o na sha zos pa'i nyes pa che rung /de la brten nas gzhan bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher 'byung bas nyes pa las phan yon che ba de 'dems dgos zer na/ pha ma sems can gyi sha khrag la brten nas sngar yang bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen ma byung la phyin chad kyang mi 'byung / mi 'byung ba'i rtags su dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sngon 700

sha spangs nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams la yang sdig zas sha'i rigs spongs zhes gsungs snang /da lta bltas na yang sha la brten nas lus stobs rgyas te thig le 'phel 'ga' res btsun chung gi brla sha brdar/ 'ga' zhig gis skye dman gyi stu mnye/ kha cig gis khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyongs brdung re byed/ phal cher gyis sha rgyags re 'chos nas gnyid mkhan mang ba ma gtogs/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen 'di byung dang / yon tan 'di skyes zhes ston rgyu gang yang mi snang / da sha spangs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po ma byung yang rung / sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa tshos sha spangs nas bstan 'gro'i don yong ba de tsam zhig byung na des chog de bas che zhig mi dgos/ sngon gyi bka' gdams pa dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar ltar dge 'dun pa yongs kyis zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i za ma ma gtogs/ sha yi rigs mtha' dag spangs nas mi za ba dang /khyem pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang rang ka shi ba sogs kyi sha ma gtogs/ srog dbugs bcad pa'i pha ma sems can gyi sha khrag dmar po la longs mi spyod par/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i yul phyogs thams cad na srog gcod kyi sgra tsam yang mi 701

grags pa'i bskal pa zhig byung na/ de'i bsod nams la gzugs shig yod na nam mkha'i khams la yang mi shongs/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma bod la shar nas/ sems can thams cad bde skyid kyi 'od khang du chud yod ces lha mi yongs la skad gseng mthon pos sgrogs par rigs pas de lugs kun gyis gnang 'tshal/ gal te snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma'/ dkar phyogs pa rnams mthu chung / nag phyogs pa rnams mthu che/ sems can las ngan pa'i dbang gis de ltar chod pa'i skal pa ma byung na/ pha ma sems can re re tsam gyi srog bskyabs na yang phan yon che ba kun gyi thugs kyis mkhyen par gsal ba la zhu ci dgos/ des na skyabs mgon rgyal ba thugs rje can/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal tshab rin po che sogs sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ lha ldan sogs phyogs phyogs kyi dgon mtha'i gtsug lag khang sogs kyi thag nye'i bshan pa rnams kyis nyin re bzhin lug brgya stong mang po bsad de/ sha khrom brtsig nas btsongs pa 'di je nyung du gtong ba'i chos gsungs khrims 'jog pa sogs thabs sna tshogs byed pa dang /gzhan bla ma dge bshes rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' khyim 702

pa pho mo snying rje can mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyis chos kyi mchog tu pha ma sems can ra lug g.yag gsum sogs bshan pas gsod pa rnams kyi srog blu tshe thar ci mang gyis/ lo re bzhin bka' chos gnang ba'i bla ma rnams kyis skya ser pho mo drag zhan thams cad la/ sha'i nyes dmigs za mi rung bar spong dgos tshul mdo rgyud bstan bcos na gang yod lung rigs 'brel ba'i sgo nas gsungs la/ dge 'dun pa rab kyis sha spongs ci thub ltos/ 'bring gis shi sha ma gtogs srog bcad pa'i sha ma za/ tha mas kyang bshan pas srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag skabs re tsam za yang rgyun du bag med du ma za 'dod chung chog shes byed dgos pa'i bka' chos gnang bar zhu zhes thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar mdzad na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yod pa'i rtags dang khyad chos su gda'/ bstan pa gnas pa dang byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i khyad chos su de lta bu zhig ci nas kyang dgos/ nyam thag pha ma sems can gye srog la babs yod pa rnams kyi nang nas srog blu gcig tsam byas te/ tshe dar btags nas lha la phul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs byas 703

smon lam btabs na de bas dge ba zhig gzhan na med/ de mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yin pa gzhir bzhag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba snying rje yin de'i yan lag lta bu sdig spongs dge ba sgrub pa rnams yin pas/ mi des don gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bzung bar 'gyur/ dper na bu la byams na ma shugs kyis dga' ba ltar/ pha ma sems can la phan btags na rgyal ba sras bcas rnams thugs dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de'i mthus ma 'ongs pa na mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku thob pas nam yang mi 'jigs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ tshe thar srog blu byas pa'i mthus tshe 'dir yang tshe ring nad med pa'i tshe sgrub zhabs brtan kun gye mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas mjug tu ji ltar gdams pa ni/ deng sang sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig lta bu'i ston pa ni zhal mi bzhugs shing /dbang gyur gye skye bo phal cher zad pa dang / de nyid ma mthong ba'i skye bo mang pos ston pa'i bstan pa dkrugs pa'i dus 'dir thar 'dod rnams kyis bag yod dran shes bsten dgos te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa 'jig rten mig ni zum gyur cing / /dbang gyur skye bo phal cher zad pa na/ /de nyid 704

ma mthong rang dgar gyur pa yi/ /ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa 'di dkrugs so/ /rang byung rang byung bstan pa gces 'dzin rnams/ /mchog tu zhing gshegs 'gro mgon med pa na/ /'doms med yon tan 'joms par byed pa yi/ /dri mas dga' mgur deng sang 'di na spyod/ /de ltar thub pa dag gi bstan pa ni/ /lkog mar srog byin 'dra dang dri ma rnams/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su rigs nas ni/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis bag yod gyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zeg pa chen po'i chos kyi srog dang 'dra ba'i snying rje chen po'i bstan pa rin po che nyams pa'i dus 'dir sdig zas sha la sred pa mang pos sha zos chog pa'i lung rigs ltar snang mang po bstan nas/ rnam gsum dag ma dag gnyis ka 'jol nyog tu spyod pa'i dus 'dir blo gros can rnams kyis ston pa'i gsung rab dang / rgya bod mkhas grub tshad ldan rnam/sa kyi gsung dpang por bzhag nas blang dor ma nor bar mdzod ces gdams so/ /da ni nyi ma nub kyi ri mgor lhung ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che nub la nye/bstan pa'i rtsa ba snying rje chen po ni rang gzhan gang gi rgyud na med pa'i dus 'dir chos min sdig pa'i las la dga' ba rnams rgyal ba'i dus yin te/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 705

'byams pas/ e ma deng sang bstan pa yi/ /nyi ma nub kyi ri mgor lhung / /mdo rgyud zer gyi snang ba yang / /mkhas grub 'ga' las gang na'ang dkon/ /detha gzhung la bsten rnams kyang / /gzhan du log pa'i bshes kyis 'khrid/ /mig ldan 'gro ba ldongs 'gyur zhing / /'byung bo'i bya rnams dga' ba'i dus/ /chos ma yin rnams rgyal la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thog tu babs pa'i dus 'dir/ 'di 'dra'i chos bshad byed pa'ang dka' ste/ sa skya paṇa chen gyes/ da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /thal sbyar nas ni 'di skad gsol/ /bdag gis bden par smra lags sam/ /'on te dzun du smra bar bgye/ /bden par smras na gzhan sems bsreg /rdzun par smras na bstan pa 'jig /smra ba spangs na don mi rtogs/ /des na dam pa'i spyod pa dka'/ /e ṭa zhes bya'i drang srong mchog /de yis gsod pa'i mchod sbyin bkag /de'i tshe sha la dga' ba yi/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsad ces grags/ /deng sang na yang yul de la/ /e ṭa gdug pa'i yul zhes zer/ /dam chos smra ba'i dge slong mchog /me tog zla mdzes thugs rje can/ /dam chos bshad pa'i le lan gyis / /rgyal po'i chad pas bcad ces thos/ /gzhan yang bden par smra ba'i rgyus/ /smra ba po la 'jig rten kun/ /log par 'jug pa 706

mang lags pas/ /thugs rje mnga' bas bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs bzhin blo kha nang du log nas rang gi sems la blta bar bya ste/ mnyam med po to ba'i lam rim las/ 'dzam gling sangs rgyas gnyis par grags pa yi/ /jo bo'i bka' brgyud bdud rtsi lta bu 'di/ /tshong 'dus 'o ma bzhin du bsres bslad byas/ /deng sang dus na grong bskor byed par gyur/ /dam pa phan tshun gcig gis gcig bstod pa/ /deng sang dus na thams cad 'gran par gyur/ /dben par kun nas tshul bzhin sems pa de/ /deng sang dus na nyin par skar ma tsam/ /tshe 'di blos btang thar lam bsgom pa de/ /deng sang dus na rang 'do med par byed/ /tshe 'di'i don gnyer yo byad gsog pa de/ /deng sang dus na rang 'do can du byed/ /bslab la gus shing dman sa 'dzin pa de/ /deng sang dus na kun gyes brnyas bcos byed/ /sdig la mi 'dzem rtsab ral byed pa de/ /deng sang dus na kun gyes spyi bor bkur/ /dam pa thams cad rim gyes gshegs gyur pas/ /deng sang dus na brten sa med par gyur/ /rang gi 'khor ba'i skyon la bsam byas nas/ /shes pa nang du bzlog ste blta bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang sems la blta ba man ngag bla na med pa yin mod/707

'on kyang rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ sa 'di mkhas grub brgya stong gis/ /rin chen khur chen 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /'bad pa du mas de rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar so so'i legs bshad len/ /dus kyi dbang gis de nyams tshe/ /de dag rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud/ /yi ger bkod pa'i gzhung mang rnams/ /bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ /legs par sbyangs te len pa ni/ /de yi dod du mkhas pas shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag gis kyang sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyi thugs bcud yi ger bkod pa'i gzhung mang po nas 'di nyid blangs pa yin pas/ blo gros can gzhan gyis kyang 'di nyid nyams su len par 'os te/ slob dpon kā ma la shī las/ dam pa phrag dog la sogs dri ma thag bsring ba/ /yon tan rnams kyis mi mngon chu yi mtsho 'dra dag /rnam par phye nas legs par bshad rnams 'dzin byed de/ /ngang pa rab dga' chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /de lta bas na mkhas rnams kyis/ phyogs lhung dkrugs yid ring spongs la/ /byis pa las kyang legs bshad pa/ /thams cad blangs pa kho na yin/ /gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs na gang zag de gnas skabs kun tu bde zhing / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /708

smras pa/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas dus kun tu/ /snying rje'i yul gyur 'gro la lha chos kyi/ /snying po snying rje'i chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i/ /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyi rgyan kyi mchog /dpag med yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje rin po che'i/ /yon tan dran bzhin bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /snying rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /snying rje chen po gter chen bum bzang 'dra/ /snying rje chen po dpag bsam lngon shing 'dra/ /snying rje chen po 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /snying rje yod na chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /snying rje yod na bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /snying rje yod na sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /snying rje yod na lha mi kun gyis smon/ /snying rje yod na thog mar sems can kyi/ /don du smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed nus/ /snying rje yod na bar du rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rlabs po che la slob par nus/ /snying rje yod na tha mar sangs rgyas tshe/ /zhi bar mi gnas sems can 'dren par nus/ /snying rje che na gas nga sngags sgo ra zhugs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par nus/ /snying rje yod na bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyir/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum nus/ /snying rje chen pos bdag 709

yid rab bskyod nas/ /'gro la phan phyir snying rje'i glegs bam brtsams/ /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma rgyal sras kyis/ /gang brtsams 'gro la phan par byen gyes rlobs/ /lung dang rigs pa'i sdebs sbyor kun tshang ba'i/ /chos kyi snying po snying rje'i sman mar 'di/ /skal bzang chos mdzad yongs kyis gsol nus na/ /byang chub sems kyi lus stobs rgyas par 'gyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /snying rje chen po skye ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying rje chen po dang / /'bral ba med par shog ces smon lam 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do tshe rabs thams cad du/ /snying rje can gyi bla mar mjal bar shog /snying rje'i lha mchog sbyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /sa gzhi nam gnas bar du glegs bam 'dis/ /sa thog 'di na sdig zas sha yi phyir/ /sa la bsgyel nas sems can gsod tshad kyi/ /sa steng skye 'gro yongs la phan par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog gi nor bu ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rgyal bstan snying po snying rje'i nor bu yis/ /rgyal khams yongs la phan pa'i bkra shis shog /ces 710

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis gsungs pa'i byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi chos 'khor rnams kyi nang nas 'dir mkho ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pas glegs bam chung chung zhig longs tshe/ gsung chos de rnams las slar yang sprul ba'i glegs bam zhig dang 'dra ba byung snyam nas/ mtshan yang snying rje sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi yid la goms pa dang / skal bzang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir snga gong nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul ba/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i sprul sku rnam gsum dang / mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom kun bzang stobs ldan dbang po'i thugs sras rnam gnyis/skal ldan las 'phro can gyi dge slong blo gros/ mi gzhi lha las bzang ba'i mtshams pa tshe mgon/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bya bral 'jigs med/ gu yangs blo bde'i slob bu blo bzang mkhas mchog sogs theg pa chen po'i snod ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/ chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di kun gye rgyud la sgye dka' bar 'dug pas/ phyin chad snying rje skye ba'i thabs su 'di lta bu'i legs bshad zab mo zhig dgos zhes lha rdzas dang bcas te 711

yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig /swa ste/ rmad byung goms stobs thugs kyi rgya mtsho las/ /'khrungs pa'i gzhan phan snying rje'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /sdebs legs lung rigs ri dwags gzu gas kyis mjes/ /sngar med sprul ba'i glegs bam zla ba zhig /lhag bsam shar ri'i rtse las 'phags pa'i mod/ /chos brgyad chos su rlom pa'i pad ma zums/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i tsha gdung bcil/ /legs tshogs ku mud bzhad pa ma yin grang / /'gro la rjes brtse'i rgyun bzang gaṅgā mo/ /khyod thugs bde 'byung ral klong sim pa'i mthar/ /gzhan phan skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs pas/ /byang sems snying rje'i rgya mtshor cis mi 'jug /'on tang thub bstan chu lha'i 'phang bar phyogs/ /'dod lha'i bran g.yog ser gzugs 'byung po'i byas/ /nor 'dzin khengs la nye ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'di 'dra'i dam cho sa thos pa'ang mgon khyod drin/ /drin lan bsab phyir dbyangs gsal gzugs rir spel/ /spel ba'i dge 'bras ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam grol 712

nyer zhi'i sa la ma bzhag bar/ /bar mi 'chad pa'i gzhan don sgrub rgyur bsngo/ /de'i mthus rgyal bstan rin chen snying po'i bcud/ /las ldan skye rgu'i rgyud la rang zhugs nas/ /'go kun phan bde'i dpal gyis rtag 'tsho zhing / /thub bstan yun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang burnya rat+nas so/ /sarba maṅga lo// //713
